## tattva/lib/sensitive.ts

```ts
export type SensitiveKind = "card" | "key" | "password" | "email" | "phone";

export interface SensitiveFinding {
  id: string;
  kind: SensitiveKind;
  /** Where it is in the text, so it can be taken out. */
  start: number;
  end: number;
  /** A safe preview, such as "•••• 4242". */
  preview: string;
}

// A real card number passes the Luhn check, so a long order number does not count. A phone number is 10 digits, or
// 10 to 13 written the way phone numbers are (a + or spaces), so an order number is not one either.
const luhn = (digits: string) => {
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < digits.length; i++) {
    let d = Number(digits[digits.length - 1 - i]);
    if (i % 2 === 1) { d *= 2; if (d > 9) d -= 9; }
    sum += d;
  }
  return sum % 10 === 0;
};

const RULES: { kind: SensitiveKind; re: RegExp; ok?: (m: string) => boolean; preview: (m: string) => string }[] = [
  { kind: "card", re: /\b(?:\d[ -]?){13,19}\b/g, ok: (m) => luhn(m.replace(/\D/g, "")), preview: (m) => `•••• ${m.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(-4)}` },
  { kind: "key", re: /\b(?:sk|pk|rk|ghp|gho|xox[abp]|AKIA)[-_A-Za-z0-9]{12,}\b/g, preview: (m) => `${m.slice(0, 4)}••••` },
  { kind: "password", re: /\b(?:password|passcode|pwd)\s*(?:is|:|=)\s*\S+/gi, preview: () => "••••••" },
  { kind: "email", re: /\b[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.-]+\b/g, preview: (m) => `${m[0]}•••@${m.split("@")[1]}` },
  { kind: "phone", re: /(?<!\d)\+?\d[\d ()-]{8,14}\d(?!\d)/g, ok: (m) => { const n = m.replace(/\D/g, "").length; return n >= 10 && n <= 13 && (n === 10 || /[+ ()-]/.test(m)); }, preview: (m) => `•••• ${m.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(-3)}` },
];

/**
 * Finds private details in a message before it is sent: card numbers (Luhn checked), API keys, passwords written
 * as "password: …", email addresses and phone numbers. It runs on the person's device; nothing is sent anywhere.
 * Overlapping matches keep the first, most specific kind (a card number is not also a phone number).
 */
export function findSensitive(text: string, kinds: SensitiveKind[] = ["card", "key", "password", "email", "phone"]): SensitiveFinding[] {
  const out: SensitiveFinding[] = [];
  for (const r of RULES) {
    if (!kinds.includes(r.kind)) continue;
    for (const m of text.matchAll(r.re)) {
      const raw = m[0].replace(/[ -]+$/, ""); // a match never ends in the space after a number
      const start = m.index ?? 0, end = start + raw.length;
      if (r.ok && !r.ok(raw)) continue;
      if (out.some((f) => start < f.end && end > f.start)) continue;
      out.push({ id: `${r.kind}-${start}`, kind: r.kind, start, end, preview: r.preview(raw) });
    }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
}

/** The text with the given findings taken out. */
export function removeSensitive(text: string, findings: SensitiveFinding[]): string {
  let out = text;
  for (const f of [...findings].sort((a, b) => b.start - a.start)) out = out.slice(0, f.start) + out.slice(f.end);
  return out.replace(/[ \t]{2,}/g, " ").replace(/\s+([,.;:!?])/g, "$1").trim();
}
```

## tattva/lib/useFocusAfter.ts

```ts
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

/**
 * Keeps keyboard focus in place when a part swaps the control someone just pressed for something else
 * (Keep becomes a "Kept" badge, Confirm becomes a summary). Call `arm()` in the handler; when `key`
 * next changes and focus has fallen to the page body, focus moves to what `target()` returns.
 */
export function useFocusAfter(key: unknown, target: () => HTMLElement | null | undefined) {
  const armed = useRef(false);
  const pick = useRef(target);
  pick.current = target;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!armed.current) return;
    armed.current = false;
    const a = document.activeElement;
    if (a && a !== document.body && a.isConnected) return;
    pick.current()?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [key]);
  return () => { armed.current = true; };
}

export type HeadingLevel = 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
/** The heading tag for a level, and the one below it for inner headings (never deeper than h6). */
export const headingTag = (level: HeadingLevel) => `h${level}` as "h2" | "h3" | "h4" | "h5" | "h6";
export const subHeadingTag = (level: HeadingLevel) => headingTag(Math.min(level + 1, 6) as HeadingLevel);
```

## tattva/molecules/AILabel.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { AIMark } from "../atoms/AIMark";
import { Popover } from "../atoms/Popover";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { RevertAIIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export type AILabelLevel = "feature" | "message" | "field" | "image";
export type AILabelSize = 16 | 18 | 22;

export interface AILabelProps {
  /** Where the label sits. Sets the placement classes when `placed` is true and the side the explainer opens toward. */
  level?: AILabelLevel;
  /** Pixel size. Match the text beside it: 16 for 12px text, 18 for 14px, 22 for 16px. Use one size smaller next to ghost icon buttons. */
  size?: AILabelSize;
  /** Text in the pill. */
  text?: string;
  /** Apply absolute placement for the level. The parent needs `relative`. Leave false to place the label yourself, for example inline in a row. */
  placed?: boolean;
  /** Toggletip section: a short statement of what the AI did here. */
  overview?: ReactNode;
  /** Toggletip section: model, inputs, limits or anything specific to this instance. */
  details?: ReactNode;
  /** Toggletip section: links to documentation or sources. */
  resources?: ReactNode;
  /** Toggletip section: controls such as Learn more or Turn off. The label never triggers an AI action itself. */
  actions?: ReactNode;
  /** True once a person has edited the content. The tint is dropped and an icon-only revert button replaces the pill. */
  edited?: boolean;
  /** Called when the revert button is pressed. The app restores the AI version and sets `edited` back to false. */
  onRevert?: () => void;
  /** Accessible name for the revert button. */
  revertLabel?: string;
  /** Accessible name for the toggletip panel. */
  popoverLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const PILL: Record<AILabelSize, string> = {
  16: "h-4 gap-0.5 px-1.5 text-nano leading-4",
  18: "h-4.5 gap-1 px-2 text-micro leading-chip",
  22: "h-5.5 gap-1 px-2.5 text-small leading-chip-lg",
};
const MARK: Record<AILabelSize, 16 | 18 | 22> = { 16: 16, 18: 16, 22: 16 };
const PLACE: Record<AILabelLevel, string> = {
  feature: "absolute top-3 right-3",
  message: "",
  field: "absolute top-1/2 right-3 -translate-y-1/2",
  image: "absolute bottom-2 left-2",
};

/**
 * Marks content as produced by AI and opens a toggletip that explains it. The pill is a lime fill with charcoal text.
 * It labels and explains. It never starts an AI action. After a person edits the content the pill is replaced by an
 * icon-only revert button, and reverting brings the pill back.
 */
export function AILabel({
  level = "feature", size = 18, text = "AI", placed = false, overview, details, resources, actions,
  edited = false, onRevert, revertLabel = "Revert to AI version", popoverLabel = "About this AI content", className,
}: AILabelProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const place = placed ? PLACE[level] : "";

  if (edited) {
    return (
      <button type="button" aria-label={revertLabel} title={revertLabel} onClick={onRevert}
        className={cn("inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-control border border-line bg-surface text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg pointer-coarse:size-11", place, className)}>
        <RevertAIIcon width={size === 16 ? 14 : 16} height={size === 16 ? 14 : 16} />
      </button>
    );
  }

  const sections: [string, ReactNode][] = ([["Overview", overview], ["Details", details], ["Resources", resources], ["Actions", actions]] as [string, ReactNode][]).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== false);

  return (
    <span className={cn("inline-flex align-middle", place, className)} onBlur={(e) => { if (open && !e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setOpen(false); }}>
      <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} label={popoverLabel} align={level === "image" || level === "message" ? "start" : "end"} side={level === "image" ? "top" : "bottom"}
        panelClassName="w-72 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] p-4"
        trigger={({ triggerProps, toggle }) => (
          <button type="button" onClick={toggle} {...triggerProps} aria-label={`${text}. About this AI content`}
            className="group inline-flex min-h-6 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-control tap">
            <span className={cn("inline-flex animate-pop items-center rounded-control border border-transparent bg-lime font-medium text-on-lime group-hover:bg-lime-hover", PILL[size])}>
              <AIMark size={MARK[size]} />{text}
            </span>
          </button>
        )}>
        {sections.length === 0 ? <p className="text-compact leading-5 text-fg-muted">This content was produced by AI.</p> : (
          <div className="space-y-3 text-compact leading-5 text-fg-muted">
            {sections.map(([name, body]) => (
              <section key={name} aria-label={name}>
                <h4 className="font-sans! mb-1 text-nano font-normal uppercase tracking-caps text-fg-subtle">{name}</h4>
                <div className={name === "Actions" ? "flex flex-wrap gap-2" : undefined}>{body}</div>
              </section>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </Popover>
    </span>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/AttachmentChip.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { keepFocus, useAnnounceChange } from "../lib/focus";
import { FileIcon, ImageIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Meter } from "../atoms/Meter";

export type AttachmentStatus = "ready" | "uploading" | "error";

export interface AttachmentChipProps {
  /** File name. */
  name: string;
  /** Display size such as "2.4 MB". */
  size?: string;
  /** Picks the default icon when no thumbnail is given. */
  kind?: "file" | "image";
  /** Replaces the default icon, for example an img element. Keep it decorative. */
  thumbnail?: ReactNode;
  status?: AttachmentStatus;
  /** Upload progress from 0 to 100. Used while status is "uploading". */
  progress?: number;
  /** Text shown when status is "error". */
  errorMessage?: string;
  /** Shows a Retry button in the error state. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** Shows the remove button. The button is named after the file. */
  onRemove?: () => void;
  /** Where keyboard focus goes after Remove. By default the next attachment, else the previous one, else the message box. */
  focusAfterRemove?: () => HTMLElement | null;
  /** What screen readers hear when the upload finishes. Defaults to "(name) uploaded". */
  readyMessage?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** File or image chip for the composer. Shows upload progress as a meter and a retry action when the upload fails. */
export function AttachmentChip({ name, size, kind = "file", thumbnail, status = "ready", progress = 0, errorMessage = "Upload failed", onRetry, onRemove, focusAfterRemove, readyMessage, className }: AttachmentChipProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  // Uploads finishing or failing are read out; the chip appearing is not.
  const said = useAnnounceChange(status, (now) => (now === "ready" ? readyMessage ?? `${name} uploaded` : now === "error" ? `${name}: ${errorMessage}` : ""));
  const pct = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress)));
  const Icon = kind === "image" ? ImageIcon : FileIcon;
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cn("flex w-64 max-w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-card border bg-surface p-2", status === "error" ? "border-danger-line" : "border-line", className)}>
      <span className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-sunken text-fg-muted">
        {thumbnail ?? <Icon width={18} height={18} />}
      </span>
      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span className="block truncate text-compact font-medium text-fg" title={name}>{name}</span>
        {status === "ready" && size && <span className="block text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{size}</span>}
        {status === "uploading" && (
          <span className="mt-1 block">
            <Meter value={pct} label={`Uploading ${name}`} valueText={`${pct}% uploaded`} />
            <span className="mt-1 block text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted tabular-nums">Uploading {pct}%{size ? ` of ${size}` : ""}</span>
          </span>
        )}
        {status === "error" && <span className="block truncate text-small leading-4 text-danger-fg">{errorMessage}</span>}
      </span>
      {status === "error" && onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onRetry} aria-label={`Retry upload of ${name}`}>Retry</Button>}
      {onRemove && (
        <IconButton label={`Remove ${name}`} size="sm" onClick={() => { onRemove(); keepFocus(ref.current, focusAfterRemove); }}><XIcon width={14} height={14} /></IconButton>
      )}
      <span role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{said}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/AudioPlayer.tsx

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, DownloadIcon, RetryIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Select } from "../atoms/Select";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";
import { Waveform, formatMediaTime } from "../atoms/Waveform";
import type { WaveformMarker, WaveformRegion } from "../atoms/Waveform";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";
import { AILabel } from "./AILabel";

/**
 * loading: getting the file. streaming: playable while the end is still being made. ready: loaded, not started.
 * playing, paused, buffering (waiting for data), ended, error (could not load), unavailable (the app will not play it, with a reason).
 */
export type PlayerState = "loading" | "streaming" | "ready" | "playing" | "paused" | "buffering" | "ended" | "error" | "unavailable";

export interface AudioPlayerProps {
  /** Title of the clip. Also names the player region. */
  title: string;
  /** A second line, such as "Support call, 3 October, 14:02". */
  subtitle?: string;
  /** A real audio file. Leave out to simulate playback from `duration` (for previews, tests and docs). */
  src?: string;
  /** Length in seconds. Needed without `src`; with `src` it is read from the file when left out. */
  duration?: number;
  /** Loudness per slice, each 0 to 1, worked out ahead of time. `null` shows the waveform still drawing. Leave out for a plain bar. */
  peaks?: number[] | null;
  /** Forces a state the player cannot find out on its own: loading, streaming, buffering, error or unavailable. Ready, playing, paused and ended are always tracked by the player. */
  state?: PlayerState;
  /** Position in seconds, when the parent keeps it (for example to sync a transcript). A change of more than a quarter second seeks. */
  current?: number;
  /** Called as the position moves, from playback or a seek. */
  onTimeChange?: (seconds: number) => void;
  /** Called when playback starts or stops. */
  onPlayingChange?: (playing: boolean) => void;
  /** Moments on the timeline, such as tool calls or interruptions. Use tone `review` only for one a person must check. */
  markers?: WaveformMarker[];
  /** Marked stretches, such as an AI-made section. */
  regions?: WaveformRegion[];
  /** In the streaming state, the seconds made so far. The rest of the track is drawn dashed. */
  madeUpTo?: number;
  /** Speeds offered. The first time it plays at 1. */
  speeds?: number[];
  /** The clip was made by AI (a generated voice, song or effect). Adds an AI label; the player itself stays neutral. */
  aiGenerated?: boolean;
  /** What the AI label explains, such as the model and voice used. */
  aiNote?: ReactNode;
  /** Shows a Download button. */
  onDownload?: () => void;
  /** Short note beside Download, such as "2 downloads left this month". */
  downloadNote?: string;
  /** Why it cannot be played, shown in the unavailable state, such as "Recordings are kept for 30 days." */
  unavailableReason?: string;
  /** Message in the error state. */
  errorText?: string;
  /** Shows Try again in the error state. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** Lock-screen details while playing (Media Session). */
  mediaSession?: { artist?: string; artwork?: string };
  /** One row, 56px tall, for lists. No waveform, speed or download. */
  compact?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const STATE_WORD: Record<PlayerState, string> = {
  loading: "Loading", streaming: "Still making the end", ready: "Ready", playing: "Playing", paused: "Paused",
  buffering: "Buffering", ended: "Ended", error: "Could not play", unavailable: "Not available",
};
const PLAY_EVENT = "tattva-audio-play";

const PlayGlyph = () => <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="size-5" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5.5v13a1 1 0 0 0 1.5.86l10.5-6.5a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.72L9.5 4.64A1 1 0 0 0 8 5.5z" /></svg>;
const PauseGlyph = () => <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="size-5" fill="currentColor"><rect x="6.5" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1" /><rect x="13.5" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1" /></svg>;
const ReplayGlyph = () => <RetryIcon width={20} height={20} aria-hidden />;

const isTyping = (el: EventTarget | null) => el instanceof HTMLElement && (el.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(el.tagName));

/**
 * Plays one clip: a call recording, a generated voice or a song. Play and pause, a waveform you can seek, time, speed and download.
 * It works without a file by simulating playback from `duration`, and plays a real file when `src` is set.
 * Nothing plays until the person presses Play, and starting one player pauses any other on the page.
 */
export function AudioPlayer({
  title, subtitle, src, duration, peaks, state: forced, current, onTimeChange, onPlayingChange, markers, regions, madeUpTo,
  speeds = [0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2], aiGenerated, aiNote, onDownload, downloadNote, unavailableReason, errorText = "This audio could not be loaded.",
  onRetry, mediaSession, compact = false, className,
}: AudioPlayerProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const titleId = `${id}-title`;
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const audio = useRef<HTMLAudioElement>(null);
  const [time, setTime] = useState(current ?? 0);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [ended, setEnded] = useState(false);
  const [rate, setRate] = useState(1);
  const [fileDur, setFileDur] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [fileState, setFileState] = useState<"loading" | "ok" | "buffering" | "error">(src ? "loading" : "ok");
  const [slowBuffer, setSlowBuffer] = useState(false);
  const timeRef = useRef(time);
  timeRef.current = time;

  const dur = duration ?? fileDur ?? 0;
  const blocked = forced === "loading" || forced === "error" || forced === "unavailable";
  const derived: PlayerState = src && fileState === "loading" ? "loading" : src && fileState === "error" ? "error"
    : playing && (forced === "buffering" || fileState === "buffering") ? "buffering"
    : playing ? "playing" : ended ? "ended" : time > 0 ? "paused" : "ready";
  // The app can force the states the player cannot see for itself. The rest are tracked here.
  const state: PlayerState = blocked || forced === "buffering" ? forced! : forced === "streaming" && !playing && !ended ? "streaming" : derived;
  const canPlay = state !== "loading" && state !== "error" && state !== "unavailable" && dur > 0;

  const report = useCallback((t: number) => { setTime(t); onTimeChange?.(t); }, [onTimeChange]);

  const setPlay = useCallback((on: boolean) => {
    setPlaying(on);
    onPlayingChange?.(on);
    if (on) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(PLAY_EVENT, { detail: id }));
  }, [id, onPlayingChange]);

  const seek = useCallback((t: number) => {
    const to = Math.min(Math.max(0, t), dur || 0);
    if (audio.current) audio.current.currentTime = to;
    setEnded(false);
    report(to);
  }, [dur, report]);

  // The parent moved the position (for example a transcript line was pressed).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (current !== undefined && Math.abs(current - timeRef.current) > 0.25) seek(current);
  }, [current, seek]);

  // Only one player plays at a time.
  useEffect(() => {
    const other = (e: Event) => { if ((e as CustomEvent).detail !== id) { setPlaying(false); audio.current?.pause(); } };
    window.addEventListener(PLAY_EVENT, other);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(PLAY_EVENT, other);
  }, [id]);

  // A real file plays through the audio element.
  useEffect(() => {
    const a = audio.current;
    if (!a || !src) return;
    a.playbackRate = rate;
    if (playing && !blocked) a.play().catch(() => { setPlay(false); });
    else a.pause();
  }, [playing, rate, src, blocked, setPlay]);

  // Without a file, a clock moves the position. It ticks less often with reduced motion.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (src || !playing || blocked || forced === "buffering") return;
    const step = reduced ? 250 : 100;
    let last = performance.now();
    const t = window.setInterval(() => {
      const now = performance.now();
      const next = timeRef.current + ((now - last) / 1000) * rate;
      last = now;
      if (next >= dur) { report(dur); setPlay(false); setEnded(true); } else report(next);
    }, step);
    return () => window.clearInterval(t);
  }, [src, playing, blocked, forced, reduced, rate, dur, report, setPlay]);

  // Buffering shows a spinner only after 300ms, so short waits do not flicker.
  const buffering = state === "buffering";
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!buffering) { setSlowBuffer(false); return; }
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setSlowBuffer(true), 300);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [buffering]);

  // Lock-screen controls while this clip plays.
  useEffect(() => {
    const ms = typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.mediaSession : undefined;
    if (!ms || !playing || typeof MediaMetadata === "undefined") return;
    ms.metadata = new MediaMetadata({ title, artist: mediaSession?.artist, artwork: mediaSession?.artwork ? [{ src: mediaSession.artwork }] : undefined });
    ms.setActionHandler("play", () => setPlay(true));
    ms.setActionHandler("pause", () => setPlay(false));
    ms.setActionHandler("seekto", (d) => { if (d.seekTime !== undefined) seek(d.seekTime); });
    return () => { ms.setActionHandler("play", null); ms.setActionHandler("pause", null); ms.setActionHandler("seekto", null); };
  }, [playing, title, mediaSession?.artist, mediaSession?.artwork, setPlay, seek]);

  const toggle = () => {
    if (!canPlay) return;
    if (playing) { setPlay(false); return; }
    if (ended || time >= dur) { seek(0); }
    setEnded(false);
    setPlay(true);
  };

  // Space and K play or pause while focus is in the player, but never while typing or on a control that uses Space itself.
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || isTyping(e.target)) return;
    const onButton = e.target instanceof HTMLElement && e.target.tagName === "BUTTON";
    if ((e.key === " " && !onButton) || e.key === "k" || e.key === "K") { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }
  };

  const glyph = playing ? <PauseGlyph /> : state === "ended" ? <ReplayGlyph /> : <PlayGlyph />;
  const notice = state === "error" || state === "unavailable" || state === "buffering" || state === "ended" || state === "streaming";
  const timeText = <span className="tabular-nums">{formatMediaTime(time)} / {dur ? formatMediaTime(dur) : "–:––"}</span>;

  const playButton = (
    <button type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label="Play" aria-pressed={playing} aria-disabled={!canPlay || undefined}
      className={cn("relative inline-flex size-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent text-on-accent transition-colors duration-(--dur-instant) hover:bg-accent-hover",
        !canPlay && "cursor-default bg-sunken text-fg-subtle hover:bg-sunken")}>
      {state === "loading" ? <Spinner size={18} label="Loading" /> : glyph}
      {slowBuffer && <span className="absolute -right-1 -bottom-1 rounded-full bg-surface p-0.5"><Spinner size={14} label="Buffering" /></span>}
    </button>
  );

  const heading = (
    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
        <span id={titleId} className="truncate text-compact font-medium text-fg">{title}</span>
        {aiGenerated && <AILabel level="message" size={16} text="AI" overview={aiNote ?? "This audio was made by an AI voice or music model."} popoverLabel={`About the AI in ${title}`} />}
      </div>
      <p className="truncate text-small text-fg-muted">
        {compact ? <>{timeText} · {STATE_WORD[state]}</> : subtitle ?? STATE_WORD[state]}
      </p>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={titleId} onKeyDown={onKey}
      className={cn("min-w-0 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface", compact ? "flex min-h-14 items-center gap-3 px-3 py-1.5" : "flex flex-col gap-2 p-3 sm:p-4", className)}>
      {src && (
        <audio ref={audio} src={src} preload="metadata" className="hidden"
          onLoadedMetadata={(e) => { setFileDur(e.currentTarget.duration); setFileState("ok"); }}
          onCanPlay={() => setFileState("ok")} onWaiting={() => setFileState("buffering")} onPlaying={() => setFileState("ok")}
          onError={() => { setFileState("error"); setPlay(false); }}
          onTimeUpdate={(e) => report(e.currentTarget.currentTime)}
          onEnded={() => { setPlay(false); setEnded(true); }} />
      )}
      {compact ? (<>{playButton}{heading}</>) : (
        <>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {playButton}
            {heading}
          </div>
          {state === "error" ? (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-field bg-sunken px-3 py-2 text-compact text-fg">
              <AlertIcon width={16} height={16} aria-hidden className="shrink-0 text-danger-fg" />
              <span className="min-w-40 flex-1">{errorText}</span>
              {onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onRetry} leading={<RetryIcon width={14} height={14} />} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Try again</Button>}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <Waveform peaks={peaks === undefined ? (state === "loading" ? null : []) : state === "loading" ? null : peaks}
              simple={peaks === undefined} duration={dur} position={time} onSeek={canPlay ? seek : undefined}
              label={`Seek, ${title}`} markers={markers} regions={regions} height={48}
              pendingFrom={forced === "streaming" ? (madeUpTo ?? dur) : undefined} />
          )}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2 text-small text-fg-muted">
            {timeText}
            <span className="flex-1" />
            {speeds.length > 1 && (
              <span className="w-24 shrink-0"><Select size="sm" aria-label="Playback speed" value={String(rate)} disabled={!canPlay}
                onChange={(e) => setRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                options={speeds.map((s) => ({ value: String(s), label: `${s}×` }))} /></span>
            )}
            {state === "unavailable" ? (
              <span className="text-fg-muted">{unavailableReason ?? "This audio cannot be played or downloaded."}</span>
            ) : onDownload && (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {downloadNote && <span>{downloadNote}</span>}
                <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onDownload} leading={<DownloadIcon width={14} height={14} />} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Download</Button>
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {/* State changes worth hearing; not the clock, and not play or pause, which the button already says. */}
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{notice ? `${title}: ${STATE_WORD[state]}.${state === "error" ? ` ${errorText}` : ""}${state === "unavailable" && unavailableReason ? ` ${unavailableReason}` : ""}` : ""}</span>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/AutonomyLevel.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";

export type Altitude = "summary" | "steps" | "everything";

export interface AutonomyLevelProps {
  /** Selected view (controlled). */
  value?: Altitude;
  /** Starting view when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: Altitude;
  onChange?: (value: Altitude) => void;
  /** Replace the names of the views. */
  labels?: Partial<Record<Altitude, string>>;
  /** Replace the line that explains each view. */
  hints?: Partial<Record<Altitude, string>>;
  /** Accessible name for the group. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const defaultLabels: Record<Altitude, string> = { summary: "Summary", steps: "Steps", everything: "Everything" };
const defaultHints: Record<Altitude, string> = {
  summary: "A short account of the result and anything that needs you.",
  steps: "Each thing the assistant did, one line at a time.",
  everything: "Every detail, including what it read and tried.",
};
const order: Altitude[] = ["summary", "steps", "everything"];

/** Switch between three levels of detail about what an agent did. Arrow keys move and select. */
export function AutonomyLevel({ value, defaultValue = "summary", onChange, labels, hints, label = "How much detail", className }: AutonomyLevelProps) {
  const [inner, setInner] = useState<Altitude>(defaultValue);
  const current = value ?? inner;
  const uid = useId();
  const l = { ...defaultLabels, ...labels };
  const h = { ...defaultHints, ...hints };
  return (
    <div className={cn("min-w-0", className)}>
      <div className="max-w-full overflow-x-auto">
        <SegmentedControl label={label} value={current} options={order.map((k) => ({ value: k, label: l[k] }))}
          onChange={(v) => { if (value === undefined) setInner(v); onChange?.(v); }} />
      </div>
      <p id={`${uid}-hint`} className="mt-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{h[current]}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

/** @deprecated Renamed to AutonomyLevel in 0.29.0, to match the name other design systems use. The old name goes in 0.31.0. */
export const AltitudeToggle = AutonomyLevel;
/** @deprecated Renamed to AutonomyLevelProps in 0.29.0. */
export type AltitudeToggleProps = AutonomyLevelProps;
```

## tattva/molecules/AvatarStack.tsx

```tsx
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { PlusIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Avatar } from "../atoms/Avatar";

export interface AvatarStackPerson {
  name: string;
  kind?: "user" | "ai";
}

export interface AvatarStackProps {
  /** People to show, most relevant first. Only the first `max` are drawn. */
  people: AvatarStackPerson[];
  /** Everyone counted, including the ones drawn. The number shown is the rest: `total - drawn`. Defaults to `people.length`. */
  total?: number;
  /** How many avatars to draw before the plus and the number. */
  max?: number;
  /** Word after the number, e.g. "others" or "more viewers". */
  label?: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md";
  /** Show large numbers short, e.g. 1.2k instead of 1,248. */
  compact?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * A few overlapping avatars, a plus, then how many more people there are.
 * The picture is decoration; screen readers hear one plain sentence with the names and the count.
 */
export function AvatarStack({ people, total = people.length, max = 3, label = "others", size = "md", compact = false, className }: AvatarStackProps) {
  const shown = people.slice(0, Math.max(0, max));
  const rest = Math.max(0, total - shown.length);
  const fmt = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, compact ? { notation: "compact", maximumFractionDigits: 1 } : undefined);
  const names = shown.map((p) => (p.kind === "ai" ? "Assistant" : p.name));
  const sentence = names.length === 0
    ? `${fmt.format(rest)} ${label}`
    : rest > 0 ? `${names.join(", ")} and ${fmt.format(rest)} ${label}` : names.length > 1 ? `${names.slice(0, -1).join(", ")} and ${names[names.length - 1]}` : names[0];
  const ring = "ring-2 ring-[var(--bg)]";
  const disc = size === "sm" ? "size-6" : "size-8";
  return (
    <span className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-2", className)}>
      <span aria-hidden className="flex items-center">
        {shown.map((p, i) => (
          <Avatar key={`${p.name}-${i}`} kind={p.kind ?? "user"} name={p.name} size={size} className={cn(ring, i > 0 && (size === "sm" ? "-ml-1.5" : "-ml-2.5"))} />
        ))}
        {rest > 0 && (
          <span className={cn("inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line bg-surface text-fg-muted", disc, ring, shown.length > 0 && (size === "sm" ? "-ml-1.5" : "-ml-2.5"))}>
            <PlusIcon width={size === "sm" ? 11 : 14} height={size === "sm" ? 11 : 14} />
          </span>
        )}
      </span>
      {rest > 0 && (
        <span aria-hidden className={cn("tabular-nums text-fg", size === "sm" ? "text-small leading-4" : "text-body leading-5")}>
          <span className="font-semibold">{fmt.format(rest)}</span> <span className="text-fg-muted">{label}</span>
        </span>
      )}
      <span className="sr-only">{sentence}</span>
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AgentStatusIcon, type AgentStatus } from "../atoms/AgentStatusIcon";

export interface BackgroundRunChipProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "children"> {
  /** Name of the run, such as "Trip plan". */
  name: string;
  status: AgentStatus;
  /** Short plain status, such as "Booking hotels". Defaults to the status name. */
  statusText?: string;
  /** How long the run has been going, such as "4 min". */
  elapsed?: string;
  /** Pass true while the details panel this chip opens is showing. */
  expanded?: boolean;
}

const defaults: Record<AgentStatus, string> = {
  working: "Working", "needs-input": "Needs you", idle: "Waiting", completed: "Done", failed: "Failed", stopped: "Stopped",
};

/**
 * Compact chip for a run in the background. It is a button that opens details or a peek. A run that
 * needs a person gets the amber style; every other state stays neutral. The state icon, the words and
 * the time are read together as the button name.
 */
export function BackgroundRunChip({ name, status, statusText, elapsed, expanded, className, type = "button", ...rest }: BackgroundRunChipProps) {
  const needs = status === "needs-input";
  return (
    <button type={type} aria-expanded={expanded} {...rest}
      className={cn("inline-flex max-w-full min-w-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-control border px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-small leading-4 transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)]",
        needs ? "border-transparent bg-attention-soft text-attention-fg hover:opacity-90" : "border-line bg-surface text-fg hover:border-line-strong hover:bg-bg", className)}>
      <AgentStatusIcon status={status} size={14} className={needs ? "text-attention-fg" : undefined} />
      <span className="truncate font-medium">{name}</span>
      <span className={cn("truncate", needs ? "" : "text-fg-muted")}>{statusText ?? defaults[status]}</span>
      {elapsed && <span className={cn("shrink-0 tabular-nums", needs ? "" : "text-fg-subtle")}>{elapsed}</span>}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, InfoIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import type { Tone } from "../atoms/Badge";

const calloutTones: Record<Exclude<Tone, "neutral" | "accent" | "lime" | "unsure" | "celebrate">, string> = {
  info: "bg-info-soft text-info-fg",
  success: "bg-success-soft text-success-fg",
  warning: "bg-warning-soft text-warning-fg",
  danger: "bg-danger-soft text-danger-fg",
};

export function Callout({ tone = "info", title, children, action }: { tone?: keyof typeof calloutTones; title?: string; children?: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode }) {
  const Icon = tone === "info" || tone === "success" ? InfoIcon : AlertIcon;
  return (
    <div role={tone === "danger" ? "alert" : "status"} className={cn("flex gap-3 rounded-card p-4 text-body leading-5 max-sm:flex-wrap", calloutTones[tone])}>

        {title && <p className="font-medium">{title}</p>}
        {children && <div className={cn(title && "mt-0.5")}>{children}</div>}
      </div>
      {action && <div className="shrink-0 max-sm:basis-full max-sm:pl-8">{action}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/CameraMovePicker.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";

export type CameraMove =
  | "static" | "pushIn" | "pullOut" | "panLeft" | "panRight" | "tiltUp" | "tiltDown"
  | "truckLeft" | "truckRight" | "orbit" | "crane" | "tracking" | "handheld";

export type CameraStrength = "subtle" | "strong";

/** Plain names and one-line meanings, so nobody has to learn camera jargon. */
export const cameraMoveInfo: Record<CameraMove, { name: string; meaning: string }> = {
  static: { name: "Static", meaning: "The camera does not move." },
  pushIn: { name: "Push in", meaning: "The camera moves closer to the subject." },
  pullOut: { name: "Pull out", meaning: "The camera moves away from the subject." },
  panLeft: { name: "Pan left", meaning: "The camera turns to the left." },
  panRight: { name: "Pan right", meaning: "The camera turns to the right." },
  tiltUp: { name: "Tilt up", meaning: "The camera tips upward." },
  tiltDown: { name: "Tilt down", meaning: "The camera tips downward." },
  truckLeft: { name: "Truck left", meaning: "The camera slides sideways to the left." },
  truckRight: { name: "Truck right", meaning: "The camera slides sideways to the right." },
  orbit: { name: "Orbit", meaning: "The camera circles around the subject." },
  crane: { name: "Crane up", meaning: "The camera rises above the scene." },
  tracking: { name: "Tracking", meaning: "The camera follows a moving subject." },
  handheld: { name: "Handheld", meaning: "A slight, natural shake, as if held by hand." },
};

export const allCameraMoves = Object.keys(cameraMoveInfo) as CameraMove[];

export interface CameraMovePickerProps {
  /** Chosen moves, in the order they were picked. Static is never combined with other moves. */
  value: CameraMove[];
  onChange: (value: CameraMove[]) => void;
  /** Visible name of the group. */
  label?: string;
  /** Moves to offer, in order. Defaults to all of them. */
  moves?: CameraMove[];
  /** How many moves can be combined. 1 makes it a single choice. */
  max?: number;
  /** Moves the chosen model can make. Others stay visible but cannot be picked. Leave out when all are supported. */
  supported?: CameraMove[];
  /** Why the other moves cannot be picked, for example "Not available with Reel Lite". */
  unsupportedReason?: string;
  /** How strong the move is. Shown only with onStrengthChange and a moving choice. */
  strength?: CameraStrength;
  onStrengthChange?: (strength: CameraStrength) => void;
  /** Turns the whole picker off, for example while a take is generating. */
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/* ---------- diagrams ----------
   Each diagram is a frame with a subject and a fixed arrow for the move. On hover or keyboard focus the subject moves
   once, as it would appear in the shot, and holds. It never loops. Under reduced motion nothing moves: the arrow and the
   still subject already say what the move is. */

const still = "transition-transform duration-(--dur-slow) ease-(--ease-out) transform-fill origin-center motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:translate-none! motion-reduce:scale-none! motion-reduce:rotate-none!";

/** Where the subject goes during the preview, written as utilities that only apply while the tile is hovered or focused. */
const subjectMotion: Record<CameraMove, string> = {
  static: "",
  pushIn: "group-hover:scale-150 group-focus-visible:scale-150",
  pullOut: "scale-150 group-hover:scale-100 group-focus-visible:scale-100",
  panLeft: "group-hover:translate-x-1.5 group-focus-visible:translate-x-1.5",
  panRight: "group-hover:-translate-x-1.5 group-focus-visible:-translate-x-1.5",
  tiltUp: "group-hover:translate-y-1 group-focus-visible:translate-y-1",
  tiltDown: "group-hover:-translate-y-1 group-focus-visible:-translate-y-1",
  truckLeft: "group-hover:translate-x-2 group-focus-visible:translate-x-2",
  truckRight: "group-hover:-translate-x-2 group-focus-visible:-translate-x-2",
  orbit: "group-hover:scale-x-50 group-focus-visible:scale-x-50",
  crane: "group-hover:translate-y-1 group-hover:scale-90 group-focus-visible:translate-y-1 group-focus-visible:scale-90",
  tracking: "",
  handheld: "group-hover:translate-x-0.5 group-hover:rotate-6 group-focus-visible:translate-x-0.5 group-focus-visible:rotate-6",
};

/** Background marks that move instead of the subject (the subject stays centred while the world slides by). */
const groundMotion: Partial<Record<CameraMove, string>> = {
  tracking: "group-hover:-translate-x-2 group-focus-visible:-translate-x-2",
};

/** The fixed arrow (or mark) for each move, drawn in a 32 by 24 box. */
const arrows: Record<CameraMove, ReactNode> = {
  static: <path d="M13 21h6M16 18v3" />,
  pushIn: <path d="M4 5l3 3M28 5l-3 3M4 19l3-3M28 19l-3-3" />,
  pullOut: <path d="M7 8L4 5M25 8l3-3M7 16l-3 3M25 16l3 3M4 7V5h2M28 7V5h-2M4 17v2h2M28 17v2h-2" />,
  panLeft: <path d="M11 21H5M7 19l-2 2 2 2" />,
  panRight: <path d="M21 21h6M25 19l2 2-2 2" />,
  tiltUp: <path d="M28 15V7M26 9l2-2 2 2" />,
  tiltDown: <path d="M28 9v8M26 15l2 2 2-2" />,
  truckLeft: <path d="M22 21H5M7 19l-2 2 2 2" />,
  truckRight: <path d="M10 21h17M25 19l2 2-2 2" />,
  orbit: <path d="M7 19c3 3 15 3 18 0M23 17l2 2-2.5 1" />,
  crane: <path d="M28 18V5M26 7l2-2 2 2" />,
  tracking: <path d="M21 4h6M25 2l2 2-2 2" />,
  handheld: <path d="M5 21l2-1.5 2 1.5 2-1.5 2 1.5" />,
};

function MoveDiagram({ move }: { move: CameraMove }) {
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 32 24" className="h-6 w-8 shrink-0 overflow-visible" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
      <rect x="2" y="1.5" width="28" height="21" rx="2.5" strokeOpacity={0.35} />
      <g className={cn(still, groundMotion[move])} strokeOpacity={0.45}>
        <path d="M6 17h20" />
        {move === "tracking" && <path d="M9 15v4M15 15v4M21 15v4" />}
      </g>
      <g className={cn(still, subjectMotion[move])}>
        <circle cx="16" cy="9" r="2.2" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" />
        <path d="M13 15c.5-2.2 1.6-3.2 3-3.2s2.5 1 3 3.2" />
      </g>
      <g strokeWidth={1.75}>{arrows[move]}</g>
    </svg>
  );
}

/**
 * Pick a camera move by name, with a small diagram for each one. Moves can be combined up to `max`. Moves the model
 * cannot make stay visible, cannot be picked, and say why in words. The diagram moves once on hover or focus and never
 * under reduced motion.
 */
export function CameraMovePicker({
  value, onChange, label = "Camera move", moves = allCameraMoves, max = 1, supported, unsupportedReason = "Not available with this model",
  strength, onStrengthChange, disabled = false, className,
}: CameraMovePickerProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const refs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const single = max <= 1;
  const full = !single && value.length >= max;
  const isSupported = (m: CameraMove) => !supported || supported.includes(m);
  const unsupported = moves.filter((m) => !isSupported(m));

  // Why a tile cannot be pressed right now, or null when it can.
  const blockedWhy = (m: CameraMove): string | null => {
    if (disabled) return null;
    if (!isSupported(m)) return unsupportedReason;
    if (full && !value.includes(m) && m !== "static") return `Up to ${max} moves. Remove one to pick another.`;
    return null;
  };

  const toggle = (m: CameraMove) => {
    if (disabled || blockedWhy(m)) return;
    const on = value.includes(m);
    if (single) { onChange(on && m !== "static" ? ["static"] : [m]); return; }
    if (m === "static") { onChange(["static"]); return; }
    const rest = value.filter((x) => x !== "static");
    const next = on ? rest.filter((x) => x !== m) : [...rest, m];
    onChange(next.length ? next : ["static"]);
  };

  // One tab stop: the first chosen tile, or the first tile. Arrow keys move between tiles, Home and End jump.
  const firstChosen = Math.max(0, moves.findIndex((m) => value.includes(m)));
  const onKey = (i: number, e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    const n = moves.length;
    let next = i;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") next = (i + 1) % n;
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") next = (i - 1 + n) % n;
    else if (e.key === "Home") next = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") next = n - 1;
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    refs.current[next]?.focus();
  };

  const chosen = value.filter((m) => moves.includes(m)).map((m) => cameraMoveInfo[m].name);
  const summary = chosen.length === 0 ? "No move chosen" : chosen.length === 1 ? chosen[0] : `${chosen.slice(0, -1).join(", ")}, then ${chosen[chosen.length - 1].toLowerCase()}`;
  const moving = value.some((m) => m !== "static");
  const reasonId = `${uid}-reason`;
  const limitId = `${uid}-limit`;

  return (
    <div className={cn("min-w-0 space-y-2", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
        <span id={`${uid}-label`} className="text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg">{label}</span>
        <span className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">
          {single ? "Pick one" : `Combine up to ${max}`}<span aria-hidden> · </span><span className="text-fg">{summary}</span>
        </span>
      </div>
      <div role="group" aria-labelledby={`${uid}-label`} aria-describedby={!single ? limitId : undefined}
        className={cn("grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 sm:grid-cols-4", disabled && "opacity-(--disabled-opacity)")}>
        {moves.map((m, i) => {
          const on = value.includes(m);
          const why = blockedWhy(m);
          const off = disabled || !!why;
          const info = cameraMoveInfo[m];
          return (
            <button key={m} ref={(el) => { refs.current[i] = el; }} type="button" aria-pressed={on} aria-disabled={off || undefined}
              aria-describedby={!isSupported(m) ? reasonId : undefined} title={why ?? info.meaning}
              tabIndex={i === firstChosen ? 0 : -1} onClick={() => toggle(m)} onKeyDown={(e) => onKey(i, e)}
              className={cn("group tap relative flex min-w-0 flex-col items-center gap-1 rounded-card border px-1.5 pt-2 pb-1.5 text-small leading-4.5 font-medium",
                "transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast)",
                on ? "border-fg bg-surface text-fg shadow-sm" : "border-line text-fg-muted",
                off ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-(--disabled-opacity)" : "cursor-pointer hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg")}>
              {on && <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} className="absolute top-1 right-1" />}
              <MoveDiagram move={m} />
              <span className="max-w-full truncate">{info.name}</span>
              {!isSupported(m) && <span className="sr-only">, not available</span>}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {!single && <p id={limitId} className={cn("text-small leading-4.5", full ? "text-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>
        {full ? `${max} of ${max} moves chosen. Remove one to pick another.` : "Static cannot be combined with other moves."}
      </p>}
      {unsupported.length > 0 && (
        <p id={reasonId} className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">
          {unsupported.map((m) => cameraMoveInfo[m].name).join(", ")}: {unsupportedReason.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + unsupportedReason.slice(1)}.
        </p>
      )}
      {onStrengthChange && moving && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
          <span className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">Strength</span>
          <SegmentedControl size="sm" label="Camera move strength" value={strength ?? "subtle"} onChange={onStrengthChange}
            options={[{ value: "subtle", label: "Subtle" }, { value: "strong", label: "Strong" }]} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Children, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface CardRowProps {
  /** Names the group for screen readers: "Hotels in Paris". */
  label: string;
  /** Two or more ResultCards with the same fields. */
  children: ReactNode;
  /** Narrowest a card may get on wide screens before the row wraps, in the spacing scale (60 is 240px). */
  minCardWidth?: 52 | 60 | 72;
  className?: string;
}

const MIN: Record<NonNullable<CardRowProps["minCardWidth"]>, string> = {
  52: "sm:grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(calc(var(--spacing)*52),1fr))]",
  60: "sm:grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(calc(var(--spacing)*60),1fr))]",
  72: "sm:grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(calc(var(--spacing)*72),1fr))]",
};

/**
 * Two or more results of the same kind side by side: a grid on wide screens and a row that swipes sideways on a
 * phone, with the next card peeking in so people can tell there is more. A list, so its length is announced.
 */
export function CardRow({ label, children, minCardWidth = 60, className }: CardRowProps) {
  const items = Children.toArray(children);
  return (
    <ul aria-label={label} tabIndex={0}
      className={cn(
        "m-0 flex list-none snap-x snap-mandatory gap-3 overflow-x-auto p-0 pb-2 [scrollbar-width:thin] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--focus-ring)]",
        "sm:grid sm:snap-none sm:overflow-visible sm:pb-0", MIN[minCardWidth], className,
      )}>
      {/* On a phone the next card peeks in to show there is more; a single card takes the full width. */}
      {items.map((child, i) => (
        <li key={i} className={cn("flex shrink-0 snap-start sm:w-auto", items.length > 1 ? "w-[85%]" : "w-full")}>{child}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/ChartFrame.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode, type RefObject } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";
import { ErrorState } from "./ErrorState";
import { DataTable, type DataTableProps } from "./DataTable";

/* ---------- shared chart helpers (used by the chart organisms) ---------- */

/** Measures the content width of an element and keeps it current with a ResizeObserver. Returns 0 until measured. */
export function useElementWidth<T extends HTMLElement>(): [RefObject<T | null>, number] {
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);
  const [w, setW] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    setW(Math.floor(el.getBoundingClientRect().width));
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      const next = Math.floor(entries[0].contentRect.width);
      setW((p) => (p === next ? p : next));
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, w];
}

/** True when the person asked the system to reduce motion. Charts skip draw-in animation when it is true. */
export function usePrefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  const [r, setR] = useState(() => typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.matchMedia === "function" && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window.matchMedia !== "function") return;
    const mq = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const on = () => setR(mq.matches);
    mq.addEventListener("change", on);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", on);
  }, []);
  return r;
}

const round = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 1e9) / 1e9;

/** Round tick values that cover min to max, never more than 6. */
export function niceTicks(min: number, max: number, target = 5): number[] {
  if (!(max > min)) max = min + 1;
  let raw = (max - min) / Math.max(1, target - 1);
  for (let guard = 0; guard < 8; guard++) {
    const mag = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw));
    const n = raw / mag;
    const step = (n <= 1 ? 1 : n <= 2 ? 2 : n <= 2.5 ? 2.5 : n <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * mag;
    const lo = Math.floor(min / step + 1e-9) * step;
    const hi = Math.ceil(max / step - 1e-9) * step;
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (let v = lo; v <= hi + step / 1e6; v += step) out.push(round(v));
    if (out.length <= 6) return out;
    raw = step * 1.01;
  }
  return [min, max];
}

/** Default number formatter: thousands separators and at most two decimals. */
export function formatNumber(n: number): string {
  return n.toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
}

/* ---------- ChartFrame ---------- */

export interface ChartEmptyState {
  /** What is missing, for example "No requests in this window." */
  what: string;
  /** Why it is empty, for example "Filters exclude every model." */
  why: string;
  /** The action that fixes it, such as a Button. */
  action?: ReactNode;
}

export interface ChartFrameProps {
  /** Chart title. Set in the serif. */
  title: string;
  /** States the unit and the time window, for example "p95 latency in ms, last 7 days". */
  subtitle?: string;
  /** Plain-language reading of the chart, shown above it in body text. Say what the data shows. */
  summary?: ReactNode;
  /** The chart. Receives the full width of the frame. */
  children?: ReactNode;
  /** Data for the table view. Without it the toggle is hidden. */
  table?: DataTableProps;
  /** Source line, for example "Source: gateway logs". */
  source?: string;
  /** Caveat line, for example "Latest point is still streaming." */
  note?: string;
  /** Rendered above the chart, usually a ChartLegend. */
  legend?: ReactNode;
  /** Data state. Anything other than "ready" replaces the chart. */
  state?: "ready" | "loading" | "empty" | "error";
  /** Content for the empty state. */
  empty?: ChartEmptyState;
  /** Message for the error state. */
  errorMessage?: string;
  /** Called by the retry button in the error state. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** Shown instead of the chart when the frame is narrower than minWidth, usually a Sparkline. */
  fallback?: ReactNode;
  /** Narrowest width in px at which the chart is drawn. */
  minWidth?: number;
  /** Start in the table view. */
  defaultView?: "chart" | "table";
  /** Adds a Download data button and calls this when pressed. */
  onDownload?: () => void;
  /** Height in px reserved for loading and empty states so the layout does not jump. */
  stateHeight?: number;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Frame for every chart: serif title, unit and time window, a visible text summary, the chart, a source line
 * and a "View as table" toggle. It also owns the loading, empty and error states and the collapse-below-minimum fallback.
 */
export function ChartFrame({
  title, subtitle, summary, children, table, source, note, legend, state = "ready", empty, errorMessage, onRetry,
  fallback, minWidth = 280, defaultView = "chart", onDownload, stateHeight = 200, className,
}: ChartFrameProps) {
  const [view, setView] = useState<"chart" | "table">(defaultView);
  const [bodyRef, width] = useElementWidth<HTMLDivElement>();
  const id = useId();
  const showTable = view === "table" && !!table;
  const collapsed = !showTable && !!fallback && width > 0 && width < minWidth;

  let body: ReactNode;
  if (state === "loading") {
    body = (
      <div role="status" aria-label="Loading chart" style={{ height: stateHeight }} className="relative flex items-end gap-3 border-b border-l border-[var(--chart-axis)] px-4 pb-0">
        <span className="sr-only">Loading chart data</span>
        {[0.45, 0.7, 0.55, 0.85, 0.6, 0.75].map((h, i) => <Skeleton key={i} className="flex-1 rounded-b-none" style={{ height: `${h * 100}%` }} />)}
      </div>
    );
  } else if (state === "empty") {
    body = (
      <div style={{ minHeight: stateHeight }} className="flex flex-col items-start justify-center gap-2 rounded-card border border-dashed border-line-strong px-5 py-6 text-compact leading-5">
        <p className="font-medium text-fg">{empty?.what ?? "No data to show."}</p>
        {empty?.why && <p className="text-fg-muted">{empty.why}</p>}
        {empty?.action}
      </div>
    );
  } else if (state === "error") {
    body = <div style={{ minHeight: stateHeight }}><ErrorState title="This chart did not load" message={errorMessage ?? "The data could not be fetched. Nothing you entered was lost."} onRetry={onRetry} /></div>;
  } else if (showTable && table) {
    body = <DataTable {...table} maxHeight={table.maxHeight ?? 320} stickyHeader={table.stickyHeader ?? true} />;
  } else if (collapsed) {
    body = (
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        {fallback}
        <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">Too narrow for the full chart. Use the table view for every value.</p>
      </div>
    );
  } else {
    body = <>{legend}{children}</>;
  }

  return (
    <figure className={cn("m-0 min-w-0 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 sm:p-5", className)} aria-busy={state === "loading" || undefined}>
      <figcaption>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h3 className="font-serif! text-lead-lg leading-6 [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">{title}</h3>
            {subtitle && <p className="mt-0.5 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{subtitle}</p>}
          </div>
          {state === "ready" && (table || onDownload) && (
            <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap gap-2">
              {table && (
                <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" aria-controls={`${id}-body`} onClick={() => setView(showTable ? "chart" : "table")}>
                  {showTable ? "View as chart" : "View as table"}
                </Button>
              )}
              {onDownload && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onDownload}>Download data</Button>}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {summary && state === "ready" && <p className="mt-3 max-w-[68ch] text-compact leading-6 text-fg-muted">{summary}</p>}
      </figcaption>
      <div ref={bodyRef} id={`${id}-body`} className="mt-3 min-w-0">{body}</div>
      {(source || note) && state === "ready" && (
        <p className="mt-3 text-micro leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{[source, note].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}</p>
      )}
    </figure>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/ChartRangeBrush.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef } from "react";
import type { HTMLAttributes, KeyboardEvent, PointerEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { RefreshIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { useElementWidth } from "./ChartFrame";

export interface ChartRangeBrushProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onChange"> {
  /** The overview series, one value per position. Drawn as a small line. */
  values: number[];
  /** One label per value, for example dates. Used in the range text and read out by the handles. */
  labels?: string[];
  /** Start and end index, both inclusive. The parent owns it. */
  range: [number, number];
  /** Called with the new start and end index after a drag, a key press or Reset. */
  onRangeChange: (range: [number, number]) => void;
  /** The fewest points the window may hold. */
  minSpan?: number;
  /** Name of the control, for example "Date range". */
  label: string;
  /** Turns an index into the text shown and read out. Defaults to labels[index], or the position counted from 1. */
  formatLabel?: (index: number) => string;
  /** Turns the number of points in the window into words, for example (n) => `${n} days`. */
  formatCount?: (count: number) => string;
  className?: string;
}

type Part = "start" | "end" | "window";

const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));
const STRIP_H = 48;

/**
 * A strip under a long chart that narrows it to a range. Two slider handles and a draggable window sit on a small overview line.
 * Fully controlled: it never holds the range itself. Drags move instantly, with no easing, because they are direct manipulation.
 */
export function ChartRangeBrush({ values, labels, range, onRangeChange, minSpan = 2, label, formatLabel, formatCount, className, ...rest }: ChartRangeBrushProps) {
  const labelId = useId();
  const [stripRef, measured] = useElementWidth<HTMLDivElement>();
  const startRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const endRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const drag = useRef<{ part: Part; s0: number; e0: number; f0: number; id: number } | null>(null);

  const n = values.length;
  const last = Math.max(0, n - 1);
  // gap is the smallest allowed end minus start; minSpan counts points, so it is one less.
  const gap = clamp(Math.round(minSpan) - 1, 0, last);
  let s = clamp(Math.round(range[0]), 0, last);
  let e = clamp(Math.round(range[1]), 0, last);
  if (s > e) [s, e] = [e, s];
  if (e - s < gap) { e = Math.min(last, s + gap); s = Math.max(0, e - gap); }
  const latest = useRef<[number, number]>([s, e]);
  latest.current = [s, e];

  const name = (i: number) => (formatLabel ? formatLabel(i) : labels?.[i] ?? String(i + 1));
  const count = e - s + 1;
  const countText = formatCount ? formatCount(count) : `${count} ${count === 1 ? "point" : "points"}`;
  const pageStep = Math.max(1, Math.round(last * 0.1));
  const full = s === 0 && e === last;

  const emit = (ns: number, ne: number) => {
    const [cs, ce] = latest.current;
    if (ns !== cs || ne !== ce) onRangeChange([ns, ne]);
  };
  const moveStart = (i: number) => emit(clamp(i, 0, e - gap), e);
  const moveEnd = (i: number) => emit(s, clamp(i, s + gap, last));
  const moveWindow = (i: number) => { const ns = clamp(i, 0, last - (e - s)); emit(ns, ns + (e - s)); };

  const onKey = (part: Part) => (ev: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const cur = part === "end" ? e : s;
    const k = ev.key;
    let to: number;
    if (k === "ArrowRight" || k === "ArrowUp") to = cur + 1;
    else if (k === "ArrowLeft" || k === "ArrowDown") to = cur - 1;
    else if (k === "PageUp") to = cur + pageStep;
    else if (k === "PageDown") to = cur - pageStep;
    else if (k === "Home") to = 0;
    else if (k === "End") to = last;
    else return;
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (part === "start") moveStart(to);
    else if (part === "end") moveEnd(to);
    else moveWindow(to);
  };

  const fracAt = (clientX: number) => {
    const r = stripRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    return r && r.width ? clamp((clientX - r.left) / r.width, 0, 1) : 0;
  };

  const down = (ev: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if ((ev.pointerType === "mouse" && ev.button !== 0) || last < 1) return;
    const hit = (ev.target as Element).closest("[data-part]")?.getAttribute("data-part") as Part | null;
    let part: Part;
    let [s0, e0] = [s, e];
    if (hit) part = hit;
    else {
      // A press on the bare track brings the nearer handle to that point and keeps dragging it.
      const i = Math.round(fracAt(ev.clientX) * last);
      part = Math.abs(i - s) <= Math.abs(i - e) ? "start" : "end";
      if (part === "start") s0 = clamp(i, 0, e - gap); else e0 = clamp(i, s + gap, last);
      emit(s0, e0);
      (part === "start" ? startRef : endRef).current?.focus();
    }
    ev.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
    drag.current = { part, s0, e0, f0: fracAt(ev.clientX), id: ev.pointerId };
  };

  const move = (ev: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const d = drag.current;
    if (!d || d.id !== ev.pointerId) return;
    const f = fracAt(ev.clientX);
    const i = Math.round(f * last);
    if (d.part === "start") emit(clamp(i, 0, d.e0 - gap), d.e0);
    else if (d.part === "end") emit(d.s0, clamp(i, d.s0 + gap, last));
    else {
      const span = d.e0 - d.s0;
      const ns = clamp(d.s0 + Math.round((f - d.f0) * last), 0, last - span);
      emit(ns, ns + span);
    }
  };
  const up = (ev: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => { if (drag.current?.id === ev.pointerId) drag.current = null; };

  // Overview drawing, sized to the measured strip like LineChart.
  const w = measured || 320;
  const lo = n ? Math.min(...values) : 0;
  const hi = n ? Math.max(...values) : 1;
  const px = (i: number) => (last ? (i / last) * w : w / 2);
  const py = (v: number) => STRIP_H - 6 - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (STRIP_H - 12);
  const d = values.map((v, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"}${px(i).toFixed(1)} ${py(v).toFixed(1)}`).join("");
  const pct = (i: number) => `${last ? (i / last) * 100 : 0}%`;

  const handle = (part: "start" | "end") => {
    const isStart = part === "start";
    const i = isStart ? s : e;
    const word = isStart ? "Start" : "End";
    return (
      <div ref={isStart ? startRef : endRef} data-part={part} role="slider" tabIndex={0}
        aria-label={`${label}, ${word.toLowerCase()}`}
        aria-valuemin={isStart ? 0 : s + gap} aria-valuemax={isStart ? e - gap : last} aria-valuenow={i}
        aria-valuetext={`${word}, ${name(i)}`} aria-orientation="horizontal" onKeyDown={onKey(part)}
        // Each hit box sits mostly outside the window, so the two handles never cover each other.
        className={cn("group absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-6 cursor-ew-resize rounded-sm pointer-coarse:w-11", isStart ? "ml-1.5 -translate-x-full" : "-ml-1.5")}
        style={{ left: pct(i) }}>
        <span aria-hidden className={cn("absolute inset-y-0 w-0.5 bg-fg forced-colors:bg-[CanvasText]", isStart ? "right-1.5 translate-x-1/2" : "left-1.5 -translate-x-1/2")} />
        <span aria-hidden className={cn("absolute top-1/2 h-5 w-2.5 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full border border-line-strong bg-surface shadow-sm transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] group-hover:border-fg forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]", isStart ? "right-1.5 translate-x-1/2" : "left-1.5 -translate-x-1/2")} />
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2", className)} {...rest}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
        <p className="min-w-0 text-small">
          <span id={labelId} className="block font-medium text-fg">{label}</span>
          <span className="block text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{name(s)} to {name(e)}, {countText}</span>
        </p>
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" aria-disabled={full} leading={<RefreshIcon width={14} height={14} />}
          onClick={() => { if (!full) emit(0, last); }}
          className={cn("pointer-coarse:h-11", full && "cursor-default opacity-50")}>
          Reset
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className="px-4.5 pointer-coarse:px-9.5">
        <div ref={stripRef} role="group" aria-labelledby={labelId} onPointerDown={down} onPointerMove={move} onPointerUp={up} onPointerCancel={up}
          className="relative h-12 touch-none select-none">
          <div aria-hidden className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden rounded-md bg-sunken ring-1 ring-line forced-colors:outline forced-colors:outline-1">
            <svg width={w} height={STRIP_H} viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${STRIP_H}`} className="block max-w-full" focusable="false">
              <path d={d} fill="none" stroke="var(--chart-1)" strokeWidth={1.5} strokeLinejoin="round" strokeLinecap="round" />
              {/* Outside the window the line stays visible but is washed back with the strip colour. */}
              <rect x={0} y={0} width={px(s)} height={STRIP_H} fill="var(--surface-sunken)" fillOpacity={0.72} />
              <rect x={px(e)} y={0} width={Math.max(0, w - px(e))} height={STRIP_H} fill="var(--surface-sunken)" fillOpacity={0.72} />
            </svg>
          </div>
          {handle("start")}
          <div data-part="window" role="slider" tabIndex={0} aria-label={`${label}, whole window`}
            aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={last - (e - s)} aria-valuenow={s} aria-valuetext={`${name(s)} to ${name(e)}`} aria-orientation="horizontal"
            onKeyDown={onKey("window")}
            className="absolute inset-y-0 cursor-grab border-y-2 border-chart-1 active:cursor-grabbing forced-colors:border-[Highlight]"
            style={{ left: pct(s), width: `calc(${pct(e)} - ${pct(s)})`, backgroundColor: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-1) 12%, transparent)" }} />
          {handle("end")}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/CitationHoverCard.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { GlobeIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";

export interface CitationHoverCardProps {
  /** Citation number shown in the marker. */
  n: number;
  title: string;
  domain: string;
  /** Where "Open source" goes. */
  url: string;
  snippet?: string;
  /** Trust label as text, for example "Government" or "Academic". */
  trust?: string;
  /** Favicon or any small mark. Falls back to the first letter of the domain. */
  favicon?: ReactNode;
  openLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Numbered citation that opens a source card on hover, on keyboard focus and on click or tap.
 * Click pins the card so it stays open on touch. Escape closes it and returns focus to the marker.
 */
export function CitationHoverCard({ n, title, domain, url, snippet, trust, favicon, openLabel = "Open source", className }: CitationHoverCardProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  const root = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const btn = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const id = useId();
  const close = () => { setOpen(false); setPinned(false); };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDoc = (e: MouseEvent) => { if (root.current && !root.current.contains(e.target as Node)) close(); };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === "Escape") { close(); btn.current?.focus(); } };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDoc);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => { document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDoc); document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey); };
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <span ref={root} className={`relative mx-0.5 inline-block align-baseline ${className ?? ""}`}
      onMouseEnter={() => setOpen(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => { if (!pinned) setOpen(false); }}
      onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
      onBlur={(e) => { if (!root.current?.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node)) close(); }}>
      <button ref={btn} type="button" aria-label={`Source ${n}: ${domain}`} aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={id}
        onClick={() => { if (open && pinned) close(); else { setOpen(true); setPinned(true); } }}
        className="inline-flex h-4 min-w-4 -translate-y-0.5 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded bg-accent-soft px-1 text-nano font-semibold text-accent-fg hover:bg-accent hover:text-on-accent">
        {n}
      </button>
      {open && (
        <span id={id} role="group" aria-label={`Source ${n}: ${title}`} className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 z-30 block w-72 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] -translate-x-1/2 pb-2 max-sm:fixed max-sm:inset-x-4 max-sm:bottom-[max(1rem,var(--safe-bottom))] max-sm:left-4 max-sm:w-auto max-sm:max-w-none max-sm:translate-x-0 max-sm:pb-0">
          <span className="block animate-rise rounded-overlay border border-line bg-raised p-3 text-left text-body leading-5 font-normal shadow-lg">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">
              <span className="flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-sunken text-nano font-semibold text-fg-muted" aria-hidden="true">
                {favicon ?? (domain ? domain.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : <GlobeIcon width={11} height={11} />)}
              </span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{domain}</span>
              {trust && <Badge>{trust}</Badge>}
            </span>
            <span className="mt-2 block font-medium text-fg">{title}</span>
            {snippet && <span className="mt-1 line-clamp-3 block text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{snippet}</span>}
            <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener" className="mt-2.5 inline-block text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg underline underline-offset-2">{openLabel}</a>
          </span>
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/ClaimCheck.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, SourceIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export interface Claim {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  /** unsupported: no source backs it up. disputed: a source says otherwise. */
  status: "unsupported" | "disputed";
  /** Why it was flagged, in plain words. */
  note?: string;
}

/** Plain text, or a claim the check flagged. */
export type ClaimSegment = string | Claim;

export interface ClaimCheckLabels {
  /** Receives how many claims were flagged. */
  summary?: (n: number) => string;
  unsupported?: string;
  disputed?: string;
  askSource?: string;
  remove?: string;
  close?: string;
  /** Prefix of each mark's name, before the claim: "Why it is flagged". */
  why?: string;
}

export interface ClaimCheckProps {
  /** The reply, as plain text and flagged claims in reading order. */
  segments: ClaimSegment[];
  /** Asks the assistant to back the claim up. The button is hidden when omitted. */
  onAskSource?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Takes the claim out of the reply. The button is hidden when omitted. */
  onRemove?: (id: string) => void;
  labels?: ClaimCheckLabels;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * A reply with the sentences no source backs up marked in place. The warning mark after each one is a button that
 * opens a short note under the reply: why it was flagged, and what to do (ask for a source, or take it out). A line above the
 * reply says how many were flagged, so nobody has to scan for the marks. Marks are a dotted underline plus a small
 * icon, never colour alone.
 */
export function ClaimCheck({ segments, onAskSource, onRemove, labels, className }: ClaimCheckProps) {
  const l = {
    summary: (n: number) => (n === 1 ? "1 claim has no source. Check it before you rely on it." : `${n} claims have no source. Check them before you rely on them.`),
    unsupported: "No source backs this up.", disputed: "A source says otherwise.", askSource: "Ask for a source", remove: "Take it out", close: "Close", why: "Why it is flagged", ...labels,
  };
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const uid = useId();
  const claims = segments.filter((s): s is Claim => typeof s !== "string");
  const cut = (t: string) => { const x = t.trimEnd(); const i = x.lastIndexOf(" "); return i < 0 ? 0 : i + 1; };
  const head = (t: string) => t.trimEnd().slice(0, cut(t));
  const tail = (t: string) => t.trimEnd().slice(cut(t));
  const mark = (c: Claim) => cn("rounded-sm underline decoration-dotted decoration-2 underline-offset-4", c.status === "disputed" ? "decoration-danger" : "decoration-attention", open === c.id && "bg-attention-soft");
  const current = claims.find((c) => c.id === open);
  return (
    <div className={cn("space-y-3", className)}>
      {claims.length > 0 && (
        <p className="m-0 flex items-start gap-2 text-small leading-5 text-attention-fg">
          <AlertIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />{l.summary(claims.length)}
        </p>
      )}
      <p className="m-0 text-body-lg leading-7 text-fg">
        {segments.map((s, i) => typeof s === "string" ? <span key={i}>{s}</span> : (
          // The claim stays ordinary text so it wraps like the words around it; the warning mark after it is the
          // button (a button cannot break across lines).
          <span key={s.id}>
            <span className={mark(s)}>{head(s.text)}</span>
            {/* The last word and the mark stay together, so the mark never starts a line on its own. */}
            <span className="whitespace-nowrap"><span className={mark(s)}>{tail(s.text)}</span><button type="button" aria-expanded={open === s.id} aria-controls={`${uid}-note`} onClick={() => setOpen(open === s.id ? null : s.id)}
              aria-label={`${s.status === "disputed" ? l.disputed : l.unsupported} ${l.why}: ${s.text}`}
              className={cn("-my-1 ml-0.5 inline-flex size-6 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full align-middle transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) hover:bg-attention-soft motion-reduce:transition-none",
                s.status === "disputed" ? "text-danger-fg" : "text-attention-fg", open === s.id && "bg-attention-soft")}>
              <AlertIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />
            </button></span>
          </span>
        ))}
      </p>
      <div id={`${uid}-note`} aria-live="polite">
        {current && (
          <div className="rounded-control border border-attention-line bg-attention-soft p-3">
            <p className="m-0 text-small leading-5 font-medium text-fg">{current.status === "disputed" ? l.disputed : l.unsupported}</p>
            <p className="m-0 mt-1 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">“{current.text.trim()}”{current.note ? ` ${current.note}` : ""}</p>
            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {onAskSource && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<SourceIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={() => onAskSource(current.id)}>{l.askSource}</Button>}
              {onRemove && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { onRemove(current.id); setOpen(null); }}>{l.remove}</Button>}
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen(null)}>{l.close}</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
