## tattva/molecules/ClipRangeSelector.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { HTMLAttributes, KeyboardEvent, PointerEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { NumberField } from "../atoms/NumberField";
import { formatMediaTime } from "../atoms/Waveform";
import { speakClipTime } from "../atoms/FrameScrubber";

/** editing: the person can move the range. processing: the AI is working on it, so it is locked. applied: done, shown with a note. */
export type ClipRangeStatus = "editing" | "processing" | "applied";

export interface ClipRangeSelectorProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onChange"> {
  /** Length of the clip in seconds. */
  durationSec: number;
  /** Start and end, in seconds. The parent owns it. */
  range: [number, number];
  /** Called with the new start and end after a drag, a key press, a typed number or a playhead button. */
  onRangeChange: (range: [number, number]) => void;
  /** Name of the control, such as "Part to extend from". Also names the two handles. */
  label: string;
  /** Frames per second. Handles snap to whole frames and the arrow keys move one frame. */
  fps?: number;
  /** The longest range allowed, such as 10. The window cannot be stretched past it. */
  maxSpanSec?: number;
  /** The shortest range allowed. */
  minSpanSec?: number;
  /** Still images spread evenly over the clip, drawn as a filmstrip. */
  thumbnails?: string[];
  /** Draws one filmstrip tile for a time, when there are no image thumbnails. */
  renderThumbnail?: (seconds: number) => ReactNode;
  /** The player's position. Shows a playhead line and the "Set start here" and "Set end here" buttons. */
  playhead?: number;
  /** editing (default), processing (locked while the AI works) or applied. */
  status?: ClipRangeStatus;
  /** Words for the processing or applied status, such as "Extending from this part" or "Applied. Saved as version 3". */
  statusNote?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));
const TILES = 8;
type Part = "start" | "end" | "window";

/**
 * Picks the part of a clip to edit, extend from, loop or keep. Two named slider handles over a filmstrip, with the
 * longest allowed length built in: the window cannot pass it, so the person never meets a "too long" error later.
 * Number fields and "Set at playhead" buttons give a way to set it without dragging.
 */
export function ClipRangeSelector({
  durationSec, range, onRangeChange, label, fps, maxSpanSec, minSpanSec = 1, thumbnails, renderThumbnail, playhead, status = "editing",
  statusNote, className, ...rest
}: ClipRangeSelectorProps) {
  const labelId = useId();
  const strip = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const drag = useRef<{ part: Part; s0: number; e0: number; t0: number; id: number } | null>(null);
  const [announce, setAnnounce] = useState("");
  const keyTimer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);

  const dur = Math.max(0, durationSec || 0);
  const unit = fps ? 1 / fps : 0.1;
  const snap = (t: number) => Math.round(t / unit) * unit;
  const maxSpan = Math.min(dur, maxSpanSec ?? dur);
  const minSpan = clamp(minSpanSec, 0, maxSpan);
  const locked = status === "processing";

  // Normalise what the parent passed. A range longer than the maximum keeps its start and snaps the end back.
  let s = clamp(Math.min(range[0], range[1]), 0, dur);
  let e = clamp(Math.max(range[0], range[1]), 0, dur);
  const rawSpan = e - s;
  const snapped = rawSpan > maxSpan + 1e-6;
  if (snapped) e = s + maxSpan;
  if (e - s < minSpan) { e = Math.min(dur, s + minSpan); s = Math.max(0, e - minSpan); }
  if (e > dur) { e = dur; s = Math.max(0, dur - (e - s)); }
  const span = e - s;
  const atMax = maxSpanSec !== undefined && span >= maxSpan - unit / 2;
  const latest = useRef<[number, number]>([s, e]);
  latest.current = [s, e];

  const spanWords = (a: number, b: number) => `${speakClipTime(a)} to ${speakClipTime(b)}, ${speakClipTime(b - a)} long`;
  const say = () => {
    const [a, b] = latest.current;
    setAnnounce(`${label}: ${spanWords(a, b)}${maxSpanSec !== undefined && b - a >= maxSpan - unit / 2 ? ", the most allowed" : ""}.`);
  };
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(keyTimer.current), []);

  const emit = (ns: number, ne: number) => {
    const [cs, ce] = latest.current;
    const a = Number(snap(ns).toFixed(4));
    const b = Number(snap(ne).toFixed(4));
    if (Math.abs(a - cs) > 1e-6 || Math.abs(b - ce) > 1e-6) { latest.current = [a, b]; onRangeChange([a, b]); }
  };
  // Each handle stays within the min and max length of the other; it stops rather than pushing the other handle.
  const moveStart = (t: number, end = latest.current[1]) => emit(clamp(t, Math.max(0, end - maxSpan), end - minSpan), end);
  const moveEnd = (t: number, start = latest.current[0]) => emit(start, clamp(t, start + minSpan, Math.min(dur, start + maxSpan)));
  const moveWindow = (t: number, len = latest.current[1] - latest.current[0]) => { const ns = clamp(t, 0, dur - len); emit(ns, ns + len); };

  const onKey = (part: Part) => (ev: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (locked || ev.altKey || ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey) return;
    const [cs, ce] = latest.current;
    const cur = part === "end" ? ce : cs;
    const big = ev.shiftKey ? 1 : unit;
    const k = ev.key;
    let to: number;
    if (k === "ArrowRight" || k === "ArrowUp") to = cur + big;
    else if (k === "ArrowLeft" || k === "ArrowDown") to = cur - big;
    else if (k === "PageUp") to = cur + 1;
    else if (k === "PageDown") to = cur - 1;
    else if (k === "Home") to = 0;
    else if (k === "End") to = dur;
    else return;
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (part === "start") moveStart(to);
    else if (part === "end") moveEnd(to);
    else moveWindow(to);
    // The length is said once the keys stop, not on every step.
    window.clearTimeout(keyTimer.current);
    keyTimer.current = window.setTimeout(say, 700);
  };

  const timeAt = (clientX: number) => {
    const r = strip.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    return r && r.width ? clamp((clientX - r.left) / r.width, 0, 1) * dur : 0;
  };
  const down = (ev: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (locked || dur <= 0 || (ev.pointerType === "mouse" && ev.button !== 0)) return;
    const hit = (ev.target as Element).closest("[data-part]")?.getAttribute("data-part") as Part | null;
    const t = timeAt(ev.clientX);
    const part: Part = hit ?? (Math.abs(t - s) <= Math.abs(t - e) ? "start" : "end");
    if (!hit) {
      if (part === "start") moveStart(t); else moveEnd(t);
      (ev.currentTarget.querySelector(`[data-part="${part}"]`) as HTMLElement | null)?.focus();
    }
    ev.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
    drag.current = { part, s0: latest.current[0], e0: latest.current[1], t0: t, id: ev.pointerId };
  };
  const move = (ev: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const d = drag.current;
    if (!d || d.id !== ev.pointerId) return;
    const t = timeAt(ev.clientX);
    if (d.part === "start") moveStart(t, d.e0);
    else if (d.part === "end") moveEnd(t, d.s0);
    else moveWindow(d.s0 + (t - d.t0), d.e0 - d.s0);
  };
  const up = (ev: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (drag.current?.id !== ev.pointerId) return;
    drag.current = null;
    say();
  };

  const pct = (t: number) => `${dur ? (clamp(t, 0, dur) / dur) * 100 : 0}%`;
  // "0:04.5": the clock with tenths, because generated clips are short.
  const fmt = (t: number) => { const r = Math.round(t * 10) / 10; return `${formatMediaTime(Math.floor(r))}.${Math.round((r - Math.floor(r)) * 10)}`; };

  const tile = (i: number) => {
    const t = ((i + 0.5) / TILES) * dur;
    if (thumbnails?.length) {
      const j = clamp(Math.round((i / (TILES - 1)) * (thumbnails.length - 1)), 0, thumbnails.length - 1);
      return <img src={thumbnails[j]} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" />;
    }
    return renderThumbnail?.(t);
  };

  const handle = (part: "start" | "end") => {
    const isStart = part === "start";
    const t = isStart ? s : e;
    const word = isStart ? "start" : "end";
    const lo = isStart ? Math.max(0, e - maxSpan) : s + minSpan;
    const hi = isStart ? e - minSpan : Math.min(dur, s + maxSpan);
    return (
      <div data-part={part} role="slider" tabIndex={0} aria-label={`${label}, ${word}`}
        aria-valuemin={Math.round(lo * 10) / 10} aria-valuemax={Math.round(hi * 10) / 10} aria-valuenow={Math.round(t * 10) / 10}
        aria-valuetext={`${isStart ? "Starts" : "Ends"} at ${speakClipTime(t)}`} aria-orientation="horizontal" aria-disabled={locked || undefined}
        onKeyDown={onKey(part)}
        // The hit box sits outside the window, so it reaches past the clip edge and never covers the other handle.
        className={cn("group absolute -inset-y-1 z-10 w-6 rounded-sm pointer-coarse:w-11", isStart ? "-translate-x-full" : "", locked ? "cursor-default" : "cursor-ew-resize")}
        style={{ left: pct(t) }}>
        <span aria-hidden className={cn("absolute inset-y-0 flex w-3 items-center justify-center bg-fg forced-colors:bg-[CanvasText]",
          isStart ? "right-0 rounded-l-sm" : "left-0 rounded-r-sm")}>
          <span className="h-4 w-0.5 rounded-full bg-bg" />
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const showPlayhead = playhead !== undefined && dur > 0;
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3", className)} {...rest}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
        <span id={labelId} className="text-small font-medium text-fg">{label}</span>
        <span className="text-small text-fg-muted tabular-nums">
          {fmt(s)} to {fmt(e)} · {span.toFixed(1)}{maxSpanSec !== undefined ? ` of ${maxSpan} s max` : " s"}
          {atMax && <span className="ml-1.5 rounded-control border border-line px-1.5 text-micro text-fg">At the limit</span>}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="px-6 pointer-coarse:px-11">
        <div ref={strip} role="group" aria-labelledby={labelId} onPointerDown={down} onPointerMove={move} onPointerUp={up} onPointerCancel={up}
          className={cn("relative h-14 touch-none select-none", locked && "opacity-(--disabled-opacity)")}>
          <div aria-hidden className="absolute inset-0 flex overflow-hidden rounded-sm bg-sunken ring-1 ring-line forced-colors:outline forced-colors:outline-1">
            {(thumbnails?.length || renderThumbnail) && Array.from({ length: TILES }, (_, i) => (
              <span key={i} className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden border-r border-glass last:border-r-0">{tile(i)}</span>
            ))}
            {/* Outside the window is washed back, so the chosen part reads at a glance. */}
            <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-glass" style={{ width: pct(s) }} />
            <span className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 bg-glass" style={{ left: pct(e) }} />
          </div>
          {handle("start")}
          <div data-part="window" role="slider" tabIndex={0} aria-label={`${label}, whole part`}
            aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={Math.round((dur - span) * 10) / 10} aria-valuenow={Math.round(s * 10) / 10}
            aria-valuetext={spanWords(s, e)} aria-orientation="horizontal" aria-disabled={locked || undefined}
            onKeyDown={onKey("window")}
            className={cn("absolute inset-y-0 border-y-2 border-fg forced-colors:border-[Highlight]", locked ? "cursor-default" : "cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing")}
            style={{ left: pct(s), width: `calc(${pct(e)} - ${pct(s)})` }} />
          {handle("end")}
          {showPlayhead && (
            <span aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute -inset-y-1.5 z-20 w-0.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-fg-muted ring-1 ring-surface" style={{ left: pct(playhead!) }} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {status !== "editing" ? (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-small text-fg">
          <span aria-hidden className={cn("inline-block size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full", status === "processing" ? "bg-lime ring-1 ring-fg-muted motion-safe:animate-pulse" : "bg-success")} />
          {status === "processing" ? (statusNote ?? "Working on this part. The range is locked until it finishes.") : (statusNote ?? "Applied.")}
        </p>
      ) : snapped ? (
        <p className="text-small text-fg-muted">That was longer than {maxSpan} seconds, so the end was moved to {fmt(e)}.</p>
      ) : null}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">
        <div className="flex min-w-32 flex-1 flex-col gap-1 text-small text-fg-muted">
          <span aria-hidden>Start, seconds</span>
          <NumberField size="sm" label={`${label}, start in seconds`} value={Number(s.toFixed(1))} step={0.1} precision={1}
            min={0} max={Number((e - minSpan).toFixed(1))} disabled={locked}
            onChange={(v) => { if (v !== null) { moveStart(v); say(); } }} />
        </div>
        <div className="flex min-w-32 flex-1 flex-col gap-1 text-small text-fg-muted">
          <span aria-hidden>End, seconds</span>
          <NumberField size="sm" label={`${label}, end in seconds`} value={Number(e.toFixed(1))} step={0.1} precision={1}
            min={Number((s + minSpan).toFixed(1))} max={Number(Math.min(dur, s + maxSpan).toFixed(1))} disabled={locked}
            onChange={(v) => { if (v !== null) { moveEnd(v); say(); } }} />
        </div>
        {showPlayhead && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={locked} className="pointer-coarse:h-11"
              onClick={() => { const [, ce] = latest.current; if (playhead! < ce) moveStart(playhead!); else moveWindow(playhead!); say(); }}>
              Set start at {formatMediaTime(playhead!)}
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={locked} className="pointer-coarse:h-11"
              onClick={() => { const [cs, ce] = latest.current; if (playhead! > cs) moveEnd(playhead!); else moveWindow(playhead! - (ce - cs)); say(); }}>
              Set end at {formatMediaTime(playhead!)}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{announce}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/CodeBlock.tsx

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { CheckIcon, CopyIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export function CodeBlock({ code, language = "text" }: { code: string; language?: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const copy = async () => {
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code); setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500); } catch { /* clipboard unavailable */ }
  };
  return (
    <figure className="overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-code text-code-fg">
      <figcaption className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-code-line px-3 py-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-code-muted">
        <span className="font-mono">{language}</span>
        <button type="button" onClick={copy} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 hover:text-code-fg">
          {copied ? <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} /> : <CopyIcon width={12} height={12} />}
          <span aria-live="polite">{copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}</span>
        </button>
      </figcaption>
      <pre tabIndex={0} className="overflow-x-auto p-3 font-mono text-compact leading-6"><code>{code}</code></pre>
    </figure>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { ChevronIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { usePresence } from "../hooks/usePresence";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";

export interface CollapsibleProps {
  header: ReactNode;
  children: ReactNode;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Controls whether it is open. Use with `onOpenChange`; without it the part keeps its own state. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Called with the new value when the header is pressed. */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Wraps the header button in a heading of this level, so screen reader users can jump between sections. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * A header that shows and hides what is under it. The content grows open in --dur-base and closes faster in --dur-fast.
 * Closed content is hidden from everyone, not just from sight. Under reduced motion it simply appears.
 */
export function Collapsible({ header, children, defaultOpen = false, open: openProp, onOpenChange, headingLevel, className }: CollapsibleProps) {
  const [openState, setOpenState] = useState(openProp ?? defaultOpen);
  const open = openProp ?? openState;
  const setOpen = (v: boolean) => { if (openProp === undefined) setOpenState(v); onOpenChange?.(v); };
  const id = useId();
  const { present } = usePresence(open);
  // `shown` turns on one frame after the content mounts, so the height has a closed state to grow from.
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(open);
  // Clipping is only needed while the height moves; once open, focus rings inside are not cut off.
  const [settled, setSettled] = useState(open);
  useEffect(() => {
    setSettled(false);
    if (!open) { setShown(false); return; }
    const r = requestAnimationFrame(() => setShown(true));
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(r);
  }, [open]);
  return (
    <div className={className}>
      {(() => {
        const button = (
          <button type="button" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={id} onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
            className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left">
            <ChevronIcon className={cn("shrink-0 text-fg-subtle transition-transform duration-[var(--dur-fast)]", open && "rotate-90")} />
            {header}
          </button>
        );
        if (!headingLevel) return button;
        const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
        return <H className="m-0 font-[inherit] text-[length:inherit] leading-[inherit]">{button}</H>;
      })()}
      <div id={id} hidden={!present} onTransitionEnd={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && open) setSettled(true); }}
        className={cn("grid transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity] ease-(--ease-arrive)", shown ? "grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100 duration-(--dur-base)" : "grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0 duration-(--dur-fast)")}>
        <div className={cn("min-h-0", !(shown && settled) && "overflow-hidden")}>{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/Combobox.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { TextField } from "../atoms/TextField";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { SearchIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface ComboboxOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  /** Small text on the right of the row, such as a category. */
  hint?: string;
}

export interface ComboboxProps {
  /** The text in the box. Always the text, never an id. */
  value: string;
  /** Called on every keystroke, and with the option's label when a suggestion is picked. */
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  options: ComboboxOption[];
  /** Labels shown before typing. A label that matches an option uses that option's value. */
  popular?: string[];
  /** Called when a suggestion is picked ("option") or the typed text is accepted ("typed"). */
  onSelect?: (value: string, how: "option" | "typed") => void;
  /** Accessible name of the box. */
  label: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Text of the last row while typing, which keeps exactly what was typed. */
  useTypedLabel?: (typed: string) => string;
  /** Line under the popular names, saying any name can be typed. */
  emptyHint?: string;
  invalid?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Set by Field. */
  id?: string;
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-invalid"?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

type Row = { key: string; value: string; label: string; hint?: string; how: "option" | "typed" };
const MAX = 6;

/**
 * A search box with suggestions that is never a closed list. Whatever is typed can be used. WAI-ARIA combobox with list
 * autocomplete: focus stays in the input and the active option is named with aria-activedescendant.
 */
export function Combobox({ value, onChange, options, popular, onSelect, label, placeholder, useTypedLabel, emptyHint = "Not here? Type its name above.", invalid, disabled, id, className, ...aria }: ComboboxProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const listId = `${uid}-list`;
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(-1);
  const list = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);

  const typed = value.trim();
  const q = typed.toLowerCase();
  const rows = useMemo<Row[]>(() => {
    if (!typed) {
      return (popular ?? []).map((p) => {
        const o = options.find((x) => x.label.toLowerCase() === p.toLowerCase());
        return { key: `p-${p}`, value: o?.value ?? p, label: o?.label ?? p, hint: o?.hint, how: "option" as const };
      });
    }
    const starts = options.filter((o) => o.label.toLowerCase().startsWith(q));
    const contains = options.filter((o) => !o.label.toLowerCase().startsWith(q) && o.label.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    const found: Row[] = [...starts, ...contains].slice(0, MAX).map((o) => ({ key: `o-${o.value}`, value: o.value, label: o.label, hint: o.hint, how: "option" as const }));
    // An exact match is already in the list, so a second row saying the same thing would only confuse.
    if (!found.some((r) => r.label.toLowerCase() === q)) found.push({ key: "typed", value: typed, label: useTypedLabel ? useTypedLabel(typed) : `Use “${typed}”`, how: "typed" });
    return found;
  }, [typed, q, options, popular, useTypedLabel]);

  const open = focused && !dismissed && !disabled && (typed ? true : rows.length > 0);
  const suggestions = rows.filter((r) => r.how === "option");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (active >= 0) list.current?.children[active]?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: "nearest" });
  }, [active]);

  const pick = (r: Row) => {
    if (r.how === "option") { onChange(r.label); onSelect?.(r.value, "option"); }
    else { if (r.value !== value) onChange(r.value); onSelect?.(r.value, "typed"); }
    setDismissed(true);
    setActive(-1);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      if (!rows.length) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!open) { setDismissed(false); setActive(-1); return; }
      const n = rows.length;
      setActive(e.key === "ArrowDown" ? (active + 1) % n : active <= 0 ? n - 1 : active - 1);
    } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      if (!typed) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const top = suggestions[0];
      if (open && active >= 0) pick(rows[active]);
      // "ama" then Enter means Amazon: a typed prefix of the top suggestion picks it.
      else if (top && top.label.toLowerCase().startsWith(q)) pick(top);
      else pick({ key: "typed", value: typed, label: typed, how: "typed" });
    } else if (e.key === "Escape" && open) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      setDismissed(true);
      setActive(-1);
    }
  };

  const status = !open ? "" : typed ? (suggestions.length ? `${suggestions.length} ${suggestions.length === 1 ? "suggestion" : "suggestions"}. Use the arrow keys, or press Enter to use what you typed.` : "No suggestions. Press Enter to use what you typed.") : `${rows.length} popular. Or type any name.`;

  return (
    <div className={cn("relative w-full", className)}>
      <TextField
        {...aria} id={id} type="text" role="combobox" autoComplete="off" aria-label={label} aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={listId} aria-autocomplete="list"
        aria-activedescendant={open && active >= 0 ? `${uid}-o${active}` : undefined}
        leading={<SearchIcon />} placeholder={placeholder} value={value} invalid={invalid} disabled={disabled}
        onChange={(e) => { onChange(e.target.value); setDismissed(false); setActive(-1); }}
        onFocus={() => setFocused(true)} onBlur={() => { setFocused(false); setDismissed(false); setActive(-1); }} onKeyDown={onKeyDown} />
      <div className={cn("absolute inset-x-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 overflow-hidden rounded-overlay border border-line bg-raised py-1 shadow-md", !open && "hidden")}>
        <ul ref={list} id={listId} role="listbox" aria-label={`${label} suggestions`} className="m-0 list-none p-0">
          {open && rows.map((r, i) => (
            // mousedown is stopped so the input keeps focus and the list does not close before the click lands.
            <li key={r.key} id={`${uid}-o${i}`} role="option" aria-selected={i === active} onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()} onClick={() => pick(r)}
              className={cn(
                "flex min-h-9 cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3 py-1.5 text-body leading-5 text-fg pointer-coarse:min-h-11",
                r.how === "typed" && suggestions.length > 0 && "mt-1 border-t border-line pt-2",
                i === active ? "bg-hover shadow-[inset_3px_0_0_var(--fg)] forced-colors:bg-[Highlight] forced-colors:text-[HighlightText]" : "hover:bg-hover",
              )}>
              <span className={r.how === "typed" ? "font-medium" : undefined}>{r.label}</span>
              {r.hint && <span className="shrink-0 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{r.hint}</span>}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        {open && !typed && <p className="px-3 pt-1.5 pb-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{emptyHint}</p>}
      </div>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{status}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/ConfidenceIndicator.tsx

```tsx
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";

export type ConfidenceLevel = "low" | "medium" | "high";
/** Amber marks low confidence because a person should verify. Medium is neutral: it asks for nothing. */
const map: Record<ConfidenceLevel, { tone: "neutral" | "warning" | "success"; text: string; bars: number }> = {
  low: { tone: "warning", text: "Low confidence. Verify before relying on this.", bars: 1 },
  medium: { tone: "neutral", text: "Moderate confidence. Spot-check key facts.", bars: 2 },
  high: { tone: "success", text: "High confidence, supported by multiple sources.", bars: 3 },
};

/** Never convey confidence by colour alone: bars + text label are always present. */
export function ConfidenceIndicator({ level, showText = true }: { level: ConfidenceLevel; showText?: boolean }) {
  const m = map[level];
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2" title={m.text}>
      <span className="flex items-end gap-0.5" aria-hidden>
        {[1, 2, 3].map((b) => (
          <span key={b} className={cn("w-1 origin-bottom animate-grow-y rounded-sm", b <= m.bars ? { low: "bg-attention", medium: "bg-fg-subtle", high: "bg-success" }[level] : "bg-line-strong")} style={{ height: 6 + b * 3, animationDelay: `${b * 60}ms` }} />
        ))}
      </span>
      <Badge tone={m.tone}>{level[0].toUpperCase() + level.slice(1)} confidence</Badge>
      {showText && <span className="sr-only">{m.text}</span>}
    </span>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/ConnectorPermission.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { headingTag, subHeadingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { AlertIcon, EditIcon, EyeIcon, SendIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { InlineConfirm } from "./InlineConfirm";

export type AccessLevel = "read" | "write" | "send" | "delete";

export interface ConnectorAccess {
  id: string;
  /** What it can do, in plain words: "Read your email". */
  label: string;
  level: AccessLevel;
}

export interface ConnectorPermissionLabels {
  status?: Partial<Record<"connected" | "off" | "expired", string>>;
  canHeading?: string;
  levels?: Partial<Record<AccessLevel, string>>;
  connect?: string;
  reconnect?: string;
  disconnect?: string;
  /** Receives the app name. */
  disconnectQuestion?: (app: string) => string;
  keep?: string;
  /** Receives when it was last used. */
  lastUsed?: (when: string) => string;
}

export interface ConnectorPermissionProps {
  /** The app's name, such as Gmail. */
  app: string;
  /** The app's logo, about 24px. */
  icon?: ReactNode;
  /** Which account it is connected to. */
  account?: string;
  status: "connected" | "off" | "expired";
  /** What the assistant can do with it, one line each. */
  access: ConnectorAccess[];
  /** When the assistant last used it, such as "2 hours ago". */
  lastUsed?: string;
  onConnect?: () => void;
  onDisconnect?: () => void;
  labels?: ConnectorPermissionLabels;
  /** Level of the part's heading, so it fits the page outline. Default 3. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const LEVEL_ICON: Record<AccessLevel, typeof EyeIcon> = { read: EyeIcon, write: EditIcon, send: SendIcon, delete: AlertIcon };

/**
 * One connected app, and exactly what the assistant can do with it. Each line says the action in plain words with a
 * mark for how far it reaches (see, change, send, delete); deleting stands out. Disconnecting asks once, in place.
 * An expired connection says so and offers to reconnect, instead of failing quietly.
 */
export function ConnectorPermission({ app, icon, account, status, access, lastUsed, onConnect, onDisconnect, labels, headingLevel = 3, className }: ConnectorPermissionProps) {
  const l = {
    canHeading: "The assistant can", connect: "Connect", reconnect: "Reconnect", disconnect: "Disconnect", keep: "Keep it",
    disconnectQuestion: (a: string) => `Disconnect ${a}?`, lastUsed: (w: string) => `Last used ${w}`, ...labels,
    status: { connected: "Connected", off: "Not connected", expired: "Needs you to sign in again", ...labels?.status },
    levels: { read: "See", write: "Change", send: "Send", delete: "Delete", ...labels?.levels },
  };
  const uid = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const H2 = subHeadingTag(headingLevel);
  const tone = status === "connected" ? "success" : status === "expired" ? "warning" : "neutral";
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2">
        {icon && <span aria-hidden className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-control border border-line bg-bg">{icon}</span>}
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <H id={`${uid}-h`} className="m-0 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">{app}</H>
          {account && <p className="m-0 truncate text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{account}</p>}
        </div>
        <Badge tone={tone}>{l.status[status]}</Badge>
      </div>
      {status !== "off" && access.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <H2 className="m-0 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted">{l.canHeading}</H2>
          <ul className="mt-2 space-y-2">
            {access.map((a) => {
              const Icon = LEVEL_ICON[a.level];
              return (
                <li key={a.id} className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <Icon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className={cn("mt-0.5 shrink-0", a.level === "delete" ? "text-danger-fg" : "text-fg-muted")} />
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-body leading-6 text-fg">{a.label}</span>
                  <span className={cn("shrink-0 text-small leading-6", a.level === "delete" ? "font-medium text-danger-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>{l.levels[a.level]}</span>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
      {lastUsed && status === "connected" && <p className="m-0 mt-4 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.lastUsed(lastUsed)}</p>}
      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2">
        {status === "connected" && onDisconnect && (
          <InlineConfirm onConfirm={onDisconnect} confirmLabel={l.disconnect} cancelLabel={l.keep} question={l.disconnectQuestion(app)} tone="danger">{l.disconnect}</InlineConfirm>
        )}
        {status !== "connected" && onConnect && <Button size="sm" onClick={onConnect}>{status === "expired" ? l.reconnect : l.connect}</Button>}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/ContextChip.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { keepFocus } from "../lib/focus";
import { ChevronIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";

/**
 * Scope control that lives inside the composer: "what is this chat about?"
 * With onClick it opens a picker (shows a chevron). With onClear it is a removable label; after clearing, focus moves
 * to what is left of the pill, else the next control, else the message box (or to `focusAfterClear`).
 */
export function ContextChip({ icon, children, onClick, onClear, clearLabel = "Clear context", focusAfterClear, className }: { icon?: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; onClear?: () => void; clearLabel?: string; focusAfterClear?: () => HTMLElement | null; className?: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const body = (
    <>
      {icon && <span className="text-fg-subtle">{icon}</span>}
      <span>{children}</span>
      {onClick && <ChevronIcon className="size-3 rotate-90 text-fg-subtle" />}
    </>
  );
  const base = cn("inline-flex h-7 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control border border-line bg-surface px-3 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg", className);
  return (
    <span ref={ref} className={cn("inline-flex items-center", onClear && "rounded-control bg-hover pr-1")}>
      {onClick
        ? <button type="button" onClick={onClick} className={cn(base, "cursor-pointer hover:bg-bg")}>{body}</button>
        : <span className={cn(base, onClear && "border-transparent bg-transparent pr-1")}>{body}</span>}
      {onClear && <button type="button" aria-label={clearLabel} onClick={() => { onClear(); keepFocus(ref.current, focusAfterClear); }} className="flex size-5 items-center justify-center rounded-control text-fg-subtle hover:bg-line cursor-pointer"><XIcon width={12} height={12} /></button>}
    </span>
  );
}

/** @deprecated Renamed to ContextChip in 0.29.0, to match the name other design systems use. The old name goes in 0.31.0. */
export const ContextPill = ContextChip;
```

```tsx
import { CheckIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Meter } from "../atoms/Meter";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface ContextMeterProps {
  /** Share of the context window in use, 0 to 100. */
  percent: number;
  /** Text beside the bar. Defaults to "68% of context". */
  valueText?: string;
  /** At or above this percent the bar turns amber and Summarize appears. */
  summarizeAt?: number;
  /** Called when the person chooses Summarize. The action stays hidden when omitted. */
  onSummarize?: () => void;
  /** Disables Summarize while a summary is being made. */
  summarizing?: boolean;
  /** Shows a compaction marker with this text, for example "Earlier messages summarized". */
  compactionNote?: string;
  /** Reason shown beside the Summarize action. */
  warnText?: string;
  summarizeLabel?: string;
  /** Accessible name for the meter. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Context-window usage. Stays neutral until the limit is near, then says why and offers to summarize. */
export function ContextMeter({ percent, valueText, summarizeAt = 85, onSummarize, summarizing, compactionNote, warnText = "Close to the limit.", summarizeLabel = "Summarize", label = "Context used", className }: ContextMeterProps) {
  const pct = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent)));
  const text = valueText ?? `${pct}% of context`;
  const near = pct >= summarizeAt;
  return (
    <div className={cn("space-y-2", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-small leading-4">
        <span className="text-fg-muted">{text}</span>
        {near && <span className="text-attention-fg">{warnText}</span>}
      </div>
      <Meter label={label} value={pct} warnAt={summarizeAt / 100} valueText={text} />
      {(near && onSummarize) && (
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={summarizing} onClick={onSummarize}>{summarizing ? "Summarizing" : summarizeLabel}</Button>
      )}
      {compactionNote && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-line pt-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted"><CheckIcon width={12} height={12} />{compactionNote}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { InfoIcon, AlertIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export interface ContinueNoticeLabels {
  length?: string;
  stopped?: string;
  lost?: string;
  continue?: string;
  retry?: string;
}

export interface ContinueNoticeProps {
  /** Why the reply ended early: it hit the length limit, the person pressed Stop, or the connection dropped. */
  reason: "length" | "stopped" | "lost";
  /** Picks up where the reply ended (or, after a lost connection, tries again). */
  onContinue: () => void;
  /** True while the continuation is starting. The button keeps its place and ignores presses. */
  busy?: boolean;
  labels?: ContinueNoticeLabels;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * One quiet line under a reply that ended early, saying why in plain words and offering to carry on. A reply cut
 * off by the length limit otherwise just stops mid-sentence, and people cannot tell whether it finished.
 */
export function ContinueNotice({ reason, onContinue, busy, labels, className }: ContinueNoticeProps) {
  const l = {
    length: "The reply stopped at the length limit.", stopped: "You stopped this reply.", lost: "The connection dropped before the reply finished.",
    continue: "Continue", retry: "Try again", ...labels,
  };
  const Icon = reason === "lost" ? AlertIcon : InfoIcon;
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2", className)}>
      <p className="m-0 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">
        <Icon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0" />{l[reason]}
      </p>
      <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" busy={busy} busyLabel={reason === "lost" ? l.retry : l.continue} onClick={onContinue}>{reason === "lost" ? l.retry : l.continue}</Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/Countdown.tsx

```tsx
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Meter } from "../atoms/Meter";

export interface CountdownProps {
  /** ISO date, such as 2026-10-27. Only the calendar day is used. */
  deadline: string;
  /** ISO date to count from. Defaults to today on this device. Pass it in docs and tests. */
  today?: string;
  /** What the date is, such as "They must reply by". */
  label: string;
  /** ISO date the clock started. Turns on the time bar. */
  start?: string;
  /** Only days for now. */
  unit?: "days";
  /** Shown with an icon once the deadline has passed. */
  missedLabel?: string;
  /** Turns an ISO date into the large text. Defaults to a long en-IN date. */
  formatDate?: (iso: string) => string;
  /** Amber treatment for a deadline that is due or missed and needs a person to act. Never on by default. */
  needsAction?: boolean;
  /** Text of the amber chip. */
  actionText?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const DAY = 86_400_000;

/** Whole days since 1970 for the calendar day in an ISO string. Plain UTC maths, so time zones and daylight saving cannot shift it. */
function dayNumber(iso: string): number {
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(iso);
  if (!m) return NaN;
  return Math.round(Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]) / DAY);
}

function localToday(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  const p = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p(d.getDate())}`;
}

const longDate = (iso: string) => {
  const n = dayNumber(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(n) ? "—" : new Date(n * DAY).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
};

const plural = (n: number) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? "day" : "days"}`;

/** The deadline, first and biggest: the date in large text, the days left in words, and an optional bar of time used. */
export function Countdown({ deadline, today, label, start, missedLabel = "Deadline passed", formatDate = longDate, needsAction, actionText = "Needs action", className }: CountdownProps) {
  const end = dayNumber(deadline);
  const now = dayNumber(today ?? localToday());
  const left = end - now;
  const valid = !Number.isNaN(left);
  const missed = valid && left < 0;
  const begin = start ? dayNumber(start) : NaN;
  const total = end - begin;
  const showBar = valid && total > 0;
  const used = showBar ? Math.max(0, Math.min(total, now - begin)) : 0;
  const attention = needsAction && valid && left <= 0;
  const words = !valid ? "" : missed ? `${plural(-left)} past` : left === 0 ? "Due today" : `${plural(left)} left`;
  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={label} className={cn("min-w-0 rounded-card border bg-surface p-4", attention ? "border-attention" : "border-line", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{label}</p>
        {needsAction && <span className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-control bg-attention-soft px-2 py-0.5 text-micro leading-4 font-medium text-attention-fg"><AlertIcon width={12} height={12} />{actionText}</span>}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-1 text-title-lg leading-9 font-semibold tracking-snug tabular-nums text-fg [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">
        {valid ? <time dateTime={deadline.slice(0, 10)}>{formatDate(deadline.slice(0, 10))}</time> : "—"}
      </p>
      {valid && (
        <p className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 text-body leading-6 text-fg">
          {missed && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium"><AlertIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0" />{missedLabel}</span>}
          <span className={cn("tabular-nums", missed ? "text-fg-muted" : "font-medium")}>{missed && <span aria-hidden>{"· "}</span>}{words}</span>
        </p>
      )}
      {showBar && (
        <Meter className="mt-3" label="Time used" value={used} max={total} warnAt={attention ? 0 : undefined}
          valueText={`${used} of ${total} days used`} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export type DataRow = Record<string, ReactNode>;
export type SortDirection = "asc" | "desc";
export interface SortState { key: string; direction: SortDirection }
export type Direction = "up" | "down" | "flat";

export interface DataTableColumn {
  /** Key into each row object. */
  key: string;
  /** Visible column header. Include the unit, for example "p95 latency (ms)". */
  header: string;
  /** Right-align and use tabular figures. Set on every numeric column. */
  numeric?: boolean;
  /** Lets people sort by this column. The cell text is used unless sortValue is given. */
  sortable?: boolean;
  /** The raw number or text to sort by, for cells that show formatted text such as "₹1,200" or "+2.1%". */
  sortValue?: (row: DataRow) => number | string;
  /** Colours the cell as up or down and puts an arrow before it. Return undefined for no marker. The text must still carry its own sign. */
  direction?: (row: DataRow) => Direction | undefined;
}

export interface DataTableProps {
  /** Column definitions in display order. The first column is the row header. */
  columns: DataTableColumn[];
  /** One object per row, keyed by column key. Values are already formatted. */
  rows: DataRow[];
  /** Names the table for assistive technology and states what it holds. */
  caption: string;
  /** Keep the header row visible while the body scrolls. Pair with maxHeight. */
  stickyHeader?: boolean;
  /** Maximum body height in px before the table scrolls vertically. */
  maxHeight?: number;
  /** Row spacing. Dense fits more rows, for screens people scan all day. */
  density?: "comfortable" | "dense";
  /** Current sort, when your code keeps it. */
  sort?: SortState | null;
  /** Starting sort, when the table keeps it. */
  defaultSort?: SortState | null;
  /** Called when a sortable heading is pressed. Needed when you pass sort. */
  onSortChange?: (sort: SortState | null) => void;
  /** Called when a row is chosen. The row name becomes a button, so it works with the keyboard. */
  onRowClick?: (row: DataRow, index: number) => void;
  /** Key of the row to mark as the current one. Use with rowKey. */
  activeRowKey?: string;
  /** Gives each row a stable key. Defaults to the row's id value, then its position. */
  rowKey?: (row: DataRow, index: number) => string;
  /** What a narrow container does with the table. "scroll" keeps the columns and scrolls sideways. "stack" turns each row into a card, with the column name before each value, so nothing scrolls. */
  responsive?: "scroll" | "stack";
  /** Shown instead of the body when there are no rows. */
  emptyText?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const text = (v: ReactNode) => (typeof v === "string" || typeof v === "number" ? v : "");

function compare(a: number | string, b: number | string) {
  if (typeof a === "number" && typeof b === "number") return a - b;
  return String(a).localeCompare(String(b), undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
}

function Arrow({ dir }: { dir: Direction }) {
  if (dir === "flat") return <span aria-hidden className="inline-block w-[0.7em] text-center">–</span>;
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 10 10" className={cn("inline-block size-[0.7em] fill-current", dir === "down" && "rotate-180")}>
      <path d="M5 1.5 9 8.5H1Z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function SortMark({ state }: { state: "none" | SortDirection }) {
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 10 14" className="size-3 shrink-0">
      <path d="M5 1 8.5 5.5h-7Z" className={state === "asc" ? "fill-fg" : "fill-fg-subtle opacity-50"} />
      <path d="M5 13 1.5 8.5h7Z" className={state === "desc" ? "fill-fg" : "fill-fg-subtle opacity-50"} />
    </svg>
  );
}

/**
 * Semantic table counterpart to a chart, and a working data grid for screens of numbers. Numbers are right-aligned with
 * tabular figures, headings can sort, cells can carry an up or down marker, and the table scrolls horizontally in its own
 * region on narrow screens.
 */
export function DataTable({
  columns, rows, caption, stickyHeader, maxHeight, density = "comfortable", sort, defaultSort = null, onSortChange,
  onRowClick, activeRowKey, rowKey, responsive = "scroll", emptyText, className,
}: DataTableProps) {
  const [inner, setInner] = useState<SortState | null>(defaultSort);
  const controlled = sort !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? sort : inner;
  const live = useId();

  const keyOf = (r: DataRow, i: number) => rowKey?.(r, i) ?? (typeof r.id === "string" || typeof r.id === "number" ? String(r.id) : String(i));

  const shown = useMemo(() => {
    if (!current) return rows.map((r, i) => ({ r, i }));
    const col = columns.find((c) => c.key === current.key);
    if (!col) return rows.map((r, i) => ({ r, i }));
    const val = (r: DataRow) => (col.sortValue ? col.sortValue(r) : (text(r[col.key]) as number | string));
    const dir = current.direction === "asc" ? 1 : -1;
    return rows.map((r, i) => ({ r, i })).sort((x, y) => dir * compare(val(x.r), val(y.r)) || x.i - y.i);
  }, [rows, columns, current]);

  const press = (key: string) => {
    // none -> ascending -> descending -> none
    const next: SortState | null = current?.key !== key ? { key, direction: "asc" } : current.direction === "asc" ? { key, direction: "desc" } : null;
    if (!controlled) setInner(next);
    onSortChange?.(next);
  };

  const pad = density === "dense" ? "px-3 py-1" : "px-3 py-2";
  const stack = responsive === "stack";
  const sortedCol = current ? columns.find((c) => c.key === current.key) : undefined;

  return (
    <div role="region" aria-label={caption} tabIndex={0}
      className={cn(stack && "@container", "relative overflow-auto rounded-card border border-line bg-surface focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--focus-ring)]", className)}
      style={maxHeight ? { maxHeight } : undefined}>
      <table role={stack ? "table" : undefined} className={cn("w-full border-collapse text-left text-compact leading-5", stack && "@max-md:block")}>
        <caption className="sr-only">{caption}</caption>
        <thead role={stack ? "rowgroup" : undefined} className={cn(stack && "@max-md:sr-only")}>
          <tr role={stack ? "row" : undefined}>
            {columns.map((c) => {
              const state = current?.key === c.key ? current.direction : "none";
              return (
                <th key={c.key} scope="col" role={stack ? "columnheader" : undefined} aria-sort={c.sortable ? (state === "asc" ? "ascending" : state === "desc" ? "descending" : "none") : undefined}
                  className={cn("bg-sunken text-micro font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-fg-muted", c.sortable ? "p-0" : pad, c.numeric && "text-right", stickyHeader && "sticky top-0 z-10")}>
                  {c.sortable ? (
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => press(c.key)}
                      className={cn("flex w-full items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-micro font-medium text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg pointer-coarse:min-h-11", c.numeric ? "justify-end" : "justify-start", density === "dense" && "py-1")}>
                      <span>{c.header}</span>
                      <SortMark state={state} />
                    </button>
                  ) : c.header}
                </th>
              );
            })}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody role={stack ? "rowgroup" : undefined} className={cn(stack && "@max-md:block")}>
          {shown.length === 0 && (
            <tr><td colSpan={columns.length} className="px-3 py-6 text-center text-fg-muted">{emptyText ?? "No rows."}</td></tr>
          )}
          {shown.map(({ r, i }) => {
            const k = keyOf(r, i);
            const active = activeRowKey !== undefined && activeRowKey === k;
            return (
              <tr key={k} role={stack ? "row" : undefined} aria-current={active ? "true" : undefined} onClick={onRowClick ? () => onRowClick(r, i) : undefined}
                className={cn("border-t border-line", stack && "@max-md:block @max-md:px-3 @max-md:py-2", onRowClick && "cursor-pointer hover:bg-hover", active && "bg-selected")}>
                {columns.map((c, j) => {
                  const dir = c.direction?.(r);
                  const content = dir ? (
                    <span className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1", dir === "up" && "text-up-fg", dir === "down" && "text-down-fg")}>
                      <Arrow dir={dir} /><span className="sr-only">{dir === "up" ? "Up " : dir === "down" ? "Down " : "Unchanged "}</span>{r[c.key]}
                    </span>
                  ) : r[c.key];
                  return j === 0 ? (
                    <th key={c.key} scope="row" role={stack ? "rowheader" : undefined} className={cn(pad, "font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-fg", c.numeric && "text-right [font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums]", stack && "@max-md:block @max-md:px-0 @max-md:text-left @max-md:text-body")}>
                      {onRowClick ? (
                        <button type="button" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onRowClick(r, i); }}
                          className="-mx-1 rounded px-1 text-left font-medium text-fg underline-offset-4 hover:underline pointer-coarse:min-h-11">{content}</button>
                      ) : content}
                    </th>
                  ) : (
                    <td key={c.key} role={stack ? "cell" : undefined} data-label={stack ? c.header : undefined} className={cn(pad, "whitespace-nowrap text-fg-muted", c.numeric && "text-right [font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums]", stack && "@max-md:flex @max-md:justify-between @max-md:gap-4 @max-md:px-0 @max-md:text-right @max-md:before:text-left @max-md:before:text-small @max-md:before:text-fg-muted @max-md:before:content-[attr(data-label)]")}>{content}</td>
                  );
                })}
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <p id={live} role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
        {current && sortedCol ? `Sorted by ${sortedCol.header}, ${current.direction === "asc" ? "ascending" : "descending"}.` : ""}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/DatePicker.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { ChevronIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface DatePickerProps {
  /** The chosen day as an ISO date (yyyy-mm-dd), or null when nothing is chosen. */
  value: string | null;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  /** Earliest day that can be picked (ISO). Earlier days are shown but disabled. */
  min?: string;
  /** Latest day that can be picked (ISO). Later days are shown but disabled. Defaults to today. */
  max?: string;
  /** Today as an ISO date. Set it for tests and docs. Defaults to the real date on this device. */
  today?: string;
  /** Accessible name of the calendar grid, such as "Date it happened". */
  label: string;
  /** BCP 47 locale for month, weekday and day names. */
  locale?: string;
  className?: string;
}

// All date maths is in UTC on yyyy-mm-dd strings, so a day never shifts with the time zone.
const DAY = 86_400_000;
const toUTC = (iso: string) => { const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number); return Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d); };
const toISO = (t: number) => new Date(t).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const addDays = (iso: string, n: number) => toISO(toUTC(iso) + n * DAY);
const daysIn = (y: number, m: number) => new Date(Date.UTC(y, m + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
const monthKey = (iso: string) => iso.slice(0, 7);
// Clamps the day so 31 Jan plus one month is 28 or 29 Feb, not 3 March.
function addMonths(iso: string, n: number) {
  const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
  const t = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1 + n, 1));
  return toISO(Date.UTC(t.getUTCFullYear(), t.getUTCMonth(), Math.min(d, daysIn(t.getUTCFullYear(), t.getUTCMonth()))));
}
const localToday = () => { const n = new Date(); return toISO(Date.UTC(n.getFullYear(), n.getMonth(), n.getDate())); };
const weekdayIndex = (iso: string) => (new Date(toUTC(iso)).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7; // Monday is 0

function monthCells(y: number, m: number): (string | null)[] {
  const first = toISO(Date.UTC(y, m, 1));
  const cells: (string | null)[] = Array(weekdayIndex(first)).fill(null);
  for (let d = 1; d <= daysIn(y, m); d++) cells.push(toISO(Date.UTC(y, m, d)));
  while (cells.length % 7) cells.push(null);
  return cells;
}

/** "Sat, 20 Sep 2026 · 6 days ago". Today and yesterday get their own words. */
function describe(iso: string, today: string, fmt: (iso: string, o: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => string) {
  const label = `${fmt(iso, { weekday: "short" })}, ${fmt(iso, { day: "numeric" })} ${fmt(iso, { month: "short" })} ${fmt(iso, { year: "numeric" })}`;
  const ago = Math.round((toUTC(today) - toUTC(iso)) / DAY);
  const when = ago === 0 ? "Today" : ago === 1 ? "Yesterday" : ago > 1 ? `${ago} days ago` : ago === -1 ? "Tomorrow" : `in ${-ago} days`;
  return `${label} · ${when}`;
}

/**
 * An inline month calendar for dates that are almost always recent. It is not a pop-up. Days outside min and max are shown
 * but cannot be picked. It follows the WAI-ARIA date picker grid: one tab stop, arrow keys, Home, End and Page keys.
 */
export function DatePicker({ value, onChange, min, max, today: todayProp, label, locale = "en-IN", className }: DatePickerProps) {
  const today = todayProp ?? localToday();
  const latest = max ?? today;
  const start = value ?? today;
  const [view, setView] = useState(() => ({ y: Number(start.slice(0, 4)), m: Number(start.slice(5, 7)) - 1 }));
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState(start);
  const grid = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const moved = useRef(false);

  const fmt = useMemo(() => {
    const cache = new Map<string, Intl.DateTimeFormat>();
    return (iso: string, o: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => {
      const k = JSON.stringify(o);
      let f = cache.get(k);
      if (!f) { f = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { ...o, timeZone: "UTC" }); cache.set(k, f); }
      return f.format(toUTC(iso));
    };
  }, [locale]);

  const allowed = (iso: string) => iso <= latest && (!min || iso >= min);
  const cells = useMemo(() => monthCells(view.y, view.m), [view]);
  const rows = Array.from({ length: cells.length / 7 }, (_, i) => cells.slice(i * 7, i * 7 + 7));
  const viewKey = `${view.y}-${String(view.m + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  const firstOfView = `${viewKey}-01`;
  const prevDisabled = !!min && addDays(firstOfView, -1) < min;
  const nextDisabled = addMonths(firstOfView, 1) > latest;
  // The one day in the tab order: where focus was, else the chosen day, else the first allowed day of the month.
  const tabDay = [focus, value].find((d) => d && monthKey(d) === viewKey && allowed(d)) ?? cells.find((c) => c && allowed(c)) ?? null;

  // After a key press moves focus to a day (possibly in another month), focus its button once it has rendered.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!moved.current) return;
    moved.current = false;
    grid.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-day="${focus}"]`)?.focus();
  }, [focus, view]);

  // Follow a value changed from outside, such as the parent's own shortcut buttons.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!value) return;
    setFocus(value);
    setView({ y: Number(value.slice(0, 4)), m: Number(value.slice(5, 7)) - 1 });
  }, [value]);

  const show = (iso: string) => setView({ y: Number(iso.slice(0, 4)), m: Number(iso.slice(5, 7)) - 1 });
  const shiftMonth = (by: number) => { const n = addMonths(firstOfView, by); show(n); };
  const pick = (iso: string) => { if (!allowed(iso)) return; setFocus(iso); onChange(iso); };

  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    const from = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>("[data-day]")?.dataset.day;
    if (!from) return;
    let next: string;
    switch (e.key) {
      case "ArrowLeft": next = addDays(from, -1); break;
      case "ArrowRight": next = addDays(from, 1); break;
      case "ArrowUp": next = addDays(from, -7); break;
      case "ArrowDown": next = addDays(from, 7); break;
      case "Home": next = addDays(from, -weekdayIndex(from)); break;
      case "End": next = addDays(from, 6 - weekdayIndex(from)); break;
      case "PageUp": next = addMonths(from, e.shiftKey ? -12 : -1); break;
      case "PageDown": next = addMonths(from, e.shiftKey ? 12 : 1); break;
      default: return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    // A day outside the range is skipped to the nearest allowed day. If that is where we already are, nothing moves.
    if (min && next < min) next = min;
    if (next > latest) next = latest;
    if (next === from) return;
    moved.current = true;
    setFocus(next);
    show(next);
  };

  const quick = [{ text: "Today", iso: today }, { text: "Yesterday", iso: addDays(today, -1) }].filter((q) => allowed(q.iso));
  const heads = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
    const iso = addDays("2024-01-01", i); // a Monday
    return { short: fmt(iso, { weekday: "narrow" }), long: fmt(iso, { weekday: "long" }) };
  });

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-fit max-w-full rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3", className)}>
      {quick.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex gap-2 pb-3">
          {quick.map((q) => <Button key={q.text} variant="secondary" size="sm" className="pointer-coarse:h-11" onClick={() => pick(q.iso)}>{q.text}</Button>)}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-2">
        <p aria-live="polite" className="px-1 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">{fmt(firstOfView, { month: "long", year: "numeric" })}</p>
        <div className="flex gap-1">
          {([["Previous month", -1, prevDisabled], ["Next month", 1, nextDisabled]] as const).map(([name, by, off]) => (
            <button key={name} type="button" aria-label={name} disabled={off} onClick={() => shiftMonth(by)}
              className="inline-flex size-9 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-control text-fg transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] hover:bg-hover disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-disabled-fg disabled:hover:bg-transparent pointer-coarse:size-11">
              <ChevronIcon className={by < 0 ? "rotate-180" : undefined} />
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div ref={grid} role="grid" aria-label={label} onKeyDown={onKey}>
        <div role="row" className="grid grid-cols-7">
          {heads.map((h) => (
            <div key={h.long} role="columnheader" className="flex h-8 items-center justify-center text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted">
              <abbr title={h.long} aria-hidden className="no-underline">{h.short}</abbr>
              <span className="sr-only">{h.long}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {rows.map((row, r) => (
          <div key={r} role="row" className="grid grid-cols-7">
            {row.map((iso, c) => {
              if (!iso) return <div key={c} role="gridcell" aria-hidden className="size-10 pointer-coarse:size-11" />;
              const ok = allowed(iso), chosen = iso === value, isToday = iso === today;
              return (
                <div key={iso} role="gridcell" aria-selected={chosen} className="flex items-center justify-center">
                  <button type="button" data-day={iso} tabIndex={iso === tabDay ? 0 : -1} aria-disabled={!ok || undefined} aria-current={isToday ? "date" : undefined}
                    aria-label={`${fmt(iso, { weekday: "long" })}, ${fmt(iso, { day: "numeric" })} ${fmt(iso, { month: "long" })} ${fmt(iso, { year: "numeric" })}`}
                    onClick={() => pick(iso)}
                    className={cn(
                      "flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 text-body leading-5 tabular-nums transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] pointer-coarse:size-11",
                      isToday ? "border-fg" : "border-transparent",
                      chosen ? "bg-accent font-semibold text-on-accent forced-colors:bg-[Highlight] forced-colors:text-[HighlightText]"
                        : ok ? "cursor-pointer text-fg hover:bg-hover" : "cursor-not-allowed text-fg-subtle opacity-50",
                    )}>
                    {Number(iso.slice(8))}
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p aria-live="polite" className={cn("px-1 pt-3 text-body leading-5", value ? "font-medium text-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>
        {value ? describe(value, today, fmt) : "Pick a date"}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/DiagramFigure.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { CodeBlock } from "./CodeBlock";

export interface DiagramFigureProps {
  /** Short alt. Names the diagram and says where the long description is. Becomes the figure's aria-label. */
  label: string;
  /** Visible caption. */
  caption: string;
  /** Long description, shown on the page for everyone. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Text alternative shown under the diagram, such as an ordered list of steps. */
  alternative?: ReactNode;
  /** Textual definition of the diagram. Enables the view-source toggle. */
  source?: string;
  /** Language label for the source block. */
  sourceLanguage?: string;
  /** The diagram itself. */
  children: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Accessible wrapper for a complex image. It renders a figure with a short aria-label, a caption,
 * a visible long description, an optional text alternative and a view-source toggle with copy.
 */
export function DiagramFigure({ label, caption, description, alternative, source, sourceLanguage = "text", children }: DiagramFigureProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const uid = useId();
  const desc = `${uid}-desc`;
  const src = `${uid}-src`;
  return (
    <figure aria-label={label} className="m-0 min-w-0 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 sm:p-5">
      <div tabIndex={0} className="overflow-x-auto">{children}</div>
      <figcaption className="mt-4 border-t border-line pt-4">
        <p className="text-compact font-medium text-fg">{caption}</p>
        {description && <div id={desc} className="mt-1 max-w-[68ch] text-compact leading-6 text-fg-muted">{description}</div>}
      </figcaption>
      {alternative && <div className="mt-3 text-compact leading-6 text-fg-muted">{alternative}</div>}
      {source && (
        <div className="mt-3">
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={src} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>{open ? "Hide source" : "View source"}</Button>
          {open && <div id={src} className="mt-3"><CodeBlock code={source} language={sourceLanguage} /></div>}
        </div>
      )}
    </figure>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useRef } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { useFocusAfter } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { CheckIcon, FileIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export type DiffHunkState = "pending" | "kept" | "rejected";
/** A file is "partial" when some hunks are kept and others are rejected or still pending. */
export type DiffReviewState = DiffHunkState | "partial";

export interface DiffFileRowProps {
  /** File path. The directory is shown muted and the file name in full weight. */
  path: string;
  /** Number of added lines. */
  added: number;
  /** Number of removed lines. */
  removed: number;
  state?: DiffReviewState;
  /** Marks the file whose hunks are currently shown. */
  selected?: boolean;
  onSelect?: () => void;
  onKeep?: () => void;
  onReject?: () => void;
  /** Return a kept or rejected file to pending. When omitted, decided rows show no undo. */
  onReset?: () => void;
  labels?: { keep?: string; reject?: string; kept?: string; rejected?: string; partial?: string; undo?: string; /** Spoken in place of the +/- counts. */ lines?: (added: number, removed: number) => string };
  className?: string;
}

/** Half-filled circle for a partly kept file. */
function PartialGlyph() {
  return (
    <svg width={11} height={11} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden>
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" /><path d="M12 3a9 9 0 0 1 0 18z" fill="currentColor" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/** One file in a change review: name, +/- counts and a per-file Keep and Reject. Decided files show a badge with an icon and text, and a partly kept file shows its badge beside the buttons. */
export function DiffFileRow({ path, added, removed, state = "pending", selected, onSelect, onKeep, onReject, onReset, labels, className }: DiffFileRowProps) {
  const l = { keep: "Keep", reject: "Reject", kept: "Kept", rejected: "Rejected", partial: "Partly kept", undo: "Undo", lines: (a: number, r: number) => `${a} ${a === 1 ? "line" : "lines"} added, ${r} removed`, ...labels };
  const slash = path.lastIndexOf("/");
  const dir = slash >= 0 ? path.slice(0, slash + 1) : "";
  const name = slash >= 0 ? path.slice(slash + 1) : path;
  const nameBtn = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  // Keep, Reject and Undo disappear once pressed. Focus then lands on the file name, which says the new state.
  const arm = useFocusAfter(state, () => nameBtn.current);
  const act = (f?: () => void) => () => { arm(); f?.(); };
  const stateWord = state === "kept" ? l.kept : state === "rejected" ? l.rejected : state === "partial" ? l.partial : "";
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1.5 rounded-card px-3 py-2", selected ? "bg-selected" : "hover:bg-hover", className)}>
      <button ref={nameBtn} type="button" onClick={onSelect} aria-current={selected ? "true" : undefined}
        className="flex min-w-36 flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-control text-left">
        <FileIcon width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0 text-fg-subtle" />
        <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-compact">
          <span className={selected ? "text-fg-muted" : "text-fg-subtle"}>{dir}</span>
          <span className={cn("font-medium", state === "rejected" && "line-through text-fg-muted")}>{name}</span>
          {stateWord && <span className="sr-only">, {stateWord}</span>}
        </span>
      </button>
      <span className="font-mono text-small leading-4 tabular-nums">
        <span aria-hidden className="text-success-fg">+{added}</span>{" "}
        <span aria-hidden className="text-danger-fg">&minus;{removed}</span>
        <span className="sr-only">{l.lines(added, removed)}</span>
      </span>
      {state === "pending" || state === "partial" ? (
        <span key="open" className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          {state === "partial" && (
            <Badge tone="neutral"><PartialGlyph />{l.partial}</Badge>
          )}
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={act(onKeep)} aria-label={`${l.keep} ${path}`}>{l.keep}</Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={act(onReject)} aria-label={`${l.reject} ${path}`}>{l.reject}</Button>
          {state === "partial" && onReset && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={act(onReset)} aria-label={`${l.undo}: ${path}`}>{l.undo}</Button>}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span key="decided" className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Badge tone={state === "kept" ? "success" : "danger"}>
            {state === "kept" ? <CheckIcon width={11} height={11} /> : <XIcon width={11} height={11} />}
            {state === "kept" ? l.kept : l.rejected}
          </Badge>
          {onReset && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={act(onReset)} aria-label={`${l.undo}: ${path}`}>{l.undo}</Button>}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/DraftPreview.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { ChevronIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface DraftHeader {
  label: string;
  value: ReactNode;
}

export interface DraftPreviewProps {
  /** Rows like To, From and Subject, drawn as a labelled list above the body. */
  headers?: DraftHeader[];
  /** The body text. */
  children: ReactNode;
  /** Shown in the expand button, such as "Read all 95 words". */
  wordCount?: number;
  /** How many lines show before the text fades out. */
  previewLines?: number;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange. */
  open?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Text of the expand button. */
  expandLabel?: (words: number | undefined) => string;
  /** Text of the collapse button. */
  collapseLabel?: string;
  /** A line under the message, such as "Nothing goes out without your tap." */
  footer?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

const LINE = 1.625;
const defaultExpand = (words: number | undefined) => (words === undefined ? "Read all" : `Read all ${words} words`);

/** A drafted message shown as what it is, with headers and a body, so no one approves text they have not read. It never opens by itself. */
export function DraftPreview({ headers, children, wordCount, previewLines = 4, defaultOpen = false, open, onOpenChange, expandLabel = defaultExpand, collapseLabel = "Show less", footer, className }: DraftPreviewProps) {
  const [inner, setInner] = useState(defaultOpen);
  const isOpen = open ?? inner;
  const [overflows, setOverflows] = useState(true);
  const bodyRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const id = useId();

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = bodyRef.current;
    if (!el || isOpen) return;
    const measure = () => setOverflows(el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 1);
    measure();
    const ro = typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined" ? null : new ResizeObserver(measure);
    ro?.observe(el);
    return () => ro?.disconnect();
  }, [isOpen, previewLines, children]);

  const toggle = () => { const next = !isOpen; if (open === undefined) setInner(next); onOpenChange?.(next); };
  const clamped = !isOpen && overflows;
  return (
    <section className={cn("min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-surface forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]", className)}>
      {headers && headers.length > 0 && (
        <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-4 gap-y-1 border-b border-line bg-sunken px-4 py-3 text-body leading-5">
          {headers.map((h) => (
            <div key={h.label} className="col-span-2 grid grid-cols-subgrid items-baseline">
              <dt className="text-fg-muted">{h.label}</dt>
              <dd className="m-0 min-w-0 text-fg [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">{h.value}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
      <div className="px-4 py-3">
        <div className="relative">
          <div ref={bodyRef} id={id} className={cn("text-body leading-5 text-fg [overflow-wrap:anywhere]", !isOpen && "overflow-hidden")}
            style={{ lineHeight: LINE, maxHeight: isOpen ? undefined : `${previewLines * LINE}em` }}>{children}</div>
          {clamped && <div aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-10 bg-linear-to-t from-surface to-transparent" />}
        </div>
        {(overflows || isOpen) && (
          <button type="button" aria-expanded={isOpen} aria-controls={id} onClick={toggle}
            className="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-6 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-md text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg underline-offset-4 hover:underline pointer-coarse:min-h-11">
            <ChevronIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} className={cn("shrink-0 text-fg-subtle transition-transform duration-[var(--dur-fast)]", isOpen ? "-rotate-90" : "rotate-90")} />
            {isOpen ? collapseLabel : expandLabel(wordCount)}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {footer != null && <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-2.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{footer}</div>}
    </section>
  );
}
```
