## tattva/molecules/EditableTurn.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CopyIcon, EditIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { VersionPager } from "./VersionPager";

export interface EditableTurnLabels {
  edit?: string;
  copy?: string;
  copied?: string;
  send?: string;
  cancel?: string;
  /** Name of the edit box for screen readers. */
  field?: string;
  /** One line under the edit box. */
  note?: string;
}

export interface EditableTurnProps {
  /** Every version of this message the person has sent, oldest first. */
  versions: string[];
  /** Which version is showing, 1-based. Defaults to the newest. */
  current?: number;
  /** Shows another version (and the replies that followed it). */
  onChangeVersion?: (version: number) => void;
  /** Sends the edited text as a new version. The replies after this message are written again. */
  onResend: (text: string) => void;
  /** Copies the message. The button is hidden when omitted. */
  onCopy?: (text: string) => void;
  labels?: EditableTurnLabels;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * A message the person sent, which they can edit and send again. Sending an edit starts a new branch: the earlier
 * versions stay, and a small pager (◀ 2 of 2 ▶) moves between them. The Edit and Copy buttons sit under the
 * bubble and are always there, not only on hover, so touch and keyboard users can reach them.
 */
export function EditableTurn({ versions, current, onChangeVersion, onResend, onCopy, labels, className }: EditableTurnProps) {
  const l = {
    edit: "Edit", copy: "Copy", copied: "Copied", send: "Send", cancel: "Cancel", field: "Edit your message",
    note: "Sending this writes the replies after it again. Your earlier version stays.", ...labels,
  };
  const at = Math.min(Math.max(current ?? versions.length, 1), versions.length);
  const text = versions[at - 1] ?? "";
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(text);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const box = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const editBtn = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const uid = useId();
  const back = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing) { const el = box.current; el?.focus(); el?.setSelectionRange(el.value.length, el.value.length); }
    else if (back.current) { back.current = false; editBtn.current?.focus(); }
  }, [editing]);
  const start = () => { setDraft(text); setEditing(true); };
  const stop = () => { back.current = true; setEditing(false); };
  const send = () => { const t = draft.trim(); if (!t) return; back.current = true; setEditing(false); if (t !== text.trim()) onResend(t); };
  if (editing) {
    return (
      <div className={cn("flex justify-end", className)}>
        <div className="w-full max-w-[80%] max-sm:max-w-full">
          <label htmlFor={`${uid}-box`} className="sr-only">{l.field}</label>
          <textarea id={`${uid}-box`} ref={box} value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} rows={3} aria-describedby={`${uid}-note`}
            onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); stop(); } if (e.key === "Enter" && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) { e.preventDefault(); send(); } }}
            className="block w-full resize-y rounded-card border border-line-strong bg-surface px-4 py-3 text-body-lg leading-relaxed text-fg" />
          <p id={`${uid}-note`} className="m-0 mt-2 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.note}</p>
          <div className="mt-3 flex justify-end gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={stop}>{l.cancel}</Button>
            <Button size="sm" onClick={send} disabled={!draft.trim()}>{l.send}</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col items-end gap-1.5", className)}>
      <div className="max-w-[80%] rounded-card rounded-br-[min(var(--radius-lg),var(--shape-card))] bg-sunken px-5 py-3 text-body-lg leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap text-fg">{text}</div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
        {versions.length > 1 && <VersionPager total={versions.length} current={at} onChange={onChangeVersion} edited={at > 1} label="Versions of your message" />}
        {onCopy && (
          <IconButton size="sm" label={copied ? l.copied : l.copy} onClick={() => { onCopy(text); setCopied(true); window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500); }}>
            <CopyIcon width={14} height={14} />
          </IconButton>
        )}
        <IconButton ref={editBtn} size="sm" label={l.edit} onClick={start}><EditIcon width={14} height={14} /></IconButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/EmptyState.tsx

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Illustration, type IllustrationName } from "../atoms/Illustration";

export type EmptyStateVariant = "first-use" | "no-results" | "cleared" | "error" | "permission" | "offline" | "rate-limit";

interface Preset {
  art: IllustrationName;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  /** True when a person must act, which is the only time amber appears. */
  attention: boolean;
  /** Whether the region announces itself when it appears. */
  live: boolean;
}

/** Default copy follows "cause, then next step". Every string can be overridden. */
const presets: Record<EmptyStateVariant, Preset> = {
  "first-use": { art: "empty-chat", title: "Start your first chat", body: "Nothing is here yet. Ask a question or add a file to begin.", attention: false, live: false },
  "no-results": { art: "no-results", title: "No results for these filters", body: "Try a shorter search or clear the filters.", attention: false, live: true },
  cleared: { art: "success", title: "Everything here is done", body: "New items will show up as they arrive.", attention: false, live: false },
  error: { art: "error", title: "We could not load this", body: "The request failed on our side and your work is safe. Try again.", attention: false, live: false },
  permission: { art: "permission", title: "You need access to see this", body: "This project is private. Ask an owner to add you.", attention: true, live: false },
  offline: { art: "offline", title: "You are offline", body: "Changes are saved on this device and will sync when you reconnect.", attention: false, live: true },
  "rate-limit": { art: "rate-limit", title: "You reached the usage limit", body: "Wait for the limit to reset or upgrade your plan to continue.", attention: true, live: false },
};

export interface EmptyStateProps {
  /** Preset that sets the default art, copy, tone and live behavior. */
  variant?: EmptyStateVariant;
  /** Art slot. Omit for the variant's illustration, pass `null` for none, or pass an Illustration or Pictogram. */
  art?: ReactNode | null;
  /** Names the cause or invites the first step. */
  title?: string;
  /** One short line that gives the next step. */
  children?: ReactNode;
  /** The one primary action, usually a Button. */
  action?: ReactNode;
  /** Optional secondary link or ghost button. */
  secondary?: ReactNode;
  /** `center` suits full panels. `start` left-aligns text for small areas. */
  layout?: "center" | "start";
  /** Drops the art for dense contexts such as tables and menus. */
  compact?: boolean;
  /** Heading level of the title. */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  /** Overrides whether the region has role="status". Defaults per variant: no-results and offline only. */
  live?: boolean;
  /** Label of the amber chip shown for permission and rate-limit. */
  attentionLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Message for an area with nothing to show. It names the cause, gives one next step and optionally shows art.
 * Presets cover first use, no results, cleared, error, permission, offline and rate limit.
 */
export function EmptyState({
  variant = "first-use", art, title, children, action, secondary, layout = "center", compact = false,
  headingLevel = 3, live, attentionLabel = "Action needed", className,
}: EmptyStateProps) {
  const p = presets[variant];
  const Heading = `h${headingLevel}` as "h3";
  const center = layout === "center";
  const artNode = compact ? null : art === undefined ? <Illustration name={p.art} size={center ? 96 : 64} /> : art;
  const isLive = live ?? p.live;
  return (
    <div
      role={isLive ? "status" : undefined}
      className={cn("flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-6", center ? "items-center text-center" : "items-start text-left", compact && "gap-3 p-4", className)}
    >
      {artNode && <div aria-hidden={art === undefined ? true : undefined} className="shrink-0">{artNode}</div>}
      <div className={cn("min-w-0 max-w-[44ch]", center && "mx-auto")}>
        {p.attention && (
          <p className={cn("mb-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control bg-attention-soft px-2.5 py-0.5 text-micro font-medium text-attention-fg")}>
            <AlertIcon width={12} height={12} />{attentionLabel}
          </p>
        )}
        <Heading className="text-lead-lg leading-6 [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">{title ?? p.title}</Heading>
        <p className="mt-1.5 text-body leading-6 text-fg-muted">{children ?? p.body}</p>
      </div>
      {(action || secondary) && (
        <div className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2", center && "justify-center")}>
          {action}{secondary}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/EnhanceCompare.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { type HeadingLevel, headingTag } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { AlertIcon, RetryIcon, SparkleIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Checkbox } from "../atoms/Checkbox";
import { Kbd } from "../atoms/Kbd";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";
import { Slider } from "../atoms/Slider";
import { AudioPlayer } from "./AudioPlayer";

/** idle: not cleaned up yet. processing: the AI is cleaning it up. ready: Before and After can be compared. failed: the clean-up did not work. */
export type EnhanceStatus = "idle" | "processing" | "ready" | "failed";
export type EnhanceListening = "before" | "after";

export interface EnhanceKeepPart {
  id: string;
  /** What to keep, such as "Keep laughter" or "Keep room sound". */
  label: string;
  on: boolean;
}

export interface EnhanceCompareProps {
  /** Name of the recording. Also names the player. */
  title: string;
  /** Length in seconds. */
  duration: number;
  /** Cleanup strength, 0 (Natural) to 100 (Clean). */
  strength: number;
  onStrengthChange: (n: number) => void;
  /** Which version is playing. Switching keeps the position. */
  listening: EnhanceListening;
  onListeningChange: (v: EnhanceListening) => void;
  status: EnhanceStatus;
  /** Starts or repeats the clean-up with the current settings. Shows the Clean up button. */
  onProcess?: () => void;
  /** Cost shown beside Clean up, such as "Free on your plan" or "about 2 credits". */
  costNote?: string;
  /** Sounds the person can choose to keep. */
  keepParts?: EnhanceKeepPart[];
  onKeepPartChange?: (id: string, on: boolean) => void;
  /** Loudness per slice of the original. */
  beforePeaks?: number[];
  /** Loudness per slice of the cleaned version. */
  afterPeaks?: number[];
  /** The original file. Leave both files out to simulate playback. */
  beforeSrc?: string;
  /** The cleaned file. */
  afterSrc?: string;
  /** Message in the failed state. */
  errorText?: string;
  /** Heading of the panel. */
  heading?: string;
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const isTyping = (el: EventTarget | null) => el instanceof HTMLElement && (el.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(el.tagName));
const strengthWords = (n: number) => `${n} percent, ${n < 34 ? "closer to Natural" : n > 66 ? "closer to Clean" : "between Natural and Clean"}`;
const settingsKey = (strength: number, parts?: EnhanceKeepPart[]) => `${strength}|${(parts ?? []).filter((p) => p.on).map((p) => p.id).join(",")}`;

/**
 * Cleans up a recording and lets the person hear the difference. One strength slider runs from Natural to Clean,
 * a few check boxes keep sounds worth keeping, and a Before and After switch changes version at the same moment,
 * so the change is heard straight away instead of after a new render. The After version carries the AI label; the original does not.
 */
export function EnhanceCompare({
  title, duration, strength, onStrengthChange, listening, onListeningChange, status, onProcess, costNote, keepParts, onKeepPartChange,
  beforePeaks, afterPeaks, beforeSrc, afterSrc, errorText = "The clean-up did not finish. Your recording is unchanged.", heading = "Clean up sound", headingLevel = 3, className,
}: EnhanceCompareProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(0);
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState<number | undefined>(undefined);
  const lastPos = useRef(0);
  const switchedAt = useRef(0);
  const nudge = useRef(0);
  const applied = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const ready = status === "ready";
  const showing: EnhanceListening = ready ? listening : "before";
  const key = settingsKey(strength, keepParts);
  // Remember the settings the After version was made with, so a later change can say it is not applied yet.
  useEffect(() => { if (ready && applied.current === null) applied.current = key; if (status === "processing") applied.current = null; }, [ready, status, key]);
  const changed = ready && applied.current !== null && applied.current !== key;

  const setListening = (v: EnhanceListening) => {
    if (v === listening || !ready) return;
    lastPos.current = pos;
    switchedAt.current = performance.now();
    onListeningChange(v);
  };

  // A real file restarts at zero when it changes. Put it back where the person was, so the switch is a true A/B.
  const onTime = (t: number) => {
    if (performance.now() - switchedAt.current < 1500 && t < lastPos.current - 0.5) {
      nudge.current = (nudge.current + 1) % 2;
      setCurrent(lastPos.current + nudge.current * 0.001);
      return;
    }
    setPos(t);
  };

  // B switches Before and After while focus is inside, but never while typing or on the slider.
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || isTyping(e.target)) return;
    if ((e.key === "b" || e.key === "B") && ready) { e.preventDefault(); setListening(listening === "before" ? "after" : "before"); }
  };

  const statusText = status === "processing" ? "Cleaning up. You can keep listening to the original."
    : status === "ready" ? "Clean-up ready. Switch between Before and After to compare."
    : status === "failed" ? `Clean-up failed. ${errorText}` : "";

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${id}-h`} onKeyDown={onKey} className={cn("@container flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3 sm:p-4", className)}>
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <H id={`${id}-h`} className="text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">{heading}</H>
        {ready && (
          <SegmentedControl<EnhanceListening> label="Listen to" value={listening} onChange={setListening}
            options={[{ value: "before", label: "Before" }, { value: "after", label: "After" }]} className="pointer-coarse:[&_button]:min-h-11" />
        )}
      </header>

      <AudioPlayer title={title} duration={duration} speeds={[1]}
        subtitle={showing === "after" ? "Listening to After, cleaned up" : ready ? "Listening to Before, the original" : "The original"}
        peaks={showing === "after" ? afterPeaks ?? beforePeaks : beforePeaks}
        src={showing === "after" ? afterSrc : beforeSrc}
        aiGenerated={showing === "after"} aiNote="The After version was cleaned up by AI. The original is kept as it was."
        current={current} onTimeChange={onTime} />

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <span aria-hidden className="text-compact font-medium text-fg">Strength</span>
        <Slider label="Cleanup strength" value={strength} onChange={onStrengthChange} min={0} max={100} step={5}
          formatValue={strengthWords} disabled={status === "processing"} />
        <div aria-hidden className="flex justify-between text-small text-fg-muted">
          <span>Natural</span><span>Clean</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {keepParts && keepParts.length > 0 && (
        <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-1" disabled={status === "processing"}>
          <legend className="mb-1 text-compact font-medium text-fg">Sounds to keep</legend>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-1">
            {keepParts.map((p) => (
              <Checkbox key={p.id} checked={p.on} label={p.label} disabled={status === "processing"} onChange={(on) => onKeepPartChange?.(p.id, on)} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </fieldset>
      )}

      {status === "failed" && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-field bg-sunken px-3 py-2 text-compact text-fg">
          <AlertIcon width={16} height={16} aria-hidden className="shrink-0 text-danger-fg" />
          <span className="min-w-40 flex-1">{errorText}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <footer className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2 border-t border-line pt-3">
        <p className="flex min-w-40 flex-1 items-center gap-2 text-small text-fg-muted">
          {status === "processing" && <span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-lime ring-1 ring-fg-muted motion-safe:animate-pulse-dot" />}
          {status === "idle" && "Not cleaned up yet. Press Clean up, then compare Before and After."}
          {status === "processing" && "Cleaning up. You can keep listening to the original."}
          {ready && !changed && <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">Cleaned up. <span className="pointer-coarse:hidden">Press <Kbd>B</Kbd> to switch.</span></span>}
          {changed && "Settings changed. Apply them to hear the new After."}
          {status === "failed" && "Nothing was changed."}
        </p>
        {onProcess && status !== "processing" && (status !== "ready" || changed) && (
          <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {costNote && <span className="text-small text-fg-muted">{costNote}</span>}
            <Button size="sm" variant={status === "failed" ? "secondary" : "lime"} onClick={onProcess} className="pointer-coarse:h-11"
              leading={status === "failed" ? <RetryIcon width={14} height={14} /> : <SparkleIcon width={14} height={14} />}>
              {status === "failed" ? "Try again" : changed ? "Apply" : "Clean up"}
            </Button>
          </span>
        )}
      </footer>

      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{statusText}</span>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Callout } from "./Callout";

/** Recoverable failure: say what happened, whether the user's input is safe, and offer a next step. */
export function ErrorState({ title = "Something went wrong", message, onRetry }: { title?: string; message: ReactNode; onRetry?: () => void }) {
  return <Callout tone="danger" title={title} action={onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onRetry}>Try again</Button>}>{message}</Callout>;
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";

export interface Fact {
  /** What the value is: "Check-in", "Plan". */
  label: string;
  /** The value itself: "3pm", "Pro". Text or a small part such as a Badge. */
  value: ReactNode;
}

export interface FactListProps {
  facts: Fact[];
  /** "split" puts the label and the value side by side; "stacked" puts the label above the value, for narrow places. */
  layout?: "split" | "stacked";
  /** On wide screens, lays the facts out in two columns. */
  columns?: 1 | 2;
  /** Shows placeholder rows while the facts are still arriving. */
  loading?: boolean;
  /** How many placeholder rows to show while loading. */
  loadingRows?: number;
  /** Said when there are no facts. Nothing is drawn when omitted. */
  emptyLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Short label and value pairs, such as "Check-in: 3pm" or "Plan: Pro". A description list, so each value is read
 * with its label. Light enough to sit in an answer or a card, and easy to scan on a phone.
 */
export function FactList({ facts, layout = "split", columns = 1, loading = false, loadingRows = 3, emptyLabel, className }: FactListProps) {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div aria-busy="true" className={cn("grid gap-2", className)}>
        {Array.from({ length: loadingRows }, (_, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4"><Skeleton className="h-4 w-24" /><Skeleton className="h-4 w-16" /></div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (facts.length === 0) return emptyLabel ? <p className={cn("m-0 text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted", className)}>{emptyLabel}</p> : null;
  return (
    <dl className={cn("m-0 grid gap-x-8", columns === 2 && "sm:grid-cols-2", className)}>
      {facts.map((f, i) => (
        <div key={`${f.label}-${i}`}
          className={cn("min-w-0 py-1.5", layout === "split" ? "flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4" : "flex flex-col gap-0.5")}>
          <dt className="shrink-0 text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{f.label}</dt>
          <dd className={cn("m-0 min-w-0 text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg [overflow-wrap:anywhere]", layout === "split" && "text-right")}>{f.value}</dd>
        </div>
      ))}
    </dl>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/FeedbackBar.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ThumbDownIcon, ThumbUpIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";

export type Rating = "up" | "down" | null;
const reasons = ["Inaccurate", "Not helpful", "Unsafe", "Too long", "Other"];

export interface FeedbackBarProps {
  /** Called once per message. Thumbs up sends the rating. Thumbs down sends the rating with a reason, or alone when the person chooses Skip. */
  onSubmit: (rating: Exclude<Rating, null>, reason?: string) => void;
  /** Any value. When it changes, for example to the message id, the bar returns to its starting state. */
  resetKey?: unknown;
}

/** Thumbs up and down for one response. After submitting, the chosen thumb stays pressed and a thank-you line sits beside it. */
export function FeedbackBar({ onSubmit, resetKey }: FeedbackBarProps) {
  const [rating, setRating] = useState<Rating>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const first = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (first.current) { first.current = false; return; }
    setRating(null); setDone(false);
  }, [resetKey]);

  const submit = (r: Exclude<Rating, null>, reason?: string) => { setRating(r); setDone(true); if (reason === undefined) onSubmit(r); else onSubmit(r, reason); };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="-ml-1.5 flex items-center gap-0.5">
        <IconButton size="sm" label="Good response" active={rating === "up"} onClick={() => { if (!done) submit("up"); }}><ThumbUpIcon /></IconButton>
        <IconButton size="sm" label="Bad response" active={rating === "down"} onClick={() => { if (!done) setRating("down"); }}><ThumbDownIcon /></IconButton>
        <p className="ml-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted" role="status">{done ? "Thanks, your feedback helps improve responses." : ""}</p>
      </div>
      {rating === "down" && !done && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5" role="group" aria-label="What went wrong?">
          <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">What went wrong?</span>
          {reasons.map((r) => <Button key={r} size="sm" variant="secondary" className="h-7 px-2.5 text-small leading-4" onClick={() => submit("down", r)}>{r}</Button>)}
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-7 px-2.5 text-small leading-4" onClick={() => submit("down")}>Skip</Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/Field.tsx

```tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface FieldControlProps {
  id: string;
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-invalid"?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
}

export interface FieldProps {
  /** Visible label, joined to the control with htmlFor. */
  label: string;
  /** Help text under the control. */
  hint?: string;
  /** Error message. Setting it marks the control invalid. */
  error?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  /** Shows "(optional)" after the label. */
  optional?: boolean;
  /** Receives the id and aria props to spread onto the control. */
  children: (control: FieldControlProps) => ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

/** Label, control, hint and error in one wrapper, with the ids wired for you. */
export function Field({ label, hint, error, required, optional, children, className }: FieldProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const id = `${uid}-control`, hintId = `${uid}-hint`, errorId = `${uid}-error`;
  const describedBy = [hint && hintId, error && errorId].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || undefined;
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1.5", className)}>
      <label htmlFor={id} className="text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">
        {label}
        {required && <span aria-hidden className="ml-0.5 text-fg-muted">*</span>}
        {optional && !required && <span className="ml-1 font-normal text-fg-muted">(optional)</span>}
      </label>
      {children({ id, "aria-describedby": describedBy, "aria-invalid": error ? true : undefined, required: required || undefined })}
      {hint && <p id={hintId} className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{hint}</p>}
      {/* Always mounted so screen readers pick up the message when it appears. */}
      <div id={errorId} aria-live="polite" className="empty:-mt-1.5">
        {error && <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-danger-fg"><AlertIcon className="mt-px shrink-0" width={14} height={14} />{error}</p>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/FileDropZone.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, PaperclipIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export interface FileDropZoneLabels {
  title?: string;
  browse?: string;
  drop?: string;
  /** Receives the accepted kinds and the size limit, already in words. */
  hint?: (kinds: string, size: string) => string;
  /** Receives the file name. */
  wrongKind?: (name: string) => string;
  /** Receives the file name and the limit. */
  tooBig?: (name: string, size: string) => string;
}

export interface FileDropZoneProps {
  /** Called with the files that passed the checks. */
  onFiles: (files: File[]) => void;
  /** Accepted extensions, such as ["pdf", "docx", "png"]. Any file when omitted. */
  accept?: string[];
  /** Largest file in megabytes. */
  maxSizeMb?: number;
  multiple?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels?: FileDropZoneLabels;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Where people add files for the AI to read: drop them on the area or press Browse. It says up front which kinds
 * and sizes work, and when a file does not, it says which one and why, instead of failing quietly. Browse is a real
 * button, so keyboard and screen reader users never need to drag.
 */
export function FileDropZone({ onFiles, accept, maxSizeMb, multiple = true, disabled, labels, className }: FileDropZoneProps) {
  const l = {
    title: "Add files", browse: "Browse files", drop: "Drop to add",
    hint: (k: string, s: string) => [k, s].filter(Boolean).join(". ") + (k || s ? "." : ""),
    wrongKind: (n: string) => `${n} is a kind of file that cannot be read here.`,
    tooBig: (n: string, s: string) => `${n} is larger than ${s}.`, ...labels,
  };
  const [over, setOver] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const uid = useId();
  const sizeText = maxSizeMb ? `${maxSizeMb} MB` : "";
  const kindsText = accept?.length ? `${accept.map((a) => a.toUpperCase()).join(", ")}` : "";
  const take = (list: FileList | null) => {
    if (!list || disabled) return;
    const ok: File[] = [], bad: string[] = [];
    for (const f of [...list].slice(0, multiple ? undefined : 1)) {
      const ext = f.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
      if (accept?.length && !accept.map((a) => a.toLowerCase()).includes(ext)) bad.push(l.wrongKind(f.name));
      else if (maxSizeMb && f.size > maxSizeMb * 1024 * 1024) bad.push(l.tooBig(f.name, sizeText));
      else ok.push(f);
    }
    setErrors(bad);
    if (ok.length) onFiles(ok);
  };
  return (
    <div className={cn("space-y-2", className)}>
      <div
        onDragOver={(e) => { if (disabled) return; e.preventDefault(); setOver(true); }}
        onDragLeave={() => setOver(false)}
        onDrop={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setOver(false); take(e.dataTransfer.files); }}
        className={cn("flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-card border-2 border-dashed px-4 py-8 text-center transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) motion-reduce:transition-none",
          over ? "border-selected-line bg-selected" : "border-line-strong bg-bg", disabled && "opacity-(--disabled-opacity)")}>
        <PaperclipIcon aria-hidden width={22} height={22} className="text-fg-muted" />
        <p className="m-0 text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">{over ? l.drop : l.title}</p>
        {(kindsText || sizeText) && <p id={`${uid}-hint`} className="m-0 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.hint(kindsText, sizeText ? `Up to ${sizeText}` : "")}</p>}
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => input.current?.click()} aria-describedby={kindsText || sizeText ? `${uid}-hint` : undefined}>{l.browse}</Button>
        <input ref={input} type="file" multiple={multiple} hidden tabIndex={-1} accept={accept?.map((a) => `.${a}`).join(",")}
          onChange={(e) => { take(e.target.files); e.target.value = ""; }} />
      </div>
      <div role="alert">
        {errors.map((e) => (
          <p key={e} className="m-0 flex items-start gap-1.5 text-small leading-5 text-danger-fg"><AlertIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />{e}</p>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/FileResultCard.tsx

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, DownloadIcon, FileIcon, ImageIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";

export type FileKind = "document" | "sheet" | "slides" | "pdf" | "image" | "code" | "file";

export interface FileResultCardLabels {
  kinds?: Partial<Record<FileKind, string>>;
  open?: string;
  download?: string;
  retry?: string;
  /** Receives the file name. */
  making?: (name: string) => string;
  failed?: string;
}

export interface FileResultCardProps {
  /** The file's name, with its extension: "Q3 report.docx". */
  name: string;
  /** What kind of file it is. Worked out from the extension when omitted. */
  kind?: FileKind;
  /** Size or length, such as "24 KB" or "8 slides". */
  detail?: string;
  /** A small picture of the first page or the image itself. */
  preview?: ReactNode;
  status?: "ready" | "making" | "failed";
  /** Opens the file in the app (a canvas or a viewer). The button is hidden when omitted. */
  onOpen?: () => void;
  /** Downloads the file. The button is hidden when omitted. */
  onDownload?: () => void;
  /** Tries again after a failure. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  labels?: FileResultCardLabels;
  className?: string;
}

const BY_EXT: Record<string, FileKind> = {
  doc: "document", docx: "document", md: "document", txt: "document", rtf: "document", odt: "document",
  xls: "sheet", xlsx: "sheet", csv: "sheet", ods: "sheet",
  ppt: "slides", pptx: "slides", key: "slides", odp: "slides",
  pdf: "pdf",
  png: "image", jpg: "image", jpeg: "image", gif: "image", webp: "image", svg: "image",
  js: "code", ts: "code", tsx: "code", py: "code", json: "code", html: "code", css: "code", sql: "code",
};
const KIND: Record<FileKind, string> = { document: "Document", sheet: "Spreadsheet", slides: "Slides", pdf: "PDF", image: "Image", code: "Code", file: "File" };

/** What kind of file a name is, from its extension. */
export const fileKindOf = (name: string): FileKind => BY_EXT[name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? ""] ?? "file";

/**
 * A file the AI made: a report, a spreadsheet, slides or an image. It shows what kind of file it is in words, a
 * small preview when there is one, and Open and Download. While the file is being made it says so; if making it
 * failed, it says so and offers to try again, instead of a broken link.
 */
export function FileResultCard({ name, kind, detail, preview, status = "ready", onOpen, onDownload, onRetry, labels, className }: FileResultCardProps) {
  const l = {
    open: "Open", download: "Download", retry: "Try again", making: (n: string) => `Making ${n}`, failed: "Could not make this file.", ...labels,
    kinds: { ...KIND, ...labels?.kinds },
  };
  const k = kind ?? fileKindOf(name);
  const Icon = k === "image" ? ImageIcon : FileIcon;
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex w-full max-w-md items-center gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3", className)} aria-busy={status === "making" || undefined}>
      <div aria-hidden className="grid size-14 shrink-0 place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-control border border-line bg-bg text-fg-muted">
        {status === "making" ? <Spinner label="" /> : preview ?? <Icon width={22} height={22} />}
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p className="m-0 truncate text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg" title={name}>{name}</p>
        <p className={cn("m-0 mt-0.5 text-small leading-5", status === "failed" ? "text-danger-fg" : "text-fg-muted")} role={status === "making" || status === "failed" ? "status" : undefined}>
          {status === "making" ? l.making(name) : status === "failed"
            ? <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><AlertIcon aria-hidden width={13} height={13} />{l.failed}</span>
            : [l.kinds[k], detail].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}
        </p>
      </div>
      {status === "ready" && (onOpen || onDownload) && (
        <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap justify-end gap-1.5">
          {onOpen && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onOpen} aria-label={`${l.open} ${name}`}>{l.open}</Button>}
          {onDownload && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onDownload} aria-label={`${l.download} ${name}`} leading={<DownloadIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />}>{l.download}</Button>}
        </div>
      )}
      {status === "failed" && onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onRetry} className="shrink-0">{l.retry}</Button>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/GenerationProgress.tsx

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Meter } from "../atoms/Meter";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";

/**
 * queued: waiting in line. generating: being made. streaming: playable already while the rest is made (audio).
 * finalising: almost done. done. failed. cancelled: the person stopped it.
 */
export type GenerationStatus = "queued" | "generating" | "streaming" | "finalising" | "done" | "failed" | "cancelled";

export interface GenerationProgressProps {
  status: GenerationStatus;
  /** 0 to 100. Shown as a bar while generating or streaming. Omit for an indeterminate state. */
  percent?: number;
  /** Place in the queue while queued. */
  queuePosition?: number;
  /** Time estimate such as "About 30 seconds left". */
  eta?: string;
  /** Shown while failed. */
  error?: string;
  onCancel?: () => void;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** While streaming, shows a Listen now button. Nothing plays until the person presses it. */
  onListen?: () => void;
  /** Text for the Listen now button. */
  listenLabel?: string;
  /** Result shown when done, and while streaming when it can already be played. Before then a placeholder of the same shape stands in. */
  preview?: ReactNode;
  /** Shape of the placeholder. `media` is a plain block (16:9 unless previewClassName says otherwise). `audio` is a flat waveform with a label. */
  previewShape?: "media" | "audio";
  /** Words in the audio placeholder, such as "Song, about 2 minutes". */
  previewLabel?: string;
  /** Classes for the preview area, to set its aspect ratio or height. */
  previewClassName?: string;
  /** What happens to the credits, such as "Cancelling now returns your 40 credits." Shown next to Cancel and after cancelling. Pass it only when you know it is true. */
  refundNote?: string;
  /** Replaces the text for each status. Also used for the announcement. */
  labels?: Partial<Record<GenerationStatus, string>>;
  className?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_LABELS: Record<GenerationStatus, string> = {
  queued: "Queued", generating: "Generating", streaming: "Ready to listen, still finishing", finalising: "Finalising",
  done: "Done", failed: "Generation failed", cancelled: "Cancelled",
};

/** A flat waveform: even, low bars, so it reads as "audio will be here" without pretending to show the sound. */
function AudioPlaceholder({ label, moving }: { label: string; moving: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="relative flex h-full min-h-16 items-center gap-3 bg-sunken px-3">
      <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-x-3 inset-y-2">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 48 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" focusable="false" className="size-full">
          {Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => <rect key={i} x={i + 0.15} width={0.7} y={42} height={16} fill="var(--border-strong)" />)}
        </svg>
      </span>
      {moving && <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-0 bg-[linear-gradient(90deg,transparent_25%,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--surface)_60%,transparent)_50%,transparent_75%)] bg-[length:200%_100%] motion-safe:animate-shimmer" />}
      <span className="relative rounded-control bg-surface px-2 py-0.5 text-small text-fg-muted">{label}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Status for slow generation. The visible text can change often, but screen readers only hear status changes.
 * Streaming audio can be listened to before it is finished; Listen now never starts playback on its own.
 */
export function GenerationProgress({
  status, percent, queuePosition, eta, error, onCancel, onRetry, onListen, listenLabel = "Listen now", preview, previewShape = "media",
  previewLabel, previewClassName, refundNote, labels, className,
}: GenerationProgressProps) {
  const text = { ...DEFAULT_LABELS, ...labels };
  const active = status === "queued" || status === "generating" || status === "streaming" || status === "finalising";
  const determinate = (status === "generating" || status === "streaming") && percent !== undefined;
  const announcement = status === "failed" && error ? `${text.failed}. ${error}`
    : status === "cancelled" && refundNote ? `${text.cancelled}. ${refundNote}` : text[status];
  const pct = percent === undefined ? 0 : Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent)));
  const audio = previewShape === "audio";
  const showPreview = !!preview && (status === "done" || status === "streaming");
  const stopped = status === "failed" || status === "cancelled";
  const placeholderLabel = stopped ? (status === "cancelled" ? "Not made" : "No audio") : previewLabel ?? "The audio will appear here";

  return (
    <div className={cn("space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3", className)}>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{announcement}</p>
      <div className={cn("overflow-hidden rounded-card", previewClassName ?? (audio ? "" : "aspect-video"))}>
        {showPreview ? preview
          : audio ? <AudioPlaceholder label={placeholderLabel} moving={active} />
          : <Skeleton className={cn("h-full w-full", stopped && "animate-none")} />}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-body leading-5 font-medium" aria-hidden>
          {status === "done" && <CheckIcon width={14} height={14} />}
          {status === "failed" && <AlertIcon width={14} height={14} className="text-danger-fg" />}
          {status === "cancelled" && <XIcon width={14} height={14} className="text-fg-muted" />}
          <span className={status === "failed" ? "text-danger-fg" : undefined}>{text[status]}</span>
          {status === "queued" && queuePosition !== undefined && <span className="font-normal text-fg-muted">Position {queuePosition}</span>}
          {determinate && <span className="font-normal text-fg-muted">{pct}%</span>}
        </p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {active && eta && <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{eta}</span>}
          {status === "streaming" && onListen && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onListen} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">{listenLabel}</Button>}
          {active && onCancel && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Cancel</Button>}
          {stopped && onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onRetry} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">{status === "cancelled" ? "Start again" : "Retry"}</Button>}
        </div>
      </div>
      {determinate && <Meter label="Generation progress" value={pct} valueText={`${pct}%`} />}
      {active && !determinate && status !== "queued" && <div aria-hidden className="h-1.5 w-full rounded-full bg-[linear-gradient(90deg,var(--border)_25%,var(--fg-subtle)_50%,var(--border)_75%)] bg-[length:200%_100%] animate-shimmer" />}
      {status === "failed" && error && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{error}</p>}
      {refundNote && (active && onCancel || status === "cancelled") && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{refundNote}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/InlineConfirm.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { FocusEvent, KeyboardEvent, PointerEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface InlineConfirmProps {
  /** The first button's label, for example "Delete chat". */
  children: ReactNode;
  /** Label of the button that does the action. */
  confirmLabel?: string;
  /** Label of the safe button that goes back. It gets focus when the question shows. */
  cancelLabel?: string;
  /** The question shown in place of the button. Defaults to the confirm label plus " this?". */
  question?: string;
  /** Called once when the confirm button is pressed. */
  onConfirm: () => void;
  /** danger draws the confirm button in the danger colour. */
  tone?: "danger" | "default";
  /** Milliseconds before the question quietly goes back to the first button. 0 turns this off. */
  timeout?: number;
  className?: string;
}

type Pause = "hover" | "focus" | "touch" | "hidden";

/** A button that asks "Are you sure?" in its own place instead of opening a dialog. */
export function InlineConfirm({ children, confirmLabel = "Delete", cancelLabel = "Keep it", question, onConfirm, tone = "default", timeout = 6000, className }: InlineConfirmProps) {
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState(false);
  const questionId = useId();
  const root = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const cancel = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  // "trigger" or "cancel": where focus goes after the next swap. Visibility must change before focus can land.
  const focusNext = useRef<"trigger" | "cancel" | null>(null);

  const pauses = useRef(new Set<Pause>());
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>(undefined);
  const left = useRef(timeout);
  const startedAt = useRef(0);

  const close = (focusTrigger: boolean) => {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = undefined;
    // Hover and touch are still true after a close; they are tracked all the time.
    pauses.current.delete("focus");
    pauses.current.delete("hidden");
    focusNext.current = focusTrigger ? "trigger" : null;
    setAsking(false);
  };

  // Runs the timer only while nothing pauses it, and keeps the time left across pauses.
  const sync = () => {
    if (!asking || timeout <= 0) return;
    if (pauses.current.size === 0 && timer.current === undefined) {
      startedAt.current = Date.now();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        timer.current = undefined;
        // Only take focus back if it was inside, so a timeout never pulls focus from elsewhere.
        close(!!root.current?.contains(document.activeElement));
      }, left.current);
    } else if (pauses.current.size > 0 && timer.current !== undefined) {
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      timer.current = undefined;
      left.current -= Date.now() - startedAt.current;
    }
  };
  const pause = (p: Pause, on: boolean) => {
    if (on) pauses.current.add(p); else pauses.current.delete(p);
    sync();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (asking) left.current = timeout;
    const target = focusNext.current === "cancel" ? cancel.current : focusNext.current === "trigger" ? trigger.current : null;
    focusNext.current = null;
    target?.focus();
    if (!asking) return;
    const onVis = () => pause("hidden", document.visibilityState === "hidden");
    onVis();
    sync();
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis);
    return () => { document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVis); clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = undefined; };
  }, [asking]);

  const ask = () => { focusNext.current = "cancel"; setAsking(true); };
  const confirm = () => { close(true); onConfirm(); };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (asking && e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); close(true); }
  };
  // Keyboard focus pauses the timer. Focus moved there after a mouse press does not, so the question still times out.
  const onFocusIn = (e: FocusEvent) => { if (asking) pause("focus", (e.target as HTMLElement).matches(":focus-visible")); };
  const onFocusOut = (e: FocusEvent) => { if (!root.current?.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) pause("focus", false); };
  const onEnter = (e: PointerEvent) => { if (e.pointerType === "mouse") pause("hover", true); };
  const onLeave = (e: PointerEvent) => { if (e.pointerType === "mouse") pause("hover", false); };

  const q = question ?? `${confirmLabel} this?`;

  return (
    <span
      ref={root}
      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      onFocus={onFocusIn}
      onBlur={onFocusOut}
      onPointerEnter={onEnter}
      onPointerLeave={onLeave}
      onTouchStart={() => pause("touch", true)}
      onTouchEnd={() => pause("touch", false)}
      onTouchCancel={() => pause("touch", false)}
      // Two columns: the first holds the button and, stacked on it, the question and Cancel. Confirm sits in the
      // second, so it can never appear under the pointer that pressed the first button.
      className={cn("inline-grid grid-cols-[auto_auto] items-center gap-x-2 align-middle", className)}
    >
      <span className={cn("col-start-1 row-start-1 justify-self-start", asking && "invisible")}>
        <Button ref={trigger} variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={ask}>{children}</Button>
      </span>
      <span className={cn("col-start-1 row-start-1 flex items-center gap-2", asking ? "motion-safe:animate-fade" : "invisible")}>
        <span id={questionId} className="text-compact text-fg">{q}</span>
        <Button ref={cancel} variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => close(true)}>{cancelLabel}</Button>
      </span>
      <span className={cn("col-start-2 row-start-1", asking ? "motion-safe:animate-fade" : "invisible")}>
        <Button variant={tone === "danger" ? "danger" : "primary"} size="sm" onClick={confirm} aria-describedby={questionId}>{confirmLabel}</Button>
      </span>
      <span role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{asking ? q : ""}</span>
    </span>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/InlineEdit.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { TextField } from "../atoms/TextField";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, EditIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface InlineEditProps {
  /** Visible label, small and muted. Also the accessible name of the input. */
  label: string;
  value: string;
  /** Called with the new text when the edit is saved. */
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  /** How to show the value when not editing, such as a Money. Defaults to the text. */
  display?: ReactNode;
  /** Forces the "Edited" tag on or off. When left out, the part compares value with originalValue. */
  edited?: boolean;
  /** The value before anyone changed it. Defaults to the value this part first received. */
  originalValue?: string;
  inputMode?: "text" | "numeric" | "decimal" | "tel" | "email" | "url" | "search";
  /** Returns an error message, or null when the value is fine. On an error the edit stays open. */
  validate?: (value: string) => string | null;
  /** Accessible name of the Edit button. */
  editLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * "Verify, don't fill in". A value reads as plain text with a visible Edit button. Pressing it turns the value into an
 * input in place. Enter or Done saves, Escape cancels, and a saved change gets an "Edited" tag.
 */
export function InlineEdit({ label, value, onChange, display, edited, originalValue, inputMode, validate, editLabel, className }: InlineEditProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const labelId = `${uid}-label`, errorId = `${uid}-error`;
  const first = useRef(value);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState("");
  const editBtn = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const back = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => { if (editing) { input.current?.focus(); input.current?.select(); } }, [editing]);
  // The input is gone after save or cancel, so focus goes back to the Edit button that opened it.
  useEffect(() => { if (!editing && back.current) { back.current = false; editBtn.current?.focus(); } }, [editing]);

  const isEdited = edited ?? value !== (originalValue ?? first.current);

  const start = () => { setDraft(value); setError(null); setSaved(""); setEditing(true); };
  const cancel = () => { back.current = true; setError(null); setEditing(false); };
  const save = () => {
    const err = validate?.(draft) ?? null;
    if (err) { setError(err); input.current?.focus(); return; }
    if (draft !== value) { onChange(draft); setSaved("Saved"); }
    back.current = true;
    setEditing(false);
  };
  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); save(); }
    else if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); cancel(); }
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("border-b border-line py-3 last:border-b-0", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span id={labelId} className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{label}</span>
        {isEdited && <span className="rounded-control bg-sunken px-2 py-0.5 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted forced-colors:border forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]">Edited</span>}
      </div>
      {editing ? (
        <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <TextField ref={input} className="flex-1" aria-labelledby={labelId} aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined} invalid={!!error} inputMode={inputMode} value={draft}
              onChange={(e) => { setDraft(e.target.value); if (error) setError(null); }} onKeyDown={onKeyDown} />
            <Button size="sm" className="pointer-coarse:h-11" onClick={save}>Done</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="pointer-coarse:h-11" onClick={cancel}>Cancel</Button>
          </div>
          <div id={errorId} aria-live="polite" className="empty:hidden">
            {error && <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-danger-fg"><AlertIcon className="mt-px shrink-0" width={14} height={14} />{error}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-0.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0 text-lead leading-6 font-medium text-fg">{display ?? (value || <span className="font-normal text-fg-muted">Not set</span>)}</div>
          <button ref={editBtn} type="button" aria-label={editLabel ?? `Edit ${label}`} onClick={start}
            className="inline-flex min-h-8 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control px-3 text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg underline underline-offset-4 transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] hover:bg-hover tap">
            <EditIcon width={14} height={14} />Edit
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{saved}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/JsonView.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { CSSProperties, KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon, ChevronIcon, CopyIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface JsonViewProps {
  /** The value to show, for example a tool call's input or output. */
  value: unknown;
  /** Accessible name of the tree. Also shown as the heading of the box. */
  label: string;
  /** How many levels start open. 1 opens the top level only, 0 starts fully closed. */
  defaultExpandDepth?: number;
  /** Strings longer than this are cut short with a "Show all" choice. */
  maxStringLength?: number;
  /** Replaces the built-in clipboard copy. Gets the value as indented JSON. Throw or reject to report a failure. */
  onCopy?: (text: string) => void | Promise<void>;
  className?: string;
}

type Kind = "object" | "array" | "string" | "number" | "boolean" | "null" | "other";

interface Row {
  id: string;
  parent: string | null;
  depth: number;
  name: string | number | null;
  value: unknown;
  kind: Kind;
  /** Number of children, 0 for leaves and empty containers. */
  count: number;
  pos: number;
  size: number;
  circular: boolean;
}

const kindOf = (v: unknown): Kind => {
  if (v === null) return "null";
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return "array";
  const t = typeof v;
  if (t === "object") return "object";
  if (t === "string" || t === "boolean") return t;
  if (t === "number" || t === "bigint") return "number";
  return "other";
};

const childrenOf = (v: unknown, kind: Kind): [string | number, unknown][] =>
  kind === "array" ? (v as unknown[]).map((x, i) => [i, x]) : kind === "object" ? Object.entries(v as object) : [];

const parentOf = (id: string) => (id === "$" ? null : id.slice(0, id.lastIndexOf("/")));

const typeWord: Record<Kind, string> = { object: "object", array: "array", string: "string", number: "number", boolean: "boolean", null: "null", other: "value" };
const tint: Record<Kind, string> = {
  string: "text-success-fg",
  number: "text-info-fg",
  boolean: "text-accent-fg",
  null: "text-fg-subtle italic",
  other: "text-fg-subtle italic",
  object: "text-fg-muted",
  array: "text-fg-muted",
};

const plural = (n: number, one: string) => `${n} ${one}${n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;

/** Shows a JSON value as a tree that opens level by level, following the WAI-ARIA tree view pattern. */
export function JsonView({ value, label, defaultExpandDepth = 1, maxStringLength = 160, onCopy, className }: JsonViewProps) {
  const labelId = useId();
  const [toggled, setToggled] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [full, setFull] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [active, setActive] = useState("$");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"" | "copied" | "failed">("");
  const items = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLDivElement>());
  const resetTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(resetTimer.current), []);

  const isOpen = (id: string, depth: number) => toggled[id] ?? depth < defaultExpandDepth;

  // Only open branches are walked, so a large or self-referencing value costs nothing until someone opens it.
  const rows: Row[] = [];
  const visit = (v: unknown, id: string, parent: string | null, depth: number, name: string | number | null, pos: number, size: number, seen: unknown[]) => {
    const circular = typeof v === "object" && v !== null && seen.includes(v);
    const kind = circular ? "other" : kindOf(v);
    const kids = childrenOf(v, kind);
    rows.push({ id, parent, depth, name, value: v, kind, count: kids.length, pos, size, circular });
    if (kids.length && isOpen(id, depth)) {
      kids.forEach(([k, c], i) => visit(c, `${id}/${encodeURIComponent(String(k))}`, id, depth + 1, k, i + 1, kids.length, [...seen, v]));
    }
  };
  visit(value, "$", null, 0, null, 1, 1, []);

  const ids = new Set(rows.map((r) => r.id));
  let current: string | null = active;
  while (current && !ids.has(current)) current = parentOf(current);
  const activeId = current ?? "$";

  const isLong = (r: Row) => r.kind === "string" && (r.value as string).length > maxStringLength;
  const toggle = (r: Row) => setToggled((t) => ({ ...t, [r.id]: !isOpen(r.id, r.depth) }));
  const flipFull = (id: string) => setFull((f) => ({ ...f, [id]: !f[id] }));
  const move = (id: string) => { setActive(id); items.current.get(id)?.focus(); };

  const activate = (r: Row) => {
    if (r.count) toggle(r);
    else if (isLong(r)) flipFull(r.id);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const i = rows.findIndex((r) => r.id === activeId);
    const r = rows[i];
    if (!r) return;
    const open = r.count > 0 && isOpen(r.id, r.depth);
    let next: string | undefined;
    switch (e.key) {
      case "ArrowDown": next = rows[i + 1]?.id; break;
      case "ArrowUp": next = rows[i - 1]?.id; break;
      case "Home": next = rows[0].id; break;
      case "End": next = rows[rows.length - 1].id; break;
      case "ArrowRight": if (r.count) { if (open) next = rows[i + 1]?.id; else toggle(r); } break;
      case "ArrowLeft": if (open) toggle(r); else if (r.parent) next = r.parent; break;
      case "Enter": case " ": activate(r); break;
      default: return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    if (next) move(next);
  };

  const copy = async () => {
    clearTimeout(resetTimer.current);
    try {
      const text = JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) ?? String(value);
      if (onCopy) await onCopy(text);
      else await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setStatus("copied");
    } catch {
      // The failure is shown and announced instead of being dropped.
      setStatus("failed");
    }
    resetTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setStatus(""), 2000);
  };

  const describe = (r: Row) => {
    const v = r.value;
    if (r.circular) return { text: "[circular]", spoken: "circular reference" };
    if (r.kind === "object") return r.count ? { text: `{ ${plural(r.count, "key")} }`, spoken: plural(r.count, "key") } : { text: "{ }", spoken: "empty" };
    if (r.kind === "array") return r.count ? { text: `[ ${plural(r.count, "item")} ]`, spoken: plural(r.count, "item") } : { text: "[ ]", spoken: "empty" };
    if (r.kind === "string") {
      const s = v as string;
      const cut = isLong(r) && !full[r.id];
      const shown = cut ? s.slice(0, maxStringLength) : s;
      return { text: JSON.stringify(shown).slice(0, -1) + (cut ? "…\"" : "\""), spoken: shown + (cut ? ", shortened, press Enter to show all" : isLong(r) ? ", press Enter to shorten" : "") };
    }
    const t = String(v);
    return { text: t, spoken: t };
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-line py-1 ps-3 pe-1">
        <span id={labelId} className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-small font-medium text-fg-muted">{label}</span>
        <span role="status" aria-live="polite" className={cn("text-small", status === "failed" ? "text-danger-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>
          {status === "copied" ? "Copied" : status === "failed" ? "Could not copy" : ""}
        </span>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={copy} leading={status === "copied" ? <CheckIcon width={14} height={14} /> : <CopyIcon width={14} height={14} />} className="pointer-coarse:min-h-11">
          Copy
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div role="region" aria-labelledby={labelId} className="overflow-x-auto p-1 font-mono text-compact leading-5">
        <div role="tree" aria-labelledby={labelId} onKeyDown={onKeyDown} className="min-w-full">
          {rows.map((r) => {
            const open = r.count > 0 && isOpen(r.id, r.depth);
            const d = describe(r);
            const name = r.name === null ? "" : `${r.name}, `;
            return (
              <div
                key={r.id}
                ref={(el) => { if (el) items.current.set(r.id, el); else items.current.delete(r.id); }}
                role="treeitem"
                aria-level={r.depth + 1}
                aria-posinset={r.pos}
                aria-setsize={r.size}
                aria-expanded={r.count ? open : undefined}
                aria-label={`${name}${typeWord[r.kind]}, ${d.spoken}`}
                tabIndex={r.id === activeId ? 0 : -1}
                onFocus={() => setActive(r.id)}
                onClick={() => { move(r.id); activate(r); }}
                style={{ "--depth": r.depth } as CSSProperties}
                className={cn(
                  "flex items-start gap-1 rounded-md py-0.5 pe-2 hover:bg-hover pointer-coarse:min-h-11 pointer-coarse:items-center motion-safe:animate-fade",
                  "ps-[calc(var(--depth)*var(--spacing)*2.5+var(--spacing))] sm:ps-[calc(var(--depth)*var(--spacing)*4+var(--spacing))]",
                  (r.count > 0 || isLong(r)) && "cursor-pointer",
                )}
              >
                <span aria-hidden className="flex h-5 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-fg-subtle">
                  {r.count > 0 && <ChevronIcon width={12} height={12} className={cn("motion-safe:transition-transform motion-safe:duration-[var(--dur-fast)]", open && "rotate-90")} />}
                </span>
                <span aria-hidden className="min-w-32 flex-1 wrap-anywhere">
                  {r.name !== null && (
                    <><span className={typeof r.name === "number" ? "text-fg-subtle" : "text-fg"}>{r.name}</span><span className="text-fg-subtle">: </span></>
                  )}
                  <span className={tint[r.kind]}>{d.text}</span>
                  {isLong(r) && <span className="ms-2 font-sans text-small text-accent-fg underline underline-offset-2">{full[r.id] ? "Show less" : "Show all"}</span>}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/JumpToLatest.tsx

```tsx
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { ChevronIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";

export interface JumpToLatestProps {
  /** Show the pill. Usually `!atBottom` from useStickToBottom. */
  visible: boolean;
  /** Messages that arrived while the reader was scrolled up. Shown with the "New messages" label when above zero. */
  count?: number;
  /** Scrolls the thread. Usually `scrollToBottom` from useStickToBottom. */
  onClick: () => void;
  /** Label with no unseen messages. */
  label?: string;
  /** Label with unseen messages. */
  newLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Floating pill that returns the reader to the newest message. Position it inside a relatively positioned thread.
 * It rises in over 220ms, or appears with no motion when the person prefers reduced motion.
 */
export function JumpToLatest({ visible, count = 0, onClick, label = "Jump to latest", newLabel = "New messages", className }: JumpToLatestProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  if (!visible) return null;
  return (
    <div className={cn("pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-3 z-10 flex justify-center", className)}>
      <button type="button" onClick={onClick}
        className={cn("pointer-events-auto inline-flex h-9 cursor-pointer tap items-center gap-2 rounded-control border border-line-strong bg-surface-raised px-4 text-compact text-fg shadow-md hover:bg-hover", !reduced && "animate-rise")}>
        <ChevronIcon className="rotate-90" width={14} height={14} />
        <span>{count > 0 ? newLabel : label}</span>
        {count > 0 && <span className="rounded-control bg-lime px-1.5 text-micro font-medium text-on-lime tabular-nums"><span className="sr-only">, </span>{count}</span>}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useId, type ReactNode } from "react";

      </p>

}
```
