## tattva/molecules/LatencyBreakdown.tsx

```tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export type LatencyStageKey = "endpointing" | "stt" | "llm" | "tools" | "tts" | "transport" | "s2s";

export interface LatencyStage {
  key: LatencyStageKey;
  /** Time spent in this stage, in milliseconds. */
  ms: number;
}

export interface LatencyTurn {
  id: string;
  /** Shown in the list, for example "Turn 4" or "Turn 4, 00:52". Defaults to "Turn" and its position. */
  label?: string;
  totalMs: number;
  stages: LatencyStage[];
}

export interface LatencyBreakdownProps {
  /** One reply (turn), or the whole call (stages are medians across turns). */
  mode: "turn" | "call";
  stages: LatencyStage[];
  /** Total time from the end of the person's speech to the first sound of the reply. */
  totalMs: number;
  /** Call mode: spread of turn times. */
  percentiles?: { p50: number; p90: number; p99?: number };
  /** A goal your team set, for example 800. Shown as your team's target, never as a rule. */
  targetMs?: number;
  /** Call mode: every turn. Turns over the target are listed. */
  turns?: LatencyTurn[];
  /** Called when a slow turn is chosen, for example to seek the recording to it. Turns become buttons when given. */
  onTurnSelect?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Heading. Defaults to "Response time" for a turn and "Response time, whole call" for a call. */
  title?: string;
  /** Override stage names, for localisation or your own vocabulary. */
  stageLabels?: Partial<Record<LatencyStageKey, string>>;
  className?: string;
}

const NAMES: Record<LatencyStageKey, string> = {
  endpointing: "End of speech",
  stt: "Speech to text",
  llm: "Model",
  tools: "Tools",
  tts: "Voice",
  transport: "Network",
  s2s: "Speech model",
};

/** Fixed colour per stage, so the same stage looks the same everywhere. Never lime: this is about time, not the AI. */
const SWATCH: Record<LatencyStageKey, string> = {
  endpointing: "bg-(--chart-neutral)",
  stt: "bg-(--chart-1)",
  llm: "bg-(--chart-2)",
  tools: "bg-(--chart-3)",
  tts: "bg-(--chart-4)",
  transport: "bg-(--chart-5)",
  s2s: "bg-(--chart-seq-4)",
};

const fmt = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-GB");
const ms = (n: number) => `${fmt.format(Math.round(n))} ms`;

const slowestOf = (stages: LatencyStage[]) => stages.reduce<LatencyStage | null>((a, s) => (!a || s.ms > a.ms ? s : a), null);

/**
 * Where the time went in a voice turn or a whole call. A stacked bar (decorative) names the slowest stage in words,
 * and a real table follows with every stage in ms. In call mode, turns over the team's target are listed and can
 * seek the recording. On a phone the bar gives way to the table, whose rows carry their own small bars.
 */
export function LatencyBreakdown({ mode, stages, totalMs, percentiles, targetMs, turns, onTurnSelect, title, stageLabels, className }: LatencyBreakdownProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const names = { ...NAMES, ...stageLabels };
  const sum = stages.reduce((a, s) => a + Math.max(0, s.ms), 0) || 1;
  const slowest = slowestOf(stages);
  const over = targetMs !== undefined && totalMs > targetMs;
  const slowTurns = targetMs !== undefined && turns ? turns.filter((t) => t.totalMs > targetMs) : [];
  const heading = title ?? (mode === "turn" ? "Response time" : "Response time, whole call");
  const totalLabel = mode === "turn" ? "This reply" : "Median reply";

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${id}-h`} className={cn("w-full space-y-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5 max-sm:p-4", className)}>
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
        <h3 id={`${id}-h`} className="text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">{heading}</h3>
        {targetMs !== undefined && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">Your team's target: {ms(targetMs)}</p>}
      </header>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-x-6 gap-y-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{totalLabel}</p>
          <p className="font-mono text-title-sm tabular-nums text-fg">{ms(totalMs)}</p>
          {targetMs !== undefined && (
            <p className={cn("text-small leading-4", over ? "text-danger-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>
              {over ? `Over target by ${ms(totalMs - targetMs)}` : `Within target, ${ms(targetMs - totalMs)} to spare`}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        {percentiles && (
          <dl className="flex gap-5 text-small leading-4">
            {([["P50", percentiles.p50], ["P90", percentiles.p90], ["P99", percentiles.p99]] as const).map(([k, v]) => v !== undefined && (
              <div key={k}>
                <dt className="text-fg-muted"><abbr title={`${k.slice(1)} percent of replies were this fast or faster`} className="no-underline">{k}</abbr></dt>
                <dd className="font-mono text-body leading-5 tabular-nums text-fg">{ms(v)}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        )}
      </div>

      {slowest && (
        <p className="text-body leading-5 text-fg">
          Most time: <span className="font-medium">{names[slowest.key].toLowerCase()}</span>, <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{ms(slowest.ms)}</span>
          <span className="text-fg-muted"> ({Math.round((slowest.ms / sum) * 100)}% of the reply)</span>
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Decorative: the table below carries every number. Hidden on a phone, where the table rows hold the bars. */}
      <div aria-hidden className="max-sm:hidden">
        <div className="flex h-4 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-control bg-sunken">
          {stages.map((s) => (
            <span key={s.key} style={{ width: `${(Math.max(0, s.ms) / sum) * 100}%` }}
              className={cn("h-full border-r border-surface last:border-r-0 motion-safe:animate-grow-x origin-left", SWATCH[s.key], slowest && s.key !== slowest.key && "opacity-60")} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <table className="w-full text-compact">
        <caption className="sr-only">{heading}: time per stage in milliseconds</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-line text-left text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
            <th scope="col" className="py-1.5 pr-2 font-medium">Stage</th>
            <th scope="col" className="py-1.5 pr-2 text-right font-medium">Time</th>
            <th scope="col" className="py-1.5 text-right font-medium sm:w-2/5">Share</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {stages.map((s) => {
            const pct = Math.round((Math.max(0, s.ms) / sum) * 100);
            const top = slowest?.key === s.key;
            return (
              <tr key={s.key} className="border-b border-line last:border-b-0">
                <th scope="row" className={cn("py-2 pr-2 text-left", top ? "font-semibold text-fg" : "font-normal text-fg")}>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span aria-hidden className={cn("size-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full", SWATCH[s.key])} />
                    {names[s.key]}{top && <span className="sr-only"> (slowest)</span>}
                  </span>
                </th>
                <td className="whitespace-nowrap py-2 pr-2 text-right font-mono tabular-nums">{ms(s.ms)}</td>
                <td className="py-2">
                  <span className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <span aria-hidden className="h-1.5 w-full max-w-24 min-w-6 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-sunken sm:hidden">
                      <span className={cn("block h-full", SWATCH[s.key])} style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
                    </span>
                    <span className="w-10 text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-fg-muted">{pct}%</span>
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>

      {mode === "call" && targetMs !== undefined && turns && (
        <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-line pt-4">
          <h4 className="text-small leading-4 font-semibold text-fg">
            {slowTurns.length === 0 ? `No turns over ${ms(targetMs)}` : `${slowTurns.length} of ${turns.length} turns over ${ms(targetMs)}`}
          </h4>
          {slowTurns.length > 0 && (
            <ul className="space-y-1">
              {slowTurns.map((t) => {
                const s = slowestOf(t.stages);
                const name = t.label ?? `Turn ${turns.indexOf(t) + 1}`;
                const body = (
                  <>
                    <span className="font-medium text-fg">{name}</span>
                    <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-fg">{ms(t.totalMs)}</span>
                    {s && <span className="text-fg-muted">most time: {names[s.key].toLowerCase()}, {ms(s.ms)}</span>}
                  </>
                );
                return (
                  <li key={t.id}>
                    {onTurnSelect ? (
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => onTurnSelect(t.id)}
                        className="flex min-h-9 w-full cursor-pointer flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 rounded-control px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-compact hover:bg-hover pointer-coarse:min-h-11">
                        {body}
                        <span className="ml-auto text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">Play from here</span>
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 px-2 py-1.5 text-compact">{body}</p>
                    )}
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/MediaFrame.tsx

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { ImageIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { AIBadge } from "../atoms/AIBadge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";
import { ProvenancePopover, type ProvenancePopoverProps } from "./ProvenancePopover";

export type MediaRatio = "1:1" | "4:3" | "16:9" | "3:2";

const ratioClass: Record<MediaRatio, string> = {
  "1:1": "aspect-square",
  "4:3": "aspect-[4/3]",
  "16:9": "aspect-video",
  "3:2": "aspect-[3/2]",
};

export interface MediaFrameProps {
  /** Image URL. */
  src: string;
  /** Describes what the image shows, not how it was made. Required. Ignored when `decorative` is set. */
  alt: string;
  /** Marks the image as decoration. Renders alt="". */
  decorative?: boolean;
  /** Fixed ratio. The frame reserves this space before the image loads, so layout does not shift. */
  ratio?: MediaRatio;
  /** Average color of the image as any CSS color, such as a token `var(--lime-soft)`. Used as the placeholder. When omitted, a shimmer shows while loading. */
  dominantColor?: string;
  /** Caption below the image. Wraps the frame in figure and figcaption. */
  caption?: string;
  /** Shows the AI-generated label on the image. */
  aiGenerated?: boolean;
  /** Label text for the AI badge. */
  aiLabel?: string;
  /** Provenance details. When set, the label opens a popover with them. */
  provenance?: Omit<ProvenancePopoverProps, "label">;
  /** Called when Retry is pressed after a load failure. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** Forces a state. Use it for previews and for controlled loading. */
  status?: "loading" | "error";
  /** Copy for the error tile. */
  errorLabel?: string;
  retryLabel?: string;
  /** Edge to edge inside a card: no corners or border of its own, so the card's corners clip the picture. */
  flush?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Image with a fixed ratio, a token radius and a reserved box. It shows a placeholder while loading,
 * a fallback tile with Retry when the image fails, an optional caption and an optional AI label.
 */
export function MediaFrame({
  src, alt, decorative, ratio = "4:3", dominantColor, caption, aiGenerated, aiLabel = "AI-generated", provenance, onRetry,
  status, errorLabel = "Image could not load", retryLabel = "Retry", flush = false, className,
}: MediaFrameProps) {
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const error = status === "error" || (status === undefined && failed);
  const showImage = status === undefined && !failed;
  const loading = status === "loading" || (showImage && !loaded);

  const retry = () => { setFailed(false); setLoaded(false); setAttempt((n) => n + 1); onRetry?.(); };

  const frame = (
    <div className={cn("relative", className)}>
      <div className={cn("relative overflow-hidden bg-sunken", !flush && "rounded-card border border-line", ratioClass[ratio])} style={dominantColor && !error ? { backgroundColor: dominantColor } : undefined}>
        {loading && !dominantColor && <Skeleton className="absolute inset-0 rounded-none" />}
        {showImage && (
          <img
            key={attempt}
            src={src}
            alt={decorative ? "" : alt}
            onLoad={() => setLoaded(true)}
            onError={() => setFailed(true)}
            className={cn("absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-[var(--dur-base)] motion-reduce:transition-none", loaded ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0")}
          />
        )}
        {error && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-sunken p-3 text-center">
            <ImageIcon width={20} height={20} className="text-fg-subtle" />
            <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{errorLabel}</p>
            <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={retry}>{retryLabel}</Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {aiGenerated && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-2 left-2 z-10 rounded-control bg-surface p-0.5">
          {provenance ? <ProvenancePopover label={aiLabel} side="top" {...provenance} /> : <AIBadge label={aiLabel} solid />}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  if (!caption) return frame;
  return (
    <figure className="m-0">
      {frame}
      <figcaption className="mt-2 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{caption}</figcaption>
    </figure>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { SparkleIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface MemoryNoticeProps {
  /** Heading. */
  title?: string;
  /** What was saved, in the person's terms. */
  saved: ReactNode;
  /** Opens the memory manager. The button is hidden when omitted. */
  onManage?: () => void;
  /** Removes the saved item. The button is hidden when omitted. */
  onUndo?: () => void;
  /** Dismisses the notice. The close button is hidden when omitted. */
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  manageLabel?: string;
  undoLabel?: string;
  dismissLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Inline notice shown at the moment something is saved to memory. It names what was saved and offers Manage and Undo. */
export function MemoryNotice({ title = "Memory updated", saved, onManage, onUndo, onDismiss, manageLabel = "Manage", undoLabel = "Undo", dismissLabel = "Dismiss memory notice", className }: MemoryNoticeProps) {
  return (
    <div role="status" className={cn("flex items-start gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken px-4 py-3 text-body leading-5", className)}>
      <SparkleIcon className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-fg-muted" width={14} height={14} />
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p className="font-medium text-fg">{title}</p>
        <p className="mt-0.5 text-fg-muted">{saved}</p>
        {(onManage || onUndo) && (
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {onManage && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onManage}>{manageLabel}</Button>}
            {onUndo && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onUndo}>{undoLabel}</Button>}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {onDismiss && <IconButton size="sm" label={dismissLabel} onClick={onDismiss}><XIcon /></IconButton>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/Menu.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { Kbd } from "../atoms/Kbd";
import { Popover } from "../atoms/Popover";

export type MenuEntry =
  | { type?: "item"; id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; shortcut?: string; disabled?: boolean; danger?: boolean; onSelect: () => void }
  | { type: "separator" }
  | { type: "label"; label: string };

export interface MenuProps {
  /** Content of the trigger button. For an icon alone, also set triggerLabel. */
  trigger: ReactNode;
  /** Accessible name of the trigger button. Required when the trigger is only an icon. */
  triggerLabel?: string;
  /** Accessible name of the menu itself. Defaults to triggerLabel, then "Menu". */
  label?: string;
  items: MenuEntry[];
  align?: "start" | "end";
  side?: "bottom" | "top";
  /** Draw the menu on the page itself so a scrolling or clipped parent cannot cut it off. Use inside lists and side bars. */
  portal?: boolean;
  /** On a phone the menu opens as a bottom sheet within thumb reach. Set false to keep a small floating menu there too. */
  phoneSheet?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const ENABLED = '[role="menuitem"]:not([aria-disabled="true"])';

/** Action menu opened from a button, following the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern. Built on Popover. */
export function Menu({ trigger, triggerLabel, label, items, align = "start", side = "bottom", portal, phoneSheet, className }: MenuProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const list = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const openAt = useRef<"first" | "last">("first");
  const buffer = useRef({ text: "", timer: 0 });

  // Popover focuses the first item. ArrowUp from the trigger asks for the last one instead.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    if (openAt.current === "last") {
      const all = list.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(ENABLED);
      all?.[all.length - 1]?.focus();
    }
    openAt.current = "first";
  }, [open]);
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(buffer.current.timer), []);

  const typeAhead = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.key.length !== 1 || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey || (e.key === " " && !buffer.current.text)) return;
    const all = Array.from(list.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(ENABLED) ?? []);
    if (!all.length) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const b = buffer.current;
    window.clearTimeout(b.timer);
    b.text += e.key.toLowerCase();
    b.timer = window.setTimeout(() => { b.text = ""; }, 600);
    const cur = all.findIndex((el) => el === document.activeElement);
    // One repeated letter cycles through matches; a longer word keeps the current match if it still fits.
    const start = b.text.length === 1 ? cur + 1 : Math.max(cur, 0);
    for (let k = 0; k < all.length; k++) {
      const el = all[(start + k) % all.length];
      if ((el.dataset.label ?? "").toLowerCase().startsWith(b.text)) { el.focus(); return; }
    }
  };

  return (
    <Popover label={label ?? triggerLabel ?? "Menu"} role="menu" align={align} side={side} portal={portal} phoneSheet={phoneSheet} open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} className={className} panelClassName="min-w-48"
      trigger={({ triggerProps }) => (
        <button type="button" aria-label={triggerLabel} {...triggerProps}
          onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (open || (e.key !== "ArrowDown" && e.key !== "ArrowUp")) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            openAt.current = e.key === "ArrowUp" ? "last" : "first";
            setOpen(true);
          }}
          className="inline-flex min-h-9 min-w-9 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-control border border-line bg-surface px-2.5 text-body font-medium text-fg transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] hover:bg-hover pointer-coarse:min-h-11 pointer-coarse:min-w-11">
          {trigger}
        </button>
      )}>
      {({ close }) => (
        <div ref={list} onKeyDown={typeAhead}>
          {items.map((it, i) => {
            if (it.type === "separator") return <div key={`s${i}`} role="separator" className="my-1 h-px bg-line forced-colors:bg-[CanvasText]" />;
            if (it.type === "label") return <div key={`l${i}`} role="presentation" className="px-2.5 pt-2 pb-1 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-subtle">{it.label}</div>;
            return (
              <button key={it.id} type="button" role="menuitem" tabIndex={-1} data-label={it.label} aria-disabled={it.disabled || undefined}
                onClick={() => { if (it.disabled) return; it.onSelect(); close(); }}
                className={cn(
                  "flex min-h-9 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 text-left text-body focus-visible:outline-offset-[-2px] pointer-coarse:min-h-11",
                  it.disabled ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-(--disabled-opacity)" : cn("cursor-pointer hover:bg-hover focus-visible:bg-hover", it.danger ? "text-danger-fg" : "text-fg"),
                )}>
                {it.icon && <span aria-hidden className="flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">{it.icon}</span>}
                <span className="flex-1">{it.label}</span>
                {it.shortcut && <Kbd>{it.shortcut}</Kbd>}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </Popover>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/Message.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { SparkleIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface MessageProps {
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  /** True while tokens are still arriving. Shows the caret, sets aria-busy and keeps the streaming text out of live announcements. */
  streaming?: boolean;
  /** Announced once, politely, when streaming ends. */
  completeLabel?: string;
  /** How the person's own turn looks. bubble is a right-aligned bubble. plain is left-aligned serif text with no box, like a line in a letter. Only changes user messages. */
  variant?: "bubble" | "plain";
  /**
   * The AI mark on an assistant reply. none (the default) shows no mark: the reply uses the full width and its place in
   * the thread says who wrote it, as in most chat products. top shows a small mark and the name above the reply: use it
   * once, on the first reply of a thread, or on every reply when more than one assistant or agent speaks.
   */
  mark?: "none" | "top";
  /** The name shown with the mark and read by screen readers before the reply. Defaults to "Assistant". */
  name?: string;
  /** @deprecated Use mark. true shows the mark above the reply; the mark no longer sits beside it. */
  showAvatar?: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
  /** Slot under the bubble: MessageActions, FeedbackBar, SourceList... */
  footer?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * User messages are right-aligned bubbles; assistant messages are unboxed prose across the full width, so long answers
 * stay readable and short ones do not leave a column of marks down the thread. Screen readers hear the name first.
 */
export function Message({ role, streaming, completeLabel = "Response complete", variant = "bubble", mark, name = "Assistant", showAvatar, children, footer, className }: MessageProps) {
  const top = (mark ?? (showAvatar ? "top" : "none")) === "top";
  const [announce, setAnnounce] = useState("");
  const was = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (streaming) setAnnounce("");
    else if (was.current) setAnnounce(completeLabel);
    was.current = !!streaming;
  }, [streaming, completeLabel]);

  if (role === "user" && variant === "plain") {
    return <div className={cn("animate-rise font-serif text-turn text-fg", className)}>{children}</div>;
  }
  if (role === "user") {
    return (
      <div className={cn("flex justify-end animate-rise", className)}>
        <div className="max-w-[80%] rounded-card rounded-br-[min(var(--radius-lg),var(--shape-card))] bg-sunken px-5 py-3 text-body-lg leading-relaxed">{children}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className={cn("animate-rise min-w-0 space-y-3", className)} aria-busy={streaming || undefined}>
      {top && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-compact font-medium text-fg-muted">
          <span aria-hidden className="grid size-5 place-items-center rounded-full bg-lime text-on-lime"><SparkleIcon width={11} height={11} /></span>{name}
        </p>
      )}
      {/* aria-live is off while tokens arrive, so screen readers are not interrupted per token. */}
      <div aria-live={streaming ? "off" : undefined} className="space-y-4 text-body-lg leading-7 text-fg">
        {!top && <span className="sr-only">{name}: </span>}
        {children}
        {streaming && <span aria-hidden className="ml-0.5 inline-block h-4 w-0.5 translate-y-0.5 bg-fg animate-caret" />}
      </div>
      {footer}
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{announce}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { CheckIcon, CopyIcon, RefreshIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";

export function MessageActions({ text, onRegenerate }: { text: string; onRegenerate?: () => void }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="-ml-1.5 flex items-center gap-0.5">
      <IconButton size="sm" label={copied ? "Copied" : "Copy response"} onClick={async () => {
        try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500); } catch { /* noop */ }
      }}>{copied ? <CheckIcon /> : <CopyIcon />}</IconButton>
      {onRegenerate && <IconButton size="sm" label="Regenerate response" onClick={onRegenerate}><RefreshIcon /></IconButton>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/ModelPicker.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon, ChevronIcon, InfoIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Popover } from "../atoms/Popover";
import { SegmentedControl, type SegmentOption } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";

export interface ModelOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** One line describing when to use it. */
  description?: string;
  /** Short badge text such as "Auto". */
  badge?: string;
  /** Marks the option that routes to another model by itself. Pair with `routedId` on the picker. */
  auto?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface ModelLimit {
  /** Reason line shown above the list, for example "Weekly limit reached. Resets Friday." */
  reason: string;
  /** Options that cannot be chosen until the limit resets. */
  limitedIds: string[];
  /** Option the conversation continues on. Its name appears in the fallback line. */
  fallbackId: string;
}

export interface ModelPickerProps {
  models: ModelOption[];
  /** Selected model id. Omit for uncontrolled use. */
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Accessible name for the list and the panel. */
  label?: string;
  /** Model that actually answered when an auto option is selected. Shown in the panel and on the trigger. */
  routedId?: string;
  /** Builds the line that names the answering model. */
  routedText?: (modelName: string) => string;
  /** Reasoning effort choices, for example Standard and Extended. Omit to hide the control. */
  effortOptions?: SegmentOption<string>[];
  effortValue?: string;
  defaultEffort?: string;
  onEffortChange?: (value: string) => void;
  effortLabel?: string;
  /** Puts the picker in its limit-reached state. */
  limit?: ModelLimit;
  /** Builds the line that names the fallback model. */
  fallbackText?: (modelName: string) => string;
  align?: "start" | "end";
  side?: "bottom" | "top";
  /** Replaces the trigger chip's trailing content. */
  triggerExtra?: ReactNode;
}

/** Chip plus popover for choosing a model or mode. Options form a labelled radio list with arrow-key movement, and an optional effort control sits below. */
export function ModelPicker({
  models, value, defaultValue, onChange, label = "Model", routedId, routedText = (n) => `Answered by ${n}`,
  effortOptions, effortValue, defaultEffort, onEffortChange, effortLabel = "Thinking time",
  limit, fallbackText = (n) => `Continuing on ${n}.`, align = "start", side = "bottom", triggerExtra,
}: ModelPickerProps) {
  const [innerValue, setInnerValue] = useState(defaultValue ?? models[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [innerEffort, setInnerEffort] = useState(defaultEffort ?? effortOptions?.[0]?.value ?? "");
  const current = value ?? innerValue;
  const effort = effortValue ?? innerEffort;
  const refs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);

  const isOff = (m: ModelOption) => m.disabled || !!limit?.limitedIds.includes(m.id);
  const selected = models.find((m) => m.id === current);
  const routed = selected?.auto && routedId ? models.find((m) => m.id === routedId) : undefined;
  const fallback = limit ? models.find((m) => m.id === limit.fallbackId) : undefined;

  const pick = (id: string) => { if (value === undefined) setInnerValue(id); onChange?.(id); };
  const setEffort = (v: string) => { if (effortValue === undefined) setInnerEffort(v); onEffortChange?.(v); };

  const move = (i: number, e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    const dir = e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : e.key === "ArrowUp" || e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 0;
    const edge = e.key === "Home" ? 0 : e.key === "End" ? models.length - 1 : -1;
    if (!dir && edge < 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const n = models.length;
    let next = i;
    if (edge >= 0) { next = edge; let guard = 0; while (isOff(models[next]) && guard++ < n) next = (next + (edge === 0 ? 1 : -1) + n) % n; }
    else { let guard = 0; do { next = (next + dir + n) % n; } while (isOff(models[next]) && guard++ < n); }
    if (isOff(models[next])) return;
    pick(models[next].id);
    refs.current[next]?.focus();
  };

  // Roving tab stop: the checked enabled option, else the first enabled one.
  const stopId = selected && !isOff(selected) ? selected.id : models.find((m) => !isOff(m))?.id;

  return (
    <Popover phoneSheet label={label} align={align} side={side} panelClassName="w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]"
      trigger={({ toggle, triggerProps }) => (
        <button type="button" onClick={toggle} {...triggerProps}
          className="inline-flex h-8 max-w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control border border-line bg-surface pl-3 pr-2 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-hover">
          <span className="sr-only">{label}: </span>
          <span className="truncate">{selected?.name ?? label}</span>
          {routed && <span className="truncate font-normal text-fg-muted">via {routed.name}</span>}
          {triggerExtra}
          <ChevronIcon width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0 rotate-90 text-fg-subtle" />
        </button>
      )}>
      {({ close }) => (
        <div>
          {limit && (
            <p className="mx-1 mb-1 flex gap-2 rounded-xl bg-sunken px-3 py-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
              <InfoIcon width={14} height={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>{limit.reason}{fallback ? ` ${fallbackText(fallback.name)}` : ""}</span>
            </p>
          )}
          <div role="radiogroup" aria-label={label}>
            {models.map((m, i) => {
              const on = m.id === current;
              const off = isOff(m);
              return (
                <button key={m.id} ref={(el) => { refs.current[i] = el; }} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={on} aria-disabled={off || undefined}
                  tabIndex={m.id === stopId ? 0 : -1}
                  onClick={() => { if (off) return; pick(m.id); close(); }} onKeyDown={(e) => move(i, e)}
                  className={cn("flex w-full items-start gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-left transition-colors", off ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-(--disabled-opacity)" : "cursor-pointer hover:bg-hover", on && "bg-selected")}>
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-compact font-medium text-fg">
                      <span className="truncate">{m.name}</span>
                      {m.badge && <Badge>{m.badge}</Badge>}
                    </span>
                    {m.description && <span className="block text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{m.description}</span>}
                  </span>
                  <span className="mt-0.5 flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-fg">{on && <CheckIcon width={16} height={16} />}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          {routed && (
            <p className="mx-1 mt-1 rounded-xl bg-sunken px-3 py-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{routedText(routed.name)}</p>
          )}
          {effortOptions && (
            <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-line px-3 pt-2.5 pb-1.5">
              <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{effortLabel}</span>
              <SegmentedControl size="sm" label={effortLabel} options={effortOptions} value={effort} onChange={setEffort} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </Popover>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/PermissionModeSwitcher.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, ChevronIcon, InfoIcon, ShieldIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Popover } from "../atoms/Popover";
import { Kbd } from "../atoms/Kbd";

export type ModeRisk = "low" | "medium" | "high";

export interface PermissionMode {
  id: string;
  /** Short name shown on the trigger, such as "Manual". */
  label: string;
  /** Plain description of what the agent may do without asking. */
  description: string;
  risk: ModeRisk;
  /** Warning line shown under the description. Use it on the riskiest mode. */
  warning?: string;
  /** When set, the mode cannot be chosen and this reason is shown, for example an admin policy. */
  lockedReason?: string;
}

export const defaultPermissionModes: PermissionMode[] = [
  { id: "manual", label: "Manual", description: "Asks before every edit and command. Read-only commands run without asking.", risk: "low" },
  { id: "plan", label: "Plan (read-only)", description: "Reads and explores, then proposes a plan. Nothing is edited until you approve it.", risk: "low" },
  { id: "accept-edits", label: "Accept edits", description: "Edits files without asking. Commands still ask.", risk: "medium" },
  { id: "auto", label: "Auto", description: "A classifier reviews each action instead of you.", risk: "medium" },
  { id: "bypass", label: "Bypass", description: "Skips all permission prompts, including protected paths.", risk: "high", warning: "Use only in an isolated environment." },
];

const riskText: Record<ModeRisk, string> = { low: "Low risk", medium: "Medium risk", high: "High risk" };
const RiskIcon = { low: ShieldIcon, medium: InfoIcon, high: AlertIcon } as const;

export interface PermissionModeSwitcherProps {
  /** Modes in display order. Defaults to Manual, Plan, Accept edits, Auto and Bypass. */
  modes?: PermissionMode[];
  /** Selected mode id (controlled). */
  value?: string;
  /** Initial mode id when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first mode. */
  defaultValue?: string;
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Accessible name for the mode list and the popover. */
  label?: string;
  /** Keyboard shortcut shown at the foot of the panel, such as "Shift+Tab". Only show it if the app binds it. */
  shortcut?: string;
  /** Text beside the shortcut. */
  shortcutLabel?: string;
  /** Text used in the live announcement, followed by the mode name. */
  announcePrefix?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Always-visible trigger that names the current autonomy mode, with a popover to change it.
 * Each mode carries a risk label written out and shown with its own icon shape.
 */
export function PermissionModeSwitcher({
  modes = defaultPermissionModes, value, defaultValue, onChange, label = "Permission mode",
  shortcut, shortcutLabel = "to cycle modes", announcePrefix = "Mode changed to", className,
}: PermissionModeSwitcherProps) {
  const [inner, setInner] = useState(defaultValue ?? modes[0]?.id);
  const [announce, setAnnounce] = useState("");
  const current = value ?? inner;
  const active = modes.find((m) => m.id === current) ?? modes[0];
  const refs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const listId = useId();

  const choose = (m: PermissionMode, close: () => void) => {
    if (m.lockedReason) return;
    if (value === undefined) setInner(m.id);
    onChange?.(m.id);
    setAnnounce(`${announcePrefix} ${m.label}`);
    close();
  };
  const move = (i: number, e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    const n = modes.length;
    const dir = e.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : e.key === "ArrowUp" ? -1 : 0;
    if (!dir) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    refs.current[(i + dir + n) % n]?.focus();
  };

  if (!active) return null;
  const ActiveIcon = RiskIcon[active.risk];

  return (
    <div className={cn("inline-block", className)}>
      <Popover phoneSheet label={label} align="start" side="top" panelClassName="w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]"
        trigger={({ toggle, triggerProps }) => (
          <button type="button" onClick={toggle} {...triggerProps}
            className="inline-flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-control border border-line bg-surface px-3 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg hover:border-line-strong">
            <ActiveIcon width={14} height={14} className="text-fg-muted" />
            <span className="text-fg-subtle">{label}:</span>
            <span>{active.label}</span>
            <span className="sr-only">, {riskText[active.risk]}</span>
            <ChevronIcon width={12} height={12} className="rotate-90 text-fg-subtle" />
          </button>
        )}>
        {({ close }) => (
          <div>
            <ul role="radiogroup" aria-label={label} id={listId} className="space-y-0.5">
              {modes.map((m, i) => {
                const on = m.id === active.id;
                const locked = !!m.lockedReason;
                const Icon = RiskIcon[m.risk];
                return (
                  <li key={m.id} role="presentation">
                    <button ref={(el) => { refs.current[i] = el; }} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={on} aria-disabled={locked || undefined}
                      tabIndex={on ? 0 : -1} onKeyDown={(e) => move(i, e)} onClick={() => choose(m, close)}
                      className={cn("flex w-full items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-left transition-colors",
                        locked ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-(--disabled-opacity)" : "cursor-pointer hover:bg-hover", on && "bg-selected")}>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-fg">{on && <CheckIcon width={14} height={14} />}</span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 text-compact font-medium text-fg">
                          {m.label}
                          <span className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-micro font-normal", m.risk === "high" ? "text-danger-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>
                            <Icon width={12} height={12} />{riskText[m.risk]}
                          </span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="mt-0.5 block text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{m.description}</span>
                        {m.warning && (
                          <span className="mt-1 flex items-start gap-1 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-danger-fg">
                            <AlertIcon width={12} height={12} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />{m.warning}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {locked && <span className="mt-1 block text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">Locked: {m.lockedReason}</span>}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
            {shortcut && (
              <p className="mt-1 border-t border-line px-2.5 pt-2 pb-1 text-micro text-fg-subtle">
                <Kbd>{shortcut}</Kbd> {shortcutLabel}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Popover>
      <span role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{announce}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

/** Private inline glyph: a ghost, 24px grid, 1.5 stroke. */
function GhostIcon({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg width={16} height={16} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" className={className}>
      <path d="M5 21V11a7 7 0 0 1 14 0v10l-3.5-2.5L12 21l-3.5-2.5L5 21z" /><path d="M9.5 11h.01M14.5 11h.01" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export interface PrivateChatBannerProps {
  /** "banner" is a full-width strip with retention copy. "compact" is a pill for headers. */
  variant?: "banner" | "compact";
  /** Name of the mode. */
  label?: string;
  /** Plain retention copy. State the real retention period for your product. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Leaves the private chat. */
  onExit?: () => void;
  exitLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Persistent indicator that the current chat is private. Neutral on purpose, because nothing needs fixing. */
export function PrivateChatBanner({ variant = "banner", label = "Private chat", description = "Not saved to your history or memory and not used for training. A copy may be kept for 30 days.", onExit, exitLabel = "Exit", className }: PrivateChatBannerProps) {
  if (variant === "compact") {
    return (
      <div className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control border border-line-strong bg-sunken py-0.5 pr-0.5 pl-2.5 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg", className)}>
        <GhostIcon className="text-fg-muted" />
        <span>{label}</span>
        {onExit ? <IconButton size="sm" label={`Exit ${label.toLowerCase()}`} onClick={onExit}><XIcon /></IconButton> : <span className="w-2" />}
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <section aria-label={label} className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 rounded-card border border-line-strong bg-sunken px-4 py-3", className)}>
      <GhostIcon className="shrink-0 text-fg-muted" />
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-56">
        <p className="text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">{label}</p>
        <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{description}</p>
      </div>
      {onExit && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onExit}>{exitLabel}</Button>}
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/ProvenancePopover.tsx

```tsx
import { SparkleIcon, ChevronIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Popover } from "../atoms/Popover";

export interface ProvenancePopoverProps {
  /** Text of the AI label. It is the accessible name of the trigger. */
  label?: string;
  /** Tool or model that produced the content. */
  madeWith?: string;
  /** When it was made, as display text. */
  date?: string;
  /** What the AI did, one short phrase each. */
  actions?: string[];
  /** Whether a person changed the content after it was generated. Omit to leave the row out. */
  editedByPerson?: boolean;
  /** One short line answering "why am I seeing this". */
  why?: string;
  /** Link to a fuller record. */
  detailsHref?: string;
  detailsLabel?: string;
  /** Heading inside the panel. */
  title?: string;
  /** Row labels, so product copy can be localised. */
  rowLabels?: { madeWith: string; date: string; actions: string; edited: string; yes: string; no: string };
  /** Controlled mode. Omit both to let it manage itself. */
  open?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  align?: "start" | "end";
  side?: "bottom" | "top";
}

const defaultRows = { madeWith: "Made with", date: "Date", actions: "What AI did", edited: "Edited by a person", yes: "Yes", no: "No" };

/**
 * AI label that opens an explanation on demand. The label is always visible text, the details sit one click away.
 * Built on Popover, so it opens with Enter, Space or a tap, closes on Escape and returns focus to the label.
 */
export function ProvenancePopover({
  label = "AI-generated", madeWith, date, actions, editedByPerson, why, detailsHref, detailsLabel = "View full details",
  title = "About this content", rowLabels = defaultRows, open, onOpenChange, align = "start", side = "bottom",
}: ProvenancePopoverProps) {
  const r = { ...defaultRows, ...rowLabels };
  const rows: [string, string][] = [];
  if (madeWith) rows.push([r.madeWith, madeWith]);
  if (date) rows.push([r.date, date]);
  if (editedByPerson !== undefined) rows.push([r.edited, editedByPerson ? r.yes : r.no]);
  return (
    <Popover phoneSheet label={title} open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange} align={align} side={side} panelClassName="w-72 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] p-3.5"
      trigger={({ open: isOpen, toggle, triggerProps }) => (
        <button type="button" onClick={toggle} {...triggerProps}
          className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-control border border-transparent bg-lime-soft px-2 py-0.5 text-micro leading-4 font-medium text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-lime-soft-hover">
          <SparkleIcon width={10} height={10} />{label}
          <ChevronIcon width={10} height={10} className={isOpen ? "-rotate-90" : "rotate-90"} />
        </button>
      )}>
      <div className="space-y-3 text-compact">
        <h4 className="font-sans! text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">{title}</h4>
        {rows.length > 0 && (
          <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-3 gap-y-1.5">
            {rows.map(([k, v]) => (<div key={k} className="contents"><dt className="text-fg-muted">{k}</dt><dd className="text-fg">{v}</dd></div>))}
          </dl>
        )}
        {actions && actions.length > 0 && (
          <div>
            <p className="text-fg-muted">{r.actions}</p>
            <ul className="mt-1 list-disc space-y-0.5 pl-4 text-fg">{actions.map((a) => <li key={a}>{a}</li>)}</ul>
          </div>
        )}
        {why && <p className="rounded-xl bg-sunken px-3 py-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{why}</p>}
        {detailsHref && <a href={detailsHref} className="inline-block text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg underline underline-offset-2">{detailsLabel}</a>}
      </div>
    </Popover>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface RadioOption {
  value: string;
  label: ReactNode;
  /** Visible hint under the label. */
  description?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface RadioGroupProps {
  options: RadioOption[];
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  /** Name of the group, shown as the legend. */
  label: string;
  /** Hides the legend visually. Screen readers still hear it. */
  hideLabel?: boolean;
  orientation?: "vertical" | "horizontal";
  /** Marks every radio as having an error (red border, aria-invalid). Show the error text yourself. */
  invalid?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Shared by all radios, which is what gives the browser its arrow-key behaviour. Defaults to a generated one. */
  name?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Controlled group of native radios in a fieldset. The browser handles Tab and the arrow keys. */
export function RadioGroup({ options, value, onChange, label, hideLabel, orientation = "vertical", invalid, disabled, name, className }: RadioGroupProps) {
  const auto = useId();
  const groupName = name ?? auto;
  return (
    <fieldset disabled={disabled} className={cn("min-w-0 border-0 p-0 m-0", className)}>
      <legend className={cn("mb-2 p-0 text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg", hideLabel && "sr-only")}>{label}</legend>
      <div className={cn("flex gap-x-6 gap-y-2", orientation === "vertical" ? "flex-col" : "flex-row flex-wrap")}>
        {options.map((o) => <Radio key={o.value} name={groupName} option={o} checked={o.value === value} invalid={invalid} onSelect={onChange} />)}
      </div>
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function Radio({ name, option, checked, invalid, onSelect }: { name: string; option: RadioOption; checked: boolean; invalid?: boolean; onSelect: (v: string) => void }) {
  const labelId = useId();
  const descId = useId();
  return (
    <label className={cn("inline-flex items-start gap-3 text-body leading-5 text-fg pointer-coarse:min-h-11 pointer-coarse:items-center", option.disabled ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-(--disabled-opacity)" : "cursor-pointer")}>
      <span className="relative mt-0.5 inline-grid size-5 shrink-0 place-items-center pointer-coarse:mt-0">
        <input type="radio" name={name} value={option.value} checked={checked} disabled={option.disabled}
          aria-invalid={invalid || undefined} aria-labelledby={labelId} aria-describedby={option.description ? descId : undefined}
          onChange={() => onSelect(option.value)}
          className={cn("peer size-5 shrink-0 appearance-none rounded-full border bg-surface transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] checked:border-accent forced-colors:border-[ButtonText] forced-colors:checked:border-[Highlight]",
            invalid ? "border-danger" : "border-line-strong", option.disabled ? "cursor-not-allowed" : "cursor-pointer")} />
        <span aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute size-2.5 scale-0 rounded-full bg-accent transition-transform duration-[var(--dur-fast)] peer-checked:scale-100 forced-colors:bg-[Highlight]" />
      </span>
      <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
        <span id={labelId}>{option.label}</span>
        {option.description && <span id={descId} className="text-fg-muted">{option.description}</span>}
      </span>
    </label>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon, ChevronIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface ReceiptProps {
  /** What was settled, such as "Confirmed the facts". */
  title: string;
  /** Right side of the row, such as a date or an amount. */
  meta?: ReactNode;
  /** Replaces the default check. Decorative. */
  icon?: ReactNode;
  /** The full card, shown when opened. */
  children: ReactNode;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Mount the children even while closed (hidden), for example to keep form state. */
  keepMounted?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * A settled card folded into one line so the thread stays short. Every decision card in a thread becomes a
 * Receipt once the person has acted. Opening it shows the original card in place; nothing traps focus.
 */
export function Receipt({ title, meta, icon, children, defaultOpen = false, open, onOpenChange, keepMounted, className }: ReceiptProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const [inner, setInner] = useState(defaultOpen);
  const isOpen = open ?? inner;
  const toggle = () => { const v = !isOpen; if (open === undefined) setInner(v); onOpenChange?.(v); };
  return (
    <div className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface", className)}>
      <button type="button" id={`${uid}-b`} aria-expanded={isOpen} aria-controls={`${uid}-r`} onClick={toggle}
        className="flex min-h-10 w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-card px-4 py-2 text-left text-body leading-5 hover:bg-hover pointer-coarse:min-h-11">
        <span aria-hidden className="flex shrink-0 text-success-fg">{icon ?? <CheckIcon width={16} height={16} />}</span>
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 break-words font-medium">{title}</span>
        {meta && <span className="shrink-0 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{meta}</span>}
        <ChevronIcon aria-hidden className={cn("shrink-0 text-fg-subtle transition-transform duration-[var(--dur-fast)]", isOpen && "rotate-90")} />
      </button>
      <div id={`${uid}-r`} role="region" aria-labelledby={`${uid}-b`} hidden={!isOpen} className="border-t border-line p-3">
        {(isOpen || keepMounted) && children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/ResultCard.tsx

```tsx
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { Badge, type Tone } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";
import { formatPrice } from "../atoms/Price";
import { FactList, type Fact } from "./FactList";
import { MediaFrame } from "./MediaFrame";

export interface ResultCardPrice {
  value: number;
  /** ISO currency code, such as "EUR". */
  currency?: string;
  locale?: string;
  decimals?: number;
  /** What the price is for: "per night", "a month". */
  note?: string;
}

export interface ResultCardProps {
  /** The thing's name: a hotel, product, place or person. */
  title: string;
  /** One short line under the name: an area, a brand, a role. */
  subtitle?: string;
  /** A picture of the thing. `alt` says what it shows. */
  image?: { src: string; alt: string };
  /** Two to four facts that help choose between results. */
  facts?: Fact[];
  price?: ResultCardPrice;
  /** One short tag, such as "Free cancellation" or "Best match". */
  tag?: { label: string; tone?: Tone };
  /** The one thing to do with this result. */
  action?: { label: string; onClick: () => void };
  /** The answer is still arriving: the card is shown, but its action waits until the answer is complete. */
  streaming?: boolean;
  /** Draws placeholders while the result is loading. */
  loading?: boolean;
  /** Level of the name's heading. Defaults to 3, under an answer's own heading. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * One thing in an answer, such as a hotel, a product, a place or a person: a picture, its name, a few facts, an
 * optional price and tag, and one action. Lay several out with CardRow, all with the same fields.
 */
export function ResultCard({ title, subtitle, image, facts, price, tag, action, streaming = false, loading = false, headingLevel = 3, className }: ResultCardProps) {
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div aria-busy="true" className={cn("flex h-full w-full flex-col gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3", className)}>
        <Skeleton className="aspect-video w-full rounded-[max(2px,calc(var(--radius-card)-12px))]" />
        <Skeleton className="h-5 w-2/3" />
        <Skeleton className="h-4 w-1/2" />
        <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <article className={cn("flex h-full w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-surface", className)} aria-busy={streaming || undefined}>
      {image && (
        <div className="relative">
          <MediaFrame src={image.src} alt={image.alt} ratio="16:9" flush />
          {/* On a picture the tag sits on its corner, so the name keeps the full width. */}
          {tag && <Badge tone={tag.tone ?? "neutral"} className="absolute top-3 left-3">{tag.label}</Badge>}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-3 p-4">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <H className="m-0 font-sans! text-lead leading-6 font-semibold text-fg [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">{title}</H>
            {subtitle && <p className="m-0 mt-0.5 text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{subtitle}</p>}
          </div>
          {tag && !image && <Badge tone={tag.tone ?? "neutral"} className="shrink-0">{tag.label}</Badge>}
        </div>
        {facts && facts.length > 0 && <FactList facts={facts} className="-my-1.5" />}
        {(price || action) && (
          <div className="mt-auto flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3 pt-1">
            {price ? (
              <p className="m-0 min-w-0">
                <span className="text-lead-lg leading-6 font-semibold text-fg tabular-nums">{formatPrice(price.value, price.currency ?? "USD", price.locale ?? "en-US", price.decimals ?? 0)}</span>
                {price.note && <span className="ml-1 text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{price.note}</span>}
              </p>
            ) : <span />}
            {action && (
              <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={action.onClick} disabled={streaming} aria-label={`${action.label}: ${title}`}>{action.label}</Button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/RevertToggle.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export type RevertVersion = "ai" | "user";

export interface RevertToggleProps {
  /** The original AI suggestion. */
  aiValue: ReactNode;
  /** The person's edited version. When absent, only the AI value shows and the controls are hidden. */
  userValue?: ReactNode;
  /** Controlled active version. Omit to let the toggle manage itself. */
  value?: RevertVersion;
  /** Starting version in uncontrolled mode. Defaults to "user" when an edit exists. */
  defaultValue?: RevertVersion;
  onChange?: (value: RevertVersion) => void;
  /** Called when the person chooses Revert to original. The app should drop the edit. */
  onRevert?: () => void;
  aiLabel?: string;
  userLabel?: string;
  revertLabel?: string;
  /** Accessible name for the version switch. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Switches a value between the AI suggestion and the person's edit, with a way back to the original. */
export function RevertToggle({ aiValue, userValue, value, defaultValue, onChange, onRevert, aiLabel = "AI suggestion", userLabel = "Your edit", revertLabel = "Revert to original", label = "Version", className }: RevertToggleProps) {
  const hasEdit = userValue !== undefined && userValue !== null;
  const [inner, setInner] = useState<RevertVersion>(defaultValue ?? (hasEdit ? "user" : "ai"));
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const active: RevertVersion = hasEdit ? (value ?? inner) : "ai";
  const names = { ai: aiLabel, user: userLabel };
  const set = (v: RevertVersion) => { if (value === undefined) setInner(v); onChange?.(v); setMessage(`Showing ${names[v]}`); };
  return (
    <div className={cn("space-y-3", className)}>
      {hasEdit && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <SegmentedControl size="sm" label={label} value={active} onChange={set} options={[{ value: "ai", label: aiLabel }, { value: "user", label: userLabel }]} />
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { set("ai"); onRevert?.(); }}>{revertLabel}</Button>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3 text-body leading-5 text-fg">{active === "ai" ? aiValue : userValue}</div>
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{message}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/SceneIllustration.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { AnimationItem } from "lottie-web";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

/** The 35 Tattva scenes. Each is a Lottie file at `scenes/<name>.json` on the site and in the npm package. */
export const sceneNames = [
  "first-use", "no-results", "error", "permission", "offline", "rate-limit", "success", "upload", "working",
  "sources", "approval", "confidence", "refusal", "memory", "private", "undo", "sensitive",
  "plan", "takeover", "needs-you", "background",
  "variants", "voice", "video", "slides", "music",
  "chart", "generated", "first-run", "download", "connect", "lost", "whats-new", "accessible", "mobile",
] as const;
export type SceneName = (typeof sceneNames)[number];

/** A plain title for each scene, for galleries and as a fallback accessible name. */
export const sceneTitles: Record<SceneName, string> = {
  "first-use": "First message", "no-results": "Nothing found", error: "Something broke", permission: "Asking for access",
  offline: "No connection", "rate-limit": "Slow down", success: "Done", upload: "Add a file", working: "Working on it",
  sources: "Show the sources", approval: "Ask before acting", confidence: "How sure it is", refusal: "A polite no",
  memory: "What it remembers", private: "Private chat", undo: "Take it back", sensitive: "Hide private details",
  plan: "The plan", takeover: "Take over", "needs-you": "Waiting for you", background: "Working while you are away",
  variants: "Pick a version", voice: "Speak to it", video: "Take after take", slides: "Build a deck", music: "Make music",
  chart: "Read the numbers", generated: "Built as it goes", "first-run": "Get started", download: "Download",
  connect: "Connect", lost: "Page not found", "whats-new": "What is new", accessible: "Works for everyone", mobile: "On a phone",
};

export type SceneMotion = "loop" | "once" | "still";
export type SceneSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "fill";

export interface SceneIllustrationProps {
  /** The scene's Lottie data. Pass this or `src`. */
  data?: object;
  /** Address of the scene's Lottie file, for example `${base}scenes/approval.json`. Used when `data` is not given. */
  src?: string;
  /** Accessible name. Leave it out when nearby words already say what the scene shows; the scene is then hidden from assistive tech. */
  label?: string;
  /** `loop` plays the entrance, then a calm loop. `once` plays the entrance and stops. `still` shows the finished picture. Reduced motion always shows the still picture. */
  motion?: SceneMotion;
  /** Width: 12rem, 18rem or 30rem. `fill` takes the width of its container. Height follows at 4:3. */
  size?: SceneSize;
  className?: string;
}

const sizes: Record<SceneSize, string> = { sm: "w-48", md: "w-72", lg: "w-120", fill: "w-full" };

/* Scenes are drawn with three key colours. The theme decides what they become, so scenes follow light and dark mode. */
const themed =
  "[&_[fill='rgb(17,17,17)']]:fill-fg [&_[stroke='rgb(17,17,17)']]:stroke-fg " +
  "[&_[fill='rgb(255,255,255)']]:fill-surface [&_[stroke='rgb(255,255,255)']]:stroke-surface " +
  "[&_[fill='rgb(200,240,74)']]:fill-lime [&_[stroke='rgb(200,240,74)']]:stroke-lime";

interface Marker { tm: number; cm: string; dr: number }

/** Where the entrance ends and the loop runs, read from the file's "intro" and "loop" markers. */
function segments(data: { markers?: Marker[]; op?: number }) {
  const intro = data.markers?.find((m) => m.cm === "intro");
  const loop = data.markers?.find((m) => m.cm === "loop");
  const end = data.op ?? 0;
  const introEnd = intro ? intro.tm + intro.dr : end;
  return { introEnd, loop: loop ? [loop.tm, loop.tm + loop.dr] as [number, number] : null };
}

/**
 * A Tattva scene: a small story told with objects and a lime shape, played from a Lottie file.
 * It plays a short entrance, then a calm loop that carries the meaning, and pauses while off screen.
 */
export function SceneIllustration({ data, src, label, motion = "loop", size = "md", className }: SceneIllustrationProps) {
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let anim: AnimationItem | null = null;
    let seen: IntersectionObserver | null = null;
    let cancelled = false;
    const still = motion === "still" || window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

    (async () => {
      const json = (data ?? (src ? await fetch(src).then((r) => r.json()) : null)) as { markers?: Marker[]; op?: number } | null;
      if (!json || cancelled || !box.current) return;
      const lottie = (await import("lottie-web/build/player/lottie_light")).default;
      if (cancelled || !box.current) return;
      const { introEnd, loop } = segments(json);
      anim = lottie.loadAnimation({
        container: box.current, renderer: "svg", loop: false, autoplay: false,
        animationData: structuredClone(json), rendererSettings: { preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid meet" },
      });
      anim.addEventListener("DOMLoaded", () => {
        setReady(true);
        if (still) { anim?.goToAndStop(introEnd, true); return; }
        anim?.playSegments([0, introEnd], true);
      });
      anim.addEventListener("complete", () => {
        if (motion === "loop" && loop && anim) { anim.loop = true; anim.playSegments(loop, true); }
      });
      if (!still) {
        let hidden = false;
        seen = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => {
          if (!anim) return;
          if (!e.isIntersecting) { hidden = true; anim.pause(); } else if (hidden) { hidden = false; anim.play(); }
        });
        seen.observe(box.current);
      }
    })();

    return () => { cancelled = true; seen?.disconnect(); anim?.destroy(); };
  }, [data, src, motion]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={box}
      role={label ? "img" : undefined}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-busy={ready ? undefined : true}
      className={cn("aspect-[4/3] max-w-full shrink-0", sizes[size], themed, className)}
    />
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/SelectionToolbar.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { SendIcon, SparkleIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Popover } from "../atoms/Popover";
import { IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";

export interface SelectionAction { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode }

export interface SelectionToolbarProps {
  /** Preset chips shown in the bar. */
  presets?: SelectionAction[];
  /** Items in the overflow menu. Pass an empty array to hide the menu. */
  moreActions?: SelectionAction[];
  /** Called with the action id for a preset or overflow item. */
  onAction?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Called with the instruction typed in the free-text field. */
  onAsk?: (instruction: string) => void;
  /** Called on Escape. Hide the bar and return focus to the editor. */
  onClose?: () => void;
  /** Accessible name for the toolbar. */
  label?: string;
  moreLabel?: string;
  askLabel?: string;
  askPlaceholder?: string;
  sendLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const defaultPresets: SelectionAction[] = [{ id: "rephrase", label: "Rephrase" }, { id: "shorten", label: "Shorten" }, { id: "tone", label: "Change tone" }];
const defaultMore: SelectionAction[] = [
  { id: "elaborate", label: "Elaborate" }, { id: "formal", label: "More formal" }, { id: "casual", label: "More casual" },
  { id: "bullets", label: "Bulletize" }, { id: "summarize", label: "Summarize" },
];

const chip = "inline-flex h-8 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control border border-line bg-surface px-3 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg transition-colors hover:bg-hover";

/**
 * Floating action bar for highlighted text. It renders inline and does no measuring, so the consumer positions it.
 * It is a toolbar with one tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move between controls, Escape calls onClose.
 * Real apps should also offer the same actions from a context menu and a keyboard shortcut.
 */
export function SelectionToolbar({
  presets = defaultPresets, moreActions = defaultMore, onAction, onAsk, onClose, label = "Edit selected text",
  moreLabel = "More options", askLabel = "Ask AI to edit", askPlaceholder = "Ask AI to edit", sendLabel = "Send instruction", className,
}: SelectionToolbarProps) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const [moreOpen, setMoreOpen] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const focusFirstItem = useRef(false);
  const items = () => Array.from(root.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-roving]") ?? []);
  const tab = (i: number) => (i === active ? 0 : -1);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (moreOpen && focusFirstItem.current) { root.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="menuitem"]')?.focus(); }
    focusFirstItem.current = false;
  }, [moreOpen]);

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") { if (!moreOpen) onClose?.(); return; }
    const list = items();
    const i = list.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
    if (i < 0) return;
    const el = list[i];
    if (el instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
      const atStart = el.selectionStart === 0 && el.selectionEnd === 0;
      const atEnd = el.selectionStart === el.value.length && el.selectionEnd === el.value.length;
      if ((e.key === "ArrowLeft" && !atStart) || (e.key === "ArrowRight" && !atEnd) || e.key === "Home" || e.key === "End") return;
    }
    let next = i;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") next = Math.min(i + 1, list.length - 1);
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") next = Math.max(i - 1, 0);
    else if (e.key === "Home") next = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") next = list.length - 1;
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    list[next].focus();
  };

  const onMenuKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const m = Array.from(e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="menuitem"]'));
    const i = m.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") m[(i + 1) % m.length]?.focus();
    else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") m[(i - 1 + m.length) % m.length]?.focus();
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
  };

  const submit = () => { const t = text.trim(); if (!t) return; onAsk?.(t); setText(""); };

  return (
    <div ref={root} role="toolbar" aria-label={label} aria-orientation="horizontal" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      className={cn("inline-flex max-w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 rounded-overlay border border-line bg-raised p-1.5 shadow-md", className)}>
      {presets.map((p, i) => (
        <button key={p.id} type="button" data-roving tabIndex={tab(i)} onFocus={() => setActive(i)} onClick={() => onAction?.(p.id)} className={chip}>{p.icon}{p.label}</button>
      ))}
      {moreActions.length > 0 && (
        <Popover role="menu" label={moreLabel} open={moreOpen} onOpenChange={setMoreOpen} panelClassName="min-w-44"
          trigger={({ toggle, triggerProps }) => (
            <button type="button" data-roving tabIndex={tab(presets.length)} onFocus={() => setActive(presets.length)} {...triggerProps}
              onClick={toggle} aria-label={moreLabel} title={moreLabel}
              onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); focusFirstItem.current = true; setMoreOpen(true); } }}
              className={cn(chip, "px-2.5")}>
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="tracking-widest">...</span>
            </button>
          )}>
          {({ close }) => (
            <div onKeyDown={onMenuKey} className="flex flex-col">
              {moreActions.map((a) => (
                <button key={a.id} type="button" role="menuitem" tabIndex={-1}
                  onClick={() => { onAction?.(a.id); close(); }}
                  className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-left text-compact text-fg hover:bg-hover">{a.icon}{a.label}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </Popover>
      )}
      <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); submit(); }} className="flex min-w-48 flex-1 items-center gap-1 rounded-field border border-line bg-sunken pl-3 pr-0.5 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-2 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-[var(--focus-ring)]">
        <SparkleIcon width={12} height={12} className="shrink-0 text-fg-subtle" />
        <input data-roving tabIndex={tab(presets.length + (moreActions.length > 0 ? 1 : 0))}
          onFocus={() => setActive(presets.length + (moreActions.length > 0 ? 1 : 0))}
          value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} aria-label={askLabel} placeholder={askPlaceholder}
          className="h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-small leading-4 text-fg placeholder:text-fg-subtle focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-none" />
        <IconButton type="submit" size="sm" label={sendLabel} variant="primary" disabled={!text.trim()}><SendIcon width={13} height={13} /></IconButton>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { LockIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import type { SensitiveFinding, SensitiveKind } from "../lib/sensitive";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export interface SensitiveDataGuardLabels {
  /** Receives how many details were found. */
  heading?: (n: number) => string;
  body?: string;
  kinds?: Partial<Record<SensitiveKind, string>>;
  remove?: string;
  removeAll?: string;
  sendAnyway?: string;
}

export interface SensitiveDataGuardProps {
  /** What was found, from findSensitive(text). Nothing shows when the list is empty. */
  findings: SensitiveFinding[];
  /** Takes one detail out of the message. */
  onRemove: (id: string) => void;
  /** Takes every detail out. */
  onRemoveAll: () => void;
  /** Sends the message as it is. */
  onSendAnyway: () => void;
  labels?: SensitiveDataGuardLabels;
  /** Level of the part's heading, so it fits the page outline. Default 3. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const KIND: Record<SensitiveKind, string> = { card: "Card number", key: "API key", password: "Password", email: "Email address", phone: "Phone number" };

/**
 * Sits just above the message box when a message about to be sent holds a private detail: a card number, an API key,
 * a password, an email address or a phone number. It names each one with a safe preview, offers to take it out, and
 * still lets the person send as it is. Taking it out is the main action. Use findSensitive() to fill it.
 */
export function SensitiveDataGuard({ findings, onRemove, onRemoveAll, onSendAnyway, labels, headingLevel = 3, className }: SensitiveDataGuardProps) {
  const l = {
    heading: (n: number) => (n === 1 ? "This message has a private detail" : `This message has ${n} private details`),
    body: "The assistant does not need these to help. Take them out, or send as it is.",
    remove: "Take out", removeAll: "Take them out", sendAnyway: "Send anyway", ...labels,
    kinds: { ...KIND, ...labels?.kinds },
  };
  const uid = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  if (!findings.length) return null;
  return (
    <section role="status" aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} className={cn("rounded-card border border-attention-line bg-attention-soft p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
        <LockIcon aria-hidden width={18} height={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-attention-fg" />
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <H id={`${uid}-h`} className="m-0 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">{l.heading(findings.length)}</H>
          <p className="m-0 mt-1 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.body}</p>
          <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
            {findings.map((f) => (
              <li key={f.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
                <span className="text-small leading-5 text-fg">{l.kinds[f.kind]}</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{f.preview}</span>
                {findings.length > 1 && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => onRemove(f.id)} aria-label={`${l.remove}: ${l.kinds[f.kind]} ${f.preview}`}>{l.remove}</Button>}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" onClick={findings.length > 1 ? onRemoveAll : () => onRemove(findings[0].id)}>{findings.length > 1 ? l.removeAll : l.remove}</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onSendAnyway}>{l.sendAnyway}</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```
