## tattva/molecules/SlideStage.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, EditIcon, EyeIcon, InfoIcon, RetryIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";
import { WorkingEdge } from "../atoms/WorkingEdge";
import { AILabel } from "./AILabel";

export type SlideRatio = "16:9" | "4:3" | "1:1" | "4:5" | "9:16" | "fluid";
export type StageState = "viewing" | "editing" | "working" | "previewing" | "loading" | "partial" | "failed";
export type StageIssueKind = "overflow" | "contrast" | "missingAlt" | "noSource";

export interface StageIssue {
  id: string;
  kind: StageIssueKind;
  /** Plain words, such as "The third point does not fit. Shorten it or split the slide." */
  message: string;
  /** id of the element on the slide this is about. Choosing the issue focuses it. */
  targetId?: string;
  /** True when it stops the person presenting or exporting. Only then the chip turns amber. */
  blocking?: boolean;
}

export interface StageAIChange {
  /** What the AI changed on this slide, in one or two plain sentences. */
  summary: string;
  /** Shown as Undo this change when given. */
  onUndo?: () => void;
}

/** Width and height, in design pixels, of a slide at each ratio. Content is laid out at this size and then scaled. */
const DESIGN: Record<Exclude<SlideRatio, "fluid">, [number, number]> = {
  "16:9": [960, 540], "4:3": [960, 720], "1:1": [960, 960], "4:5": [960, 1200], "9:16": [540, 960],
};

/* ---------------- SlideCanvas ---------------- */

export interface SlideCanvasProps {
  /** Slide shape. "fluid" grows with its content and is not scaled. */
  ratio?: SlideRatio;
  /** The slide, laid out for the design size (960 wide for landscape, 540 wide for 9:16). */
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  /** Extra styles on the frame, for example a max width. */
  style?: CSSProperties;
}

/**
 * Draws a slide at its design size and scales the whole thing to the width it is given, so nothing reflows.
 * What the person sees here is what will export. SlideStage and SlideRail thumbnails both use it.
 */
export function SlideCanvas({ ratio = "16:9", children, className, style }: SlideCanvasProps) {
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(0);
  const size = ratio === "fluid" ? null : DESIGN[ratio];

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = box.current;
    if (!el || !size) return;
    const fit = () => setScale(el.clientWidth / size[0]);
    fit();
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(fit);
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [size?.[0]]);

  if (!size) return <div className={cn("relative w-full overflow-hidden", className)} style={style}>{children}</div>;
  return (
    <div ref={box} className={cn("relative w-full overflow-hidden", className)} style={{ aspectRatio: `${size[0]} / ${size[1]}`, ...style }}>
      {/* Hidden until measured, so a full-size slide never flashes before it is scaled. Scaling never animates. */}
      <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 origin-top-left" style={{ width: size[0], height: size[1], transform: `scale(${scale})`, visibility: scale ? undefined : "hidden" }}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- SlideStage ---------------- */

export interface SlideStageProps {
  /** Names the stage for screen readers and in the header, such as "Slide 3, Pricing". */
  label: string;
  /** Slide shape. The frame keeps it at every width. */
  ratio?: SlideRatio;
  /** What is happening to this slide. */
  state?: StageState;
  /** The slide, laid out at its design size. */
  children?: ReactNode;
  /** Things to check before presenting, such as text that does not fit. */
  issues?: StageIssue[];
  /** Called when the person picks an issue. Without it, focus moves to the element named by targetId. */
  onIssueSelect?: (issue: StageIssue) => void;
  /** Words for the preview banner. */
  previewLabel?: string;
  /** Shows Exit preview in the banner. Escape inside the stage does the same. */
  onExitPreview?: () => void;
  /** What the AI is doing while state is "working", such as "Rewriting the title and points". */
  workingLabel?: string;
  /** What is missing while state is "partial", such as "The chart could not be made. The text is ready." */
  partialNote?: string;
  /** Why it failed, while state is "failed". Say whether anything was kept. */
  errorMessage?: string;
  /** Shows Try again while state is "failed" or "partial". */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** A caption under the slide saying what the AI changed. */
  aiChange?: StageAIChange;
  /** Tallest the frame may be, as any CSS length. Portrait slides use it to stay on screen. */
  maxHeight?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const STATE_WORDS: Record<StageState, string> = {
  viewing: "", editing: "Editing", working: "AI is working on this slide", previewing: "Preview",
  loading: "Loading slide", partial: "Partly built", failed: "Could not build this slide",
};

const KIND_WORDS: Record<StageIssueKind, string> = {
  overflow: "Text does not fit", contrast: "Hard to read", missingAlt: "Image has no description", noSource: "Number has no source",
};

function aspect(ratio: SlideRatio) {
  if (ratio === "fluid") return undefined;
  const [w, h] = DESIGN[ratio];
  return w / h;
}

/**
 * The current slide at its true shape, scaled to fit, with the warnings a person needs before presenting.
 * It covers viewing, editing, AI working, previewing a change, loading, partly built and failed, each in words.
 */
export function SlideStage({
  label, ratio = "16:9", state = "viewing", children, issues = [], onIssueSelect, previewLabel = "Previewing a change. Nothing has changed yet.",
  onExitPreview, workingLabel, partialNote, errorMessage, onRetry, aiChange, maxHeight = "70dvh", className,
}: SlideStageProps) {
  const [showIssues, setShowIssues] = useState(false);
  const issuesId = useId();
  const blocking = issues.filter((i) => i.blocking).length;
  const ar = aspect(ratio);
  // Width is capped so the frame's height never passes maxHeight: a 9:16 slide stays on screen.
  const frameStyle: CSSProperties | undefined = ar ? { maxWidth: `min(100%, calc(${maxHeight} * ${ar}))` } : undefined;

  useEffect(() => { if (!issues.length) setShowIssues(false); }, [issues.length]);

  const pick = (issue: StageIssue) => {
    if (onIssueSelect) onIssueSelect(issue);
    else if (issue.targetId) {
      const el = document.getElementById(issue.targetId);
      if (el) {
        if (!el.hasAttribute("tabindex") && !el.matches("a, button, input, select, textarea")) el.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
        el.focus();
      }
    }
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && state === "previewing" && onExitPreview) { e.preventDefault(); onExitPreview(); }
  };

  const words = state === "working" && workingLabel ? workingLabel : STATE_WORDS[state];
  const issueWords = blocking
    ? `${blocking} ${blocking === 1 ? "thing" : "things"} to fix before you present`
    : `${issues.length} ${issues.length === 1 ? "thing" : "things"} to check`;

  let body: ReactNode;
  if (state === "loading") {
    body = (
      <div className="absolute inset-0 grid content-center gap-3 p-6">
        <Skeleton className="h-6 w-3/5 rounded-control" />
        <Skeleton className="h-3 w-4/5 rounded-control" />
        <Skeleton className="h-3 w-2/3 rounded-control" />
      </div>
    );
  } else if (state === "failed") {
    body = (
      <div role="alert" className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-sunken p-4 text-center">
        <AlertIcon width={20} height={20} className="text-danger-fg" />
        <p className="text-body font-medium text-fg">Could not build this slide</p>
        {errorMessage && <p className="max-w-narrow text-compact text-fg-muted">{errorMessage}</p>}
        {onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<RetryIcon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onRetry} className="mt-1">Try again</Button>}
      </div>
    );
  } else {
    body = (
      <div key={state === "previewing" ? "preview" : "slide"} className={cn("size-full", "motion-safe:animate-fade")}>
        <SlideCanvas ratio={ratio}>{children}</SlideCanvas>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const frame = (
    <div className={cn(
      "relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-card border bg-surface",
      state === "editing" ? "border-fg" : "border-line",
      state === "working" && "opacity-90",
    )} style={ar && (state === "loading" || state === "failed") ? { aspectRatio: String(ar) } : undefined}>
      {body}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <section role="region" aria-label={label} onKeyDown={onKeyDown} className={cn("grid w-full min-w-0 gap-2", className)}>
      {/* Top line: the state in words on the left, things to check on the right. */}
      <div className="flex min-h-8 flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 text-compact text-fg-muted">
          {state === "editing" && <EditIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />}
          {state === "previewing" && <EyeIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />}
          {state === "failed" && <AlertIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden className="text-danger-fg" />}
          <span className="truncate font-medium text-fg">{label}</span>
          {words && <span aria-hidden className="text-fg-subtle">·</span>}
          {words && <span className="truncate">{words}</span>}
        </p>
        {issues.length > 0 && (
          <button type="button" aria-expanded={showIssues} aria-controls={issuesId} onClick={() => setShowIssues((v) => !v)}
            className={cn(
              "tap inline-flex h-7 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control border px-2.5 text-small font-medium transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast)",
              blocking ? "border-transparent bg-attention-soft text-attention-fg hover:opacity-90" : "border-line bg-surface text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg",
            )}>
            {blocking ? <AlertIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden /> : <InfoIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />}
            {issueWords}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {state === "previewing" && (
        <div role="status" className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-2 motion-safe:animate-fade">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-compact text-fg"><EyeIcon width={16} height={16} aria-hidden className="shrink-0 text-fg-muted" />{previewLabel}</p>
          {onExitPreview && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onExitPreview}>Exit preview</Button>}
        </div>
      )}

      {showIssues && issues.length > 0 && (
        <ul id={issuesId} aria-label="Things to check on this slide" className="grid gap-1 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-1.5">
          {issues.map((i) => (
            <li key={i.id}>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => pick(i)}
                className="flex min-h-9 w-full cursor-pointer items-start gap-2 rounded-control px-2 py-1.5 text-left hover:bg-hover pointer-coarse:min-h-11">
                {i.blocking
                  ? <Badge className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 border-transparent bg-attention-soft text-attention-fg">Fix first</Badge>
                  : <Badge className="mt-0.5 shrink-0">Check</Badge>}
                <span className="min-w-0 text-compact leading-5">
                  <span className="font-medium text-fg">{KIND_WORDS[i.kind]}. </span>
                  <span className="text-fg-muted">{i.message}</span>
                  {i.targetId && <span className="text-fg-subtle"> Go to it.</span>}
                </span>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      <div className="mx-auto w-full" style={frameStyle}>
        <WorkingEdge active={state === "working"} label={workingLabel ?? "AI is working on this slide"} radius="card">
          {frame}
        </WorkingEdge>
      </div>

      {state === "partial" && (
        <div role="status" className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-compact text-fg-muted">
          <Badge tone="unsure">Partly built</Badge>
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">{partialNote ?? "Some parts of this slide are not ready yet."}</span>
          {onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<RetryIcon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onRetry}>Try the rest again</Button>}
        </div>
      )}

      {aiChange && state !== "loading" && state !== "failed" && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-2 text-compact leading-5 text-fg-muted">
          <AILabel level="message" size={18} text="AI edit" overview="The AI changed this slide at your request. Your theme and the rest of the deck stayed the same." />
          <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-48">{aiChange.summary}</p>
          {aiChange.onUndo && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={aiChange.onUndo}>Undo this change</Button>}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { GlobeIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface Source { id: number; title: string; url: string; domain: string; snippet?: string }

/** One numbered source. Render inside an <ol>; the id anchors inline citation markers. */
export function SourceCard({ source: s }: { source: Source }) {
  return (
    <li id={`source-${s.id}`}>
      <a href={s.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener"
        className="flex h-full animate-rise gap-2.5 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3 text-body leading-5 no-underline transition-colors hover:border-line-strong hover:bg-sunken">
        <span className="flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-lime-soft text-nano font-semibold text-fg">{s.id}</span>
        <span className="min-w-0">
          <span className="line-clamp-1 font-medium text-fg">{s.title}</span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle"><GlobeIcon width={11} height={11} />{s.domain}</span>
          {s.snippet && <span className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 block text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{s.snippet}</span>}
        </span>
      </a>
    </li>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/SpeakerNotes.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, ChevronIcon, EditIcon, ImageIcon, RegenerateIcon, StopIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { WorkingEdge } from "../atoms/WorkingEdge";
import { AILabel } from "./AILabel";
import { InlineConfirm } from "./InlineConfirm";

export type NotesState = "empty" | "generating" | "proposed" | "kept" | "edited" | "failed";

export interface SpeakerNotesProps {
  /** Which slide these notes are for, such as "Slide 4: Pricing plans". Names the notes box. */
  slideLabel: string;
  /** The notes the person has now. Nothing the AI writes lands here until they press Keep. */
  value: string;
  /** Called on every keystroke. Your app sets state to "edited" once the person changes AI-written notes. */
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  /**
   * empty: no notes yet. generating: the AI is drafting (show the text so far in `proposed`). proposed: a draft waits for Keep or Discard.
   * kept: notes are the AI draft the person kept. edited: the person has written or changed them. failed: the draft did not arrive.
   */
  state: NotesState;
  /** The AI draft, shown apart from the person's notes while generating or proposed. */
  proposed?: string;
  /** Asks the AI to draft notes for this slide. When the person has edited the notes it asks first. */
  onGenerate?: () => void;
  onKeep?: () => void;
  onDiscard?: () => void;
  /** Stops a draft that is still being written. */
  onStop?: () => void;
  /** Puts the AI draft back after the person edited it. Shows a small revert button beside "Edited by you". */
  onRevert?: () => void;
  /** Speaking pace used to turn words into time. The sum is done here in code, never by the model. */
  wordsPerMinute?: number;
  /** Lines about images on this slide, such as "Image on this slide: made by AI". */
  imageCredits?: string[];
  /** Why the draft failed, in plain words. */
  error?: string;
  /** Folds the notes under a button, for a phone where they sit below the slide. */
  collapsible?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const countWords = (t: string) => (t.trim() ? t.trim().split(/\s+/).length : 0);

/** "About 45 seconds" or "About 2 minutes" from a word count and a pace. Rounded to the nearest 5 seconds under two minutes. */
function speakingTime(words: number, wpm: number) {
  if (!words) return "";
  const secs = (words / wpm) * 60;
  if (secs < 10) return "under 10 seconds";
  if (secs < 120) return `about ${Math.round(secs / 5) * 5} seconds`;
  const mins = Math.round(secs / 30) / 2;
  return `about ${mins % 1 ? mins.toFixed(1) : mins} minutes`;
}

const measure = (text: string, wpm: number) => {
  const n = countWords(text);
  return n ? `${n} ${n === 1 ? "word" : "words"}, ${speakingTime(n, wpm)} to say` : "No notes yet";
};

const ANNOUNCE: Partial<Record<NotesState, string>> = {
  generating: "Drafting notes", proposed: "Draft ready. Keep it or discard it.", kept: "Notes kept", failed: "Notes could not be drafted",
};

/**
 * Speaker notes for one slide. An AI draft is held apart until the person keeps it; kept notes carry an AI label that
 * turns into "Edited by you" once they type. The word count and speaking time are worked out here from the text.
 * Drafting again over the person's own words asks first.
 */
export function SpeakerNotes({
  slideLabel, value, onChange, state, proposed, onGenerate, onKeep, onDiscard, onStop, onRevert, wordsPerMinute = 130,
  imageCredits, error, collapsible = false, defaultOpen = true, className,
}: SpeakerNotesProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen || !collapsible);
  const showBody = !collapsible || open;
  const draft = state === "generating" || state === "proposed";

  // Announce changes of state only, never the streaming words.
  const [spoken, setSpoken] = useState("");
  const prev = useRef(state);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prev.current === state) return;
    const from = prev.current;
    prev.current = state;
    if (from === "proposed" && (state === "empty" || state === "edited")) setSpoken("Draft discarded");
    else if (state !== "edited") setSpoken(ANNOUNCE[state] ?? "");
  }, [state]);

  const origin =
    state === "kept" ? <AILabel level="field" size={16} text="AI draft" overview="The AI wrote these notes and you kept them. Change anything; it becomes yours." /> :
    state === "edited" && value.trim() ? (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted"><EditIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} />Edited by you</span>
        {onRevert && <AILabel edited onRevert={onRevert} revertLabel="Put back the AI draft" size={16} />}
      </span>
    ) : null;

  const draftLabel = value.trim() ? "Draft new notes" : "Draft notes with AI";
  const generate = onGenerate && !draft && (
    state === "edited" && value.trim() ? (
      <InlineConfirm question="Draft over your edits?" confirmLabel="Draft new notes" cancelLabel="Keep mine" onConfirm={onGenerate}>
        <RegenerateIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />{draftLabel}
      </InlineConfirm>
    ) : (
      <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<RegenerateIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onGenerate}>{draftLabel}</Button>
    )
  );

  const header = (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
      {collapsible ? (
        <button type="button" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={`${id}-body`} onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
          className="tap -ml-1 inline-flex min-h-8 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control px-1 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg hover:bg-hover">
          <ChevronIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} className={cn("transition-transform duration-(--dur-fast)", open && "rotate-90")} />
          Speaker notes
        </button>
      ) : (
        <label htmlFor={`${id}-notes`} className="text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">Speaker notes</label>
      )}
      {origin}
      <span className="ml-auto text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{measure(value, wordsPerMinute)}</span>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <section aria-label={`Speaker notes, ${slideLabel}`} className={cn("w-full space-y-2", className)}>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{spoken}</p>
      {header}
      {showBody && (
        <div id={`${id}-body`} className="space-y-2">
          <textarea id={`${id}-notes`} aria-label={collapsible ? `Speaker notes for ${slideLabel}` : undefined} aria-describedby={`${id}-for`}
            value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} rows={4}
            placeholder={state === "empty" ? "What you plan to say on this slide. Only you see these while presenting." : undefined}
            className="block w-full resize-y rounded-field border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-body leading-relaxed text-fg placeholder:text-fg-subtle hover:border-line-strong pointer-coarse:text-lead" />
          <p id={`${id}-for`} className="sr-only">For {slideLabel}.</p>

          {draft && (
            <WorkingEdge active={state === "generating"} label="AI is drafting notes" radius="card">
              <div className="space-y-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken p-3">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <AILabel size={16} text={state === "generating" ? "Drafting" : "AI draft"} overview="A draft from the AI. It does not replace your notes until you press Keep." />
                  <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{state === "generating" ? "Writing a draft. Your notes above stay as they are." : measure(proposed ?? "", wordsPerMinute)}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-compact leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap text-fg">{proposed || <span className="text-fg-subtle">Starting…</span>}</p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  {state === "proposed" && onKeep && <Button size="sm" onClick={onKeep}>{value.trim() ? "Keep, replacing my notes" : "Keep"}</Button>}
                  {state === "proposed" && onDiscard && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onDiscard}>Discard</Button>}
                  {state === "generating" && onStop && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" leading={<StopIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} />} onClick={onStop}>Stop drafting</Button>}
                </div>
              </div>
            </WorkingEdge>
          )}

          {state === "failed" && (
            <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-danger-fg"><AlertIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} className="mt-px shrink-0" />{error ?? "The draft did not arrive. Your notes are unchanged."}</p>
          )}

          {(generate || (state === "failed" && onGenerate)) && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {state === "failed" && onGenerate ? <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<RegenerateIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onGenerate}>Try drafting again</Button> : generate}
            </div>
          )}

          {imageCredits && imageCredits.length > 0 && (
            <ul aria-label="Images on this slide" className="space-y-1 border-t border-line pt-2">
              {imageCredits.map((c) => <li key={c} className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted"><ImageIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />{c}</li>)}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/Splitter.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface SplitterProps {
  /** horizontal draws a vertical bar between left and right panes. vertical draws a horizontal bar between top and bottom panes. */
  direction: "horizontal" | "vertical";
  /** Size of the first pane in px. */
  value: number;
  onChange: (px: number) => void;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  /** Accessible name, for example "Resize sidebar". */
  label: string;
  /** Called on double click and on Enter. Use it to collapse or restore the first pane. */
  onToggle?: () => void;
  /** Keyboard step in px. Shift multiplies it by 4. */
  step?: number;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Only the draggable bar. Your layout draws the two panes and sizes the first one from `value`.
 * The bar is 12px across (44px on touch screens, through an invisible larger hit area).
 */
export function Splitter({ direction, value, onChange, min, max, label, onToggle, step = 16, className }: SplitterProps) {
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const start = useRef({ pos: 0, size: 0 });
  const horizontal = direction === "horizontal";
  const clamp = (n: number) => Math.round(Math.min(max, Math.max(min, n)));

  const down = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    start.current = { pos: horizontal ? e.clientX : e.clientY, size: value };
    setDragging(true);
  };
  const move = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const delta = (horizontal ? e.clientX : e.clientY) - start.current.pos;
    const next = clamp(start.current.size + delta);
    if (next !== value) onChange(next);
  };
  const up = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId)) e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    setDragging(false);
  };

  const key = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const s = step * (e.shiftKey ? 4 : 1);
    const grow = horizontal ? "ArrowRight" : "ArrowDown";
    const shrink = horizontal ? "ArrowLeft" : "ArrowUp";
    let next: number | undefined;
    if (e.key === grow) next = value + s;
    else if (e.key === shrink) next = value - s;
    else if (e.key === "Home") next = min;
    else if (e.key === "End") next = max;
    else if (e.key === "Enter" && onToggle) { e.preventDefault(); onToggle(); return; }
    if (next === undefined) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    onChange(clamp(next));
  };

  return (
    <div role="separator" tabIndex={0} aria-label={label} aria-orientation={horizontal ? "vertical" : "horizontal"}
      aria-valuenow={clamp(value)} aria-valuemin={min} aria-valuemax={max}
      onPointerDown={down} onPointerMove={move} onPointerUp={up} onPointerCancel={up} onDoubleClick={onToggle} onKeyDown={key}
      className={cn(
        "group relative shrink-0 touch-none select-none",
        horizontal ? "h-full w-3 cursor-col-resize" : "h-3 w-full cursor-row-resize",
        className,
      )}>
      {/* Larger invisible target on touch screens. */}
      <span aria-hidden className={cn("absolute hidden pointer-coarse:block", horizontal ? "inset-y-0 -inset-x-4" : "inset-x-0 -inset-y-4")} />
      <span aria-hidden className={cn(
        "absolute transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] forced-colors:bg-[CanvasText]",
        horizontal ? cn("inset-y-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2", dragging ? "w-0.5" : "w-px") : cn("inset-x-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2", dragging ? "h-0.5" : "h-px"),
        dragging ? "bg-accent" : "bg-line group-hover:bg-line-strong group-focus-visible:bg-line-strong",
      )} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/StatTile.tsx

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { Meter } from "../atoms/Meter";
import { AlertIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export type DeltaDirection = "up" | "down" | "flat";

export interface StatDelta {
  /** Signed text with the unit, for example "+4.2%" or "-120 ms". */
  text: string;
  /** Which way the number moved. Drives the arrow. */
  direction: DeltaDirection;
  /** The comparison period, for example "vs previous 7 days". */
  versus?: string;
}

export interface StatThreshold {
  /** Current value on the same scale as max. */
  value: number;
  /** Upper end of the scale. */
  max: number;
  /** Where the threshold tick sits on the scale. */
  at: number;
  /** Visible name for the tick, for example "Target 800 ms". */
  label: string;
}

export interface StatTileProps {
  /** Metric name in sentence case, without a trailing colon. */
  label: string;
  /** Formatted value, for example "1.24 s" or "$4.2K". */
  value: string;
  /** Set the value in the serif. */
  serif?: boolean;
  /** Change since the comparison period. */
  delta?: StatDelta;
  /** Which direction of change is an improvement. Use "down" for latency, cost and error rate. */
  goodDirection?: "up" | "down" | "neutral";
  /** A visible detail line under the value, such as an interval or a sample size. */
  detail?: string;
  /** Slot for a Sparkline. Pass it with decorative set, since the value and delta already say the numbers. */
  spark?: ReactNode;
  /** Draws a thin scale with a tick at the threshold. */
  threshold?: StatThreshold;
  /** A person has to act on this metric. Shows an amber chip with text. Leave off for ordinary good or bad movement. */
  needsAction?: boolean;
  /** Text of the amber chip. */
  actionText?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const Arrow = ({ d }: { d: DeltaDirection }) => (
  <svg width={14} height={14} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden>
    {d === "up" ? <path d="M12 19V5M5 12l7-7 7 7" /> : d === "down" ? <path d="M12 5v14M5 12l7 7 7-7" /> : <path d="M5 12h14" />}
  </svg>
);

/**
 * One headline number with its change. The delta carries an arrow and text, and a visible "better" or "worse" word,
 * so the meaning never rests on color. goodDirection decides which way counts as better, so a drop in latency reads as good.
 */
export function StatTile({ label, value, serif, delta, goodDirection = "up", detail, spark, threshold, needsAction, actionText = "Needs review", className }: StatTileProps) {
  const verdict = !delta || delta.direction === "flat" || goodDirection === "neutral" ? "none" : delta.direction === goodDirection ? "better" : "worse";
  const tone = verdict === "better" ? "text-success-fg" : verdict === "worse" ? "text-danger-fg" : "text-fg-muted";
  const dirWord = delta ? { up: "up", down: "down", flat: "unchanged" }[delta.direction] : "";
  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={label} className={cn("min-w-0 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{label}</p>
        {needsAction && <span className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-control bg-attention-soft px-2 py-0.5 text-micro leading-4 font-medium text-attention-fg"><AlertIcon width={12} height={12} />{actionText}</span>}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <p className={cn("min-w-0 text-title-lg leading-9 font-medium tracking-snug text-fg [overflow-wrap:anywhere]", serif && "font-serif font-normal")}>{value}</p>
        {spark && <div className="shrink-0 pb-1">{spark}</div>}
      </div>
      {delta && (
        <p className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-1.5 text-small leading-5">
          <span className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium", tone)}>
            <Arrow d={delta.direction} />
            <span className="sr-only">{dirWord}, </span>{delta.text}
            {verdict !== "none" && <span className="font-normal">{verdict}</span>}
          </span>
          {delta.versus && <span className="text-fg-subtle">{delta.versus}</span>}
        </p>
      )}
      {detail && <p className="mt-1 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{detail}</p>}
      {threshold && (
        <div className="mt-3">
          <div className="relative">
            <Meter label={label} value={threshold.value} max={threshold.max} warnAt={needsAction ? threshold.at / threshold.max : undefined}
              valueText={`${value}. ${threshold.label}.`} />
            <span aria-hidden className="absolute -top-1 h-3.5 w-0.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-fg" style={{ left: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (threshold.at / threshold.max) * 100))}%` }} />
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-micro leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{threshold.label}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/StreamingReveal.tsx

```tsx
import { Fragment, useRef } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";

export interface StreamingRevealProps {
  /** The text received so far. Pass the `text` from useStreamingText or your own buffer. */
  text: string;
  /** True while more text may arrive. The last partial word is held back until it ends, so words land whole. */
  streaming?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Renders streamed text so each new word fades in once from a faint blur (--dur-base, --ease-arrive).
 * Words that have settled keep their element and never re-animate. New words append in flow, so nothing moves.
 * Under reduced motion the text appears instantly. Words present at first render do not animate.
 */
export function StreamingReveal({ text, streaming = false, className }: StreamingRevealProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  let tokens = text.split(/(\s+)/).filter((t) => t !== "");
  if (streaming && tokens.length > 0 && !/\s$/.test(text)) tokens = tokens.slice(0, -1);
  const settled = useRef<number | null>(null);
  if (settled.current === null) settled.current = tokens.length;
  if (tokens.length < settled.current) settled.current = 0;
  const initial = settled.current;

  if (reduced) return <span className={className}>{tokens.join("")}</span>;
  return (
    <span className={className}>
      {tokens.map((t, i) =>
        /^\s+$/.test(t) ? <Fragment key={i}>{t}</Fragment> : <span key={i} className={cn(i >= initial && "animate-word-in")}>{t}</span>,
      )}
    </span>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/SuggestionCard.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { keepFocus } from "../lib/focus";
import { AlertIcon, SearchIcon, SparkleIcon, UsersIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge, type Tone } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export type SuggestionCategory = "correctness" | "clarity" | "engagement" | "tone";

const categories: Record<SuggestionCategory, { label: string; icon: ReactNode; tone: Tone }> = {
  correctness: { label: "Correctness", icon: <AlertIcon width={11} height={11} />, tone: "danger" },
  clarity: { label: "Clarity", icon: <SearchIcon width={11} height={11} />, tone: "info" },
  engagement: { label: "Engagement", icon: <SparkleIcon width={11} height={11} />, tone: "success" },
  tone: { label: "Tone", icon: <UsersIcon width={11} height={11} />, tone: "neutral" },
};

export interface SuggestionCardProps {
  category?: SuggestionCategory;
  /** Override the category text, for document-specific categories. */
  categoryLabel?: string;
  /** Override the category icon. */
  categoryIcon?: ReactNode;
  /** Text as written. Shown struck through. */
  original: string;
  /** Proposed replacement. Shown highlighted. Leave empty for a deletion. */
  suggestion: string;
  /** Short reason for the change. */
  explanation?: string;
  onAccept?: () => void;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  acceptLabel?: string;
  dismissLabel?: string;
  /** Where keyboard focus goes after Accept or Dismiss. By default the next suggestion, else the previous one, else the text. */
  focusAfter?: () => HTMLElement | null;
  className?: string;
}

/** One writing suggestion with a category label, an original-versus-suggested diff, a reason, Accept and Dismiss. Category is always text plus an icon, never color alone. */
export function SuggestionCard({
  category = "correctness", categoryLabel, categoryIcon, original, suggestion, explanation, onAccept, onDismiss,
  acceptLabel = "Accept", dismissLabel = "Dismiss", focusAfter, className,
}: SuggestionCardProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const act = (f?: () => void) => () => { f?.(); keepFocus(ref.current, focusAfter); };
  const c = categories[category];
  const label = categoryLabel ?? c.label;
  return (
    <article ref={ref} aria-label={`${label} suggestion`} className={`w-full max-w-sm space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 text-body leading-5 shadow-sm ${className ?? ""}`}>
      <Badge tone={c.tone}>{categoryIcon ?? c.icon}{label}</Badge>
      <p className="leading-relaxed text-fg">
        <span className="sr-only">Original: </span>
        <del className="text-fg-muted decoration-danger decoration-2">{original}</del>
        {" "}
        <span className="sr-only">Suggested: </span>
        {suggestion ? <ins className="rounded-sm bg-lime-soft px-0.5 text-fg no-underline">{suggestion}</ins> : <span className="text-fg-muted">(remove)</span>}
      </p>
      {explanation && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{explanation}</p>}
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Button size="sm" variant="lime" onClick={act(onAccept)}>{acceptLabel}</Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={act(onDismiss)}>{dismissLabel}</Button>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```
