## tattva/molecules/Tabs.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useScrollEdges } from "../hooks/useScrollEdges";
import { useIndicator } from "../hooks/useIndicator";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface TabItem {
  id: string;
  label: ReactNode;
  /** A number shown after the label, such as unread items. */
  count?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Content for this tab. Only the active tab's panel is rendered. */
  panel?: ReactNode;
}

export interface TabsProps {
  tabs: TabItem[];
  /** Id of the active tab. */
  value: string;
  onChange: (id: string) => void;
  /** Accessible name of the tab list. */
  label: string;
  variant?: "underline" | "pill";
  /** auto selects a tab when arrow keys reach it. manual only moves focus; Enter or Space selects. */
  activation?: "auto" | "manual";
  /** Tabs share the full width instead of sizing to their label. */
  fill?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * WAI-ARIA tabs. One tab stop (the active tab), arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs. On narrow screens the
 * list scrolls sideways with no visible scrollbar and keeps the active tab in view. Only the active panel is mounted.
 */
export function Tabs({ tabs, value, onChange, label, variant = "underline", activation = "auto", fill, className }: TabsProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const list = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const tabId = (id: string) => `${uid}-tab-${id}`;
  const panelId = (id: string) => `${uid}-panel-${id}`;
  const edges = useScrollEdges(list);
  const mark = useIndicator(list, '[role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]', value);
  const enabled = tabs.filter((t) => !t.disabled);
  const active = tabs.find((t) => t.id === value);
  // If value matches nothing, the first enabled tab takes the tab stop so the list stays reachable.
  const stop = active && !active.disabled ? active.id : enabled[0]?.id;

  useEffect(() => {
    const l = list.current;
    const el = l?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-selected="true"]');
    if (!l || !el) return;
    const a = l.getBoundingClientRect(); const b = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (b.left < a.left) l.scrollLeft += b.left - a.left;
    else if (b.right > a.right) l.scrollLeft += b.right - a.right;
  }, [value]);

  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "Home", "End"].includes(e.key) || !enabled.length) return;
    const cur = enabled.findIndex((t) => tabId(t.id) === (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.id);
    const n = enabled.length;
    const j = e.key === "Home" ? 0 : e.key === "End" ? n - 1 : e.key === "ArrowRight" ? (cur + 1) % n : (cur < 0 ? 0 : (cur - 1 + n) % n);
    e.preventDefault();
    const next = enabled[j];
    document.getElementById(tabId(next.id))?.focus();
    if (activation === "auto") onChange(next.id);
  };

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <div ref={list} role="tablist" aria-label={label} onKeyDown={onKey} style={edges}
        className={cn("relative flex overflow-x-auto [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden", variant === "underline" ? "gap-1 border-b border-line sm:gap-4" : "gap-1")}>
        {mark && (
          <span aria-hidden style={variant === "underline" ? { ...mark, top: undefined, bottom: 0, height: 2 } : mark}
            className={cn("pointer-events-none forced-colors:hidden", variant === "underline" ? "rounded-full bg-fg" : "rounded-control bg-accent")} />
        )}
        {tabs.map((t) => {
          const on = t.id === value;
          return (
            <button key={t.id} type="button" role="tab" id={tabId(t.id)} aria-selected={on} disabled={t.disabled}
              aria-controls={on && t.panel !== undefined ? panelId(t.id) : undefined} tabIndex={t.id === stop ? 0 : -1}
              onClick={() => { if (!t.disabled) onChange(t.id); }}
              className={cn(
                "relative inline-flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap text-body font-medium transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] focus-visible:outline-offset-[-2px] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-disabled-fg pointer-coarse:h-11",
                fill && "flex-1",
                variant === "underline"
                  ? cn("h-10 border-b-2 px-3", on ? cn(mark ? "border-transparent" : "border-fg", "text-fg forced-colors:border-[Highlight] forced-colors:text-[Highlight]") : "border-transparent text-fg-muted hover:text-fg forced-colors:border-transparent")
                  : cn("h-9 rounded-control px-4", on ? cn(!mark && "bg-accent", "text-on-accent forced-colors:bg-[Highlight] forced-colors:text-[HighlightText]") : "text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg"),
              )}>
              {t.label}
              {t.count !== undefined && <span className="text-small leading-4 tabular-nums opacity-80">{t.count}</span>}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {active?.panel !== undefined && (
        <div key={active.id} role="tabpanel" id={panelId(active.id)} aria-labelledby={tabId(active.id)} tabIndex={0} className="animate-panel-in pt-4">{active.panel}</div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/TakeCard.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, type CSSProperties, type KeyboardEvent, type MouseEvent, type Ref } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, BranchIcon, CheckIcon, HistoryIcon, InfoIcon, MoreIcon, ShieldIcon, SparkleIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Meter } from "../atoms/Meter";
import { WorkingEdge } from "../atoms/WorkingEdge";
import { AILabel } from "./AILabel";
import { Menu, type MenuEntry } from "./Menu";

/* ---------- shared vocabulary for video takes (also used by TakeGrid and TakeVersions) ---------- */

export type TakeStatus = "queued" | "generating" | "finalising" | "done" | "failed" | "blocked" | "cancelled" | "rateLimited";
export type TakeRatio = "16:9" | "9:16" | "1:1" | "4:3" | "21:9";
/** A drawn stand-in frame, made only from colour tokens. Use it in previews and while you have no poster image. */
export type TakeScene = "harbour" | "dusk" | "forest" | "city" | "studio";
export type TakeChargeState = "estimated" | "charged" | "refunded" | "notCharged";

export interface TakeCharge {
  /** Credits (or the unit you pass). Code works it out; never let the model write it. */
  amount: number;
  /** estimated: before or during the run. charged: taken. refunded: taken, then given back. notCharged: never taken. */
  state: TakeChargeState;
  /** Plural unit. Defaults to "credits". */
  unit?: string;
}

export interface TakeBlockedReason {
  /** input: the prompt or a reference was stopped before generating. output: the finished video was stopped by the safety check. */
  where: "input" | "output";
  /** What the policy check said, in plain words. */
  message: string;
  /** One way to rephrase or change the request. */
  suggestion?: string;
}

export interface TakeProvenance {
  /** Model or tool that made the take. Defaults to `model`. */
  madeWith?: string;
  /** When it was made, as display text. */
  made?: string;
  /** What the file carries, one item each, such as "Invisible watermark" or "C2PA Content Credentials". */
  carries?: string[];
  /** What can remove the marks. Defaults to a plain warning that re-uploads can strip metadata. */
  caveat?: string;
}

export const TAKE_STATUS_WORD: Record<TakeStatus, string> = {
  queued: "Queued", generating: "Generating", finalising: "Finalising", done: "Ready", failed: "Failed",
  blocked: "Blocked by content policy", cancelled: "Cancelled", rateLimited: "Paused, too many requests",
};

/** True while a model is really working on the take. Drives the lime working edge and aria-busy. */
export const isTakeWorking = (s: TakeStatus) => s === "queued" || s === "generating" || s === "finalising";

const RATIO: Record<TakeRatio, string> = {
  "16:9": "aspect-video", "9:16": "aspect-[9/16]", "1:1": "aspect-square", "4:3": "aspect-[4/3]", "21:9": "aspect-[21/9]",
};
export const takeRatioClass = (r: TakeRatio) => RATIO[r];

/** "0:08" for the eye. */
export function formatClock(sec: number) {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.round(sec));
  return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}
/** "8 seconds" or "1 minute 4 seconds" for the ear. */
export function formatSpokenDuration(sec: number) {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.round(sec));
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const r = s % 60;
  const part = (n: number, w: string) => `${n} ${w}${n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  if (!m) return part(r, "second");
  return r ? `${part(m, "minute")} ${part(r, "second")}` : part(m, "minute");
}

/** "20 credits", "1 credit". */
export function formatCredits(amount: number, unit = "credits") {
  const n = new Intl.NumberFormat("en", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(amount);
  return `${n} ${amount === 1 && unit.endsWith("s") ? unit.slice(0, -1) : unit}`;
}

/** The charge in words. Every ending says whether credits were taken. */
export function chargeText(c: TakeCharge) {
  const amt = formatCredits(c.amount, c.unit);
  switch (c.state) {
    case "estimated": return `Estimated ${amt}`;
    case "charged": return `Charged ${amt}`;
    case "refunded": return `${amt} refunded`;
    case "notCharged": return "Not charged";
  }
}

/* ---------- drawn poster ---------- */

const mix = (a: string, pct: number, b: string) => `color-mix(in oklab, ${a} ${pct}%, ${b})`;

const SCENES: Record<TakeScene, { sky: [string, string]; sun: string; far: string; near: string; city?: boolean }> = {
  harbour: { sky: ["var(--chart-seq-1)", mix("var(--chart-seq-2)", 70, "var(--surface)")], sun: mix("var(--chart-2)", 70, "var(--surface)"), far: "var(--chart-seq-3)", near: "var(--chart-seq-5)" },
  dusk: { sky: [mix("var(--chart-5)", 45, "var(--surface)"), mix("var(--chart-2)", 50, "var(--surface)")], sun: mix("var(--chart-2)", 80, "var(--surface)"), far: mix("var(--chart-5)", 70, "var(--fg)"), near: mix("var(--chart-5)", 35, "var(--fg)") },
  forest: { sky: [mix("var(--chart-3)", 30, "var(--surface)"), mix("var(--chart-4)", 25, "var(--surface)")], sun: mix("var(--chart-4)", 35, "var(--surface)"), far: mix("var(--chart-4)", 80, "var(--surface)"), near: mix("var(--chart-4)", 55, "var(--fg)") },
  city: { sky: [mix("var(--chart-seq-2)", 45, "var(--surface)"), mix("var(--chart-seq-1)", 30, "var(--surface)")], sun: mix("var(--chart-2)", 55, "var(--surface)"), far: "var(--chart-seq-3)", near: "var(--chart-seq-5)", city: true },
  studio: { sky: ["var(--surface-sunken)", "var(--border)"], sun: mix("var(--chart-3)", 60, "var(--surface)"), far: "var(--border-strong)", near: "var(--fg-subtle)" },
};

export interface TakePosterProps {
  /** Poster image URL. Wins over `scene`. */
  src?: string;
  /** Drawn stand-in frame from colour tokens. Defaults to "harbour". */
  scene?: TakeScene;
  className?: string;
}

/** A still frame for a take: the poster image, or a small drawn scene in token colours. Always decorative; the card carries the words. */
export function TakePoster({ src, scene = "harbour", className }: TakePosterProps) {
  const id = useId();
  if (src) return <img src={src} alt="" className={cn("h-full w-full object-cover", className)} />;
  const s = SCENES[scene];
  const fill = (c: string): CSSProperties => ({ fill: c });
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 160 90" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" className={cn("block h-full w-full", className)}>
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={`${id}sky`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" style={{ stopColor: s.sky[0] }} />
          <stop offset="1" style={{ stopColor: s.sky[1] }} />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <rect width="160" height="90" fill={`url(#${id}sky)`} />
      <circle cx="100" cy="32" r="11" style={fill(s.sun)} />
      {s.city ? (
        <g style={fill(s.far)}>
          <rect x="6" y="40" width="16" height="50" /><rect x="26" y="30" width="12" height="60" /><rect x="42" y="46" width="20" height="44" />
          <rect x="68" y="24" width="14" height="66" /><rect x="88" y="42" width="18" height="48" /><rect x="112" y="34" width="12" height="56" /><rect x="130" y="48" width="24" height="42" />
        </g>
      ) : (
        <path d="M0 60 Q30 44 60 56 T120 52 T160 50 V90 H0Z" style={fill(s.far)} />
      )}
      <path d="M0 74 Q40 62 80 72 T160 68 V90 H0Z" style={fill(s.near)} />
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ---------- card ---------- */

export interface TakeCardProps {
  id: string;
  /** Name of the take, such as "Take 2". It names the card for screen readers. */
  label: string;
  status: TakeStatus;
  /** The box keeps this ratio from the moment the request is sent, so nothing moves when the result lands. */
  ratio?: TakeRatio;
  /** Poster image URL, shown when done. */
  poster?: string;
  /** Drawn stand-in poster when there is no image. */
  scene?: TakeScene;
  /** Length in seconds. Shown as 0:08 and read as "8 seconds". */
  durationSec?: number;
  /** Model that made it, shown on the card. */
  model?: string;
  /** What was asked for. Shown under the title. It is not a description of the result. */
  prompt?: string;
  /** "draft" adds a Draft tag, so a low-resolution preview is never taken for the finished take. */
  quality?: "draft" | "final";
  /** Place in the queue while queued. */
  queuePosition?: number;
  /** Why the person is waiting, such as "Busy period". Never an upgrade pitch. */
  queueReason?: string;
  /** Plain time estimate such as "About 2 minutes". Only if the service gives one. */
  eta?: string;
  /** 0 to 100, only if the service really reports it. Omit for no bar. */
  percent?: number;
  /** The charge for this take and whether it was taken. */
  charge?: TakeCharge;
  /** Why a blocked take was stopped. Shown as a calm note, never a red error. */
  blockedReason?: TakeBlockedReason;
  /** What went wrong, shown when failed. */
  error?: string;
  /** When the rate limit lets this take start again, such as "Starts again in about a minute". */
  retryNote?: string;
  /** Says whether cancelling returns credits, such as "Cancel now and the 20 credits come back." Shown while working. */
  cancelNote?: string;
  /** Where this take came from, such as "Extended from take 2". */
  lineage?: string;
  /** What the file carries and what can strip it. Fills the AI label's explainer. */
  provenance?: TakeProvenance;
  /** Opens the take in your player or lightbox. Makes the poster a Play button when done. */
  onOpen?: () => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
  /** Shown as Try again on failed, cancelled and rate-limited takes. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** Shown as Edit prompt on blocked takes. */
  onEditPrompt?: () => void;
  /** Extra actions for a finished take (Extend, Remix, Download), in an overflow menu. */
  menu?: MenuEntry[];
  /** Turns on the select control. "multi" is a checkbox, "single" picks one take. */
  selectMode?: "single" | "multi";
  selected?: boolean;
  onSelect?: () => void;
  /** Speak status changes from this card. TakeGrid turns this off and speaks for all its cards at once. */
  announce?: boolean;
  /** Heading level of the take name. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  /** Makes the whole card a focus stop. TakeGrid sets this for its roving focus. */
  tabIndex?: number;
  onKeyDown?: (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
  /** Extra id for aria-describedby, such as a keyboard hint. */
  describedBy?: string;
  /** Hides the prompt and the lineage line, for small tiles. The name, status and charge stay. */
  compact?: boolean;
  ref?: Ref<HTMLElement>;
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_ICON: Record<TakeStatus, typeof CheckIcon> = {
  queued: HistoryIcon, generating: SparkleIcon, finalising: SparkleIcon, done: CheckIcon, failed: AlertIcon,
  blocked: ShieldIcon, cancelled: XIcon, rateLimited: HistoryIcon,
};

/** The sentence spoken for a status change. No percentages. */
export function takeAnnouncement(label: string, status: TakeStatus) {
  return `${label}: ${TAKE_STATUS_WORD[status].toLowerCase()}`;
}

/**
 * One generated video take, from the queue to the finished clip. The box holds its ratio from the start, a calm lime
 * edge shows only while a model is working, and every ending (failed, blocked, cancelled, rate limited) says in words
 * whether credits were taken. Status is always a word with an icon, never colour alone.
 */
export function TakeCard({
  id, label, status, ratio = "16:9", poster, scene, durationSec, model, prompt, quality, queuePosition, queueReason, eta, percent,
  charge, blockedReason, error, retryNote, cancelNote, lineage, provenance, onOpen, onCancel, onRetry, onEditPrompt, menu,
  selectMode, selected = false, onSelect, announce = true, headingLevel = 3, tabIndex, onKeyDown, describedBy, compact = false, ref, className,
}: TakeCardProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const working = isTakeWorking(status);
  const done = status === "done";
  const Icon = STATUS_ICON[status];
  const word = TAKE_STATUS_WORD[status];
  const pct = percent === undefined ? undefined : Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent)));
  const spokenLength = durationSec !== undefined ? formatSpokenDuration(durationSec) : undefined;
  const madeWith = provenance?.madeWith ?? model;
  const stop = (e: MouseEvent) => e.stopPropagation();

  return (
    <article
      ref={ref}
      data-take-id={id}
      aria-labelledby={`${uid}t`}
      aria-describedby={`${uid}s ${uid}c${describedBy ? ` ${describedBy}` : ""}`}
      aria-busy={working || undefined}
      tabIndex={tabIndex}
      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      className={cn("group/take min-w-0 rounded-card", className)}
    >
      <WorkingEdge active={working} label="" className="h-full">
        <div className={cn(
          "flex h-full flex-col rounded-card border bg-surface transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-(--dur-fast) ease-(--ease-out)",
          selected ? "border-fg shadow-md" : "border-line",
        )}>
          {/* Media box: holds the ratio in every state. */}
          <div className={cn("relative rounded-t-card bg-sunken", RATIO[ratio])}>
            {done ? (
              <>
                <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden rounded-t-card motion-safe:animate-[fade_var(--dur-base)_var(--ease-out)_both]"><TakePoster src={poster} scene={scene} /></div>
                {onOpen ? (
                  <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} aria-label={`Play ${label}${spokenLength ? `, ${spokenLength}` : ""}`}
                    className="group/play absolute inset-0 flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-t-card">
                    <span aria-hidden className="flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-overlay text-inverse-fg shadow-md transition-transform duration-(--dur-fast) ease-(--ease-out) motion-safe:group-hover/play:scale-105">
                      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="ml-0.5 size-5" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5.5v13l10.5-6.5z" /></svg>
                    </span>
                  </button>
                ) : null}
                {durationSec !== undefined && (
                  <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2 bottom-2 rounded-control bg-overlay px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-micro leading-4 text-inverse-fg tabular-nums" aria-hidden>{formatClock(durationSec)}</span>
                )}
                <span className="absolute bottom-2 left-2">
                  <AILabel level="message" size={16} text="AI" popoverLabel={`About ${label}`}
                    overview={`This video was generated by AI${madeWith ? ` with ${madeWith}` : ""}${provenance?.made ? `, ${provenance.made}` : ""}.`}
                    details={provenance?.carries?.length ? <><p>The file carries:</p><ul className="mt-1 list-disc pl-4">{provenance.carries.map((c) => <li key={c}>{c}</li>)}</ul></> : undefined}
                    resources={<p>{provenance?.caveat ?? "These marks can be lost when the file is edited elsewhere or re-uploaded, so a missing label does not prove a video is real."}</p>} />
                </span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 p-3 text-center">
                <Icon width={18} height={18} aria-hidden className={cn(status === "failed" ? "text-danger-fg" : "text-fg-muted")} />
                <p key={status} className={cn("text-small font-medium motion-safe:animate-fade", status === "failed" ? "text-danger-fg" : "text-fg")} aria-hidden>{word}</p>
                {status === "queued" && queuePosition !== undefined && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted" aria-hidden>Position {queuePosition} in the queue</p>}
                {status === "rateLimited" && retryNote && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted" aria-hidden>{retryNote}</p>}
                {status === "generating" && pct !== undefined && (
                  <Meter label={`${label} progress`} value={pct} valueText={`${pct}%`} className="mt-1 w-2/3 max-w-40" />
                )}
              </div>
            )}
            {quality === "draft" && (
              <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-2 left-2"><Badge className="bg-glass">Draft</Badge></span>
            )}
            {selectMode && onSelect && (
              <button type="button" onClick={(e) => { stop(e); onSelect(); }} tabIndex={tabIndex === undefined ? undefined : -1}
                {...(selectMode === "multi" ? { role: "checkbox", "aria-checked": selected } : { "aria-pressed": selected })}
                aria-label={`${selectMode === "multi" ? "Select" : "Pick"} ${label}`}
                className={cn(
                  "absolute top-2 right-2 flex size-7 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border shadow-sm",
                  selected ? "border-transparent bg-inverse text-inverse-fg" : "border-line-strong bg-glass text-transparent hover:text-fg-subtle",
                )}>
                <CheckIcon width={14} height={14} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Words: name, status, meta, notes, charge, actions. */}
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2 p-3">
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5">
              <H id={`${uid}t`} className="min-w-0 truncate text-compact font-semibold text-fg">{label}</H>
              <p id={`${uid}s`} className={cn("flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4 font-medium", status === "failed" ? "text-danger-fg" : done ? "text-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>
                <Icon width={12} height={12} aria-hidden />
                <span key={status} className="motion-safe:animate-fade">{word}{selected ? <span className="sr-only">, selected</span> : null}</span>
              </p>
            </div>

            <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-1.5 gap-y-0.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
              {durationSec !== undefined && <><span aria-hidden className="font-mono tabular-nums">{formatClock(durationSec)}</span><span className="sr-only">{spokenLength}</span></>}
              {durationSec !== undefined && (model || ratio) && <span aria-hidden>·</span>}
              {model && <span>{model}</span>}
              {model && <span aria-hidden>·</span>}
              <span><span className="sr-only">Ratio </span>{ratio}</span>
              {quality === "draft" && <><span aria-hidden>·</span><span>Draft quality</span></>}
            </p>

            {prompt && !compact && <p className="line-clamp-2 text-small text-fg-muted"><span className="sr-only">Prompt: </span>{prompt}</p>}

            {lineage && !compact && (
              <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted"><BranchIcon width={12} height={12} aria-hidden />{lineage}</p>
            )}

            {status === "queued" && (queueReason || eta) && (
              <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{[queueReason, eta].filter(Boolean).join(". ")}</p>
            )}
            {(status === "generating" || status === "finalising") && eta && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{eta}</p>}

            {status === "blocked" && (
              <div className="rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken p-2.5 text-small">
                <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium text-fg"><ShieldIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />
                  {blockedReason?.where === "input" ? "Your request was stopped before generating" : "The finished video was stopped by the safety check"}
                </p>
                {blockedReason?.where === "output" && <p className="mt-1 text-fg-muted">The check looked at what the model made, not at you.</p>}
                {blockedReason?.message && <p className="mt-1 text-fg-muted">{blockedReason.message}</p>}
                {blockedReason?.suggestion && <p className="mt-1 text-fg-muted"><span className="font-medium text-fg">Try: </span>{blockedReason.suggestion}</p>}
              </div>
            )}
            {status === "failed" && error && (
              <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-small text-fg-muted"><AlertIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-danger-fg" />{error}</p>
            )}
            {status === "rateLimited" && (
              <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-small text-fg-muted"><InfoIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                Too many takes were requested at once, so this one is waiting. {retryNote ?? "It starts again on its own."}
              </p>
            )}

            <div className="mt-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1">
              <p id={`${uid}c`} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
                {charge ? <>
                  {charge.state === "refunded" || charge.state === "notCharged" ? <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} aria-hidden /> : null}
                  <span className={cn(charge.state !== "notCharged" && "font-mono tabular-nums")}>{chargeText(charge)}</span>
                </> : null}
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                {working && onCancel && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel} aria-label={`Cancel ${label}`}>Cancel</Button>}
                {(status === "failed" || status === "cancelled" || status === "rateLimited") && onRetry && (
                  <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onRetry} aria-label={`Try ${label} again`}>Try again</Button>
                )}
                {status === "blocked" && onEditPrompt && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onEditPrompt}>Edit prompt</Button>}
                {done && menu && menu.length > 0 && (
                  <Menu portal align="end" triggerLabel={`More actions for ${label}`} items={menu}
                    trigger={<MoreIcon width={16} height={16} />} />
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            {working && cancelNote && onCancel && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{cancelNote}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </WorkingEdge>
      {announce && <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{takeAnnouncement(label, status)}</p>}
    </article>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/TakeVersions.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { BranchIcon, SparkleIcon, UsersIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { headingTag, useFocusAfter, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { TakePoster, TAKE_STATUS_WORD, formatClock, formatSpokenDuration, type TakeScene, type TakeStatus } from "./TakeCard";
import { VersionPager } from "./VersionPager";

export type TakeOp = "generated" | "extended" | "edited" | "remixed" | "upscaled" | "recut" | "uploaded";

export interface TakeVersion {
  id: string;
  /** Overrides the automatic name "v1", "v2"... */
  name?: string;
  /** What made this version. */
  op: TakeOp;
  /** Id of the version it came from. */
  from?: string;
  /** The prompt behind this version. */
  prompt?: string;
  /** Seconds of the clip that were edited or re-cut, as [start, end]. */
  segment?: [number, number];
  /** Short extra fact, such as "4K" for an upscale or "sunset lighting" for an edit. */
  detail?: string;
  durationSec: number;
  author: "ai" | "person";
  /** Person name, or the model name for AI. */
  authorName?: string;
  /** Display time such as "5 min ago". */
  time: string;
  status: TakeStatus;
  poster?: string;
  scene?: TakeScene;
}

export interface TakeVersionsProps {
  /** Oldest first. Versions are numbered from the start, so the first is v1. The list shows the newest at the top. */
  versions: TakeVersion[];
  currentId: string;
  /** Called when a version is shown for a look, without changing anything. Showing the current one ends the preview. */
  onPreview: (id: string) => void;
  /** Makes a version the current one. Nothing is deleted, and the notice that follows offers Undo. */
  onMakeCurrent: (id: string) => void;
  /** Starts a new line of edits from this version. */
  onBranch?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Controlled preview id. Omit to let the part keep it. */
  previewId?: string;
  /** list: every version in a column. pager: one at a time with Previous and Next. auto: pager on narrow screens. */
  layout?: "auto" | "list" | "pager";
  title?: string;
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const NARROW = "(max-width: 639px)";
const subscribe = (cb: () => void) => {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.matchMedia) return () => {};
  const mq = window.matchMedia(NARROW);
  mq.addEventListener("change", cb);
  return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", cb);
};
const useNarrow = () => useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => !!window.matchMedia?.(NARROW).matches, () => false);

const OP_WORD: Record<TakeOp, string> = {
  generated: "Generated", extended: "Extended", edited: "Edited", remixed: "Remixed", upscaled: "Upscaled", recut: "Re-cut", uploaded: "Uploaded",
};

/** The lineage line, such as "Extended +4 s from v2" or "Edited 0:02 to 0:06 from v2: sunset lighting". */
export function takeOpLabel(v: TakeVersion, all: TakeVersion[]) {
  const nameOf = (x: TakeVersion) => x.name ?? `v${all.indexOf(x) + 1}`;
  const src = v.from ? all.find((x) => x.id === v.from) : undefined;
  const from = src ? ` from ${nameOf(src)}` : "";
  const seg = v.segment ? ` ${formatClock(v.segment[0])} to ${formatClock(v.segment[1])}` : "";
  switch (v.op) {
    case "extended": {
      const added = src ? Math.round(v.durationSec - src.durationSec) : 0;
      return `Extended${added > 0 ? ` +${added} s` : ""}${from}`;
    }
    case "edited": return `Edited${seg}${from}${v.detail ? `: ${v.detail}` : ""}`;
    case "recut": return `Re-cut${seg}${from}`;
    case "upscaled": return `Upscaled${v.detail ? ` to ${v.detail}` : ""}${from}`;
    case "remixed": return `Remixed${from}${v.detail ? `: ${v.detail}` : ""}`;
    default: return `${OP_WORD[v.op]}${v.detail ? `: ${v.detail}` : ""}`;
  }
}

/** Where in the clip the change landed, as start and end fractions. Extends mark the added tail. */
function markOf(v: TakeVersion, all: TakeVersion[]): [number, number] | undefined {
  if (!v.durationSec) return undefined;
  if (v.segment && (v.op === "edited" || v.op === "recut")) return [v.segment[0] / v.durationSec, v.segment[1] / v.durationSec];
  if (v.op === "extended") {
    const src = all.find((x) => x.id === v.from);
    if (src && src.durationSec < v.durationSec) return [src.durationSec / v.durationSec, 1];
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** A tiny strip of frames with the changed part outlined. Drawn for the eye; the words carry the same fact. */
function Filmstrip({ mark }: { mark: [number, number] }) {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="relative mt-1.5 flex h-2.5 w-full max-w-48 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-control">
      {Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => <span key={i} className="h-full flex-1 bg-line" />)}
      <span className="absolute inset-y-0 rounded-control border-2 border-fg bg-selected" style={{ left: `${mark[0] * 100}%`, width: `${Math.max(4, (mark[1] - mark[0]) * 100)}%` }} />
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * The versions of one video take: every extend, edit, remix and upscale, each saying what it came from. Making a
 * version current never deletes anything, and an Undo follows. Up and Down move between versions.
 */
export function TakeVersions({
  versions, currentId, onPreview, onMakeCurrent, onBranch, previewId: controlledPreview, layout = "auto", title = "Versions", headingLevel = 3, className,
}: TakeVersionsProps) {
  const narrow = useNarrow();
  const pager = layout === "pager" || (layout === "auto" && narrow);
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const uid = useId();
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLOListElement>(null);
  const [innerPreview, setInnerPreview] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const previewId = controlledPreview ?? innerPreview;
  const [focusId, setFocusId] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const [undo, setUndo] = useState<{ from: string; to: string } | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [changes, setChanges] = useState(0);
  const [pagerId, setPagerId] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);

  const nameOf = (v: TakeVersion) => v.name ?? `v${versions.indexOf(v) + 1}`;
  const byId = (id?: string) => versions.find((v) => v.id === id);
  const newestFirst = [...versions].reverse();
  const stopId = byId(focusId)?.id ?? currentId;
  const armFocus = useFocusAfter(changes, () => listRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-version="${currentId}"]`));

  const preview = (id: string) => {
    const next = id === currentId ? undefined : id;
    if (controlledPreview === undefined) setInnerPreview(next);
    onPreview(id);
  };
  const makeCurrent = (id: string) => {
    const v = byId(id);
    if (!v) return;
    armFocus();
    setUndo({ from: currentId, to: id });
    setChanges((n) => n + 1);
    setNotice(`${nameOf(v)} is now the current version. Nothing was deleted.`);
    if (controlledPreview === undefined) setInnerPreview(undefined);
    onMakeCurrent(id);
  };
  const undoLast = () => {
    if (!undo) return;
    const back = byId(undo.from);
    armFocus();
    onMakeCurrent(undo.from);
    setUndo(null);
    setChanges((n) => n + 1);
    setNotice(back ? `Back to ${nameOf(back)}.` : "Undone.");
  };

  const onListKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLOListElement>) => {
    if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    const all = Array.from(listRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-version]") ?? []);
    const from = all.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
    if (from < 0) return;
    let to = from;
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") to = Math.min(from + 1, all.length - 1);
    else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") to = Math.max(from - 1, 0);
    else if (e.key === "Home") to = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") to = all.length - 1;
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    all[to]?.focus();
  };

  const row = (v: TakeVersion, roving: boolean) => {
    const name = nameOf(v);
    const isCurrent = v.id === currentId;
    const isPreview = v.id === previewId && !isCurrent;
    const op = takeOpLabel(v, versions);
    const mark = markOf(v, versions);
    const ready = v.status === "done";
    return (
      <div className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-start gap-x-3 gap-y-2 rounded-card p-2", isPreview ? "bg-sunken" : isCurrent ? "bg-surface" : "")}>
        <button type="button" data-version={v.id} tabIndex={roving ? (v.id === stopId ? 0 : -1) : undefined}
          aria-pressed={isPreview} aria-label={`Preview ${name}. ${op}${isCurrent ? ". Current version" : ""}`}
          onClick={() => preview(v.id)} onFocus={() => setFocusId(v.id)}
          className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 basis-56 cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 rounded-control text-left">
          <span className={cn("relative aspect-video w-20 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-card border", isCurrent ? "border-fg" : "border-line")}>
            {ready ? <TakePoster src={v.poster} scene={v.scene} /> : <span className="block h-full w-full bg-sunken" />}
            <span className="absolute right-1 bottom-1 rounded-control bg-overlay px-1 font-mono text-nano leading-4 text-inverse-fg tabular-nums">{formatClock(v.durationSec)}</span>
          </span>
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-compact font-semibold text-fg">
              {name}
              {isCurrent && <Badge>Current</Badge>}
              {isPreview && <Badge>Previewing</Badge>}
              {!ready && <Badge>{TAKE_STATUS_WORD[v.status]}</Badge>}
            </span>
            <span className="mt-0.5 block text-small text-fg">{op}</span>
            {v.prompt && <span className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 block text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">“{v.prompt}”</span>}
            <span className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                {v.author === "ai" ? <SparkleIcon width={11} height={11} aria-hidden /> : <UsersIcon width={11} height={11} aria-hidden />}
                {v.author === "ai" ? "AI" : "Person"}{v.authorName ? `, ${v.authorName}` : ""}
              </span>
              <span aria-hidden>·</span><span>{v.time}</span>
              <span className="sr-only">, {formatSpokenDuration(v.durationSec)}</span>
            </span>
            {mark && <Filmstrip mark={mark} />}
          </span>
        </button>
        <span className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap gap-1.5 max-sm:basis-full max-sm:pl-23">
          {!isCurrent && ready && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => makeCurrent(v.id)} aria-label={`Make ${name} current`}>Make current</Button>}
          {onBranch && ready && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" leading={<BranchIcon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={() => onBranch(v.id)} aria-label={`Branch from ${name}`}>Branch</Button>}
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const shownId = byId(pagerId)?.id ?? previewId ?? currentId;
  const shownIndex = Math.max(0, versions.findIndex((v) => v.id === shownId));

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}h`} className={cn("space-y-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2 px-1">
        <H id={`${uid}h`} className="text-body font-semibold text-fg">{title}</H>
        <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{versions.length} {versions.length === 1 ? "version" : "versions"}. Nothing is ever overwritten.</p>
      </div>

      <div className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-card text-small", notice ? "border border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-2" : "sr-only")}>
        <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="min-w-0 flex-1">{notice}</p>
        {undo && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={undoLast}>Undo</Button>}
      </div>

      {pager ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <VersionPager total={versions.length} current={shownIndex + 1} label={`${title} pager`}
            announce={(c, t) => `${nameOf(versions[c - 1])}, ${c} of ${t}`}
            onChange={(n) => { const v = versions[n - 1]; setPagerId(v.id); preview(v.id); }} />
          {row(versions[shownIndex], false)}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ol ref={listRef} onKeyDown={onListKey} aria-label={`${title}, newest first`} className="m-0 list-none space-y-1 p-0">
          {newestFirst.map((v) => (
            <li key={v.id} aria-current={v.id === currentId ? "true" : undefined}>{row(v, true)}</li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )}
      {!pager && <p className="px-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">Up and Down move between versions. Preview does not change the current version.</p>}
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/TakeoverBar.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { useFocusAfter } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { EyeIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { AgentStatusIcon } from "../atoms/AgentStatusIcon";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export type TakeoverState = "you-control" | "agent-working" | "supervise";

export interface TakeoverBarLabels {
  youControl?: string;
  youControlHint?: string;
  agentWorking?: string;
  supervise?: string;
  /** Receives the step the person is asked to watch. */
  superviseHint?: (step: string) => ReactNode;
  takeOver?: string;
  resume?: string;
  handBack?: string;
}

export interface TakeoverBarProps {
  state: TakeoverState;
  /** The step that needs watching. Shown in the supervise state. */
  step?: string;
  /** Person takes control from the agent. Shown in the working and supervise states. */
  onTakeOver?: () => void;
  /** Agent continues from where it paused. */
  onResume?: () => void;
  /** Person gives control back, and the agent continues with what the person changed. */
  onHandBack?: () => void;
  labels?: TakeoverBarLabels;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Full-width bar that says who is in control right now. The status sentence sits in one polite
 * live region so a screen reader says it once when the state changes. Only the supervise state uses
 * amber, because only then a person must act.
 */
export function TakeoverBar({ state, step, onTakeOver, onResume, onHandBack, labels, className }: TakeoverBarProps) {
  const l = {
    youControl: "You have control", youControlHint: "The agent is paused and is not doing anything.",
    agentWorking: "The agent is working", supervise: "This step needs you to watch",
    superviseHint: (s: string) => <>The agent will wait while you watch: {s}</>,
    takeOver: "Take over", resume: "Resume", handBack: "Hand back", ...labels,
  };
  const title = state === "you-control" ? l.youControl : state === "agent-working" ? l.agentWorking : l.supervise;
  const actions = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  // Every button is swapped when control changes hands. Focus moves to the first button of the new state.
  const arm = useFocusAfter(state, () => actions.current?.querySelector("button"));
  const act = (f?: () => void) => () => { arm(); f?.(); };
  const hint = state === "you-control" ? l.youControlHint : state === "supervise" ? (step ? l.superviseHint(step) : null) : null;
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 rounded-card border px-4 py-3",
      state === "supervise" ? "border-transparent bg-attention-soft text-attention-fg" : "border-line bg-surface text-fg", className)}>
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 basis-56 items-start gap-2.5">
        <span className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden>
          {state === "agent-working" ? <AgentStatusIcon status="working" /> : state === "you-control" ? <AgentStatusIcon status="idle" /> : <EyeIcon />}
        </span>
        <div role="status" aria-live="polite" className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-body leading-5 font-medium">{title}</p>
          {hint && <p className={cn("text-small leading-4", state === "supervise" ? "text-attention-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>{hint}</p>}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div ref={actions} className="ml-auto flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2">
        {state === "agent-working" && <Button variant="secondary" onClick={act(onTakeOver)}>{l.takeOver}</Button>}
        {state === "supervise" && (<><Button variant="secondary" onClick={act(onTakeOver)}>{l.takeOver}</Button><Button onClick={act(onResume)}>{l.resume}</Button></>)}
        {state === "you-control" && (<><Button variant="secondary" onClick={act(onHandBack)}>{l.handBack}</Button><Button onClick={act(onResume)}>{l.resume}</Button></>)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/TickerTape.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { Ref } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";
import { PriceChange } from "../atoms/PriceChange";

export interface TickerItem {
  symbol: string;
  price: number;
  /** Absolute change. */
  change: number;
  /** Change in percent. */
  percent: number;
}

export interface TickerTapeProps {
  items: TickerItem[];
  /** Accessible name of the strip, such as "Market ticker". */
  label: string;
  /** Scroll speed in pixels per second. */
  speed?: number;
  /** Controlled pause state. Leave out to let the strip manage it. */
  paused?: boolean;
  onPausedChange?: (paused: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}

function plain(n: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return "—";
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(n);
}

function Row({ items, hidden, rowRef }: { items: TickerItem[]; hidden?: boolean; rowRef?: Ref<HTMLUListElement> }) {
  return (
    <ul ref={rowRef} aria-hidden={hidden || undefined} inert={hidden} className="m-0 flex shrink-0 list-none items-center p-0">
      {items.map((it) => (
        <li key={it.symbol} className="flex items-baseline gap-2 border-r border-line px-4 py-2 text-body leading-5 whitespace-nowrap">
          <span className="font-medium text-fg">{it.symbol}</span>
          <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-fg">{plain(it.price)}</span>
          <PriceChange change={it.change} percent={it.percent} format="both" className="text-small leading-4" />
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

function PauseIcon({ paused }: { paused: boolean }) {
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-4" fill="currentColor">
      {paused ? <path d="M5 3l8 5-8 5z" /> : <path d="M4.5 3h2.5v10H4.5zM9 3h2.5v10H9z" />}
    </svg>
  );
}

/** A looping strip of prices. It stops when paused, hovered or focused, and does not move at all with reduced motion. */
export function TickerTape({ items, label, speed = 40, paused, onPausedChange, className }: TickerTapeProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const [inner, setInner] = useState(false);
  const isControlled = paused !== undefined;
  const pausedNow = isControlled ? paused : inner;
  const [hover, setHover] = useState(false);
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState(false);
  const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const copyRef = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);
  const offset = useRef(0);

  const moving = !reduced && !pausedNow && !hover && !focus && items.length > 0;
  const loops = !reduced && items.length > 0;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!moving) return;
    let raf = 0;
    let last = performance.now();
    const step = (t: number) => {
      const width = copyRef.current?.offsetWidth ?? 0;
      const dt = Math.min(t - last, 100) / 1000;
      last = t;
      if (width > 0) {
        offset.current = (offset.current + speed * dt) % width;
        if (trackRef.current) trackRef.current.style.transform = `translateX(${-offset.current}px)`;
      }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [moving, speed]);

  // Reduced motion: drop the transform so the strip can be scrolled by hand.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced && trackRef.current) { trackRef.current.style.transform = ""; offset.current = 0; }
  }, [reduced]);

  const toggle = () => { if (!isControlled) setInner(!pausedNow); onPausedChange?.(!pausedNow); };
  const name = pausedNow ? "Play ticker" : "Pause ticker";

  return (
    <div role="region" aria-label={label} className={cn("flex items-stretch overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-surface", className)}
      onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
      onFocus={() => setFocus(true)} onBlur={(e) => { if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget)) setFocus(false); }}>
      <div tabIndex={reduced ? 0 : undefined} className={cn("min-w-0 flex-1", reduced ? "overflow-x-auto" : "overflow-hidden")}>
        <div ref={trackRef} className="flex w-max will-change-transform">
          <Row items={items} rowRef={copyRef} />
          {loops && <Row items={items} hidden />}
        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label={name} title={name}
        className="inline-flex min-h-9 min-w-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border-l border-line px-3 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg pointer-coarse:min-h-11 pointer-coarse:min-w-11">
        <PauseIcon paused={pausedNow} />
        <span className="hidden sm:inline">{pausedNow ? "Play" : "Pause"}</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export type TimelineState = "done" | "current" | "upcoming" | "failed";

export interface TimelineEvent {
  id: string;
  /** Display text for the time, such as "09:40" or "3 Oct". */
  time: string;
  /** Machine-readable value for the time element, such as "2026-10-03T09:40". */
  dateTime?: string;
  title: string;
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Optional state. Shown as a marker shape and as text. */
  state?: TimelineState;
}

export interface TimelineProps {
  events: TimelineEvent[];
  /** Text for each state label, for localisation. */
  stateLabels?: Record<TimelineState, string>;
  className?: string;
}

const defaultLabels: Record<TimelineState, string> = { done: "Done", current: "In progress", upcoming: "Upcoming", failed: "Failed" };

/** Vertical timeline as an ordered list. Each event has a time element, a title and an optional state. */
export function Timeline({ events, stateLabels = defaultLabels, className }: TimelineProps) {
  return (
    <ol className={cn("m-0 list-none p-0", className)}>
      {events.map((e, i) => (
        <li key={e.id} className="relative flex gap-4 pb-6 last:pb-0">
          {i < events.length - 1 && <span aria-hidden className="absolute top-6 bottom-0 left-2.75 w-px bg-line-strong" />}
          <span aria-hidden className={cn("relative z-(--z-above) flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border",
            e.state === "done" && "border-transparent bg-lime text-on-lime",
            e.state === "current" && "border-fg bg-surface",
            e.state === "failed" && "border-transparent bg-danger-soft text-danger-fg",
            (!e.state || e.state === "upcoming") && "border-line-strong bg-surface")}>
            {e.state === "done" && <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} />}
            {e.state === "current" && <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-fg" />}
            {e.state === "failed" && <XIcon width={12} height={12} />}
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pt-0.5">
            <p className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3 text-compact">
              <time dateTime={e.dateTime} className="font-mono text-small text-fg-subtle tabular-nums">{e.time}</time>
              <span className="font-medium text-fg">{e.title}</span>
              {e.state && <span className="text-micro text-fg-muted">{stateLabels[e.state]}</span>}
            </p>
            {e.description && <div className="mt-1 text-compact leading-6 text-fg-muted">{e.description}</div>}
          </div>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/Toast.tsx

```tsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type HTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, InfoIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";

export type ToastTone = "neutral" | "success" | "danger" | "info";

export interface ToastOptions {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  tone?: ToastTone;
  action?: { label: string; onClick: () => void };
  /** Milliseconds before it closes. 0 keeps it until dismissed. By default it follows the content: 4s for a title, 6s with a description, 8s with an action. */
  duration?: number;
}

export interface ToastApi {
  show: (options: ToastOptions) => string;
  dismiss: (id: string) => void;
  /** Changes a toast in place, for example "Saving" to "Saved". Its timer starts again with the new content. */
  update: (id: string, options: Partial<ToastOptions>) => void;
}

/** How long a toast stays when no duration is given: long enough to read, longest when there is something to press. */
export const toastDuration = (o: ToastOptions) => o.duration ?? (o.action ? 8000 : o.description ? 6000 : 4000);

const toneIcon = {
  neutral: null,
  success: <CheckIcon aria-hidden width={18} height={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-success-fg" />,
  danger: <AlertIcon aria-hidden width={18} height={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-danger-fg" />,
  info: <InfoIcon aria-hidden width={18} height={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-info-fg" />,
} satisfies Record<ToastTone, ReactNode>;

export interface ToastProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title"> {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  tone?: ToastTone;
  action?: { label: string; onClick: () => void };
  /** Shows the close button. Without it the toast has no close button, so pass it whenever the toast can go away. */
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  /** Shows how much time is left, as a thin bar along the bottom. Pass the length in ms; `paused` holds it. */
  timeLeft?: { duration: number; paused: boolean };
}

/** The toast itself, without any timing. Use it to show a toast in docs or to build your own host. A danger toast has role="alert". */
export function Toast({ title, description, tone = "neutral", action, onDismiss, timeLeft, className, onKeyDown, ...rest }: ToastProps) {
  return (
    <div role={tone === "danger" ? "alert" : undefined} {...rest}
      onKeyDown={(e) => { onKeyDown?.(e); if (e.key === "Escape" && onDismiss && !e.defaultPrevented) { e.stopPropagation(); onDismiss(); } }}
      className={cn("pointer-events-auto relative flex w-full max-w-sm items-start gap-3 overflow-hidden rounded-overlay border border-line bg-raised p-3 pl-4 text-body leading-5 text-fg shadow-lg forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]", className)}>
      {toneIcon[tone]}
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 py-0.5">
        <p className="font-medium">{title}</p>
        {description && <p className="mt-0.5 text-fg-muted">{description}</p>}
        {action && (
          <button type="button" onClick={action.onClick}
            className="-ml-2 mt-1.5 inline-flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-md px-2 text-compact font-medium text-accent-fg hover:bg-hover pointer-coarse:min-h-11">
            {action.label}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {onDismiss && (
        <IconButton label={`Close notification: ${title}`} size="sm" onClick={onDismiss} className="-mt-0.5 -mr-1 shrink-0 pointer-coarse:size-11">
          <XIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />
        </IconButton>
      )}
      {timeLeft && timeLeft.duration > 0 && (
        <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-0.5 origin-left bg-line-strong motion-reduce:hidden"
          style={{ animation: `shrink-x ${timeLeft.duration}ms linear both`, animationPlayState: timeLeft.paused ? "paused" : "running" }} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastApi | null>(null);

/** Returns `{ show, dismiss, update }`. Must be used under a ToastProvider. */
export function useToast(): ToastApi {
  const api = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!api) throw new Error("useToast must be used inside a ToastProvider.");
  return api;
}

interface Item extends ToastOptions { id: string; version: number; leaving?: boolean }
const MAX_VISIBLE = 3;
const EXIT_MS = 150; // --dur-fast

function ToastItem({ item, onDismiss }: { item: Item; onDismiss: (id: string) => void }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = useState(false);
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState(false);
  const [touch, setTouch] = useState(false);
  // A hidden tab cannot be read, so the clock stops there too.
  const [away, setAway] = useState(() => typeof document !== "undefined" && document.visibilityState === "hidden");
  useEffect(() => {
    const f = () => setAway(document.visibilityState === "hidden");
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", f);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", f);
  }, []);
  const paused = hover || focus || touch || away;
  const duration = toastDuration(item);
  const remaining = useRef(duration);
  const dismiss = useRef(onDismiss);
  dismiss.current = onDismiss;

  // Time left carries over a pause, so hovering does not reset the countdown.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!duration || paused) return;
    const start = Date.now();
    const t = setTimeout(() => dismiss.current(item.id), remaining.current);
    return () => { clearTimeout(t); remaining.current -= Date.now() - start; };
  }, [paused, duration, item.id]);

  return (
    <li className={cn("pointer-events-none flex w-full justify-center md:justify-end", item.leaving ? "motion-safe:animate-fade-out" : "motion-safe:animate-rise")}>
      <Toast title={item.title} description={item.description} tone={item.tone} action={item.action && { label: item.action.label, onClick: () => { item.action!.onClick(); onDismiss(item.id); } }}
        onDismiss={() => onDismiss(item.id)} timeLeft={item.action && duration ? { duration, paused } : undefined}
        onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
        onTouchStart={() => setTouch(true)} onTouchEnd={() => setTouch(false)} onTouchCancel={() => setTouch(false)}
        onFocus={() => setFocus(true)} onBlur={(e) => { if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget)) setFocus(false); }} />
    </li>
  );
}

/**
 * Hosts the toasts. Put it once near the root. The region and its live list stay mounted so screen readers
 * hear new toasts. At most three show at once, newest on top; older ones wait and appear when there is room.
 */
export function ToastProvider({ children, className }: { children: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Item[]>([]);
  const counter = useRef(0);
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  // A toast fades out (faster than it arrived) before it leaves the list.
  const dismiss = useCallback((id: string) => {
    if (reduce) { setItems((l) => l.filter((t) => t.id !== id)); return; }
    setItems((l) => l.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, leaving: true } : t)));
    window.setTimeout(() => setItems((l) => l.filter((t) => t.id !== id)), EXIT_MS);
  }, [reduce]);
  const show = useCallback((options: ToastOptions) => {
    counter.current += 1;
    const id = `toast-${counter.current}`;
    setItems((l) => [...l, { ...options, id, version: 0 }]);
    return id;
  }, []);
  const update = useCallback((id: string, options: Partial<ToastOptions>) => {
    setItems((l) => l.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, ...options, version: t.version + 1 } : t)));
  }, []);
  const api = useMemo(() => ({ show, dismiss, update }), [show, dismiss, update]);
  const visible = [...items].reverse().slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={api}>
      {children}
      <section role="region" aria-label="Notifications" className={cn("pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-50 p-4 pb-[max(1rem,var(--safe-bottom))]", className)}>
        <ol aria-live="polite" aria-relevant="additions text" className="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
          {visible.map((t) => <ToastItem key={`${t.id}-${t.version}`} item={t} onDismiss={dismiss} />)}
        </ol>
      </section>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, ToolIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge, type Tone } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";
import { Collapsible } from "./Collapsible";

export type ToolStatus = "pending" | "running" | "success" | "error";

const status: Record<ToolStatus, { tone: Tone; label: string }> = {
  pending: { tone: "neutral", label: "Queued" },
  running: { tone: "accent", label: "Running" },
  success: { tone: "success", label: "Done" },
  error: { tone: "danger", label: "Failed" },
};

export interface ToolCallCardProps {
  name: string;
  status: ToolStatus;
  /** One-line human summary of what the tool is doing, e.g. 'Searching "q3 revenue"'. */
  summary?: string;
  input?: unknown;
  output?: ReactNode;
  durationMs?: number;
}

export function ToolCallCard({ name, status: s, summary, input, output, durationMs }: ToolCallCardProps) {
  const { tone, label } = status[s];
  return (
    <div className={cn("rounded-card border bg-surface p-3", s === "error" ? "border-danger-line" : "border-line")}>
      <Collapsible
        header={
          <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2">
            <span className="flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-sunken text-fg-muted">
              {s === "running" ? <Spinner size={14} /> : s === "success" ? <CheckIcon className="text-success" /> : s === "error" ? <AlertIcon className="text-danger" /> : <ToolIcon />}
            </span>
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span className="block truncate font-mono text-compact font-medium">{name}</span>
              {summary && <span className="block truncate text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{summary}</span>}
            </span>
            {durationMs != null && s !== "running" && <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle tabular-nums">{(durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s</span>}
            <Badge tone={tone}>{label}</Badge>
          </span>
        }
      >
        <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-small leading-4">
          {input !== undefined && (
            <div>
              <p className="mb-1 font-medium text-fg-subtle">Input</p>
              <pre tabIndex={0} className="overflow-x-auto rounded-md bg-sunken p-2 font-mono leading-5">{JSON.stringify(input, null, 2)}</pre>
            </div>
          )}
          {output != null && (
            <div>
              <p className="mb-1 font-medium text-fg-subtle">Output</p>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-md bg-sunken p-2 font-mono leading-5 [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">{output}</div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Collapsible>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  /** Overrides the remove button name. Defaults to `Remove ${label}`. */

}

      {onRemove && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => { onRemove(); keepFocus(ref.current, focusAfterRemove); }} aria-label={removeLabel ?? `Remove ${label}`} title={removeLabel ?? `Remove ${label}`}

        </button>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Meter } from "../atoms/Meter";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface UsageMeterProps {
  /** Credits or quota left. */
  remaining: number;
  /** Full allowance for the period. */
  total: number;
  /** Plural unit name. */
  unit?: string;
  /** Cost of the action about to run, in the same unit. Shows "This will use about N credits". */
  estimate?: number;
  /** Reset time, for example "Resets Nov 1". */
  resetText?: string;
  /** Fraction of the allowance used at which the meter warns, 0 to 1. */
  warnAt?: number;
  /** Slot for an upgrade action. Shown only in the warn state. */
  upgrade?: ReactNode;
  /** Reason shown in the warn state. */
  warnText?: string;
  /** Accessible name for the meter. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Remaining credits or quota with an optional cost estimate. Warns only when the person may need to act. */
export function UsageMeter({ remaining, total, unit = "credits", estimate, resetText, warnAt = 0.8, upgrade, warnText, label = "Usage", className }: UsageMeterProps) {
  const used = Math.max(0, total - remaining);
  const short = estimate !== undefined && estimate > remaining;
  const low = total > 0 && used / total >= warnAt;
  const warn = low || short;
  const reason = warnText ?? (short ? `Not enough ${unit} left for this.` : `Running low on ${unit}.`);
  const text = `${remaining} of ${total} ${unit} left`;
  return (
    <div className={cn("space-y-2", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-small leading-4">
        <span className="font-medium text-fg">{text}</span>
        {resetText && <span className="text-fg-subtle">{resetText}</span>}
      </div>
      <Meter label={label} value={used} max={total} warnAt={warnAt} valueText={text} className={short && !low ? "[&>div]:bg-attention" : undefined} />
      {estimate !== undefined && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">This will use about {estimate} {unit}.</p>}
      {warn && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-small leading-4">
          <span className="text-attention-fg">{reason}</span>
          {upgrade}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { SegmentedControl, type SegmentOption } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";

export interface VariationAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** Cost hint shown beside the action, such as "About 4 credits". */
  cost?: ReactNode;
  /** Set false for actions with no strength choice. Default true. */
  strength?: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_VARIATION_ACTIONS: VariationAction[] = [
  { id: "vary", label: "Vary" },
  { id: "upscale", label: "Upscale" },
  { id: "remix", label: "Remix" },
  { id: "extend", label: "Extend", strength: false },
];

export interface VariationActionsProps {
  /** Actions in display order. Defaults to Vary, Upscale, Remix and Extend. */
  actions?: VariationAction[];
  /** Called with the action id and the chosen strength value. */
  onAction: (actionId: string, strength: string) => void;
  /** Strength choices shared by every action that has one. */
  strengths?: SegmentOption<string>[];
  /** Strength selected at first for each action. Defaults to the first strength. */
  defaultStrength?: string;
  /** Lineage line, for example "Made from Variant B". */
  lineage?: ReactNode;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const STRENGTHS: SegmentOption<string>[] = [{ value: "subtle", label: "Subtle" }, { value: "strong", label: "Strong" }];

/** Action row for one generated item. Each action keeps its own strength choice and can show what it costs. */
export function VariationActions({ actions = DEFAULT_VARIATION_ACTIONS, onAction, strengths = STRENGTHS, defaultStrength, lineage, disabled, className }: VariationActionsProps) {
  const first = defaultStrength ?? strengths[0]?.value ?? "";
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  return (
    <div className={cn("space-y-2", className)}>
      {lineage && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{lineage}</p>}
      <ul className="space-y-1.5">
        {actions.map((a) => {
          const s = chosen[a.id] ?? first;
          const hasStrength = a.strength !== false;
          return (
            <li key={a.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => onAction(a.id, hasStrength ? s : "")}>{a.label}</Button>
              {hasStrength && <SegmentedControl size="sm" label={`${a.label} strength`} options={strengths} value={s} onChange={(v) => setChosen((c) => ({ ...c, [a.id]: v }))} />}
              {a.cost && <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{a.cost}</span>}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
```
