## tattva/molecules/VersionPager.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { ChevronIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface VersionPagerProps {
  /** Number of sibling versions, from edits and regenerations. */
  total: number;
  /** Controlled current version, 1-based. Omit to let the pager manage itself. */
  current?: number;
  /** Starting version in uncontrolled mode. Defaults to the last version. */
  defaultCurrent?: number;
  /** Called with the new 1-based version when the person steps. */
  onChange?: (version: number) => void;
  /** Shows a small "edited" label when the current version came from an edit. */
  edited?: boolean;
  /** Text for the edited label. */
  editedLabel?: string;
  /** Slot for an action such as a "Branch from here" button. */
  branchAction?: ReactNode;
  /** Builds the polite announcement. Defaults to "Version 2 of 3". */
  announce?: (current: number, total: number) => string;
  /** Accessible name for the group. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Pager for sibling versions of one message. Announces each change through a separate polite status region. */
export function VersionPager({ total, current, defaultCurrent, onChange, edited, editedLabel = "Edited", branchAction, announce = (c, t) => `Version ${c} of ${t}`, label = "Message versions", className }: VersionPagerProps) {
  const [inner, setInner] = useState(defaultCurrent ?? total);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const value = Math.min(Math.max(current ?? inner, 1), Math.max(total, 1));
  const go = (next: number) => {
    if (next < 1 || next > total) return;
    if (current === undefined) setInner(next);
    onChange?.(next);
    setMessage(announce(next, total));
  };
  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={label} className={cn("inline-flex max-w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted", className)}>
      <IconButton size="sm" label="Previous version" disabled={value <= 1} onClick={() => go(value - 1)}><ChevronIcon className="rotate-180" /></IconButton>
      <span className="min-w-8 text-center tabular-nums" aria-hidden="true">{value}/{total}</span>
      <IconButton size="sm" label="Next version" disabled={value >= total} onClick={() => go(value + 1)}><ChevronIcon /></IconButton>
      {edited && <span className="rounded-control border border-line bg-sunken px-2 py-0.5 text-micro leading-4">{editedLabel}</span>}
      {branchAction}
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{message}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/VideoPlayer.tsx

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent, PointerEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, LoopIcon, RetryIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { FrameScrubber, frameAt } from "../atoms/FrameScrubber";
import { Kbd } from "../atoms/Kbd";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";
import { Switch } from "../atoms/Switch";
import { WorkingEdge } from "../atoms/WorkingEdge";
import { formatMediaTime } from "../atoms/Waveform";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";
import { AILabel } from "./AILabel";
import { Collapsible } from "./Collapsible";
import { ProvenancePopover } from "./ProvenancePopover";
import type { ProvenancePopoverProps } from "./ProvenancePopover";

export type VideoRatio = "16:9" | "9:16" | "1:1";
/** A drawn stand-in for a clip, used when there is no `src` (previews, tests and docs). */
export type VideoSceneName = "harbour" | "kite";
/**
 * generating: the AI is still making the clip; the poster shows and nothing can play. loading: getting the file.
 * ready, playing, paused, buffering, ended: tracked by the player. error: the clip could not be loaded.
 */
export type VideoPlayerState = "generating" | "loading" | "ready" | "playing" | "paused" | "buffering" | "ended" | "error";

export interface VideoFrameAction {
  id: string;
  /** Short verb phrase, such as "Use as start frame" or "Extend from here". */
  label: string;
  icon?: ReactNode;
}

export interface VideoCue {
  start: number;
  end: number;
  text: string;
}

export interface VideoPlayerProps {
  /** Names the player, such as "Take 3, harbour at dawn". Tells clips apart. */
  label: string;
  /** A second line, such as "8 seconds, made 3 October". Without it the line shows the state in words. */
  subtitle?: string;
  /** A real video file. Leave out to simulate playback with a drawn scene. */
  src?: string;
  /** Length in seconds. Needed without `src`; with `src` it is read from the file when left out. */
  duration?: number;
  /** The drawn scene used without `src`. */
  scene?: VideoSceneName;
  /** Still image shown before playing and while generating. Without it the first drawn frame is used. */
  poster?: string;
  /** Shape of the frame. The space is reserved before anything loads. */
  ratio?: VideoRatio;
  /** Frames per second. Turns on frame step buttons and keys, and frame numbers. */
  fps?: number;
  /** Forces a state the player cannot see for itself: generating, loading or error. */
  state?: "generating" | "loading" | "error";
  /** Extra words beside the generating or error state, such as "Second in the queue, busy period". */
  statusNote?: string;
  /** Shows Try again in the error state. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** Starts with loop on. The person can change it. */
  loop?: boolean;
  /** Starts muted. The person can change it. Nothing ever plays, with or without sound, until the person presses Play. */
  muted?: boolean;
  /** Set to false when the clip has no sound. The mute button then says so and does nothing. */
  hasAudio?: boolean;
  /** Caption files for a real `src`, played through native tracks. */
  captions?: { src: string; lang: string; label: string }[];
  /** Caption lines drawn over the frame. Works with or without `src`. */
  cues?: VideoCue[];
  /** The words spoken in the clip, or a description of what it shows. Shown in a collapsed Transcript section. */
  transcript?: ReactNode;
  /** Actions on the paused frame, such as "Use as start frame". They show only while paused. */
  frameActions?: VideoFrameAction[];
  /** Called with the action id, the time in seconds and the frame number (when `fps` is set). */
  onFrameAction?: (id: string, seconds: number, frame?: number) => void;
  /** Single-key shortcuts (K, M, C, comma, period) on at first. They only work while focus is inside the player, and the person can turn them off. */
  shortcuts?: boolean;
  /** Adds an AI label beside the title. The player itself stays neutral. */
  aiGenerated?: boolean;
  /** What the AI label explains, used when there is no `provenance`. */
  aiNote?: ReactNode;
  /** Opens full provenance details from the label: model, date, what the file carries. Say what can strip it. */
  provenance?: Omit<ProvenancePopoverProps, "open" | "onOpenChange">;
  /** Position in seconds, when the parent keeps it. A change of more than a frame seeks. */
  current?: number;
  onTimeChange?: (seconds: number) => void;
  onPlayingChange?: (playing: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const STATE_WORD: Record<VideoPlayerState, string> = {
  generating: "Generating", loading: "Loading", ready: "Ready", playing: "Playing", paused: "Paused",
  buffering: "Buffering", ended: "Ended", error: "Could not play",
};
const RATIO: Record<VideoRatio, string> = { "16:9": "aspect-video", "9:16": "aspect-[9/16] max-w-64", "1:1": "aspect-square max-w-md" };
const VIEW: Record<VideoRatio, string> = { "16:9": "0 35 160 90", "9:16": "35 0 90 160", "1:1": "0 0 160 160" };
// Shared with AudioPlayer, so starting a video pauses any audio on the page and the reverse.
const PLAY_EVENT = "tattva-audio-play";
const DOUBLE_TAP_SECONDS = 2;

const isTyping = (el: EventTarget | null) => el instanceof HTMLElement && (el.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(el.tagName));
const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));

/* ---------- glyphs ---------- */
const G = ({ children, className = "size-5" }: { children: ReactNode; className?: string }) => (
  <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 24 24" className={className} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">{children}</svg>
);
const PlayGlyph = ({ className }: { className?: string }) => <G className={className}><path d="M8 5.5v13a1 1 0 0 0 1.5.86l10.5-6.5a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.72L9.5 4.64A1 1 0 0 0 8 5.5z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" /></G>;
const PauseGlyph = () => <G><rect x="6.5" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" /><rect x="13.5" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" /></G>;
const FrameBackGlyph = () => <G><path d="M6 5v14" /><path d="M18 6l-8 6 8 6z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" /></G>;
const FrameFwdGlyph = () => <G><path d="M18 5v14" /><path d="M6 6l8 6-8 6z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" /></G>;
const SoundGlyph = ({ off }: { off: boolean }) => (
  <G><path d="M4 9.5h3.5L12 6v12l-4.5-3.5H4z" />{off ? <path d="M16 9.5l5 5M21 9.5l-5 5" /> : <path d="M15.5 9a4 4 0 0 1 0 6M18 6.5a7.5 7.5 0 0 1 0 11" />}</G>
);
const CaptionsGlyph = () => <G><rect x="3" y="5.5" width="18" height="13" rx="2" /><path d="M10.5 10.5a2 2 0 1 0 0 3M17 10.5a2 2 0 1 0 0 3" /></G>;
const FullGlyph = () => <G><path d="M4 9V4h5M20 9V4h-5M4 15v5h5M20 15v5h-5" /></G>;

/* ---------- drawn scenes ---------- */

/**
 * One frame of a drawn stand-in clip, worked out from the time alone, so any frame can be drawn again (for the scrubber
 * preview, a filmstrip or a frame action). Colours come from tokens. Use it where a real file is not needed.
 */
export function VideoScene({ scene = "harbour", time, duration, ratio = "16:9", className }: { scene?: VideoSceneName; time: number; duration: number; ratio?: VideoRatio; className?: string }) {
  const p = duration > 0 ? clamp(time / duration, 0, 1) : 0;
  const gid = useId().replace(/:/g, "");
  const paper = "var(--ref-paper)";
  const ink = "var(--ref-charcoal)";
  if (scene === "kite") {
    const kx = 80 + Math.sin(p * Math.PI * 4) * 28;
    const ky = 52 + Math.sin(p * Math.PI * 8) * 10 - p * 8;
    const cloud = (x: number, y: number, s: number) => (
      <g transform={`translate(${((x + p * 60) % 200) - 20} ${y}) scale(${s})`} fill={paper} fillOpacity={0.85}>
        <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="12" ry="5" /><ellipse cx="7" cy="-3" rx="8" ry="5" /><ellipse cx="-6" cy="-2" rx="6" ry="4" />
      </g>
    );
    return (
      <svg viewBox={VIEW[ratio]} preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" className={cn("block size-full", className)} focusable="false" aria-hidden>
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={`${gid}k`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0" style={{ stopColor: "var(--chart-seq-3)" }} />
            <stop offset="1" style={{ stopColor: "var(--chart-seq-1)" }} />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        <rect width="160" height="160" fill={`url(#${gid}k)`} />
        {cloud(20, 30, 1)}{cloud(110, 45, 0.8)}{cloud(70, 18, 0.6)}
        <path d="M0 118 Q40 96 85 108 T160 102 V160 H0z" style={{ fill: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-4) 70%, var(--ref-charcoal))" }} />
        <path d="M0 128 Q50 112 100 124 T160 118 V160 H0z" fill="var(--chart-4)" />
        {/* A child on the hill holding the line. */}
        <g transform="translate(58 112)" fill={ink}><circle cx="0" cy="-9" r="2.2" /><path d="M-2 -7h4l1 7h-6z" /><path d="M-2 0v5M2 0v5" stroke={ink} strokeWidth="1.4" /></g>
        <path d={`M60 106 Q${(kx + 60) / 2} ${ky + 30} ${kx} ${ky + 8}`} fill="none" stroke={ink} strokeWidth="0.5" />
        <g transform={`translate(${kx} ${ky}) rotate(${Math.sin(p * Math.PI * 8) * 12})`}>
          <path d="M0 -8 L6 0 L0 10 L-6 0z" fill="var(--chart-2)" stroke={ink} strokeWidth="0.6" />
          <path d="M0 10 q3 5 0 9 q-3 4 0 8" fill="none" stroke="var(--chart-2)" strokeWidth="1" />
        </g>
      </svg>
    );
  }
  const sx = 34 + p * 70;
  const sy = 104 - Math.sin(p * Math.PI * 0.85) * 46;
  const boat = 8 + p * 112;
  const wave = (y: number, o: number) => {
    const x0 = -20 + ((p * 40 + o) % 20);
    return <path d={`M${x0} ${y} q5 -2 10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0 t10 0`} fill="none" stroke={paper} strokeOpacity={0.35} strokeWidth="0.7" />;
  };
  return (
    <svg viewBox={VIEW[ratio]} preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" className={cn("block size-full", className)} focusable="false" aria-hidden>
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={`${gid}s`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" style={{ stopColor: "var(--chart-seq-5)" }} />
          <stop offset="0.7" style={{ stopColor: "var(--chart-seq-2)" }} />
          <stop offset="1" style={{ stopColor: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-2) 45%, var(--ref-paper))" }} />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <rect width="160" height="160" fill={`url(#${gid}s)`} />
      <circle cx={sx} cy={sy} r="9" style={{ fill: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-2) 40%, var(--ref-paper))" }} />
      <path d="M0 100 L18 90 L30 95 L48 84 L64 96 L160 96 V100z" fill="var(--chart-seq-5)" />
      <rect y="100" width="160" height="60" fill="var(--chart-seq-4)" />
      <ellipse cx={sx} cy={112} rx="6" ry="14" style={{ fill: "color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-2) 40%, var(--ref-paper))" }} fillOpacity={0.35} />
      {wave(106, 0)}{wave(114, 7)}{wave(124, 13)}{wave(138, 4)}
      {/* Lighthouse on the right. */}
      <g transform="translate(136 72)">
        <path d="M-3 0h6l2 28h-10z" fill={paper} />
        <rect x="-4" y="8" width="8" height="4" fill="var(--chart-2)" /><rect x="-4.6" y="18" width="9.2" height="4" fill="var(--chart-2)" />
        <rect x="-3.5" y="-5" width="7" height="5" fill={ink} />
        <path d="M-20 28h40v4h-40z" fill="var(--chart-seq-5)" />
      </g>
      <g transform={`translate(${boat} 101)`}>
        <path d="M-9 0h18l-3 4h-12z" fill={ink} />
        <path d="M0 -1V-15L8 -2z" fill={paper} />
        <path d="M-1 -1V-11L-7 -2z" fill={paper} fillOpacity={0.8} />
      </g>
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ---------- player ---------- */

/**
 * Plays one generated clip and lets the person act on the exact frame they paused on. Play and pause, a frame-accurate
 * scrubber, frame steps, loop, mute, captions and full screen. Nothing plays until the person presses Play.
 * Without `src` it simulates playback with a drawn scene, so previews and docs need no file.
 */
export function VideoPlayer({
  label, subtitle, src, duration, scene = "harbour", poster, ratio = "16:9", fps, state: forced, statusNote, onRetry,
  loop: loopStart = false, muted: mutedStart = false, hasAudio = true, captions, cues, transcript, frameActions, onFrameAction,
  shortcuts = true, aiGenerated, aiNote, provenance, current, onTimeChange, onPlayingChange, className,
}: VideoPlayerProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const titleId = `${id}-title`;
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const [time, setTime] = useState(current ?? 0);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [ended, setEnded] = useState(false);
  const [loop, setLoop] = useState(loopStart);
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(mutedStart || !hasAudio);
  const [captionsOn, setCaptionsOn] = useState(true);
  const [keysOn, setKeysOn] = useState(shortcuts);
  const [fileDur, setFileDur] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [fileState, setFileState] = useState<"loading" | "ok" | "buffering" | "error">(src ? "loading" : "ok");
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  const timeRef = useRef(time);
  timeRef.current = time;

  const dur = duration ?? fileDur ?? 0;
  const blocked = forced === "generating" || forced === "loading" || forced === "error";
  const state: VideoPlayerState = blocked ? forced!
    : src && fileState === "loading" ? "loading" : src && fileState === "error" ? "error"
    : playing && fileState === "buffering" ? "buffering" : playing ? "playing" : ended ? "ended" : time > 0 ? "paused" : "ready";
  const canPlay = !blocked && state !== "loading" && state !== "error" && dur > 0;
  const hasCaptions = !!cues?.length || !!captions?.length;
  const frame = fps ? 1 / fps : 0;
  const frameNo = fps ? Math.min(frameAt(time, fps), Math.max(1, Math.round(dur * fps))) : undefined;
  const totalFrames = fps ? Math.max(1, Math.round(dur * fps)) : 0;

  const report = useCallback((t: number) => { setTime(t); onTimeChange?.(t); }, [onTimeChange]);
  const setPlay = useCallback((on: boolean) => {
    setPlaying(on);
    onPlayingChange?.(on);
    if (on) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(PLAY_EVENT, { detail: id }));
  }, [id, onPlayingChange]);

  const seek = useCallback((t: number) => {
    const to = clamp(t, 0, dur || 0);
    if (video.current) video.current.currentTime = to;
    setEnded(false);
    report(to);
  }, [dur, report]);

  // The parent moved the position.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (current !== undefined && Math.abs(current - timeRef.current) > Math.max(frame, 0.05)) seek(current);
  }, [current, seek, frame]);

  // Only one player plays at a time, across audio and video.
  useEffect(() => {
    const other = (e: Event) => { if ((e as CustomEvent).detail !== id) { setPlaying(false); video.current?.pause(); } };
    window.addEventListener(PLAY_EVENT, other);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(PLAY_EVENT, other);
  }, [id]);

  // Stop when the clip becomes unplayable (for example it goes back to generating).
  useEffect(() => { if (blocked && playing) setPlay(false); }, [blocked, playing, setPlay]);

  // A real file plays through the video element.
  useEffect(() => {
    const v = video.current;
    if (!v || !src) return;
    v.muted = muted;
    v.loop = loop;
    if (playing && !blocked) v.play().catch(() => setPlay(false));
    else v.pause();
  }, [playing, muted, loop, src, blocked, setPlay]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const tracks = video.current?.textTracks;
    if (!tracks) return;
    for (let i = 0; i < tracks.length; i++) tracks[i].mode = captionsOn ? "showing" : "hidden";
  }, [captionsOn, src]);

  // Without a file, a clock moves the playhead. It ticks less often with reduced motion.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (src || !playing || blocked) return;
    const step = reduced ? 250 : 1000 / Math.min(fps ?? 30, 30);
    let last = performance.now();
    const t = window.setInterval(() => {
      const now = performance.now();
      const next = timeRef.current + (now - last) / 1000;
      last = now;
      if (next >= dur) {
        if (loop) report(0);
        else { report(dur); setPlay(false); setEnded(true); }
      } else report(next);
    }, step);
    return () => window.clearInterval(t);
  }, [src, playing, blocked, reduced, dur, loop, fps, report, setPlay]);

  // Say state changes once: ready after generating (WorkingEdge already says generating), ended, error. Never the clock or play and pause.
  const prevForced = useRef(forced);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevForced.current === "generating" && forced !== "generating") setSaid(`${label} is ready to play.`);
    else if (state === "generating") setSaid(statusNote ?? "");
    else if (state === "ended") setSaid(`${label}: ended.`);
    else if (state === "error") setSaid(`${label}: could not play.${statusNote ? ` ${statusNote}` : ""}`);
    else if (state === "buffering") setSaid(`${label}: buffering.`);
    prevForced.current = forced;
  }, [state, forced, label, statusNote]);

  const toggle = () => {
    if (!canPlay) return;
    if (playing) { setPlay(false); return; }
    if (ended || time >= dur) seek(0);
    setEnded(false);
    setPlay(true);
  };
  const stepFrame = (dir: 1 | -1) => {
    if (!canPlay) return;
    if (playing) setPlay(false);
    seek(Math.round((timeRef.current + dir * (frame || 0.1)) / (frame || 0.1)) * (frame || 0.1));
  };
  const toggleMute = () => { if (hasAudio) setMuted((m) => !m); };
  const fullscreen = () => {
    const el = root.current;
    if (!el) return;
    if (document.fullscreenElement) void document.exitFullscreen?.();
    else void el.requestFullscreen?.().catch(() => {});
  };
  const canFull = typeof document !== "undefined" && !!document.fullscreenEnabled;

  // Keys work only while focus is inside the player, never while typing. Single-character keys can be turned off.
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || isTyping(e.target)) return;
    const el = e.target instanceof HTMLElement ? e.target : null;
    const onButton = el?.tagName === "BUTTON";
    const k = e.key;
    let done = true;
    if (k === " " && !onButton) toggle();
    else if (keysOn && (k === "k" || k === "K")) toggle();
    else if (keysOn && (k === "m" || k === "M")) toggleMute();
    else if (keysOn && (k === "c" || k === "C") && hasCaptions) setCaptionsOn((c) => !c);
    else if (keysOn && k === ",") stepFrame(-1);
    else if (keysOn && k === ".") stepFrame(1);
    else if (k === "ArrowLeft" || k === "ArrowRight") {
      const dir = k === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 1;
      if (e.shiftKey) stepFrame(dir); else if (canPlay) seek(timeRef.current + dir);
    } else if (k === "Home" && canPlay) seek(0);
    else if (k === "End" && canPlay) seek(dur);
    else done = false;
    if (done) e.preventDefault();
  };

  // Touch: one tap plays or pauses; a quick second tap on the left or right side seeks back or forward.
  const tap = useRef<{ at: number; timer: number } | null>(null);
  const onSurfaceUp = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (e.pointerType !== "touch" || !canPlay) return;
    const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const side = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width;
    if (tap.current && performance.now() - tap.current.at < 300) {
      window.clearTimeout(tap.current.timer);
      tap.current = null;
      if (side < 0.4) seek(timeRef.current - DOUBLE_TAP_SECONDS);
      else if (side > 0.6) seek(timeRef.current + DOUBLE_TAP_SECONDS);
      return;
    }
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => { tap.current = null; toggle(); }, 260);
    tap.current = { at: performance.now(), timer };
  };
  useEffect(() => () => { if (tap.current) window.clearTimeout(tap.current.timer); }, []);
  const lastPointer = useRef("mouse");

  const cue = captionsOn && cues?.find((c) => time >= c.start && time < c.end);
  const showFrameActions = !!frameActions?.length && canPlay && !playing;
  const showPoster = !src && (state === "generating" || state === "loading") ? poster : undefined;
  const timeText = <span className="tabular-nums">{formatMediaTime(time)} / {dur ? formatMediaTime(dur) : "–:––"}</span>;

  const iconBtn = "inline-flex size-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-control text-fg-muted transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg aria-disabled:cursor-default aria-disabled:text-disabled-fg aria-disabled:hover:bg-transparent aria-pressed:text-fg aria-pressed:bg-sunken pointer-coarse:size-11";

  return (
    <section ref={root} aria-labelledby={titleId} onKeyDown={onKey}
      className={cn("flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3 sm:p-4 [&:fullscreen]:justify-center [&:fullscreen]:overflow-auto", className)}>
      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
            <h3 id={titleId} className="truncate text-compact font-medium text-fg">{label}</h3>
            {provenance ? <ProvenancePopover label="AI-generated" {...provenance} />
              : aiGenerated && <AILabel level="message" size={16} text="AI" overview={aiNote ?? "This clip was made by an AI video model."} popoverLabel={`About the AI in ${label}`} />}
          </div>
          <p className="truncate text-small text-fg-muted">{subtitle ?? STATE_WORD[state]}{subtitle && state !== "ready" && state !== "paused" ? ` · ${STATE_WORD[state]}` : ""}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <WorkingEdge active={state === "generating"} label={`Generating ${label}`} className={cn("mx-auto w-full", RATIO[ratio])}>
        <div className="relative size-full overflow-hidden rounded-card bg-sunken">
          {src ? (
            <video ref={video} src={src} poster={poster} preload="metadata" playsInline muted={muted} loop={loop}
              aria-label={label} className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-contain"
              onLoadedMetadata={(e) => { setFileDur(e.currentTarget.duration); setFileState("ok"); }}
              onCanPlay={() => setFileState("ok")} onWaiting={() => setFileState("buffering")} onPlaying={() => setFileState("ok")}
              onError={() => { setFileState("error"); setPlay(false); }}
              onTimeUpdate={(e) => report(e.currentTarget.currentTime)}
              onEnded={() => { setPlay(false); setEnded(true); }}>
              {captions?.map((c) => <track key={c.src} kind="captions" src={c.src} srcLang={c.lang} label={c.label} default={captionsOn} />)}
            </video>
          ) : showPoster ? (
            <img src={showPoster} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover" />
          ) : (
            <VideoScene scene={scene} time={state === "generating" ? 0 : time} duration={dur || 1} ratio={ratio}
              className={cn("absolute inset-0", (state === "generating" || state === "loading") && "opacity-50 saturate-50")} />
          )}

          {/* Pointer convenience only: the Play button below is the keyboard and screen reader control. */}
          {canPlay && (
            <button type="button" tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden data-compact
              onPointerDown={(e) => { lastPointer.current = e.pointerType; }}
              onPointerUp={onSurfaceUp}
              onClick={() => { if (lastPointer.current !== "touch") toggle(); }}
              className="group absolute inset-0 flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-center">
              <span className={cn("flex size-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-overlay text-inverse-fg shadow-md transition-opacity duration-(--dur-fast) motion-reduce:transition-none",
                playing ? "opacity-0" : "opacity-100")}>
                {state === "ended" ? <RetryIcon width={24} height={24} /> : <PlayGlyph className="size-7" />}
              </span>
            </button>
          )}

          {cue && (
            <p aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-3 bottom-3 text-center">
              <span className="box-decoration-clone rounded-sm bg-overlay px-1.5 py-0.5 text-compact leading-relaxed text-inverse-fg">{cue.text}</span>
            </p>
          )}

          {state === "generating" && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-3">
              <p className="flex max-w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-control bg-glass px-3 py-1.5 text-small text-fg shadow-sm">
                <span className="min-w-0 text-center">Generating{statusNote ? `. ${statusNote}` : ""}</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          {state === "loading" && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"><Spinner size={22} label="Loading" /></div>
          )}
          {state === "buffering" && (
            <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 rounded-full bg-glass p-1"><Spinner size={16} label="Buffering" /></div>
          )}
          {state === "error" && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-sunken p-3 text-center">
              <AlertIcon width={20} height={20} aria-hidden className="text-danger-fg" />
              <p className="text-compact text-fg">This clip could not be loaded.{statusNote ? ` ${statusNote}` : ""}</p>
              {onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onRetry} leading={<RetryIcon width={14} height={14} />} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Try again</Button>}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </WorkingEdge>

      <FrameScrubber duration={canPlay ? dur : 0} value={time} onChange={(t) => seek(t)} fps={fps}
        label={`Seek, ${label}`} disabled={!canPlay}
        onScrubbingChange={(on) => { if (on && playing) setPlay(false); }}
        renderThumbnail={src ? undefined : (t) => <VideoScene scene={scene} time={t} duration={dur || 1} ratio="16:9" />} />

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-1 gap-y-1 text-small text-fg-muted">
        <button type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label="Play" aria-pressed={playing} aria-disabled={!canPlay || undefined}
          className={cn("inline-flex size-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent text-on-accent transition-colors duration-(--dur-instant) hover:bg-accent-hover",
            !canPlay && "cursor-default bg-sunken text-fg-subtle hover:bg-sunken")}>
          {playing ? <PauseGlyph /> : state === "ended" ? <RetryIcon width={20} height={20} aria-hidden /> : <PlayGlyph />}
        </button>
        {fps && (
          <>
            <button type="button" className={iconBtn} onClick={() => stepFrame(-1)} aria-disabled={!canPlay || frameNo === 1 || undefined}
              aria-label={canPlay && frameNo && frameNo > 1 ? `Back one frame, to frame ${frameNo - 1}` : "Back one frame"}><FrameBackGlyph /></button>
            <button type="button" className={iconBtn} onClick={() => stepFrame(1)} aria-disabled={!canPlay || frameNo === totalFrames || undefined}
              aria-label={canPlay && frameNo && frameNo < totalFrames ? `Forward one frame, to frame ${frameNo + 1}` : "Forward one frame"}><FrameFwdGlyph /></button>
          </>
        )}
        <span className="ml-1 flex-1 whitespace-nowrap">{timeText}{fps && canPlay && frameNo ? <span className="hidden sm:inline"> · frame {frameNo}</span> : null}</span>
        {/* The secondary toggles wrap together onto their own line when space runs out. */}
        <span className="ml-auto flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
          <button type="button" className={iconBtn} onClick={() => setLoop((l) => !l)} aria-pressed={loop} aria-label="Loop"><LoopIcon width={18} height={18} aria-hidden /></button>
          <button type="button" className={iconBtn} onClick={toggleMute} aria-pressed={hasAudio ? muted : undefined} aria-disabled={!hasAudio || undefined}
            aria-label={hasAudio ? "Mute" : "No sound in this clip"} title={hasAudio ? undefined : "No sound in this clip"}><SoundGlyph off={muted} /></button>
          {hasCaptions && (
            <button type="button" className={iconBtn} onClick={() => setCaptionsOn((c) => !c)} aria-pressed={captionsOn} aria-label="Captions"><CaptionsGlyph /></button>
          )}
          {canFull && <button type="button" className={iconBtn} onClick={fullscreen} aria-label="Full screen"><FullGlyph /></button>}
        </span>
      </div>

      {showFrameActions && (
        <div role="group" aria-label={`Actions for the paused frame${frameNo ? `, frame ${frameNo}` : ""}`}
          className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-field bg-sunken px-3 py-2 motion-safe:animate-fade">
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-full text-small text-fg-muted tabular-nums sm:basis-auto">
            Paused at {formatMediaTime(time)}{frameNo ? `, frame ${frameNo}` : ""}
          </span>
          {frameActions!.map((a) => (
            <Button key={a.id} size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={a.icon} className="pointer-coarse:h-11"
              onClick={() => onFrameAction?.(a.id, timeRef.current, fps ? frameAt(timeRef.current, fps) : undefined)}>
              {a.label}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {transcript && (
        <Collapsible header={<span className="text-small font-medium text-fg">Transcript</span>} className="border-t border-line pt-2">
          <div className="pt-2 pl-6 text-compact text-fg">{transcript}</div>
        </Collapsible>
      )}
      <Collapsible header={<span className="text-small font-medium text-fg">Keyboard shortcuts</span>} className={cn(!transcript && "border-t border-line pt-2")}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 pt-2 pl-6 text-small text-fg-muted">
          <p>These work while focus is inside the player, and never while typing.</p>
          <ul className="grid gap-1 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <li className="flex items-center gap-2"><Kbd>Space</Kbd><Kbd>K</Kbd> Play or pause</li>
            <li className="flex items-center gap-2"><Kbd>←</Kbd><Kbd>→</Kbd> Back or forward 1 second</li>
            {fps && <li className="flex items-center gap-2"><Kbd>,</Kbd><Kbd>.</Kbd> or Shift with an arrow: one frame</li>}
            <li className="flex items-center gap-2"><Kbd>Home</Kbd><Kbd>End</Kbd> Start or end</li>
            <li className="flex items-center gap-2"><Kbd>M</Kbd> Mute</li>
            {hasCaptions && <li className="flex items-center gap-2"><Kbd>C</Kbd> Captions</li>}
          </ul>
          <Switch checked={keysOn} onChange={setKeysOn} label="Single-key shortcuts">Single-key shortcuts (K, M, C, comma and period)</Switch>
        </div>
      </Collapsible>

      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{said}</span>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/molecules/VoiceCard.tsx

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, HistoryIcon, LockIcon, ShieldIcon, StopIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";

export type VoiceSource = "builtIn" | "designed" | "cloned" | "library";
export type VoiceConsent = "self-verified" | "licensed" | "none";
export type VoiceStatus = "available" | "withdrawing" | "withdrawn" | "locked";
export type PreviewState = "idle" | "loading" | "playing" | "error";

export interface VoicePreview {
  state: PreviewState;
  /** Starts the sample, or stops it when it is loading or playing. */
  onToggle: () => void;
  /** Seconds played so far, for the readout while playing. */
  elapsed?: number;
  /** Length of the sample in seconds. */
  duration?: number;
}

export interface VoiceCardProps {
  name: string;
  /** One short line about how it sounds, for example "Warm, unhurried, good for long reads". */
  description?: string;
  /** Short tags such as accent, age range or use case. */
  tags?: string[];
  /** Where the voice came from. Built in, designed from a description, cloned from a recording, or shared in a library. */
  source: VoiceSource;
  /** Person the voice belongs to. For a cloned voice, leave it out when it is the person's own voice. */
  owner?: string;
  /** How the owner agreed. "none" on a cloned voice asks the person to verify it. */
  consent?: VoiceConsent;
  /** The sample player. Never starts by itself. */
  preview?: VoicePreview;
  status?: VoiceStatus;
  /** Date the voice stops working, already written out by your code, for example "3 March 2027". Shown when withdrawing. */
  withdrawsOn?: string;
  /** Why a locked voice cannot be chosen, for example "Needs the Studio plan". */
  lockedReason?: string;
  /** Shows the card as chosen. Only with onSelect. */
  selected?: boolean;
  /** Makes the card a radio. Leave out for a card that only plays its sample. */
  onSelect?: () => void;
  /** Radio group name. VoicePicker sets it. */
  groupName?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const sourceText: Record<VoiceSource, string> = { builtIn: "Built in", designed: "Designed", cloned: "Cloned", library: "From the library" };

/** "0:07" for seven seconds. */
export const formatSeconds = (s: number) => {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.floor(s));
  return `${Math.floor(t / 60)}:${String(t % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
};

function ownershipLine(source: VoiceSource, owner?: string, consent?: VoiceConsent): { text: string; needsYou?: boolean } | null {
  if (source === "cloned") {
    if (consent === "none") return { text: owner ? `Cloned from ${owner}. Not verified yet` : "Not verified yet. Verify it to use it", needsYou: true };
    if (!owner) return { text: "Your voice, verified" };
    return { text: consent === "licensed" ? `${owner}'s voice, licensed` : `${owner}'s voice, verified` };
  }
  if (source === "library" && owner) return { text: consent === "licensed" ? `Shared by ${owner}, licensed` : `Shared by ${owner}` };
  if (owner) return { text: `Made by ${owner}` };
  return null;
}

/** Three small bars that move only while the sample plays. Under reduced motion they hold still at mid height. */
function PreviewBars({ playing, tick }: { playing: boolean; tick: number }) {
  const shape = [0.5, 0.9, 0.65, 0.8];
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="flex h-4 items-center gap-0.5">
      {shape.map((h, i) => {
        const live = playing ? 0.35 + (((tick + i * 3) * 37) % 65) / 100 : h * 0.5;
        return (
          <span key={i} style={{ ["--lvl" as string]: String(live) }}
            className="h-4 w-0.5 origin-center scale-y-50 rounded-full bg-fg-muted motion-safe:scale-y-(--lvl) motion-safe:transition-transform motion-safe:duration-(--dur-fast)" />
        );
      })}
    </span>
  );
}

const PlayGlyph = (p: { className?: string }) => (
  <svg aria-hidden width={16} height={16} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" className={p.className}><path d="M8 5.5v13a1 1 0 0 0 1.5.9l10.2-6.5a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.7L9.5 4.6A1 1 0 0 0 8 5.5z" /></svg>
);

/**
 * One voice: its name, how it sounds, who it belongs to and whether it can be used, with a sample button.
 * Choosing the voice and playing its sample are separate controls. Give it onSelect to make it a radio inside VoicePicker.
 */
export function VoiceCard({
  name, description, tags, source, owner, consent, preview, status = "available", withdrawsOn,
  lockedReason = "Not on your plan", selected = false, onSelect, groupName, className,
}: VoiceCardProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const own = ownershipLine(source, owner, consent);
  const withdrawn = status === "withdrawn";
  const locked = status === "locked";
  const blocked = withdrawn || locked;
  const pState = preview?.state ?? "idle";
  const busy = pState === "loading" || pState === "playing";
  const tick = Math.round((preview?.elapsed ?? 0) * 4);

  const previewLabel = pState === "playing" ? `Stop sample of ${name}` : pState === "loading" ? `Stop loading sample of ${name}`
    : pState === "error" ? `Try the sample of ${name} again` : `Play sample of ${name}`;
  // Said once per change of state, never per second.
  const announce = pState === "playing" ? `Playing sample of ${name}` : pState === "loading" ? `Loading sample of ${name}`
    : pState === "error" ? `The sample of ${name} did not load` : "";

  const statusLine: ReactNode =
    status === "withdrawing" ? <><HistoryIcon width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0" />{withdrawsOn ? `Available until ${withdrawsOn}` : "Being withdrawn by its owner"}</>
    : withdrawn ? <><XCircle />Withdrawn by its owner. No longer available</>
    : locked ? <><LockIcon width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0" />{lockedReason}</>
    : null;

  const heading = onSelect
    ? <label htmlFor={`${id}-r`} className={cn("text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg after:absolute after:inset-0 after:rounded-card after:content-['']", blocked ? "cursor-not-allowed" : "cursor-pointer")}>{name}</label>
    : <p className="text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">{name}</p>;

  return (
    <div className={cn(
      "relative flex items-start gap-3 rounded-card border bg-surface p-3 transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) ease-(--ease-out)",
      selected ? "border-fg" : "border-line", onSelect && !blocked && !selected && "hover:border-line-strong",
      "has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-2 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-accent",
      className,
    )}>
      {onSelect && (
        <span className="relative mt-0.5 inline-grid size-5 shrink-0 place-items-center">
          <input id={`${id}-r`} type="radio" name={groupName} checked={selected} disabled={blocked}
            aria-describedby={`${id}-d`} onChange={() => onSelect()}
            className={cn("peer size-5 appearance-none rounded-full border bg-surface outline-none transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) checked:border-accent forced-colors:border-[ButtonText] forced-colors:checked:border-[Highlight]",
              "border-line-strong", blocked ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-(--disabled-opacity)" : "cursor-pointer")} />
          <span aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute size-2.5 scale-0 rounded-full bg-accent transition-transform duration-(--dur-fast) peer-checked:scale-100 forced-colors:bg-[Highlight]" />
        </span>
      )}

      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1">
          {heading}
          {selected && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg"><CheckIcon width={12} height={12} />Selected</span>}
        </div>
        <div id={`${id}-d`} className={cn("mt-0.5 space-y-1", blocked && "text-fg-subtle")}>
          {description && <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">{description}</p>}
          <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            <Badge>{sourceText[source]}</Badge>
            {tags?.map((t) => <Badge key={t}>{t}</Badge>)}
          </p>
          {own && (
            <p className={cn("flex items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4.5", own.needsYou ? "text-warning-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>
              {own.needsYou ? <AlertIcon width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0" /> : <ShieldIcon width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0" />}{own.text}
            </p>
          )}
          {statusLine && <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">{statusLine}</p>}
          {withdrawn && selected && (
            <p className="rounded-control bg-warning-soft px-2 py-1 text-small leading-4.5 text-warning-fg">You are still on this voice. Pick another one.</p>
          )}
          {preview && pState !== "idle" && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-0.5 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted" aria-hidden>
              {pState === "loading" && <span>Loading sample…</span>}
              {pState === "error" && <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-danger-fg"><AlertIcon width={14} height={14} />Sample did not load</span>}
              {pState === "playing" && (
                <>
                  <PreviewBars playing tick={tick} />
                  <span className="tabular-nums">Playing {formatSeconds(preview.elapsed ?? 0)}{preview.duration ? ` of ${formatSeconds(preview.duration)}` : ""}</span>
                  {preview.duration ? (
                    <span className="h-1 min-w-8 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-line">
                      <span className="block h-full origin-left rounded-full bg-fg" style={{ transform: `scaleX(${Math.min(1, (preview.elapsed ?? 0) / preview.duration)})` }} />
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {preview && !withdrawn && (
        <button type="button" onClick={preview.onToggle} aria-label={previewLabel} title={previewLabel}
          className={cn("relative z-10 inline-flex size-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) pointer-coarse:size-11",
            busy ? "border-inverse bg-inverse text-inverse-fg" : "border-line bg-surface text-fg hover:bg-hover")}>
          {pState === "playing" ? <StopIcon width={14} height={14} />
            : pState === "loading" ? <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="size-4 motion-safe:animate-spin"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeOpacity="0.3" strokeWidth="3" /><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 0-9-9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>
            : pState === "error" ? <AlertIcon width={16} height={16} />
            : <PlayGlyph />}
        </button>
      )}
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{announce}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

const XCircle = () => (
  <svg aria-hidden width={14} height={14} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5} strokeLinecap="round" className="shrink-0"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" /><path d="M9 9l6 6M15 9l-6 6" /></svg>
);

/* ---------- simulated sample playback ---------- */

export interface SampleSpec {
  /** Length of the sample in seconds. */
  seconds: number;
  /** Makes the sample fail to load, to show the error state. */
  fails?: boolean;
}

export interface SamplePlayback {
  /** Voice whose sample is loading, playing or failed. Null when nothing is. */
  id: string | null;
  state: PreviewState;
  elapsed: number;
  /** Plays the sample for this id, or stops it if it is the one already going. Starting one stops any other. */
  toggle: (id: string, spec: SampleSpec) => void;
  stop: () => void;
  /** The preview prop for one card. */
  previewFor: (id: string, spec: SampleSpec) => VoicePreview;
}

/**
 * Stand-in for real audio: a short load, then a timer that counts up to the sample length. Only one sample plays at a time.
 * Swap it for your own player and pass the same preview shape to each card.
 */
export function useSimulatedSamples({ loadMs = 600, tickMs = 250 }: { loadMs?: number; tickMs?: number } = {}): SamplePlayback {
  const [id, setId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [state, setState] = useState<PreviewState>("idle");
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const timers = useRef<number[]>([]);
  const clear = () => { timers.current.forEach((t) => window.clearTimeout(t)); timers.current.forEach((t) => window.clearInterval(t)); timers.current = []; };
  useEffect(() => clear, []);

  const stop = useCallback(() => { clear(); setId(null); setState("idle"); setElapsed(0); }, []);

  const toggle = useCallback((next: string, spec: SampleSpec) => {
    if (next === id && (state === "loading" || state === "playing")) { stop(); return; }
    clear();
    setId(next); setState("loading"); setElapsed(0);
    timers.current.push(window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (spec.fails) { setState("error"); return; }
      setState("playing");
      let t = 0;
      const iv = window.setInterval(() => {
        t += tickMs / 1000;
        if (t >= spec.seconds) { clear(); setId(null); setState("idle"); setElapsed(0); return; }
        setElapsed(t);
      }, tickMs);
      timers.current.push(iv);
    }, loadMs));
  }, [id, state, stop, loadMs, tickMs]);

  const previewFor = (v: string, spec: SampleSpec): VoicePreview => ({
    state: v === id ? state : "idle",
    elapsed: v === id ? elapsed : 0,
    duration: spec.seconds,
    onToggle: () => toggle(v, spec),
  });

  return { id, state, elapsed, toggle, stop, previewFor };
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ActionDraft.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";
import { InlineEdit } from "../molecules/InlineEdit";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { useFocusAfter } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, RefreshIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface ActionDraftField {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  kind?: "text" | "number";
  editable?: boolean;
  /** Shown after the value, such as "shares". */
  unit?: string;
  /** A message in words. While any field has one, Confirm is disabled. */
  error?: string;
}
export interface ActionDraftStep {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  state: "pending" | "running" | "done" | "failed";
  detail?: string;
}
export type ActionDraftStatus = "draft" | "confirming" | "working" | "done" | "failed";

export interface ActionDraftProps {
  status: ActionDraftStatus;
  /** What will happen, in one line, such as "Buy 10 RELIANCE at market". */
  title: string;
  summary?: string;
  fields: ActionDraftField[];
  onFieldChange: (id: string, value: string) => void;
  /** Facts the app worked out, such as margin and charges. Read only. */
  rows?: { label: string; value: ReactNode }[];
  /** Progress once confirmed. */
  steps?: ActionDraftStep[];
  /** Shown when status is done. */
  result?: ReactNode;
  /** Shown in words when status is failed. */
  error?: string;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onDiscard: () => void;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  discardLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS: Record<ActionDraftStatus, { text: string; tone: "neutral" | "unsure" | "success" | "danger" }> = {
  draft: { text: "Draft", tone: "neutral" },
  confirming: { text: "Confirming", tone: "unsure" },
  working: { text: "In progress", tone: "unsure" },
  done: { text: "Done", tone: "success" },
  failed: { text: "Failed", tone: "danger" },
};

function StepIcon({ state }: { state: ActionDraftStep["state"] }) {
  const words = { pending: "Waiting", running: "In progress", done: "Done", failed: "Failed" }[state];
  return (
    <span className="mt-0.5 flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center" >
      {state === "pending" && <span aria-hidden className="size-3.5 rounded-full border border-line-strong forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]" />}
      {state === "running" && <RefreshIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="text-fg-muted motion-safe:animate-spin" />}
      {state === "done" && <CheckIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="text-success-fg" />}
      {state === "failed" && <XIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="text-danger-fg" />}
      <span className="sr-only">{words}. </span>
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * The draft an AI proposes. The person reads it, edits what is wrong in place and confirms. The same card then shows
 * progress and the result. Nothing runs until Confirm is pressed, and this part never confirms by itself.
 */
export function ActionDraft({ status, title, summary, fields, onFieldChange, rows, steps, result, error, onConfirm, onDiscard, confirmLabel = "Confirm", discardLabel = "Not now", className }: ActionDraftProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const titleId = `${uid}-title`, noteId = `${uid}-note`;
  const heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const originals = useRef<Record<string, string>>({});
  for (const f of fields) if (!(f.id in originals.current)) originals.current[f.id] = f.value;
  const arm = useFocusAfter(status, () => heading.current);

  const isDraft = status === "draft";
  const blocked = fields.some((f) => !!f.error);
  const s = STATUS[status];
  const running = steps?.find((x) => x.state === "running");
  const live = status === "working" ? `In progress${running ? `: ${running.label}` : ""}.` : status === "done" ? "Done." : status === "confirming" ? "Confirming." : "";

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={titleId} className={cn("flex w-full max-w-phone flex-col gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <h3 id={titleId} ref={heading} tabIndex={-1} className="text-lead leading-6 font-semibold text-fg">{title}</h3>
        <Badge tone={s.tone} className="shrink-0">
          {status === "done" && <CheckIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} />}
          {status === "failed" && <XIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} />}
          {(status === "working" || status === "confirming") && <RefreshIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} className="motion-safe:animate-spin" />}
          {s.text}
        </Badge>
      </div>
      {summary && <p className="text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{summary}</p>}

      <div>
        {fields.map((f) => {
          const shown = f.unit ? `${f.value} ${f.unit}` : f.value;
          const edited = f.value !== originals.current[f.id];
          return (
            <div key={f.id} className="border-b border-line last:border-b-0">
              {isDraft && f.editable ? (
                <InlineEdit label={f.label} value={f.value} display={shown} originalValue={originals.current[f.id]} inputMode={f.kind === "number" ? "decimal" : "text"}
                  onChange={(v) => onFieldChange(f.id, v)} className="border-b-0" />
              ) : (
                <div className="py-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{f.label}</span>
                    {edited && <span className="rounded-control bg-sunken px-2 py-0.5 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted forced-colors:border forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]">Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-lead leading-6 font-medium text-fg">{shown || <span className="font-normal text-fg-muted">Not set</span>}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              {f.error && <p className="-mt-1 pb-3 flex items-start gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-danger-fg"><AlertIcon className="mt-px shrink-0" width={14} height={14} />{f.error}</p>}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {rows && rows.length > 0 && (
        <dl className="m-0 flex flex-col gap-1.5 rounded-card bg-sunken p-3 text-body leading-5">
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <div key={r.label} className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
              <dt className="text-fg-muted">{r.label}</dt>
              <dd className="m-0 font-medium text-fg tabular-nums">{r.value}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}

      {!isDraft && steps && steps.length > 0 && (
        <ol className="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
          {steps.map((x) => (
            <li key={x.id} className="flex items-start gap-2.5 text-body leading-5">
              <StepIcon state={x.state} />
              <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                <span className={cn("text-fg", x.state === "pending" && "text-fg-muted")}>{x.label}</span>
                {x.detail && <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{x.detail}</span>}
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )}

      {status === "done" && result != null && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-card bg-success-soft p-3 text-body leading-5 text-success-fg">
          <CheckIcon aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" width={16} height={16} />
          <div className="min-w-0">{result}</div>
        </div>
      )}
      {status === "failed" && (
        <div role="alert" className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-card bg-danger-soft p-3 text-body leading-5 text-danger-fg">
          <AlertIcon aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" width={16} height={16} />
          <p className="min-w-0">{error ?? "Something went wrong."}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {(isDraft || status === "confirming") && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <p id={noteId} className="text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">
            {status === "confirming" ? "Confirming. Please wait." : blocked ? "Fix the fields marked above to continue." : "Nothing happens until you confirm."}
          </p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button size="lg" className="flex-1 pointer-coarse:h-12" aria-describedby={noteId} disabled={!isDraft || blocked}
              leading={status === "confirming" ? <Spinner size={16} label="Confirming" /> : undefined} onClick={() => { arm(); onConfirm(); }}>
              {confirmLabel}
            </Button>
            <Button size="lg" variant="secondary" className="flex-1 pointer-coarse:h-12" disabled={!isDraft} onClick={() => { arm(); onDiscard(); }}>
              {discardLabel}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{live}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ActionLog.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, HistoryIcon, UndoIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { ApprovedByMark, type ApprovedBy } from "../atoms/ApprovedByMark";
import { Badge, type Tone } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";

export type ActionStatus = "done" | "failed" | "undone" | "waiting";

export interface ActionLogItem {
  id: string;
  /** What was done, in plain words, such as "Moved 12 files to Archive". */
  action: string;
  /** Who did it, such as "Travel helper". */
  actor: string;
  status: ActionStatus;
  /** When, as text, such as "10:42" or "2 minutes ago". */
  time: string;
  approvedBy?: ApprovedBy;
  /** Minutes left to undo. Omit when it was never undoable and give notUndoableReason instead. 0 means the time is over. */
  undoMinutes?: number;
  /** Why this cannot be undone, such as "The email was already sent." */
  notUndoableReason?: string;
}

export interface ActionLogLabels {
  filter?: string;
  all?: string;
  done?: string;
  failed?: string;
  undone?: string;
  waiting?: string;
  undo?: string;
  empty?: string;
  cannotUndo?: string;
  undoEnded?: string;
  /** Receives the minutes left. */
  undoFor?: (minutes: number) => string;
}

export interface ActionLogProps {
  items: ActionLogItem[];
  /** Called when the person presses Undo. The row then shows Undone. */
  onUndo?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Starting filter. */
  defaultFilter?: ActionStatus | "all";
  labels?: ActionLogLabels;
  className?: string;
}

const tone: Record<ActionStatus, Tone> = { done: "success", failed: "danger", undone: "neutral", waiting: "info" };
const statusIcon: Record<ActionStatus, ReactNode> = {
  done: <CheckIcon width={11} height={11} />, failed: <XIcon width={11} height={11} />,
  undone: <UndoIcon width={11} height={11} />, waiting: <HistoryIcon width={11} height={11} />,
};
const statuses: ActionStatus[] = ["done", "failed", "undone", "waiting"];

/** Lasting record of what an agent did. Each row shows who did it, how it ended, who approved it, and Undo while time remains. */
export function ActionLog({ items, onUndo, defaultFilter = "all", labels, className }: ActionLogProps) {
  const l = {
    filter: "Show actions", all: "All", done: "Done", failed: "Failed", undone: "Undone", waiting: "Waiting", undo: "Undo",
    empty: "No actions match this filter.", cannotUndo: "Can't be undone", undoEnded: "Undo time is over",
    undoFor: (m: number) => `Undo for ${m} more ${m === 1 ? "minute" : "minutes"}`, ...labels,
  };
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<ActionStatus | "all">(defaultFilter);
  const [undoneIds, setUndoneIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const uid = useId();
  const rows = items.map((i) => (undoneIds.includes(i.id) ? { ...i, status: "undone" as const } : i));
  const count = (s: ActionStatus) => rows.filter((r) => r.status === s).length;
  const shown = filter === "all" ? rows : rows.filter((r) => r.status === filter);
  const summary = `${rows.length} ${rows.length === 1 ? "action" : "actions"}: ${statuses.filter((s) => count(s) > 0).map((s) => `${count(s)} ${l[s].toLowerCase()}`).join(", ") || "none yet"}`;
  const name = (s: ActionStatus) => l[s];

  const undo = (r: ActionLogItem) => {
    setUndoneIds((x) => [...x, r.id]);
    setMessage(`Undone: ${r.action}`);
    onUndo?.(r.id);
  };
  const choose = (v: ActionStatus | "all") => {
    setFilter(v);
    const n = v === "all" ? rows.length : rows.filter((r) => r.status === v).length;
    setMessage(`${n} ${n === 1 ? "action" : "actions"} shown`);
  };

  return (
    <section aria-label="Action log" className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
        <p className="min-w-0 text-body leading-5 font-medium">{summary}</p>
        <div className="max-w-full overflow-x-auto">
          <SegmentedControl size="sm" label={l.filter} value={filter} onChange={choose}
            options={[{ value: "all", label: `${l.all} ${rows.length}` }, ...statuses.map((s) => ({ value: s, label: `${l[s]} ${count(s)}` }))]} />
        </div>
      </div>
      {shown.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-3 text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.empty}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
          {shown.map((r) => (
            <li key={r.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-x-3 gap-y-2 rounded-card border border-line px-3 py-2.5">
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-48">
                <p className="text-body leading-5 break-words">{r.action}</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
                  <span>{r.actor}</span><span aria-hidden>·</span><span>{r.time}</span>
                </p>
                {r.approvedBy && <ApprovedByMark by={r.approvedBy} className="mt-1" />}
              </div>
              <div className="ml-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <Badge tone={tone[r.status]}>{statusIcon[r.status]}{name(r.status)}</Badge>
                {r.status === "done" && (
                  r.notUndoableReason ? (
                    <p id={`${uid}-${r.id}`} className="flex max-w-56 items-start gap-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
                      <AlertIcon width={13} height={13} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" /><span><span className="font-medium text-fg">{l.cannotUndo}.</span> {r.notUndoableReason}</span>
                    </p>
                  ) : r.undoMinutes && r.undoMinutes > 0 ? (
                    <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<UndoIcon width={13} height={13} />} onClick={() => undo(r)} aria-label={`${l.undo}: ${r.action}. ${l.undoFor(r.undoMinutes)}`}>{l.undoFor(r.undoMinutes)}</Button>
                  ) : r.undoMinutes === 0 ? (
                    <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{l.undoEnded}</span>
                  ) : null
                )}
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{message}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ActivityTrace.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon, ChevronIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";

export type TraceActor = "ai" | "rule" | "calculated" | "check" | "you";
export type TraceStatus = "pending" | "running" | "done" | "failed";

export interface TraceStep {
  id: string;
  actor: TraceActor;
  title: string;
  detail?: ReactNode;
  /** Default "done". */
  status?: TraceStatus;
}

export interface ActivityTraceProps {
  steps: TraceStep[];
  /** True while steps are still arriving. The list stays open and each new row is announced. */
  streaming?: boolean;
  /** The one line shown when folded, such as "Read your message · 8 steps". */
  summary: string;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Rename the tags, for another language or wording. */
  actorLabels?: Partial<Record<TraceActor, string>>;
  className?: string;
}

const defaultLabels: Record<TraceActor, string> = { ai: "AI", rule: "Rule sheet", calculated: "Calculated", check: "Safety check", you: "You" };
const statusWords: Record<TraceStatus, string> = { pending: "Waiting", running: "Running", done: "Done", failed: "Failed" };

function StatusIcon({ status }: { status: TraceStatus }) {
  return (
    <span className="mt-0.5 flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
      {status === "running" ? (
        <svg aria-hidden width={16} height={16} viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="text-fg-muted motion-safe:animate-spin">
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeOpacity="0.25" strokeWidth="3" />
          <path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 0-9-9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" />
        </svg>
      ) : status === "done" ? <CheckIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="text-success-fg" />
        : status === "failed" ? <XIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="text-danger-fg" />
        : <span aria-hidden className="size-2.5 rounded-full border border-line-strong forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]" />}
      <span className="sr-only">{statusWords[status]}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * The agent's work shown step by step, then folded into one line. Each step carries a tag that says who did it:
 * AI (a judgment that can be wrong), Rule sheet (looked up and checked), Calculated (done by code), Safety check
 * (a guardrail), or You. While streaming the list is open; when the work is done the parent sets streaming to false and the person can fold it.
 */
export function ActivityTrace({ steps, streaming, summary, defaultOpen = false, open, onOpenChange, actorLabels, className }: ActivityTraceProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const [inner, setInner] = useState(defaultOpen);
  const isOpen = streaming || (open ?? inner);
  const labels = { ...defaultLabels, ...actorLabels };
  const toggle = () => { if (streaming) return; const v = !isOpen; if (open === undefined) setInner(v); onOpenChange?.(v); };

  // Announce each new step once. The first render is not announced, so a trace that mounts full stays quiet.
  const seen = useRef(steps.length);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    if (steps.length > seen.current && streaming) { const s = steps[steps.length - 1]; setSaid(`${labels[s.actor]}: ${s.title}`); }
    seen.current = steps.length;
    // labels is rebuilt each render; steps.length is the real trigger.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [steps.length, streaming]);

  return (
    <div className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface", className)}>
      <button type="button" aria-expanded={isOpen} aria-controls={`${uid}-list`} aria-disabled={streaming || undefined} onClick={toggle}
        className={cn("flex min-h-10 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-card px-4 py-2 text-left text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted pointer-coarse:min-h-11", streaming ? "cursor-default" : "cursor-pointer hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg")}>
        <ChevronIcon aria-hidden className={cn("shrink-0 text-fg-subtle transition-transform duration-[var(--dur-fast)]", isOpen && "rotate-90")} />
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 break-words">{summary}</span>
      </button>
      {isOpen && (
        <ol id={`${uid}-list`} className="m-0 list-none space-y-3 border-t border-line px-4 py-3">
          {steps.map((s) => {
            const status = s.status ?? "done";
            return (
              <li key={s.id} className={cn("flex gap-3", streaming && "motion-safe:animate-rise")}>
                <StatusIcon status={status} />
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-body leading-5">
                    <span className={cn("font-medium break-words", status === "pending" && "text-fg-muted", status === "failed" && "text-danger-fg")}>{s.title}</span>
                    <Badge tone={s.actor === "ai" ? "accent" : "neutral"}>{labels[s.actor]}</Badge>
                    {status === "failed" && <span className="text-small leading-4 text-danger-fg">Failed</span>}
                  </p>
                  {s.detail && <div className="mt-0.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted break-words">{s.detail}</div>}
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      )}
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{said}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
