## tattva/organisms/ChartLegend.tsx

```tsx
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export type MarkerShape = "circle" | "square" | "triangle" | "diamond";

export interface SeriesStyle {
  /** CSS color value, a chart token such as var(--chart-1). */
  color: string;
  /** Marker drawn at line ends and in the legend. */
  shape: MarkerShape;
  /** SVG stroke-dasharray for lines. Undefined means solid. */
  dash?: string;
}

/**
 * Fixed series order. Colors are assigned by position and never cycled. From the third series on, a dash pattern
 * and a marker shape repeat the color so identity never rests on hue alone. Dotted lines are kept for projections.
 */
export const SERIES_STYLES: SeriesStyle[] = [
  { color: "var(--chart-1)", shape: "circle" },
  { color: "var(--chart-2)", shape: "circle" },
  { color: "var(--chart-3)", shape: "square", dash: "9 4" },
  { color: "var(--chart-4)", shape: "triangle", dash: "9 4 2 4" },
  { color: "var(--chart-5)", shape: "diamond", dash: "14 4" },
];
/** Color used for "Other" and context series. */
export const NEUTRAL_STYLE: SeriesStyle = { color: "var(--chart-neutral)", shape: "circle" };

/** Style for series at index i. Index 5 and beyond is not defined: fold the tail into Other. */
export function seriesStyle(i: number): SeriesStyle {
  return SERIES_STYLES[Math.min(i, SERIES_STYLES.length - 1)];
}

/** Path for a marker of the given shape centred on cx, cy. r is the half size (use 4 or more for an 8px marker). */
export function markerPath(shape: MarkerShape, cx: number, cy: number, r: number): string {
  switch (shape) {
    case "square": return `M${cx - r} ${cy - r}h${2 * r}v${2 * r}h${-2 * r}z`;
    case "triangle": return `M${cx} ${cy - r * 1.15}L${cx + r * 1.1} ${cy + r * 0.85}L${cx - r * 1.1} ${cy + r * 0.85}z`;
    case "diamond": return `M${cx} ${cy - r * 1.25}L${cx + r * 1.25} ${cy}L${cx} ${cy + r * 1.25}L${cx - r * 1.25} ${cy}z`;
    default: return `M${cx - r} ${cy}a${r} ${r} 0 1 0 ${2 * r} 0a${r} ${r} 0 1 0 ${-2 * r} 0z`;
  }
}

export interface SeriesMarkProps {
  shape: MarkerShape;
  cx: number;
  cy: number;
  color: string;
  /** Half size in px. Default 4.5, which gives a 9px marker. */
  r?: number;
  /** Hollow marker: surface fill with a colored outline. Used for provisional values. */
  hollow?: boolean;
}

/** Marker with a 2px surface ring so it stays legible where it crosses a line. Use inside an svg. */
export function SeriesMark({ shape, cx, cy, color, r = 4.5, hollow }: SeriesMarkProps) {
  const d = markerPath(shape, cx, cy, r);
  if (hollow) {
    return (<g><path d={d} fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--surface)" strokeWidth={5} strokeLinejoin="round" /><path d={d} fill="var(--surface)" stroke={color} strokeWidth={2} strokeLinejoin="round" /></g>);
  }
  return <path d={d} fill={color} stroke="var(--surface)" strokeWidth={2} paintOrder="stroke" strokeLinejoin="round" />;
}

export interface LegendItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** Overrides the style taken from the item's position. */
  style?: SeriesStyle;
}

export interface ChartLegendProps {
  /** Items in the same order as the chart's series or stack. */
  items: LegendItem[];
  /** "line" shows the dash and marker. "bar" shows a rounded swatch. */
  kind?: "line" | "bar";
  /** Ids currently hidden. Only used when onToggle is set. */
  hidden?: string[];
  /** Makes items toggle buttons. Pressed means the series is shown. */
  onToggle?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Accessible name for the group. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

function Key({ style, kind }: { style: SeriesStyle; kind: "line" | "bar" }) {
  if (kind === "bar") return <span aria-hidden className="inline-block h-2.5 w-4 shrink-0 rounded-xs" style={{ background: style.color }} />;
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden width={26} height={12} viewBox="0 0 26 12" className="shrink-0">
      <line x1={1} y1={6} x2={25} y2={6} stroke={style.color} strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray={style.dash} strokeLinecap="butt" />
      <SeriesMark shape={style.shape} cx={13} cy={6} color={style.color} r={4} />
    </svg>
  );
}

/**
 * Legend that defines every visual property: color, dash and marker for lines, color for bars. Order matches the
 * chart. Items become toggle buttons (aria-pressed) when onToggle is given. Render it for two or more series only.
 */
export function ChartLegend({ items, kind = "line", hidden = [], onToggle, label = "Legend", className }: ChartLegendProps) {
  return (
    <ul aria-label={label} className={cn("m-0 mb-2 flex list-none flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 p-0", className)}>
      {items.map((it, i) => {
        const st = it.style ?? seriesStyle(i);
        const off = hidden.includes(it.id);
        const inner = (<><Key style={st} kind={kind} /><span className={cn("text-small leading-5", off ? "text-fg-subtle line-through" : "text-fg-muted")}>{it.label}</span></>);
        return (
          <li key={it.id}>
            {onToggle ? (
              <button type="button" aria-pressed={!off} onClick={() => onToggle(it.id)}
                className={cn("inline-flex min-h-6 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control px-1.5 hover:bg-hover tap", off && "opacity-70")}>
                {inner}<span className="sr-only">{off ? "hidden" : "shown"}</span>
              </button>
            ) : (
              <span className="inline-flex min-h-6 items-center gap-1.5">{inner}</span>
            )}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/CheckpointList.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useFocusReturn } from "../lib/focus";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export type RestoreMode = "everything" | "conversation" | "work";

export interface Checkpoint {
  id: string;
  /** The prompt that created this checkpoint. */
  prompt: string;
  /** Relative time, for example "12 min ago". */
  time: string;
  /** Number of files changed since the previous checkpoint. */
  files: number;
}

export interface CheckpointListProps {
  /** Newest first or oldest first, rendered in the order given. */
  checkpoints: Checkpoint[];
  /** Id of the checkpoint the work is at now. It is marked and has no actions. */
  currentId?: string;
  /** Called after the person confirms a restore. */
  onRestore?: (id: string, mode: RestoreMode) => void;
  /** Called when Summarize from here is chosen. It runs without a confirm step. */
  onSummarize?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Slot for what the checkpoints do not cover, such as untracked changes. */
  limitations?: ReactNode;
  /** Overrides for any visible label. */
  labels?: Partial<Record<RestoreMode | "summarize" | "confirm" | "cancel" | "current" | "rewind", string>>;
  /** Words for the change count, for example `(n) => `${n} edits``. Defaults to a file count. */
  changeLabel?: (count: number) => string;
  className?: string;
}

const defaults = { everything: "Restore everything", conversation: "Restore conversation only", work: "Restore work only", summarize: "Summarize from here", confirm: "Confirm restore", cancel: "Cancel", current: "Current", rewind: "Rewind" };
const warnings: Record<RestoreMode, string> = {
  everything: "This replaces your work and the conversation with how they were at this point. Later changes are removed.",
  conversation: "This removes the messages after this point. Your work stays as it is.",
  work: "This replaces your work with how it was at this point. The conversation stays as it is.",
};

/** Rewind list with one row per earlier prompt. A destructive restore needs an inline confirm. */
export function CheckpointList({ checkpoints, currentId, onRestore, onSummarize, limitations, labels, changeLabel, className }: CheckpointListProps) {
  const t = { ...defaults, ...labels };
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<RestoreMode | null>(null);
  const close = () => { setOpen(null); setPending(null); };
  const modes: RestoreMode[] = ["everything", "conversation", "work"];
  // Focus follows the choices: into the confirm step when a restore is picked, back to that choice on Cancel, and
  // back to the row's Rewind button (or the row, if it became the current one) after a restore or a summary.
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const rows = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLLIElement>());
  const last = useRef<{ id: string; mode: RestoreMode | null } | null>(null);
  useFocusReturn(`${open}|${pending}|${currentId}`, root, () => {
    const at = last.current; if (!at) return null;
    const row = rows.current.get(at.id);
    if (open === at.id && pending) return row?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="group"]');
    if (open === at.id && at.mode) return row?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-mode="${at.mode}"]`);
    return row?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("button[aria-expanded]") ?? row;
  });

  return (
    <div ref={root} className={cn("space-y-3", className)}>
      <ol className="divide-y divide-line rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
        {checkpoints.map((c) => {
          const current = c.id === currentId;
          const expanded = open === c.id;
          return (
            <li key={c.id} ref={(n) => { if (n) rows.current.set(c.id, n); else rows.current.delete(c.id); }} tabIndex={-1} className="px-4 py-3 outline-offset-[-2px]" aria-current={current ? "step" : undefined}>
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p title={typeof c.prompt === "string" ? c.prompt : undefined} className="truncate text-body leading-5 text-fg">{c.prompt}</p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{c.time} · {changeLabel ? changeLabel(c.files) : c.files === 1 ? "1 file changed" : `${c.files} files changed`}</p>
                </div>
                {current ? <Badge tone="accent">{t.current}</Badge> : (
                  <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" aria-expanded={expanded} onClick={() => (expanded ? close() : (setOpen(c.id), setPending(null)))}>{t.rewind}</Button>
                )}
              </div>
              {expanded && !current && (
                <div className="mt-3 space-y-3 rounded-card bg-sunken p-3">
                  {pending === null ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {modes.map((m) => (
                        <Button key={m} size="sm" variant="secondary" data-mode={m} disabled={m === "work" && c.files === 0} onClick={() => { last.current = { id: c.id, mode: m }; setPending(m); }}>{t[m]}</Button>
                      ))}
                      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { last.current = { id: c.id, mode: null }; onSummarize?.(c.id); close(); }}>{t.summarize}</Button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div role="group" tabIndex={-1} aria-label={t[pending]} className="space-y-2 outline-offset-4">
                      <p className="text-body leading-5 text-fg">{t[pending]}? <span className="text-fg-muted">{warnings[pending]}</span></p>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <Button size="sm" variant="danger" onClick={() => { last.current = { id: c.id, mode: null }; onRestore?.(c.id, pending); close(); }}>{t.confirm}</Button>
                        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setPending(null)}>{t.cancel}</Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      {limitations && <div className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{limitations}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/CommandPalette.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { SearchIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Kbd } from "../atoms/Kbd";

export interface PaletteCommand {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** Heading the command is listed under. Commands without one sit above the headings. */
  group?: string;
  /** Short helper text under the label. */
  hint?: string;
  icon?: ReactNode;
  /** Shown as a key hint. Display only: your app wires the real shortcut. */
  shortcut?: string;
  /** Extra words that should find this command. */
  keywords?: string[];
  disabled?: boolean;
  onSelect: () => void;
}

export interface CommandPaletteProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  commands: PaletteCommand[];
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Shown when nothing matches. */
  emptyText?: string;
  /** Required. Accessible name for the dialog and the search field. */
  label: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Lower is better. -1 means no match. Subsequence: the letters appear in order, not necessarily next to each other. */
function rank(c: PaletteCommand, q: string): number {
  const label = c.label.toLowerCase();
  if (label.startsWith(q)) return 0;
  if (label.includes(q)) return 1;
  const sub = (s: string) => { let i = 0; for (const ch of s) if (ch === q[i]) i += 1; return i === q.length; };
  if (sub(label)) return 2;
  const rest = [c.group ?? "", ...(c.keywords ?? [])].join(" ").toLowerCase();
  if (rest.includes(q)) return 3;
  return sub(`${label} ${rest}`) ? 4 : -1;
}

function filter(commands: PaletteCommand[], raw: string): PaletteCommand[] {
  const q = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return commands;
  return commands.map((c, i) => ({ c, i, r: rank(c, q) })).filter((x) => x.r >= 0).sort((a, b) => a.r - b.r || a.i - b.i).map((x) => x.c);
}

/** Groups in order of first appearance. Commands with no group come first, without a heading. */
function groupUp(list: PaletteCommand[]): { name: string; items: PaletteCommand[] }[] {
  const m = new Map<string, PaletteCommand[]>();
  for (const c of list) m.set(c.group ?? "", [...(m.get(c.group ?? "") ?? []), c]);
  return [...m].map(([name, items]) => ({ name, items })).sort((a, b) => Number(a.name !== "") - Number(b.name !== ""));
}

/**
 * Searchable list of actions in a modal window (native <dialog>). The search field is a combobox and focus stays
 * in it while the arrow keys move through the options. It adds no keyboard shortcut of its own: your app decides how it opens.
 */
export function CommandPalette({ open, onClose, commands, placeholder = "Type a command…", emptyText = "No matching commands", label, className }: CommandPaletteProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const opener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const openRef = useRef(open);
  openRef.current = open;

  useEffect(() => {
    const d = ref.current;
    if (!d || !open) return;
    opener.current = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
    if (!d.open) d.showModal();
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const prevOverflow = root.style.overflow;
    root.style.overflow = "hidden";
    d.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="combobox"]')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    return () => {
      root.style.overflow = prevOverflow;
      if (d.open) d.close();
      const back = opener.current;
      if (back && back.isConnected) back.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      opener.current = null;
    };
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <dialog ref={ref} aria-label={label}
      onCancel={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); onClose(); }}
      onClose={() => { if (openRef.current) onClose(); }}
      onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}
      className="fixed inset-0 m-0 h-full max-h-none w-full max-w-none items-start justify-center bg-transparent p-0 text-fg backdrop:bg-(--scrim) open:flex">
      {/* Mounted only while open, so the search text and the active option start fresh each time. */}
      {open && <Body commands={commands} placeholder={placeholder} emptyText={emptyText} label={label} onClose={onClose} className={className} />}
    </dialog>
  );
}

function Body({ commands, placeholder, emptyText, label, onClose, className }: Required<Pick<CommandPaletteProps, "commands" | "placeholder" | "emptyText" | "label" | "onClose">> & { className?: string }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const uid = useId();
  const list = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const flatGroups = useMemo(() => groupUp(filter(commands, q)), [commands, q]);
  const flat = useMemo(() => flatGroups.flatMap((g) => g.items), [flatGroups]);
  const enabled = flat.filter((c) => !c.disabled);
  const active = enabled.find((c) => c.id === activeId) ?? enabled[0];
  const optId = (c: PaletteCommand) => `${uid}-o${flat.indexOf(c)}`;

  useEffect(() => {
    // Scroll the list itself rather than calling scrollIntoView, which can also scroll the page.
    const box = list.current;
    const el = active ? box?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[id="${optId(active)}"]`) : null;
    if (!box || !el) return;
    if (el.offsetTop - 32 < box.scrollTop) box.scrollTop = Math.max(0, el.offsetTop - 32);
    else if (el.offsetTop + el.offsetHeight > box.scrollTop + box.clientHeight) box.scrollTop = el.offsetTop + el.offsetHeight - box.clientHeight + 8;
  });

  const run = (c: PaletteCommand) => { if (c.disabled) return; onClose(); c.onSelect(); };
  const move = (to: "next" | "prev" | "first" | "last") => {
    if (!enabled.length) return;
    const i = active ? enabled.indexOf(active) : 0;
    const n = to === "first" ? 0 : to === "last" ? enabled.length - 1 : to === "next" ? (i + 1) % enabled.length : (i - 1 + enabled.length) % enabled.length;
    setActiveId(enabled[n].id);
  };
  const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    const map: Record<string, "next" | "prev" | "first" | "last"> = { ArrowDown: "next", ArrowUp: "prev", Home: "first", End: "last" };
    if (map[e.key]) { e.preventDefault(); move(map[e.key]); }
    else if (e.key === "Enter" && active) { e.preventDefault(); run(active); }
  };

  const count = flat.length;
  return (
    <div className={cn("mx-3 mt-3 flex max-h-[calc(100dvh-1.5rem)] w-full max-w-xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-overlay border border-line bg-raised shadow-lg motion-safe:animate-rise sm:mt-[10dvh] sm:max-h-[min(30rem,80dvh)] forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-line px-4">
        <SearchIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="shrink-0 text-fg-subtle" />
        <input value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={onKey} placeholder={placeholder} aria-label={label}
          role="combobox" aria-expanded={count > 0} aria-controls={`${uid}-list`} aria-autocomplete="list" aria-activedescendant={active ? optId(active) : undefined}
          autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false}
          className="h-14 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-lead leading-6 text-fg placeholder:text-fg-subtle focus-visible:outline-none" />
        <Kbd className="shrink-0 max-sm:hidden"><span aria-hidden>Esc</span></Kbd>
      </div>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{q.trim() ? `${count} result${count === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : ""}</p>
      <div ref={list} id={`${uid}-list`} role="listbox" aria-label={label} className="relative min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-2">
        {count === 0 && <p className="px-3 py-8 text-center text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{emptyText}</p>}
        {flatGroups.map((g, gi) => {
          const options = g.items.map((c) => (
            <div key={c.id} id={optId(c)} role="option" aria-selected={c === active} aria-disabled={c.disabled || undefined}
              onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
              onMouseMove={() => { if (!c.disabled && c !== active) setActiveId(c.id); }}
              onClick={() => run(c)}
              className={cn("flex min-h-9 cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-body leading-5 pointer-coarse:min-h-11 forced-colors:border forced-colors:border-transparent",
                c === active && "bg-hover forced-colors:border-[Highlight]", c.disabled && "cursor-not-allowed opacity-(--disabled-opacity)")}>
              {c.icon && <span aria-hidden className="shrink-0 text-fg-subtle">{c.icon}</span>}
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className="block truncate">{c.label}</span>
                {c.hint && <span className="block truncate text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{c.hint}</span>}
              </span>
              {c.shortcut && <Kbd className="shrink-0 max-sm:hidden">{c.shortcut}</Kbd>}
            </div>
          ));
          if (!g.name) return <div key="__none" className={cn(gi > 0 && "mt-1")}>{options}</div>;
          return (
            <div key={g.name} role="group" aria-labelledby={`${uid}-g${gi}`} className={cn(gi > 0 && "mt-1")}>
              <p id={`${uid}-g${gi}`} className="px-3 pt-2 pb-1 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted">{g.name}</p>
              {options}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ComparisonTable.tsx

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";

export interface ComparisonItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Short line under the name. */
  subtitle?: string;
  /** Marks this item with a visible text badge and a lime fill. */
  badge?: string;
}

export interface ComparisonRow {
  id: string;
  /** Attribute name. */
  label: string;
  /** One value per item, in the same order as `items`. */
  values: ReactNode[];
}

export interface ComparisonTableProps {
  /** Two to five items. Extras are ignored. */
  items: ComparisonItem[];
  rows: ComparisonRow[];
  /** Names the table. Visible to screen readers on the table and used as the heading of the stacked cards. */
  caption: string;
  /** Header text of the attribute column. */
  attributeLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Semantic comparison table for 2 to 5 items. Column headers are th scope=col, row headers are th scope=row.
 * Below the sm breakpoint (600px) it switches to one stacked card per item. Only one form is exposed at a time.
 */
export function ComparisonTable({ items, rows, caption, attributeLabel = "Attribute", className }: ComparisonTableProps) {
  const list = items.slice(0, 5);
  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <div tabIndex={0} className="hidden overflow-x-auto rounded-card border border-line bg-surface sm:block">
        <table className="w-full min-w-120 border-collapse text-left text-compact">
          <caption className="sr-only">{caption}</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-sunken">
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 text-nano font-normal uppercase tracking-caps text-fg-muted">{attributeLabel}</th>
              {list.map((it) => (
                <th key={it.id} scope="col" className={cn("px-4 py-3 align-bottom font-medium text-fg", it.badge && "bg-lime-faint")}>
                  <span className="block">{it.name}</span>
                  {it.subtitle && <span className="block text-small font-normal text-fg-muted">{it.subtitle}</span>}
                  {it.badge && <Badge tone="accent" className="mt-1">{it.badge}</Badge>}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((r) => (
              <tr key={r.id} className="border-t border-line align-top">
                <th scope="row" className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-fg">{r.label}</th>
                {list.map((it, i) => <td key={it.id} className={cn("px-4 py-3 leading-5 text-fg-muted", it.badge && "bg-lime-faint")}>{r.values[i]}</td>)}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <div className="sm:hidden">
        <h3 className="font-sans! mb-2 text-compact font-bold">{caption}</h3>
        <ul className="m-0 list-none space-y-3 p-0">
          {list.map((it, i) => (
            <li key={it.id} className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4">
              <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-body font-medium">{it.name}{it.badge && <Badge tone="accent">{it.badge}</Badge>}</p>
              {it.subtitle && <p className="text-small text-fg-muted">{it.subtitle}</p>}
              <dl className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-compact">
                {rows.map((r) => (
                  <div key={r.id} className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,2fr)_minmax(0,3fr)] gap-3 border-t border-line pt-2">
                    <dt className="text-fg-subtle">{r.label}</dt>
                    <dd className="m-0 text-fg-muted">{r.values[i]}</dd>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </dl>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/Composer.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { PaperclipIcon, SendIcon, StopIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";

export interface ComposerProps {
  onSend: (text: string) => void;
  /** While true the send button becomes Stop and calls onStop. */
  generating?: boolean;
  onStop?: () => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Example messages that take turns as the placeholder while the box is empty. With reduced motion the first one stays. Overrides placeholder. */
  placeholders?: string[];
  /** Milliseconds each example stays. Default 4000. */
  placeholderInterval?: number;
  maxLength?: number;
  /** Called when Attach file is pressed. The attach button renders only when this is provided. */
  onAttach?: () => void;
  /** Extra controls (model picker, tools toggle) rendered left of the send button. */
  tools?: ReactNode;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function Composer({ onSend, generating, onStop, onAttach, placeholder = "Message the assistant…", placeholders, placeholderInterval = 4000, maxLength = 4000, tools, disabled }: ComposerProps) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState("");
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState(0);
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const rotating = !!placeholders && placeholders.length > 1 && !reduced && value === "";
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!rotating) return;
    const t = window.setInterval(() => setTurn((n) => n + 1), placeholderInterval);
    return () => window.clearInterval(t);
  }, [rotating, placeholderInterval]);
  const shownPlaceholder = placeholders?.length ? placeholders[(rotating ? turn : 0) % placeholders.length] : placeholder;
  const ref = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const inputId = useId();
  const canSend = value.trim().length > 0 && !disabled;

  const submit = () => {
    if (!canSend || generating) return;
    onSend(value.trim());
    setValue("");
    if (ref.current) ref.current.style.height = "auto";
  };
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    // Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline. Never send mid IME composition.
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) { e.preventDefault(); submit(); }
  };
  const grow = (el: HTMLTextAreaElement) => { el.style.height = "auto"; el.style.height = `${Math.min(el.scrollHeight, 200)}px`; };
  const nearLimit = value.length > maxLength * 0.9;

  return (
    <div className={cn("rounded-field border border-line-strong bg-surface shadow-sm transition-shadow focus-within:border-fg-subtle focus-within:shadow-md has-[textarea:focus-visible]:outline-2 has-[textarea:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2 has-[textarea:focus-visible]:outline-[var(--focus-ring)]", disabled && "opacity-(--disabled-opacity)")}>
      <label htmlFor={inputId} className="sr-only">Message</label>
      <textarea enterKeyHint="send"
        id={inputId} ref={ref} rows={1} value={value} maxLength={maxLength} disabled={disabled}
        placeholder={shownPlaceholder}
        onChange={(e) => { setValue(e.target.value); grow(e.target); }}
        onKeyDown={onKey}
        className="block w-full resize-none bg-transparent px-5 pt-4 pb-1 text-body-lg leading-relaxed outline-none [field-sizing:content] placeholder:text-fg-subtle"
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 pb-2.5">
        {onAttach && <IconButton label="Attach file" size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onAttach}><PaperclipIcon /></IconButton>}
        {tools}
        <span className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5">
        {nearLimit && <span className="mr-2 text-small leading-4 text-warning-fg" aria-live="polite">{value.length}/{maxLength}</span>}
        {generating
          ? <IconButton label="Stop generating" variant="secondary" onClick={onStop}><StopIcon /></IconButton>
          : <IconButton label="Send message" variant="lime" disabled={!canSend} onClick={submit}><SendIcon /></IconButton>}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ContextPanel.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { headingTag, subHeadingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { ContextIcon, FileIcon, GlobeIcon, MemoryIcon, NotebookIcon, PlusIcon, ToolIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Meter } from "../atoms/Meter";

export type ContextKind = "file" | "app" | "memory" | "page" | "instruction";

export interface ContextItem {
  id: string;
  kind: ContextKind;
  /** Its name, such as "Q3 report.pdf" or "Gmail". */
  label: string;
  /** One short line, such as "12 pages" or "Read only". */
  detail?: string;
  /** Items that cannot be taken out here (an app's own instructions). */
  fixed?: boolean;
}

export interface ContextPanelLabels {
  heading?: string;
  /** Receives how many items there are. */
  count?: (n: number) => string;
  groups?: Partial<Record<ContextKind, string>>;
  /** Receives the item's name. */
  remove?: (label: string) => string;
  /** Read out after an item is taken out. Receives its name. */
  removed?: (label: string) => string;
  add?: string;
  empty?: string;
  /** Receives used and total, already formatted. */
  room?: (used: string, total: string) => string;
  /** Name of the bar for screen readers. */
  roomLabel?: string;
}

export interface ContextPanelProps {
  items: ContextItem[];
  /** Takes an item out of what the assistant can see. */
  onRemove: (id: string) => void;
  /** Opens a way to add files or apps. The button is hidden when omitted. */
  onAdd?: () => void;
  /** How much of the assistant's working memory the items fill, as words or tokens. */
  room?: { used: number; total: number };
  labels?: ContextPanelLabels;
  /** Level of the part's heading, so it fits the page outline. Default 3. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const ORDER: ContextKind[] = ["instruction", "page", "file", "app", "memory"];
const ICON: Record<ContextKind, typeof FileIcon> = { file: FileIcon, app: ToolIcon, memory: MemoryIcon, page: GlobeIcon, instruction: NotebookIcon };
const fmt = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US");

/**
 * Everything the assistant can see right now, in one place: instructions, the open page, files, connected apps and
 * memories, grouped by kind. Each can be taken out with one press, and focus moves to the next item so a keyboard user
 * never lands on nothing. An optional bar shows how full the assistant's working memory is.
 */
export function ContextPanel({ items, onRemove, onAdd, room, labels, headingLevel = 3, className }: ContextPanelProps) {
  const l = {
    heading: "What the assistant can see", count: (n: number) => (n === 1 ? "1 item" : `${n} items`), remove: (x: string) => `Take out ${x}`,
    removed: (x: string) => `${x} taken out.`, add: "Add", empty: "Nothing is shared yet. The assistant only sees this chat.",
    room: (u: string, t: string) => `Uses ${u} of ${t} tokens`, roomLabel: "Working memory used", ...labels,
    groups: { instruction: "Instructions", page: "Open page", file: "Files", app: "Connected apps", memory: "Memories", ...labels?.groups },
  };
  const uid = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const H2 = subHeadingTag(headingLevel);
  const list = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const said = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  const take = (item: ContextItem) => {
    // Move focus to the next remove button (or the heading) before the row goes, then say what happened.
    const buttons = [...(list.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-remove]") ?? [])];
    const at = buttons.findIndex((b) => b.dataset.remove === item.id);
    const next = buttons[at + 1] ?? buttons[at - 1];
    onRemove(item.id);
    if (said.current) said.current.textContent = l.removed(item.label);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => (next && next.isConnected ? next : document.getElementById(`${uid}-h`))?.focus());
  };
  const groups = ORDER.map((k) => ({ kind: k, items: items.filter((i) => i.kind === k) })).filter((g) => g.items.length);
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
        <ContextIcon aria-hidden width={18} height={18} className="shrink-0 text-fg-muted" />
        <H id={`${uid}-h`} tabIndex={-1} className="m-0 min-w-0 flex-1 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg outline-none">{l.heading}</H>
        <span className="text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.count(items.length)}</span>
      </div>
      <div ref={list} className="mt-3 space-y-4">
        {groups.length === 0 && <p className="m-0 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.empty}</p>}
        {groups.map((g) => {
          const Icon = ICON[g.kind];
          return (
            <div key={g.kind}>
              <H2 className="m-0 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted">{l.groups[g.kind]}</H2>
              <ul className="mt-1.5 space-y-1">
                {g.items.map((i) => (
                  <li key={i.id} className="flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-control px-2 py-1 hover:bg-hover">
                    <Icon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="shrink-0 text-fg-muted" />
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="line-clamp-2 block text-body leading-5 text-fg">{i.label}</span>
                      {i.detail && <span className="block truncate text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{i.detail}</span>}
                    </span>
                    {!i.fixed && (
                      <IconButton size="sm" label={l.remove(i.label)} data-remove={i.id} onClick={() => take(i)}><XIcon width={14} height={14} /></IconButton>
                    )}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {(room || onAdd) && (
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-3">
          {room && (
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-48">
              <p className="m-0 mb-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{l.room(fmt(room.used), fmt(room.total))}</p>
              <Meter value={room.used} max={room.total} warnAt={0.9} label={l.roomLabel} valueText={l.room(fmt(room.used), fmt(room.total))} />
            </div>
          )}
          {onAdd && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<PlusIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onAdd}>{l.add}</Button>}
        </div>
      )}
      <p ref={said} role="status" className="sr-only" />
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ConversationList.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { EditIcon, MoreIcon, PlusIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Menu } from "../molecules/Menu";

export interface ConversationItem { id: string; title: string; group?: string }

export interface ConversationListProps {
  items: ConversationItem[];
  activeId?: string;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
  onNew: () => void;
  /** When given, each row gets a "More" menu with Rename. Your code asks for the new name. */
  onRename?: (id: string) => void;
  /** When given, each row gets Delete in its menu. Pressing it asks once, in place, with Keep as easy to press as Delete. */
  onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Words for the in-place confirmation. */
  labels?: { delete?: string; keep?: string; confirm?: (title: string) => string };
}

/** The history of past chats for a side bar, with an optional row menu and an in-place delete confirmation. */
export function ConversationList({ items, activeId, onSelect, onNew, onRename, onDelete, labels }: ConversationListProps) {
  const groups = [...new Set(items.map((i) => i.group ?? "Recent"))];
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const keep = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const L = { delete: labels?.delete ?? "Delete", keep: labels?.keep ?? "Keep it", confirm: labels?.confirm ?? ((t: string) => `Delete “${t}”?`) };
  // Focus lands on the safe choice, so a stray Enter keeps the chat.
  useEffect(() => { if (asking) keep.current?.focus(); }, [asking]);
  const rowMenu = (i: ConversationItem) => {
    const menu = [
      ...(onRename ? [{ id: "rename", label: "Rename", icon: <EditIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />, onSelect: () => onRename(i.id) }] : []),
      ...(onDelete ? [{ id: "delete", label: L.delete, icon: <XIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />, danger: true, onSelect: () => setAsking(i.id) }] : []),
    ];
    if (!menu.length) return null;
    return <Menu portal align="end" triggerLabel={`More for ${i.title}`} trigger={<MoreIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} />} items={menu}
      className="shrink-0 [&>button]:size-8 [&>button]:rounded-control [&>button]:text-fg-subtle [&>button]:hover:bg-hover [&>button]:hover:text-fg pointer-coarse:[&>button]:size-11" />;
  };
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Conversations" className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Button variant="secondary" leading={<PlusIcon />} onClick={onNew} className="w-full justify-start">New chat</Button>
      {groups.map((g) => (
        <div key={g}>
          <p className="px-2 pb-1 text-nano font-medium uppercase tracking-caps text-fg-subtle">{g}</p>
          <ul>
            {items.filter((i) => (i.group ?? "Recent") === g).map((i) => (
              <li key={i.id}>
                {asking === i.id ? (
                  <div role="group" aria-label={L.confirm(i.title)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") { e.stopPropagation(); setAsking(null); } }}
                    className="rounded-card border border-line-strong bg-sunken p-2.5">
                    <p className="px-1 pb-2 text-small leading-4 [overflow-wrap:anywhere] text-fg">{L.confirm(i.title)}</p>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <Button ref={keep} variant="secondary" size="sm" className="flex-1" onClick={() => setAsking(null)}>{L.keep}</Button>
                      <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" className="flex-1" onClick={() => { setAsking(null); onDelete?.(i.id); }}>{L.delete}</Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <button type="button" aria-current={i.id === activeId ? "page" : undefined} onClick={() => onSelect(i.id)}
                      className={cn("min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-control [overflow-wrap:anywhere] px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-small leading-4 hover:bg-hover", i.id === activeId ? "bg-hover text-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>
                      {i.title}
                    </button>
                    {rowMenu(i)}
                  </div>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      ))}
    </nav>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/DeckBuildProgress.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, ChevronIcon, RetryIcon, StopIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export type DeckBuildState = "queued" | "building" | "partial" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "done";
export type SlideBuildStatus = "waiting" | "building" | "ready" | "failed";
/** What the little drawing of a ready slide looks like. Only a hint for the thumbnail. */
export type SlideThumbKind = "title" | "chart" | "quote" | "columns" | "text";

export interface DeckBuildSlide {
  id: string;
  /** The slide title from the outline, such as "Why churn went up". */
  title: string;
  status: SlideBuildStatus;
  /** Shape of the thumbnail once the slide is ready. Defaults to "text". */
  kind?: SlideThumbKind;
}

export interface DeckBuildProgressProps {
  /** Where the whole job is. Use "partial" when the job ended with some slides made and some failed; "failed" only when nothing usable exists. */
  state: DeckBuildState;
  /** Every slide in outline order. Ready, failed and waiting counts come from here, so the numbers are always real. */
  slides: DeckBuildSlide[];
  /** The real step the job is on, written by your app, such as "Making the chart for slide 4". Never a made-up percentage. */
  currentStep?: string;
  /** Place in the queue while queued. */
  queuePosition?: number;
  /** The job runs on the server. Says "You can leave this page" instead of asking the person to keep it open. */
  background?: boolean;
  /** Why the whole build failed, in plain words. Shown in the failed state. */
  error?: string;
  /** Stops the build and keeps every ready slide. The button says how many it keeps. */
  onStop?: () => void;
  /** Retries one failed slide. */
  onRetrySlide?: (slideId: string) => void;
  /** Retries every failed slide, or the whole build in the failed state. */
  onRetryFailed?: () => void;
  /** Builds the slides that were not made after a stop. */
  onResume?: () => void;
  /** Opens the deck, or one ready slide when an id is given. */
  onOpen?: (slideId?: string) => void;
  /** One row for a phone: status, count, bar and the main action, with the slide list behind a Show slides button. */
  compact?: boolean;
  /** Name of the deck, used in the heading, such as "Q3 churn review". */
  deckTitle?: string;
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const plural = (n: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

const STATE_WORD: Record<DeckBuildState, string> = {
  queued: "Waiting to start", building: "Building", partial: "Partly ready", failed: "Build failed", cancelled: "Stopped", done: "Ready",
};

/** Small drawing of a slide made from tokens, so a ready slide is recognisable at a glance. */
function SlideThumb({ kind = "text", status }: { kind?: SlideThumbKind; status: SlideBuildStatus }) {
  const frame = "relative aspect-video w-14 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-control border";
  if (status === "waiting") return <span aria-hidden className={cn(frame, "border-dashed border-line-strong bg-transparent")} />;
  if (status === "failed") {
    return <span aria-hidden className={cn(frame, "grid place-items-center border-line bg-danger-soft text-danger-fg")}><AlertIcon width={14} height={14} /></span>;
  }
  if (status === "building") {
    return (
      <span aria-hidden className={cn(frame, "border-lime bg-sunken")}>
        <span className="absolute inset-x-2 top-2 h-1 rounded-full bg-line-strong" />
        <span className="absolute inset-x-2 top-4 h-1 w-1/2 rounded-full bg-line" />
        <span className="absolute right-1 bottom-1 size-1.5 rounded-full bg-lime motion-safe:animate-pulse-dot" />
      </span>
    );
  }
  const bar = "absolute rounded-full bg-fg-subtle";
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className={cn(frame, "border-line bg-surface")}>
      {kind === "title" && <><span className={cn(bar, "inset-x-3 top-3 h-1.5 bg-fg")} /><span className={cn(bar, "inset-x-5 top-6 h-0.5")} /></>}
      {kind === "chart" && (
        <>
          <span className={cn(bar, "top-1.5 left-1.5 h-0.5 w-6 bg-fg")} />
          <span className="absolute inset-x-2 bottom-1.5 flex h-4 items-end gap-0.5">
            {["h-1/3", "h-1/2", "h-2/3", "h-full", "h-3/4"].map((h, i) => <span key={i} className={cn("flex-1 bg-fg-muted", h)} />)}
          </span>
        </>
      )}
      {kind === "quote" && <><span className="absolute top-0.5 left-1.5 text-small leading-none font-semibold text-fg-muted">“</span><span className={cn(bar, "inset-x-3 top-3 h-0.5")} /><span className={cn(bar, "top-4.5 right-5 left-3 h-0.5")} /><span className={cn(bar, "right-3 bottom-1.5 h-0.5 w-3 bg-fg-muted")} /></>}
      {kind === "columns" && (
        <>
          <span className={cn(bar, "top-1.5 left-1.5 h-0.5 w-6 bg-fg")} />
          <span className="absolute inset-x-1.5 top-3.5 bottom-1.5 flex gap-1">
            {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => <span key={i} className="flex-1 bg-sunken" />)}
          </span>
        </>
      )}
      {kind === "text" && <><span className={cn(bar, "top-1.5 left-1.5 h-0.5 w-6 bg-fg")} />{["top-3.5", "top-5", "top-6.5"].map((t) => <span key={t} className={cn(bar, "left-1.5 h-0.5 w-9", t)} />)}</>}
    </span>
  );
}

const SLIDE_WORD: Record<SlideBuildStatus, string> = { waiting: "Waiting", building: "Building", ready: "Ready", failed: "Failed" };

/**
 * Progress for a deck built slide by slide. It counts slides ready out of the total, shows the real current step,
 * lists every slide with its status, and keeps what is done when the person stops. A failed slide gets its own Retry.
 * The live region speaks when the job changes state or a slide fails, never for each step.
 */
export function DeckBuildProgress({
  state, slides, currentStep, queuePosition, background, error, onStop, onRetrySlide, onRetryFailed, onResume, onOpen,
  compact = false, deckTitle, headingLevel = 3, className,
}: DeckBuildProgressProps) {
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const total = slides.length;
  const ready = slides.filter((s) => s.status === "ready").length;
  const failed = slides.filter((s) => s.status === "failed");
  const notMade = total - ready - failed.length;
  const active = state === "queued" || state === "building";
  const [listOpen, setListOpen] = useState(!compact);

  const countText = `${ready} of ${plural(total, "slide")} ready`;
  const failText = failed.length ? `, ${failed.length} failed` : "";

  // Announce only changes of job state and new failures. Steps and each ready slide stay silent.
  const announcement =
    state === "queued" ? "Deck build is waiting to start" :
    state === "building" ? (failed.length ? `Slide ${slides.indexOf(failed[failed.length - 1]) + 1} failed. Still building.` : `Building ${plural(total, "slide")}`) :
    state === "partial" ? `Build finished. ${countText}${failText}` :
    state === "failed" ? `Build failed${error ? `. ${error}` : ""}` :
    state === "cancelled" ? `Stopped. ${plural(ready, "slide")} kept` :
    `Deck ready. ${plural(total, "slide")}`;
  const [spoken, setSpoken] = useState("");
  const first = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    // Skip the first render so a page that opens mid-build does not shout; the heading already says where things are.
    if (first.current) { first.current = false; return; }
    setSpoken(announcement);
  }, [announcement]);

  const headline =
    state === "queued" ? (queuePosition ? `Waiting to start. Number ${queuePosition} in the queue.` : "Waiting to start.") :
    state === "building" ? `${countText}${failText}` :
    state === "partial" ? `${countText}. ${plural(failed.length, "slide")} did not build.` :
    state === "failed" ? (ready ? `${countText}.` : "No slides were made.") :
    state === "cancelled" ? `Stopped. ${plural(ready, "slide")} kept${notMade ? `, ${notMade} not built` : ""}.` :
    `All ${plural(total, "slide")} are ready.`;

  const stopLabel = ready ? `Stop and keep ${plural(ready, "slide")}` : "Stop building";

  const icon =
    state === "done" ? <CheckIcon width={14} height={14} className="text-success-fg" /> :
    state === "failed" ? <AlertIcon width={14} height={14} className="text-danger-fg" /> :
    state === "partial" ? <AlertIcon width={14} height={14} className="text-attention-fg" /> :
    state === "cancelled" ? <StopIcon width={12} height={12} className="text-fg-muted" /> :
    <span className={cn("size-2 rounded-full", state === "building" ? "bg-lime motion-safe:animate-pulse-dot" : "border border-fg-subtle")} />;

  const bar = (
    <div role="progressbar" aria-label="Slides ready" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={total} aria-valuenow={ready}
      aria-valuetext={`${countText}${failText}`} className="flex h-1.5 w-full gap-0.5">
      {slides.map((s) => (
        <span key={s.id} className={cn("h-full min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-full transition-colors duration-(--dur-base) ease-(--ease-out)",
          s.status === "ready" ? "bg-fg" : s.status === "failed" ? "bg-danger" : s.status === "building" ? "bg-lime" : "bg-line",
          state === "cancelled" && s.status !== "ready" && "bg-line opacity-50")} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );

  const actions = (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      {active && onStop && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<StopIcon width={12} height={12} aria-hidden />} onClick={onStop}>{stopLabel}</Button>}
      {(state === "partial" || (state === "building" && failed.length > 0)) && onRetryFailed && failed.length > 0 && (
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<RetryIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />} onClick={onRetryFailed}>
          {failed.length === 1 ? "Retry the failed slide" : `Retry ${failed.length} failed slides`}
        </Button>
      )}
      {state === "failed" && onRetryFailed && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<RetryIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />} onClick={onRetryFailed}>Try the build again</Button>}
      {state === "cancelled" && onResume && notMade + failed.length > 0 && (
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onResume}>Build the other {plural(notMade + failed.length, "slide")}</Button>
      )}
      {(state === "done" || state === "partial" || state === "cancelled") && ready > 0 && onOpen && <Button size="sm" onClick={() => onOpen()}>Open deck</Button>}
    </div>
  );

  const list = (
    <ol aria-label="Slides" className="divide-y divide-line">
      {slides.map((s, i) => {
        const shownStatus: SlideBuildStatus | "not built" = state === "cancelled" && (s.status === "waiting" || s.status === "building") ? "not built" : s.status;
        return (
          <li key={s.id} className="flex min-h-12 items-center gap-3 py-1.5">
            <SlideThumb kind={s.kind} status={s.status === "building" && !active ? "waiting" : s.status} />
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span className="block truncate text-compact text-fg"><span className="text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{i + 1}.</span> {s.title}</span>
              <span className={cn("flex items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4",
                shownStatus === "failed" ? "text-danger-fg" : shownStatus === "ready" ? "text-fg-muted" : "text-fg-subtle")}>
                {shownStatus === "ready" && <CheckIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} />}
                {shownStatus === "failed" && <AlertIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} />}
                {shownStatus === "not built" ? "Not built" : SLIDE_WORD[shownStatus]}
              </span>
            </span>
            {s.status === "failed" && onRetrySlide && (
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="shrink-0" aria-label={`Retry slide ${i + 1}, ${s.title}`} onClick={() => onRetrySlide(s.id)}>Retry</Button>
            )}
            {s.status === "ready" && onOpen && (
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="shrink-0" aria-label={`Open slide ${i + 1}, ${s.title}`} onClick={() => onOpen(s.id)}>Open</Button>
            )}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );

  const step = active && (currentStep || background) && (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      {currentStep && state === "building" && <p className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 text-compact text-fg-muted"><span className="truncate">{currentStep}</span></p>}
      {background && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">You can leave this page. The deck keeps building and we will tell you when it is ready.</p>}
    </div>
  );

  if (compact) {
    return (
      <section aria-label={deckTitle ? `Building ${deckTitle}` : "Deck build"} className={cn("w-full space-y-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3", className)}>
        <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{spoken}</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span aria-hidden className="flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">{icon}</span>
          <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-compact"><span className="font-medium">{STATE_WORD[state]}</span><span className="text-fg-muted"> · {state === "queued" ? "Not started" : `${ready} of ${total} ready`}{failed.length ? `, ${failed.length} failed` : ""}</span></p>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded={listOpen} onClick={() => setListOpen(!listOpen)}
            className="tap inline-flex h-8 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-control px-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg">
            {listOpen ? "Hide slides" : "Show slides"}
            <ChevronIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} className={cn("transition-transform duration-(--dur-fast)", listOpen ? "-rotate-90" : "rotate-90")} />
          </button>
        </div>
        {bar}
        {state === "building" && currentStep && <p className="truncate text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{currentStep}</p>}
        {state === "failed" && error && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-danger-fg">{error}</p>}
        {actions}
        {listOpen && list}
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section aria-label={deckTitle ? `Building ${deckTitle}` : "Deck build"} className={cn("w-full space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{spoken}</p>
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <H className="flex items-center gap-2 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">
          <span aria-hidden className="flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">{icon}</span>
          <span className="min-w-0">{STATE_WORD[state]}{deckTitle && <span className="font-normal text-fg-muted">: {deckTitle}</span>}</span>
        </H>
        <p className="text-compact text-fg">{headline}</p>
        {state === "failed" && error && <p className="text-compact text-danger-fg">{error}</p>}
        {state === "partial" && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-attention-fg">Needs you: retry or remove the failed {failed.length === 1 ? "slide" : "slides"} before you present.</p>}
      </div>
      {bar}
      {step}
      {actions}
      {total > 0 && (
        <div>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded={listOpen} onClick={() => setListOpen(!listOpen)}
            className="tap inline-flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-control text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted hover:text-fg">
            <ChevronIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} className={cn("transition-transform duration-(--dur-fast)", listOpen && "rotate-90")} />
            {listOpen ? "Hide slides" : `Show all ${plural(total, "slide")}`}
          </button>
          {listOpen && list}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/DeckChangeReview.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode, type RefObject } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { type HeadingLevel, headingTag, subHeadingTag } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { ChevronIcon, CheckIcon, HistoryIcon, NeedsReviewIcon, UndoIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { AIMark } from "../atoms/AIMark";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";

/** proposed: waiting for the person. kept: the change will go into the deck. rejected: the slide stays as it was ("Undone" on screen). */
export type DeckChangeState = "proposed" | "kept" | "rejected";

export interface DeckChange {
  slideId: string;
  /** Position in the deck, for example 3. Shown as "Slide 3". */
  slideNumber: number;
  /** The slide's title. */
  title: string;
  /** A drawing of the slide before the AI edit. */
  before: ReactNode;
  /** A drawing of the slide after the AI edit. */
  after: ReactNode;
  /** What changed, in one plain line, for example "Turned the bullet list into a bar chart". */
  summary: string;
  state: DeckChangeState;
}

/** reviewing: decisions open. applying: Done was pressed and the deck is saving. applied: saved as one version. */
export type DeckReviewStatus = "reviewing" | "applying" | "applied";

export interface DeckChangeReviewProps {
  /** What the person asked the AI to do, for example "Make it more visual". */
  request: string;
  changes: DeckChange[];
  /** Called when the person keeps or undoes one slide's change. */
  onChange: (slideId: string, state: DeckChangeState) => void;
  onKeepAll: () => void;
  onRejectAll: () => void;
  /** Applies the kept changes to the deck as one version. Only offered once every change has a decision. */
  onDone: () => void;
  status?: DeckReviewStatus;
  /** side-by-side: Before and After next to each other. toggle: one picture with a Before and After switch. Narrow screens always use toggle. */
  view?: "side-by-side" | "toggle";
  /** list: every slide in a column. pager: one slide at a time with Previous and Next. auto: pager when the part is narrower than a phone. */
  layout?: "auto" | "list" | "pager";
  /** In the applied state, opens version history so the whole edit can be restored. */
  onOpenHistory?: () => void;
  /** Heading level of the panel title. Each slide is one level below. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const plural = (n: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;
const SAID: Record<DeckChangeState, string> = { proposed: "back to needs review", kept: "kept", rejected: "undone" };

/** Counts for the header, in words: "2 of 6 kept, 1 undone, 3 left to review". */
export function deckReviewSummary(changes: { state: DeckChangeState }[]) {
  const n = (s: DeckChangeState) => changes.filter((c) => c.state === s).length;
  const parts = [`${n("kept")} of ${plural(changes.length, "slide")} kept`];
  if (n("rejected")) parts.push(`${n("rejected")} undone`);
  parts.push(n("proposed") ? `${n("proposed")} left to review` : "all reviewed");
  return parts.join(", ");
}

function StateBadge({ state }: { state: DeckChangeState }) {
  if (state === "kept") return <Badge tone="success"><CheckIcon aria-hidden width={10} height={10} />Kept</Badge>;
  if (state === "rejected") return <Badge><UndoIcon aria-hidden width={10} height={10} />Undone</Badge>;
  return <Badge tone="warning"><NeedsReviewIcon aria-hidden width={10} height={10} />Needs review</Badge>;
}

function Frame({ label, ai, children }: { label: string; ai?: boolean; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <figure className="m-0 min-w-0">
      <figcaption className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-micro font-medium text-fg-muted">
        {ai && <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-4 items-center justify-center rounded-control bg-lime text-on-lime"><AIMark size={16} className="size-3" /></span>}
        {label}
      </figcaption>
      <div aria-hidden className="relative aspect-video overflow-hidden rounded-xs border border-line bg-bg">{children}</div>
    </figure>
  );
}

/** Narrower than this, the part shows one slide at a time with the toggle view. */
const PAGER_BELOW = 480;

function useNarrow(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, on: boolean) {
  const [narrow, setNarrow] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!on || !el || typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => setNarrow(e.contentRect.width < PAGER_BELOW));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [ref, on]);
  return on && narrow;
}

/**
 * Review an AI edit that touched several slides, one slide at a time. Each slide shows what changed in one line, the
 * slide before and after, and Keep or Undo. Nothing reaches the deck until Done, which saves every kept change as one
 * version that can be restored as a whole. Undecided slides are the amber "needs you" state.
 */
export function DeckChangeReview({
  request, changes, onChange, onKeepAll, onRejectAll, onDone, status = "reviewing", view = "side-by-side", layout = "auto",
  onOpenHistory, headingLevel = 3, className,
}: DeckChangeReviewProps) {
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const SubH = subHeadingTag(headingLevel);
  const id = useId();
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const narrow = useNarrow(root, layout === "auto");
  const pager = layout === "pager" || narrow;
  const mode = pager ? "toggle" : view;
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<Record<string, "before" | "after">>({});
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  const [doneHint, setDoneHint] = useState(false);

  const left = changes.filter((c) => c.state === "proposed").length;
  const kept = changes.filter((c) => c.state === "kept").length;
  const locked = status !== "reviewing";
  const at = Math.min(page, Math.max(changes.length - 1, 0));
  const visible = pager ? changes.slice(at, at + 1) : changes;

  useEffect(() => { if (left === 0) setDoneHint(false); }, [left]);
  const lastStatus = useRef(status);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === lastStatus.current) return;
    lastStatus.current = status;
    if (status === "applying") setSaid("Saving changes to the deck.");
    if (status === "applied") setSaid(`Saved. ${plural(kept, "slide")} changed as one version.`);
  }, [status, kept]);

  const decide = (c: DeckChange, s: DeckChangeState) => {
    if (locked || c.state === s) return;
    onChange(c.slideId, s);
    const after = left - (c.state === "proposed" ? 1 : 0) + (s === "proposed" ? 1 : 0);
    setSaid(`Slide ${c.slideNumber} ${SAID[s]}. ${after ? `${after} left to review.` : "All slides reviewed."}`);
  };

  if (status === "applied") {
    return (
      <section ref={root} aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`} className={cn("min-w-0 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
        <H id={`${id}-title`} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">
          <CheckIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="text-success-fg" />Changes saved
        </H>
        <p className="mt-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
          {kept ? <>Saved as one version: <span className="text-fg">AI: {request}, {plural(kept, "slide")}</span>. You can restore the whole edit from version history.</> : "No changes were kept. The deck is as it was."}
        </p>
        {kept > 0 && onOpenHistory && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" className="mt-3" leading={<HistoryIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onOpenHistory}>Version history</Button>
        )}
        <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{said}</p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section ref={root} aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`} className={cn("min-w-0 space-y-3", className)}>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <H id={`${id}-title`} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">
          <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-control bg-lime text-on-lime"><AIMark size={16} /></span>
          AI changed {plural(changes.length, "slide")}
        </H>
        <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">You asked: <q className="text-fg">{request}</q>. Nothing reaches the deck until you press Done.</p>
        <p className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-card border px-3 py-2 text-small leading-4",
          left ? "border-attention bg-attention-soft text-attention-fg" : "border-line bg-surface text-fg")}>
          {left ? <NeedsReviewIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0" /> : <CheckIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0 text-success-fg" />}
          <span className="font-medium">{left ? "Needs your review." : "All reviewed."}</span>
          <span>{deckReviewSummary(changes)}.</span>
        </p>
      </div>

      <ol className="m-0 list-none space-y-3 p-0" aria-label="Changed slides">
        {visible.map((c) => {
          const face = shown[c.slideId] ?? "after";
          return (
            <li key={c.slideId} className={cn("min-w-0 rounded-card border bg-surface p-3 transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast)",
              c.state === "proposed" ? "border-attention" : "border-line")}>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-2">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <SubH className="text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg"><span className="text-fg-muted">Slide {c.slideNumber}</span> {c.title}</SubH>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{c.summary}</p>
                </div>
                <StateBadge state={c.state} />
              </div>

              {mode === "side-by-side" ? (
                <div className={cn("mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3", c.state === "rejected" && "[&_figure:last-child]:opacity-60")}>
                  <Frame label="Before">{c.before}</Frame>
                  <Frame label="After" ai>{c.after}</Frame>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                  <SegmentedControl size="sm" label={`Slide ${c.slideNumber}: show`} value={face}
                    onChange={(v) => setShown((m) => ({ ...m, [c.slideId]: v }))}
                    options={[{ value: "before", label: "Before" }, { value: "after", label: "After" }]} />
                  <div className="max-w-md">{face === "after" ? <Frame label="After" ai>{c.after}</Frame> : <Frame label="Before">{c.before}</Frame>}</div>
                </div>
              )}

              <div role="group" aria-label={`Slide ${c.slideNumber}, ${c.title}`} className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <Button size="sm" variant={c.state === "kept" ? "primary" : "secondary"} aria-pressed={c.state === "kept"} disabled={locked}
                  leading={<CheckIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={() => decide(c, c.state === "kept" ? "proposed" : "kept")}>
                  Keep
                </Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant={c.state === "rejected" ? "primary" : "secondary"} aria-pressed={c.state === "rejected"} disabled={locked}
                  leading={<UndoIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={() => decide(c, c.state === "rejected" ? "proposed" : "rejected")}>
                  Undo
                </Button>
              </div>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>

      {pager && changes.length > 1 && (
        <nav aria-label="Changed slides" className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={at === 0} onClick={() => setPage(at - 1)}
            leading={<ChevronIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} className="rotate-180" />}>Previous</Button>
          <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{at + 1} of {changes.length}</span>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={at >= changes.length - 1} onClick={() => setPage(at + 1)}
            trailing={<ChevronIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />}>Next</Button>
        </nav>
      )}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line pt-3">
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={locked} onClick={() => { onKeepAll(); setSaid(`All ${plural(changes.length, "slide")} kept.`); }}>Keep all</Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={locked} onClick={() => { onRejectAll(); setSaid(`All ${plural(changes.length, "slide")} undone.`); }}>Undo all</Button>
        <span className="flex-1" />
        <Button size="sm" busy={status === "applying"} busyLabel="Saving changes" aria-disabled={left > 0 || undefined}
          aria-describedby={left > 0 ? `${id}-hint` : undefined}
          onClick={() => { if (left > 0) { setDoneHint(true); return; } onDone(); }}
          className={cn(left > 0 && "opacity-60")}>
          {kept ? `Done, apply ${plural(kept, "change")}` : "Done"}
        </Button>
        <p id={`${id}-hint`} className={cn("w-full text-micro", doneHint ? "text-attention-fg" : "text-fg-muted", left === 0 && "sr-only")}>
          {left > 0 ? `Keep or undo ${plural(left, "more slide")} first, or use Keep all.` : ""}
        </p>
      </div>

      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{said}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```
