## tattva/organisms/Heatmap.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import type { DataTableProps } from "../molecules/DataTable";
import { formatNumber } from "../molecules/ChartFrame";

export interface HeatmapProps {
  /** Row labels, top to bottom. */
  rows: string[];
  /** Column labels, left to right. */
  cols: string[];
  /** One array per row, one value per column. Use null for a cell with no data. */
  values: (number | null)[][];
  /** "direction" colours around zero (up or down, stronger for bigger moves). "sequential" uses one hue from low to high. */
  scale?: "direction" | "sequential";
  /** Formats the number in a cell. With the direction scale it gets the size of the move and the sign is added for you. */
  formatValue?: (n: number) => string;
  /** Word read after each value by screen readers, for example "percent". */
  unit?: string;
  /** Print the number in every cell, so colour is never the only channel. */
  showValues?: boolean;
  /** Name for the grid, for example "Sector moves this week". */
  ariaLabel: string;
  /** Show a small scale bar with the lowest, zero and highest values. */
  legend?: boolean;
  /** Smallest cell width and height in px. */
  cellSize?: number;
  className?: string;
}

const BUCKETS = 5;

function dirWord(v: number): "up" | "down" | "flat" {
  return v > 0 ? "up" : v < 0 ? "down" : "flat";
}

/** Signed text for the direction scale. */
function signed(v: number, f: (n: number) => string): string {
  return `${v > 0 ? "+" : v < 0 ? "−" : ""}${f(Math.abs(v))}`;
}

/**
 * A grid of coloured cells. Colour shows size, the number printed in each cell and the words in the cell label give the same facts.
 * The grid is one tab stop. Arrow keys move between cells, Home and End go to the row ends, PageUp and PageDown go to the column ends.
 */
export function Heatmap({ rows, cols, values, scale = "direction", formatValue = formatNumber, unit = "", showValues = true, ariaLabel, legend, cellSize = 44, className }: HeatmapProps) {
  const refs = useRef<Map<string, HTMLDivElement>>(new Map());
  const [cur, setCur] = useState<{ r: number; c: number }>({ r: 0, c: 0 });
  const nr = rows.length;
  const nc = cols.length;

  const nums = values.flat().filter((v): v is number => typeof v === "number");
  const absMax = nums.length ? Math.max(...nums.map(Math.abs)) || 1 : 1;
  const vMin = nums.length ? Math.min(...nums) : 0;
  const vMax = nums.length ? Math.max(...nums) : 1;

  /** Share of the up or down colour mixed into the surface. Capped so the printed number keeps its contrast. */
  const mix = (v: number) => 14 + 46 * (Math.abs(v) / absMax);
  const dirBg = (v: number) => (v === 0 ? "var(--surface-sunken)" : `color-mix(in srgb, var(${v > 0 ? "--up" : "--down"}) ${mix(v).toFixed(0)}%, var(--surface))`);
  const bucket = (v: number) => Math.min(BUCKETS, Math.max(1, 1 + Math.floor(((v - vMin) / (vMax - vMin || 1)) * BUCKETS - 1e-9)));
  const seqBg = (v: number) => `var(--chart-seq-${bucket(v)})`;

  const text = (v: number) => (scale === "direction" ? signed(v, formatValue) : formatValue(v));
  const label = (r: number, c: number) => {
    const v = values[r]?.[c];
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return `${rows[r]}, ${cols[c]}: No data`;
    const u = unit ? ` ${unit}` : "";
    return scale === "direction"
      ? `${rows[r]}, ${cols[c]}: ${dirWord(v)}${v === 0 ? "" : ` ${formatValue(Math.abs(v))}`}${u}`
      : `${rows[r]}, ${cols[c]}: ${formatValue(v)}${u}`;
  };

  const go = (r: number, c: number) => {
    setCur({ r, c });
    refs.current.get(`${r}:${c}`)?.focus();
  };

  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>, r: number, c: number) => {
    if (!nr || !nc) return;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") go(r, Math.min(nc - 1, c + 1));
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") go(r, Math.max(0, c - 1));
    else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") go(Math.min(nr - 1, r + 1), c);
    else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") go(Math.max(0, r - 1), c);
    else if (e.key === "Home") go(e.ctrlKey ? 0 : r, 0);
    else if (e.key === "End") go(e.ctrlKey ? nr - 1 : r, nc - 1);
    else if (e.key === "PageUp") go(0, c);
    else if (e.key === "PageDown") go(nr - 1, c);
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
  };

  const cell = Math.max(32, cellSize);
  const grid: CSSProperties = { gridTemplateColumns: `minmax(64px, max-content) repeat(${nc}, minmax(${cell}px, 1fr))` };
  const sample = (k: number) => (scale === "direction" ? dirBg(absMax * k) : "");

  return (
    <div className={cn("min-w-0", className)}>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <div role="grid" aria-label={ariaLabel} aria-rowcount={nr + 1} aria-colcount={nc + 1} className="grid gap-px text-small leading-4" style={grid}>
          <div role="row" className="contents">
            <div role="presentation" aria-hidden />
            {cols.map((c, ci) => (
              <div key={c + ci} role="columnheader" className="truncate px-1 pb-1 text-center text-fg-muted">{c}</div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {rows.map((rl, r) => (
            <div key={rl + r} role="row" className="contents">
              <div role="rowheader" className="flex items-center pr-2 text-fg-muted" style={{ minHeight: cell }}>{rl}</div>
              {cols.map((cl, c) => {
                const v = values[r]?.[c];
                const empty = v === null || v === undefined;
                return (
                  <div key={cl + c} role="gridcell" aria-label={label(r, c)} tabIndex={cur.r === r && cur.c === c ? 0 : -1}
                    ref={(el) => { if (el) refs.current.set(`${r}:${c}`, el); else refs.current.delete(`${r}:${c}`); }}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => onKey(e, r, c)} onFocus={() => setCur({ r, c })} onPointerDown={() => setCur({ r, c })}
                    className={cn("flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-transparent px-1 text-center [font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-[var(--focus-ring)] forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]",
                      empty && "border-dashed border-line bg-sunken text-fg-subtle")}
                    style={{ minHeight: cell, background: empty ? undefined : scale === "direction" ? dirBg(v) : seqBg(v) }}>
                    {empty ? (
                      <span aria-hidden>{"–"}</span>
                    ) : showValues ? (
                      scale === "direction"
                        ? <span aria-hidden className="rounded-sm bg-surface px-1 text-fg">{text(v)}</span>
                        : <span aria-hidden className="rounded-sm bg-surface px-1 text-fg">{text(v)}</span>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {legend && nums.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-3 max-w-xs text-micro text-fg-muted" aria-hidden>
          {scale === "direction" ? (
            <>
              <div className="h-2 rounded-sm border border-line" style={{ background: `linear-gradient(to right, ${sample(-1)}, var(--surface), ${sample(1)})` }} />
              <div className="mt-1 flex justify-between [font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums]">
                <span>Down {formatValue(absMax)}</span><span>0</span><span>Up {formatValue(absMax)}</span>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="flex h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-sm border border-line">
                {Array.from({ length: BUCKETS }, (_, i) => <span key={i} className="flex-1" style={{ background: `var(--chart-seq-${i + 1})` }} />)}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 flex justify-between [font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums]">
                <span>Low {formatValue(vMin)}</span><span>High {formatValue(vMax)}</span>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Table data for ChartFrame's table view: one row per heatmap row, one column per heatmap column. */
export function heatmapTable(opts: { rows: string[]; cols: string[]; values: (number | null)[][]; scale?: "direction" | "sequential"; formatValue?: (n: number) => string; unit?: string; rowHeader?: string; caption: string }): DataTableProps {
  const f = opts.formatValue ?? formatNumber;
  const dir = (opts.scale ?? "direction") === "direction";
  const u = opts.unit ? ` ${opts.unit}` : "";
  return {
    caption: opts.caption,
    columns: [
      { key: "row", header: opts.rowHeader ?? "Row" },
      ...opts.cols.map((c, i) => ({ key: `c${i}`, header: c, numeric: true, direction: dir ? (r: Record<string, unknown>) => { const t = String(r[`c${i}`]); return t.startsWith("+") ? "up" as const : t.startsWith("−") ? "down" as const : undefined; } : undefined })),
    ],
    rows: opts.rows.map((rl, r) => {
      const row: Record<string, string> = { row: rl };
      opts.cols.forEach((_, c) => {
        const v = opts.values[r]?.[c];
        row[`c${c}`] = v === null || v === undefined ? "No data" : `${dir ? signed(v, f) : f(v)}${u}`;
      });
      return row;
    }),
  };
}
```

## tattva/organisms/LayoutAlternatives.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { type HeadingLevel, headingTag } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, EditIcon, RetryIcon, UndoIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { AIMark } from "../atoms/AIMark";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Reveal } from "../atoms/Reveal";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";

/** loading: nothing back yet. partial: some layouts back, more coming. ready: all back. failed: the request broke. none: the AI found no layout good enough. */
export type LayoutAltState = "loading" | "partial" | "ready" | "failed" | "none";

/** keep: the person's words stay exactly as written. fit: the AI may shorten text so a layout fits. */
export type LayoutTextMode = "keep" | "fit";

export interface LayoutOption {
  id: string;
  /** Short plain name, for example "Chart left, points right". Also the option's accessible name. */
  label: string;
  /** A drawing of the slide in this layout. Decorative: the label says what it is. */
  thumbnail: ReactNode;
  /** Optional one line on what changes, for example "Shortens two bullet points". */
  note?: string;
}

export interface LayoutAlternativesProps {
  /** The slide as it is now. Always the first option, so there is always a way back. */
  current: { thumbnail: ReactNode; label?: string };
  /** Layouts the AI suggested. They arrive over time in the partial state. */
  options: LayoutOption[];
  state: LayoutAltState;
  /** Placeholders to draw while loading or partial, for layouts still on the way. */
  loadingCount?: number;
  /** The option shown on the slide right now without being applied. null or undefined means the current layout. */
  previewId?: string | null;
  /** Called to preview an option on the slide (focus, hover, or a tap on touch screens), or with null to go back to the current layout. Never changes the deck. */
  onPreview: (id: string | null) => void;
  /** Called when the person applies an option: Enter, a click with a mouse, or the Apply button. */
  onApply: (id: string) => void;
  /** The option that was just applied. Shows "Applied" with an Undo button until you clear it. */
  appliedId?: string | null;
  /** Shows Undo in the applied state. Your app restores the previous layout and clears appliedId. */
  onUndo?: () => void;
  /** The promise about the person's words. Shown as a two-way control when onTextModeChange is passed. */
  textMode: LayoutTextMode;
  onTextModeChange?: (mode: LayoutTextMode) => void;
  /** Asks for more layouts. Shown as "More layouts" while nothing else is loading. */
  onMore?: () => void;
  /** Shown in the failed state. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** Offered in the none state, so the person can change the content instead. */
  onEditText?: () => void;
  /** Plain reason in the failed state. */
  error?: string;
  /** Plain reason in the none state, for example "The table has too many rows for another layout." */
  noneReason?: string;
  /** Cost of asking for more, shown next to the button, for example "About 2 credits". */
  cost?: ReactNode;
  /** The slide these layouts are for, for example "Slide 3, Pricing". Used in the heading and the group name. */
  slideName?: string;
  /** Heading level of the panel title. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const plural = (n: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

/** The one sentence the live region speaks when the set of layouts changes. */
export function layoutAltSummary(state: LayoutAltState, ready: number, waiting: number) {
  if (state === "loading") return `Making ${plural(waiting || 3, "layout")}.`;
  if (state === "partial") return `${ready} of ${ready + waiting} layouts ready.`;
  if (state === "ready") return `${plural(ready, "layout")} ready.`;
  if (state === "none") return "No good layouts for this slide.";
  return "Could not make layouts.";
}

const CURRENT = "__current";

/**
 * Other layouts for one slide, suggested by the AI and compared side by side with the slide as it is.
 * Focus or hover previews a layout on the slide without changing the deck. Enter, a mouse click or Apply commits it.
 * On touch a tap only previews, and the Apply button commits. Escape goes back to the current layout.
 * The text mode is a visible promise about the person's words.
 */
export function LayoutAlternatives({
  current, options, state, loadingCount = 0, previewId, onPreview, onApply, appliedId, onUndo, textMode, onTextModeChange,
  onMore, onRetry, onEditText, error, noneReason, cost, slideName, headingLevel = 3, className,
}: LayoutAlternativesProps) {
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const id = useId();
  const group = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pointer = useRef<string>("");
  // A preview chosen by focus or tap stays when the mouse leaves; a hover preview goes back to it.
  const pinned = useRef<string | null>(previewId ?? null);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");

  const showOptions = state !== "none" && !(state === "failed" && options.length === 0);
  const waiting = state === "loading" || state === "partial" ? loadingCount : 0;
  const previewing = previewId && options.some((o) => o.id === previewId) ? previewId : null;
  const previewOption = options.find((o) => o.id === previewing);
  const applied = appliedId ? options.find((o) => o.id === appliedId) : undefined;
  const all = [{ id: CURRENT, label: current.label ?? "Current layout" }, ...(showOptions ? options : [])];
  const stopId = previewing ?? CURRENT;
  const nameOf = (o: string | null) => (o ? options.find((x) => x.id === o)?.label ?? "" : current.label ?? "Current layout");

  // Speak only when the set of layouts changes state, never on every hover.
  const summary = layoutAltSummary(state, options.length, waiting);
  const lastSummary = useRef("");
  useEffect(() => {
    if (summary !== lastSummary.current) { lastSummary.current = summary; setSaid(summary); }
  }, [summary]);

  const preview = (o: string | null, speak: boolean) => {
    pinned.current = o;
    if (o !== previewing) { onPreview(o); if (speak) setSaid(o ? `Previewing ${nameOf(o)}. Not applied yet.` : "Back to original."); }
  };
  const apply = (o: string) => {
    if (o === CURRENT) { preview(null, true); return; }
    pinned.current = null;
    onApply(o);
    setSaid(`${nameOf(o)} applied.`);
  };

  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    const tiles = Array.from(group.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="radio"]') ?? []);
    const from = tiles.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      if (previewing) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); preview(null, true); tiles[0]?.focus(); }
      return;
    }
    if (from < 0) return;
    let to = from;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") to = (from + 1) % tiles.length;
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") to = (from - 1 + tiles.length) % tiles.length;
    else if (e.key === "Home") to = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") to = tiles.length - 1;
    else if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); apply(all[from].id); return; }
    else if (e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); preview(all[from].id === CURRENT ? null : all[from].id, true); return; }
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    tiles[to]?.focus();
  };

  const tile = (o: { id: string; label: string; note?: string }, thumb: ReactNode, i: number) => {
    const isCurrent = o.id === CURRENT;
    const on = isCurrent ? !previewing : o.id === previewing;
    const isApplied = !isCurrent && o.id === appliedId;
    const optionId = isCurrent ? null : o.id;
    return (
      <Reveal as="div" key={o.id} index={i} className="min-w-0">
        <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={on} tabIndex={o.id === stopId ? 0 : -1}
          aria-describedby={`${id}-keys`}
          aria-label={`${o.label}${isCurrent ? ", the slide as it is now" : ""}${isApplied ? ", applied" : ""}${o.note ? `. ${o.note}` : ""}`}
          onFocus={() => preview(optionId, true)}
          onPointerDown={(e: PointerEvent) => { pointer.current = e.pointerType; }}
          onPointerEnter={(e: PointerEvent) => { if (e.pointerType === "mouse" && optionId !== previewing) onPreview(optionId); }}
          onClick={() => {
            const touch = pointer.current === "touch" || pointer.current === "pen";
            pointer.current = "";
            if (touch) preview(optionId, true); else apply(o.id);
          }}
          className={cn("group block w-full cursor-pointer rounded-card border bg-surface p-1.5 text-left transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-(--dur-fast) ease-(--ease-out)",
            on ? "border-fg ring-1 ring-fg" : "border-line hover:border-line-strong")}>
          <span aria-hidden className="relative block aspect-video overflow-hidden rounded-[max(2px,calc(var(--radius-card)-7px))] border border-line bg-bg">
            {thumb}
          </span>
          <span className="flex min-h-9 items-start gap-1.5 px-1 pt-1.5">
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span className="line-clamp-2 block text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg">{o.label}</span>
              {o.note && <span className="line-clamp-2 block text-micro text-fg-muted">{o.note}</span>}
            </span>
            {isCurrent ? <Badge className="shrink-0">Current</Badge>
              : isApplied ? <Badge tone="success" className="shrink-0"><CheckIcon aria-hidden width={10} height={10} />Applied</Badge>
              : on ? <Badge className="shrink-0 border-fg">Previewing</Badge> : null}
          </span>
        </button>
      </Reveal>
    );
  };

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`} className={cn("@container min-w-0 space-y-3", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2">
        <H id={`${id}-title`} className="flex min-w-48 flex-1 items-center gap-2 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">
          <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-control bg-lime text-on-lime"><AIMark size={16} /></span>
          <span className="min-w-0">Other layouts{slideName ? <span className="font-normal text-fg-muted"> for {slideName}</span> : null}</span>
        </H>
        {onTextModeChange && (
          <SegmentedControl size="sm" label="Your words" value={textMode} onChange={onTextModeChange}
            options={[{ value: "keep", label: "Keep my words" }, { value: "fit", label: "Shorten to fit" }]} />
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
        {textMode === "keep"
          ? "Your text stays exactly as written. Layouts that cannot fit it are left out."
          : "The AI may shorten text so a layout fits. Each option says what it shortens."}
      </p>

      <p id={`${id}-keys`} className="sr-only">Arrow keys and focus preview a layout on the slide without changing it. Enter applies it. Escape goes back to the current layout.</p>

      <div ref={group} role="radiogroup" aria-label={`Layouts${slideName ? ` for ${slideName}` : ""}`} onKeyDown={onKey}
        onPointerLeave={(e) => { if (e.pointerType === "mouse" && pinned.current !== previewing) onPreview(pinned.current); }}
        className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 @xl:grid-cols-3 @3xl:grid-cols-4">
        {tile({ id: CURRENT, label: current.label ?? "Current layout" }, current.thumbnail, 0)}
        {showOptions && options.map((o, i) => tile(o, o.thumbnail, i + 1))}
        {waiting > 0 && Array.from({ length: waiting }, (_, i) => (
          <div key={`wait-${i}`} aria-hidden className="min-w-0 rounded-card border border-dashed border-line-strong bg-surface p-1.5">
            <div className="flex aspect-video items-center justify-center rounded-xs bg-sunken text-fg-subtle"><AIMark size={16} /></div>
            <div className="flex min-h-9 items-start px-1 pt-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">Making a layout</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {state === "none" && (
        <div className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4">
          <p className="text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">No good layouts for this slide</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{noneReason ?? "Rather than show weak options, the AI showed none. Changing the content usually opens up new layouts."}</p>
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {onEditText && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<EditIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onEditText}>Edit text</Button>}
            {onMore && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onMore}>Try again</Button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {state === "failed" && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4">
          <AlertIcon aria-hidden width={18} height={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-danger-fg" />
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">{options.length ? "Could not make more layouts" : "Could not make layouts"}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{error ?? "Something went wrong on our side. Your slide has not changed."}</p>
          </div>
          {onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<RetryIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onRetry}>Try again</Button>}
        </div>
      )}

      {previewOption && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken p-3">
          <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg"><span className="font-medium">Previewing {previewOption.label}.</span> <span className="text-fg-muted">Not applied yet.</span></p>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => preview(null, true)}>Back to current</Button>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => apply(previewOption.id)}>Apply layout</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {applied && !previewOption && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3">
          <CheckIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="shrink-0 text-success-fg" />
          <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg"><span className="font-medium">{applied.label} applied.</span></p>
          {onUndo && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<UndoIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={() => { onUndo(); setSaid("Layout change undone."); }}>Undo</Button>}
        </div>
      )}

      {onMore && state !== "none" && (state === "ready" || (state === "failed" && options.length > 0)) && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<AIMark size={16} />} onClick={onMore}>More layouts</Button>
          {cost && <span className="text-micro text-fg-muted">{cost}</span>}
        </div>
      )}

      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{said}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/LikenessConsent.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, ApproveIcon, CameraIcon, HistoryIcon, InfoIcon, LockIcon, MicIcon, ShieldIcon, SparkleIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { headingTag, subHeadingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { AttentionDot } from "../atoms/AttentionDot";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Callout } from "../molecules/Callout";
import { InlineConfirm } from "../molecules/InlineConfirm";
import { RadioGroup } from "../molecules/RadioGroup";
import { VoiceConsentCheck, type VoiceConsentCheckProps } from "./VoiceConsentCheck";

export type LikenessStatus =
  | "notRequested" | "pending" | "expired" | "recording" | "reviewing"
  | "accepted" | "rejected" | "revoked" | "notRealPerson";
export type LikenessKind = "face" | "voice" | "faceAndVoice";
export type LikenessAudience = "onlyMe" | "approved" | "workspace" | "anyone";

export interface LikenessUse { who: string; what: string; when: string }

export interface LikenessConsentProps {
  /** The person whose face or voice it is, for example "Asha Rao". For a made-up avatar, its name. */
  subjectName: string;
  kind?: LikenessKind;
  status: LikenessStatus;
  /** How long the consent link has left, worked out by your code and written in words, for example "23 hours". Links last 24 hours. */
  linkExpiresIn?: string;
  /** Why the recording was not accepted, in plain words. */
  rejectionReason?: string;
  /** When consent was given or revoked, written by your code, for example "2 October". */
  decidedOn?: string;
  /** Who may use the likeness. Starts at the narrowest choice. */
  audience?: LikenessAudience;
  onAudienceChange?: (audience: LikenessAudience) => void;
  /** Audience choices to offer, in order. Leave "anyone" out unless your product allows it. */
  audienceOptions?: LikenessAudience[];
  /** True when the viewer is the person in the likeness (or its owner) and may change who uses it or revoke it. */
  canManage?: boolean;
  /** Where it has been used, newest first. The owner is told each time. */
  usage?: LikenessUse[];
  /** Send the subject a link to record on their own device. Also "Send a new link" after expiry or rejection. */
  onSendLink?: () => void;
  /** The subject is here: record on this device instead of sending a link. */
  onRecordHere?: () => void;
  /** Withdraw a pending request. */
  onCancelRequest?: () => void;
  onRevoke?: () => void;
  /** Props for the recording step, passed to VoiceConsentCheck with subject="likeness". Needed when status is "recording". */
  check?: Omit<VoiceConsentCheckProps, "subject" | "headingLevel">;
  /** Set when avatars of real people are not allowed where the viewer is. Nothing can be requested and the message says why. */
  region?: { allowed: boolean; message?: string };
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const kindWords: Record<LikenessKind, { thing: string; Icon: typeof CameraIcon }> = {
  face: { thing: "face", Icon: CameraIcon },
  voice: { thing: "voice", Icon: MicIcon },
  faceAndVoice: { thing: "face and voice", Icon: CameraIcon },
};

const audienceText: Record<LikenessAudience, { label: string; description: string }> = {
  onlyMe: { label: "Only the person in it", description: "Nobody else can pick this likeness." },
  approved: { label: "People they approve", description: "Each person is approved by name." },
  workspace: { label: "Everyone in this workspace", description: "Anyone on the team can use it in their takes." },
  anyone: { label: "Anyone with the link", description: "Widest choice. Hard to keep track of." },
};

const stepNames = ["Ask", "Record", "Review", "Ready"] as const;
const stepOf: Partial<Record<LikenessStatus, number>> = { notRequested: 0, pending: 1, expired: 1, recording: 1, reviewing: 2, rejected: 2, accepted: 3 };

/**
 * Consent for using a real person's face or voice in avatars and takes. The person records it themselves (a link to their
 * own phone, or here with VoiceConsentCheck), the link lasts 24 hours, and the status is always written out. The person
 * in it decides who may use it and can revoke it, and every use is listed. Amber shows only while that person still has
 * to act. There is no way to make a likeness from an uploaded photo.
 */
export function LikenessConsent({
  subjectName, kind = "faceAndVoice", status, linkExpiresIn, rejectionReason, decidedOn, audience = "onlyMe", onAudienceChange,
  audienceOptions = ["onlyMe", "approved", "workspace"], canManage = false, usage = [], onSendLink, onRecordHere, onCancelRequest, onRevoke,
  check, region, headingLevel = 2, className,
}: LikenessConsentProps) {
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const H2 = subHeadingTag(headingLevel);
  const headId = useId();
  const headRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const first = subjectName.split(" ")[0];
  const { thing, Icon } = kindWords[kind];
  const blockedRegion = region && !region.allowed;

  // When the status changes and the pressed button went away, start keyboard and screen reader users at the heading.
  // A change that arrives from elsewhere (the subject accepted) never takes focus from what the viewer is doing.
  const firstRender = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (firstRender.current) { firstRender.current = false; return; }
    const a = document.activeElement;
    if (!a || a === document.body || !a.isConnected) headRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [status]);

  const badge: Record<LikenessStatus, ReactNode> = {
    notRequested: <Badge>Not requested</Badge>,
    pending: <Badge tone="warning"><span aria-hidden className="size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-attention" />Waiting for {first}</Badge>,
    expired: <Badge><HistoryIcon width={12} height={12} />Link expired</Badge>,
    recording: <Badge tone="warning"><span aria-hidden className="size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-attention" />{first} is recording</Badge>,
    reviewing: <Badge><ShieldIcon width={12} height={12} />Checking the recording</Badge>,
    accepted: <Badge tone="success"><ApproveIcon width={12} height={12} />Consent given</Badge>,
    rejected: <Badge tone="danger"><AlertIcon width={12} height={12} />Not accepted</Badge>,
    revoked: <Badge><LockIcon width={12} height={12} />Revoked</Badge>,
    notRealPerson: <Badge><SparkleIcon width={12} height={12} />Not a real person</Badge>,
  };

  const heading =
    status === "notRequested" ? `Ask ${first} for consent`
    : status === "pending" ? `Waiting for ${first} to record`
    : status === "expired" ? "The link expired"
    : status === "recording" ? `${first} is recording`
    : status === "reviewing" ? "Checking the recording"
    : status === "accepted" ? `${first} said yes`
    : status === "rejected" ? "The recording was not accepted"
    : status === "revoked" ? `${first} withdrew consent`
    : "Made-up avatar";

  const announce =
    status === "pending" ? `Waiting for ${first} to record.${linkExpiresIn ? ` The link expires in ${linkExpiresIn}.` : ""}`
    : status === "accepted" ? `${first} gave consent.`
    : status === "rejected" ? "The recording was not accepted."
    : status === "revoked" ? "Consent revoked. The likeness can no longer be used."
    : status === "expired" ? "The link expired."
    : status === "reviewing" ? "Checking the recording."
    : "";

  const step = stepOf[status];
  const usable = status === "accepted" || status === "notRealPerson";

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headId}
      className={cn("flex w-full min-w-0 flex-col gap-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 sm:p-6", className)}>
      <header className="space-y-2">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <p className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">
            <Icon width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{status === "notRealPerson" ? `Avatar: ${subjectName}` : `${subjectName}'s ${thing}`}</span>
          </p>
          {badge[status]}
        </div>
        {step !== undefined && (
          <ol aria-label="Steps" className="flex gap-1">
            {stepNames.map((n, i) => (
              <li key={n} aria-current={i === step ? "step" : undefined} className="flex-1 space-y-1">
                <span className={cn("block h-1 rounded-full", i < step || (i === step && status === "accepted") ? "bg-fg" : i === step ? "bg-fg-muted" : "bg-line")} />
                <span className={cn("block text-small leading-4.5", i === step ? "font-medium text-fg" : "text-fg-subtle")}>
                  {n}<span className="sr-only">{i < step || status === "accepted" ? ", done" : i === step ? ", current" : ""}</span>
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        )}
        <H id={headId} ref={headRef} tabIndex={-1} className="text-subhead font-semibold text-fg outline-none">{heading}</H>
      </header>

      {blockedRegion && status !== "notRealPerson" && (
        <Callout tone="info" title="Not available where you are">
          {region?.message ?? "Avatars of real people are not offered in your region. Made-up avatars still work."}
        </Callout>
      )}

      {status === "notRequested" && !blockedRegion && (
        <div className="space-y-2 text-compact text-fg">
          <p>{first} records a short video on their own device and reads a few lines aloud. That recording is the consent. A photo is not enough.</p>
          <p className="text-fg-muted">The link lasts 24 hours. {first} can say no, and can withdraw consent at any time later.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {status === "pending" && (
        <div className="space-y-2 text-compact text-fg">
          <p className="flex items-start gap-2"><span className="mt-1.5 flex shrink-0"><AttentionDot label={`Needs ${first}`} /></span>
            <span>We sent {first} a link to record on their phone.{linkExpiresIn ? ` It expires in ${linkExpiresIn}.` : " It lasts 24 hours."}</span></p>
          <p className="text-fg-muted">Nothing can be made with this likeness until {first} records and agrees.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {status === "expired" && (
        <p className="text-compact text-fg">{first} did not record within 24 hours, so the link stopped working. Nothing was saved. Send a new link if you still need it.</p>
      )}

      {status === "recording" && (check
        ? <VoiceConsentCheck {...check} subject="likeness" headingLevel={Math.min(headingLevel + 1, 6) as HeadingLevel} className="border-0 p-0 sm:p-0" />
        : <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">{first} is recording on their own device. This updates when they finish.</p>)}

      {status === "reviewing" && (
        <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">We are checking that the person in the video read the lines and agreed. This usually takes a minute. You can leave this page.</p>
      )}

      {status === "rejected" && (
        <div className="space-y-2 text-compact text-fg">
          <p>{rejectionReason ?? "The recording did not show clear agreement."}</p>
          <p className="text-fg-muted">Nothing was made from it. {first} can record again with a new link.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {status === "revoked" && (
        <div className="space-y-2 text-compact text-fg">
          <p>{decidedOn ? `On ${decidedOn}, ${first}` : first} withdrew consent. Nobody can use this likeness in new takes.</p>
          <p className="text-fg-muted">Takes already made stay in their projects, labelled as using a withdrawn likeness. Ask {first} again to use it.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {status === "notRealPerson" && (
        <p className="text-compact text-fg">This avatar was made from a description, not from a real person, so nobody's consent is needed. It cannot be changed to look or sound like a real person.</p>
      )}

      {status === "accepted" && (
        <p className="text-compact text-fg">{first} recorded and agreed{decidedOn ? ` on ${decidedOn}` : ""}. Only {first} can change who uses it or withdraw it.</p>
      )}

      {usable && (
        <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-line pt-4">
          {canManage && onAudienceChange
            ? <RadioGroup label="Who can use it" value={audience} onChange={(v) => onAudienceChange(v as LikenessAudience)}
                options={audienceOptions.map((a) => ({ value: a, ...audienceText[a] }))} />
            : <div className="space-y-1">
                <H2 className="text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">Who can use it</H2>
                <p className="text-compact text-fg">{audienceText[audience].label}</p>
                {status === "accepted" && !canManage && <p className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">Only {first} can change this.</p>}
              </div>}
        </div>
      )}

      {(status === "accepted" || status === "revoked") && (
        <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-line pt-4">
          <H2 className="text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">Where it was used</H2>
          {usage.length === 0
            ? <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">Not used yet. {first} is told each time someone uses it.</p>
            : <>
                <p className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">Used in {usage.length} {usage.length === 1 ? "take" : "takes"}. {first} is told each time.</p>
                <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
                  {usage.map((u, i) => (
                    <li key={i} className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-3 py-1.5 text-compact">
                      <span className="min-w-0 text-fg">{u.who} <span className="text-fg-muted">used it in</span> {u.what}</span>
                      <span className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">{u.when}</span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </>}
        </div>
      )}

      {(() => {
        const actions: ReactNode[] = [];
        if (!blockedRegion && (status === "notRequested" || status === "expired" || status === "rejected" || status === "revoked")) {
          if (onSendLink) actions.push(<Button key="send" onClick={onSendLink}>{status === "notRequested" ? `Send ${first} a link` : "Send a new link"}</Button>);
          if (onRecordHere) actions.push(<Button key="here" variant="secondary" leading={<Icon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onRecordHere}>{first} is here: record now</Button>);
        }
        if (status === "pending") {
          if (onSendLink) actions.push(<Button key="resend" variant="secondary" onClick={onSendLink}>Send the link again</Button>);
          if (onRecordHere) actions.push(<Button key="here" variant="secondary" leading={<Icon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onRecordHere}>{first} is here: record now</Button>);
          if (onCancelRequest) actions.push(<Button key="cancel" variant="ghost" leading={<XIcon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onCancelRequest}>Cancel request</Button>);
        }
        if (status === "accepted" && canManage && onRevoke) {
          actions.push(<InlineConfirm key="revoke" tone="danger" confirmLabel="Revoke" cancelLabel="Keep it" onConfirm={onRevoke}
            question={`Stop all new use of ${first}'s ${thing}?`}>Revoke consent</InlineConfirm>);
        }
        return actions.length ? <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line pt-4 max-sm:[&>button]:flex-1">{actions}</div> : null;
      })()}

      {status !== "recording" && status !== "notRealPerson" && <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-subtle"><InfoIcon width={14} height={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
        Consent covers this workspace only. It does not give anyone ownership of {first}'s likeness.</p>}
      <p role="status" className="sr-only">{announce}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/LineChart.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import type { DataTableProps } from "../molecules/DataTable";
import { formatNumber, niceTicks, useElementWidth, usePrefersReducedMotion } from "../molecules/ChartFrame";
import { ChartLegend, SeriesMark, seriesStyle } from "./ChartLegend";

export interface LineSeries {
  /** Stable id. Color follows the series position, so keep the order fixed. */
  id: string;
  /** Name shown in the legend, end label, tooltip and table. */
  label: string;
  /** One value per x position. Use null for a gap. */
  data: (number | null)[];
  /** Index of the first projected point. Points from here on are dotted, and the line is solid before it. */
  projectionFrom?: number;
}

export interface LineChartProps {
  /** Up to five series. Extra series are ignored. Fold the tail into one "Other" series before passing it in. */
  series: LineSeries[];
  /** X labels, one per data position, already formatted for display. */
  x: string[];
  /** Formats values on the axis, in labels and in the tooltip. */
  formatValue?: (n: number) => string;
  /** Unit word read after each value by screen readers, for example "milliseconds". */
  unit?: string;
  /** Plot height in px, including the x axis band. Minimum 160. */
  height?: number;
  /** Fixed y domain. Overrides zeroBaseline. */
  yDomain?: [number, number];
  /** Start the y axis at zero when every value is non-negative. Turn off only for data where zero is meaningless. */
  zeroBaseline?: boolean;
  /** The latest point of each series is hollow because it is not final yet. */
  streaming?: boolean;
  /** Reveal the lines once on mount. Skipped when the person prefers reduced motion. */
  animate?: boolean;
  /** Name for the chart region, for example "p95 latency by model". */
  ariaLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const MAX_SERIES = 5;

function seg(vals: (number | null)[], from: number, to: number, px: (i: number) => number, py: (v: number) => number): string {
  let d = "";
  let pen = false;
  for (let i = Math.max(0, from); i <= Math.min(vals.length - 1, to); i++) {
    const v = vals[i];
    if (v === null || v === undefined) { pen = false; continue; }
    d += `${pen ? "L" : "M"}${px(i).toFixed(1)} ${py(v).toFixed(1)}`;
    pen = true;
  }
  return d;
}

/**
 * Multi-series line chart drawn in SVG at real pixel size. Solid lines are actuals and dotted lines are projections.
 * The plot takes focus: arrow keys step through points and each point is announced as "Series, x, value, unit".
 * The tooltip shows on focus, pointer and tap and never depends on hover.
 */
export function LineChart({ series: all, x, formatValue = formatNumber, unit = "", height = 240, yDomain, zeroBaseline = true, streaming, animate, ariaLabel = "Line chart", className }: LineChartProps) {
  const series = all.slice(0, MAX_SERIES);
  const [ref, measured] = useElementWidth<HTMLDivElement>();
  const reduced = usePrefersReducedMotion();
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement | null>(null);
  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const cid = `clip-${useId().replace(/:/g, "")}`;
  const [active, setActive] = useState<{ s: number; i: number } | null>(null);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(!animate);
  useEffect(() => { if (animate && !reduced) { const t = requestAnimationFrame(() => setRevealed(true)); return () => cancelAnimationFrame(t); } setRevealed(true); }, [animate, reduced]);

  const w = measured || 640;
  const h = Math.max(160, height);
  const n = x.length;
  const all_ = series.flatMap((s) => s.data).filter((v): v is number => typeof v === "number");
  const dMin = all_.length ? Math.min(...all_) : 0;
  const dMax = all_.length ? Math.max(...all_) : 1;
  const ticks = yDomain ? niceTicks(yDomain[0], yDomain[1]) : niceTicks(zeroBaseline && dMin >= 0 ? 0 : dMin, dMax);
  const lo = yDomain ? yDomain[0] : ticks[0];
  const hi = yDomain ? yDomain[1] : ticks[ticks.length - 1];
  const tickLabels = ticks.map((t) => formatValue(t));
  const left = Math.max(28, Math.max(...tickLabels.map((t) => t.length)) * 6.6 + 14);
  const endY = (s: LineSeries) => {
    for (let i = s.data.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (s.data[i] !== null && s.data[i] !== undefined) return i;
    return -1;
  };

  const plotTop = 12;
  const plotBottom = h - 28;
  const py = (v: number) => plotBottom - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (plotBottom - plotTop);

  const labelsWanted = series.length >= 2 && series.length <= 4 && w >= 480;
  const endYs = series.map((s) => { const e = endY(s); return e >= 0 ? py(s.data[e] as number) : -999; }).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const collide = endYs.some((v, i) => i > 0 && v - endYs[i - 1] < 14);
  const direct = labelsWanted && !collide;
  const clip = (t: string) => (t.length > 20 ? `${t.slice(0, 19)}…` : t);
  const right = direct ? Math.min(150, Math.max(...series.map((s) => clip(s.label).length)) * 6.4 + 24) : 24;
  const pw = Math.max(40, w - left - right);
  const px = (i: number) => left + (n <= 1 ? pw / 2 : (i * pw) / (n - 1));

  const xw = Math.max(0, ...x.map((t) => t.length)) * 6.4 + 14;
  const stepK = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(xw / (n > 1 ? pw / (n - 1) : pw)));

  const pf = (s: LineSeries) => s.projectionFrom ?? n;
  const readout = (s: number, i: number) => {
    const sr = series[s];
    const v = sr.data[i];
    const tail = i >= pf(sr) ? ", projected" : streaming && i === endY(sr) ? ", provisional" : "";
    return `${sr.label}, ${x[i]}, ${v === null || v === undefined ? "no data" : `${formatValue(v)}${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ""}`}${tail}`;
  };

  const step = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!n || !series.length) return;
    const cur = active ?? { s: 0, i: n - 1 };
    let { s, i } = cur;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") i = Math.min(n - 1, i + 1);
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") i = Math.max(0, i - 1);
    else if (e.key === "Home") i = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") i = n - 1;
    else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") s = Math.min(series.length - 1, s + 1);
    else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") s = Math.max(0, s - 1);
    else if (e.key === "Escape") { setActive(null); setSaid(""); return; }
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive({ s, i });
    setSaid(readout(s, i));
  };

  const point = (e: PointerEvent<SVGRectElement>) => {
    const r = svgRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!r || !n) return;
    const i = n <= 1 ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round(((e.clientX - r.left - left) / pw) * (n - 1))));
    const yy = e.clientY - r.top;
    let best = 0, bd = Infinity;
    series.forEach((s, si) => { const v = s.data[i]; if (v === null || v === undefined) return; const d = Math.abs(py(v) - yy); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = si; } });
    setActive({ s: best, i });
  };

  const ai = active?.i ?? -1;
  const tipRight = ai >= 0 && px(ai) > w / 2;

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cn("relative min-w-0", className)}>
      {series.length >= 2 && <ChartLegend items={series.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, label: s.label }))} />}
      <div ref={wrapRef} tabIndex={0} role="group" aria-roledescription="line chart"
        aria-label={`${ariaLabel}. ${series.length} series, ${n} points. Use arrow keys to step through points.`}
        onKeyDown={step} onFocus={() => { if (n) setActive((p) => p ?? { s: 0, i: n - 1 }); }}
        onBlur={() => { setActive(null); setSaid(""); }}
        className="relative rounded-lg focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--focus-ring)]">
        <svg ref={svgRef} width={w} height={h} viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} className="block max-w-full touch-pan-y select-none" aria-hidden focusable="false"
          style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: "var(--text-small)" }}>
          <defs>
            <clipPath id={cid}>
              <rect x={0} y={0} height={h} width={revealed ? w : 0} style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "width var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-arrive)" }} />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>
          {ticks.map((t, i) => (
            <g key={t}>
              <line x1={left} x2={left + pw} y1={py(t)} y2={py(t)} stroke={i === 0 ? "var(--chart-axis)" : "var(--chart-grid)"} strokeWidth={i === 0 ? 1 : 0.5} shapeRendering="crispEdges" />
              <text x={left - 8} y={py(t)} textAnchor="end" dominantBaseline="central" fill="var(--fg-muted)" style={{ fontVariantNumeric: "tabular-nums" }}>{tickLabels[i]}</text>
            </g>
          ))}
          {x.map((t, i) => {
            if (i % stepK !== 0) return null;
            const half = (t.length * 6.4) / 2;
            const cx = px(i);
            const anchor = cx - half < 0 ? "start" : cx + half > w ? "end" : "middle";
            return <text key={i} x={anchor === "start" ? Math.max(0, cx - half) : cx} y={plotBottom + 18} textAnchor={anchor} fill="var(--fg-muted)">{t}</text>;
          })}
          {ai >= 0 && <line x1={px(ai)} x2={px(ai)} y1={plotTop} y2={plotBottom} stroke="var(--chart-axis)" strokeWidth={1} shapeRendering="crispEdges" />}
          <g clipPath={`url(#${cid})`}>
            {series.map((s, si) => {
              const st = seriesStyle(si);
              const p = pf(s);
              return (
                <g key={s.id}>
                  <path d={seg(s.data, 0, p - 1, px, py)} fill="none" stroke={st.color} strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeDasharray={st.dash} />
                  {p < n && <path d={seg(s.data, p - 1, n - 1, px, py)} fill="none" stroke={st.color} strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray="0.1 5" />}
                </g>
              );
            })}
          </g>
          {series.map((s, si) => {
            const e = endY(s);
            if (e < 0) return null;
            const st = seriesStyle(si);
            return (
              <g key={s.id}>
                <SeriesMark shape={st.shape} cx={px(e)} cy={py(s.data[e] as number)} color={st.color} hollow={streaming} />
                {direct && <text x={px(e) + 11} y={py(s.data[e] as number)} dominantBaseline="central" fill="var(--fg)" style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{clip(s.label)}</text>}
              </g>
            );
          })}
          {ai >= 0 && series.map((s, si) => {
            const v = s.data[ai];
            if (v === null || v === undefined || ai === endY(s)) return null;
            const st = seriesStyle(si);
            return <SeriesMark key={s.id} shape={st.shape} cx={px(ai)} cy={py(v)} color={st.color} r={active?.s === si ? 5.5 : 4.5} />;
          })}
          <rect x={left} y={0} width={pw + Math.min(right, 12)} height={plotBottom + 4} fill="transparent" onPointerMove={point} onPointerDown={point}
            onPointerLeave={(e) => { if (e.pointerType === "mouse" && document.activeElement !== wrapRef.current) setActive(null); }} />
        </svg>
        {ai >= 0 && (
          <div aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10 min-w-36 max-w-64 rounded-overlay border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-small leading-4 shadow-md"
            style={{ top: plotTop, left: px(ai), transform: `translateX(${tipRight ? "calc(-100% - 12px)" : "12px"})` }}>
            <p className="mb-1 text-fg-muted">{x[ai]}</p>
            {series.map((s, si) => {
              const v = s.data[ai];
              const st = seriesStyle(si);
              return (
                <p key={s.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 leading-5">
                  <svg width={18} height={10} viewBox="0 0 18 10" aria-hidden><line x1={0} x2={18} y1={5} y2={5} stroke={st.color} strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray={st.dash} /></svg>
                  <span className={cn("flex-1 text-fg-muted", active?.s === si && "font-medium text-fg")}>{s.label}</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-fg [font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums]">{v === null || v === undefined ? "No data" : formatValue(v)}</span>
                  {v !== null && v !== undefined && (ai >= pf(s) ? <span className="text-fg-subtle">projected</span> : streaming && ai === endY(s) ? <span className="text-fg-subtle">provisional</span> : null)}
                </p>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="sr-only" aria-live="polite" role="status">{said}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Table data for ChartFrame's table view, with one column per series. */
export function lineChartTable(x: string[], series: LineSeries[], opts: { xHeader: string; caption: string; formatValue?: (n: number) => string; unit?: string }): DataTableProps {
  const f = opts.formatValue ?? formatNumber;
  return {
    caption: opts.caption,
    columns: [{ key: "x", header: opts.xHeader }, ...series.slice(0, MAX_SERIES).map((s) => ({ key: s.id, header: opts.unit ? `${s.label} (${opts.unit})` : s.label, numeric: true }))],
    rows: x.map((label, i) => {
      const row: Record<string, string> = { x: label };
      series.slice(0, MAX_SERIES).forEach((s) => {
        const v = s.data[i];
        row[s.id] = v === null || v === undefined ? "No data" : `${f(v)}${s.projectionFrom !== undefined && i >= s.projectionFrom ? " (projected)" : ""}`;
      });
      return row;
    }),
  };
}
```

## tattva/organisms/LiveCaptions.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";
import { AIMark } from "../atoms/AIMark";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { JumpToLatest } from "../molecules/JumpToLatest";

export type CaptionStatus = "interim" | "final" | "interrupted" | "redacted";
export type CaptionSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl";

export interface CaptionLine {
  /** Stable id. An interim line keeps its id when it becomes final, so it settles in place. */
  id: string;
  /** "person", "assistant", or any other speaker key for calls and rooms. */
  speaker: "person" | "assistant" | (string & {});
  /** For redacted lines, write `[hidden]` where the secret was; never pass the secret itself. */
  text: string;
  status: CaptionStatus;
  /** Interrupted lines: how many characters were actually played before the person cut in. */
  spokenUpTo?: number;
  /** Already formatted time or offset, such as "00:42". */
  at?: string;
  /** Redacted lines: what the hidden part was, shown in brackets. Defaults to "number hidden". */
  hiddenLabel?: string;
}

export interface LiveCaptionsProps {
  /** Every line so far, oldest first. Update an interim line by id until it is final. */
  lines: CaptionLine[];
  /** Captions on or off. Keep this setting for the person across sessions. */
  visible?: boolean;
  onVisibleChange?: (visible: boolean) => void;
  /** Caption text size. Defaults to lg on a narrow screen and md elsewhere. Store the person's choice. */
  size?: CaptionSize;
  onSizeChange?: (size: CaptionSize) => void;
  /** Keep the newest line in view. Scrolling up turns it off until the person returns to the bottom. */
  follow?: boolean;
  onFollowChange?: (follow: boolean) => void;
  /** Make each line a button that jumps the audio to it (for recordings, not live calls). */
  onSeek?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Names to show for each speaker key. */
  speakerLabels?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Speaker keys that are AI. Their labels carry the AI mark. */
  aiSpeakers?: string[];
  /** Interrupted lines: show the unspoken rest struck through, or leave it out. */
  unspoken?: "show" | "hide";
  /** Read each finished AI line aloud to screen readers, for people who mute the audio. Off by default. */
  announceFinal?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the caption log, also shown as its heading. */
  label?: string;
  /** Shown when there are no lines yet. */
  emptyText?: ReactNode;
  /** Show the size control and the Hide button in the header. */
  controls?: boolean;
  /** Tallest the log grows before it scrolls: spacing steps (64 is 16rem) or a CSS length. */
  maxHeight?: number | string;
  className?: string;
}

const NEAR = 4;
const sizeText: Record<CaptionSize, string> = {
  sm: "text-compact",
  md: "text-body-lg",
  lg: "text-subhead",
  xl: "text-title-sm",
};
const sizeOptions: { value: CaptionSize; label: string; description: string }[] = [
  { value: "sm", label: "S", description: "Small captions" },
  { value: "md", label: "M", description: "Medium captions" },
  { value: "lg", label: "L", description: "Large captions" },
  { value: "xl", label: "XL", description: "Extra large captions" },
];
const narrow = () => typeof window !== "undefined" && !!window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(max-width: 37.5rem)").matches;

/** Interim text has no end punctuation, so it never looks finished. */
const unfinished = (t: string) => t.replace(/[.!?。]+\s*$/, "");

function Redacted({ text, hiddenLabel = "number hidden" }: { text: string; hiddenLabel?: string }) {
  const chip = (k: number) => (
    <span key={k} className="inline-block rounded-control bg-sunken px-1.5 text-fg-muted">[{hiddenLabel}]</span>
  );
  const parts = text.split("[hidden]");
  if (parts.length === 1) return <>{text} {chip(0)}</>;
  return <>{parts.flatMap((p, i) => (i === 0 ? [p] : [chip(i), p]))}</>;
}

/**
 * A streaming, two-sided caption log for voice. Interim words are lighter with no full stop and settle in place.
 * When the person cuts the assistant off, the words it never said are struck through and named "Not spoken".
 * It follows the newest line until the person scrolls up, then offers Jump to latest. It is a log that people
 * read on demand; it does not read every word aloud.
 */
export function LiveCaptions({
  lines, visible, onVisibleChange, size, onSizeChange, follow = true, onFollowChange, onSeek,
  speakerLabels, aiSpeakers = ["assistant"], unspoken = "show", announceFinal = false, label = "Captions",
  emptyText = "Captions appear here as you talk.", controls = true, maxHeight = 64, className,
}: LiveCaptionsProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const headId = useId();
  const scroller = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const names: Record<string, string> = { person: "You", assistant: "Assistant", ...speakerLabels };
  const isAI = (s: string) => aiSpeakers.includes(s);

  // visible and size work with or without the parent controlling them.
  const [ownVisible, setOwnVisible] = useState(visible ?? true);
  const on = visible ?? ownVisible;
  const setVisible = (v: boolean) => { setOwnVisible(v); onVisibleChange?.(v); };
  const [ownSize, setOwnSize] = useState<CaptionSize>(() => size ?? (narrow() ? "lg" : "md"));
  const textSize = size ?? ownSize;
  const setSize = (s: CaptionSize) => { setOwnSize(s); onSizeChange?.(s); };

  const [following, setFollowing] = useState(follow);
  const [prevFollow, setPrevFollow] = useState(follow);
  const [stopAt, setStopAt] = useState<number | null>(null);
  if (prevFollow !== follow) { setPrevFollow(follow); setFollowing(follow); setStopAt(follow ? null : lines.length); }
  const unseen = following || stopAt === null ? 0 : Math.max(0, lines.length - stopAt);
  const setFollow = (v: boolean) => {
    if (v === following) return;
    setFollowing(v);
    setStopAt(v ? null : lines.length);
    onFollowChange?.(v);
  };

  // Only lines that arrive after the first render fade in. An interim line becoming final keeps its id, so it never re-animates.
  const seen = useRef<Set<string> | null>(null);
  if (seen.current === null) seen.current = new Set(lines.map((l) => l.id));
  const fresh = new Set<string>();
  for (const l of lines) if (!seen.current.has(l.id)) fresh.add(l.id);
  useEffect(() => { for (const id of fresh) seen.current?.add(id); });

  const lastText = lines.length ? lines[lines.length - 1].text : "";
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = scroller.current;
    if (el && following) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
  }, [lines.length, lastText, following, textSize, on]);

  const onScroll = () => {
    const el = scroller.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const dist = el.scrollHeight - el.scrollTop - el.clientHeight;
    if (following && dist > NEAR) setFollow(false);
    else if (!following && dist <= NEAR) setFollow(true);
  };
  const toLatest = () => {
    const el = scroller.current;
    if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
    setFollow(true);
  };

  // announceFinal: read each AI line once, when it is final or interrupted (only the part that was spoken).
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  const announced = useRef<Set<string> | null>(null);
  if (announced.current === null) announced.current = new Set(lines.filter((l) => l.status !== "interim").map((l) => l.id));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!announceFinal) return;
    for (const l of lines) {
      if (!isAI(l.speaker) || l.status === "interim" || announced.current?.has(l.id)) continue;
      announced.current?.add(l.id);
      const text = l.status === "interrupted" && l.spokenUpTo != null ? l.text.slice(0, l.spokenUpTo) : l.text.split("[hidden]").join(l.hiddenLabel ?? "number hidden");
      setSaid(`${names[l.speaker] ?? l.speaker}: ${text}`);
    }
  });

  const height: CSSProperties = { maxHeight: typeof maxHeight === "number" ? `calc(var(--spacing) * ${maxHeight})` : maxHeight };

  const body = (l: CaptionLine) => {
    if (l.status === "redacted") return <Redacted text={l.text} hiddenLabel={l.hiddenLabel} />;
    if (l.status === "interim") return <>{unfinished(l.text)}</>;
    if (l.status === "interrupted") {
      const cut = Math.max(0, Math.min(l.text.length, l.spokenUpTo ?? l.text.length));
      const said = l.text.slice(0, cut).trimEnd();
      const rest = l.text.slice(cut).trim();
      return (
        <>
          {said}
          {rest && unspoken === "show" && (
            <> <span className="text-fg-subtle line-through decoration-fg-subtle"><span className="sr-only">Not spoken: </span>{rest}</span></>
          )}
        </>
      );
    }
    return <>{l.text}</>;
  };

  const tag = (l: CaptionLine) =>
    l.status === "interim" ? "Still changing"
    : l.status === "interrupted" ? "Interrupted"
    : l.status === "redacted" ? "Part hidden"
    : "";

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headId} className={cn("flex min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-surface", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2 border-b border-line px-4 py-2">
        <p id={headId} className="mr-auto text-small font-medium text-fg-muted">{label}</p>
        {controls && on && <SegmentedControl size="sm" label="Caption size" options={sizeOptions} value={textSize} onChange={setSize} />}
        {controls && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label={on ? "Hide captions" : "Show captions"} onClick={() => setVisible(!on)} className="tap">
            {on ? "Hide" : "Show"}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      {on ? (
        <div className="relative min-h-0">
          <div ref={scroller} role="log" aria-live="off" aria-labelledby={headId} tabIndex={0} onScroll={onScroll} style={height}
            className="overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain px-4 py-3 focus-visible:[outline-offset:-2px]">
            {lines.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">{emptyText}</p>
            ) : (
              <ol className={cn("flex flex-col gap-3", sizeText[textSize])}>
                {lines.map((l) => {
                  const ai = isAI(l.speaker);
                  const who = names[l.speaker] ?? l.speaker;
                  const t = tag(l);
                  const content = (
                    <>
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-small leading-5">
                        {ai ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-control bg-lime-soft px-1.5 font-medium text-fg">
                            <AIMark size={16} />{who}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="font-medium text-fg-muted">{who}</span>
                        )}
                        {l.at && <span className="font-mono text-fg-subtle tabular-nums">{l.at}</span>}
                        {t && <span className="text-fg-subtle">{t}</span>}
                      </span>
                      <span className={cn("block break-words", l.status === "interim" ? "text-fg-muted" : "text-fg")}>
                        {body(l)}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  );
                  return (
                    <li key={l.id} className={cn("min-w-0", fresh.has(l.id) && !reduced && "animate-fade")}>
                      {onSeek ? (
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => onSeek(l.id)}
                          className="-mx-2 flex w-[calc(100%+var(--spacing)*4)] cursor-pointer flex-col gap-0.5 rounded-control px-2 py-1 text-left hover:bg-hover">
                          {content}
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">{content}</div>
                      )}
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ol>
            )}
          </div>
          <JumpToLatest visible={!following && lines.length > 0} count={unseen} newLabel="New captions" onClick={toLatest} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="px-4 py-3 text-compact text-fg-muted">Captions are off.</p>
      )}
      <p role="status" className="sr-only">{announceFinal ? said : ""}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/LiveLog.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";
import { JumpToLatest } from "../molecules/JumpToLatest";

export type LiveLogLevel = "info" | "warn" | "error";

export interface LiveLogLine {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  /** Already formatted, e.g. "10:42:03". */
  time?: string;
  /** info lines carry no marker. warn and error lines show an icon and a word. */
  level?: LiveLogLevel;
}

export interface LiveLogProps {
  /** Every line so far, oldest first. Append only: new lines go on the end. */
  lines: LiveLogLine[];
  /** Keep the newest line in view. Scrolling up turns it off; scrolling back to the bottom turns it on. */
  follow?: boolean;
  onFollowChange?: (follow: boolean) => void;
  /** Hold new lines back. They wait behind an "N new lines" button. */
  paused?: boolean;
  onPauseChange?: (paused: boolean) => void;
  /** Tallest the log grows before it scrolls: a number of spacing steps (64 is 16rem) or a CSS length such as "var(--container-phone)". */
  maxHeight?: number | string;
  /** Accessible name of the log, also shown as its heading. */
  label: string;
  /** Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways. */
  wrap?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/** At most one spoken update per this many ms, so a burst of lines is read as one summary. */
const SPEAK_GAP = 2000;
/** Lines in a burst after this many arrive together with the last staggered one. */
const STAGGER_CAP = 4;
/** Pixels from the bottom that still count as "at the newest line". */
const NEAR = 4;

const levelMark: Record<Exclude<LiveLogLevel, "info">, { word: string; cls: string; Icon: typeof AlertIcon }> = {
  // Warnings use plain text, not amber: amber is kept for "a person must act".
  warn: { word: "Warning", cls: "text-fg font-medium", Icon: AlertIcon },
  error: { word: "Error", cls: "text-danger-fg font-medium", Icon: XIcon },
};

const spoken = (l: LiveLogLine) => `${l.level && l.level !== "info" ? `${levelMark[l.level].word}: ` : ""}${l.text}`;

/**
 * A streaming, monospaced log of what an agent is doing. It follows the newest line until the person scrolls up,
 * then offers "Jump to latest". Pausing holds new lines back. Screen readers hear single lines as they come and a
 * short summary, at most every 2 seconds, when many arrive at once; nothing is spoken while paused or scrolled up.
 */
export function LiveLog({ lines, follow = true, onFollowChange, paused = false, onPauseChange, maxHeight = 64, label, wrap = false, className }: LiveLogProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const scroller = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const headId = useId();
  // How many lines were showing when the pause began. Lines past that are held.
  const [frozenAt, setFrozenAt] = useState<number | null>(paused ? lines.length : null);
  // How many lines were showing when following stopped, for the Jump to latest count.
  const [stopAt, setStopAt] = useState<number | null>(follow ? null : lines.length);

  // follow and paused work with or without the parent controlling them.
  const [following, setFollowing] = useState(follow);
  const [prevFollow, setPrevFollow] = useState(follow);
  if (prevFollow !== follow) { setPrevFollow(follow); setFollowing(follow); setStopAt(follow ? null : lines.length); }
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(paused);
  const [prevPaused, setPrevPaused] = useState(paused);
  if (prevPaused !== paused) { setPrevPaused(paused); setIsPaused(paused); setFrozenAt(paused ? lines.length : null); }

  const shownCount = isPaused ? Math.min(frozenAt ?? lines.length, lines.length) : lines.length;
  const shown = lines.slice(0, shownCount);
  const held = lines.length - shownCount;
  const unseen = following || stopAt === null ? 0 : Math.max(0, shownCount - stopAt);

  const setFollow = (v: boolean) => {
    if (v === following) return;
    setFollowing(v);
    setStopAt(v ? null : shownCount);
    onFollowChange?.(v);
  };
  const setPause = (v: boolean) => {
    setIsPaused(v);
    setFrozenAt(v ? lines.length : null);
    onPauseChange?.(v);
  };

  // Arrival motion: lines present on first render do not animate. Each later line keeps the delay it got when it
  // first appeared, so a re-render mid-animation does not restart or cut it.
  const delays = useRef<Map<string, number> | null>(null);
  if (delays.current === null) delays.current = new Map(lines.map((l) => [l.id, -1]));
  let burst = 0;
  for (const l of shown) if (!delays.current.has(l.id)) delays.current.set(l.id, Math.min(burst++, STAGGER_CAP));

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = scroller.current;
    if (el && following) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
  }, [shownCount, following, wrap]);

  // Announcements. The log itself is polite while following and not paused, so a lone line is read. During a
  // burst it goes quiet and a status line reads a count instead, no more than once per SPEAK_GAP.
  const live = following && !isPaused;
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState("");
  const lastSpoke = useRef(0);
  const pending = useRef(0);
  const timer = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const prevCount = useRef(shownCount);
  const latest = useRef<LiveLogLine | undefined>(undefined);
  latest.current = shown[shown.length - 1];

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = scroller.current;
    const delta = shownCount - prevCount.current;
    prevCount.current = shownCount;
    if (!el) return;
    if (!live) {
      el.setAttribute("aria-live", "off");
      pending.current = 0;
      if (timer.current !== null) { window.clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = null; }
      return;
    }
    if (delta <= 0) { if (timer.current === null) el.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite"); return; }
    const now = Date.now();
    if (delta === 1 && timer.current === null && now - lastSpoke.current >= SPEAK_GAP) {
      el.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
      lastSpoke.current = now;
      return;
    }
    el.setAttribute("aria-live", "off");
    pending.current += delta;
    if (timer.current !== null) return;
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      timer.current = null;
      const n = pending.current;
      pending.current = 0;
      lastSpoke.current = Date.now();
      const last = latest.current;
      if (n > 0 && last) setSummary(`${n} new ${n === 1 ? "line" : "lines"}. Latest: ${spoken(last)}`);
      scroller.current?.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
    }, Math.max(0, lastSpoke.current + SPEAK_GAP - now));
  }, [shownCount, live]);

  useEffect(() => () => { if (timer.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(timer.current); }, []);

  const onScroll = () => {
    const el = scroller.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const dist = el.scrollHeight - el.scrollTop - el.clientHeight;
    if (following && dist > NEAR) setFollow(false);
    else if (!following && dist <= NEAR) setFollow(true);
  };
  const toLatest = () => {
    const el = scroller.current;
    if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
    setFollow(true);
  };

  const height: CSSProperties = { maxHeight: typeof maxHeight === "number" ? `calc(var(--spacing) * ${maxHeight})` : maxHeight };
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex min-w-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-line px-3 py-1.5">
        <p id={headId} className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-small font-medium text-fg-muted">{label}</p>
        {isPaused && <span className="text-small text-fg-muted">Paused</span>}
        <button type="button" aria-label={`${isPaused ? "Resume" : "Pause"} ${label}`} onClick={() => setPause(!isPaused)}
          className="inline-flex h-7 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-control px-3 text-small text-fg hover:bg-hover tap">
          {isPaused ? "Resume" : "Pause"}
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="relative min-h-0">
        {/* aria-live is set by the effect above, so React never fights it. */}
        <div ref={scroller} role="log" aria-labelledby={headId} tabIndex={0} onScroll={onScroll} style={height}
          className={cn("overflow-auto overscroll-contain px-3 py-2 font-mono text-small text-fg tabular-nums")}>
          {shown.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-fg-muted">Nothing yet.</p>
          ) : (
            <ol className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
              {shown.map((l) => {
                const d = delays.current?.get(l.id) ?? -1;
                const mark = l.level && l.level !== "info" ? levelMark[l.level] : null;
                return (
                  <li key={l.id} style={!reduced && d >= 0 ? { animationDelay: `calc(var(--stagger) * ${d})` } : undefined}
                    className={cn("flex gap-3 leading-5", !reduced && d >= 0 && "animate-blur-in")}>
                    {l.time && <span className="shrink-0 text-fg-subtle">{l.time}</span>}
                    {mark && (
                      <span className={cn("inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1", mark.cls)}>
                        <mark.Icon width={12} height={12} />{mark.word}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className={cn("min-w-0", wrap ? "whitespace-pre-wrap break-words" : "whitespace-pre")}>{l.text}</span>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ol>
          )}
        </div>
        {isPaused && held > 0 ? (
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-3 z-10 flex justify-center">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => { setPause(false); toLatest(); }}
              className="pointer-events-auto inline-flex h-9 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-control border border-line-strong bg-raised px-4 text-compact text-fg shadow-md hover:bg-hover tap">
              <span className="tabular-nums">{held}</span> new {held === 1 ? "line" : "lines"}
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <JumpToLatest visible={!following && shown.length > 0} count={unseen} newLabel="New lines" onClick={toLatest} />
        )}
      </div>
      <p role="status" className="sr-only">{live ? summary : ""}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
