```tsx
import { Fragment, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { CitationMarker } from "../atoms/CitationMarker";
import { CodeBlock } from "../molecules/CodeBlock";

/**
 * Small, dependency-free Markdown renderer for assistant output.
 * - Builds React elements only (no innerHTML), so model output cannot inject markup.
 * - Tolerates partial input: an unclosed code fence renders as code while streaming.
 * - Links are limited to http(s)/mailto. `[1]` becomes a CitationMarker.
 * - Lists nest up to 3 levels by leading-space indentation (2 or 4 spaces per level, or tabs). Each list is ordered or not by its own first item.
 * Supports: headings, paragraphs, bold, italic, inline code, links, lists, blockquotes, tables, hr, fenced code.
 */

const SAFE_URL = /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i;

function inline(text: string, keyBase = ""): ReactNode[] {
  const out: ReactNode[] = [];
  const re = /(`[^`]+`)|(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)|(\*[^*\s][^*]*\*)|(\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\))|(\[(\d{1,2})\])/g;
  let last = 0, m: RegExpExecArray | null, i = 0;
  while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push(text.slice(last, m.index));
    const k = `${keyBase}${i++}`;
    if (m[1]) out.push(<code key={k} className="rounded bg-sunken px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[0.9em]">{m[1].slice(1, -1)}</code>);
    else if (m[2]) out.push(<strong key={k} className="font-semibold">{inline(m[2].slice(2, -2), k)}</strong>);
    else if (m[3]) out.push(<em key={k}>{inline(m[3].slice(1, -1), k)}</em>);
    else if (m[4]) {
      out.push(SAFE_URL.test(m[6])
        ? <a key={k} href={m[6]} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener" className="text-accent-fg underline underline-offset-2 hover:text-accent">{m[5]}</a>
        : <Fragment key={k}>{m[5]}</Fragment>);
    } else if (m[7]) out.push(<CitationMarker key={k} n={Number(m[8])} />);
    last = m.index + m[0].length;
  }
  if (last < text.length) out.push(text.slice(last));
  return out;
}

const isTableSep = (l?: string) => !!l && /^\s*\|?\s*:?-{2,}:?\s*(\|\s*:?-{2,}:?\s*)*\|?\s*$/.test(l);
const cells = (l: string) => l.trim().replace(/^\||\|$/g, "").split("|").map((c) => c.trim());

const LIST_RE = /^([ \t]*)([-*+]|\d+\.)\s+(.*)$/;
const MAX_DEPTH = 3;
interface ListItem { depth: number; ordered: boolean; text: string }

/** Turn consecutive list lines into items with a depth of 0 to 2, from leading whitespace. Tabs count as 4 spaces. */
function listItems(raw: string[]): ListItem[] {
  const stack: number[] = [];
  return raw.map((line) => {
    const m = line.match(LIST_RE)!;
    const indent = m[1].replace(/\t/g, "    ").length;
    while (stack.length && indent < stack[stack.length - 1]) stack.pop();
    if (!stack.length || indent > stack[stack.length - 1]) { if (stack.length < MAX_DEPTH) stack.push(indent); }
    return { depth: stack.length - 1, ordered: /\d/.test(m[2]), text: m[3] };
  });
}

/** Render items from `from` as one list at `depth`. The list is ordered or not by its first item and ends when a sibling of the other type starts. */
function renderList(items: ListItem[], from: number, depth: number, key: string | number): [ReactNode, number] {
  const ordered = items[from].ordered;
  const Tag = ordered ? "ol" : "ul";
  const lis: ReactNode[] = [];
  let i = from;
  while (i < items.length && items[i].depth >= depth) {
    const it = items[i];
    if (it.depth === depth && it.ordered !== ordered) break;
    if (it.depth > depth) break;
    i++;
    let nested: ReactNode = null;
    if (i < items.length && items[i].depth > depth) {
      const nestedNodes: ReactNode[] = [];
      while (i < items.length && items[i].depth > depth) {
        const [node, next] = renderList(items, i, depth + 1, nestedNodes.length);
        nestedNodes.push(node); i = next;
      }
      nested = nestedNodes;
    }
    lis.push(<li key={lis.length}>{inline(it.text)}{nested}</li>);
  }
  return [<Tag key={key} className={`space-y-1 pl-5 ${depth > 0 ? "mt-1 " : ""}${ordered ? "list-decimal" : "list-disc"} marker:text-fg-subtle`}>{lis}</Tag>, i];
}

export function Markdown({ children }: { children: string }) {
  const lines = children.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  const blocks: ReactNode[] = [];
  let i = 0, k = 0;

  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i];
    if (!line.trim()) { i++; continue; }

    const fence = line.match(/^```\s*([\w+-]*)/);
    if (fence) {
      const buf: string[] = []; i++;
      while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].startsWith("```")) buf.push(lines[i++]);
      i++; // closing fence (may be missing while streaming)
      blocks.push(<CodeBlock key={k++} language={fence[1] || "text"} code={buf.join("\n")} />);
      continue;
    }
    const h = line.match(/^(#{1,4})\s+(.*)$/);
    if (h) {
      const size = ["text-title-xs leading-7", "text-subhead leading-7", "text-lead leading-6", "text-body-lg"][h[1].length - 1];
      blocks.push(<p key={k++} role="heading" aria-level={h[1].length + 1} className={`${size} mt-2 font-semibold tracking-tight`}>{inline(h[2])}</p>);
      i++; continue;
    }
    if (/^\s*([-*_])\1{2,}\s*$/.test(line)) { blocks.push(<hr key={k++} className="border-line" />); i++; continue; }
    if (line.startsWith(">")) {
      const buf: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && lines[i].startsWith(">")) buf.push(lines[i++].replace(/^>\s?/, ""));
      blocks.push(<blockquote key={k++} className="border-l-2 border-accent-line pl-4 text-fg-muted">{inline(buf.join(" "))}</blockquote>);
      continue;
    }
    if (line.includes("|") && isTableSep(lines[i + 1])) {
      const head = cells(line); i += 2;
      const rows: string[][] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && lines[i].includes("|") && lines[i].trim()) rows.push(cells(lines[i++]));
      blocks.push(
        <div key={k++} tabIndex={0} className="overflow-x-auto rounded-card border border-line">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-body leading-5">
            <thead className="bg-sunken text-fg-muted"><tr>{head.map((c, j) => <th key={j} scope="col" className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">{inline(c)}</th>)}</tr></thead>
            <tbody>{rows.map((r, a) => <tr key={a} className="border-t border-line">{r.map((c, j) => <td key={j} className="px-3 py-2">{inline(c)}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>,
      );
      continue;
    }
    if (LIST_RE.test(line)) {
      const raw: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && LIST_RE.test(lines[i])) raw.push(lines[i++]);
      const items = listItems(raw);
      let at = 0;
      while (at < items.length) {
        // A list that starts indented is still a top-level list, so shift everything up to depth 0.
        const [node, next] = renderList(items, at, 0, k++);
        blocks.push(node); at = next;
      }
      continue;
    }
    const buf: string[] = [];
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() && !/^(```|#{1,4}\s|>|[ \t]*([-*+]|\d+\.)\s)/.test(lines[i]) && !(lines[i].includes("|") && isTableSep(lines[i + 1]))) buf.push(lines[i++]);
    blocks.push(<p key={k++} className="[overflow-wrap:anywhere]">{inline(buf.join(" "))}</p>);
  }
  return <>{blocks}</>;
}

## tattva/organisms/MediaGrid.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { EmptyState } from "../molecules/EmptyState";
import { MediaFrame, type MediaFrameProps, type MediaRatio } from "../molecules/MediaFrame";

export interface MediaGridItem extends Omit<MediaFrameProps, "ratio" | "className"> {
  id: string;
}

export interface MediaGridProps {
  items: MediaGridItem[];
  /** Maximum columns. The grid uses 2 on small screens, 3 from the md breakpoint and 4 from xl, capped by this value. */
  columns?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  /** Ratio shared by every tile, so rows stay even. */
  ratio?: MediaRatio;
  /** Lets people pick tiles with a checkbox button on each one. */
  selectable?: boolean;
  /** Controlled selection, as item ids. */
  selected?: string[];
  onSelectedChange?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** Accessible name of the list. */
  label: string;
  /** Replaces the default empty state. */
  empty?: ReactNode;
  /** Builds the count line. Defaults to "N images". */
  countLabel?: (count: number, selected: number) => string;
  className?: string;
}

const cols: Record<2 | 3 | 4, string> = {
  2: "grid-cols-2",
  3: "grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3",
  4: "grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4",
};

const defaultCount = (n: number, s: number) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? "image" : "images"}${s ? `, ${s} selected` : ""}`;

/**
 * Responsive gallery of MediaFrames with one gap and one ratio. Selection is optional and every control is a native button,
 * so it works with Tab, Enter and Space. When there are no items it shows an EmptyState.
 */
export function MediaGrid({
  items, columns = 4, ratio = "4:3", selectable, selected, onSelectedChange, label, empty, countLabel = defaultCount, className,
}: MediaGridProps) {
  const [inner, setInner] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const picked = selected ?? inner;
  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    const next = picked.includes(id) ? picked.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...picked, id];
    if (selected === undefined) setInner(next);
    onSelectedChange?.(next);
  };

  if (items.length === 0) return <>{empty ?? <EmptyState variant="first-use" title="No images yet" className={className}>Add images and they will appear here.</EmptyState>}</>;

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <p role="status" className="mb-3 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{countLabel(items.length, picked.length)}</p>
      <ul aria-label={label} className={cn("m-0 grid list-none gap-3 p-0", cols[columns])}>
        {items.map((it) => {
          const { id, ...frame } = it;
          const on = picked.includes(id);
          return (
            <li key={id} className="relative min-w-0">
              <div className={cn("rounded-card", on && "ring-2 ring-fg ring-offset-2 ring-offset-bg")}>
                <MediaFrame {...frame} ratio={ratio} />
              </div>
              {selectable && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  role="checkbox"
                  aria-checked={on}
                  aria-label={`Select ${frame.decorative ? `image ${id}` : frame.alt}`}
                  onClick={() => toggle(id)}
                  className={cn(
                    "absolute top-2 right-2 flex size-7 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border",
                    on ? "border-transparent bg-lime text-on-lime" : "border-line-strong bg-surface text-transparent hover:text-fg-subtle",
                  )}
                >
                  <CheckIcon width={14} height={14} />
                </button>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

## tattva/organisms/MemoryList.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useAnnounceChange, useFocusReturn } from "../lib/focus";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Switch } from "../atoms/Switch";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface MemoryEntry {
  id: string;
  /** Short topic heading, for example "Work". */
  topic?: string;
  /** What is remembered. */
  text: string;
  /** Where it applies, for example "All chats" or "This project". */
  scope: string;
}

export interface MemoryListProps {
  entries: MemoryEntry[];
  /** Called with the entry id and new text when an edit is saved. */
  onEdit?: (id: string, text: string) => void;
  /** Called with the entry id when delete is chosen. */
  onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Whether new memories are paused. Controlled when set. */
  paused?: boolean;
  defaultPaused?: boolean;
  onPausedChange?: (paused: boolean) => void;
  /** Whether past chats can be searched for context. Controlled when set. */
  searchChats?: boolean;
  defaultSearchChats?: boolean;
  onSearchChatsChange?: (on: boolean) => void;
  /** Replaces the empty state. */
  emptyState?: ReactNode;
  pauseLabel?: string;
  pauseDescription?: string;
  searchLabel?: string;
  searchDescription?: string;
  /** What screen readers hear after a memory is deleted. */
  deletedMessage?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Private inline glyphs, 24px grid, 1.5 stroke. */
const svg = { width: 16, height: 16, viewBox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeLinecap: "round" as const, strokeLinejoin: "round" as const, "aria-hidden": true };
const PencilIcon = () => <svg {...svg}><path d="M4 20h4L19 9l-4-4L4 16v4zM13.5 6.5l4 4" /></svg>;
const TrashIcon = () => <svg {...svg}><path d="M4 7h16M10 11v6M14 11v6M6 7l1 13h10l1-13M9 7V4h6v3" /></svg>;

function useFlag(controlled: boolean | undefined, initial: boolean, notify?: (v: boolean) => void) {
  const [inner, setInner] = useState(initial);
  return [controlled ?? inner, (v: boolean) => { if (controlled === undefined) setInner(v); notify?.(v); }] as const;
}

/** Memory manager. Two controls on top, then one row per remembered topic with scope, edit and delete. */
export function MemoryList({ entries, onEdit, onDelete, paused, defaultPaused = false, onPausedChange, searchChats, defaultSearchChats = true, onSearchChatsChange, emptyState, pauseLabel = "Pause memory", pauseDescription = "Stop saving new memories. Existing ones stay.", searchLabel = "Search past chats", searchDescription = "Let replies draw on earlier conversations.", deletedMessage = "Memory deleted.", className }: MemoryListProps) {
  const [isPaused, setPaused] = useFlag(paused, defaultPaused, onPausedChange);
  const [isSearch, setSearch] = useFlag(searchChats, defaultSearchChats, onSearchChatsChange);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  // Focus never falls to the page: after Save or Cancel it returns to that memory's Edit button; after a delete it
  // goes to the next memory (or the previous one, or the empty message).
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const empty = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const editButtons = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLButtonElement>());
  const lastEdited = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const afterDelete = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useFocusReturn(editing, root, () => (lastEdited.current ? editButtons.current.get(lastEdited.current) : null));
  const ids = entries.map((e) => e.id).join("|");
  useFocusReturn(ids, root, () => (afterDelete.current ? editButtons.current.get(afterDelete.current) : null) ?? empty.current);
  const said = useAnnounceChange(entries.length, (now, before) => (now < before ? deletedMessage : ""));
  const remove = (id: string) => {
    const i = entries.findIndex((e) => e.id === id);
    afterDelete.current = (entries[i + 1] ?? entries[i - 1])?.id ?? null;
    onDelete?.(id);
  };

  return (
    <div ref={root} className={cn("space-y-4", className)}>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{said}</p>
      <div className="divide-y divide-line rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
        {[{ l: pauseLabel, d: pauseDescription, v: isPaused, s: setPaused }, { l: searchLabel, d: searchDescription, v: isSearch, s: setSearch }].map((r) => (
          <div key={r.l} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3">
            <div className="min-w-0"><p className="text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">{r.l}</p><p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{r.d}</p></div>
            <Switch checked={r.v} onChange={r.s} label={r.l} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {entries.length === 0 ? (
        <div ref={empty} tabIndex={-1} className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-line-strong px-4 py-8 text-center text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{emptyState ?? "Nothing is remembered yet. Memories you save will appear here."}</div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="divide-y divide-line rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
          {entries.map((e) => (
            <li key={e.id} className="px-4 py-3">
              {editing === e.id ? (
                <form className="space-y-2" onSubmit={(ev) => { ev.preventDefault(); onEdit?.(e.id, draft.trim()); lastEdited.current = e.id; setEditing(null); }}>
                  <label className="block text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted" htmlFor={`mem-${e.id}`}>{e.topic ?? "Memory"}</label>
                  <textarea id={`mem-${e.id}`} autoFocus value={draft} onChange={(ev) => setDraft(ev.target.value)} rows={2}
                    className="w-full resize-none rounded-field border border-line-strong bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-body leading-5 text-fg" />
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <Button size="sm" type="submit" disabled={!draft.trim()}>Save</Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { lastEdited.current = e.id; setEditing(null); }}>Cancel</Button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="mb-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      {e.topic && <span className="text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted">{e.topic}</span>}
                      <Badge>{e.scope}</Badge>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-body leading-5 text-fg">{e.text}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-0.5">
                    <IconButton size="sm" ref={(n) => { if (n) editButtons.current.set(e.id, n); else editButtons.current.delete(e.id); }} label={`Edit memory: ${e.topic ?? e.text}`} onClick={() => { setDraft(e.text); setEditing(e.id); }}><PencilIcon /></IconButton>
                    <IconButton size="sm" label={`Delete memory: ${e.topic ?? e.text}`} onClick={() => remove(e.id)}><TrashIcon /></IconButton>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Labelled log for a thread. New messages are announced politely. A streaming Message opts its own text out

## tattva/organisms/MessageQueue.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { ChevronIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Kbd } from "../atoms/Kbd";

export interface QueuedMessage {
  id: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface MessageQueueProps {
  items: QueuedMessage[];
  /** Sends this message now instead of waiting for its turn. */
  onSendNow?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Moves a message one place earlier or later. The parent reorders `items`. */
  onMove?: (id: string, direction: "up" | "down") => void;
  onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
  title?: string;
  /** Explains queueing against steering. Replace it with your own product wording. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  emptyText?: string;
  /** Shortcut shown beside Send now on the first item, for example "Ctrl Enter". Omit to hide. */
  sendNowShortcut?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Messages the person sent while the assistant was working. They show in a pending style, and can be sent now, reordered or removed. */
export function MessageQueue({
  items, onSendNow, onMove, onDelete, title = "Queued", sendNowShortcut, className, emptyText = "Nothing queued. Messages you send while the assistant works will wait here.",
  description = "Queued messages send in order when the assistant finishes this step. To change what it is doing now, steer it instead.",
}: MessageQueueProps) {
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const move = (id: string, i: number, dir: "up" | "down") => {
    setNote(`Message moved to position ${dir === "up" ? i : i + 2} of ${items.length}`);
    onMove?.(id, dir);
  };
  return (
    <section aria-label={title} className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <header className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <h3 className="font-sans! text-compact font-medium text-fg">{title}</h3>
        <Badge>{items.length}</Badge>
      </header>
      <p className="mt-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{description}</p>
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-3 rounded-card bg-sunken px-3 py-4 text-center text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{emptyText}</p>
      ) : (
        <ol className="mt-3 space-y-2">
          {items.map((m, i) => (
            <li key={m.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 rounded-card border border-dashed border-line-strong bg-sunken py-1.5 pr-1.5 pl-3">
              <span className="w-4 shrink-0 text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle tabular-nums">{i + 1}</span>
              <span className="min-w-32 flex-1 truncate text-compact text-fg-muted" title={m.text}>{m.text}</span>
              <span className="ml-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1">
              <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => onSendNow?.(m.id)} aria-label={`Send now: ${m.text}`}>
                Send now{i === 0 && sendNowShortcut && <Kbd>{sendNowShortcut}</Kbd>}
              </Button>
              <IconButton size="sm" label={`Move message ${i + 1} up`} disabled={i === 0} onClick={() => move(m.id, i, "up")}><ChevronIcon width={14} height={14} className="-rotate-90" /></IconButton>
              <IconButton size="sm" label={`Move message ${i + 1} down`} disabled={i === items.length - 1} onClick={() => move(m.id, i, "down")}><ChevronIcon width={14} height={14} className="rotate-90" /></IconButton>
              <IconButton size="sm" label={`Delete message ${i + 1}`} onClick={() => onDelete?.(m.id)}><XIcon width={14} height={14} /></IconButton>
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )}
      <p role="status" className="sr-only">{note}</p>
    </section>
  );
}

## tattva/organisms/OptionChain.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";

export interface ChainSide {
  ltp: number | null;
  oi?: number | null;
  oiChange?: number | null;
  iv?: number | null;
  delta?: number | null;
}
export type ChainColumn = "oi" | "oiChange" | "iv" | "delta" | "ltp";
export interface ChainRow { strike: number; call: ChainSide; put: ChainSide }
export interface ChainPick { side: "call" | "put"; strike: number; ltp: number }

export interface OptionChainProps {
  rows: ChainRow[];
  /** Current price of the underlying. The row with the nearest strike is marked. */
  spot: number;
  /** Columns on each side. Calls show them in this order; puts mirror it so Price is next to the strike on both sides. */
  columns?: ChainColumn[];
  /** Called when a price cell is pressed. When left out, prices are plain text. */
  onPick?: (pick: ChainPick) => void;
  selected?: { side: "call" | "put"; strike: number };
  /** Shown above the table, such as "Expiry 30 Oct". */
  expiryLabel?: string;
  /** Accessible name of the scrolling region. */
  ariaLabel: string;
  /** CSS height limit for the scrolling region, such as 420 or "60vh". The header stays in view. */
  maxHeight?: number | string;
  className?: string;
}

const COLS: Record<ChainColumn, string> = { oi: "OI", oiChange: "OI change", iv: "IV", delta: "Delta", ltp: "Price" };
const NONE = "—";

/** Lakh and crore for large counts, so 1,23,456 reads as 1.23 L. */
function compact(n: number): string {
  const a = Math.abs(n);
  if (a >= 1e7) return `${(n / 1e7).toFixed(2)} Cr`;
  if (a >= 1e5) return `${(n / 1e5).toFixed(2)} L`;
  return n.toLocaleString("en-IN");
}
function show(col: ChainColumn, v: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (v == null) return NONE;
  if (col === "oi") return compact(v);
  if (col === "oiChange") return `${v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${compact(v)}`;
  if (col === "iv") return `${v.toFixed(1)}%`;
  if (col === "delta") return v.toFixed(2);
  return v.toFixed(2);
}
const strikeText = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-IN");

/**
 * Calls on the left, puts on the right, strike in the middle. A real table inside its own scroll region.
 * In-the-money cells get a quiet grey tint and a small diamond. Gain and loss colours are not used.
 */
export function OptionChain({ rows, spot, columns = ["oi", "iv", "ltp"], onPick, selected, expiryLabel, ariaLabel, maxHeight, className }: OptionChainProps) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const cols = columns.length ? columns : (["ltp"] as ChainColumn[]);
  const putCols = [...cols].reverse();
  const atm = rows.reduce<number | null>((best, r) => (best === null || Math.abs(r.strike - spot) < Math.abs(best - spot) ? r.strike : best), null);

  // Up and down move between rows in the same column. Left, right and Tab keep their native behaviour.
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, side: "call" | "put") => {
    if (e.key !== "ArrowDown" && e.key !== "ArrowUp") return;
    const all = Array.from(root.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(`button[data-pick="${side}"]`) ?? []);
    const i = all.indexOf(e.currentTarget);
    const next = all[i + (e.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1)];
    if (next) { e.preventDefault(); next.focus(); }
  };

  const th = "sticky z-20 border-b border-line bg-sunken px-2 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted whitespace-nowrap";
  const cell = (row: ChainRow, side: "call" | "put", col: ChainColumn, edge: boolean) => {
    const data = side === "call" ? row.call : row.put;
    const itm = side === "call" ? row.strike < spot : row.strike > spot;
    const isAtm = row.strike === atm;
    const v = data[col];
    const on = selected?.side === side && selected.strike === row.strike;
    return (
      <td key={`${side}-${col}`} className={cn("px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-small leading-4 text-fg tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap", isAtm ? "border-y border-fg" : "border-b border-line", itm && "bg-sunken")}>
        {itm && edge && (
          <>
            <span aria-hidden className="mr-1.5 inline-block size-1.5 rotate-45 border border-fg-muted align-middle forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]" />
            <span className="sr-only">In the money. </span>
          </>
        )}
        {col === "ltp" && onPick && v != null ? (
          <button type="button" data-pick={side} aria-pressed={on} aria-label={`${side === "call" ? "Call" : "Put"} ${strikeText(row.strike)}, price ${v.toFixed(2)}`}
            onClick={() => onPick({ side, strike: row.strike, ltp: v })} onKeyDown={(e) => onKey(e, side)}
            className={cn("-my-1 -mx-1 min-w-12 cursor-pointer rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-right text-small leading-4 tabular-nums transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] pointer-coarse:min-h-11 pointer-coarse:min-w-11",
              on ? "bg-accent font-medium text-on-accent" : "hover:bg-hover")}>
            {show(col, v)}
          </button>
        ) : show(col, v)}
      </td>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-full min-w-0", className)}>
      <p className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-3 text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">
          <span>{expiryLabel}</span>
          <span>Spot <span className="font-medium text-fg tabular-nums">{spot.toLocaleString("en-IN", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span></span>
      </p>
      <div ref={root} role="region" aria-label={ariaLabel} tabIndex={0} style={{ maxHeight }} className="relative overflow-auto rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
        <table className="w-full min-w-max border-separate border-spacing-0">
          <caption className="sr-only">{`${ariaLabel}. Calls on the left, puts on the right, strike in the middle.${expiryLabel ? ` ${expiryLabel}.` : ""}`}</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="colgroup" colSpan={cols.length} className={cn(th, "top-0 h-8 text-center")}>Calls</th>
              <th scope="col" rowSpan={2} className={cn(th, "top-0 left-0 right-0 z-30 border-x border-line text-center")}>Strike</th>
              <th scope="colgroup" colSpan={cols.length} className={cn(th, "top-0 h-8 text-center")}>Puts</th>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              {cols.map((c) => <th key={`c-${c}`} scope="col" className={cn(th, "top-8 py-1 text-right")}>{COLS[c]}</th>)}
              {putCols.map((c) => <th key={`p-${c}`} scope="col" className={cn(th, "top-8 py-1 text-right")}>{COLS[c]}</th>)}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((r) => {
              const isAtm = r.strike === atm;
              return (
                <tr key={r.strike}>
                  {cols.map((c, i) => cell(r, "call", c, i === cols.length - 1))}
                  <th scope="row" className={cn("sticky left-0 right-0 z-10 border-x border-line px-3 py-1.5 text-center text-small leading-4 font-semibold text-fg tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap", isAtm ? "border-y border-y-fg bg-sunken" : "border-b bg-surface")}>
                    {strikeText(r.strike)}
                    {isAtm && (
                      <>
                        <span aria-hidden className="ml-1.5 rounded-control border border-fg px-1.5 text-nano font-medium">ATM</span>
                        <span className="sr-only"> At the money</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </th>
                  {putCols.map((c, i) => cell(r, "put", c, i === 0))}
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/OrderTicket.tsx

```tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import type { FormEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { NumberField } from "../atoms/NumberField";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";
import { Field } from "../molecules/Field";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, LockIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface OrderTicketValue {
  side: "buy" | "sell";
  quantity: number | null;
  orderType: "market" | "limit" | "stop";
  limitPrice: number | null;
  product: "intraday" | "delivery";
  stop: number | null;
  target: number | null;
}

export interface OrderTicketProps {
  symbol: string;
  /** Last traded price, shown at the top. Formatting only; this part does no money maths. */
  price?: number;
  value: OrderTicketValue;
  onChange: (value: OrderTicketValue) => void;
  /** Size of one lot. Quantity then moves in lots and must be a multiple of it. */
  lotSize?: number;
  /** Smallest price step for the price fields. */
  tickSize?: number;
  /** What the order will cost or risk, worked out by the app. Shown as given. */
  summary?: { label: string; value: ReactNode; hint?: string }[];
  /** Messages in words, one per field. */
  errors?: Partial<Record<keyof OrderTicketValue, string>>;
  /** Called when the person presses the submit button. This part never places an order itself. */
  onSubmit: () => void;
  /** Button text. Defaults to the side and symbol, such as "Buy RELIANCE". */
  submitLabel?: string;
  /** Shows a spinner in the button and blocks a second press. */
  submitting?: boolean;
  /** Locks every field and the button. */
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Why it is locked, in words, next to the button. */
  disabledReason?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const fmt = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-IN", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });

/** A small labelled group for choices that are buttons, with the error in words under it. */
function Group({ label, error, children }: { label: string; error?: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
      <span className="text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg">{label}</span>
      {children}
      <div aria-live="polite" className="empty:hidden">
        {error && <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-danger-fg"><AlertIcon className="mt-px shrink-0" width={14} height={14} />{error}</p>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * A controlled order form. It collects the choices and hands them back; it never sends anything.
 * The submit button calls onSubmit and the app decides what happens next.
 */
export function OrderTicket({ symbol, price, value, onChange, lotSize, tickSize = 0.05, summary, errors = {}, onSubmit, submitLabel, submitting, disabled, disabledReason, className }: OrderTicketProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const reasonId = `${uid}-reason`;
  const set = (patch: Partial<OrderTicketValue>) => onChange({ ...value, ...patch });
  const priced = value.orderType !== "market";
  const lotError = lotSize && value.quantity != null && value.quantity % lotSize !== 0 ? `Quantity must be a multiple of ${lotSize}.` : undefined;
  const label = submitLabel ?? `${value.side === "buy" ? "Buy" : "Sell"} ${symbol}`;
  const locked = !!disabled || !!submitting;
  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!locked) onSubmit(); };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} aria-label={`Order ticket for ${symbol}`} className={cn("flex w-full max-w-phone flex-col gap-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
        <h3 className="text-lead leading-6 font-semibold text-fg">{symbol}</h3>
        {price != null && <p className="text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">Last price <span className="font-medium text-fg tabular-nums">{fmt(price)}</span></p>}
      </div>
      <fieldset disabled={disabled} className="m-0 flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4 border-0 p-0">
        <legend className="sr-only">Order details</legend>
        <Group label="Side" error={errors.side}>
          <SegmentedControl label="Side" value={value.side} onChange={(side) => set({ side })} options={[{ value: "buy", label: "Buy" }, { value: "sell", label: "Sell" }]} />
        </Group>
        <Field label="Quantity" error={errors.quantity ?? lotError} hint={lotSize ? `1 lot = ${lotSize}` : undefined}>
          {(a) => <NumberField {...a} label="Quantity" value={value.quantity} onChange={(quantity) => set({ quantity })} min={lotSize ?? 1} step={lotSize ?? 1} precision={0} />}
        </Field>
        <Group label="Order type" error={errors.orderType}>
          <SegmentedControl label="Order type" value={value.orderType} onChange={(orderType) => set({ orderType })} options={[{ value: "market", label: "Market" }, { value: "limit", label: "Limit" }, { value: "stop", label: "Stop" }]} />
        </Group>
        {priced && (
          <Field label={value.orderType === "stop" ? "Trigger price" : "Limit price"} error={errors.limitPrice}>
            {(a) => <NumberField {...a} label={value.orderType === "stop" ? "Trigger price" : "Limit price"} value={value.limitPrice} onChange={(limitPrice) => set({ limitPrice })} min={0} step={tickSize} precision={2} />}
          </Field>
        )}
        <Group label="Product" error={errors.product}>
          <SegmentedControl label="Product" value={value.product} onChange={(product) => set({ product })} options={[{ value: "intraday", label: "Intraday" }, { value: "delivery", label: "Delivery" }]} />
        </Group>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <Field label="Stop" optional error={errors.stop}>
            {(a) => <NumberField {...a} label="Stop" value={value.stop} onChange={(stop) => set({ stop })} min={0} step={tickSize} precision={2} />}
          </Field>
          <Field label="Target" optional error={errors.target}>
            {(a) => <NumberField {...a} label="Target" value={value.target} onChange={(target) => set({ target })} min={0} step={tickSize} precision={2} />}
          </Field>
        </div>
      </fieldset>
      {summary && summary.length > 0 && (
        <dl className="m-0 flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-card bg-sunken p-3 text-body leading-5">
          {summary.map((r) => (
            // A description group holds its term and details directly, as the HTML list rules require.
            <div key={r.label} className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-3">
              <dt className="text-fg-muted">{r.label}</dt>
              <dd className="m-0 font-medium text-fg tabular-nums">{r.value}</dd>
              {r.hint && <dd className="m-0 w-full text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{r.hint}</dd>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Button type="submit" size="lg" className="w-full pointer-coarse:h-12" disabled={locked} aria-busy={submitting || undefined} aria-describedby={disabled && disabledReason ? reasonId : undefined}
          leading={submitting ? <Spinner size={16} label="Submitting" /> : undefined}>
          {label}
        </Button>
        {disabled && disabledReason && (
          <p id={reasonId} className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted"><LockIcon className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" width={14} height={14} />{disabledReason}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/OutlineEditor.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, ChevronIcon, LockIcon, PlusIcon, SourceIcon, UndoIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { AIMark } from "../atoms/AIMark";
import { Badge, type Tone } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Reveal } from "../atoms/Reveal";
import { TextField } from "../atoms/TextField";
import { WorkingEdge } from "../atoms/WorkingEdge";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";

export type OutlineState = "drafting" | "ready" | "edited" | "updating" | "approved" | "building" | "failed";

export interface OutlineItem {
  id: string;
  /** The slide title. Required before building: screen-reader users move through a deck by its titles. */
  title: string;
  /** One line on what the slide says. */
  description?: string;
  /** Files or pages the AI used for this slide. */
  sources?: { id: string; label: string }[];
  /** Update outline leaves this slide as it is. The person sets it with the Lock button. */
  locked?: boolean;
  /** Who wrote it. "ai" shows the AI mark until the person edits it; "person" says Added by you. */
  origin?: "ai" | "person";
  /** The person changed an AI-drafted slide. Set by the part on edit. */
  edited?: boolean;
}

export interface OutlineEditorLabels {
  heading: string;
  build: string;
  update: string;
  retry: string;
  addEnd: string;
  titleError: string;
  failedNote: string;
}

export interface OutlineEditorProps {
  items: OutlineItem[];
  /** Where the outline is. Any edit while "ready" shows as "edited" until the state changes again. */
  state: OutlineState;
  /** The AI's short summary of the deck, shown above the slides. */
  overview?: ReactNode;
  /** id of the slide the AI is still writing while drafting. It stays read-only until it is complete. */
  pendingId?: string;
  /** Called with the new list after every edit, insert, remove, reorder or Keep toggle. */
  onItemsChange: (items: OutlineItem[]) => void;
  /** Told when an edit turns "ready" into "edited". */
  onStateChange?: (state: OutlineState) => void;
  /** Redraft the outline around the person's edits. Adds Update outline while edited, and Try again when failed. */
  onUpdate?: () => void;
  /** Approve the outline and build the slides. Only called when every slide has a title. */
  onBuild: () => void;
  /** Worked out by your app, never by the model: "12 slides, about 60 credits". Shown beside Build. */
  estimate?: ReactNode;
  /** Plain-language reason when drafting failed, such as "The connection dropped after slide 6." */
  error?: ReactNode;
  /** Most slides allowed. Add is turned off at the limit, with the reason in words. */
  maxItems?: number;
  /** Level of the part's own heading. Default 3. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  labels?: Partial<OutlineEditorLabels>;
  className?: string;
}

const BADGE: Record<OutlineState, { tone: Tone; text: string; ai?: boolean }> = {
  drafting: { tone: "accent", text: "AI is drafting", ai: true },
  ready: { tone: "neutral", text: "Ready to build" },
  edited: { tone: "info", text: "Edited by you" },
  updating: { tone: "accent", text: "AI is updating", ai: true },
  approved: { tone: "success", text: "Approved" },
  building: { tone: "accent", text: "Building slides", ai: true },
  failed: { tone: "danger", text: "Drafting stopped" },
};

const NOTE: Partial<Record<OutlineState, string>> = {
  drafting: "Slides appear as they are written. You can edit each one once it is complete.",
  edited: "Update outline redrafts the unlocked slides around your changes. Build slides uses the outline as it is.",
  updating: "Redrafting around your changes. Locked slides stay as they are.",
  approved: "Approved. The slides will be built from this outline.",
  building: "Building slides from this outline. It can no longer be changed here.",
};

let seq = 0;
const newId = () => `outline-new-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${seq++}`;

/**
 * The plan of a deck before any slide is built. The AI drafts it; the person edits, adds, removes, reorders and keeps
 * slides, then builds. Focus stays where it is when the outline appears, because it is not a blocking request.
 */
export function OutlineEditor({
  items, state, overview, pendingId, onItemsChange, onStateChange, onUpdate, onBuild, estimate, error, maxItems,
  headingLevel = 3, labels, className,
}: OutlineEditorProps) {
  const l: OutlineEditorLabels = {
    heading: "Outline", build: "Build slides", update: "Update outline", retry: "Try again", addEnd: "Add slide",
    titleError: "Every slide needs a title", failedNote: "The AI stopped before the outline was finished. You can keep what is here, edit it, or try again.",
    ...labels,
  };
  const uid = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLOListElement>(null);
  const undoRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  // An edit while "ready" shows as "edited" until the parent moves the state on.
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => { setDirty(false); }, [state]);
  const shown: OutlineState = state === "ready" && dirty ? "edited" : state;

  const [announce, setAnnounce] = useState("");
  const say = (t: string) => setAnnounce((prev) => (prev === t ? `${t} ` : t));
  const [showErrors, setShowErrors] = useState(false);
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set());
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set());
  const [removed, setRemoved] = useState<{ item: OutlineItem; index: number } | null>(null);
  const focusNext = useRef<{ id: string; part: "title" | "up" | "down" } | "undo" | null>(null);

  const locked = shown === "updating" || shown === "approved" || shown === "building";
  const canEdit = (it: OutlineItem) => !locked && it.id !== pendingId;
  const atMax = maxItems !== undefined && items.length >= maxItems;
  const missing = items.filter((it) => it.id !== pendingId && !it.title.trim());
  const canBuild = items.length > 0 && (shown === "ready" || shown === "edited" || shown === "failed");

  // Announce milestones only, never each streamed word.
  const prevState = useRef(state);
  useEffect(() => {
    const was = prevState.current;
    prevState.current = state;
    if (was === state) return;
    const n = `${items.length} ${items.length === 1 ? "slide" : "slides"}`;
    if (state === "ready" && was === "drafting") say(`Outline drafted, ${n}`);
    else if (state === "ready" && was === "updating") say(`Outline updated, ${n}`);
    else if (state === "updating") say("Updating outline");
    else if (state === "approved") say("Outline approved");
    else if (state === "building") say("Building slides");
    else if (state === "failed") say("Drafting stopped. What was written is kept.");
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [state]);

  const commit = (next: OutlineItem[]) => {
    onItemsChange(next);
    if (state === "ready" && !dirty) { setDirty(true); onStateChange?.("edited"); }
  };

  const patch = (id: string, change: Partial<OutlineItem>) =>
    commit(items.map((it) => (it.id === id ? { ...it, ...change, edited: it.origin === "ai" && ("title" in change || "description" in change) ? true : it.edited } : it)));

  const move = (i: number, by: -1 | 1, from: "up" | "down" | "row") => {
    const j = i + by;
    if (j < 0 || j >= items.length) return;
    const next = items.slice();
    const [it] = next.splice(i, 1);
    next.splice(j, 0, it);
    // Keep focus on the pressed button; once a row reaches an end its button turns off, so focus moves to the other one.
    const part = from === "row" ? null : j === 0 && from === "up" ? "down" : j === items.length - 1 && from === "down" ? "up" : from;
    if (part) focusNext.current = { id: it.id, part };
    commit(next);
    say(`Slide ${i + 1} moved to ${j + 1}`);
  };

  const insert = (at: number) => {
    if (atMax) return;
    const it: OutlineItem = { id: newId(), title: "", origin: "person" };
    const next = items.slice();
    next.splice(at, 0, it);
    focusNext.current = { id: it.id, part: "title" };
    commit(next);
    say(`New slide ${at + 1} added`);
  };

  const remove = (i: number) => {
    const it = items[i];
    setRemoved({ item: it, index: i });
    focusNext.current = "undo";
    commit(items.filter((x) => x.id !== it.id));
    say(`Slide ${i + 1} removed. Undo is available.`);
  };

  const undo = () => {
    if (!removed) return;
    const next = items.slice();
    const at = Math.min(removed.index, next.length);
    next.splice(at, 0, removed.item);
    focusNext.current = { id: removed.item.id, part: "title" };
    setRemoved(null);
    commit(next);
    say(`Slide ${at + 1} restored`);
  };

  const build = () => {
    if (missing.length) {
      setShowErrors(true);
      const first = listRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(`[data-title="${CSS.escape(missing[0].id)}"]`);
      first?.focus();
      say(missing.length === 1 ? "One slide needs a title" : `${missing.length} slides need a title`);
      return;
    }
    onBuild();
  };

  // Put focus where the last action said, after the list has re-rendered.
  useEffect(() => {
    const f = focusNext.current;
    if (!f) return;
    focusNext.current = null;
    if (f === "undo") { undoRef.current?.focus(); return; }
    const sel = f.part === "title" ? `[data-title="${CSS.escape(f.id)}"]` : `[data-move="${CSS.escape(f.id)}-${f.part}"]`;
    listRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(sel)?.focus();
  });

  // Reorder motion: rows slide from their old place to the new one (FLIP), quickly. None under reduced motion.
  const tops = useRef(new Map<string, number>());
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const rows = Array.from(listRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-row]") ?? []);
    const next = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const el of rows) {
      const id = el.dataset.row!;
      const top = el.offsetTop;
      next.set(id, top);
      const before = tops.current.get(id);
      if (reduced || before === undefined || before === top) continue;
      el.style.transition = "none";
      el.style.transform = `translateY(${before - top}px)`;
      void el.offsetHeight;
      el.style.transition = "transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)";
      el.style.transform = "";
    }
    tops.current = next;
  }, [items, reduced]);

  const onRowKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLLIElement>, i: number) => {
    if (!e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || (e.key !== "ArrowUp" && e.key !== "ArrowDown")) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const by = e.key === "ArrowUp" ? -1 : 1;
    const j = i + by;
    if (j < 0 || j >= items.length) return;
    // Keep focus on the same field or button inside the moved row.
    const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    const id = items[i].id;
    if (active?.dataset.title === id) focusNext.current = { id, part: "title" };
    move(i, by, "row");
    if (!focusNext.current && active) requestAnimationFrame(() => active.isConnected && document.activeElement !== active && active.focus());
  };

  const badge = BADGE[shown];
  const ai = shown === "drafting" || shown === "updating";
  const note = shown === "failed" ? null : NOTE[shown];
  const count = `${items.length} ${items.length === 1 ? "slide" : "slides"}`;

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} aria-busy={ai || undefined} className={cn("w-full max-w-read", className)}>
      <WorkingEdge active={ai} label={shown === "drafting" ? "AI is drafting the outline" : "AI is updating the outline"}>
        <div className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-5">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2">
              <H id={`${uid}-h`} className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-40 text-lead font-semibold">{l.heading}</H>
              <span className="text-small text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{count}</span>
              <Badge tone={badge.tone}>
                {badge.ai ? <AIMark size={16} /> : shown === "approved" ? <CheckIcon width={11} height={11} /> : shown === "failed" ? <AlertIcon width={11} height={11} /> : null}
                {badge.text}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            {note && <p className="mt-2 text-small text-fg-muted">{note}</p>}
            {shown === "failed" && (
              <div role="alert" className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken p-3 text-compact text-fg">
                <AlertIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-danger-fg" />
                <div className="min-w-0"><p>{l.failedNote}</p>{error && <p className="mt-1 text-fg-muted">{error}</p>}</div>
              </div>
            )}
            {overview && (
              <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2.5 rounded-card bg-sunken p-3">
                <span aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 inline-flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-lime text-on-lime"><AIMark size={16} /></span>
                <div className="min-w-0 text-compact text-fg"><p className="text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted">Overview, drafted by AI</p><div className="mt-0.5">{overview}</div></div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {items.length === 0 && shown === "drafting" && (
            <p className="border-t border-line px-4 py-6 text-compact text-fg-muted sm:px-5">The first slide will appear here in a moment.</p>
          )}
          {items.length === 0 && shown !== "drafting" && (
            <p className="border-t border-line px-4 py-6 text-compact text-fg-muted sm:px-5">No slides yet. Add one to start, or try drafting again.</p>
          )}

          <ol ref={listRef} aria-label={`${l.heading}, ${count}`} className="border-t border-line">
            {items.map((it, i) => {
              const editable = canEdit(it);
              const pending = it.id === pendingId;
              const empty = !it.title.trim();
              const err = !pending && empty && (showErrors || touched.has(it.id));
              const descOpen = open.has(it.id) || !!err;
              const n = i + 1;
              const name = it.title.trim() || "untitled";
              return (
                <Reveal as="li" key={it.id} data-row={it.id} aria-label={`Slide ${n}: ${name}`} onKeyDown={(e) => editable && onRowKey(e as KeyboardEvent<HTMLLIElement>, i)}
                  className="relative border-b border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3 last:border-b-0 sm:px-5">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-3">
                    <span aria-hidden className="mt-2 flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong bg-sunken text-small leading-4 tabular-nums text-fg-muted pointer-coarse:mt-2.5">{n}</span>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      {editable ? (
                        <>
                          <TextField data-title={it.id} aria-label={`Slide ${n} title`} value={it.title} placeholder="Slide title" invalid={err}
                            aria-describedby={err ? `${uid}-${it.id}-err` : undefined}
                            onChange={(e) => patch(it.id, { title: e.target.value })}
                            onBlur={() => setTouched((t) => (t.has(it.id) ? t : new Set(t).add(it.id)))}
                            className="font-medium" />
                          {err && <p id={`${uid}-${it.id}-err`} className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-small text-danger-fg"><AlertIcon aria-hidden width={13} height={13} />{l.titleError}</p>}
                          <button type="button" aria-expanded={descOpen} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => { const s = new Set(o); if (s.has(it.id)) s.delete(it.id); else s.add(it.id); return s; })}
                            className="mt-1 inline-flex min-h-8 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-control text-small text-fg-muted hover:text-fg sm:hidden tap">
                            <ChevronIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} className={cn("transition-transform duration-(--dur-fast)", descOpen && "rotate-90")} />
                            {it.description?.trim() ? "Description" : "Add a description"}
                          </button>
                          <TextField aria-label={`Slide ${n} description`} value={it.description ?? ""} placeholder="One line on what this slide says (optional)"
                            onChange={(e) => patch(it.id, { description: e.target.value })}
                            size="sm" className={cn("mt-1.5 text-compact text-fg-muted", !descOpen && "max-sm:hidden")} />
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="pt-1">
                          <p className={cn("text-body font-medium", !it.title && "text-fg-muted")}>{it.title || (pending ? "Writing the title" : "Untitled slide")}</p>
                          {it.description && <p className="mt-0.5 text-compact text-fg-muted">{it.description}</p>}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {it.sources && it.sources.length > 0 && (
                        <ul aria-label={`Sources for slide ${n}`} className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                          {it.sources.map((s) => (
                            <li key={s.id} className="inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-control border border-line bg-sunken px-2 py-0.5 text-micro text-fg-muted">
                              <SourceIcon aria-hidden width={11} height={11} className="shrink-0" /><span className="truncate">{s.label}</span>
                            </li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-2 mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1.5 sm:col-span-1 sm:col-start-2">
                        {pending ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-small text-fg-muted">
                            <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-lime text-on-lime"><AIMark size={16} /></span>
                            Still writing this slide
                          </span>
                        ) : it.origin === "ai" && !it.edited ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-small text-fg-muted">
                            <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-lime text-on-lime"><AIMark size={16} /></span>
                            Drafted by AI
                          </span>
                        ) : it.origin === "ai" ? <Badge>Edited by you</Badge> : it.origin === "person" ? <Badge>Added by you</Badge> : null}
                        {it.locked && <Badge><LockIcon width={11} height={11} />Locked</Badge>}

                        {editable && (
                          <span className="ml-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1 max-sm:w-full max-sm:justify-between">
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <IconButton size="sm" data-move={`${it.id}-up`} label={`Move slide ${n} up`} disabled={i === 0} onClick={() => move(i, -1, "up")} className="pointer-coarse:size-11">
                              <ChevronIcon width={14} height={14} className="-rotate-90" />
                            </IconButton>
                            <IconButton size="sm" data-move={`${it.id}-down`} label={`Move slide ${n} down`} disabled={i === items.length - 1} onClick={() => move(i, 1, "down")} className="pointer-coarse:size-11">
                              <ChevronIcon width={14} height={14} className="rotate-90" />
                            </IconButton>
                            <IconButton size="sm" label={`Add a slide after slide ${n}`} disabled={atMax} onClick={() => insert(i + 1)} className="pointer-coarse:size-11">
                              <PlusIcon width={14} height={14} />
                            </IconButton>
                            {onUpdate && (
                              <IconButton size="sm" label={`Lock slide ${n} so Update outline leaves it as it is`} aria-pressed={!!it.locked} active={!!it.locked}
                                onClick={() => { patch(it.id, { locked: !it.locked }); say(it.locked ? `Slide ${n} unlocked` : `Slide ${n} locked`); }}
                                className={cn("pointer-coarse:size-11", it.locked && "bg-hover text-fg")}>
                                <LockIcon width={14} height={14} />
                              </IconButton>
                            )}
                            </span>
                            <IconButton size="sm" label={`Remove slide ${n}: ${name}`} onClick={() => remove(i)} className="pointer-coarse:size-11">
                              <XIcon width={14} height={14} />
                            </IconButton>
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                  </div>
                </Reveal>
              );
            })}
          </ol>

          {removed && !locked && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line bg-sunken px-4 py-2 text-compact sm:px-5">
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-fg-muted">Removed {removed.item.title.trim() ? `"${removed.item.title.trim()}"` : "an empty slide"}.</span>
              <Button ref={undoRef} size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<UndoIcon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={undo} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Undo remove</Button>
              <IconButton size="sm" label="Dismiss" onClick={() => setRemoved(null)} className="pointer-coarse:size-11"><XIcon width={14} height={14} /></IconButton>
            </div>
          )}

          {!locked && shown !== "drafting" && (
            <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-3 sm:px-5">
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" leading={<PlusIcon width={14} height={14} />} disabled={atMax} onClick={() => insert(items.length)} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">{l.addEnd}</Button>
              {atMax && <span className="ml-2 text-small text-fg-muted">An outline can have up to {maxItems} slides.</span>}
            </div>
          )}

          {(canBuild || shown === "failed") && (
            <div className="sticky bottom-0 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2 rounded-b-card border-t border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3 pb-[max(--spacing(3),var(--safe-bottom))] sm:static sm:px-5">
              {showErrors && missing.length > 0 && (
                <p className="flex w-full items-center gap-1.5 text-small text-danger-fg">
                  <AlertIcon aria-hidden width={13} height={13} />
                  {missing.length === 1 ? `Slide ${items.indexOf(missing[0]) + 1} needs a title before you can build.` : `${missing.length} slides need a title before you can build.`}
                </p>
              )}
              {canBuild && <Button onClick={build} className="pointer-coarse:h-11 max-sm:flex-1">{l.build}</Button>}
              {onUpdate && (shown === "edited" || shown === "failed") && (
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onUpdate} className="pointer-coarse:h-11 max-sm:flex-1">{shown === "failed" ? l.retry : l.update}</Button>
              )}
              {estimate && <span className="text-small text-fg-muted max-sm:w-full">{estimate}</span>}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </WorkingEdge>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{announce}</p>
    </section>
  );
}

## tattva/organisms/ParameterPanel.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { SparkleIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";
import { Switch } from "../atoms/Switch";

/** A value held for one parameter. A seed is a number when fixed and null when left random. */
export type ParameterValue = string | number | boolean | null;
export type ParameterValues = Record<string, ParameterValue>;

export interface ParameterOption { value: string; label: string; description?: string }

interface BaseSpec { /** Key in the values object. */ id: string; /** Visible label. */ label: string; /** Short helper text under the label. */ hint?: string }

export type ParameterSpec =
  | (BaseSpec & { kind: "segmented"; options: ParameterOption[] })
  | (BaseSpec & { kind: "aspect"; options: ParameterOption[] })
  | (BaseSpec & { kind: "presets"; options: ParameterOption[] })
  | (BaseSpec & { kind: "number"; min?: number; max?: number; step?: number; unit?: string })
  | (BaseSpec & { kind: "seed"; /** Seed used when the person switches Fixed on. */ defaultSeed?: number; fixedLabel?: string });

export interface ParameterPanelProps {
  /** Schema that decides which controls render, in order. */
  parameters: ParameterSpec[];
  /** Current values keyed by parameter id. */
  values: ParameterValues;
  onChange: (values: ParameterValues) => void;
  /** Called with the current values when Generate is pressed. */
  onGenerate: (values: ParameterValues) => void;
  /** Returns the cost for the current values. Omit to hide the readout. */
  estimateCost?: (values: ParameterValues) => number;
  /** Formats the cost readout. */
  formatCost?: (cost: number) => string;
  title?: string;
  generateLabel?: string;
  busyLabel?: string;
  /** Disables Generate and shows a spinner. */
  busy?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

function RatioGlyph({ ratio }: { ratio: string }) {
  const [w, h] = ratio.split(":").map(Number);
  if (!w || !h) return null;
  const scale = 12 / Math.max(w, h);
  return <span aria-hidden className="inline-block rounded-2xs border border-current" style={{ width: Math.max(4, w * scale), height: Math.max(4, h * scale) }} />;
}

/** Wrapping single-choice chips with roving tab stop and arrow keys. */
function ChipGroup({ options, value, onChange, label, glyph }: { options: ParameterOption[]; value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; label: string; glyph?: boolean }) {
  const refs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const move = (i: number, e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    const n = options.length;
    let next = i;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") next = (i + 1) % n;
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") next = (i - 1 + n) % n;
    else if (e.key === "Home") next = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") next = n - 1;
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    onChange(options[next].value);
    refs.current[next]?.focus();
  };
  const hasValue = options.some((o) => o.value === value);
  return (
    <div role="radiogroup" aria-label={label} className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      {options.map((o, i) => {
        const on = o.value === value;
        return (
          <button key={o.value} ref={(el) => { refs.current[i] = el; }} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={on} title={o.description}
            tabIndex={on || (!hasValue && i === 0) ? 0 : -1} onClick={() => onChange(o.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => move(i, e)}
            className={cn("inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control border px-3 py-1 text-small leading-4 font-medium transition-colors",
              on ? "border-fg bg-surface text-fg shadow-sm" : "border-line text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg")}>
            {glyph && <RatioGlyph ratio={o.label} />}{o.label}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

function Field({ spec, children, labelId }: { spec: BaseSpec; children: React.ReactNode; labelId: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <div>
        <span id={labelId} className="text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg">{spec.label}</span>
        {spec.hint && <span className="ml-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{spec.hint}</span>}
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Generation settings driven by a schema. Values are controlled. A cost readout is computed
 * from the values by `estimateCost`, and Generate passes the values back to the caller.
 */
export function ParameterPanel({ parameters, values, onChange, onGenerate, estimateCost, formatCost = (c) => `About ${c} credits`, title = "Settings", generateLabel = "Generate", busyLabel = "Generating…", busy, className }: ParameterPanelProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const set = (id: string, v: ParameterValue) => onChange({ ...values, [id]: v });
  const cost = estimateCost?.(values);

  return (
    <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!busy) onGenerate(values); }} aria-label={title}
      className={cn("space-y-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 shadow-sm", className)}>
      <h3 className="text-lead leading-6">{title}</h3>
      {parameters.map((p) => {
        const labelId = `${uid}-${p.id}`;
        const v = values[p.id];
        if (p.kind === "segmented") {
          return <Field key={p.id} spec={p} labelId={labelId}>
            <SegmentedControl label={p.label} options={p.options} value={String(v ?? p.options[0]?.value ?? "")} onChange={(x) => set(p.id, x)} />
          </Field>;
        }
        if (p.kind === "aspect" || p.kind === "presets") {
          return <Field key={p.id} spec={p} labelId={labelId}>
            <ChipGroup label={p.label} glyph={p.kind === "aspect"} options={p.options} value={String(v ?? "")} onChange={(x) => set(p.id, x)} />
          </Field>;
        }
        if (p.kind === "number") {
          return <Field key={p.id} spec={p} labelId={labelId}>
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-field border border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-1 focus-within:border-fg-subtle has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-2 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-[var(--focus-ring)]">
              <input type="number" aria-labelledby={labelId} min={p.min} max={p.max} step={p.step} value={typeof v === "number" ? v : ""}
                onChange={(e) => { const n = e.target.valueAsNumber; if (!Number.isNaN(n)) set(p.id, n); }}
                className="w-16 bg-transparent text-body leading-5 outline-none" />
              {p.unit && <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{p.unit}</span>}
            </div>
          </Field>;
        }
        const fixed = typeof v === "number";
        return <Field key={p.id} spec={p} labelId={labelId}>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
              <Switch label={`${p.fixedLabel ?? "Fixed"} ${p.label.toLowerCase()}`} checked={fixed} onChange={(on) => set(p.id, on ? (p.defaultSeed ?? 1234) : null)} />
              {p.fixedLabel ?? "Fixed"}
            </span>
            {fixed
              ? <input type="number" aria-labelledby={labelId} value={v as number} onChange={(e) => { const n = e.target.valueAsNumber; if (!Number.isNaN(n)) set(p.id, n); }}
                  className="w-28 rounded-field border border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-1 text-body leading-5 focus:border-fg-subtle" />
              : <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">Random each time</span>}
          </div>
        </Field>;
      })}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-line pt-3">
        <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{cost !== undefined ? formatCost(cost) : ""}</p>
        <Button type="submit" variant="lime" disabled={busy} leading={busy ? <Spinner size={14} /> : <SparkleIcon width={14} height={14} />}>{busy ? busyLabel : generateLabel}</Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
