## tattva/organisms/PayoffChart.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import type { DataTableProps } from "../molecules/DataTable";
import { formatNumber, niceTicks, useElementWidth } from "../molecules/ChartFrame";

export interface PayoffPoint {
  /** Price of the underlying at the end. */
  spot: number;
  /** Profit (positive) or loss (negative) at that price. */
  pnl: number;
}

export interface PayoffLeg {
  kind: "call" | "put" | "stock";
  side: "buy" | "sell";
  /** Strike price for an option. For a stock leg, the price paid or received per share. */
  strike?: number;
  /** Price per unit paid (buy) or received (sell). Always positive. Defaults to 0. Not used by stock legs. */
  premium?: number;
  /** Number of units. */
  qty: number;
}

export interface PayoffChartProps {
  /** Ready-made points. Use this or legs. */
  points?: PayoffPoint[];
  /** Positions to compute the result at expiry from. Used when points is not given. */
  legs?: PayoffLeg[];
  /** Price range to draw when computing from legs. Defaults to a band around the strikes. */
  spotRange?: [number, number];
  /** Number of steps across the range when computing from legs. */
  steps?: number;
  /** Current price. Drawn as a labelled vertical marker when it is inside the range. */
  spot?: number;
  /** Formats prices and amounts. */
  formatValue?: (n: number) => string;
  /** Name for the chart region, for example "Bull call spread, result at expiry". */
  ariaLabel: string;
  /** Plot height in px. Minimum 180. */
  height?: number;
  className?: string;
}

/** Profit or loss of the legs at expiry for each price in spots. Premium is per unit and qty multiplies it. */
export function payoffAtExpiry(legs: PayoffLeg[], spots: number[]): number[] {
  return spots.map((s) => legs.reduce((sum, l) => {
    const sign = l.side === "buy" ? 1 : -1;
    const k = l.strike ?? 0;
    const prem = l.premium ?? 0;
    const intrinsic = l.kind === "call" ? Math.max(s - k, 0) : l.kind === "put" ? Math.max(k - s, 0) : s - k;
    return sum + sign * l.qty * (l.kind === "stock" ? intrinsic : intrinsic - prem);
  }, 0));
}

const clean = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 1e9) / 1e9;

/** Points from legs (with every strike included so the kinks are exact) or from the points given. */
function resolve(points: PayoffPoint[] | undefined, legs: PayoffLeg[] | undefined, range: [number, number] | undefined, steps: number): PayoffPoint[] {
  if (points && points.length) return [...points].sort((a, b) => a.spot - b.spot);
  if (!legs || !legs.length) return [];
  const ks = legs.map((l) => l.strike).filter((k): k is number => typeof k === "number");
  const kLo = ks.length ? Math.min(...ks) : 50;
  const kHi = ks.length ? Math.max(...ks) : 150;
  const span = kHi - kLo;
  const [a, b] = range ?? [Math.max(0, kLo - (span || kLo) * 0.5), kHi + (span || kLo) * 0.5];
  const n = Math.max(2, Math.floor(steps));
  const spots = Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, (_, i) => clean(a + ((b - a) * i) / n));
  ks.forEach((k) => { if (k > a && k < b) spots.push(k); });
  const sorted = [...new Set(spots)].sort((x, y) => x - y);
  const pnl = payoffAtExpiry(legs, sorted);
  return sorted.map((spot, i) => ({ spot, pnl: clean(pnl[i]) }));
}

function breakevens(p: PayoffPoint[]): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  if (p.length && p[0].pnl === 0) out.push(p[0].spot);
  for (let i = 0; i < p.length - 1; i++) {
    const a = p[i].pnl, b = p[i + 1].pnl;
    if (a * b < 0) out.push(clean(p[i].spot + ((p[i + 1].spot - p[i].spot) * -a) / (b - a)));
    else if (b === 0 && a !== 0) out.push(p[i + 1].spot);
  }
  return out;
}

const verdict = (v: number, f: (n: number) => string) => (v > 0 ? `profit ${f(v)}` : v < 0 ? `loss ${f(-v)}` : "break even");

/**
 * Profit or loss at expiry as the price moves, drawn in SVG. The profit area is tinted, loss area is tinted and hatched.
 * Break-even prices and the best and worst outcomes are labelled. "Unlimited" is only said for the right edge,
 * because a price cannot fall below zero. The plot takes focus: Left and Right step through prices.
 */
export function PayoffChart({ points, legs, spotRange, steps = 120, spot, formatValue = formatNumber, ariaLabel, height = 260, className }: PayoffChartProps) {
  const [ref, measured] = useElementWidth<HTMLDivElement>();
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement | null>(null);
  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [active, setActive] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "");

  const pts = resolve(points, legs, spotRange, steps);
  const n = pts.length;
  const w = measured || 640;
  const h = Math.max(180, height);

  const pMin = n ? Math.min(...pts.map((p) => p.pnl)) : 0;
  const pMax = n ? Math.max(...pts.map((p) => p.pnl)) : 1;
  const pad = (Math.max(pMax, 0) - Math.min(pMin, 0) || 1) * 0.12;
  const ticks = niceTicks(Math.min(pMin, 0) - (pMin < 0 ? pad : 0), Math.max(pMax, 0) + (pMax > 0 ? pad : 0));
  const lo = ticks[0];
  const hi = ticks[ticks.length - 1];
  const tickLabels = ticks.map((t) => formatValue(t));
  const left = Math.max(32, Math.max(...tickLabels.map((t) => t.length)) * 6.6 + 14);
  const right = 16;
  const pw = Math.max(40, w - left - right);
  const plotTop = 30;
  const plotBottom = h - 30;
  const py = (v: number) => plotBottom - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (plotBottom - plotTop);
  const s0 = n ? pts[0].spot : 0;
  const s1 = n ? pts[n - 1].spot : 1;
  const px = (s: number) => left + ((s - s0) / (s1 - s0 || 1)) * pw;
  const zy = py(0);

  const line = pts.map((p, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"}${px(p.spot).toFixed(1)} ${py(p.pnl).toFixed(1)}`).join("");
  const area = n ? `${line}L${px(s1).toFixed(1)} ${zy.toFixed(1)}L${px(s0).toFixed(1)} ${zy.toFixed(1)}Z` : "";

  const eps = (pMax - pMin || 1) * 1e-6;
  const slopeR = n > 1 ? (pts[n - 1].pnl - pts[n - 2].pnl) / (pts[n - 1].spot - pts[n - 2].spot || 1) : 0;
  const profitOpen = n > 1 && slopeR > 1e-9 && pts[n - 1].pnl >= pMax - eps;
  const lossOpen = n > 1 && slopeR < -1e-9 && pts[n - 1].pnl <= pMin + eps;
  const bes = breakevens(pts);

  const mid = (target: number) => {
    const idx = pts.map((p, i) => (Math.abs(p.pnl - target) <= eps ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0);
    return idx.length ? pts[idx[Math.floor(idx.length / 2)]] : pts[0];
  };

  /** Keep a label inside the drawing: start-, middle- or end-anchored depending on how close it is to an edge. */
  const place = (x: number, text: string) => {
    const half = (text.length * 6.4) / 2;
    return x - half < 2 ? { x: 2, a: "start" as const } : x + half > w - 2 ? { x: w - 2, a: "end" as const } : { x, a: "middle" as const };
  };
  const halo = { paintOrder: "stroke" as const, stroke: "var(--surface)", strokeWidth: 3, strokeLinejoin: "round" as const };

  const readout = (i: number) => `Price ${formatValue(pts[i].spot)}, ${verdict(pts[i].pnl, formatValue)}`;
  const step = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!n) return;
    let i = active ?? Math.round((n - 1) / 2);
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") i = Math.min(n - 1, i + 1);
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") i = Math.max(0, i - 1);
    else if (e.key === "PageDown") i = Math.min(n - 1, i + 10);
    else if (e.key === "PageUp") i = Math.max(0, i - 10);
    else if (e.key === "Home") i = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") i = n - 1;
    else if (e.key === "Escape") { setActive(null); setSaid(""); return; }
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setActive(i);
    setSaid(readout(i));
  };
  const point = (e: PointerEvent<SVGRectElement>) => {
    const r = svgRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!r || !n) return;
    const s = s0 + ((e.clientX - r.left - left) / pw) * (s1 - s0);
    let best = 0, bd = Infinity;
    pts.forEach((p, i) => { const d = Math.abs(p.spot - s); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = i; } });
    setActive(best);
  };

  const ai = active !== null && active < n ? active : -1;
  const ap = ai >= 0 ? pts[ai] : null;
  const tipRight = ap ? px(ap.spot) > w / 2 : false;
  const xTicks = n ? niceTicks(s0, s1, 6).filter((t) => t >= s0 - 1e-9 && t <= s1 + 1e-9) : [];
  const maxText = profitOpen ? "Max profit: Unlimited" : `Max profit ${formatValue(pMax)}`;
  const minText = lossOpen ? "Max loss: Unlimited" : `Max loss ${formatValue(-pMin)}`;
  const mp = n && pMax > 0 ? mid(pMax) : null;
  const lp = n && pMin < 0 ? mid(pMin) : null;
  const spotIn = typeof spot === "number" && n > 0 && spot >= s0 && spot <= s1;
  const spotText = spotIn ? `Price now ${formatValue(spot as number)}` : "";

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cn("relative min-w-0", className)}>
      <div ref={wrapRef} tabIndex={0} role="group" aria-roledescription="payoff chart"
        aria-label={`${ariaLabel}. ${n} prices. Use left and right arrow keys to step through prices.`}
        onKeyDown={step} onFocus={() => { if (n) setActive((p) => p ?? Math.round((n - 1) / 2)); }}
        onBlur={() => { setActive(null); setSaid(""); }}
        className="relative rounded-lg focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--focus-ring)]">
        <svg ref={svgRef} width={w} height={h} viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} className="block max-w-full touch-pan-y select-none" aria-hidden focusable="false"
          style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: "var(--text-small)" }}>
          <defs>
            <pattern id={`${uid}-hatch`} width={6} height={6} patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(45)">
              <line x1={0} y1={0} x2={0} y2={6} stroke="var(--down)" strokeWidth={1.25} strokeOpacity={0.55} />
            </pattern>
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-above`}><rect x={left} y={0} width={pw} height={Math.max(0, zy)} /></clipPath>
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-below`}><rect x={left} y={zy} width={pw} height={Math.max(0, h - zy)} /></clipPath>
          </defs>
          {ticks.map((t) => (
            <g key={t}>
              {t !== 0 && <line x1={left} x2={left + pw} y1={py(t)} y2={py(t)} stroke="var(--chart-grid)" strokeWidth={0.5} shapeRendering="crispEdges" />}
              <text x={left - 8} y={py(t)} textAnchor="end" dominantBaseline="central" fill="var(--fg-muted)" style={{ fontVariantNumeric: "tabular-nums" }}>{formatValue(t)}</text>
            </g>
          ))}
          {xTicks.map((t) => {
            const lab = formatValue(t);
            const p = place(px(t), lab);
            return <text key={t} x={p.x} y={h - 10} textAnchor={p.a} fill="var(--fg-muted)">{lab}</text>;
          })}
          {n > 0 && (
            <g>
              <path d={area} clipPath={`url(#${uid}-above)`} fill="var(--up-soft)" stroke="none" />
              <path d={area} clipPath={`url(#${uid}-below)`} fill="var(--down-soft)" stroke="none" />
              <path d={area} clipPath={`url(#${uid}-below)`} fill={`url(#${uid}-hatch)`} stroke="none" />
            </g>
          )}
          <line x1={left} x2={left + pw} y1={zy} y2={zy} stroke="var(--chart-axis)" strokeWidth={1} shapeRendering="crispEdges" />
          {spotIn && (
            <g>
              <line x1={px(spot as number)} x2={px(spot as number)} y1={plotTop - 6} y2={plotBottom} stroke="var(--fg-muted)" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="3 3" shapeRendering="crispEdges" />
              <text x={place(px(spot as number), spotText).x} y={plotTop - 12} textAnchor={place(px(spot as number), spotText).a} fill="var(--fg)" style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{spotText}</text>
            </g>
          )}
          {n > 0 && <path d={line} fill="none" stroke="var(--chart-1)" strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />}
          {bes.map((b) => {
            const lab = `Breakeven ${formatValue(b)}`;
            const p = place(px(b), lab);
            return (
              <g key={b}>
                <circle cx={px(b)} cy={zy} r={4} fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--fg)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
                <text x={p.x} y={zy + 18} textAnchor={p.a} fill="var(--fg)" style={halo}>{lab}</text>
              </g>
            );
          })}
          {mp && (() => { const p = place(px(mp.spot), maxText); return <text x={p.x} y={py(mp.pnl) - 8} textAnchor={p.a} fill="var(--up-fg)" style={{ ...halo, fontWeight: 500 }}>{maxText}</text>; })()}
          {lp && (() => { const p = place(px(lp.spot), minText); return <text x={p.x} y={py(lp.pnl) + 16} textAnchor={p.a} fill="var(--down-fg)" style={{ ...halo, fontWeight: 500 }}>{minText}</text>; })()}
          {ap && (
            <g>
              <line x1={px(ap.spot)} x2={px(ap.spot)} y1={plotTop} y2={plotBottom} stroke="var(--chart-axis)" strokeWidth={1} shapeRendering="crispEdges" />
              <circle cx={px(ap.spot)} cy={py(ap.pnl)} r={4.5} fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--chart-1)" strokeWidth={2} />
            </g>
          )}
          <rect x={left} y={0} width={pw + right} height={h - 24} fill="transparent" onPointerMove={point} onPointerDown={point}
            onPointerLeave={(e) => { if (e.pointerType === "mouse" && document.activeElement !== wrapRef.current) setActive(null); }} />
        </svg>
        {ap && (
          <div aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10 min-w-36 max-w-64 rounded-overlay border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-small leading-4 shadow-md"
            style={{ top: plotTop, left: px(ap.spot), transform: `translateX(${tipRight ? "calc(-100% - 12px)" : "12px"})` }}>
            <p className="mb-1 text-fg-muted">Price {formatValue(ap.spot)}</p>
            <p className={cn("font-semibold [font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums]", ap.pnl > 0 ? "text-up-fg" : ap.pnl < 0 ? "text-down-fg" : "text-fg")}>
              {ap.pnl > 0 ? `Profit ${formatValue(ap.pnl)}` : ap.pnl < 0 ? `Loss ${formatValue(-ap.pnl)}` : "Break even"}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="sr-only" aria-live="polite" role="status">{said}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Table data for ChartFrame's table view. The Result column says profit, loss or break even in words. */
export function payoffTable(input: { points?: PayoffPoint[]; legs?: PayoffLeg[]; spotRange?: [number, number]; steps?: number }, formatValue: (n: number) => string = formatNumber, caption = "Profit or loss at each price"): DataTableProps {
  const pts = resolve(input.points, input.legs, input.spotRange, input.steps ?? 20);
  return {
    caption,
    columns: [
      { key: "spot", header: "Price", numeric: true },
      { key: "result", header: "Result", numeric: true, direction: (r) => (String(r.result).startsWith("Profit") ? "up" : String(r.result).startsWith("Loss") ? "down" : "flat") },
    ],
    rows: pts.map((p) => ({ spot: formatValue(p.spot), result: p.pnl > 0 ? `Profit ${formatValue(p.pnl)}` : p.pnl < 0 ? `Loss ${formatValue(-p.pnl)}` : "Break even" })),
  };
}
```

## tattva/organisms/PermissionPrompt.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { useFocusAfter } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { CheckIcon, ShieldIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Kbd } from "../atoms/Kbd";

export type PermissionChoice = "once" | "session" | "always" | "deny";
export type PermissionState = "pending" | "allowed-once" | "allowed-session" | "allowed-rule" | "denied";

export interface PermissionDecision {
  choice: PermissionChoice;
  /** The optional note the person added, trimmed. Empty when none. */
  note: string;
}

export interface PermissionPromptLabels {
  once?: string;
  /** Text of the session choice. */
  session?: string;
  /** Receives the rule scope, such as `npm test *`. */
  always?: (scope: string) => ReactNode;
  deny?: string;
  confirm?: string;
  addNote?: string;
  noteHint?: string;
  notePlaceholder?: string;
  scopeHeading?: string;
}

export interface PermissionPromptProps {
  /** Kind of action, such as "Bash command" or "Fetch a web page". Also the dialog name. */
  tool: string;
  /** Plain description of what the action does. */
  description: string;
  /** The literal command or target. Pass an array to list each subcommand of a compound command. */
  target: string | string[];
  /** Why the person is being asked. */
  reason?: string;
  /** Name of the subagent that asked, shown when the request comes from a background task. */
  requestedBy?: string;
  /** Scope of the rule saved by "Allow always", such as `npm test *`. Omit to offer only a one-time approval. */
  ruleScope?: string;
  /** What "Allow for this session" covers, such as `Emails to team@example.com`. Adds a middle choice that lasts until the session ends. Omit to hide it. */
  sessionScope?: string;
  /** Exactly what a saved rule covers, one entry per rule. Shown while the always option is selected. */
  ruleCovers?: string[];
  /** Where and how long a saved rule lasts, such as "Saved for this repository". */
  ruleLifetime?: string;
  /** Explains why only a one-time approval is offered. Shown when ruleScope is omitted. */
  onceOnlyReason?: string;
  /** State (controlled). */
  state?: PermissionState;
  onStateChange?: (state: PermissionState) => void;
  onDecide?: (decision: PermissionDecision) => void;
  /** Move focus to the options when the prompt mounts. Use only when the agent is blocked until the person answers. */
  autoFocus?: boolean;
  labels?: PermissionPromptLabels;
  className?: string;
}

const fromChoice: Record<PermissionChoice, PermissionState> = { once: "allowed-once", session: "allowed-session", always: "allowed-rule", deny: "denied" };

/**
 * Permission request for one tool action. It shows the literal command, a reason, and three choices:
 * allow once, allow always for a named scope, or deny. A saved rule lists exactly what it covers, and
 * the person can add a note to the decision. Unlike ApprovalPrompt it offers scoped persistence and amendment.
 * While focus is inside the prompt, Escape denies and N opens the note field. Tab keeps its normal focus meaning.
 */
export function PermissionPrompt({
  tool, description, target, reason = "This command requires approval", requestedBy, sessionScope, ruleScope, ruleCovers, ruleLifetime, onceOnlyReason,
  state, onStateChange, onDecide, autoFocus = false, labels, className,
}: PermissionPromptProps) {
  const l = {
    once: "Allow once", session: "Allow for this session", deny: "Deny", confirm: "Confirm", addNote: "Add a note",
    noteHint: "Optional. Your note is sent with this decision.", notePlaceholder: "For example: run it in the staging folder only",
    scopeHeading: "A saved rule covers", ...labels,
  };
  const [inner, setInner] = useState<PermissionState>("pending");
  const [choice, setChoice] = useState<PermissionChoice>("once");
  const [noteOpen, setNoteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [decided, setDecided] = useState<PermissionDecision | null>(null);
  const current = state ?? inner;
  const uid = useId();
  const firstRadio = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const noteInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const focusNote = useRef(false);
  const targets = Array.isArray(target) ? target : [target];
  const resultBox = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const byUs = useRef(false);
  // The options disappear once a choice is confirmed. Focus moves to the result, which names the decision.
  const arm = useFocusAfter(current, () => resultBox.current);
  useEffect(() => { if (current === "pending") byUs.current = false; }, [current]);

  useEffect(() => { if (autoFocus) firstRadio.current?.focus(); }, [autoFocus]);
  useEffect(() => { if (noteOpen && focusNote.current) { focusNote.current = false; noteInput.current?.focus(); } }, [noteOpen]);

  const options: { value: PermissionChoice; label: ReactNode }[] = [
    { value: "once", label: l.once },
    ...(sessionScope ? [{ value: "session" as const, label: l.session }] : []),
    ...(ruleScope ? [{ value: "always" as const, label: l.always ? l.always(ruleScope) : <>Allow always for <code className="font-mono text-compact">{ruleScope}</code></> }] : []),
    { value: "deny", label: l.deny },
  ];

  const submit = (picked: PermissionChoice = choice) => {
    const d = { choice: picked, note: note.trim() };
    byUs.current = true;
    arm();
    setDecided(d);
    const s = fromChoice[picked];
    if (state === undefined) setInner(s);
    onStateChange?.(s);
    onDecide?.(d);
  };

  /** Escape is the same as choosing Deny and confirming. N opens the note field unless the person is typing. */
  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (e.defaultPrevented || e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); setChoice("deny"); submit("deny"); return; }
    if (e.key.toLowerCase() === "n" && !e.shiftKey) {
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
      if (t.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || t.isContentEditable || (t.tagName === "INPUT" && (t as HTMLInputElement).type !== "radio")) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      focusNote.current = true;
      if (noteOpen) { focusNote.current = false; noteInput.current?.focus(); } else setNoteOpen(true);
    }
  };

  const resultText: Record<Exclude<PermissionState, "pending">, string> = {
    "allowed-once": "Allowed once",
    "allowed-session": "Allowed for this session",
    "allowed-rule": ruleScope ? `Allowed with a saved rule for ${ruleScope}` : "Allowed with a saved rule",
    denied: "Denied",
  };

  // One live region that stays mounted, so a decision made elsewhere is announced when its text arrives.
  // A decision made here is not announced twice: focus moves to the result instead.
  const live = <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{current !== "pending" && !byUs.current ? resultText[current] : ""}</p>;

  if (current !== "pending") {
    const ok = current !== "denied";
    return (
      <>
        <section ref={resultBox} tabIndex={-1} aria-label={`${tool}: ${resultText[current]}`} className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Badge tone={ok ? "success" : "danger"}>{ok ? <CheckIcon width={11} height={11} /> : <XIcon width={11} height={11} />}{resultText[current]}</Badge>
            <span className="text-body leading-5 font-medium">{tool}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{description}</p>
          <pre tabIndex={0} className="mt-2 overflow-x-auto rounded-card bg-code p-3 font-mono text-small leading-5 text-code-fg">{targets.join("\n")}</pre>
          {decided?.note && <p className="mt-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">Your note: {decided.note}</p>}
        </section>
        {live}
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
    <section aria-label={`Permission needed: ${tool}`} onKeyDown={onKeyDown} className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <ShieldIcon className="text-fg-muted" />
        <p className="font-sans text-body leading-5 font-medium">{tool}</p>
        {requestedBy && <Badge>From {requestedBy}</Badge>}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-1.5 text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{description}</p>
      <div className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
        {targets.map((t, i) => (
          <pre key={i} tabIndex={0} className="overflow-x-auto rounded-card bg-code p-3 font-mono text-small leading-5 text-code-fg"><code>{t}</code></pre>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-2 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg" id={`${uid}-reason`}>{reason}</p>

      <fieldset className="mt-3" aria-describedby={`${uid}-reason`}>
        <legend className="sr-only">Choose how to respond to this request</legend>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          {options.map((o, i) => (
            <label key={o.value} className={cn("flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 rounded-card border px-3 py-2 text-body leading-5 pointer-coarse:min-h-11 has-[:focus-visible]:outline has-[:focus-visible]:outline-(length:--focus-width)", choice === o.value ? "border-line-strong bg-sunken" : "border-transparent hover:bg-hover")}>
              <input ref={i === 0 ? firstRadio : undefined} type="radio" name={`${uid}-choice`} value={o.value} checked={choice === o.value}
                onChange={() => setChoice(o.value)} aria-keyshortcuts={o.value === "deny" ? "Escape" : undefined} className="size-4 shrink-0 accent-[var(--accent)]" />
              <span className="flex-1">{o.label}</span>
              {o.value === "deny" && <span aria-hidden><Kbd>Esc</Kbd></span>}
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        {!ruleScope && onceOnlyReason && <p className="mt-1.5 px-3 text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{onceOnlyReason}</p>}
      </fieldset>

      {choice === "session" && sessionScope && (
        <div className="mt-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken p-3" id={`${uid}-session`}>
          <p className="text-small leading-4 font-medium">Covers until this session ends</p>
          <p className="mt-1.5"><code className="rounded-md bg-surface px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-small leading-4">{sessionScope}</code></p>
        </div>
      )}

      {choice === "always" && ruleScope && (
        <div className="mt-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken p-3" id={`${uid}-scope`}>
          <p className="text-small leading-4 font-medium">{l.scopeHeading}{ruleLifetime ? `. ${ruleLifetime}` : ""}</p>
          <ul className="mt-1.5 space-y-1">
            {(ruleCovers?.length ? ruleCovers : [ruleScope]).map((c) => (
              <li key={c}><code className="rounded-md bg-surface px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-small leading-4">{c}</code></li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="mt-3">
        <button type="button" aria-expanded={noteOpen} aria-controls={`${uid}-note`} onClick={() => setNoteOpen(!noteOpen)} aria-keyshortcuts="N"
          className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control px-1 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted hover:text-fg"><span className="underline underline-offset-2">{l.addNote}</span><span aria-hidden><Kbd>N</Kbd></span></button>
        {noteOpen && (
          <div id={`${uid}-note`} className="mt-1.5">
            <label className="sr-only" htmlFor={`${uid}-note-input`}>{l.addNote}</label>
            <input ref={noteInput} id={`${uid}-note-input`} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder={l.notePlaceholder} aria-describedby={`${uid}-note-hint`}
              className="h-9 w-full rounded-field border border-line bg-surface px-4 text-body leading-5 placeholder:text-fg-subtle" />
            <p id={`${uid}-note-hint`} className="mt-1 px-3 text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{l.noteHint}</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4">
        <Button onClick={() => submit()}>{l.confirm}</Button>
      </div>
    </section>
    {live}
    </>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/PlanCard.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { CheckIcon, InfoIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge, type Tone } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";

export type PlanState = "draft" | "awaiting" | "approved" | "revised";

export interface PlanStep {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** One short sentence on what this step does. */
  description?: string;
}

export interface PlanCardLabels {
  approve?: string;
  revise?: string;
  editStep?: string;
  removeStep?: string;
  /** Shown while the plan is a draft. */
  draftNote?: string;
  approvedNote?: string;
  revisedNote?: string;
}

export interface PlanCardProps {
  title: string;
  steps: PlanStep[];
  /** Time or cost estimate, for example "About 6 minutes" or "Around 40 credits". */
  estimate?: ReactNode;
  /** State (controlled). Draft disables the actions, awaiting enables them. */
  state?: PlanState;
  /** Initial state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultState?: PlanState;
  onStateChange?: (state: PlanState) => void;
  onApprove?: () => void;
  onRevise?: () => void;
  /** Adds an Edit button to each step while the plan can still change. */
  onEditStep?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Adds a Remove button to each step while the plan can still change. */
  onRemoveStep?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Read-only badge text. Pass null to hide it. Hidden once approved. */
  readOnlyLabel?: string | null;
  labels?: PlanCardLabels;
  /** Level of the part's own heading, so it fits the page outline. Default 3. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const stateBadge: Record<PlanState, { tone: Tone; text: string }> = {
  draft: { tone: "neutral", text: "Draft" },
  awaiting: { tone: "neutral", text: "Awaiting approval" },
  approved: { tone: "success", text: "Approved" },
  revised: { tone: "info", text: "Revision requested" },
};

/**
 * The plan, shown before any work starts. The person approves it or asks for a revision.
 * Focus stays where it is when the card appears, because a plan is not a blocking request.
 */
export function PlanCard({
  title, steps, estimate, state, defaultState = "awaiting", onStateChange, onApprove, onRevise, onEditStep, onRemoveStep,
  readOnlyLabel = "Nothing has changed yet", labels, headingLevel = 3, className,
}: PlanCardProps) {
  const l = {
    approve: "Approve", revise: "Revise", editStep: "Edit", removeStep: "Remove",
    draftNote: "The plan is still being written.", approvedNote: "Approved. The work can start.", revisedNote: "Revision requested. A new plan will replace this one.",
    ...labels,
  };
  const [inner, setInner] = useState<PlanState>(defaultState);
  const [announce, setAnnounce] = useState("");
  const current = state ?? inner;
  const set = (s: PlanState) => { if (state === undefined) setInner(s); onStateChange?.(s); setAnnounce(stateBadge[s].text); };
  const editable = current === "draft" || current === "awaiting";
  const badge = stateBadge[current];
  const note = current === "draft" ? l.draftNote : current === "approved" ? l.approvedNote : current === "revised" ? l.revisedNote : null;
  const headingId = `${useId()}-plan`;
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headingId} className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <H id={headingId} className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-title-xs leading-7">{title}</H>
        <Badge tone={badge.tone}>{current === "approved" && <CheckIcon width={11} height={11} />}{badge.text}</Badge>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
        {readOnlyLabel && current !== "approved" && <Badge><InfoIcon width={11} height={11} />{readOnlyLabel}</Badge>}
        {estimate && <span>{estimate}</span>}
      </div>
      <ol className="mt-4 space-y-3">
        {steps.map((s, i) => (
          <li key={s.id} className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <span aria-hidden className="flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong bg-sunken text-small leading-4 tabular-nums text-fg-muted">{i + 1}</span>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pt-0.5">
              <p className="text-body leading-5 font-medium">{s.title}</p>
              {s.description && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{s.description}</p>}
            </div>
            {editable && (onEditStep || onRemoveStep) && (
              <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                {onEditStep && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => onEditStep(s.id)} aria-label={`${l.editStep} step ${i + 1}: ${s.title}`}>{l.editStep}</Button>}
                {onRemoveStep && <IconButton size="sm" label={`${l.removeStep} step ${i + 1}: ${s.title}`} onClick={() => onRemoveStep(s.id)}><XIcon width={14} height={14} /></IconButton>}
              </div>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        {editable ? (
          <>
            <Button disabled={current === "draft"} onClick={() => { onApprove?.(); set("approved"); }}>{l.approve}</Button>
            <Button variant="secondary" disabled={current === "draft"} onClick={() => { onRevise?.(); set("revised"); }}>{l.revise}</Button>
          </>
        ) : null}
        {note && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{note}</p>}
      </div>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{announce}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ProcessDiagram.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { DiagramFigure } from "../molecules/DiagramFigure";

export type ProcessNodeKind = "start" | "step" | "decision" | "end" | "attention";

export interface ProcessNode {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** Shape and meaning. start is a pill, step a rounded box, decision a hexagon, end a box with a double outline, attention a dashed box with a "!" marker. Default step. */
  kind?: ProcessNodeKind;
  /** One sentence shown under the diagram when the node is focused or clicked. */
  detail?: string;
}

export interface ProcessEdge {
  from: string;
  to: string;
  /** Short label such as "yes" or "no". */
  label?: string;
}

export interface ProcessDiagramProps {
  nodes: ProcessNode[];
  /** Arrows. Omit to connect the nodes in order. Arrows run between neighbouring nodes in the layout. */
  edges?: ProcessEdge[];
  /** Short alt for the figure. Name the diagram and say that the full description follows. */
  label: string;
  caption: string;
  /** Long description, visible to everyone. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Override the generated textual definition shown by "View source". */
  source?: string;
}

const KIND_NAME: Record<ProcessNodeKind, string> = { start: "Start", step: "Step", decision: "Decision", end: "End", attention: "Needs a person" };
const W = 132, H = 56, GAP = 44, PAD = 4;

function lines(label: string, max = 16): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  let cur = "";
  for (const w of label.split(" ")) {
    if (cur && (cur + " " + w).length > max) { out.push(cur); cur = w; } else cur = cur ? cur + " " + w : w;
  }
  if (cur) out.push(cur);
  return out.slice(0, 3);
}

const ids = (s: string) => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/g, "_");
function mermaid(nodes: ProcessNode[], edges: ProcessEdge[]) {
  const shape = (n: ProcessNode) => {
    const t = n.label.replace(/"/g, "'");
    switch (n.kind) { case "start": return `${ids(n.id)}([${t}])`; case "decision": return `${ids(n.id)}{{${t}}}`; case "end": return `${ids(n.id)}[[${t}]]`; case "attention": return `${ids(n.id)}[/${t}/]`; default: return `${ids(n.id)}[${t}]`; }
  };
  const byId = new Map(nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
  return ["flowchart LR", ...edges.map((e) => `  ${shape(byId.get(e.from)!)} -->${e.label ? `|${e.label}|` : ""} ${shape(byId.get(e.to)!)}`)].join("\n");
}

/**
 * Flow of nodes and arrows drawn as SVG, left to right, switching to a vertical column when the width is too small.
 * Meaning is carried by shape and label. Nodes are keyboard focusable and describe themselves under the diagram.
 * It renders inside a DiagramFigure with a short aria-label, a visible long description, an ordered-list text alternative and a view-source toggle.
 */
export function ProcessDiagram({ nodes, edges, label, caption, description, source }: ProcessDiagramProps) {
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(0);
  const [active, setActive] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = wrap.current;
    if (!el) return;
    setWidth(el.clientWidth);
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => setWidth(el.clientWidth));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const links = useMemo<ProcessEdge[]>(() => edges ?? nodes.slice(1).map((n, i) => ({ from: nodes[i].id, to: n.id })), [edges, nodes]);
  const horizontal = width === 0 || width >= nodes.length * W + (nodes.length - 1) * GAP + PAD * 2;
  const pos = nodes.map((_, i) => horizontal ? { x: PAD + i * (W + GAP), y: PAD } : { x: PAD, y: PAD + i * (H + GAP) });
  const vbW = horizontal ? PAD * 2 + nodes.length * W + (nodes.length - 1) * GAP : PAD * 2 + W;
  const vbH = horizontal ? PAD * 2 + H : PAD * 2 + nodes.length * H + (nodes.length - 1) * GAP;
  const index = new Map(nodes.map((n, i) => [n.id, i]));
  const act = nodes.find((n) => n.id === active);

  const shapeOf = (n: ProcessNode) => {
    const common = { strokeWidth: 1.5 } as const;
    const stroke = n.kind === "attention" ? "var(--attention)" : "var(--border-strong)";
    const fill = n.kind === "attention" ? "var(--attention-soft)" : n.kind === "end" ? "var(--lime)" : "var(--surface)";
    const on = active === n.id ? "var(--fg)" : stroke;
    switch (n.kind) {
      case "start": return <rect width={W} height={H} rx={H / 2} fill={fill} stroke={on} {...common} />;
      case "decision": return <polygon points={`16,0 ${W - 16},0 ${W},${H / 2} ${W - 16},${H} 16,${H} 0,${H / 2}`} fill={fill} stroke={on} {...common} />;
      case "end": return <><rect width={W} height={H} rx={12} fill={fill} stroke={on} {...common} /><rect x={4} y={4} width={W - 8} height={H - 8} rx={9} fill="none" stroke="var(--on-lime)" strokeWidth={1} /></>;
      case "attention": return <rect width={W} height={H} rx={12} fill={fill} stroke={on} strokeDasharray="5 3" {...common} />;
      default: return <rect width={W} height={H} rx={12} fill={fill} stroke={on} {...common} />;
    }
  };

  const svg = (
    <div ref={wrap} className="w-full">
      <svg role="list" aria-label={label} viewBox={`0 0 ${vbW} ${vbH}`} width={vbW} height={vbH} style={{ maxWidth: "100%", height: "auto", display: "block", margin: "0 auto" }}>
        <defs>
          <marker id="pd-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 1 L10 5 L0 9 z" fill="var(--fg-subtle)" /></marker>
        </defs>
        {links.map((e, i) => {
          const a = index.get(e.from), b = index.get(e.to);
          if (a === undefined || b === undefined) return null;
          const pa = pos[a], pb = pos[b];
          const [x1, y1, x2, y2] = horizontal ? [pa.x + W, pa.y + H / 2, pb.x, pb.y + H / 2] : [pa.x + W / 2, pa.y + H, pb.x + W / 2, pb.y];
          return (
            <g key={i} aria-hidden>
              <line x1={x1} y1={y1} x2={x2} y2={y2} stroke="var(--fg-subtle)" strokeWidth={1.5} markerEnd="url(#pd-arrow)" />
              {e.label && <text x={(x1 + x2) / 2} y={(y1 + y2) / 2 - 6} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} fill="var(--fg-muted)">{e.label}</text>}
            </g>
          );
        })}
        {nodes.map((n, i) => {
          const ls = lines(n.label);
          const kind = n.kind ?? "step";
          return (
            <g key={n.id} role="listitem" tabIndex={0} aria-label={`${i + 1}. ${KIND_NAME[kind]}: ${n.label}`} transform={`translate(${pos[i].x} ${pos[i].y})`}
              style={{ cursor: "pointer", outline: "none" }} onFocus={() => setActive(n.id)} onBlur={() => setActive((c) => (c === n.id ? null : c))} onClick={() => setActive(n.id)}>
              {shapeOf(n)}
              <text textAnchor="middle" fontSize={12} fill={kind === "end" ? "var(--on-lime)" : "var(--fg)"}>
                {ls.map((l, k) => <tspan key={k} x={W / 2} y={H / 2 + 4 + (k - (ls.length - 1) / 2) * 14}>{l}</tspan>)}
              </text>
              {kind === "attention" && <text x={W - 12} y={14} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={12} fontWeight={700} fill="var(--attention-fg)">!</text>}
            </g>
          );
        })}
      </svg>
    </div>
  );

  const alternative = (
    <>
      <p className="mb-1 text-micro font-bold uppercase tracking-caps text-fg-muted">Text alternative</p>
      <ol className="m-0 list-decimal space-y-1 pl-5">
        {nodes.map((n) => {
          const out = links.filter((e) => e.from === n.id).map((e) => `${e.label ? `${e.label}: ` : ""}${nodes.find((x) => x.id === e.to)?.label ?? e.to}`);
          return <li key={n.id}><span className="font-medium text-fg">{KIND_NAME[n.kind ?? "step"]}: {n.label}.</span>{n.detail ? ` ${n.detail}` : ""}{out.length > 0 ? ` Leads to ${out.join(", ")}.` : ""}</li>;
        })}
      </ol>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <DiagramFigure label={label} caption={caption} description={description} alternative={<>
      <div role="status" className="mb-3 min-h-6 text-compact text-fg">{act ? <><span className="font-medium">{KIND_NAME[act.kind ?? "step"]}: {act.label}.</span> <span className="text-fg-muted">{act.detail}</span></> : <span className="text-fg-subtle">Focus or select a node to read its detail.</span>}</div>
      <ul className="m-0 mb-3 flex list-none flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 p-0 text-small text-fg-muted">
        {(["start", "step", "decision", "end", "attention"] as const).filter((k) => nodes.some((n) => (n.kind ?? "step") === k)).map((k) => <li key={k}>{{ start: "Pill", step: "Rounded box", decision: "Hexagon", end: "Double outline", attention: "Dashed box with !" }[k]} is {KIND_NAME[k].toLowerCase()}</li>)}
      </ul>
      {alternative}
    </>}
      source={source ?? mermaid(nodes, links)} sourceLanguage="mermaid">
      {svg}
    </DiagramFigure>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ProjectPanel.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { headingTag, subHeadingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { EditIcon, FileIcon, NotebookIcon, PlusIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Meter } from "../atoms/Meter";

export interface ProjectFile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Size or length, such as "12 pages". */
  detail?: string;
}

export interface ProjectPanelLabels {
  instructions?: string;
  noInstructions?: string;
  editInstructions?: string;
  files?: string;
  noFiles?: string;
  addFiles?: string;
  /** Receives the file name. */
  remove?: (name: string) => string;
  /** Receives the file name. */
  removed?: (name: string) => string;
  /** Receives used and total, already formatted. */
  capacity?: (used: string, total: string) => string;
  capacityLabel?: string;
  /** Receives how many chats use the project. */
  chats?: (n: number) => string;
  showMore?: string;
  showLess?: string;
}

export interface ProjectPanelProps {
  /** The project's name. */
  name: string;
  /** One line about what the project is for. */
  description?: string;
  /** How the assistant should work in every chat of this project. */
  instructions?: string;
  onEditInstructions?: () => void;
  /** Files every chat in the project can read. */
  files: ProjectFile[];
  onAddFiles?: () => void;
  onRemoveFile?: (id: string) => void;
  /** How much of the project's knowledge room the files fill. */
  capacity?: { used: number; total: number };
  /** How many chats belong to the project. */
  chatCount?: number;
  labels?: ProjectPanelLabels;
  /** Level of the project name's heading, so it fits the page outline. Default 2. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const fmt = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US");

/**
 * A project: chats that share the same instructions and files. The panel shows the project's name, its instructions
 * (folded after three lines), the files every chat can read, and how full the project's knowledge is. Taking a file
 * out moves focus to the next file, so a keyboard user never lands on nothing.
 */
export function ProjectPanel({ name, description, instructions, onEditInstructions, files, onAddFiles, onRemoveFile, capacity, chatCount, labels, headingLevel = 2, className }: ProjectPanelProps) {
  const l = {
    instructions: "Instructions", noInstructions: "No instructions yet. Tell the assistant how to work in this project.", editInstructions: "Edit instructions",
    files: "Files", noFiles: "No files yet. Every chat in this project can read the files you add here.", addFiles: "Add files",
    remove: (n: string) => `Remove ${n}`, removed: (n: string) => `${n} removed.`,
    capacity: (u: string, t: string) => `${u} of ${t} tokens used`, capacityLabel: "Project knowledge used",
    chats: (n: number) => (n === 1 ? "1 chat" : `${n} chats`), showMore: "Show all", showLess: "Show less", ...labels,
  };
  const [more, setMore] = useState(false);
  const uid = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const H2 = subHeadingTag(headingLevel);
  const list = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);
  const said = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  const long = (instructions?.length ?? 0) > 180;
  const remove = (f: ProjectFile) => {
    if (!onRemoveFile) return;
    const buttons = [...(list.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-remove]") ?? [])];
    const at = buttons.findIndex((b) => b.dataset.remove === f.id);
    const next = buttons[at + 1] ?? buttons[at - 1];
    onRemoveFile(f.id);
    if (said.current) said.current.textContent = l.removed(f.name);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => (next && next.isConnected ? next : document.getElementById(`${uid}-files`))?.focus());
  };
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} className={cn("space-y-5 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 sm:p-5", className)}>
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3">
          <H id={`${uid}-h`} className="m-0 min-w-0 flex-1 text-title-sm leading-7 font-semibold text-fg">{name}</H>
          {chatCount != null && <span className="shrink-0 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.chats(chatCount)}</span>}
        </div>
        {description && <p className="m-0 mt-1 text-body leading-6 text-fg-muted">{description}</p>}
      </div>

      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <NotebookIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="shrink-0 text-fg-muted" />
          <H2 className="m-0 min-w-0 flex-1 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">{l.instructions}</H2>
          {onEditInstructions && <IconButton size="sm" label={l.editInstructions} onClick={onEditInstructions}><EditIcon width={14} height={14} /></IconButton>}
        </div>
        {instructions
          ? <>
              <p id={`${uid}-ins`} className={cn("m-0 mt-2 text-body leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-fg", long && !more && "line-clamp-3")}>{instructions}</p>
              {long && <button type="button" aria-expanded={more} aria-controls={`${uid}-ins`} onClick={() => setMore(!more)} className="mt-1 cursor-pointer text-small leading-5 font-medium text-fg hover:text-accent transition-colors pointer-coarse:min-h-11">{more ? l.showLess : l.showMore}</button>}
            </>
          : <p className="m-0 mt-2 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.noInstructions}</p>}
      </div>

      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="shrink-0 text-fg-muted" />
          <H2 id={`${uid}-files`} tabIndex={-1} className="m-0 min-w-0 flex-1 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg outline-none">{l.files}</H2>
          {onAddFiles && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onAddFiles} leading={<PlusIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />}>{l.addFiles}</Button>}
        </div>
        {files.length === 0
          ? <p className="m-0 mt-2 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.noFiles}</p>
          : (
            <ul ref={list} className="mt-2 space-y-1">
              {files.map((f) => (
                <li key={f.id} className="flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-control px-2 py-1 hover:bg-hover">
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="block truncate text-body leading-5 text-fg" title={f.name}>{f.name}</span>
                    {f.detail && <span className="block text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{f.detail}</span>}
                  </span>
                  {onRemoveFile && <IconButton size="sm" label={l.remove(f.name)} data-remove={f.id} onClick={() => remove(f)}><XIcon width={14} height={14} /></IconButton>}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        {capacity && (
          <div className="mt-4">
            <p className="m-0 mb-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{l.capacity(fmt(capacity.used), fmt(capacity.total))}</p>
            <Meter value={capacity.used} max={capacity.total} warnAt={0.9} label={l.capacityLabel} valueText={l.capacity(fmt(capacity.used), fmt(capacity.total))} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <p ref={said} role="status" className="sr-only" />
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/PromptBox.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { useAnnounceChange } from "../lib/focus";
import { SparkleIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";

/** Prompt field with a Generate button and example prompts. Screen readers hear when generating starts and ends. */
export function PromptBox({ onGenerate, busy, placeholder = "Describe what you want to create…", examples = [], busyMessage = "Generating", doneMessage = "Done. The results are ready." }: {
  onGenerate: (prompt: string) => void; busy?: boolean; placeholder?: string; examples?: string[];
  /** What screen readers hear when generating starts. */
  busyMessage?: string;
  /** What screen readers hear when it ends. Say where the results are if that helps, such as "4 images below". */
  doneMessage?: string;
}) {
  const [v, setV] = useState("");
  const said = useAnnounceChange(!!busy, (now) => (now ? busyMessage : doneMessage));
  const inputId = useId();
  return (
    <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (v.trim() && !busy) onGenerate(v.trim()); }} className="space-y-2">
      <div className="rounded-field border border-line-strong bg-surface p-2.5 shadow-sm focus-within:border-fg-subtle has-[textarea:focus-visible]:outline-2 has-[textarea:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2 has-[textarea:focus-visible]:outline-[var(--focus-ring)]">
        <label htmlFor={inputId} className="sr-only">Prompt</label>
        <textarea id={inputId} rows={3} value={v} onChange={(e) => setV(e.target.value)} placeholder={placeholder}
          className="block w-full resize-none bg-transparent p-2 text-body-lg outline-none placeholder:text-fg-subtle [field-sizing:content]" />
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1 pt-1">
          <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{v.length} characters</span>
          <Button type="submit" variant="lime" size="sm" disabled={!v.trim() || busy} leading={busy ? <Spinner size={14} /> : <SparkleIcon width={14} height={14} />}>{busy ? "Generating…" : "Generate"}</Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{said}</p>
      {examples.length > 0 && (
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">Try:
          {examples.map((x) => <button key={x} type="button" onClick={() => setV(x)} className="rounded-control border border-line px-2 py-0.5 hover:bg-hover">{x}</button>)}
        </p>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/PromptIndex.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent as ReactKeyboardEvent, PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { Sheet } from "./Sheet";

export interface PromptIndexItem {
  id: string;
  /** The person's message. Shown on one line; the full text stays in the button for screen readers. */
  text: string;
  /** When it was sent, already formatted, e.g. "10:42". */
  time?: string;
}

export interface PromptIndexProps {
  /** The person's own messages in this thread, oldest first. */
  items: PromptIndexItem[];
  /** The message in view. Marked with aria-current and a longer mark. */
  currentId?: string;
  /** Called with the id of the message to scroll to. Your code scrolls and moves focus to that message. */
  onJump: (id: string) => void;
  /** Name of the navigation, and the heading of the list. */
  label?: string;
  /** list: a plain list for a side panel or sheet. rail: thin marks on the right edge of a thread that open on hover, focus or tap. */
  variant?: "list" | "rail";
  className?: string;
}

const rowsIn = (root: HTMLElement | null) => Array.from(root?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-pi-item]") ?? []);

/** Arrow keys, Home and End move focus between the items. Enter and Space press the focused one natively. */
function moveFocus(e: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) {
  const rows = rowsIn(e.currentTarget);
  const at = rows.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement);
  if (at < 0) return;
  const next = { ArrowDown: at + 1, ArrowUp: at - 1, Home: 0, End: rows.length - 1 }[e.key];
  if (next === undefined) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  rows[Math.max(0, Math.min(rows.length - 1, next))]?.focus();
}

interface ListProps {
  items: PromptIndexItem[];
  currentId?: string;
  onPick: (id: string) => void;
  /** Hidden when a sheet title already names the list. */
  heading?: string;
  label: string;
  /** Move focus to the current item once mounted (inside the sheet). */
  focusCurrent?: boolean;
}

function IndexList({ items, currentId, onPick, heading, label, focusCurrent }: ListProps) {
  const headId = useId();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const tabbable = items.some((i) => i.id === currentId) ? currentId : items[0]?.id;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focusCurrent) return;
    // One frame later, so this runs after the sheet has put focus on its first control.
    const f = requestAnimationFrame(() => ref.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-pi-item][tabindex="0"]')?.focus());
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(f);
  }, [focusCurrent]);
  return (
    <nav ref={ref} aria-label={heading ? undefined : label} aria-labelledby={heading ? headId : undefined} onKeyDown={moveFocus} className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
      {heading && <p id={headId} className="px-2 text-small font-medium text-fg-muted">{heading}</p>}
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-2 py-2 text-compact text-fg-muted">No questions yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <ol className="flex flex-col">
          {items.map((it) => {
            const current = it.id === currentId;
            return (
              <li key={it.id}>
                <button type="button" data-pi-item tabIndex={it.id === tabbable ? 0 : -1} aria-current={current ? "location" : undefined} title={it.text} onClick={() => onPick(it.id)}
                  className={cn("group flex min-h-9 w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-compact hover:bg-hover pointer-coarse:min-h-11",
                    current ? "font-medium text-fg" : "text-fg-muted hover:text-fg")}>
                  <span aria-hidden className={cn("h-4 w-0.5 shrink-0 rounded-full motion-safe:transition-colors motion-safe:duration-[var(--dur-fast)] forced-colors:bg-[CanvasText]", current ? "bg-fg" : "bg-line-strong")} />
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate group-focus-visible:whitespace-normal">{it.text}</span>
                  {it.time && <span className="shrink-0 text-small text-fg-subtle tabular-nums"><span className="sr-only">, </span>{it.time}</span>}
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      )}
    </nav>
  );
}

/**
 * An index of the person's own messages in a long thread, so they can jump back to one.
 * The list variant is a plain list. The rail variant is a column of short marks that opens into a list on hover, on
 * keyboard focus or on a tap; below the sm breakpoint it is replaced by a "Questions" button that opens a bottom sheet.
 */
export function PromptIndex({ items, currentId, onJump, label = "Your questions", variant = "list", className }: PromptIndexProps) {
  if (variant === "list") {
    return (
      <div className={className}>
        <IndexList items={items} currentId={currentId} onPick={onJump} heading={label} label={label} />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <Rail items={items} currentId={currentId} onJump={onJump} label={label} />
      <PhoneTrigger items={items} currentId={currentId} onJump={onJump} label={label} />
    </div>
  );
}

function Rail({ items, currentId, onJump, label }: { items: PromptIndexItem[]; currentId?: string; onJump: (id: string) => void; label: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const [hover, setHover] = useState(false);
  const [focusIn, setFocusIn] = useState(false);
  const [tapped, setTapped] = useState(false);
  const [held, setHeld] = useState(false); // Escape closes the rail until the pointer or focus leaves
  // A tap on a closed rail only opens it; the click that follows that tap must not jump.
  const swallow = useRef(false);
  const open = (hover || focusIn || tapped) && !held;
  const tabbable = items.some((i) => i.id === currentId) ? currentId : items[0]?.id;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tapped) return;
    const away = (e: PointerEvent) => { if (!ref.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setTapped(false); };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", away);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", away);
  }, [tapped]);

  if (items.length === 0) return null;
  const onPointerDown = (e: ReactPointerEvent) => {
    swallow.current = e.pointerType === "touch" && !open;
    if (swallow.current) setTapped(true);
  };
  return (
    <nav ref={ref} aria-label={label}
      onPointerEnter={(e) => { if (e.pointerType !== "touch") setHover(true); }}
      onPointerLeave={(e) => { if (e.pointerType !== "touch") { setHover(false); setHeld(false); } }}
      onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
      // Only keyboard focus opens the rail; a mouse click also focuses the button but should not hold it open.
      onFocus={(e) => setFocusIn(e.target.matches(":focus-visible"))}
      onBlur={(e) => { if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) { setFocusIn(false); setHeld(false); } }}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === "Escape" && open) { e.stopPropagation(); setHeld(true); setTapped(false); return; }
        moveFocus(e);
      }}
      tabIndex={0}
      className={cn("ml-auto flex max-h-full flex-col overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-overlay border max-sm:hidden",
        "motion-safe:transition-colors motion-safe:duration-[var(--dur-fast)]",
        open ? "w-72 border-line bg-raised p-1 shadow-lg" : "border-transparent p-1")}>
      <ol className="flex flex-col">
        {items.map((it) => {
          const current = it.id === currentId;
          return (
            <li key={it.id}>
              <button type="button" data-pi-item tabIndex={it.id === tabbable ? 0 : -1} aria-current={current ? "location" : undefined} title={open ? it.text : undefined}
                onClick={() => { if (swallow.current) { swallow.current = false; return; } onJump(it.id); setTapped(false); }}
                className={cn("group flex min-h-6 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-end gap-3 rounded-lg text-left text-compact pointer-coarse:min-h-11",
                  open ? "px-2 py-1 hover:bg-hover" : "px-1", current ? "font-medium text-fg" : "text-fg-muted hover:text-fg")}>
                <span className={cn(open ? "min-w-0 flex-1 truncate group-focus-visible:whitespace-normal" : "sr-only")}>{it.text}</span>
                {it.time && <span className={cn(open ? "shrink-0 text-small text-fg-subtle tabular-nums" : "sr-only")}><span className="sr-only">, </span>{it.time}</span>}
                <span aria-hidden className={cn("h-0.5 shrink-0 rounded-full forced-colors:bg-[CanvasText]",
                  "motion-safe:transition-[width,background-color] motion-safe:duration-[var(--dur-fast)] motion-safe:ease-[var(--ease-out)]",
                  current ? "w-5 bg-fg" : "w-3 bg-line-strong")} />
              </button>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  );
}

function PhoneTrigger({ items, currentId, onJump, label }: { items: PromptIndexItem[]; currentId?: string; onJump: (id: string) => void; label: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  // The sheet hands focus back to this button when it has gone. The jump waits for that, so the app's own
  // focus move to the message is not undone by the sheet closing.
  const pending = useRef<string | null>(null);
  if (items.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="sm:hidden">
      <button type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        onFocus={() => { const id = pending.current; pending.current = null; if (id) onJump(id); }}
        className="inline-flex h-9 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-control border border-line bg-surface px-4 text-compact text-fg hover:bg-hover tap">
        Questions
        <span className="text-small text-fg-subtle tabular-nums"><span className="sr-only">, </span>{items.length}</span>
      </button>
      <Sheet open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title={label} side="bottom">
        <IndexList items={items} currentId={currentId} label={label} focusCurrent onPick={(id) => { pending.current = id; setOpen(false); }} />
      </Sheet>
    </div>
  );
}
```
