## tattva/organisms/QuestionSet.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { NumberField } from "../atoms/NumberField";
import { TextField } from "../atoms/TextField";
import { Tabs } from "../molecules/Tabs";

export interface QuestionSetOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  /** One short line that tells the options apart. */
  description?: string;
}

export interface QuestionSetInput {
  kind: "text" | "number" | "date";
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Shown before a number, such as "₹". */
  prefix?: string;
}

export interface QuestionSetQuestion {
  id: string;
  /** Short name used on the tab, such as "Amount". */
  label: string;
  /** The full question. */
  question: string;
  options?: QuestionSetOption[];
  /** When set, a "Something else" choice reveals this input. Without options, the input shows straight away. */
  input?: QuestionSetInput;
  /** Default true. An optional question never blocks the final button. */
  required?: boolean;
  /** Several options may be picked. The answer holds their values joined by commas (see answerValues). */
  multiple?: boolean;
  /** The value of the option to suggest. It is marked "Recommended", and listed first. */
  recommended?: string;
}

/** Answer value when the person skipped a question. */
export const QS_SKIPPED = "__skipped__";
/** Answer value when the person let the assistant decide. */
export const QS_AGENT_DECIDES = "__agent__";
/** The picked values of an answer, for a question with `multiple`. */
export const answerValues = (value: string | undefined) => (value ?? "").split(",").map((v) => v.trim()).filter(Boolean);

export interface QuestionSetProps {
  questions: QuestionSetQuestion[];
  /** Answer text per question id. An empty or missing value means unanswered. */
  answers: Record<string, string>;
  onAnswer: (id: string, value: string) => void;
  /** The single final action. Called from the button on the question that completes the set. */
  onSubmit: () => void;
  /** Facts already known, shown above the questions as "Already have". */
  known?: { label: string; value: ReactNode }[];
  /** Messages from the parent for answers it found invalid. The card jumps to the first one. */
  errors?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Replace the built-in input, for example to drop in a DatePicker. Called when a question's input is showing. */
  renderInput?: (q: QuestionSetQuestion, value: string, onChange: (value: string) => void) => ReactNode;
  /** Label of the final button. */
  submitLabel?: string;
  /** Label of the button while questions remain. */
  nextLabel?: string;
  title?: string;
  /** Name of the run that asked. */
  runName?: string;
  /** Show "Question 2 of 3" above the question. Default true. */
  showProgress?: boolean;
  /** Offer Skip on questions that are not required. Default false. */
  allowSkip?: boolean;
  /** Offer "You decide" on every question, so the assistant picks. Default false. */
  allowAgentDecides?: boolean;
  /** Show every answer for a last look, with a Change link each, before the final button. Default false. */
  review?: boolean;
  /** Called by "Use the defaults": the assistant fills in the rest. The button shows only when this is set. */
  onUseDefaults?: () => void;
  /** Words on the buttons, for localisation. */
  labels?: Partial<Record<"back" | "skip" | "agentDecides" | "recommended" | "useDefaults" | "review" | "change" | "skipped" | "agentDecided" | "of" | "question", string>>;
  className?: string;
}

const LABELS = { back: "Back", skip: "Skip", agentDecides: "You decide", recommended: "Recommended", useDefaults: "Use the defaults", review: "Check your answers", change: "Change", skipped: "Skipped", agentDecided: "Assistant decides", of: "of", question: "Question" };

const filled = (v: string | undefined) => (v ?? "").trim() !== "";
const field = "flex min-h-10 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-field border bg-surface px-3 text-body leading-5 text-fg transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] pointer-coarse:min-h-11 focus-within:outline-(length:--focus-width) focus-within:outline-solid focus-within:outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-[color:var(--focus-ring)]";

/**
 * One card that asks every missing fact at once. A tab per question, one panel visible, and one button.
 * Tapping an option answers and moves on to the next unanswered question. The button reads "Next" until the
 * answer that completes the set, where it reads the submit label. After submit, the parent should replace the card
 * with a Receipt so the thread stays short.
 */
export function QuestionSet({ questions, answers, onAnswer, onSubmit, known, errors, renderInput, submitLabel = "Continue", nextLabel = "Next", title = "A few quick questions", runName,
  showProgress = true, allowSkip = false, allowAgentDecides = false, review = false, onUseDefaults, labels, className }: QuestionSetProps) {
  const L = { ...LABELS, ...labels };
  const uid = useId();
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const firstOpen = questions.findIndex((q) => q.required !== false && !filled(answers[q.id]));
  const [cur, setCur] = useState(firstOpen < 0 ? 0 : firstOpen);
  const [otherOpen, setOtherOpen] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [announce, setAnnounce] = useState("");
  const [reviewing, setReviewing] = useState(false);
  const moved = useRef<"tab" | "input" | "button" | null>(null);

  const n = questions.length;
  const idx = Math.min(cur, Math.max(n - 1, 0));
  const q = questions[idx];
  const isRequired = (x: QuestionSetQuestion) => x.required !== false;
  /** Next question still to answer: any unanswered one ahead (optional ones are still shown on the way), then,
   *  wrapping around, a required one left behind. Optional questions already passed never block the end. */
  const nextOpen = (from: number, a: Record<string, string>) => {
    for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) { const j = (from + i) % n; if (!filled(a[questions[j].id]) && (j > from || isRequired(questions[j]))) return j; }
    return -1;
  };

  const go = (i: number, focus: "tab" | "input" | "button" | null) => { moved.current = focus; setCur(i); };
  const answerNow = (id: string, value: string) => { onAnswer(id, value); };

  // After a move we made, put focus somewhere sensible: the tapped option disappeared with its panel.
  useEffect(() => {
    const m = moved.current; moved.current = null;
    if (!m || !root.current) return;
    const sel = m === "tab" ? '[role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]' : m === "input" ? "[data-qs-input] input" : "[data-qs-submit]";
    root.current.querySelector<HTMLElement>(sel)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  });

  useEffect(() => { if (q) setAnnounce(reviewing ? L.review : `${L.question} ${idx + 1} ${L.of} ${n}: ${q.label}`); }, [idx, n, q, reviewing, L.review, L.question, L.of]);

  const errKey = Object.keys(errors ?? {}).filter((k) => errors?.[k]).sort().join("|");
  useEffect(() => {
    const i = questions.findIndex((x) => errors?.[x.id]);
    if (i >= 0) setCur(i);
    // Only when the set of errored questions changes, not on every render.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [errKey]);

  // Latest-state ref so Enter (which waits a tick for a number field to commit) never reads stale answers.
  const latest = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
  const remaining = questions.filter((x, i) => i !== idx && !filled(answers[x.id]) && (i > idx || isRequired(x)));
  const last = remaining.length === 0;
  const canAct = !q || !isRequired(q) || filled(answers[q.id]);
  const act = () => {
    if (reviewing) { onSubmit(); return; }
    if (!canAct) return;
    if (last) { if (review) { setReviewing(true); moved.current = "button"; } else onSubmit(); return; }
    const j = nextOpen(idx, answers);
    if (j >= 0) go(j, "tab");
  };
  latest.current = act;

  if (!q) return null;

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
    // Number keys pick an option, as in other agent tools; never while typing in a field.
    if (!reviewing && /^[1-9]$/.test(e.key) && !["INPUT", "TEXTAREA", "SELECT"].includes(t.tagName) && !e.metaKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey) {
      // In the order shown: the recommended option is first.
      const shown = [...(q.options ?? [])].sort((a, b) => Number(b.value === q.recommended) - Number(a.value === q.recommended));
      const o = shown[Number(e.key) - 1];
      if (o) { e.preventDefault(); pick(o); }
      return;
    }
    if (e.key !== "Enter" || t.tagName !== "INPUT" || e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    // A number field commits its draft in its own Enter handler; wait one tick so we see the result.
    setTimeout(() => latest.current(), 0);
  };

  const chosen = answers[q.id] ?? "";
  // The recommended option leads, so the suggestion is the first thing read.
  const opts = [...(q.options ?? [])].sort((a, b) => Number(b.value === q.recommended) - Number(a.value === q.recommended));
  const isOption = opts.some((o) => o.value === chosen) || (!!q.multiple && answerValues(chosen).some((v) => opts.some((o) => o.value === v)));
  /** A choice that is not an option: skip, or let the assistant decide. Moves on like an option does. */
  const special = (value: string) => {
    setOtherOpen((s) => ({ ...s, [q.id]: false }));
    answerNow(q.id, value);
    const j = nextOpen(idx, { ...answers, [q.id]: value });
    go(j >= 0 ? j : idx, j >= 0 ? "tab" : "button");
  };
  const showOther = !q.multiple && !!q.input && (opts.length === 0 || (otherOpen[q.id] ?? (filled(chosen) && !isOption)));
  const err = errors?.[q.id];

  const pick = (o: QuestionSetOption) => {
    if (q.multiple) {
      // Several may be picked: toggle this one and stay, so more can be chosen. The button moves on.
      const cur = answerValues(chosen).filter((v) => v !== QS_SKIPPED && v !== QS_AGENT_DECIDES);
      answerNow(q.id, (cur.includes(o.value) ? cur.filter((v) => v !== o.value) : [...cur, o.value]).join(","));
      return;
    }
    setOtherOpen((s) => ({ ...s, [q.id]: false }));
    answerNow(q.id, o.value);
    const j = nextOpen(idx, { ...answers, [q.id]: o.value });
    go(j >= 0 ? j : idx, j >= 0 ? "tab" : "button");
  };
  const openOther = () => {
    setOtherOpen((s) => ({ ...s, [q.id]: true }));
    if (isOption) answerNow(q.id, "");
    moved.current = "input"; // the state change above re-renders, and the focus effect then runs
  };

  const setValue = (v: string) => answerNow(q.id, v);
  const inp = q.input;
  const inputEl = !inp ? null : renderInput ? renderInput(q, chosen, setValue) : inp.kind === "number" ? (
    <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
      {inp.prefix && <span aria-hidden className="text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{inp.prefix}</span>}
      <NumberField label={inp.prefix ? `${q.label} (${inp.prefix})` : q.label} value={filled(chosen) && Number.isFinite(Number(chosen)) ? Number(chosen) : null}
        onChange={(v) => setValue(v === null ? "" : String(v))} invalid={!!err} aria-describedby={err ? `${uid}-err` : undefined} />
    </span>
  ) : inp.kind === "date" ? (
    <span className={cn(field, err ? "border-danger" : "border-line hover:border-line-strong", "sm:max-w-56")}>
      <input type="date" aria-label={q.label} value={chosen} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} aria-invalid={err ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={err ? `${uid}-err` : undefined}
        className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent py-1 text-fg outline-none focus-visible:outline-none" />
    </span>
  ) : (
    <TextField aria-label={q.label} value={chosen} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} placeholder={inp.placeholder} invalid={!!err} aria-describedby={err ? `${uid}-err` : undefined} />
  );

  const panel = (
    <div>
      {showProgress && n > 1 && <p className="mb-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{L.question} {idx + 1} {L.of} {n}</p>}
      <p id={`${uid}-q`} className="text-body leading-5 font-medium break-words">{q.question}{!isRequired(q) && <span className="ml-2 text-small leading-4 font-normal text-fg-muted">Optional</span>}</p>
      {opts.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="mt-3 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {opts.map((o) => {
            const on = (q.multiple ? answerValues(chosen).includes(o.value) : chosen === o.value) && !showOther;
            return (
              <li key={o.value}>
                <button type="button" {...(q.multiple ? { role: "checkbox", "aria-checked": on } : { "aria-pressed": on })} onClick={() => pick(o)}
                  className={cn("h-full w-full cursor-pointer rounded-card border px-3 py-2 text-left transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] pointer-coarse:min-h-11 forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]",
                    on ? "border-fg bg-selected" : "border-line bg-surface hover:border-line-strong hover:bg-bg")}>
                  <span className="flex items-start gap-2">
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-body leading-5 font-medium">
                        <span>{o.label}</span>
                        {o.value === q.recommended && <Badge tone="neutral">{L.recommended}</Badge>}
                      </span>
                      {o.description && <span className="mt-0.5 block text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{o.description}</span>}
                    </span>
                    {q.multiple
                      ? <span aria-hidden className={cn("mt-0.5 inline-flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[calc(var(--radius-field)/2)] border", on ? "border-fg bg-fg text-bg" : "border-line-strong")}>{on && <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} />}</span>
                      : on && <CheckIcon aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />}
                  </span>
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
          {inp && !q.multiple && (
            <li>
              <button type="button" aria-pressed={showOther} onClick={openOther}
                className={cn("h-full w-full cursor-pointer rounded-card border border-dashed px-3 py-2 text-left text-body leading-5 font-medium transition-colors duration-[var(--dur-fast)] pointer-coarse:min-h-11 forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]",
                  showOther ? "border-fg bg-sunken" : "border-line-strong bg-surface hover:bg-bg")}>
                Something else
              </button>
            </li>
          )}
        </ul>
      )}
      {showOther && <div data-qs-input className="mt-3">{inputEl}</div>}
      {((allowSkip && !isRequired(q)) || allowAgentDecides) && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {allowAgentDecides && <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-pressed={chosen === QS_AGENT_DECIDES} onClick={() => special(QS_AGENT_DECIDES)}>{L.agentDecides}</Button>}
          {allowSkip && !isRequired(q) && <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-pressed={chosen === QS_SKIPPED} onClick={() => special(QS_SKIPPED)}>{L.skip}</Button>}
        </div>
      )}
      {err && (
        <p id={`${uid}-err`} role="alert" className="mt-2 flex items-start gap-1.5 text-body leading-5 text-danger-fg">
          <AlertIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{err}</span>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  const tabs = questions.map((x, i) => {
    const done = filled(answers[x.id]);
    const bad = !!errors?.[x.id];
    return {
      id: x.id,
      label: (
        <>
          <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-current text-micro tabular-nums">
            {bad ? <AlertIcon width={12} height={12} /> : done ? <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} /> : i + 1}
          </span>
          {/* On a phone only the current step shows its name, so all the steps fit; the others keep their name for screen readers. */}
          <span className={cn(i !== idx && "max-sm:sr-only")}>{x.label}</span>
          <span className="sr-only">{bad ? ", needs another answer" : done ? ", answered" : ", not answered yet"}</span>
        </>
      ),
      panel: i === idx ? panel : undefined,
    };
  });

  const hasKnown = known && known.length > 0;
  /** An answer in words, for the review: option labels, typed text, Skipped or Assistant decides. */
  const answerText = (x: QuestionSetQuestion) => {
    const v = answers[x.id];
    if (!filled(v)) return "—";
    if (v === QS_SKIPPED) return L.skipped;
    if (v === QS_AGENT_DECIDES) return L.agentDecided;
    const label = (val: string) => x.options?.find((o) => o.value === val)?.label ?? val;
    return x.multiple ? answerValues(v).map(label).join(", ") : label(v);
  };
  const reviewList = (
    <div>
      <p className="text-body leading-5 font-medium">{L.review}</p>
      <dl className="mt-3 divide-y divide-line rounded-card border border-line">
        {questions.map((x, i) => (
          <div key={x.id} className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-3 py-2">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <dt className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{x.label}</dt>
              <dd className="m-0 mt-0.5 text-body leading-5 font-medium break-words">{answerText(x)}</dd>
            </div>
            <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label={`${L.change}: ${x.label}`} onClick={() => { setReviewing(false); go(i, "tab"); }}>{L.change}</Button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <section ref={root} aria-labelledby={`${uid}-t`} onKeyDown={onKeyDown} className={cn("rounded-card border border-attention bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Badge tone="warning">Needs your answers</Badge>
        {runName && <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{runName}</span>}
      </div>
      <h3 id={`${uid}-t`} className="mt-2 text-body leading-5 font-semibold">{title}</h3>
      {hasKnown && (
        <dl className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
          <dt className="font-medium">Already have:</dt>
          {known.map((k) => (
            <dd key={k.label} className="m-0"><span>{k.label} </span><span className="font-medium text-fg">{k.value}</span></dd>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
      {reviewing
        ? <div className="mt-3">{reviewList}</div>
        : <Tabs className="mt-3" label="Questions" tabs={tabs} value={q.id} onChange={(id) => go(questions.findIndex((x) => x.id === id), null)} />}
      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {(reviewing || idx > 0) && <Button type="button" size="md" variant="ghost" className="pointer-coarse:h-11" onClick={() => (reviewing ? setReviewing(false) : go(idx - 1, "tab"))}>{L.back}</Button>}
          {onUseDefaults && !reviewing && <Button type="button" size="md" variant="ghost" className="pointer-coarse:h-11" onClick={onUseDefaults}>{L.useDefaults}</Button>}
        </div>
        <Button data-qs-submit="" aria-disabled={(!reviewing && !canAct) || undefined} onClick={act} variant="primary" size="md" className={cn("ml-auto pointer-coarse:h-11", !reviewing && !canAct && "opacity-50")}>
          {reviewing ? submitLabel : last ? (review ? nextLabel : submitLabel) : nextLabel}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{announce}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ResearchRun.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, SearchIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export interface ResearchPhase {
  id: string;
  /** What happens in this phase, such as "Searching the web". */
  label: string;
  state: "done" | "active" | "waiting";
}

export interface ResearchRunLabels {
  heading?: string;
  /** Receives the number of sources read. */
  sources?: (n: number) => string;
  /** Receives the time so far, such as "4 min". */
  elapsed?: (t: string) => string;
  stop?: string;
  open?: string;
  /** Receives sources read and the time taken. */
  doneSummary?: (n: number, t: string) => string;
  stopped?: string;
  failed?: string;
  retry?: string;
  phaseNow?: (label: string) => string;
}

export interface ResearchRunProps {
  /** What is being researched, in the person's words. */
  question: string;
  status: "running" | "done" | "stopped" | "failed";
  phases: ResearchPhase[];
  /** Sources read so far. */
  sourcesRead: number;
  /** Time so far, already in words: "4 min". */
  elapsed: string;
  /** What it is doing this moment, such as "Reading reuters.com". Shown while running. */
  activity?: string;
  onStop?: () => void;
  /** Opens the finished report. */
  onOpenReport?: () => void;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  labels?: ResearchRunLabels;
  /** Level of the part's heading, so it fits the page outline. Default 3. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * A deep research run, which can take many minutes. While it runs it shows the phases (done, now, next), how many
 * sources it has read and for how long, and what it is reading this moment; Stop is always there. Screen readers
 * hear each new phase, not every source. When it finishes, the card says what it did in one line and opens the report.
 */
export function ResearchRun({ question, status, phases, sourcesRead, elapsed, activity, onStop, onOpenReport, onRetry, labels, headingLevel = 3, className }: ResearchRunProps) {
  const l = {
    heading: "Research", sources: (n: number) => (n === 1 ? "1 source read" : `${n} sources read`), elapsed: (t: string) => t, stop: "Stop", open: "Open report",
    doneSummary: (n: number, t: string) => `Read ${n} sources in ${t}.`, stopped: "Stopped. The report covers what was read so far.", failed: "The research stopped because of an error.",
    retry: "Try again", phaseNow: (p: string) => `Now: ${p}`, ...labels,
  };
  const uid = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const active = phases.find((p) => p.state === "active");
  // Announce each new phase once, not each source.
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  const last = useRef<string | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => { if (status === "running" && active && active.id !== last.current) { last.current = active.id; setSaid(l.phaseNow(active.label)); } }, [status, active]);
  const running = status === "running";
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} aria-busy={running || undefined} className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
        <SearchIcon aria-hidden width={18} height={18} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-fg-muted" />
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <H id={`${uid}-h`} className="m-0 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted">{l.heading}</H>
          <p className="m-0 mt-1 text-body leading-6 font-medium text-fg">{question}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <ol className="mt-4 space-y-2">
        {phases.map((p) => (
          <li key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-2.5" aria-current={p.state === "active" ? "step" : undefined}>
            <span aria-hidden className={cn("grid size-5 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full",
              p.state === "done" ? "bg-success-soft text-success-fg" : p.state === "active" ? "border-2 border-lime" : "border border-line-strong")}>
              {p.state === "done" && <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} />}
              {p.state === "active" && <span className={cn("size-2 rounded-full bg-lime", running && "motion-safe:animate-pulse")} />}
            </span>
            <span className={cn("text-body leading-5", p.state === "waiting" ? "text-fg-muted" : "text-fg", p.state === "active" && "font-medium")}>{p.label}</span>
            <span className="sr-only">{p.state === "done" ? "(done)" : p.state === "active" ? "(now)" : "(next)"}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>

      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
        <p className="m-0 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{l.sources(sourcesRead)} · {l.elapsed(elapsed)}</p>
        {running && activity && <p className="m-0 min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted" title={activity}>{activity}</p>}
      </div>

      {status === "done" && <p className="m-0 mt-3 text-body leading-6 text-fg">{l.doneSummary(sourcesRead, elapsed)}</p>}
      {status === "stopped" && <p className="m-0 mt-3 text-body leading-6 text-fg">{l.stopped}</p>}
      {status === "failed" && <p className="m-0 mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-body leading-6 text-danger-fg"><AlertIcon aria-hidden width={15} height={15} />{l.failed}</p>}

      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {running && onStop && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onStop}>{l.stop}</Button>}
        {(status === "done" || status === "stopped") && onOpenReport && <Button size="sm" onClick={onOpenReport}>{l.open}</Button>}
        {status === "failed" && onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onRetry}>{l.retry}</Button>}
      </div>
      <p role="status" className="sr-only">{status === "done" ? l.doneSummary(sourcesRead, elapsed) : status === "stopped" ? l.stopped : status === "failed" ? l.failed : said}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ResponseCompare.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { headingTag, subHeadingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { CheckIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export interface CompareReply {
  id: string;
  /** Short name for the reply, such as "Reply A". */
  label: string;
  content: ReactNode;
}

export interface ResponseCompareLabels {
  heading?: string;
  hint?: string;
  choose?: string;
  same?: string;
  chosen?: string;
  /** Read out after a choice. Receives the chosen reply's label, or null for "about the same". */
  thanks?: (label: string | null) => string;
}

export interface ResponseCompareProps {
  /** Exactly two replies to the same question. */
  replies: [CompareReply, CompareReply];
  /** Called with the chosen reply's id, or "same". */
  onChoose: (id: string | "same") => void;
  /** The chosen reply's id, or "same". Leave it out to let the part keep its own choice. */
  chosen?: string | "same" | null;
  /** Offer an "About the same" choice. On by default. */
  allowSame?: boolean;
  labels?: ResponseCompareLabels;
  /** Level of the part's heading, so it fits the page outline. Default 3. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Two replies to the same question, side by side, and the person picks the better one. The choice is a plain button
 * under each reply, so it works the same with a mouse, a finger, a keyboard or a screen reader. After a choice, the
 * kept reply says so in words and the other steps back; nothing moves.
 */
export function ResponseCompare({ replies, onChoose, chosen: chosenProp, allowSame = true, labels, headingLevel = 3, className }: ResponseCompareProps) {
  const l = {
    heading: "Which reply is better?", hint: "Your choice helps the assistant learn what you prefer.", choose: "Choose this reply", same: "About the same",
    chosen: "You chose this", thanks: (label: string | null) => (label ? `Thanks. You chose ${label}.` : "Thanks. You said they are about the same."), ...labels,
  };
  const [own, setOwn] = useState<string | "same" | null>(null);
  const chosen = chosenProp !== undefined ? chosenProp : own;
  const uid = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const H2 = subHeadingTag(headingLevel);
  const pick = (id: string | "same") => { setOwn(id); onChoose(id); };
  const label = chosen && chosen !== "same" ? replies.find((r) => r.id === chosen)?.label ?? null : null;
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 sm:p-5", className)}>
      <H id={`${uid}-h`} className="m-0 text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">{l.heading}</H>
      <p className="mt-1 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.hint}</p>
      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        {replies.map((r) => {
          const isChosen = chosen === r.id;
          const faded = !!chosen && chosen !== "same" && !isChosen;
          return (
            <article key={r.id} aria-labelledby={`${uid}-${r.id}`}
              className={cn("flex min-w-0 flex-col rounded-control border p-4 transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) motion-reduce:transition-none",
                isChosen ? "border-selected-line bg-selected" : "border-line bg-bg", faded && "opacity-70")}>
              <H2 id={`${uid}-${r.id}`} className="m-0 text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted">{r.label}</H2>
              <div className="mt-2 min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-3 text-body leading-6 text-fg">{r.content}</div>
              <div className="mt-4">
                {isChosen
                  ? <p className="m-0 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-5 font-medium text-fg"><CheckIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />{l.chosen}</p>
                  : <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => pick(r.id)} aria-describedby={`${uid}-${r.id}`}>{l.choose}</Button>}
              </div>
            </article>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {allowSame && chosen !== "same" && (
        <div className="mt-3"><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => pick("same")}>{l.same}</Button></div>
      )}
      <p role="status" className={cn("text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted", chosen ? "mt-3" : "sr-only")}>{chosen ? l.thanks(label) : ""}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/RiskLimits.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Meter } from "../atoms/Meter";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { useFocusAfter } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { InfoIcon, LockIcon, StopIcon } from "../lib/icons";

export interface RiskLimit {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  used: number;
  max: number;
  /** Text after the numbers, such as "trades". */
  unit?: string;
  /** Formats a number for display, such as a money format. The app owns money formatting. */
  format?: (n: number) => string;
}

export interface RiskLimitsProps {
  limits: RiskLimit[];
  /** True when trading is stopped. Every limit then says "Paused". */
  paused?: boolean;
  /** Why it is paused, in words. */
  pausedReason?: string;
  /** The kill switch. It asks once, in place, before calling this. Not shown while paused. */
  onKill?: () => void;
  killLabel?: string;
  /** A line of reassurance under the limits, such as "Exits are never blocked." */
  note?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

const plain = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-IN");

/** The limits that protect the person, each with a meter in words and numbers, and a kill switch that asks in place. */
export function RiskLimits({ limits, paused, pausedReason, onKill, killLabel = "Stop all trading", note, className }: RiskLimitsProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const headId = `${uid}-head`, askId = `${uid}-ask`;
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState(false);
  // Button takes no ref, so focus is found through these wrappers.
  const killWrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const keepWrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const back = useRef(false);
  const arm = useFocusAfter(paused, () => heading.current);

  useEffect(() => { if (asking) keepWrap.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("button")?.focus(); }, [asking]);
  useEffect(() => { if (!asking && back.current) { back.current = false; killWrap.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("button")?.focus(); } }, [asking]);

  const close = () => { back.current = true; setAsking(false); };
  const stop = () => { arm(); setAsking(false); onKill?.(); };
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === "Escape") { e.stopPropagation(); close(); } };

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headId} className={cn("flex w-full max-w-phone flex-col gap-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <h3 id={headId} ref={heading} tabIndex={-1} className="text-lead leading-6 font-semibold text-fg">Risk limits</h3>
        {paused && <Badge tone="unsure"><LockIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} />Paused</Badge>}
      </div>
      {paused && pausedReason && <p className="text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{pausedReason}</p>}
      <ul className="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-4 p-0">
        {limits.map((l) => {
          const fmt = l.format ?? plain;
          const ratio = l.max > 0 ? l.used / l.max : 0;
          const reached = ratio >= 1, near = !reached && ratio >= 0.8;
          const text = `${fmt(l.used)} of ${fmt(l.max)}${l.unit ? ` ${l.unit}` : ""}`;
          return (
            <li key={l.id} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 text-body leading-5">
                <span className="font-medium text-fg">{l.label}</span>
                <span className="text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{text}</span>
              </div>
              <Meter value={Math.min(l.used, l.max)} max={l.max} label={l.label} valueText={text} />
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 empty:hidden">
                {reached && <Badge tone="unsure"><LockIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} />Limit reached</Badge>}
                {near && <Badge tone="unsure"><InfoIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} />Near the limit</Badge>}
                {paused && <Badge tone="neutral"><LockIcon aria-hidden width={12} height={12} />Paused</Badge>}
              </div>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
      {note && <p className="text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{note}</p>}
      {onKill && !paused && (asking ? (
        <div role="group" aria-labelledby={askId} onKeyDown={onKey} className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-card border border-line-strong bg-sunken p-3">
          <p id={askId} className="text-body leading-5 text-fg">{killLabel}? This pauses new orders. Exits stay open.</p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" className="flex-1 pointer-coarse:h-12" onClick={stop}>Stop trading</Button>
            <div ref={keepWrap} className="flex flex-1"><Button variant="secondary" size="lg" className="w-full pointer-coarse:h-12" onClick={close}>Keep trading</Button></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div ref={killWrap} className="flex"><Button variant="secondary" size="lg" className="w-full pointer-coarse:h-12" leading={<StopIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />} onClick={() => setAsking(true)}>{killLabel}</Button></div>
      ))}
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{paused ? `Trading is paused.${pausedReason ? ` ${pausedReason}` : ""}` : ""}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/SandboxedFrame.tsx

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { ShieldIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export type SandboxPermission = "open-links" | "call-tools";

/**
 * Messages the page inside the frame may send. Anything else is ignored.
 *  { type: "tattva:resize", height: number }
 *  { type: "tattva:open-link", url: string }
 *  { type: "tattva:call-tool", id?: string, name: string, args?: object }
 * The host answers a tool request with { type: "tattva:tool-result", id, ok: boolean }.
 */
export const SANDBOX_MESSAGES = { resize: "tattva:resize", openLink: "tattva:open-link", callTool: "tattva:call-tool", toolResult: "tattva:tool-result" } as const;

export interface SandboxedFrameLabels {
  generatedBy?: (source: string) => string;
  whatItCanDo?: string;
  allow?: string;
  deny?: string;
}

export interface SandboxedFrameProps {
  /** Who made the page. Always visible. */
  source: string;
  /** Name of the frame for screen readers, for example "Trip budget calculator". */
  title: string;
  /** The page as a string. Runs with no access to this site. Use this or `src`. */
  srcDoc?: string;
  /** Address of a page on another origin. Use this or `srcDoc`. */
  src?: string;
  /** What the page may ask to do. Each one still needs a yes from the person every time. Default none. */
  permissions?: SandboxPermission[];
  /** Tool names the page may ask for. Requests for other names are ignored. */
  allowedTools?: string[];
  /** Called after the person agrees to open a link. Default opens it in a new tab with no link back to this site. */
  onOpenLink?: (url: string) => void;
  /** Called after the person agrees to a tool request. May return a promise. A rejected promise tells the page it failed. */
  onCallTool?: (name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown | Promise<unknown>;
  minHeight?: number;
  maxHeight?: number;
  /** Start height in px. */
  initialHeight?: number;
  /** Let scripts send forms. Off by default. */
  allowForms?: boolean;
  /**
   * Gives the page this site's origin, which lets it read everything the site can. Almost never right for generated pages.
   * Off by default. Never turn it on together with `srcDoc` for pages you did not write.
   */
  allowSameOrigin?: boolean;
  /** Overrides the plain-language line under the frame. */
  summary?: string;
  labels?: SandboxedFrameLabels;
  className?: string;
}

type Request = { kind: "link"; url: string } | { kind: "tool"; id?: string; name: string; args: Record<string, unknown> };

const permissionText: Record<SandboxPermission, string> = { "open-links": "Ask to open a link", "call-tools": "Ask the assistant to do something for you" };

const permissionSentence: Record<SandboxPermission, string> = { "open-links": "ask to open a link", "call-tools": "ask the assistant to do something for you" };

function webUrl(v: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof v !== "string") return null;
  try { const u = new URL(v); return u.protocol === "https:" || u.protocol === "http:" ? u.href : null; } catch { return null; }
}

function originOf(src?: string): string | null {
  if (!src) return null;
  try { return new URL(src, window.location.href).origin; } catch { return null; }
}

/**
 * Runs a page made by someone else, such as a generated mini app, inside a locked box. The box has no access to this
 * site's data and cannot open links or call tools on its own. It can only send a few messages, and the host checks
 * each one: who sent it, where it came from, and whether the person agrees. Use it when a catalog part cannot do the job.
 */
export function SandboxedFrame({
  source, title, srcDoc, src, permissions = [], allowedTools = [], onOpenLink, onCallTool, minHeight = 120, maxHeight = 640, initialHeight = 240,
  allowForms = false, allowSameOrigin = false, summary, labels, className,
}: SandboxedFrameProps) {
  const l = { generatedBy: (s: string) => `Generated by ${s}`, whatItCanDo: "What this can do", allow: "Allow", deny: "Don't allow", ...labels };
  const frame = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null);
  const [height, setHeight] = useState(() => Math.min(maxHeight, Math.max(minHeight, initialHeight)));
  const [request, setRequest] = useState<Request | null>(null);
  const requestRef = useRef<Request | null>(null);
  requestRef.current = request;
  const expectedOrigin = srcDoc !== undefined ? "null" : originOf(src);

  const tokens = ["allow-scripts", ...(allowForms ? ["allow-forms"] : []), ...(allowSameOrigin ? ["allow-same-origin"] : [])].join(" ");

  const reply = useCallback((msg: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    const target = expectedOrigin && expectedOrigin !== "null" ? expectedOrigin : "*";
    try { frame.current?.contentWindow?.postMessage(msg, target); } catch { /* the frame is gone */ }
  }, [expectedOrigin]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onMessage = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      // Only the frame we made, from the origin we expect.
      if (!frame.current || e.source !== frame.current.contentWindow) return;
      if (expectedOrigin === null || e.origin !== expectedOrigin) return;
      const d: unknown = e.data;
      if (typeof d !== "object" || d === null || Array.isArray(d)) return;
      const m = { ...(d as Record<string, unknown>) };
      // Frames written before the rename send "sandstone:*"; read them as the same messages.
      if (typeof m.type === "string") m.type = m.type.replace(/^sandstone:/, "tattva:");
      if (m.type === SANDBOX_MESSAGES.resize) {
        if (typeof m.height === "number" && Number.isFinite(m.height)) setHeight(Math.min(maxHeight, Math.max(minHeight, Math.round(m.height))));
      } else if (m.type === SANDBOX_MESSAGES.openLink) {
        const url = webUrl(m.url);
        if (url && permissions.includes("open-links") && !requestRef.current) setRequest({ kind: "link", url });
      } else if (m.type === SANDBOX_MESSAGES.callTool) {
        if (typeof m.name === "string" && permissions.includes("call-tools") && allowedTools.includes(m.name) && !requestRef.current) {
          setRequest({ kind: "tool", id: typeof m.id === "string" ? m.id : undefined, name: m.name, args: typeof m.args === "object" && m.args !== null && !Array.isArray(m.args) ? (m.args as Record<string, unknown>) : {} });
        }
      }
      // Anything else is ignored on purpose.
    };
    window.addEventListener("message", onMessage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("message", onMessage);
  }, [expectedOrigin, maxHeight, minHeight, permissions, allowedTools]);

  const allowRequest = async () => {
    const r = request;
    setRequest(null);
    if (!r) return;
    if (r.kind === "link") {
      if (onOpenLink) onOpenLink(r.url); else window.open(r.url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
      return;
    }
    let ok = true;
    try { await onCallTool?.(r.name, r.args); } catch { ok = false; }
    if (r.id) reply({ type: SANDBOX_MESSAGES.toolResult, id: r.id, ok });
  };
  const denyRequest = () => {
    const r = request;
    setRequest(null);
    if (r?.kind === "tool" && r.id) reply({ type: SANDBOX_MESSAGES.toolResult, id: r.id, ok: false });
  };

  const can = permissions.length
    ? `This page runs in a locked box and cannot see your account. It can ${permissions.map((p) => permissionSentence[p]).join(" and ")}, and it asks you every time.`
    : "This page runs in a locked box and cannot see your account. It can only show things on this screen.";

  return (
    <section aria-label={l.generatedBy(source)} className={cn("min-w-0 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3", className)}>
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 px-1 pb-2">
        <Badge><ShieldIcon width={11} height={11} aria-hidden />{l.generatedBy(source)}</Badge>
        {permissions.length > 0 && (
          <ul aria-label="Permissions this page asked for" className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
            {permissions.map((p) => <li key={p}><Badge tone="info">{permissionText[p]}</Badge></li>)}
          </ul>
        )}
      </header>
      <iframe
        ref={frame} title={title} sandbox={tokens} srcDoc={srcDoc} src={srcDoc === undefined ? src : undefined}
        referrerPolicy="no-referrer" allow="" loading="lazy" style={{ height }}
        className="block w-full max-w-full rounded-card border border-line bg-bg focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--focus-ring)]"
      />
      {request && (
        <div role="group" aria-label="This page is asking for permission" className="mt-2 rounded-card bg-attention-soft p-3 text-body leading-5 text-attention-fg">
          <p className="font-medium">
            {request.kind === "link" ? "This page wants to open a link." : `This page wants the assistant to do this: ${request.name}.`}
          </p>
          {request.kind === "link" && <p className="mt-0.5 [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">{request.url}</p>}
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" autoFocus onClick={allowRequest}>{l.allow}</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={denyRequest}>{l.deny}</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="mt-2 px-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted"><span className="font-medium text-fg">{l.whatItCanDo}.</span> {summary ?? can}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/SceneStrip.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type DragEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, ApproveIcon, ChevronIcon, PlusIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

/**
 * Where a shot is. `empty`: no take made yet. `generating`: the AI is making it. `needsPick`: takes are ready and a person
 * must choose one. `ready`: a take is chosen. `failed`: it did not work; say whether it was charged in `note`.
 */
export type SceneShotStatus = "empty" | "generating" | "needsPick" | "ready" | "failed";

export interface SceneShot {
  id: string;
  /** Short name, for example "Harbour at dawn". */
  label: string;
  /** What was asked for. Shown under the name. */
  prompt?: string;
  /** Length of the chosen take, in seconds. Leave out while there is none. */
  durationSec?: number;
  status: SceneShotStatus;
  /** Poster image of the chosen take. Decorative: the name says what the shot is. */
  poster?: string;
  /** A short extra line, for example "Not charged" on a failed shot or "3 takes" on one that needs a pick. */
  note?: string;
}

export interface SceneStripProps {
  shots: SceneShot[];
  /** Called with the new order after a move or a drop. */
  onReorder: (shots: SceneShot[]) => void;
  /** Adds a shot at the end. Leave out to hide Add shot. */
  onAdd?: () => void;
  /** Opens a shot to pick a take or trim it. */
  onOpen?: (id: string) => void;
  title?: string;
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const clock = (sec: number) => {
  const s = Math.round(sec);
  return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
};
const spoken = (sec: number) => {
  const s = Math.round(sec);
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const r = s % 60;
  return [m ? `${m} ${m === 1 ? "minute" : "minutes"}` : "", r || !m ? `${r} ${r === 1 ? "second" : "seconds"}` : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
};

function StatusLine({ shot }: { shot: SceneShot }) {
  const base = "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-4.5 font-medium";
  if (shot.status === "generating") return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg")}><span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-lime" />Generating</span>;
  if (shot.status === "needsPick") return <span className={cn(base, "text-attention-fg")}><span aria-hidden className="size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-attention" />Pick a take</span>;
  if (shot.status === "ready") return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg")}><ApproveIcon width={12} height={12} className="shrink-0" />Ready</span>;
  if (shot.status === "failed") return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg")}><AlertIcon width={12} height={12} className="shrink-0" />Did not work</span>;
  return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg-muted")}>No take yet</span>;
}

const statusWords: Record<SceneShotStatus, string> = { empty: "no take yet", generating: "generating", needsPick: "pick a take", ready: "ready", failed: "did not work" };

/**
 * An ordered storyboard of shots for one scene, with a total length and a status on every shot. Reorder by dragging a
 * card, with the Move earlier and Move later buttons on each card, or with Alt and the arrow keys on a focused card.
 * Each move is announced. Kept simpler than an editing timeline on purpose: order, status and length.
 */
export function SceneStrip({ shots, onReorder, onAdd, onOpen, title = "Scene", headingLevel = 3, className }: SceneStripProps) {
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const uid = useId();
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [dragId, setDragId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dropAt, setDropAt] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const cards = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLLIElement>());
  const buttons = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLButtonElement>());
  // After a move, where focus should go once the new order has rendered.
  const refocus = useRef<{ id: string; key: string } | null>(null);

  const total = shots.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.durationSec ?? 0), 0);
  const counts = {
    generating: shots.filter((s) => s.status === "generating").length,
    needsPick: shots.filter((s) => s.status === "needsPick").length,
    failed: shots.filter((s) => s.status === "failed").length,
  };
  const pending = [
    counts.generating ? `${counts.generating} generating` : "",
    counts.needsPick ? `${counts.needsPick} to pick` : "",
    counts.failed ? `${counts.failed} did not work` : "",
  ].filter(Boolean).join(", ");

  const move = (from: number, to: number, how: "button" | "key" | "drop", key?: string) => {
    if (to < 0 || to >= shots.length || from === to) return;
    const next = shots.slice();
    const [item] = next.splice(from, 1);
    next.splice(to, 0, item);
    onReorder(next);
    setMessage(`${item.label} moved to position ${to + 1} of ${shots.length}.`);
    if (how === "button" && key) {
      // Keep focus on the pressed button, or on its opposite when the shot reached an end and the button turned off.
      const atEnd = (key === "earlier" && to === 0) || (key === "later" && to === shots.length - 1);
      refocus.current = { id: item.id, key: atEnd ? (key === "earlier" ? "later" : "earlier") : key };
    } else if (how === "key") refocus.current = { id: item.id, key: "card" };
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const r = refocus.current;
    if (!r) return;
    refocus.current = null;
    const el = r.key === "card" ? cards.current.get(r.id) : buttons.current.get(`${r.id}:${r.key}`);
    el?.focus({ preventScroll: false });
  }, [shots]);

  const onCardKey = (i: number, e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLLIElement>) => {
    if (e.target !== e.currentTarget || !e.altKey) return;
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); move(i, i - 1, "key"); }
    else if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") { e.preventDefault(); move(i, i + 1, "key"); }
  };

  const onDragOver = (i: number, e: DragEvent<HTMLLIElement>) => {
    if (!dragId) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const box = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    setDropAt(e.clientX < box.left + box.width / 2 ? i : i + 1);
  };
  const onDrop = (e: DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const from = shots.findIndex((s) => s.id === dragId);
    if (from >= 0 && dropAt !== null) move(from, dropAt > from ? dropAt - 1 : dropAt, "drop");
    setDragId(null); setDropAt(null);
  };

  const helpId = `${uid}-help`;

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} className={cn("w-full min-w-0 space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
        <H id={`${uid}-h`} className="text-lead leading-6 font-semibold text-fg">{title}</H>
        <p className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted tabular-nums">
          <span className="font-medium text-fg">{clock(total)}</span><span className="sr-only"> ({spoken(total)})</span> total · {shots.length} {shots.length === 1 ? "shot" : "shots"}
          {pending && <> · {pending}</>}
        </p>
      </header>
      {shots.length > 1 && <p id={helpId} className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-subtle max-sm:hidden">Drag a shot, use its arrows, or press Alt and an arrow key on a focused shot to move it.</p>}

      {shots.length === 0
        ? <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-3 rounded-card border border-dashed border-line p-4">
            <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">No shots yet. Add your first shot to start the scene.</p>
            {onAdd && <Button size="sm" leading={<PlusIcon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onAdd}>Add shot</Button>}
          </div>
        : <div className="-mx-1 flex snap-x snap-mandatory gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-1 pt-1 pb-2 [scrollbar-width:thin]">
          <ol aria-label={`${title} shots, in order`} onDragLeave={(e) => { if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node)) setDropAt(null); }}
            className="flex gap-3">
            {shots.map((s, i) => (
              <li key={s.id} ref={(el) => { if (el) cards.current.set(s.id, el); else cards.current.delete(s.id); }}
                tabIndex={0} aria-describedby={shots.length > 1 ? helpId : undefined}
                aria-label={`Shot ${i + 1} of ${shots.length}: ${s.label}, ${statusWords[s.status]}${s.durationSec ? `, ${spoken(s.durationSec)}` : ""}`}
                draggable onDragStart={(e) => { setDragId(s.id); e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move"; e.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", s.id); }}
                onDragEnd={() => { setDragId(null); setDropAt(null); }} onDragOver={(e) => onDragOver(i, e)} onDrop={onDrop}
                onKeyDown={(e) => onCardKey(i, e)}
                className={cn("relative flex w-44 shrink-0 snap-start flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-card border bg-surface outline-offset-2 sm:w-48",
                  "cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing transition-opacity duration-(--dur-fast)",
                  s.status === "needsPick" ? "border-attention" : "border-line",
                  dragId === s.id && "opacity-50")}>
                {dropAt === i && <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-y-0 -left-0.5 w-1 rounded-full bg-fg" />}
                {dropAt === i + 1 && i === shots.length - 1 && <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-y-0 -right-0.5 w-1 rounded-full bg-fg" />}
                <div className="relative aspect-video bg-sunken">
                  {s.poster && <img src={s.poster} alt="" draggable={false} className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover" />}
                  <span className="absolute top-1.5 left-1.5 rounded-control bg-glass px-1.5 text-small leading-4.5 font-medium text-fg tabular-nums">{i + 1}</span>
                  {s.durationSec !== undefined && <span className="absolute right-1.5 bottom-1.5 rounded-control bg-glass px-1.5 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg tabular-nums">{clock(s.durationSec)}</span>}
                  {s.status === "generating" && <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-0.5 bg-lime" />}
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-1 p-2.5">
                  <p className="truncate text-compact font-medium text-fg">{s.label}</p>
                  {s.prompt && <p className="line-clamp-2 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">{s.prompt}</p>}
                  <div className="mt-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 pt-1">
                    <StatusLine shot={s} />
                    {s.note && <span className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">{s.note}</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 border-t border-line p-1.5">
                  <button type="button" aria-label={`Move ${s.label} earlier`} disabled={i === 0}
                    ref={(el) => { if (el) buttons.current.set(`${s.id}:earlier`, el); else buttons.current.delete(`${s.id}:earlier`); }}
                    onClick={() => move(i, i - 1, "button", "earlier")}
                    className="tap grid size-8 cursor-pointer place-items-center rounded-control text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-disabled-fg disabled:hover:bg-transparent">
                    <ChevronIcon className="rotate-180" />
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" aria-label={`Move ${s.label} later`} disabled={i === shots.length - 1}
                    ref={(el) => { if (el) buttons.current.set(`${s.id}:later`, el); else buttons.current.delete(`${s.id}:later`); }}
                    onClick={() => move(i, i + 1, "button", "later")}
                    className="tap grid size-8 cursor-pointer place-items-center rounded-control text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-disabled-fg disabled:hover:bg-transparent">
                    <ChevronIcon />
                  </button>
                  {onOpen && <Button size="sm" variant={s.status === "needsPick" ? "secondary" : "ghost"} className="ml-auto" aria-label={`${s.status === "needsPick" ? "Pick a take for" : "Open"} ${s.label}`}
                    onClick={() => onOpen(s.id)}>{s.status === "needsPick" ? "Pick" : "Open"}</Button>}
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
            {onAdd && (
              <div className="flex w-32 shrink-0 snap-start">
                <button type="button" onClick={onAdd}
                  className="flex w-full cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-card border border-dashed border-line-strong text-compact font-medium text-fg-muted transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg">
                  <PlusIcon />Add shot
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>}
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{message}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/SectionLane.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, ChevronIcon, LockIcon, PlusIcon, RegenerateIcon, EditIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { WorkingEdge } from "../atoms/WorkingEdge";
import { Waveform, formatMediaTime, speakMediaTime, type WaveformRegion } from "../atoms/Waveform";

/**
 * Where a section is. `original`: as generated or recorded, nothing to do. `edited`: the person changed its lyrics or style
 * and it has not been generated yet. `stale`: an edit elsewhere means it no longer fits (for example the key or tempo moved).
 * `generating`: the AI is making it. `has-alternates`: new takes are ready and a person must keep one. `failed`: it did not work.
 */
export type SectionState = "original" | "edited" | "stale" | "generating" | "has-alternates" | "failed";

export interface SongSection {
  id: string;
  /** Plain name, such as "Verse 1" or "Chorus". */
  name: string;
  /** Start and end in seconds within the whole song. */
  start: number;
  end: number;
  /** Who made it. `ai` gets a small AI mark; recorded or uploaded parts get a word instead. */
  origin: "ai" | "person" | "upload";
  state: SectionState;
  /** Lyrics, shown in the detail panel of the selected section. */
  lyrics?: string;
  /** Style words for this section, such as "half-time drums". */
  styles?: string[];
  /** Number of new takes, for `has-alternates`. */
  alternates?: number;
  /** A short extra line, such as "Not charged" on a failed section or why it is out of date. */
  note?: string;
}

export interface SectionLaneProps {
  /** Sections in play order. */
  sections: SongSection[];
  /** Length of the whole song, in seconds. */
  duration: number;
  /** Loudness of the whole song for the waveform above the lane. Leave out to hide the waveform. */
  peaks?: number[] | null;
  /** Playhead, in seconds. */
  position?: number;
  /** Makes the waveform a seek slider. */
  onSeek?: (seconds: number) => void;
  /** The selected section, or null. */
  selectedId?: string | null;
  onSelect?: (id: string | null) => void;
  /** Called with the new order of ids after Move earlier, Move later or Alt with an arrow key. */
  onReorder?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** Regenerates one section. Staged: it changes nothing until Generate. */
  onRegenerate?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Adds a new section after this one (extend). */
  onExtend?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Opens the section's lyrics and styles for editing. */
  onEdit?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Opens the new takes of a section with alternates. */
  onOpenAlternates?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Tries a failed section again. */
  onRetry?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Changes waiting for Generate. Above 0 an amber bar shows the count and the Generate button. */
  pendingChanges?: number;
  /** Generates every staged change at once. */
  onGenerate?: () => void;
  /** Cost of that generation, shown next to the button, such as "about 20 credits". */
  generateCost?: string;
  /** Why Generate cannot run, such as "Not enough credits". Turns the button off and shows the reason. */
  generateBlocked?: string;
  title?: string;
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const STATE_WORD: Record<SectionState, string> = {
  original: "Up to date", edited: "Edited, not generated", stale: "Out of date", generating: "Generating",
  "has-alternates": "New takes to compare", failed: "Did not work",
};
const ORIGIN_WORD = { ai: "Made by AI", person: "Recorded", upload: "Uploaded" } as const;
const needsYou = (s: SectionState) => s === "edited" || s === "stale" || s === "has-alternates";

function StateLine({ s }: { s: SongSection }) {
  const base = "inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-4.5 font-medium";
  if (s.state === "generating") return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg")}><span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-lime" />Generating</span>;
  if (s.state === "failed") return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg")}><AlertIcon width={12} height={12} aria-hidden className="shrink-0" />Did not work</span>;
  if (needsYou(s.state)) {
    const word = s.state === "has-alternates" ? `${s.alternates ?? 2} takes to compare` : STATE_WORD[s.state];
    return <span className={cn(base, "text-attention-fg")}><span aria-hidden className="size-1.5 shrink-0 rotate-45 bg-attention" />{word}</span>;
  }
  return <span className={cn(base, "font-normal text-fg-subtle")}>Up to date</span>;
}

function OriginMark({ origin }: { origin: SongSection["origin"] }) {
  if (origin === "ai") {
    return <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted"><span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-lime ring-1 ring-fg-muted" />AI</span>;
  }
  return <span className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">{ORIGIN_WORD[origin]}</span>;
}

/**
 * The structure of one generated song as labelled blocks on a timeline, sized to their length: select a section, regenerate
 * it, extend after it or move it. Edits are staged and shown in one amber bar until Generate, so several changes cost one
 * generation. Sections the AI made carry a small AI mark; sections that are out of date say so in words.
 */
export function SectionLane({
  sections, duration, peaks, position = 0, onSeek, selectedId = null, onSelect, onReorder, onRegenerate, onExtend, onEdit,
  onOpenAlternates, onRetry, pendingChanges = 0, onGenerate, generateCost, generateBlocked, title = "Song structure",
  headingLevel = 3, className,
}: SectionLaneProps) {
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const uid = useId();
  const [focusId, setFocusId] = useState<string | null>(selectedId ?? sections[0]?.id ?? null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const options = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLDivElement>());
  const buttons = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLButtonElement>());
  const refocus = useRef<{ id: string; key: string } | null>(null);

  const dur = Math.max(1, duration || sections.reduce((m, s) => Math.max(m, s.end), 0));
  const selected = sections.find((s) => s.id === selectedId) ?? null;
  const selectedIndex = selected ? sections.indexOf(selected) : -1;
  const activeId = sections.some((s) => s.id === focusId) ? focusId : selectedId ?? sections[0]?.id ?? null;
  const outOfDate = sections.filter((s) => s.state === "stale").length;

  // Announce the staged count only when it changes, not on first render.
  const lastPending = useRef(pendingChanges);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (lastPending.current === pendingChanges) return;
    lastPending.current = pendingChanges;
    setMessage(pendingChanges ? `${pendingChanges} ${pendingChanges === 1 ? "change" : "changes"} waiting to generate.` : "No changes waiting.");
  }, [pendingChanges]);

  // Announce sections that start generating, finish, fail or get new takes. The lane's own status region says it,
  // because a status region cannot sit inside the listbox.
  const lastStates = useRef(new Map(sections.map((s) => [s.id, s.state])));
  useEffect(() => {
    const said: string[] = [];
    for (const s of sections) {
      const was = lastStates.current.get(s.id);
      if (was && was !== s.state && s.state === "generating") said.push(`Generating ${s.name}.`);
      else if (was && was !== s.state && (s.state === "failed" || s.state === "has-alternates" || was === "generating")) {
        said.push(`${s.name}: ${s.state === "has-alternates" ? `${s.alternates ?? 2} takes ready` : STATE_WORD[s.state].toLowerCase()}.`);
      }
    }
    lastStates.current = new Map(sections.map((s) => [s.id, s.state]));
    if (said.length) setMessage(said.join(" "));
  }, [sections]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const r = refocus.current;
    if (!r) return;
    refocus.current = null;
    (r.key === "option" ? options.current.get(r.id) : buttons.current.get(`${r.id}:${r.key}`))?.focus();
  }, [sections]);

  const move = (from: number, to: number, how: "button" | "key", key?: string) => {
    if (!onReorder || to < 0 || to >= sections.length || from === to) return;
    const ids = sections.map((s) => s.id);
    const [id] = ids.splice(from, 1);
    ids.splice(to, 0, id);
    onReorder(ids);
    const name = sections[from].name;
    setMessage(`${name} moved to position ${to + 1} of ${sections.length}.`);
    if (how === "key") refocus.current = { id, key: "option" };
    else if (key) {
      const atEnd = (key === "earlier" && to === 0) || (key === "later" && to === sections.length - 1);
      refocus.current = { id, key: atEnd ? (key === "earlier" ? "later" : "earlier") : key };
    }
  };

  const focusOption = (id: string) => { setFocusId(id); options.current.get(id)?.focus(); };
  const onLaneKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const i = sections.findIndex((s) => s.id === activeId);
    if (i < 0) return;
    const k = e.key;
    if (e.altKey && (k === "ArrowLeft" || k === "ArrowUp")) { e.preventDefault(); move(i, i - 1, "key"); return; }
    if (e.altKey && (k === "ArrowRight" || k === "ArrowDown")) { e.preventDefault(); move(i, i + 1, "key"); return; }
    if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    let to = -1;
    if (k === "ArrowRight" || k === "ArrowDown") to = Math.min(sections.length - 1, i + 1);
    else if (k === "ArrowLeft" || k === "ArrowUp") to = Math.max(0, i - 1);
    else if (k === "Home") to = 0;
    else if (k === "End") to = sections.length - 1;
    else if (k === "Enter" || k === " ") { e.preventDefault(); onSelect?.(sections[i].id === selectedId ? null : sections[i].id); return; }
    else if (k === "Escape" && selectedId) { e.preventDefault(); onSelect?.(null); return; }
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    focusOption(sections[to].id);
  };

  const regions: WaveformRegion[] = sections.flatMap((s): WaveformRegion[] => {
    if (s.id === selectedId) return [{ start: s.start, end: s.end, kind: "selected" }];
    if (s.state === "stale" || s.state === "edited") return [{ start: s.start, end: s.end, kind: "stale" }];
    if (s.origin === "ai") return [{ start: s.start, end: s.end, kind: "ai" }];
    return [];
  });

  const setBtn = (key: string) => (el: HTMLButtonElement | null) => { if (el) buttons.current.set(key, el); else buttons.current.delete(key); };
  const helpId = `${uid}-help`;
  const sizeBtn = "pointer-coarse:h-11";

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} className={cn("@container w-full min-w-0 space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
        <H id={`${uid}-h`} className="text-lead leading-6 font-semibold text-fg">{title}</H>
        <p className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted tabular-nums">
          <span className="font-medium text-fg">{formatMediaTime(dur)}</span><span className="sr-only"> ({speakMediaTime(dur)})</span> · {sections.length} {sections.length === 1 ? "section" : "sections"}
          {outOfDate > 0 && <> · <span className="text-attention-fg">{outOfDate} out of date</span></>}
        </p>
      </header>

      {pendingChanges > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2 rounded-card border border-attention bg-attention-soft px-3 py-2">
          <p className="flex min-w-0 flex-[1_1_14rem] items-center gap-2 text-compact text-fg">
            <span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rotate-45 bg-attention" />
            <span><span className="font-medium">{pendingChanges} {pendingChanges === 1 ? "change" : "changes"}.</span> Generate to hear {pendingChanges === 1 ? "it" : "them"}. Nothing changes until then.</span>
          </p>
          {onGenerate && (
            <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2">
              {(generateBlocked || generateCost) && <span className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">{generateBlocked ?? generateCost}</span>}
              <Button variant="lime" size="sm" className={sizeBtn} disabled={!!generateBlocked}
                leading={generateBlocked ? <LockIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden /> : <RegenerateIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />}
                onClick={onGenerate}>Generate</Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {peaks !== undefined && (
        <Waveform peaks={peaks} duration={dur} position={position} onSeek={onSeek} label={onSeek ? `Seek, ${title}` : undefined} regions={regions} height={48} />
      )}

      {sections.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-line p-4 text-compact text-fg-muted">No sections yet. Generate a song to see its structure.</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <p id={helpId} className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-subtle max-sm:hidden">Arrow keys move between sections, Enter selects one, Alt with an arrow moves it.</p>
          <div className="-mx-1 overflow-x-auto px-1 pt-1 pb-2 [scrollbar-width:thin]">
            <div role="listbox" aria-label={`${title}, sections in order`} aria-orientation="horizontal" aria-describedby={helpId}
              onKeyDown={onLaneKey} className="flex min-w-full gap-1.5">
              {sections.map((s, i) => {
                const len = Math.max(0, s.end - s.start);
                const isSel = s.id === selectedId;
                const label = `${s.name}, ${i + 1} of ${sections.length}, ${formatMediaTime(s.start)} to ${formatMediaTime(s.end)}, ${ORIGIN_WORD[s.origin]}, ${s.state === "has-alternates" ? `${s.alternates ?? 2} takes to compare` : STATE_WORD[s.state]}`;
                return (
                  <WorkingEdge key={s.id} active={s.state === "generating"} label={`Generating ${s.name}`} radius="card" announce={false}
                    className="flex min-w-28 shrink-0 transition-[flex-grow] duration-(--dur-fast) ease-(--ease-out)"
                    style={{ flexGrow: len, flexBasis: 0 }}>
                    <div role="option" aria-selected={isSel} tabIndex={s.id === activeId ? 0 : -1} aria-label={label}
                      ref={(el) => { if (el) options.current.set(s.id, el); else options.current.delete(s.id); }}
                      onFocus={() => setFocusId(s.id)}
                      onClick={() => { setFocusId(s.id); onSelect?.(isSel ? null : s.id); }}
                      className={cn("relative flex w-full min-w-0 cursor-pointer flex-col gap-1 rounded-card border bg-surface px-2.5 py-2 text-left outline-offset-2 transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) hover:bg-hover pointer-coarse:min-h-11",
                        isSel ? "border-fg ring-1 ring-fg" : needsYou(s.state) ? "border-dashed border-attention" : "border-line",
                        s.state === "failed" && "bg-sunken")}>
                      <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1">
                        {isSel && <CheckIcon width={14} height={14} strokeWidth={3} aria-hidden className="shrink-0 text-fg" />}
                        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-compact font-medium text-fg">{s.name}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted tabular-nums">
                        {formatMediaTime(s.start)}–{formatMediaTime(s.end)}
                        <OriginMark origin={s.origin} />
                      </span>
                      <StateLine s={s} />
                    </div>
                  </WorkingEdge>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {selected && (
        <div role="group" aria-labelledby={`${uid}-sel`} className="space-y-2.5 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken p-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
            <p id={`${uid}-sel`} className="text-compact font-semibold text-fg">{selected.name} <span className="font-normal text-fg-muted tabular-nums">· {formatMediaTime(selected.start)} to {formatMediaTime(selected.end)}</span></p>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-3"><OriginMark origin={selected.origin} /><StateLine s={selected} /></span>
          </div>
          {selected.note && <p className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">{selected.note}</p>}
          {selected.lyrics && <p className="line-clamp-3 text-compact whitespace-pre-line text-fg">{selected.lyrics}</p>}
          {selected.styles && selected.styles.length > 0 && <p className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">Style: {selected.styles.join(", ")}</p>}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            {selected.state === "failed" && onRetry && (
              <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" className={sizeBtn} onClick={() => onRetry(selected.id)} aria-label={`Try ${selected.name} again`}>Try again</Button>
            )}
            {selected.state === "has-alternates" && onOpenAlternates && (
              <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" className={sizeBtn} onClick={() => onOpenAlternates(selected.id)} aria-label={`Compare new takes of ${selected.name}`}>Compare takes</Button>
            )}
            {onRegenerate && selected.state !== "failed" && (
              <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" className={sizeBtn} disabled={selected.state === "generating"} leading={<RegenerateIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />}
                onClick={() => onRegenerate(selected.id)} aria-label={`Regenerate ${selected.name}`}>Regenerate</Button>
            )}
            {onExtend && (
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className={sizeBtn} leading={<PlusIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />}
                onClick={() => onExtend(selected.id)} aria-label={`Extend after ${selected.name}`}>Extend after</Button>
            )}
            {onEdit && (
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className={sizeBtn} leading={<EditIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />}
                onClick={() => onEdit(selected.id)} aria-label={`Edit lyrics and style of ${selected.name}`}>Edit</Button>
            )}
            {onReorder && sections.length > 1 && (
              <span className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1">
                <button type="button" ref={setBtn(`${selected.id}:earlier`)} aria-label={`Move ${selected.name} earlier`} disabled={selectedIndex === 0}
                  onClick={() => move(selectedIndex, selectedIndex - 1, "button", "earlier")}
                  className="tap grid size-8 cursor-pointer place-items-center rounded-control text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-disabled-fg disabled:hover:bg-transparent pointer-coarse:size-11">
                  <ChevronIcon aria-hidden className="rotate-180" />
                </button>
                <button type="button" ref={setBtn(`${selected.id}:later`)} aria-label={`Move ${selected.name} later`} disabled={selectedIndex === sections.length - 1}
                  onClick={() => move(selectedIndex, selectedIndex + 1, "button", "later")}
                  className="tap grid size-8 cursor-pointer place-items-center rounded-control text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-disabled-fg disabled:hover:bg-transparent pointer-coarse:size-11">
                  <ChevronIcon aria-hidden />
                </button>
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{message}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```
