## tattva/organisms/Sections.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import type { HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { Collapsible } from "../molecules/Collapsible";

export interface Section {
  /** Stays the same while the answer streams, so a section keeps its open state. */
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** A short line shown next to the title, such as "3 options". */
  meta?: string;
  content: ReactNode;
}

export interface SectionsProps {
  sections: Section[];
  /** The answer is still arriving. Each new section opens as it arrives; when the answer ends, the first one stays open. */
  streaming?: boolean;
  /** Level of each section's heading. Defaults to 3. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * A long answer in foldable sections. While the answer streams, each new section opens as it arrives so people can
 * follow along. When it ends, the sections fold back to the first one. Once the person opens or closes a section
 * themselves, the answer stops moving things and leaves their choice alone.
 */
export function Sections({ sections, streaming = false, headingLevel = 3, className }: SectionsProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set(sections[0] ? [sections[0].id] : []));
  const touched = useRef(false);
  const last = sections[sections.length - 1]?.id;
  const first = sections[0]?.id;

  // While streaming, follow the newest section; when the stream ends, settle on the first. Never after a person acts.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (touched.current) return;
    if (streaming && last) setOpen(new Set([last]));
  }, [streaming, last]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (touched.current) return;
    if (!streaming && first) setOpen(new Set([first]));
  }, [streaming, first]);

  const toggle = (id: string, value: boolean) => {
    touched.current = true;
    setOpen((o) => { const n = new Set(o); if (value) n.add(id); else n.delete(id); return n; });
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("divide-y divide-line rounded-card border border-line bg-surface", className)} aria-busy={streaming || undefined}>
      {sections.map((s) => (
        <Collapsible key={s.id} open={open.has(s.id)} onOpenChange={(v) => toggle(s.id, v)} headingLevel={headingLevel}
          className="px-4 py-3"
          header={
            <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
              <span className="min-w-0 text-lead leading-6 font-semibold text-fg">{s.title}</span>
              {s.meta && <span className="shrink-0 text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{s.meta}</span>}
            </span>
          }>
          <div className="pt-2 pl-6 text-body leading-6 text-fg">{s.content}</div>
        </Collapsible>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { CheckIcon, CopyIcon, GlobeIcon, LockIcon, UsersIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { RadioGroup } from "../molecules/RadioGroup";
import { InlineConfirm } from "../molecules/InlineConfirm";

export type ShareAccess = "private" | "workspace" | "link";

export interface SharePanelLabels {
  heading?: string;
  access?: string;
  options?: Partial<Record<ShareAccess, { label: string; description: string }>>;
  link?: string;
  copy?: string;
  copied?: string;
  /** What a shared link shows, in one line. */
  scope?: string;
  stop?: string;
  stopQuestion?: string;
  keep?: string;
}

export interface SharePanelProps {
  /** What is being shared, such as the chat's title. */
  title: string;
  /** Who can open it now. */
  access: ShareAccess;
  onAccessChange: (access: ShareAccess) => void;
  /** The link, once there is one. */
  link?: string;
  /** Copies the link. Defaults to the clipboard. */
  onCopy?: (link: string) => void;
  /** Turns the link off; anyone who has it can no longer open it. */
  onStopSharing?: () => void;
  /** Hide the workspace choice for people who are not in one. */
  showWorkspace?: boolean;
  labels?: SharePanelLabels;
  /** Level of the part's heading, so it fits the page outline. Default 2, for use in a dialog or sheet. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const OPTIONS: Record<ShareAccess, { label: string; description: string }> = {
  private: { label: "Only you", description: "Nobody else can open it." },
  workspace: { label: "People in your workspace", description: "Anyone signed in to your workspace with the link." },
  link: { label: "Anyone with the link", description: "No sign-in needed. Think before sharing private details." },
};

/**
 * Who can open a chat or a result, and its link. Put it in a Dialog or a Sheet. The choice reads as plain sentences,
 * the link is one press to copy (and says Copied), a line says exactly what the link shows, and stopping sharing
 * asks once in place.
 */
export function SharePanel({ title, access, onAccessChange, link, onCopy, onStopSharing, showWorkspace = true, labels, headingLevel = 2, className }: SharePanelProps) {
  const l = {
    heading: "Share", access: "Who can open it", link: "Link", copy: "Copy link", copied: "Copied",
    scope: "The link shows this chat up to now. Messages you send later are not shared.",
    stop: "Stop sharing", stopQuestion: "Stop sharing? The link stops working.", keep: "Keep sharing", ...labels,
    options: { ...OPTIONS, ...labels?.options },
  };
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const uid = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const ICON = { private: LockIcon, workspace: UsersIcon, link: GlobeIcon };
  const copy = () => {
    if (!link) return;
    if (onCopy) onCopy(link); else void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(link).catch(() => {});
    setCopied(true); window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1800);
  };
  const keys = (Object.keys(OPTIONS) as ShareAccess[]).filter((k) => showWorkspace || k !== "workspace");
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} className={cn("flex flex-col gap-5", className)}>
      <div>
        <H id={`${uid}-h`} className="m-0 text-title-sm leading-7 font-semibold text-fg">{l.heading}</H>
        <p className="m-0 mt-0.5 truncate text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted" title={title}>{title}</p>
      </div>
      <RadioGroup label={l.access} value={access} onChange={(v) => onAccessChange(v as ShareAccess)}
        options={keys.map((k) => {
          const Icon = ICON[k];
          return { value: k, label: <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><Icon aria-hidden width={15} height={15} className="text-fg-muted" />{l.options[k].label}</span>, description: l.options[k].description };
        })} />
      {access !== "private" && link && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label htmlFor={`${uid}-link`} className="block text-small leading-5 font-medium text-fg">{l.link}</label>
          <div className="flex gap-2 max-sm:flex-col">
            <input id={`${uid}-link`} readOnly value={link} onFocus={(e) => e.currentTarget.select()} aria-describedby={`${uid}-scope`}
              className="h-10 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-field border border-line bg-sunken px-3 font-mono text-small text-fg" />
            <Button onClick={copy} variant="secondary" className="h-10 shrink-0" leading={copied ? <CheckIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} /> : <CopyIcon aria-hidden width={14} height={14} />}>{copied ? l.copied : l.copy}</Button>
          </div>
          <p id={`${uid}-scope`} className="m-0 text-small leading-5 text-fg-muted">{l.scope}</p>
          <span role="status" className="sr-only">{copied ? l.copied : ""}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {access !== "private" && link && onStopSharing && (
        <InlineConfirm className="self-start" onConfirm={onStopSharing} confirmLabel={l.stop} cancelLabel={l.keep} question={l.stopQuestion} tone="danger">{l.stop}</InlineConfirm>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/Sheet.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";

export type SheetSide = "bottom" | "right" | "left";
export type SheetSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

export interface SheetProps {
  open: boolean;
  /** Called when the sheet asks to close: Escape, a scrim tap, the Close control or a drag down. Set `open` to false in response. */
  onClose: () => void;
  /** Required. Rendered as the heading and used as the sheet's name. */
  title: string;
  /** Which edge the sheet slides in from. */
  side?: SheetSide;
  children?: ReactNode;
  /** Usually buttons, pinned under the body. */
  footer?: ReactNode;
  /** When false, Escape, a scrim tap and dragging do nothing and there is no Close control. Only your own buttons can close it. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Width for side sheets. Height cap for bottom sheets. */
  size?: SheetSize;
  className?: string;
}

const FOCUSABLE = 'a[href],button:not([disabled]),input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"]),select:not([disabled]),textarea:not([disabled]),[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
const CLOSE_DISTANCE = 80;
const FLICK_SPEED = 0.6; // px per ms
const TAP_SLOP = 6;
const EXIT_MS = 320; // a little under --dur-slow, so the sheet is gone before the next thing can happen

const heights: Record<SheetSize, string> = { sm: "max-h-[40dvh]", md: "max-h-[65dvh]", lg: "max-h-[90dvh]" };
const widths: Record<SheetSize, string> = { sm: "max-w-[min(24rem,calc(100%-2.5rem))]", md: "max-w-[min(30rem,calc(100%-2.5rem))]", lg: "max-w-[min(42rem,calc(100%-2.5rem))]" };
const place: Record<SheetSide, string> = { bottom: "items-end justify-center", right: "items-stretch justify-end", left: "items-stretch justify-start" };
const hidden: Record<SheetSide, string> = { bottom: "translate-y-full", right: "translate-x-full", left: "-translate-x-full" };

/**
 * A surface that slides over the page, on the native <dialog> element, so the page behind is inert and Tab stays inside.
 * A bottom sheet has a drag handle that is also a Close button, so dragging is never the only way out.
 * Focus goes to the first control in the body or footer (or the sheet) and returns to the opener on close.
 */
export function Sheet({ open, onClose, title, side = "bottom", children, footer, dismissible = true, size = "md", className }: SheetProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const opener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const openRef = useRef(open);
  openRef.current = open;
  const id = useId();
  const titleId = `${id}-title`;
  // `present` outlasts `open` by the length of the slide-out, so the sheet leaves as smoothly as it arrives.
  const [present, setPresent] = useState(open);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const gesture = useRef({ y: 0, t: 0, dy: 0, moved: false });
  const bottom = side === "bottom";

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) { setPresent(true); return; }
    if (!present) return;
    setShown(false);
    const reduce = typeof window !== "undefined" && !!window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setPresent(false), reduce ? 0 : EXIT_MS);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [open, present]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const d = ref.current;
    if (!d || !present) return;
    opener.current = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
    if (!d.open) d.showModal();
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const prevOverflow = root.style.overflow;
    root.style.overflow = "hidden";
    const first = d.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-sheet-body] :is(${FOCUSABLE}), [data-sheet-footer] :is(${FOCUSABLE})`);
    (first ?? d).focus({ preventScroll: true });
    // Two frames, so the off-screen position is painted once before the slide starts.
    let f2 = 0;
    const f1 = requestAnimationFrame(() => { f2 = requestAnimationFrame(() => setShown(true)); });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(f1); cancelAnimationFrame(f2);
      setShown(false); setDrag(null);
      root.style.overflow = prevOverflow;
      if (d.open) d.close();
      const back = opener.current;
      if (back && back.isConnected) back.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      opener.current = null;
    };
  }, [present]);

  const down = (e: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    try { e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch { /* the drag still works without capture */ }
    gesture.current = { y: e.clientY, t: e.timeStamp, dy: 0, moved: false };
    setDrag(0);
  };
  const move = (e: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (drag === null) return;
    const dy = Math.max(0, e.clientY - gesture.current.y);
    gesture.current.dy = dy;
    if (dy > TAP_SLOP) gesture.current.moved = true;
    setDrag(dy);
  };
  const up = (e: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (drag === null) return;
    const { dy, t } = gesture.current;
    const speed = dy / Math.max(1, e.timeStamp - t);
    setDrag(null);
    if (dy > CLOSE_DISTANCE || (dy > 24 && speed > FLICK_SPEED)) onClose();
  };

  const offset = !shown ? undefined : drag ? { transform: `translateY(${drag}px)` } : undefined;
  return (
    <dialog ref={ref} tabIndex={-1} aria-labelledby={titleId}
      // Escape is turned into a request, so the parent stays the one source of truth for `open`.
      onCancel={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (dismissible) onClose(); }}
      onClose={() => { if (openRef.current) onClose(); }}
      onClick={(e) => { if (dismissible && e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}
      className={cn("fixed inset-0 m-0 h-full max-h-none w-full max-w-none bg-transparent p-0 text-fg backdrop:bg-[var(--scrim)] open:flex", place[side])}>
      {present && (
        <div style={offset}
          className={cn(
            "flex min-h-0 w-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-raised shadow-lg forced-colors:border-[CanvasText]",
            bottom ? cn("max-w-2xl rounded-t-overlay border border-b-0 border-line", heights[size]) : cn("h-full border-line", widths[size], side === "right" ? "border-l" : "border-r"),
            !shown && hidden[side],
            drag === null && "motion-safe:transition-transform motion-safe:duration-[var(--dur-slow)] motion-safe:ease-[var(--ease-out)]",
            className,
          )}>
          {bottom && (dismissible ? (
            <button type="button" aria-label="Close" onClick={() => { if (!gesture.current.moved) onClose(); gesture.current.moved = false; }}
              onPointerDown={down} onPointerMove={move} onPointerUp={up} onPointerCancel={() => setDrag(null)}
              className="flex h-7 w-full shrink-0 cursor-grab touch-none items-center justify-center active:cursor-grabbing pointer-coarse:h-11">
              <span aria-hidden className="h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-line-strong forced-colors:bg-[CanvasText]" />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div aria-hidden className="flex h-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center"><span className="h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-line-strong forced-colors:bg-[CanvasText]" /></div>
          ))}
          <div className={cn("flex items-start gap-3 px-5 pb-3", bottom ? "pt-1" : "pt-5")}>
            <h2 id={titleId} className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-subhead leading-snug font-semibold text-balance">{title}</h2>
            {!bottom && dismissible && (
              <IconButton label="Close" onClick={onClose} className="-mt-1 -mr-2 shrink-0 pointer-coarse:size-11">
                <XIcon aria-hidden width={16} height={16} />
              </IconButton>
            )}
          </div>
          {children != null && <div data-sheet-body tabIndex={0} className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain px-5 py-2 text-body leading-5">{children}</div>}
          {footer != null && <div data-sheet-footer className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 border-t border-line px-5 py-4 pb-[max(1rem,var(--safe-bottom))] sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">{footer}</div>}
        </div>
      )}
    </dialog>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ShotSettings.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon, SparkleIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";

/** One choice in a ShotSettings group. Set `unavailable` to keep it visible but not pickable, with the reason in words. */
export interface ShotOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  /** Short helper text, for example "Faster and cheaper". */
  description?: string;
  /** Why the chosen model cannot use this option, for example "Reel Lite makes up to 6 seconds". */
  unavailable?: string;
}

export type ShotQuality = "draft" | "final";

export interface ShotSettingsValue {
  model: string;
  /** Length of each take, as the value of one of `lengths`. */
  length: string;
  /** Aspect ratio, as the value of one of `aspects`, for example "16:9". */
  aspect: string;
  quality: ShotQuality;
  /** How many takes one press of Generate makes. Each take is charged. */
  outputs: number;
}

export interface ShotSettingsProps {
  value: ShotSettingsValue;
  onChange: (value: ShotSettingsValue) => void;
  /** Called with the value when Generate is pressed. Never called while a setting does not fit the model or credits are short. */
  onGenerate: (value: ShotSettingsValue) => void;
  models: ShotOption[];
  /** Lengths for the chosen model, for example 4 s, 6 s, 8 s. Mark the ones it cannot make as unavailable. */
  lengths: ShotOption[];
  /** Aspect ratios. Labels must be ratios like "16:9" so the shape glyph can be drawn. */
  aspects: ShotOption[];
  /** Draft and final. Defaults to both, with draft described as faster and cheaper. */
  qualities?: ShotOption[];
  /** Cost of one take with the current settings, worked out by your code. The total is outputs × this. */
  costPerOutput: number;
  /** Credits left. Leave out to hide the balance. */
  balance?: number;
  /** Unit after numbers. */
  unit?: string;
  /** Most takes per press. */
  maxOutputs?: number;
  /** Note shown under quality while Final is picked, nudging people to try a draft first. */
  draftNote?: string;
  /** Extra controls placed after the aspect ratio, such as a CameraMovePicker. */
  children?: ReactNode;
  /** Disables Generate and shows a spinner. Settings stay readable. */
  busy?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const defaultQualities: ShotOption[] = [
  { value: "draft", label: "Draft", description: "Faster and cheaper, lower detail" },
  { value: "final", label: "Final", description: "Full detail" },
];

const fmt = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US");

function RatioGlyph({ ratio }: { ratio: string }) {
  const [w, h] = ratio.split(":").map(Number);
  if (!w || !h) return null;
  const scale = 12 / Math.max(w, h);
  return <span aria-hidden className="inline-block shrink-0 rounded-2xs border border-current" style={{ width: Math.max(3, w * scale), height: Math.max(3, h * scale) }} />;
}

/**
 * Single-choice chips. Unavailable options stay in view with aria-disabled and point to their written reason; arrow keys
 * skip them so a person cannot land on a choice that cannot be made. A selected value that has become unavailable keeps
 * its place and is marked, so nothing changes behind the person's back.
 */
function OptionGroup({ label, options, value, onChange, glyph, reasonId }: {
  label: string; options: ShotOption[]; value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; glyph?: boolean; reasonId: string;
}) {
  const refs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const usable = options.map((o, i) => (o.unavailable ? -1 : i)).filter((i) => i >= 0);
  const current = options.findIndex((o) => o.value === value);
  const stop = current >= 0 ? current : usable[0] ?? 0;
  const move = (i: number, e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (!usable.length) return;
    const at = usable.indexOf(i);
    let next: number;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") next = usable[(at + 1) % usable.length];
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") next = usable[at <= 0 ? usable.length - 1 : at - 1];
    else if (e.key === "Home") next = usable[0];
    else if (e.key === "End") next = usable[usable.length - 1];
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    onChange(options[next].value);
    refs.current[next]?.focus();
  };
  return (
    <div role="radiogroup" aria-label={label} className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      {options.map((o, i) => {
        const on = o.value === value;
        const off = !!o.unavailable;
        return (
          <button key={o.value} ref={(el) => { refs.current[i] = el; }} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={on} aria-disabled={off || undefined}
            aria-describedby={off ? reasonId : undefined} tabIndex={i === stop ? 0 : -1}
            onClick={() => { if (!off) onChange(o.value); }} onKeyDown={(e) => move(i, e)}
            className={cn("tap inline-flex min-h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control border px-3 py-1 text-small leading-4 font-medium transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast)",
              on ? "border-fg bg-surface text-fg shadow-sm" : "border-line text-fg-muted",
              off ? "cursor-not-allowed border-dashed" : "cursor-pointer hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg",
              off && !on && "opacity-(--disabled-opacity)")}>
            {on && <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} className="shrink-0" />}
            {glyph && <RatioGlyph ratio={o.label} />}
            {o.label}
            {off && <span className="sr-only">, not available</span>}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

/** A labelled settings row. Reasons for unavailable options are written under the chips, never only in a tooltip. */
function Row({ id, label, hint, options, children, problem }: { id: string; label: string; hint?: ReactNode; options: ShotOption[]; children: ReactNode; problem?: string }) {
  const off = options.filter((o) => o.unavailable);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2">
        <span className="text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg">{label}</span>
        {hint && <span className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-subtle">{hint}</span>}
      </div>
      {children}
      {problem && <p className="text-small leading-4.5 font-medium text-danger-fg">{problem}</p>}
      {off.length > 0 && (
        <ul id={id} className="space-y-0.5 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">
          {off.map((o) => <li key={o.value}><span className="text-fg">{o.label}</span>: {o.unavailable}</li>)}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Settings for one video generation: model, length, aspect ratio, draft or final, and how many takes. The cost reads as
 * takes × cost per take before Generate is pressed. Options the model cannot use stay visible with the reason written
 * out, and the model is never switched behind the person's back: if a chosen option stops fitting, Generate waits and
 * says which setting to change.
 */
export function ShotSettings({
  value, onChange, onGenerate, models, lengths, aspects, qualities = defaultQualities, costPerOutput, balance, unit = "credits",
  maxOutputs = 4, draftNote = "Drafts are faster and cheaper. You can make a final version of any draft later.", children, busy = false,
  title = "Shot settings", className,
}: ShotSettingsProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const set = <K extends keyof ShotSettingsValue>(k: K, v: ShotSettingsValue[K]) => onChange({ ...value, [k]: v });

  const groups: { key: "model" | "length" | "aspect" | "quality"; label: string; options: ShotOption[] }[] = [
    { key: "model", label: "Model", options: models },
    { key: "length", label: "Length", options: lengths },
    { key: "aspect", label: "Aspect ratio", options: aspects },
    { key: "quality", label: "Quality", options: qualities },
  ];
  // A chosen option that the current model cannot use. Shown in words, never fixed silently.
  const conflicts = groups.flatMap((g) => {
    const o = g.options.find((x) => x.value === String(value[g.key]));
    return o?.unavailable ? [{ key: g.key, text: `${g.label} ${o.label} cannot be used: ${o.unavailable.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${o.unavailable.slice(1)}. Pick another ${g.label.toLowerCase()}.` }] : [];
  });
  const problemFor = (k: string) => conflicts.find((c) => c.key === k)?.text;

  const outputs = Math.min(Math.max(1, value.outputs), maxOutputs);
  const total = outputs * costPerOutput;
  const short = balance !== undefined && total > balance;
  const blocked = conflicts.length > 0 || short;
  const takeWord = (n: number) => (n === 1 ? "take" : "takes");
  const costLine = `${outputs} ${takeWord(outputs)} × ${fmt(costPerOutput)} = ${fmt(total)} ${unit}`;
  const status = conflicts.length > 0 ? "Change the setting marked above to continue."
    : short ? `Not enough ${unit}: ${fmt(total)} needed, ${fmt(balance!)} left. Make fewer takes or a draft.`
    : balance !== undefined ? `${fmt(balance - total)} left after this` : "";
  const quality = qualities.find((q) => q.value === value.quality);
  const outputOptions: ShotOption[] = Array.from({ length: maxOutputs }, (_, i) => ({ value: String(i + 1), label: String(i + 1) }));

  return (
    <form aria-label={title} onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!busy && !blocked) onGenerate({ ...value, outputs }); }}
      className={cn("w-full min-w-0 space-y-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 shadow-sm", className)}>
      <h3 className="text-lead leading-6 font-semibold text-fg">{title}</h3>

      {groups.map((g) => (
        <Row key={g.key} id={`${uid}-${g.key}`} label={g.label} options={g.options} problem={problemFor(g.key)}
          hint={g.key === "quality" ? quality?.description : g.key === "model" ? models.find((m) => m.value === value.model)?.description : undefined}>
          <OptionGroup label={g.label} options={g.options} value={String(value[g.key])} reasonId={`${uid}-${g.key}`} glyph={g.key === "aspect"}
            onChange={(v) => (g.key === "quality" ? set("quality", v as ShotQuality) : set(g.key, v))} />
          {g.key === "quality" && value.quality === "final" && draftNote && <p className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">{draftNote}</p>}
          {g.key === "aspect" && children}
        </Row>
      ))}

      <Row id={`${uid}-outputs`} label="Takes" hint={`Each take is charged. Up to ${maxOutputs}.`} options={[]}>
        <OptionGroup label="Number of takes" options={outputOptions} value={String(outputs)} reasonId={`${uid}-outputs`}
          onChange={(v) => set("outputs", Number(v))} />
      </Row>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-line pt-3">
        <div role="status" aria-live="polite" className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-48 space-y-0.5">
          <p className="text-compact font-medium text-fg tabular-nums">{costLine}</p>
          {status && <p className={cn("text-small leading-4.5 tabular-nums", blocked ? "text-fg" : "text-fg-muted")}>{status}</p>}
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" variant="lime" disabled={busy || blocked} className="max-sm:w-full"
          leading={busy ? <Spinner size={14} /> : <SparkleIcon width={14} height={14} />}>
          {busy ? "Generating…" : `Generate ${outputs} ${takeWord(outputs)}`}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/SlideRail.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore, type DragEvent, type KeyboardEvent, type MouseEvent, type ReactNode, type SVGProps } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, InfoIcon, MoreIcon, PlusIcon, RetryIcon, UndoIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { AIMark } from "../atoms/AIMark";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";
import { WorkingEdge } from "../atoms/WorkingEdge";
import { Menu, type MenuEntry } from "../molecules/Menu";
import { SlideCanvas, type SlideRatio } from "../molecules/SlideStage";

export type SlideStatus = "pending" | "generating" | "ready" | "edited" | "failed" | "stale" | "review";

export interface SlideRef {
  id: string;
  /** The slide's title. Screen readers move through a deck by these, so every slide needs one. */
  title: string;
  /** The slide drawn at its design size. The rail scales it down. Leave out to show the title on a plain card. */
  thumbnail?: ReactNode;
  status: SlideStatus;
  /** True when the AI wrote this slide. Shows a small AI mark until a person edits it. */
  aiMade?: boolean;
  /** Why it failed, or what to review, in plain words. Read with the slide's name. */
  error?: string;
}

export interface SlideRailProps {
  slides: SlideRef[];
  /** The slide on the stage. It holds keyboard focus inside the rail. */
  currentId: string;
  /** Slides chosen as the scope of an AI edit or a bulk action. Defaults to the current slide only. */
  selectedIds?: string[];
  onCurrentChange: (id: string) => void;
  /** Turns on multi-select: Shift with an arrow or click, Ctrl or Cmd with a click, Space and Ctrl+A. */
  onSelectionChange?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** Turns on reordering by drag, Alt with an arrow, and Move earlier or later. `to` is the slide's new index. */
  onReorder?: (from: number, to: number) => void;
  /** Shows Try again for a failed slide. */
  onRetry?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Shows Add slide. The new slide goes after this one. */
  onInsertAfter?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Shows Duplicate for the chosen slides. */
  onDuplicate?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** Shows Delete for the chosen slides. The rail always asks first. */
  onDelete?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** Shows Undo after an add, duplicate, delete or move, and on Ctrl+Z or Cmd+Z in the rail. Your app keeps the history. */
  onUndo?: () => void;
  /** "auto" is a column on wide screens and a sideways strip on phones. */
  orientation?: "vertical" | "horizontal" | "auto";
  /** Slide shape, used for the thumbnails. */
  ratio?: SlideRatio;
  /** Name of the list. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_WORDS: Record<SlideStatus, string> = {
  pending: "waiting", generating: "being written", ready: "ready", edited: "edited by you", failed: "failed", stale: "outline changed since it was built", review: "needs your review",
};

const PHONE = "(max-width: 599.98px)";
const subscribe = (cb: () => void) => {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.matchMedia) return () => {};
  const mq = window.matchMedia(PHONE);
  mq.addEventListener("change", cb);
  return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", cb);
};
const usePhone = () => useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => !!window.matchMedia?.(PHONE).matches, () => false);

function PersonIcon(p: SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>) {
  return <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden {...p}><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="3.5" /><path d="M5 20a7 7 0 0 1 14 0" /></svg>;
}

/** The state of one slide in words, with an icon. Colour only adds to it. */
function StatusLine({ status }: { status: SlideStatus }) {
  const base = "flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 text-small leading-4";
  switch (status) {
    case "pending": return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg-subtle")}>Waiting</span>;
    case "generating": return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg-muted")}><span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-lime" />Writing…</span>;
    case "ready": return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg-subtle")}>Ready</span>;
    case "edited": return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg-muted")}><PersonIcon width={12} height={12} className="shrink-0" />Edited by you</span>;
    case "failed": return <span className={cn(base, "font-medium text-danger-fg")}><AlertIcon width={12} height={12} aria-hidden className="shrink-0" />Failed</span>;
    case "stale": return <span className={cn(base, "text-fg-muted")}><InfoIcon width={12} height={12} aria-hidden className="shrink-0" />Outline changed</span>;
    case "review": return <span className={cn(base, "font-medium text-attention-fg")}><span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-attention" />Needs review</span>;
  }
}

/**
 * The ordered strip of slide thumbnails. Each slide shows its state in words: waiting, writing, ready, edited by you,
 * failed, outline changed or needs review. People move around, choose the scope of an AI edit, reorder, add, duplicate
 * and delete, with Undo. A column on wide screens and a sideways strip on phones.
 */
export function SlideRail({
  slides, currentId, selectedIds, onCurrentChange, onSelectionChange, onReorder, onRetry, onInsertAfter, onDuplicate, onDelete, onUndo,
  orientation = "auto", ratio = "16:9", label = "Slides", className,
}: SlideRailProps) {
  const phone = usePhone();
  const horizontal = orientation === "horizontal" || (orientation === "auto" && phone);
  const list = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const bar = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const keepBtn = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const anchor = useRef(currentId);
  const focusList = useRef(false);
  const dragFrom = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const [drop, setDrop] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
  const [undoNote, setUndoNote] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [announce, setAnnounce] = useState("");
  const titleId = useId();

  const total = slides.length;
  const selected = selectedIds && selectedIds.length ? selectedIds : [currentId];
  const multi = onSelectionChange && selected.length > 1;
  const idx = (id: string) => slides.findIndex((s) => s.id === id);
  const cur = Math.max(0, idx(currentId));
  const current = slides[cur];
  const name = (i: number) => `slide ${i + 1}, ${slides[i]?.title ?? ""}`;
  const say = (text: string) => setAnnounce(text);

  // Status milestones only: a slide failing or needing review, and how many are ready. Never every change.
  const prev = useRef(new Map<string, SlideStatus>());
  useEffect(() => {
    const before = prev.current;
    const msgs: string[] = [];
    let readyGain = false;
    slides.forEach((s, i) => {
      const was = before.get(s.id);
      if (!was || was === s.status) return;
      if (s.status === "failed") msgs.push(`Slide ${i + 1} failed`);
      else if (s.status === "review") msgs.push(`Slide ${i + 1} needs your review`);
      else if (s.status === "ready" && (was === "generating" || was === "pending")) readyGain = true;
    });
    if (readyGain) {
      const done = slides.filter((s) => s.status !== "pending" && s.status !== "generating" && s.status !== "failed").length;
      msgs.push(done === total ? "All slides ready" : `${done} of ${total} slides ready`);
    }
    if (before.size && msgs.length) say(msgs.join(". "));
    prev.current = new Map(slides.map((s) => [s.id, s.status]));
  }, [slides, total]);

  // Keep focus on the current slide when it changes or moves, but only if focus was already in the list.
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = list.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-slide-id="${CSS.escape(currentId)}"]`);
    if (!el) return;
    // Scroll the rail only, never the page: scrollIntoView would also move every scrolling ancestor, the window included.
    const box = list.current;
    if (box) {
      const b = box.getBoundingClientRect(), r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.top < b.top) box.scrollTop -= b.top - r.top; else if (r.bottom > b.bottom) box.scrollTop += r.bottom - b.bottom;
      if (r.left < b.left) box.scrollLeft -= b.left - r.left; else if (r.right > b.right) box.scrollLeft += r.right - b.right;
    }
    if (focusList.current) { focusList.current = false; el.focus(); }
  }, [currentId, slides]);

  useEffect(() => { if (confirm) keepBtn.current?.focus(); }, [confirm]);

  const backToList = () => { list.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-slide-id="${CSS.escape(currentId)}"]`)?.focus(); };

  const go = (i: number, extend: boolean) => {
    const j = Math.max(0, Math.min(total - 1, i));
    const id = slides[j].id;
    focusList.current = true;
    if (extend && onSelectionChange) {
      const a = Math.max(0, idx(anchor.current));
      const [lo, hi] = a < j ? [a, j] : [j, a];
      onSelectionChange(slides.slice(lo, hi + 1).map((s) => s.id));
    } else {
      anchor.current = id;
      onSelectionChange?.([id]);
    }
    onCurrentChange(id);
  };

  const move = (from: number, to: number) => {
    if (!onReorder || to < 0 || to >= total || from === to) return;
    const t = slides[from].title;
    focusList.current = true;
    onReorder(from, to);
    const text = `Slide ${from + 1}, ${t}, moved to position ${to + 1}`;
    say(text);
    setUndoNote(`${text}.`);
  };

  const duplicate = (ids: string[]) => {
    if (!onDuplicate) return;
    onDuplicate(ids);
    const text = ids.length === 1 ? `Slide ${idx(ids[0]) + 1} duplicated.` : `${ids.length} slides duplicated.`;
    say(text); setUndoNote(text);
  };

  const insert = () => {
    if (!onInsertAfter || !current) return;
    onInsertAfter(current.id);
    const text = `New slide added after slide ${cur + 1}.`;
    say(text); setUndoNote(text);
  };

  const askDelete = (ids: string[]) => { if (onDelete && ids.length) { setUndoNote(null); setConfirm(ids); } };
  const doDelete = () => {
    if (!confirm || !onDelete) return;
    const ids = confirm;
    const text = ids.length === 1 ? `Slide ${idx(ids[0]) + 1}, ${slides[idx(ids[0])]?.title}, deleted.` : `${ids.length} slides deleted.`;
    setConfirm(null);
    focusList.current = true;
    onDelete(ids);
    say(onUndo ? `${text} Undo is available.` : text);
    setUndoNote(text);
  };
  const cancelDelete = () => { setConfirm(null); backToList(); };

  const undo = () => {
    if (!onUndo) return;
    focusList.current = true;
    onUndo();
    setUndoNote(null);
    say("Undone");
  };

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    if (!onSelectionChange) return;
    const has = selected.includes(id);
    const next = has ? selected.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...selected, id];
    onSelectionChange(next.length ? slides.filter((s) => next.includes(s.id)).map((s) => s.id) : [currentId]);
    say(`${name(idx(id))} ${has ? "removed from" : "added to"} the selection. ${next.length || 1} selected.`);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const mod = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
    const back = horizontal ? ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowUp"] : ["ArrowUp", "ArrowLeft"];
    const fwd = horizontal ? ["ArrowRight", "ArrowDown"] : ["ArrowDown", "ArrowRight"];
    const dir = back.includes(e.key) ? -1 : fwd.includes(e.key) ? 1 : 0;
    if (dir && e.altKey) { e.preventDefault(); move(cur, cur + dir); return; }
    if (dir) { e.preventDefault(); go(cur + dir, e.shiftKey); return; }
    if (e.key === "Home" || e.key === "End") { e.preventDefault(); go(e.key === "Home" ? 0 : total - 1, e.shiftKey); return; }
    if (e.key === " " && onSelectionChange) { e.preventDefault(); toggle(currentId); return; }
    if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === "a" && onSelectionChange) { e.preventDefault(); onSelectionChange(slides.map((s) => s.id)); say(`All ${total} slides selected`); return; }
    if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z" && !e.shiftKey && onUndo) { e.preventDefault(); undo(); return; }
    if (e.key === "Escape" && multi) { e.preventDefault(); onSelectionChange?.([currentId]); say("Selection cleared"); return; }
    // Delete never deletes on one key: it opens the question below the list, with Keep focused.
    if ((e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") && onDelete) { e.preventDefault(); askDelete(selected); }
  };

  const onClick = (e: MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    focusList.current = false;
    if (e.shiftKey && onSelectionChange) {
      const a = Math.max(0, idx(anchor.current)), j = idx(id);
      const [lo, hi] = a < j ? [a, j] : [j, a];
      onSelectionChange(slides.slice(lo, hi + 1).map((s) => s.id));
      onCurrentChange(id);
      return;
    }
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && onSelectionChange) { toggle(id); onCurrentChange(id); return; }
    anchor.current = id;
    onSelectionChange?.([id]);
    onCurrentChange(id);
  };

  // A right click or a long press opens the same menu as the visible More button.
  const onContext = (e: MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selected.includes(id)) { anchor.current = id; onSelectionChange?.([id]); }
    onCurrentChange(id);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => bar.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("[aria-haspopup]")?.click());
  };

  /* ---- drag to reorder (pointer only; keyboard and the menu do the same) ---- */
  const dragStart = (e: DragEvent, i: number) => { dragFrom.current = i; e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move"; e.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", slides[i].id); };
  const dragOver = (e: DragEvent<HTMLElement>, i: number) => {
    if (dragFrom.current === null) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const after = horizontal ? e.clientX > r.left + r.width / 2 : e.clientY > r.top + r.height / 2;
    setDrop(after ? i + 1 : i);
  };
  const dragEnd = () => { dragFrom.current = null; setDrop(null); };
  const dropHere = (e: DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const from = dragFrom.current;
    if (from !== null && drop !== null) {
      const to = drop > from ? drop - 1 : drop;
      if (to !== from) move(from, to);
    }
    dragEnd();
  };

  const ar = ratio === "fluid" ? 16 / 9 : ({ "16:9": 16 / 9, "4:3": 4 / 3, "1:1": 1, "4:5": 4 / 5, "9:16": 9 / 16 } as const)[ratio];

  /* ---- action bar items ---- */
  const singleItems: MenuEntry[] = current ? [
    ...(onInsertAfter ? [{ id: "add", label: `Add slide after slide ${cur + 1}`, icon: <PlusIcon width={16} height={16} />, onSelect: insert }] : []),
    ...(onDuplicate ? [{ id: "dup", label: `Duplicate slide ${cur + 1}`, onSelect: () => duplicate([current.id]) }] : []),
    ...(onReorder ? [
      { id: "up", label: "Move earlier", disabled: cur === 0, onSelect: () => move(cur, cur - 1) },
      { id: "down", label: "Move later", disabled: cur === total - 1, onSelect: () => move(cur, cur + 1) },
    ] : []),
    ...(onDelete ? [{ type: "separator" as const }, { id: "del", label: `Delete slide ${cur + 1}`, danger: true, onSelect: () => askDelete([current.id]) }] : []),
  ] : [];
  const multiItems: MenuEntry[] = [
    ...(onDuplicate ? [{ id: "dup", label: `Duplicate ${selected.length} slides`, onSelect: () => duplicate(selected) }] : []),
    { id: "one", label: `Select only slide ${cur + 1}`, onSelect: () => { onSelectionChange?.([currentId]); say("Selection cleared"); } },
    ...(onDelete ? [{ type: "separator" as const }, { id: "del", label: `Delete ${selected.length} slides`, danger: true, onSelect: () => askDelete(selected) }] : []),
  ];

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2", !horizontal && "min-h-0", className)}>
      <div className="flex min-h-8 items-center justify-between gap-2 px-1">
        <p id={titleId} className="text-compact font-medium text-fg">
          {label} <span className="font-normal text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{total}{multi ? `, ${selected.length} selected` : ""}</span>
        </p>
        {onInsertAfter && current && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<PlusIcon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={insert} aria-label={`Add slide after slide ${cur + 1}`}>Add slide</Button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div ref={list} role="listbox" aria-labelledby={titleId} aria-multiselectable={onSelectionChange ? true : undefined}
        aria-orientation={horizontal ? "horizontal" : "vertical"} onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
        onFocus={() => { focusList.current = false; }}
        onDragLeave={(e) => { if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setDrop(null); }}
        className={cn(
          "flex p-1",
          horizontal ? "snap-x snap-mandatory gap-2 overflow-x-auto overscroll-x-contain" : "min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain",
        )}>
        {slides.map((s, i) => {
          const isCur = s.id === currentId;
          const isSel = selected.includes(s.id);
          const words = `Slide ${i + 1} of ${total}, ${s.title}, ${STATUS_WORDS[s.status]}${s.aiMade && s.status !== "edited" ? ", made by AI" : ""}${s.error ? `. ${s.error}` : ""}`;
          const lineBefore = drop === i && dragFrom.current !== null && dragFrom.current !== i && dragFrom.current !== i - 1;
          const lineAfter = drop === i + 1 && i === total - 1 && dragFrom.current !== null && dragFrom.current !== i;
          const thumb = (
            <div aria-hidden className={cn("relative", horizontal ? "h-16" : "w-full")} style={horizontal ? { width: `calc(var(--spacing) * 16 * ${ar})` } : undefined}>
              <WorkingEdge active={s.status === "generating"} radius="control" label="">
                <div className={cn(
                  "relative overflow-hidden rounded-control border bg-surface",
                  isCur ? "border-fg ring-1 ring-fg" : "border-line",
                  horizontal && "h-16",
                )} style={horizontal ? undefined : { aspectRatio: String(ar) }}>
                  {s.status === "pending" ? (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 grid content-center gap-1.5 bg-sunken p-2">
                      <span className="truncate text-small text-fg-muted">{s.title}</span>
                      <Skeleton className="h-1.5 w-4/5 rounded-control motion-reduce:animate-none" />
                      <Skeleton className="h-1.5 w-3/5 rounded-control motion-reduce:animate-none" />
                    </div>
                  ) : s.status === "failed" ? (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 bg-sunken p-2 text-center">
                      <AlertIcon width={16} height={16} className="text-danger-fg" />
                      <span className="line-clamp-2 text-small text-fg-muted">{s.title}</span>
                    </div>
                  ) : s.thumbnail ? (
                    <div key={s.status} className={cn("size-full motion-safe:animate-[fade_var(--dur-base)_var(--ease-out)_both]", s.status === "generating" && "opacity-60")}>
                      <SlideCanvas ratio={ratio === "fluid" ? "16:9" : ratio} className="h-full">{s.thumbnail}</SlideCanvas>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-2 text-center">
                      <span className="line-clamp-2 text-small font-medium text-fg">{s.title}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {s.aiMade && s.status !== "edited" && s.status !== "pending" && s.status !== "failed" && (
                    <span className="absolute right-1 bottom-1 inline-flex size-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-lime text-on-lime"><AIMark size={16} className="size-3" /></span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </WorkingEdge>
            </div>
          );
          return (
            <div key={s.id} role="option" data-slide-id={s.id} aria-selected={isSel} aria-label={words} title={s.error}
              tabIndex={isCur ? 0 : -1} draggable={!!onReorder}
              onClick={(e) => onClick(e, s.id)} onContextMenu={(e) => onContext(e, s.id)}
              onDragStart={(e) => dragStart(e, i)} onDragOver={(e) => dragOver(e, i)} onDrop={dropHere} onDragEnd={dragEnd}
              className={cn(
                "relative shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-card transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) select-none",
                horizontal ? "flex snap-start flex-col gap-1 p-1" : "flex gap-2 p-1.5",
                isSel && multi ? "bg-accent-soft" : "hover:bg-hover",
              )}>
              {lineBefore && <span aria-hidden className={cn("absolute bg-fg", horizontal ? "inset-y-1 -left-1.5 w-0.5" : "inset-x-1 -top-1 h-0.5")} />}
              {lineAfter && <span aria-hidden className={cn("absolute bg-fg", horizontal ? "inset-y-1 -right-1.5 w-0.5" : "inset-x-1 -bottom-1 h-0.5")} />}
              {horizontal ? (
                <>
                  {thumb}
                  <span aria-hidden className="flex items-center gap-1 px-0.5">
                    <span className="text-small font-medium text-fg tabular-nums">{i + 1}</span>
                    {isSel && multi && <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} className="text-fg" />}
                    <StatusLine status={s.status} />
                  </span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <span aria-hidden className="flex w-5 shrink-0 flex-col items-end gap-1 pt-0.5">
                    <span className="text-small font-medium text-fg tabular-nums">{i + 1}</span>
                    {isSel && multi && <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} className="text-fg" />}
                  </span>
                  <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 gap-1">
                    {thumb}
                    <span aria-hidden><StatusLine status={s.status} /></span>
                  </span>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {undoNote && !confirm && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface px-2.5 py-1.5 motion-safe:animate-fade">
          <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-compact text-fg-muted">{undoNote}</p>
          {onUndo && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" leading={<UndoIcon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={undo}>Undo</Button>}
        </div>
      )}

      <div ref={bar} className="flex min-h-8 flex-wrap items-center gap-2 px-1">
        {confirm ? (
          <div role="group" aria-label="Confirm delete" className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2 motion-safe:animate-fade"
            onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); cancelDelete(); } }}>
            <p className="w-full text-compact text-fg">
              {confirm.length === 1 ? `Delete slide ${idx(confirm[0]) + 1}, ${slides[idx(confirm[0])]?.title}?` : `Delete ${confirm.length} slides?`}
              {onUndo && <span className="text-fg-muted"> You can undo this.</span>}
            </p>
            <Button ref={keepBtn} size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={cancelDelete}>{confirm.length === 1 ? "Keep it" : "Keep them"}</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="danger" onClick={doDelete}>{confirm.length === 1 ? "Delete slide" : `Delete ${confirm.length} slides`}</Button>
          </div>
        ) : multi ? (
          <>
            <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-compact text-fg-muted">{selected.length} slides selected</p>
            <Menu portal align="end" side="top" trigger={<MoreIcon width={16} height={16} />} triggerLabel={`Actions for ${selected.length} selected slides`} items={multiItems} />
          </>
        ) : current ? (
          <>
            <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-compact leading-5 text-fg-muted">
              {current.status === "failed" && current.error ? current.error : current.status === "review" && current.error ? current.error : `Slide ${cur + 1}`}
            </p>
            {current.status === "failed" && onRetry && (
              <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<RetryIcon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={() => onRetry(current.id)} aria-label={`Try slide ${cur + 1} again`}>Try again</Button>
            )}
            {singleItems.length > 0 && (
              <Menu portal align="end" side="top" trigger={<MoreIcon width={16} height={16} />} triggerLabel={`Actions for slide ${cur + 1}`} items={singleItems} />
            )}
          </>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{announce}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { type Source, SourceCard } from "../molecules/SourceCard";

    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { formatNumber } from "../molecules/ChartFrame";

export interface SparklineProps {
  /** Values in time order. At least two points are drawn. */
  data: number[];
  /** What the line measures, for example "p95 latency". Used in the accessible name. */
  label: string;
  /** Unit appended to values in the accessible name, for example " ms". Include the leading space if needed. */
  unit?: string;
  /** Formats values for the accessible name. */
  formatValue?: (n: number) => string;
  /** Width in px. */
  width?: number;
  /** Height in px. */
  height?: number;
  /** Mark the minimum and maximum with dots. */
  showMinMax?: boolean;
  /** Hide from assistive technology. Use when the number beside it already says everything, such as inside a StatTile. */
  decorative?: boolean;
  /** Color of the emphasized end point. Defaults to the first chart color. */
  color?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Tiny trend line in the context color with the latest point emphasized. The accessible name states the first,
 * last, minimum and maximum values. Set decorative when a visible number carries the same information.
 */
export function Sparkline({ data, label, unit = "", formatValue = formatNumber, width = 96, height = 28, showMinMax, decorative, color = "var(--chart-1)", className }: SparklineProps) {
  const n = data.length;
  const pad = 6;
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const span = max - min || 1;
  const x = (i: number) => pad + (n <= 1 ? (width - 2 * pad) / 2 : (i * (width - 2 * pad)) / (n - 1));
  const y = (v: number) => height - pad - ((v - min) / span) * (height - 2 * pad);
  const d = data.map((v, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"}${x(i).toFixed(1)} ${y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join("");
  const iMin = data.indexOf(min);
  const iMax = data.indexOf(max);
  const f = (v: number) => `${formatValue(v)}${unit}`;
  const name = n ? `${label}: first ${f(data[0])}, last ${f(data[n - 1])}, minimum ${f(min)}, maximum ${f(max)}.` : `${label}: no data.`;
  if (!n) return null;
  return (
    <svg width={width} height={height} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} className={className}
      role={decorative ? undefined : "img"} aria-label={decorative ? undefined : name} aria-hidden={decorative || undefined} focusable="false">
      {n > 1 && <path d={d} fill="none" stroke="var(--chart-axis)" strokeWidth={1.5} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />}
      {showMinMax && iMin !== n - 1 && <circle cx={x(iMin)} cy={y(min)} r={3.5} fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--chart-axis)" strokeWidth={1.5} />}
      {showMinMax && iMax !== n - 1 && iMax !== iMin && <circle cx={x(iMax)} cy={y(max)} r={3.5} fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--chart-axis)" strokeWidth={1.5} />}
      <circle cx={x(n - 1)} cy={y(data[n - 1])} r={4.5} fill={color} stroke="var(--surface)" strokeWidth={2} />
    </svg>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { keepFocus, nearestTyping, useAnnounceChange } from "../lib/focus";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";

export interface StarterIntent { id: string; label: string }
export interface StarterTemplate { id: string; title: string; description: string; category?: string }

export interface StarterGalleryProps {
  /** Heading above the statement. */
  heading?: string;
  /** One sentence on what the assistant can and cannot do. */
  statement: ReactNode;
  /** Starter intents. Three to six works best. */
  intents: StarterIntent[];
  onIntent: (id: string) => void;
  templates?: StarterTemplate[];
  onTemplate?: (id: string) => void;
  intentsLabel?: string;
  templatesLabel?: string;
  /** Slot beside the templates heading, usually a Randomize button. When the templates change, screen readers hear it. */
  randomize?: ReactNode;
  /** What screen readers hear when the templates change. */
  templatesChangedMessage?: (count: number) => string;
  /** Where keyboard focus goes after an idea or template is chosen, if the gallery goes away. By default the nearest
   * message box. */
  focusAfterChoose?: () => HTMLElement | null;
  className?: string;
}

/** First-run view. It states scope, offers starter intents next to free text, and lists templates. */
export function StarterGallery({ heading = "What would you like to make?", statement, intents, onIntent, templates = [], onTemplate, intentsLabel = "Start with", templatesLabel = "Templates", randomize, templatesChangedMessage = (n) => `New templates: ${n}`, focusAfterChoose, className }: StarterGalleryProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const choose = (f: ((id: string) => void) | undefined, id: string) => {
    const box = nearestTyping(ref.current);
    f?.(id);
    keepFocus(ref.current, () => focusAfterChoose?.() ?? box);
  };
  const said = useAnnounceChange(templates.map((t) => t.id).join("|"), () => templatesChangedMessage(templates.length));
  return (
    <section ref={ref} aria-label={heading} className={cn("space-y-6", className)}>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <h2 className="text-title-sm leading-8">{heading}</h2>
        <p className="max-w-xl text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted">{statement}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <h3 className="text-nano font-normal tracking-caps text-fg-muted uppercase font-sans!">{intentsLabel}</h3>
        <ul className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {intents.map((i) => <li key={i.id}><Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => choose(onIntent, i.id)}>{i.label}</Button></li>)}
        </ul>
      </div>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{said}</p>
      {templates.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <h3 className="text-nano font-normal tracking-caps text-fg-muted uppercase font-sans!">{templatesLabel}</h3>
            {randomize}
          </div>
          <ul className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {templates.map((t) => (
              <li key={t.id}>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => choose(onTemplate, t.id)}
                  className="flex h-full w-full cursor-pointer flex-col items-start gap-1 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 text-left transition-colors hover:border-line-strong hover:bg-hover">
                  {t.category && <Badge>{t.category}</Badge>}
                  <span className="text-body leading-5 font-medium">{t.title}</span>
                  <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{t.description}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/StemMixer.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, DownloadIcon, LockIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Checkbox } from "../atoms/Checkbox";
import { Slider } from "../atoms/Slider";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";
import { Waveform } from "../atoms/Waveform";

/** Where the split into stems is. `separating`: the AI is splitting the song. `ready`: stems can be mixed and exported. `failed`: the split did not work. `plan-locked`: the person's plan does not include stems. */
export type StemMixerStatus = "separating" | "ready" | "failed" | "plan-locked";

export interface Stem {
  id: string;
  /** Plain name, such as "Vocals" or "Drums". */
  name: string;
  /** Loudness per slice, 0 to 1. Leave out for no waveform. */
  peaks?: number[];
  /** Level, 0 to 100. */
  level: number;
  muted: boolean;
  soloed: boolean;
  /** Picked for export. */
  exported: boolean;
}

export interface StemMixerProps {
  stems: Stem[];
  status: StemMixerStatus;
  /** Length of the song, in seconds, for the waveforms. */
  duration?: number;
  /** Playhead, in seconds, drawn on each waveform. */
  position?: number;
  onLevelChange?: (id: string, level: number) => void;
  onMuteChange?: (id: string, muted: boolean) => void;
  onSoloChange?: (id: string, soloed: boolean) => void;
  onExportChange?: (id: string, exported: boolean) => void;
  /** Exports the picked stems. */
  onExport?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** Format and limits beside Export, such as "WAV, 3 downloads left this month". */
  exportNote?: string;
  /** While separating: what is happening, such as "Splitting into 4 stems. About a minute." No percentages. */
  separatingNote?: string;
  /** When failed: what happened and whether it was charged. */
  failedNote?: string;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  /** When plan-locked: which plan has stems. */
  planNote?: string;
  /** When plan-locked: opens the plans page. */
  onSeePlans?: () => void;
  /** Rows shown while separating, before stem names are known. */
  placeholderCount?: number;
  title?: string;
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_WORD: Record<StemMixerStatus, string> = { separating: "Separating", ready: "Ready", failed: "Did not work", "plan-locked": "Not on your plan" };

/**
 * One lane per stem of a song: Mute, Solo, a named level slider and a box to pick it for export.
 * Shows the separation state in words: separating, ready, failed or not on the person's plan.
 * Rows stack on a phone and the waveforms hide when the mixer is narrower than about 400px.
 */
export function StemMixer({
  stems, status, duration = 0, position = 0, onLevelChange, onMuteChange, onSoloChange, onExportChange, onExport, exportNote,
  separatingNote = "Splitting the song into stems. About a minute.", failedNote = "The song could not be split. You were not charged.", onRetry,
  planNote = "Stems come with the Pro plan.", onSeePlans, placeholderCount = 4, title = "Stems", headingLevel = 3, className,
}: StemMixerProps) {
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const uid = useId();
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const anySolo = stems.some((s) => s.soloed);
  const picked = stems.filter((s) => s.exported);

  // Announce a change of separation status only.
  const lastStatus = useRef(status);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (lastStatus.current === status) return;
    lastStatus.current = status;
    setMessage(status === "ready" ? `${stems.length} stems ready.` : status === "failed" ? "Separation did not work." : status === "separating" ? "Separating." : "");
  }, [status, stems.length]);

  const toggleSolo = (s: Stem) => {
    onSoloChange?.(s.id, !s.soloed);
    const others = stems.filter((x) => x.soloed && x.id !== s.id).length;
    setMessage(!s.soloed ? `${s.name} soloed. Stems not soloed are silent.` : others ? `${s.name} no longer soloed.` : `${s.name} no longer soloed. All stems play.`);
  };
  const toggleMute = (s: Stem) => {
    onMuteChange?.(s.id, !s.muted);
    setMessage(`${s.name} ${s.muted ? "unmuted" : "muted"}.`);
  };

  const toggle = (on: boolean) => cn("tap h-8 min-w-14 cursor-pointer rounded-control border px-2.5 text-small leading-4.5 font-medium transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) pointer-coarse:h-11 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:border-disabled-line disabled:bg-disabled disabled:text-disabled-fg",
    on ? "border-fg bg-fg text-bg" : "border-line bg-surface text-fg-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-fg");

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-h`} aria-busy={status === "separating" || undefined}
      className={cn("@container w-full min-w-0 space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4", className)}>
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
        <H id={`${uid}-h`} className="text-lead leading-6 font-semibold text-fg">{title}</H>
        <p className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-4.5 font-medium text-fg">
          {status === "separating" && <span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-lime motion-safe:animate-pulse" />}
          {status === "ready" && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-normal text-fg-muted"><span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-lime ring-1 ring-fg-muted" />Split by AI ·</span>}
          {status === "failed" && <AlertIcon width={12} height={12} aria-hidden />}
          {status === "plan-locked" && <LockIcon width={12} height={12} aria-hidden />}
          {status === "ready" ? `${stems.length} stems` : STATUS_WORD[status]}
        </p>
      </header>

      {status === "separating" && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">{separatingNote}</p>
          <ul aria-hidden className="space-y-2">
            {Array.from({ length: placeholderCount }, (_, i) => (
              <li key={i} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-card border border-line p-2.5">
                <Skeleton className="h-4 w-16" />
                <Skeleton className="h-6 flex-1 @max-sm:hidden" />
                <Skeleton className="h-4 w-24" />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}

      {status === "failed" && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken p-3">
          <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-compact text-fg">{failedNote}</p>
          {onRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" className="pointer-coarse:h-11" onClick={onRetry}>Try again</Button>}
        </div>
      )}

      {status === "plan-locked" && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-card border border-dashed border-line-strong p-3">
          <LockIcon width={16} height={16} aria-hidden className="shrink-0 text-fg-muted" />
          <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-compact text-fg">{planNote} You can still export the full song.</p>
          {onSeePlans && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" className="pointer-coarse:h-11" onClick={onSeePlans}>See plans</Button>}
        </div>
      )}

      {status === "ready" && (
        <>
          <ul aria-label={`${title}, ${stems.length}`} className="divide-y divide-line rounded-card border border-line">
            {stems.map((s) => {
              const silent = s.muted || (anySolo && !s.soloed);
              const why = s.muted ? "Muted" : anySolo && !s.soloed ? "Silent while another stem is soloed" : s.soloed ? "Soloed" : "";
              return (
                <li key={s.id} className="grid grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)] items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2 p-2.5 @3xl:grid-cols-[auto_minmax(6rem,9rem)_auto_minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(8rem,10rem)]">
                  <Checkbox checked={s.exported} onChange={(v) => onExportChange?.(s.id, v)} ariaLabel={`Export ${s.name}`} />
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="truncate text-compact font-medium text-fg">{s.name}</p>
                    <p className={cn("text-small leading-4.5", why ? "text-fg-muted" : "text-fg-subtle")}>{why || "Playing"}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="col-span-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 @3xl:col-span-1">
                    <button type="button" aria-pressed={s.muted} aria-label={`Mute ${s.name}`} onClick={() => toggleMute(s)} className={toggle(s.muted)}>Mute</button>
                    <button type="button" aria-pressed={s.soloed} aria-label={`Solo ${s.name}`} onClick={() => toggleSolo(s)} className={toggle(s.soloed)}>Solo</button>
                  </div>
                  <div className={cn("col-span-2 min-w-0 @max-sm:hidden @3xl:col-span-1", silent && "opacity-40")}>
                    {s.peaks && duration > 0 && <Waveform peaks={s.peaks} duration={duration} position={position} height={32} />}
                  </div>
                  <Slider className="col-span-2 @3xl:col-span-1" label={`${s.name} level`} value={s.level} onChange={(v) => onLevelChange?.(s.id, v)}
                    showValue formatValue={(v) => `${v}%`} />
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
          {onExport && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-x-3 gap-y-2">
              {exportNote && <span className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">{exportNote}</span>}
              <Button size="sm" className="pointer-coarse:h-11" disabled={picked.length === 0} leading={<DownloadIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />}
                onClick={() => onExport(picked.map((s) => s.id))}>
                {picked.length === 0 ? "Pick stems to export" : `Export ${picked.length} of ${stems.length} stems`}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{message}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/StepTimeline.tsx

```tsx
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";

export type StepState = "done" | "active" | "todo" | "failed";
export interface Step { id: string; title: string; detail?: string; state: StepState }

export function StepTimeline({ steps }: { steps: Step[] }) {
  return (
    <ol aria-label="Task progress" className="space-y-0">
      {steps.map((s, i) => (
        <li key={s.id} className="relative flex gap-3 pb-4 last:pb-0" aria-current={s.state === "active" ? "step" : undefined}>
          {i < steps.length - 1 && <span aria-hidden className={cn("absolute top-6 bottom-0 left-2.75 w-px", s.state === "done" ? "bg-success" : "bg-line")} />}
          <span className={cn("z-10 flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-small leading-4",
            s.state === "done" && "border-success bg-success text-on-success",
            s.state === "failed" && "border-danger bg-danger text-on-danger",
            s.state === "active" && "border-accent bg-surface",
            s.state === "todo" && "border-line-strong bg-surface text-fg-subtle")}>
            {s.state === "done" ? <CheckIcon width={12} height={12} /> : s.state === "failed" ? <XIcon width={12} height={12} /> : s.state === "active" ? <Spinner size={14} /> : i + 1}
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0 pt-0.5">
            <p className={cn("text-body leading-5 font-medium", s.state === "todo" && "text-fg-subtle")}>{s.title}</p>
            {s.detail && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{s.detail}</p>}
            <span className="sr-only">{s.state}</span>
          </div>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/SuggestionBar.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { nearestTyping, useFocusReturn } from "../lib/focus";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon, RefreshIcon, SendIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";

export type SuggestionBarStatus = "generating" | "ready" | "committed" | "discarded";

export interface SuggestionBarProps {
  /** Where the staged output is in its life. Nothing reaches the document until it is committed. */
  status?: SuggestionBarStatus;
  /** Optional preview of the staged output, rendered above the bar. */
  children?: ReactNode;
  /** Label of the primary action. Use "Replace" when the output replaces a selection. */
  primaryLabel?: string;
  /** Called by the primary action. */
  onKeep?: () => void;
  onInsertBelow?: () => void;
  /** A fresh sample from the same prompt. Not a follow-up. */
  onRegenerate?: () => void;
  onDiscard?: () => void;
  /** A follow-up instruction that changes the draft. Not a fresh sample. */
  onRefine?: (instruction: string) => void;
  /** Cost of a retry, for example "Uses 1 AI response". Shown beside Regenerate. */
  retryCost?: ReactNode;
  /** Where keyboard focus goes once the draft is kept, inserted or discarded. By default the nearest text box or
   * editor outside the bar (the document), else the bar itself, which then shows what happened. */
  focusAfter?: () => HTMLElement | null;
  /** Product text, all overridable. */
  labels?: Partial<Record<"insertBelow" | "regenerate" | "discard" | "refine" | "refinePlaceholder" | "refineSend" | "generating" | "ready" | "committed" | "discarded", string>>;
  className?: string;
}

const defaults = {
  insertBelow: "Insert below", regenerate: "Regenerate", discard: "Discard", refine: "Fine-tune this", refinePlaceholder: "Tell AI what to change",
  refineSend: "Send instruction", generating: "Writing a draft", ready: "Draft ready. Nothing is added until you choose.", committed: "Added to the document.", discarded: "Draft discarded.",
};

/**
 * Result bar for staged AI output. Keep, Insert below, Regenerate and Discard sit next to a "Fine-tune this" field.
 * Regenerate asks for a fresh sample, Fine-tune sends a follow-up instruction. Status changes are announced through a separate polite region.
 */
export function SuggestionBar({
  status = "ready", children, primaryLabel = "Keep", onKeep, onInsertBelow, onRegenerate, onDiscard, onRefine, retryCost, focusAfter, labels, className,
}: SuggestionBarProps) {
  // The buttons change with the status, so focus follows: to Discard while a new draft is written, to the primary
  // action when it is ready, and back to the document (or the bar) once the draft is kept or thrown away.
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const discardWhileWriting = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const primary = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  useFocusReturn(status, root, () =>
    status === "generating" ? discardWhileWriting.current : status === "ready" ? primary.current : focusAfter?.() ?? nearestTyping(root.current) ?? root.current);
  const t = { ...defaults, ...labels };
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const ready = status === "ready";
  const message = t[status];
  return (
    <div ref={root} tabIndex={-1} className={cn("w-full space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3 outline-offset-2", className)}>
      <p role="status" className="sr-only">{status === "generating" ? "" : message}</p>
      {children && <div className={cn("rounded-card bg-sunken p-3 text-body leading-5 text-fg", status === "discarded" && "opacity-60")}>{children}</div>}
      {status === "generating" && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted"><Spinner size={14} label={t.generating} /><span aria-hidden="true">{t.generating}</span>
          <Button ref={discardWhileWriting} size="sm" variant="ghost" className="ml-auto" onClick={onDiscard}>{t.discard}</Button></div>
      )}
      {(status === "committed" || status === "discarded") && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted" aria-hidden="true">{status === "committed" && <CheckIcon width={13} height={13} />}{message}</p>
      )}
      {ready && (
        <>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Button ref={primary} size="sm" variant="lime" onClick={onKeep}>{primaryLabel}</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onInsertBelow}>{t.insertBelow}</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" leading={<RefreshIcon width={13} height={13} />} onClick={onRegenerate}>{t.regenerate}</Button>
            {retryCost && <span className="text-micro text-fg-subtle">{retryCost}</span>}
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="ml-auto" onClick={onDiscard}>{t.discard}</Button>
          </div>
          <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); const v = text.trim(); if (v) { onRefine?.(v); setText(""); } }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-field border border-line bg-sunken pl-4 pr-1 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-2 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2 has-[input:focus-visible]:outline-[var(--focus-ring)]">
            <input value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} aria-label={t.refine} placeholder={`${t.refine}. ${t.refinePlaceholder}`}
              className="h-9 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-compact text-fg placeholder:text-fg-subtle focus:outline-none" />
            <IconButton type="submit" size="sm" variant="primary" label={t.refineSend} disabled={!text.trim()}><SendIcon width={13} height={13} /></IconButton>
          </form>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
