## tattva/organisms/SummaryCard.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { ChevronIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { AIBadge } from "../atoms/AIBadge";
import { Spinner } from "../atoms/Spinner";
import { FeedbackBar, type Rating } from "../molecules/FeedbackBar";
import type { Source } from "../molecules/SourceCard";
import { SourceList } from "./SourceList";

export interface SummaryCardProps {
  /** Heading of the block. */
  title?: string;
  /** Text of the AI label. */
  aiLabel?: string;
  /** Status line, for example "Based on 4 sources". Announced politely when it changes. */
  status?: ReactNode;
  /** Show a spinner beside the status while the summary is still being produced. */
  generating?: boolean;
  /** The summary. Place CitationHoverCard markers inline here. Never put aria-live on streamed text. */
  children: ReactNode;
  /** Longer detail revealed by the expand control. Omit to hide the control. */
  detail?: ReactNode;
  expandLabel?: string;
  collapseLabel?: string;
  defaultExpanded?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  onExpandedChange?: (expanded: boolean) => void;
  sources?: Source[];
  /** Disclaimer line under the content. */
  disclaimer?: ReactNode;
  /** Shows the feedback row when provided. */
  onFeedback?: (rating: Exclude<Rating, null>, reason?: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

/** AI overview block: label and status, summary, optional expandable detail, sources, a disclaimer and a feedback row. */
export function SummaryCard({
  title = "Overview", aiLabel, status, generating, children, detail, expandLabel = "Show more", collapseLabel = "Show less", defaultExpanded = false,
  expanded, onExpandedChange, sources, disclaimer = "AI responses may include mistakes. Check important information.", onFeedback, className,
}: SummaryCardProps) {
  const [inner, setInner] = useState(defaultExpanded);
  const open = expanded ?? inner;
  const id = useId();
  const toggle = () => { const v = !open; if (expanded === undefined) setInner(v); onExpandedChange?.(v); };
  return (
    <section aria-label={title} className={cn("w-full space-y-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5", className)}>
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2.5 gap-y-1">
        <AIBadge {...(aiLabel ? { label: aiLabel } : {})} />
        <h3 className="text-lead leading-6 text-fg">{title}</h3>
        {status && (
          <p role="status" className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
            {generating && <Spinner size={12} label="Working" />}{status}
          </p>
        )}
      </header>
      <div className="text-body leading-relaxed text-fg">{children}</div>
      {detail && (
        <div>
          <button type="button" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={id} onClick={toggle}
            className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-control text-small leading-4 font-medium text-fg-muted hover:text-fg">
            <ChevronIcon width={12} height={12} className={cn("transition-transform duration-[var(--dur-fast)]", open ? "-rotate-90" : "rotate-90")} />
            {open ? collapseLabel : expandLabel}
          </button>
          <div id={id} hidden={!open} className="mt-2 text-body leading-relaxed text-fg-muted">{detail}</div>
        </div>
      )}
      {sources && sources.length > 0 && <SourceList sources={sources} />}
      {disclaimer && <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{disclaimer}</p>}
      {onFeedback && <FeedbackBar onSubmit={onFeedback} />}
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/TakeGrid.tsx

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { type HeadingLevel, headingTag } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { Illustration } from "../atoms/Illustration";
import { Reveal } from "../atoms/Reveal";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";
import { EmptyState } from "../molecules/EmptyState";
import { TakeCard, takeRatioClass, type TakeCardProps, type TakeRatio, type TakeStatus } from "../molecules/TakeCard";

export interface TakeGridItem extends Omit<TakeCardProps, "ratio" | "selectMode" | "selected" | "onSelect" | "announce" | "headingLevel" | "tabIndex" | "onKeyDown" | "ref" | "describedBy" | "compact"> {
  /** The prompt or request this take belongs to. Used as the group heading when groupBy is "request". */
  request?: string;
}

export type TakeGridDensity = "comfortable" | "compact";

export interface TakeGridProps {
  takes: TakeGridItem[];
  /** pick: choose one take. select: choose several, for example to download or delete. */
  mode?: "pick" | "select";
  /** Selected take ids. */
  value: string[];
  onChange: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** One ratio for every tile, so rows stay even. */
  ratio?: TakeRatio;
  /** A heading per request, using each take's `request`. */
  groupBy?: "request" | "none";
  /** Tile size. Controlled when onDensityChange is passed. */
  density?: TakeGridDensity;
  onDensityChange?: (d: TakeGridDensity) => void;
  /** Shows the Comfortable and Compact control above the grid. */
  showDensityControl?: boolean;
  /** Called with the take id when Enter is pressed on a finished take, or its poster is pressed. */
  onOpen?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Takes requested but not yet known to the grid. Draws this many still placeholders. */
  loadingCount?: number;
  /** Replaces the default empty state. */
  empty?: ReactNode;
  /** Accessible name of the grid. */
  label?: string;
  /** The = and - keys change tile size while focus is in the grid. Set false to turn them off. */
  shortcuts?: boolean;
  /** Heading level of group headings. Each take's name is one level below. */
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const plural = (n: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

/**
 * The one sentence the grid speaks. It only changes when a status changes, never with a percentage, so a screen reader
 * hears "2 of 4 takes ready" once instead of every card speaking on its own.
 */
export function takeGridSummary(takes: { status: TakeStatus; charge?: TakeGridItem["charge"] }[]) {
  if (!takes.length) return "";
  const n = (s: TakeStatus) => takes.filter((t) => t.status === s).length;
  const parts = [`${n("done")} of ${plural(takes.length, "take")} ready`];
  const working = n("queued") + n("generating") + n("finalising");
  if (working) parts.push(`${working} still working`);
  const blocked = takes.filter((t) => t.status === "blocked");
  if (blocked.length) {
    const free = blocked.every((t) => t.charge && (t.charge.state === "notCharged" || t.charge.state === "refunded"));
    parts.push(`${plural(blocked.length, "take")} blocked${free ? ", not charged" : ""}`);
  }
  if (n("failed")) parts.push(`${n("failed")} failed`);
  if (n("cancelled")) parts.push(`${n("cancelled")} cancelled`);
  if (n("rateLimited")) parts.push(`${n("rateLimited")} paused by the rate limit`);
  return parts.join(", ") + ".";
}

// Columns follow the grid's own width, so the grid works in a side panel as well as a full page.
const COLS: Record<"wide" | "tall", Record<TakeGridDensity, string>> = {
  wide: { comfortable: "grid-cols-1 @lg:grid-cols-2 @4xl:grid-cols-3", compact: "grid-cols-2 @2xl:grid-cols-3 @4xl:grid-cols-4" },
  tall: { comfortable: "grid-cols-2 @2xl:grid-cols-3 @4xl:grid-cols-4", compact: "grid-cols-2 @lg:grid-cols-3 @2xl:grid-cols-4 @4xl:grid-cols-6" },
};

const isTyping = (el: EventTarget | null) => el instanceof HTMLElement && (el.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(el.tagName));

/**
 * A set of video takes where running and finished takes sit together. Arrow keys move between takes, Enter opens a
 * finished take, Space selects. One polite live region speaks for the whole grid.
 */
export function TakeGrid({
  takes, mode = "select", value, onChange, ratio = "16:9", groupBy = "none", density: densityProp, onDensityChange,
  showDensityControl = false, onOpen, loadingCount = 0, empty, label = "Takes", shortcuts = true, headingLevel = 3, className,
}: TakeGridProps) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const keysId = useId();
  const [innerDensity, setInnerDensity] = useState<TakeGridDensity>("comfortable");
  const density = densityProp ?? innerDensity;
  const setDensity = (d: TakeGridDensity) => { if (densityProp === undefined) setInnerDensity(d); onDensityChange?.(d); };
  const [focusId, setFocusId] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const GroupH = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const cardLevel = (groupBy === "request" ? Math.min(headingLevel + 1, 6) : headingLevel) as HeadingLevel;

  const canSelect = (t: TakeGridItem) => mode === "select" || t.status === "done";
  const toggle = (t: TakeGridItem) => {
    if (!canSelect(t)) return;
    if (mode === "pick") onChange(value.includes(t.id) ? [] : [t.id]);
    else onChange(value.includes(t.id) ? value.filter((x) => x !== t.id) : [...value, t.id]);
  };

  // The tab stop: the take last focused, else the first selected, else the first take.
  const stopId = takes.some((t) => t.id === focusId) ? focusId : (takes.find((t) => value.includes(t.id)) ?? takes[0])?.id;

  const tiles = () => Array.from(root.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("article[data-take-id]") ?? []);

  const onTileKey = (t: TakeGridItem) => (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (e.target !== e.currentTarget || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    const all = tiles();
    const from = all.indexOf(e.currentTarget);
    let to = -1;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") to = Math.min(from + 1, all.length - 1);
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") to = Math.max(from - 1, 0);
    else if (e.key === "Home") to = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") to = all.length - 1;
    else if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      // Same column in the next or previous row: the nearest tile by left edge among the closest row.
      const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
      const down = e.key === "ArrowDown";
      const rows = all.map((el, i) => ({ i, b: el.getBoundingClientRect() })).filter(({ b }) => (down ? b.top > r.top + 1 : b.top < r.top - 1));
      if (rows.length) {
        const rowTop = down ? Math.min(...rows.map((x) => x.b.top)) : Math.max(...rows.map((x) => x.b.top));
        const row = rows.filter((x) => Math.abs(x.b.top - rowTop) < 2);
        to = row.reduce((best, x) => (Math.abs(x.b.left - r.left) < Math.abs(best.b.left - r.left) ? x : best)).i;
      } else to = from;
    } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      if (t.status === "done") { e.preventDefault(); (onOpen ? onOpen(t.id) : t.onOpen?.()); }
      return;
    } else if (e.key === " ") {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggle(t);
      return;
    } else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    all[to]?.focus();
  };

  const onGridKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!shortcuts || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || isTyping(e.target)) return;
    if (e.key === "=" || e.key === "+") { e.preventDefault(); setDensity("comfortable"); }
    else if (e.key === "-") { e.preventDefault(); setDensity("compact"); }
  };

  const summary = takeGridSummary(takes);
  const cols = COLS[ratio === "9:16" ? "tall" : "wide"][density];

  if (!takes.length && !loadingCount) {
    return <>{empty ?? <EmptyState variant="first-use" art={<Illustration name="first-run" />} title="No takes yet" className={className}>Write a prompt and generate. Each take appears here while it is made.</EmptyState>}</>;
  }

  const groups: { key: string; title?: string; items: TakeGridItem[] }[] = [];
  if (groupBy === "request") {
    for (const t of takes) {
      const key = t.request ?? "";
      const g = groups.find((x) => x.key === key);
      if (g) g.items.push(t); else groups.push({ key, title: t.request, items: [t] });
    }
  } else groups.push({ key: "all", items: takes });

  let index = 0;
  const selectedCount = value.filter((id) => takes.some((t) => t.id === id)).length;

  return (
    <div ref={root} role="group" aria-label={label} onKeyDown={onGridKey}
      onFocus={(e) => { const id = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>("article[data-take-id]")?.dataset.takeId; if (id) setFocusId(id); }}
      className={cn("@container min-w-0", className)}>
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
          <span role="status" aria-live="polite">{summary}</span>
          {selectedCount > 0 && <span> {mode === "pick" ? "1 picked." : `${selectedCount} selected.`}</span>}
        </p>
        {showDensityControl && (
          <SegmentedControl size="sm" label="Tile size" value={density} onChange={setDensity}
            options={[{ value: "comfortable", label: "Large" }, { value: "compact", label: "Small" }]} />
        )}
      </div>
      <p id={keysId} className="sr-only">Arrow keys move between takes. Enter opens a finished take. Space {mode === "pick" ? "picks" : "selects"} it.</p>
      <div className="space-y-5">
        {groups.map((g) => (
          <section key={g.key} aria-label={g.title}>
            {g.title && <GroupH className="mb-2 line-clamp-2 text-small font-medium text-fg">{g.title}</GroupH>}
            <ul className={cn("m-0 grid list-none gap-3 p-0", cols)}>
              {g.items.map((t) => {
                const i = index++;
                const { request: _r, ...card } = t;
                void _r;
                return (
                  <Reveal as="li" key={t.id} index={i} className="min-w-0">
                    <TakeCard {...card} ratio={ratio} announce={false} headingLevel={cardLevel}
                      tabIndex={t.id === stopId ? 0 : -1} onKeyDown={onTileKey(t)}
                      describedBy={keysId} compact={density === "compact"}
                      onOpen={t.status === "done" && (onOpen || t.onOpen) ? () => (onOpen ? onOpen(t.id) : t.onOpen?.()) : undefined}
                      selectMode={canSelect(t) ? (mode === "pick" ? "single" : "multi") : undefined}
                      selected={value.includes(t.id)} onSelect={() => toggle(t)} />
                  </Reveal>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </section>
        ))}
        {loadingCount > 0 && (
          <ul aria-label="Takes on the way" className={cn("m-0 grid list-none gap-3 p-0", cols)}>
            {Array.from({ length: loadingCount }, (_, i) => (
              <li key={i} className="min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
                <div aria-hidden className={cn("w-full bg-sunken", takeRatioClass(ratio))} />
                <div aria-hidden className="space-y-2 p-3"><div className="h-3 w-1/3 rounded-control bg-sunken" /><div className="h-3 w-2/3 rounded-control bg-sunken" /></div>
              </li>
            ))}
            <li className="sr-only">Loading {plural(loadingCount, "take")}</li>
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/TakePicker.tsx

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, CheckIcon, RegenerateIcon, RetryIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { type HeadingLevel, headingTag } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { AIBadge } from "../atoms/AIBadge";
import { AIMark } from "../atoms/AIMark";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Kbd } from "../atoms/Kbd";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";
import { Waveform, formatMediaTime } from "../atoms/Waveform";
import type { WaveformRegion } from "../atoms/Waveform";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../hooks/useReducedMotion";

/** pending: a slot kept open while the take is made. streaming: playable while the end is still being made. ready: finished. failed: could not be made. */
export type AudioTakeStatus = "pending" | "streaming" | "ready" | "failed";

export interface AudioTake {
  id: string;
  /** Short name, such as "Take 2". Used in every button name, so keep it unique. */
  label: string;
  status: AudioTakeStatus;
  /** A real audio file. Leave out to simulate playback from `duration`. */
  src?: string;
  /** Loudness per slice, each 0 to 1. Leave out for a plain bar. */
  peaks?: number[];
  /** Length in seconds. */
  duration?: number;
  /** In the streaming state, the seconds made so far. The rest is drawn dashed. */
  madeUpTo?: number;
  /** What sets this take apart from the others, in a few words each, such as "Slower, 84 BPM" or "Piano lead". */
  differs?: string[];
  /** Why it failed, in plain words, such as "The model stopped early. You were not charged." */
  error?: string;
}

export interface TakePickerProps {
  takes: AudioTake[];
  /** Ids of the kept takes. */
  kept: string[];
  onKeptChange: (ids: string[]) => void;
  /** Lets the person keep more than one take. Off: Keep works like a radio choice. */
  multiple?: boolean;
  /** Shows the make-more button. */
  onMore?: () => void;
  /** Text of the make-more button. */
  moreLabel?: string;
  /** Cost shown beside the make-more button, such as "about 10 credits". */
  moreCost?: string;
  /** The takes replace one section of a longer song. Play then runs from `context` seconds before the section to `context` after it, so the seams can be heard, and the section is marked on each waveform. */
  section?: { start: number; end: number; label: string };
  /** Seconds of the surrounding song played before and after the section. */
  context?: number;
  /** Shows Try again on a failed take. */
  onRetryTake?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Heading of the picker. */
  title?: string;
  /** The request the takes were made from, shown under the heading. */
  prompt?: string;
  /** Line by the make-more button. */
  note?: string;
  /** Once every take has finished and none is kept, says in amber that a person must pick one. */
  requirePick?: boolean;
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const PLAY_EVENT = "tattva-audio-play";
const isTyping = (el: EventTarget | null) => el instanceof HTMLElement && (el.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(el.tagName));
const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));
const plural = (n: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

const PlayGlyph = () => <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="size-5" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5.5v13a1 1 0 0 0 1.5.86l10.5-6.5a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.72L9.5 4.64A1 1 0 0 0 8 5.5z" /></svg>;
const PauseGlyph = () => <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="size-5" fill="currentColor"><rect x="6.5" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1" /><rect x="13.5" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1" /></svg>;

/** The one sentence the picker speaks. It changes only when a take's status changes, never with the clock. */
export function takePickerSummary(takes: AudioTake[], keptCount = 0): string {
  if (!takes.length) return "";
  const n = (s: AudioTakeStatus) => takes.filter((t) => t.status === s).length;
  const ready = n("ready");
  const making = n("pending") + n("streaming");
  const failed = n("failed");
  let text = making && !ready ? `Making ${plural(takes.length, "take")}.`
    : making ? `${ready} of ${plural(takes.length, "take")} ready, ${making} still being made.`
    : `${plural(n("ready"), "take")} ready.`;
  if (failed) text += ` ${failed} failed.`;
  if (!making && n("ready") && !keptCount) text += " Pick one to keep.";
  return text;
}

/**
 * Compare a few AI-made takes of the same request and keep one (or several).
 * Rows are a list, not a radio group: each has Play, a waveform you can seek, the length, what is different, and Keep.
 * One shared playhead runs across every take, so moving from one take to the next plays from the same moment: the A/B comparison.
 * Nothing plays by itself, and starting a take pauses any other player on the page.
 */
export function TakePicker({
  takes, kept, onKeptChange, multiple = false, onMore, moreLabel = "Make 2 more", moreCost, section, context = 3, onRetryTake,
  title = "Takes", prompt, note = "Takes you don't keep stay in history.", requirePick = true, headingLevel = 3, className,
}: TakePickerProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const audio = useRef<HTMLAudioElement>(null);
  const [playingId, setPlayingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(section ? Math.max(0, section.start - context) : 0);
  const posRef = useRef(pos);
  posRef.current = pos;

  const playing = takes.find((t) => t.id === playingId) ?? null;
  const playable = (t: AudioTake) => (t.status === "ready" || t.status === "streaming") && (t.duration ?? 0) > 0;
  // The stretch a take is played over: the whole take, or the section with a little of the song around it.
  const windowOf = useCallback((t: AudioTake): [number, number] => {
    const dur = t.duration ?? 0;
    const made = t.status === "streaming" ? Math.min(dur, t.madeUpTo ?? dur) : dur;
    return section ? [clamp(section.start - context, 0, made), clamp(section.end + context, 0, made)] : [0, made];
  }, [section, context]);

  const stop = useCallback(() => { setPlayingId(null); audio.current?.pause(); }, []);

  const play = (t: AudioTake) => {
    if (!playable(t)) return;
    if (playingId === t.id) { stop(); return; }
    // Same position as the take that was playing, so the switch is an instant A/B. From the start when nothing was.
    const [from, to] = windowOf(t);
    const at = posRef.current;
    const start = at >= from && at < to - 0.25 ? at : from;
    setPos(start);
    setPlayingId(t.id);
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(PLAY_EVENT, { detail: id }));
  };

  // Only one player on the page plays at a time.
  useEffect(() => {
    const other = (e: Event) => { if ((e as CustomEvent).detail !== id) stop(); };
    window.addEventListener(PLAY_EVENT, other);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(PLAY_EVENT, other);
  }, [id, stop]);

  // A take that stops being playable (retried, removed) stops playing.
  useEffect(() => { if (playingId && (!playing || !playable(playing))) stop(); });

  // A real file plays through one audio element, starting at the shared position.
  useEffect(() => {
    const a = audio.current;
    if (!a) return;
    if (!playing?.src) { a.pause(); return; }
    const begin = () => { a.currentTime = posRef.current; a.play().catch(() => setPlayingId(null)); };
    if (a.getAttribute("src") !== playing.src) { a.src = playing.src; a.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", begin, { once: true }); }
    else begin();
  }, [playing?.id, playing?.src]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  // Without a file a clock moves the shared position. It ticks less often with reduced motion.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing || playing.src) return;
    const [, to] = windowOf(playing);
    let last = performance.now();
    const t = window.setInterval(() => {
      const now = performance.now();
      const next = posRef.current + (now - last) / 1000;
      last = now;
      if (next >= to) { stop(); setPos(section ? windowOf(playing)[0] : to); } else setPos(next);
    }, reduced ? 250 : 100);
    return () => window.clearInterval(t);
  }, [playing, reduced, windowOf, stop, section]);

  const onTime = () => {
    const a = audio.current;
    if (!a || !playing) return;
    const [from, to] = windowOf(playing);
    if (a.currentTime >= to) { stop(); setPos(section ? from : to); } else setPos(a.currentTime);
  };

  const seek = (t: number) => {
    setPos(t);
    if (audio.current && playing?.src) audio.current.currentTime = t;
  };

  const toggleKeep = (t: AudioTake) => {
    const on = kept.includes(t.id);
    onKeptChange(on ? kept.filter((k) => k !== t.id) : multiple ? [...kept, t.id] : [t.id]);
  };

  // 1 to 9 play that take while focus is in the list. Never while typing, and never with a modifier key.
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || isTyping(e.target)) return;
    const n = Number(e.key);
    if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1 || n > takes.length) return;
    const t = takes[n - 1];
    if (!playable(t)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    play(t);
  };

  const making = takes.some((t) => t.status === "pending" || t.status === "streaming");
  const readyCount = takes.filter((t) => t.status === "ready").length;
  const allFailed = takes.length > 0 && takes.every((t) => t.status === "failed");
  const needsPick = requirePick && !making && readyCount > 0 && kept.length === 0;
  const playableCount = takes.filter(playable).length;
  const summary = takePickerSummary(takes, kept.length);
  const regions: WaveformRegion[] | undefined = section ? [{ start: section.start, end: section.end, kind: "ai" }] : undefined;
  const listId = `${id}-list`;

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${id}-h`} className={cn("@container flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3 sm:p-4", className)}>
      {takes.some((t) => t.src) ? (
        <audio ref={audio} preload="metadata" className="hidden" onTimeUpdate={onTime} onEnded={() => stop()} onError={() => stop()} />
      ) : null}

      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <H id={`${id}-h`} className="text-body leading-5 font-semibold text-fg">{title}</H>
          {prompt && <p className="mt-0.5 text-small text-fg-muted">{prompt}</p>}
        </div>
        <AIBadge label="Made by AI" />
      </header>

      {section && (
        <p className="text-small text-fg-muted">
          Each take replaces {section.label}. Play runs from {context} seconds before it to {context} seconds after it, so you hear the joins.
        </p>
      )}

      {needsPick && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-field bg-attention-soft px-3 py-2 text-compact text-attention-fg">
          <span aria-hidden className="size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-attention" />
          <span><span className="font-medium">Pick a take to keep.</span> Listen to each, then press Keep.</span>
        </p>
      )}

      {allFailed ? (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-field bg-sunken px-3 py-3 text-compact text-fg">
          <AlertIcon width={16} height={16} aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-danger-fg" />
          <span>None of the takes could be made. {takes[0]?.error ?? "Try again, or change the request."}</span>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul id={listId} aria-label={title} onKeyDown={onKey} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {takes.map((t, i) => {
            const isKept = kept.includes(t.id);
            const isPlaying = playingId === t.id;
            const dur = t.duration ?? 0;
            const canPlay = playable(t);
            const showPos = clamp(pos, 0, dur);
            if (t.status === "pending") {
              return (
                <li key={t.id} className="flex min-h-22 items-center gap-3 rounded-card border border-dashed border-line-strong px-3 py-2">
                  <span aria-hidden className="relative inline-flex size-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-sunken">
                    <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-lime ring-1 ring-fg-muted motion-safe:animate-pulse-dot" />
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
                    <span className="text-compact text-fg">Making {t.label.toLowerCase().startsWith("take") ? t.label.toLowerCase() : t.label}</span>
                    <Skeleton className="h-6 w-full motion-reduce:animate-none" />
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            }
            if (t.status === "failed") {
              return (
                <li key={t.id} className="flex min-h-22 flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-2">
                  <AlertIcon width={20} height={20} aria-hidden className="ml-3 shrink-0 text-danger-fg" />
                  <div className="min-w-40 flex-1">
                    <p className="text-compact font-medium text-fg">{t.label} could not be made</p>
                    <p className="text-small text-fg-muted">{t.error ?? "Something went wrong while making it."}</p>
                  </div>
                  {onRetryTake && (
                    <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => onRetryTake(t.id)} leading={<RetryIcon width={14} height={14} />}
                      aria-label={`Try ${t.label} again`} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Try again</Button>
                  )}
                </li>
              );
            }
            return (
              <li key={t.id}
                className={cn("flex min-h-22 items-start gap-3 rounded-card border px-3 py-2 transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) motion-safe:animate-rise",
                  isKept ? "border-fg bg-surface forced-colors:border-[Highlight]" : "border-line bg-surface")}>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => play(t)} aria-label={`Play ${t.label}`} aria-pressed={isPlaying}
                  className="mt-1 inline-flex size-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent text-on-accent transition-colors duration-(--dur-instant) hover:bg-accent-hover">
                  {isPlaying ? <PauseGlyph /> : <PlayGlyph />}
                </button>
                <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1">
                    <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-lime text-on-lime"><AIMark size={16} className="size-3" /></span>
                    <span className="text-compact font-medium text-fg">{t.label}</span>
                    {playableCount > 1 && i < 9 && <span aria-hidden className="pointer-coarse:hidden"><Kbd>{i + 1}</Kbd></span>}
                    {isKept && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-small font-medium text-fg"><CheckIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden />Kept</span>}
                    <span className="text-small text-fg-muted tabular-nums">
                      {isPlaying ? <>{formatMediaTime(showPos)} / </> : null}{formatMediaTime(dur)}
                      {t.status === "streaming" && <> · Still making the end</>}
                      {isPlaying && <span className="sr-only"> playing</span>}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {t.differs && t.differs.length > 0 && (
                    <p className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 text-small text-fg-muted">
                      <span className="sr-only">Different: </span>
                      {t.differs.map((d, k) => (
                        <span key={k} className="rounded-control border border-line bg-sunken px-1.5 text-micro leading-5 text-fg-muted">{d}{k < t.differs!.length - 1 && <span className="sr-only">,</span>}</span>
                      ))}
                    </p>
                  )}
                  <Waveform peaks={t.peaks ?? []} simple={!t.peaks} duration={dur} position={showPos} onSeek={canPlay ? seek : undefined}
                    label={`Seek, ${t.label}`} height={32} regions={regions}
                    pendingFrom={t.status === "streaming" ? (t.madeUpTo ?? dur) : undefined} />
                </div>
                <Button size="sm" variant={isKept ? "primary" : "secondary"} onClick={() => toggleKeep(t)} aria-pressed={isKept}
                  aria-label={`Keep ${t.label}`} disabled={t.status !== "ready"} title={t.status !== "ready" ? "You can keep it once it has finished" : undefined}
                  leading={isKept ? <CheckIcon width={14} height={14} /> : undefined}
                  className="mt-1.5 shrink-0 pointer-coarse:h-11 pointer-coarse:min-w-11">
                  Keep
                </Button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}

      {playableCount > 1 && (
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-small text-fg-muted pointer-coarse:hidden">
          <Kbd>1</Kbd>to<Kbd>{Math.min(9, takes.length)}</Kbd>play a take while you are in the list. Switching takes keeps your place.
        </p>
      )}

      {(onMore || note) && (
        <footer className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2 border-t border-line pt-3">
          {note && <p className="min-w-40 flex-1 text-small text-fg-muted">{note}</p>}
          {onMore && (
            <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {moreCost && <span className="text-small text-fg-muted">{moreCost}</span>}
              <Button size="sm" variant="lime" onClick={onMore} busy={making} busyLabel="Still making takes"
                leading={<RegenerateIcon width={14} height={14} />} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">{moreLabel}</Button>
            </span>
          )}
        </footer>
      )}

      {/* Status changes only: never the clock, never each take on its own. */}
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{summary}</span>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/TaskTree.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { ChevronIcon, XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { AgentStatusIcon, type AgentStatus } from "../atoms/AgentStatusIcon";
import { Button, IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";

export type TaskStatus = "running" | "done" | "failed" | "stopped" | "partial";

export interface TaskNode {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: TaskStatus;
  children?: TaskNode[];
}

export interface TaskTreeLabels {
  status?: Partial<Record<TaskStatus, string>>;
  open?: string;
  dismiss?: string;
  expand?: string;
  collapse?: string;
}

export interface TaskTreeProps {
  tasks: TaskNode[];
  /** Called when the person opens a row, for example to show that subagent's transcript. */
  onOpen?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Called when a row is dismissed: the Dismiss button on a failed row, or `dismissAfterMs` on a done row. The tree hides the row at once, and the app should also remove it from its data. */
  onDismiss?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Milliseconds after which a done row is dismissed and onDismiss(id) is called. Off when undefined. Failed rows never auto-dismiss. A done parent waits until its nested rows are done too. */
  dismissAfterMs?: number;
  /** Ids that start collapsed. Everything else starts expanded. */
  defaultCollapsed?: string[];
  labels?: TaskTreeLabels;
  className?: string;
}

const statusText: Record<TaskStatus, string> = { running: "Running", done: "Done", failed: "Failed", stopped: "Stopped", partial: "Partial" };
const mapped: Record<Exclude<TaskStatus, "partial">, AgentStatus> = { running: "working", done: "completed", failed: "failed", stopped: "stopped" };

const countDescendants = (n: TaskNode): number => (n.children ?? []).reduce((a, c) => a + 1 + countDescendants(c), 0);

/** Half-filled circle for Partial, which the shared status icon has no shape for. */
function PartialGlyph() {
  return (
    <svg width={16} height={16} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden className="shrink-0 text-fg-muted">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" /><path d="M12 3a9 9 0 0 1 0 18z" fill="currentColor" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/**
 * Nested subagent or task rows. Each row shows a name, a status written out beside an icon shape,
 * a (+N) count of nested tasks, and an Open action. Parents expand and collapse. Failed rows stay
 * until the person dismisses them. With dismissAfterMs, done rows are dismissed after that delay.
 * The app owns the data and removes the row in onDismiss.
 */
export function TaskTree({ tasks, onOpen, onDismiss, dismissAfterMs, defaultCollapsed = [], labels, className }: TaskTreeProps) {
  const l = { open: "Open", dismiss: "Dismiss", expand: "Expand", collapse: "Collapse", ...labels };
  const names = { ...statusText, ...labels?.status };
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(defaultCollapsed));
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [announce, setAnnounce] = useState("");

  const timers = useRef(new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>());
  const latest = useRef({ onDismiss });
  latest.current = { onDismiss };

  const toggle = (id: string) => setCollapsed((c) => { const n = new Set(c); if (n.has(id)) n.delete(id); else n.add(id); return n; });
  const dismiss = (n: TaskNode) => { setDismissed((d) => new Set(d).add(n.id)); onDismiss?.(n.id); setAnnounce(`Dismissed ${n.name}`); };

  // Schedule one timer per finished row. A timer is kept while its row stays done, so re-renders do not restart it.
  useEffect(() => {
    const live = timers.current;
    const due = new Map<string, TaskNode>();
    const walk = (nodes: TaskNode[]): boolean => {
      let allDone = true;
      for (const n of nodes) {
        if (dismissed.has(n.id)) continue;
        const kidsDone = walk(n.children ?? []);
        if (n.status === "done" && kidsDone) due.set(n.id, n); else allDone = false;
      }
      return allDone;
    };
    if (dismissAfterMs !== undefined) walk(tasks);
    for (const [id, t] of live) if (!due.has(id)) { clearTimeout(t); live.delete(id); }
    for (const [id, n] of due) {
      if (live.has(id)) continue;
      live.set(id, setTimeout(() => {
        live.delete(id);
        setDismissed((d) => new Set(d).add(id));
        latest.current.onDismiss?.(id);
        setAnnounce(`Dismissed ${n.name}`);
      }, dismissAfterMs));
    }
  }, [tasks, dismissAfterMs, dismissed]);
  useEffect(() => () => { for (const t of timers.current.values()) clearTimeout(t); timers.current.clear(); }, []);

  const renderList = (nodes: TaskNode[], depth: number) => (
    <ul className="space-y-0.5">
      {nodes.filter((n) => !dismissed.has(n.id)).map((n) => {
        const kids = (n.children ?? []).filter((c) => !dismissed.has(c.id));
        const total = countDescendants({ ...n, children: kids });
        const isOpen = !collapsed.has(n.id);
        return (
          <li key={n.id}>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 rounded-card py-1 pr-2 hover:bg-hover sm:rounded-control" style={{ paddingLeft: `calc(var(--spacing) * ${depth * 5 + 1})` }}>
              {kids.length ? (
                <IconButton size="sm" label={`${isOpen ? l.collapse : l.expand} ${n.name}`} aria-expanded={isOpen} onClick={() => toggle(n.id)}>
                  <ChevronIcon width={12} height={12} className={cn("transition-transform", isOpen && "rotate-90")} />
                </IconButton>
              ) : <span aria-hidden className="size-7 shrink-0" />}
              {n.status === "partial" ? <PartialGlyph /> : <AgentStatusIcon status={mapped[n.status]} label={names[n.status]} />}
              <span className="min-w-28 flex-1 truncate text-compact font-medium">{n.name}</span>
              {total > 0 && <span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle tabular-nums"><span className="sr-only">{total} nested tasks </span><span aria-hidden>(+{total})</span></span>}
              <span className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2"><span className="text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{names[n.status]}</span>
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => onOpen?.(n.id)} aria-label={`${l.open} ${n.name}`}>{l.open}</Button>
              {n.status === "failed" && <IconButton size="sm" label={`${l.dismiss} ${n.name}`} onClick={() => dismiss(n)}><XIcon width={12} height={12} /></IconButton>}</span>
            </div>
            {kids.length > 0 && isOpen && renderList(kids, depth + 1)}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );

  return (
    <div className={cn("rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-2", className)}>
      <div role="group" aria-label="Tasks">{renderList(tasks, 0)}</div>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{announce}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/ToolMenu.tsx

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { CheckIcon, PlusIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { IconButton } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Popover } from "../atoms/Popover";

export interface ToolMenuAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: ReactNode;
  description?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface ToolMenuTool extends ToolMenuAction {
  /** Whether the tool is switched on. Owned by the parent. */
  checked: boolean;
}

export interface ToolMenuConnector extends ToolMenuAction {
  /** Status text shown at the end of the row, for example "Connected". */
  status?: string;
}

export interface ToolMenuProps {
  /** Attach actions such as "Upload file". Selecting one closes the menu. */
  attach?: ToolMenuAction[];
  /** Tools with a checked state. Toggling keeps the menu open. */
  tools?: ToolMenuTool[];
  /** Connected sources. Selecting one closes the menu. */
  connectors?: ToolMenuConnector[];
  onAttach?: (id: string) => void;
  onToggle?: (id: string, checked: boolean) => void;
  onConnector?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Section headings. */
  labels?: { attach?: string; tools?: string; connectors?: string };
  /** Name of the trigger button and the menu. */
  label?: string;
  align?: "start" | "end";
  side?: "bottom" | "top";
}

function Row({ icon, label, description, trailing, disabled, role, checked, onSelect }: ToolMenuAction & { trailing?: ReactNode; role: "menuitem" | "menuitemcheckbox"; checked?: boolean; onSelect: () => void }) {
  return (
    <button type="button" role={role} aria-checked={role === "menuitemcheckbox" ? !!checked : undefined} disabled={disabled} tabIndex={-1} onClick={onSelect}
      className={cn("flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-hover focus-visible:bg-hover disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:text-disabled-fg")}>
      {icon && <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center text-fg-muted">{icon}</span>}
      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span className="block truncate text-compact font-medium text-fg">{label}</span>
        {description && <span className="block truncate text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">{description}</span>}
      </span>
      {trailing}
      {role === "menuitemcheckbox" && <span className="flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-fg">{checked && <CheckIcon width={16} height={16} />}</span>}
    </button>
  );
}

function Group({ title, children }: { title?: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={title} className="py-1 not-first:border-t not-first:border-line">
      {title && <div aria-hidden className="px-3 pt-1 pb-1 text-nano uppercase tracking-caps text-fg-muted">{title}</div>}
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

/** The composer plus menu. Sections for attaching, tools with a checked state, and connectors. Focus, arrow keys, Home, End, Escape and Tab come from Popover with role menu. */
export function ToolMenu({ attach = [], tools = [], connectors = [], onAttach, onToggle, onConnector, labels, label = "Add to message", align = "start", side = "top" }: ToolMenuProps) {
  return (
    <Popover role="menu" label={label} align={align} side={side} panelClassName="w-72 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]"
      trigger={({ toggle, triggerProps }) => (
        <IconButton label={label} variant="secondary" onClick={toggle} {...triggerProps}><PlusIcon /></IconButton>
      )}>
      {({ close }) => (
        <div>
          {attach.length > 0 && (
            <Group title={labels?.attach ?? "Attach"}>
              {attach.map((a) => <Row key={a.id} role="menuitem" {...a} onSelect={() => { onAttach?.(a.id); close(); }} />)}
            </Group>
          )}
          {tools.length > 0 && (
            <Group title={labels?.tools ?? "Tools"}>
              {tools.map((t) => <Row key={t.id} role="menuitemcheckbox" {...t} onSelect={() => onToggle?.(t.id, !t.checked)} />)}
            </Group>
          )}
          {connectors.length > 0 && (
            <Group title={labels?.connectors ?? "Connectors"}>
              {connectors.map((c) => (
                <Row key={c.id} role="menuitem" {...c} onSelect={() => { onConnector?.(c.id); close(); }}
                  trailing={c.status ? <span className="shrink-0 text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{c.status}</span> : undefined} />
              ))}
            </Group>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </Popover>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/TranscriptAudioEditor.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent, PointerEvent } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, RetryIcon, UndoIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Kbd } from "../atoms/Kbd";
import { TextField } from "../atoms/TextField";
import { Waveform, formatMediaTime, speakMediaTime } from "../atoms/Waveform";
import type { WaveformRegion } from "../atoms/Waveform";
import { AILabel } from "../molecules/AILabel";
import { AudioPlayer } from "../molecules/AudioPlayer";
import type { AudioPlayerProps } from "../molecules/AudioPlayer";

/**
 * original: untouched. removed: cut, skipped when playing. regenerating: new audio is being made. regenerated: new audio
 * is ready and waits for Keep or Revert. kept: new audio accepted. reverted: back to the recording. failed: new audio could not be made.
 */
export type TranscriptSpanState = "original" | "removed" | "regenerating" | "regenerated" | "kept" | "reverted" | "failed";

export interface TranscriptWord {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  /** Start and end in seconds from the start of the recording. */
  start: number;
  end: number;
  /** Key into `speakers`. */
  speaker?: string;
  /** A filler word such as "um" or "you know". Marked with a dotted underline and offered for removal in one go. */
  filler?: boolean;
}

export interface TranscriptEditSpan {
  id: string;
  /** The words this edit covers, in order. */
  wordIds: string[];
  state: TranscriptSpanState;
  /** The new words, for a span whose words were changed. Shown in place of the old ones. */
  newText?: string;
  /** Why making new audio failed, in plain words. */
  error?: string;
}

export interface TranscriptAudioEditorProps {
  words: TranscriptWord[];
  /** Edits so far. Words in no span are original. */
  spans?: TranscriptEditSpan[];
  /** Who is who. Each run of words by one speaker becomes a paragraph headed by the name. */
  speakers?: Record<string, { label: string }>;
  /** Wires in a docked player. The part then keeps the time itself and skips removed words while playing. */
  audio?: Omit<AudioPlayerProps, "current" | "onTimeChange" | "compact" | "regions" | "markers" | "madeUpTo">;
  /** Loudness per slice, each 0 to 1, when you keep your own player. With `audio` its peaks are used. */
  peaks?: number[] | null;
  /** Length in seconds. Defaults to the audio's duration, or the end of the last word. */
  duration?: number;
  /** Playback position in seconds, when your own player keeps it. */
  position?: number;
  /** Called when the person moves the playhead: a word click, the waveform or Play on a new phrase. */
  onSeek?: (seconds: number) => void;
  /** Called with the words to cut. Make a `removed` span for them. */
  onRemove?: (wordIds: string[]) => void;
  /** Called with the words to replace and the new text (leave the text out to remake the same words). Make a `regenerating` span. */
  onRegenerate?: (wordIds: string[], newText?: string) => void;
  /** Shows Smooth edit: remake the audio around a cut so it does not jump. */
  onSmooth?: (wordIds: string[]) => void;
  onKeep?: (spanId: string) => void;
  onRetry?: (spanId: string) => void;
  /** Back to the recording. Also restores removed words. */
  onRevert?: (spanId: string) => void;
  /** Undoes the last edit. Also on Ctrl+Z or Cmd+Z in the editor. */
  onUndo?: () => void;
  /** What Undo will undo, such as "Undo: removed 2 words". */
  undoLabel?: string;
  /** False when there is no consented voice to make new audio with. Change words then says why. */
  voiceAvailable?: boolean;
  /** Whose voice new audio uses, such as "Maya Okafor, consent on file". */
  voiceName?: string;
  /** Why the voice is not available, shown in one line. */
  voiceUnavailableReason?: string;
  /** Limits of the voice model, said before the person types. */
  limits?: { maxChars?: number; languages?: string[] };
  /** Name of the transcript. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

interface Token {
  key: string;
  wordIds: string[];
  text: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  speaker?: string;
  span?: TranscriptEditSpan;
  removed: boolean;
  filler: boolean;
}

const REPLACED: TranscriptSpanState[] = ["regenerating", "regenerated", "kept", "failed"];
const PENDING: TranscriptSpanState[] = ["regenerating", "regenerated", "failed"];
const isTyping = (el: EventTarget | null) => el instanceof HTMLElement && (el.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(el.tagName));
const plural = (n: number, w: string) => `${n} ${w}${n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;

/** Words and edits flattened into what is shown: one token per word, or one per changed phrase. */
function buildTokens(words: TranscriptWord[], spans: TranscriptEditSpan[]): Token[] {
  const spanOf = new Map<string, TranscriptEditSpan>();
  for (const s of spans) if (s.state !== "original" && s.state !== "reverted") for (const w of s.wordIds) spanOf.set(w, s);
  const out: Token[] = [];
  const done = new Set<string>();
  for (const w of words) {
    const s = spanOf.get(w.id);
    if (s && REPLACED.includes(s.state)) {
      if (done.has(s.id)) continue;
      done.add(s.id);
      const ws = words.filter((x) => s.wordIds.includes(x.id));
      out.push({ key: w.id, wordIds: ws.map((x) => x.id), text: s.newText ?? ws.map((x) => x.text).join(" "), start: ws[0].start, end: ws[ws.length - 1].end, speaker: w.speaker, span: s, removed: false, filler: false });
    } else {
      out.push({ key: w.id, wordIds: [w.id], text: w.text, start: w.start, end: w.end, speaker: w.speaker, span: s, removed: s?.state === "removed", filler: !!w.filler });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Stretches of time that playback skips: from a removed word to the next word that stays. */
function removedRuns(tokens: Token[], dur: number): { start: number; end: number }[] {
  const runs: { start: number; end: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
    if (!tokens[i].removed) continue;
    let j = i;
    while (j < tokens.length && tokens[j].removed) j++;
    runs.push({ start: tokens[i].start, end: tokens[j]?.start ?? dur });
    i = j;
  }
  return runs;
}

/**
 * Edit speech by editing its words. Each word is tied to a time; removing words cuts the audio, and changing words makes
 * new audio for that phrase with a consented voice. The waveform shows the same cuts and new phrases. New audio is marked
 * as AI and waits for Keep or Revert. The words are a selectable list with one tab stop; Delete removes, D changes words,
 * Enter keeps, Ctrl+Z undoes. Words are never announced as they play.
 */
export function TranscriptAudioEditor({
  words, spans = [], speakers, audio, peaks, duration, position, onSeek, onRemove, onRegenerate, onSmooth, onKeep, onRetry, onRevert,
  onUndo, undoLabel = "Undo", voiceAvailable = true, voiceName, voiceUnavailableReason, limits, label = "Transcript", className,
}: TranscriptAudioEditorProps) {
  const uid = useId();
  const hintId = `${uid}-hint`;
  const tokens = useMemo(() => buildTokens(words, spans), [words, spans]);
  const tokenOfWord = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, number>();
    tokens.forEach((t, i) => t.wordIds.forEach((w) => m.set(w, i)));
    return m;
  }, [tokens]);
  const dur = audio?.duration ?? duration ?? (words.length ? words[words.length - 1].end : 0);
  const runs = useMemo(() => removedRuns(tokens, dur), [tokens, dur]);

  // Cursor and selection are kept as word ids, so they survive words merging into a changed phrase.
  const [cursorId, setCursorId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<{ anchor: string; focus: string } | null>(null);
  const [changing, setChanging] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  const [ownTime, setOwnTime] = useState(0);
  const [seekTo, setSeekTo] = useState<number | undefined>(undefined);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [, setFocusTick] = useState(0);
  const optionRefs = useRef<Map<string, HTMLSpanElement>>(new Map());
  const playerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const dragging = useRef(false);

  const time = audio ? ownTime : position ?? 0;
  const idx = (id: string | null) => (id ? tokenOfWord.get(id) ?? -1 : -1);
  const cursor = Math.max(0, idx(cursorId));
  const range = sel ? [Math.min(idx(sel.anchor), idx(sel.focus)), Math.max(idx(sel.anchor), idx(sel.focus))] as const : null;
  const picked = range && range[0] >= 0 ? tokens.slice(range[0], range[1] + 1) : [];
  const current = playing || time > 0 ? tokens.findIndex((t) => !t.removed && time >= t.start && time < t.end) : -1;

  // Announce edits finishing or failing. Status changes only, never the word being played.
  const prev = useRef(new Map<string, TranscriptSpanState>());
  useEffect(() => {
    for (const s of spans) {
      const was = prev.current.get(s.id);
      if (was === "regenerating" && s.state === "regenerated") setSaid("New audio ready. Play it, then keep or revert.");
      if (was === "regenerating" && s.state === "failed") setSaid(`Could not make new audio.${s.error ? ` ${s.error}` : ""}`);
    }
    prev.current = new Map(spans.map((s) => [s.id, s.state]));
  }, [spans]);

  const focusToken = (i: number) => {
    const t = tokens[Math.max(0, Math.min(tokens.length - 1, i))];
    if (!t) return;
    setCursorId(t.key);
    optionRefs.current.get(t.key)?.focus();
  };
  // After an edit the cursor's word may have merged into a phrase; put focus back on whatever holds it now.
  const wantFocus = useRef(false);
  const refocus = () => { wantFocus.current = true; setFocusTick((n) => n + 1); };
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!wantFocus.current) return;
    wantFocus.current = false;
    const t = tokens[Math.max(0, idx(cursorId))];
    if (t) optionRefs.current.get(t.key)?.focus();
  });

  const seek = (t: number) => {
    if (audio) { setSeekTo(t); setOwnTime(t); }
    onSeek?.(t);
  };

  // Playback skips removed words.
  const onPlayerTime = (t: number) => {
    const run = runs.find((r) => t >= r.start && t < r.end);
    if (run && playing) { setSeekTo(run.end); setOwnTime(run.end); return; }
    setOwnTime(t);
    setSeekTo(undefined);
  };

  const playFrom = (t: number) => {
    seek(t);
    if (!audio) return;
    // The docked player owns playback; press its own Play button once the seek has landed.
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      const btn = playerRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('button[aria-pressed="false"]');
      btn?.click();
    }, 60);
  };

  /* ---------- what the selection allows ---------- */
  const pickedIds = picked.flatMap((t) => t.wordIds);
  const pickedText = picked.map((t) => t.text).join(" ");
  const allRemoved = picked.length > 0 && picked.every((t) => t.removed);
  const someRemoved = picked.some((t) => t.removed);
  const pending = picked.some((t) => t.span && PENDING.includes(t.span.state));
  const speakersIn = new Set(picked.map((t) => t.speaker));
  const maxChars = limits?.maxChars;
  const changeBlocked =
    !voiceAvailable ? voiceUnavailableReason ?? "No voice to use. The speaker has not agreed to their voice being used."
    : pending ? "Keep or revert the new audio first."
    : allRemoved ? "These words are removed. Restore them first."
    : someRemoved ? "The selection crosses a cut. Select words on one side of it."
    : speakersIn.size > 1 ? "Select words from one speaker."
    : maxChars !== undefined && pickedText.length > maxChars ? `Too long: ${pickedText.length} of ${maxChars} characters. Select fewer words.`
    : null;
  const limitText = [maxChars !== undefined ? `Up to ${maxChars} characters` : "", limits?.languages?.length ? `${limits.languages.join(" or ")} only` : ""].filter(Boolean).join(". ");

  const fillers = tokens.filter((t) => t.filler && !t.removed && !t.span);

  const remove = () => {
    if (!onRemove || !picked.length) return;
    if (allRemoved) { restore(); return; }
    const ids = picked.filter((t) => !t.removed && t.span?.state !== "regenerating").flatMap((t) => t.wordIds);
    if (!ids.length) return;
    onRemove(ids);
    setSaid(`Removed ${plural(ids.length, "word")}. Playback will skip ${ids.length === 1 ? "it" : "them"}.`);
    setSel(null);
    refocus();
  };
  const restore = () => {
    const ids = new Set(picked.filter((t) => t.removed && t.span).map((t) => t.span!.id));
    ids.forEach((id) => onRevert?.(id));
    setSaid(`Restored ${plural(picked.filter((t) => t.removed).length, "word")}.`);
    setSel(null);
    refocus();
  };
  const openChange = () => {
    if (!onRegenerate || !picked.length || changeBlocked) return;
    setDraft(pickedText);
    setChanging(true);
    window.requestAnimationFrame(() => { inputRef.current?.focus(); inputRef.current?.select(); });
  };
  const closeChange = () => { setChanging(false); refocus(); };
  const submitChange = () => {
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (!text || !onRegenerate || (maxChars !== undefined && text.length > maxChars)) return;
    onRegenerate(pickedIds, text === pickedText ? undefined : text);
    setSaid("Making new audio.");
    setChanging(false);
    setSel(null);
    refocus();
  };
  const keep = (s: TranscriptEditSpan) => { onKeep?.(s.id); setSaid("Kept the new audio."); };
  const revert = (s: TranscriptEditSpan) => { onRevert?.(s.id); setSaid("Back to the original audio."); };
  const retry = (s: TranscriptEditSpan) => { onRetry?.(s.id); setSaid("Making new audio."); };

  /* ---------- keyboard and pointer ---------- */
  const paraStarts = useMemo(() => tokens.map((t, i) => i === 0 || tokens[i - 1].speaker !== t.speaker), [tokens]);
  const move = (to: number, extend: boolean) => {
    const t = tokens[Math.max(0, Math.min(tokens.length - 1, to))];
    if (!t) return;
    if (extend) setSel({ anchor: sel?.anchor ?? tokens[cursor].key, focus: t.key });
    focusToken(to);
  };

  const onListKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (isTyping(e.target) || e.altKey) return;
    const mod = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
    const k = e.key;
    const i = cursor;
    if (mod && (k === "z" || k === "Z") && !e.shiftKey) { if (onUndo) { e.preventDefault(); onUndo(); setSaid(`${undoLabel}. Done.`); } return; }
    if (mod && (k === "a" || k === "A")) { e.preventDefault(); setSel({ anchor: tokens[0].key, focus: tokens[tokens.length - 1].key }); return; }
    if (mod && k !== "Home" && k !== "End") return;
    let to: number | null = null;
    if (k === "ArrowRight") to = i + 1;
    else if (k === "ArrowLeft") to = i - 1;
    else if (k === "ArrowDown") { to = paraStarts.findIndex((p, j) => p && j > i); if (to < 0) to = tokens.length - 1; }
    else if (k === "ArrowUp") { let j = i; while (j > 0 && !paraStarts[j]) j--; to = j === i ? Math.max(0, paraStarts.lastIndexOf(true, i - 1)) : j; }
    else if (k === "Home") { let j = i; while (!mod && j > 0 && !paraStarts[j]) j--; to = mod ? 0 : j; }
    else if (k === "End") { let j = i; while (!mod && j < tokens.length - 1 && !paraStarts[j + 1]) j++; to = mod ? tokens.length - 1 : j; }
    if (to !== null) { e.preventDefault(); if (!e.shiftKey) setSel(null); move(to, e.shiftKey); return; }
    if (k === " ") { e.preventDefault(); const t = tokens[i]; setSel(sel && picked.length === 1 && picked[0] === t ? null : { anchor: t.key, focus: t.key }); return; }
    if (k === "Escape") { if (sel) { e.preventDefault(); setSel(null); } return; }
    if ((k === "Delete" || k === "Backspace") && picked.length && onRemove) { e.preventDefault(); remove(); return; }
    if ((k === "d" || k === "D") && !e.shiftKey && picked.length) { e.preventDefault(); openChange(); return; }
    if (k === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const t = tokens[i];
      if (t.span?.state === "regenerated" && onKeep) keep(t.span);
      else seek(t.start);
    }
  };

  const onRootKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (isTyping(e.target) || !(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) || e.shiftKey || (e.key !== "z" && e.key !== "Z") || !onUndo) return;
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).getAttribute("role") === "option") return; // handled by the list
    e.preventDefault();
    onUndo();
    setSaid(`${undoLabel}. Done.`);
  };

  const down = (ev: PointerEvent<HTMLSpanElement>, i: number) => {
    if (ev.pointerType === "mouse" && ev.button !== 0) return;
    const t = tokens[i];
    if (ev.shiftKey) { setSel({ anchor: sel?.anchor ?? tokens[cursor].key, focus: t.key }); setCursorId(t.key); return; }
    setCursorId(t.key);
    setSel({ anchor: t.key, focus: t.key });
    if (ev.pointerType === "mouse") dragging.current = true;
    seek(t.start);
  };
  const enter = (i: number) => {
    if (!dragging.current) return;
    setSel((s) => s && { anchor: s.anchor, focus: tokens[i].key });
    setCursorId(tokens[i].key);
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    const up = () => { dragging.current = false; };
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("pointerup", up);
  }, []);

  // A selection that no longer exists (its words merged or were undone) is dropped.
  useEffect(() => { if (sel && (idx(sel.anchor) < 0 || idx(sel.focus) < 0)) setSel(null); });

  /* ---------- summary ---------- */
  const cuts = runs.length;
  const changed = spans.filter((s) => REPLACED.includes(s.state)).length;
  const removedSeconds = runs.reduce((a, r) => a + (r.end - r.start), 0);
  const summary = cuts || changed
    ? `Edited: ${[cuts && plural(cuts, "cut"), changed && plural(changed, "changed phrase")].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}. Length ${formatMediaTime(dur - removedSeconds)}, was ${formatMediaTime(dur)}.`
    : "No edits yet.";

  /* ---------- waveform ---------- */
  const regions: WaveformRegion[] = [
    ...runs.map((r) => ({ start: r.start, end: r.end, kind: "highlight" as const, label: "Removed, skipped when playing" })),
    ...tokens.filter((t) => t.span && REPLACED.includes(t.span.state) && t.span.state !== "failed")
      .map((t) => ({ start: t.start, end: t.end, kind: "ai" as const, label: t.span!.state === "regenerating" ? "Making new audio" : "New audio by AI" })),
    ...(picked.length ? [{ start: picked[0].start, end: picked[picked.length - 1].end, kind: "selected" as const }] : []),
  ];
  const shownPeaks = audio ? audio.peaks : peaks;
  const pct = (s: number) => `${dur ? (Math.min(Math.max(s, 0), dur) / dur) * 100 : 0}%`;

  /* ---------- paragraphs ---------- */
  const paras: { start: number; speaker?: string; items: number[] }[] = [];
  tokens.forEach((t, i) => {
    if (paraStarts[i]) paras.push({ start: t.start, speaker: t.speaker, items: [] });
    paras[paras.length - 1].items.push(i);
  });

  const renderToken = (i: number) => {
    const t = tokens[i];
    const s = t.span?.state;
    const selected = !!range && i >= range[0] && i <= range[1];
    const prevT = tokens[i - 1];
    const editPoint = !!prevT && !paraStarts[i] && (prevT.removed !== t.removed || (prevT.span !== t.span && (REPLACED.includes(s as TranscriptSpanState) || REPLACED.includes(prevT.span?.state as TranscriptSpanState))));
    return (
      <span key={t.key}>
        {i > 0 && !paraStarts[i] && " "}
        {editPoint && <span aria-hidden className="mx-0.5 inline-block h-4 border-l border-dashed border-fg-subtle align-middle" />}
        <span
          ref={(el) => { if (el) optionRefs.current.set(t.key, el); else optionRefs.current.delete(t.key); }}
          id={`${uid}-${t.key}`} role="option" aria-selected={selected} tabIndex={i === cursor ? 0 : -1}
          onPointerDown={(ev) => down(ev, i)} onPointerEnter={() => enter(i)} onFocus={() => setCursorId(t.key)}
          className={cn("cursor-text rounded-sm py-0.5 select-none box-decoration-clone underline-offset-4",
            i === current && !selected && "bg-hover",
            selected && "bg-fg text-bg",
            t.removed && "text-fg-subtle line-through decoration-fg-muted",
            selected && t.removed && "text-inverse-muted decoration-inverse-fg",
            t.filler && !t.removed && "underline decoration-fg-muted decoration-dotted",
            (s === "regenerated" || s === "kept") && "underline decoration-lime",
            s === "regenerated" ? "decoration-4" : s === "kept" ? "decoration-2" : "",
            s === "regenerating" && "bg-[linear-gradient(90deg,var(--lime)_25%,var(--border)_50%,var(--lime)_75%)] bg-[length:200%_var(--spacing)] bg-bottom bg-repeat-x motion-safe:animate-shimmer",
            s === "failed" && "underline decoration-danger decoration-dashed decoration-2",
          )}>
          {t.text}
          <span className="sr-only">
            {t.removed ? ", removed" : ""}{t.filler && !t.removed ? ", filler word" : ""}
            {s === "regenerating" ? ", making new audio" : s === "regenerated" ? ", new audio by AI, not kept yet" : s === "kept" ? ", new audio by AI" : s === "failed" ? ", new audio failed" : ""}
          </span>
        </span>
      </span>
    );
  };

  const spanBar = (t: Token) => {
    const s = t.span!;
    const quote = t.text.length > 48 ? `${t.text.slice(0, 46)}…` : t.text;
    return (
      <div key={s.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1.5 rounded-field border border-line bg-sunken px-2.5 py-2 text-small">
        {s.state === "regenerating" && <span className="min-w-48 flex-1 text-fg-muted">Making new audio for “{quote}”</span>}
        {s.state === "regenerated" && (
          <span className="flex min-w-48 flex-1 items-center gap-1.5 text-fg">
            <AILabel level="field" size={16} text="AI" popoverLabel="About this new audio"
              overview={`These words were spoken by an AI voice${voiceName ? ` (${voiceName})` : ""}. The rest is the original recording.`} />
            <span className="min-w-0">New audio for “{quote}”. Keep it or revert.</span>
          </span>
        )}
        {s.state === "failed" && (
          <span className="flex min-w-48 flex-1 items-center gap-1.5 text-fg">
            <AlertIcon width={14} height={14} aria-hidden className="shrink-0 text-danger-fg" />
            <span className="min-w-0">Could not make new audio for “{quote}”.{s.error && <span className="text-fg-muted"> {s.error}</span>}</span>
          </span>
        )}
        {s.state === "regenerated" && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => playFrom(t.start)} aria-label={`Play new audio, ${quote}`} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Play</Button>}
        {(s.state === "regenerated" || s.state === "failed") && onRetry && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => retry(s)} leading={<RetryIcon width={14} height={14} />} aria-label={`Retry, ${quote}`} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Retry</Button>
        )}
        {s.state === "regenerated" && onKeep && <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => keep(s)} aria-label={`Keep new audio, ${quote}`} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Keep</Button>}
        {(s.state === "regenerated" || s.state === "failed") && onRevert && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => revert(s)} aria-label={`Revert to the original, ${quote}`} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Revert</Button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div onKeyDown={onRootKey} className={cn("flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3 sm:p-4", className)}>
      {audio && (
        <div ref={playerRef}>
          <AudioPlayer {...audio} compact current={seekTo} onTimeChange={onPlayerTime} onPlayingChange={setPlaying} />
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="relative">
        <Waveform peaks={shownPeaks === undefined ? [] : shownPeaks} simple={shownPeaks === undefined} duration={dur} position={time}
          onSeek={audio || onSeek ? seek : undefined} label={`Seek, ${audio?.title ?? label}`} regions={regions} height={48} />
        {/* Cuts are hatched over the drawing, and every edit point gets a dashed line, so the waveform matches the words. */}
        <div aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-12">
          {runs.map((r, i) => (
            <span key={i} className="absolute inset-y-0 border-x border-dashed border-fg-subtle bg-glass"
              style={{ left: pct(r.start), width: `calc(${pct(r.end)} - ${pct(r.start)})`, backgroundImage: "repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--fg-subtle) 45%, transparent) 0 calc(var(--spacing) * 0.25), transparent 0 calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5))" }} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2">
        <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-small text-fg-muted">{summary}</p>
        {onRemove && fillers.length > 0 && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => { const ids = fillers.flatMap((t) => t.wordIds); onRemove(ids); setSaid(`Removed ${plural(ids.length, "filler word")}.`); }} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">
            Remove {plural(fillers.length, "filler word")}
          </Button>
        )}
        {onUndo && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { onUndo(); setSaid(`${undoLabel}. Done.`); }} leading={<UndoIcon width={14} height={14} />} aria-label={undoLabel} title={undoLabel} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Undo</Button>
        )}
      </div>

      <p id={hintId} className="text-small text-fg-muted">
        Select words to edit them. Shift and the arrow keys select more.
        <span className="hidden sm:inline"> <Kbd>Delete</Kbd> removes, <Kbd>D</Kbd> changes words, <Kbd>Enter</Kbd> keeps new audio.</span>
      </p>

      <section aria-label={label} onKeyDown={onListKey} className="max-h-120 min-w-0 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          {paras.map((p, pi) => {
            const who = p.speaker ? speakers?.[p.speaker]?.label ?? p.speaker : undefined;
            const groupLabel = `${who ? `${who}, ` : ""}${speakMediaTime(p.start)}`;
            const bars = p.items.map((i) => tokens[i]).filter((t) => t.span && PENDING.includes(t.span.state) && t.key === t.wordIds[0] && t.wordIds.length && !t.removed);
            return (
              <div key={pi} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-small" aria-hidden>
                  {who && <span className="font-medium text-fg">{who}</span>}
                  <span className="text-fg-muted tabular-nums">{formatMediaTime(p.start)}</span>
                </p>
                <div role="listbox" aria-multiselectable aria-label={groupLabel} aria-describedby={hintId}
                  className="text-body leading-8 text-fg pointer-coarse:leading-11">
                  {p.items.map(renderToken)}
                </div>
                {bars.map(spanBar)}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Selection bar. It always holds its place, so nothing jumps when words are selected. */}
      <div className="sticky bottom-0 z-10 -mx-3 -mb-3 rounded-b-card border-t border-line bg-raised px-3 py-2.5 sm:-mx-4 sm:-mb-4 sm:px-4">
        {!picked.length ? (
          <p className="text-small text-fg-muted">Nothing selected. Tap or click a word to select it.</p>
        ) : changing ? (
          <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); submitChange(); }} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); closeChange(); } }} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <label htmlFor={`${uid}-new`} className="text-small font-medium text-fg">New words</label>
            <TextField ref={inputRef} id={`${uid}-new`} value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} aria-describedby={`${uid}-newhint`}
              invalid={maxChars !== undefined && draft.length > maxChars} autoComplete="off" />
            <p id={`${uid}-newhint`} className="text-small text-fg-muted">
              {voiceName ? `Voice: ${voiceName}. ` : ""}{limitText ? `${limitText}. ` : ""}
              {maxChars !== undefined && <span className={cn("tabular-nums", draft.length > maxChars && "text-danger-fg")}>{draft.length} of {maxChars} characters.</span>}
            </p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="lime" disabled={!draft.trim() || (maxChars !== undefined && draft.length > maxChars)} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Make new audio</Button>
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={closeChange} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Cancel</Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        ) : (
          <div role="group" aria-label="Selected words" className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <p className="text-small text-fg">
              <span className="font-medium">{plural(pickedIds.length, "word")} selected</span>
              <span className="text-fg-muted tabular-nums">, {formatMediaTime(picked[0].start)} to {formatMediaTime(picked[picked.length - 1].end)}</span>
            </p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {onRemove && (
                <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={remove} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">{allRemoved ? "Restore" : "Remove"}</Button>
              )}
              {onRegenerate && (
                <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={openChange} aria-disabled={!!changeBlocked || undefined}
                  aria-describedby={changeBlocked ? `${uid}-why` : undefined}
                  className={cn("pointer-coarse:h-11", changeBlocked && "cursor-not-allowed opacity-(--disabled-opacity)")}>Change words</Button>
              )}
              {onSmooth && someRemoved && (
                <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => { onSmooth(pickedIds); setSaid("Making new audio."); setSel(null); refocus(); }} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Smooth edit</Button>
              )}
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label="Select one word less" disabled={!range || range[0] === range[1]}
                  onClick={() => sel && range && setSel({ anchor: tokens[range[0]].key, focus: tokens[range[1] - 1].key })} className="pointer-coarse:size-11 pointer-coarse:px-0">−</Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label="Select one more word" disabled={!range || range[1] >= tokens.length - 1}
                  onClick={() => sel && range && setSel({ anchor: tokens[range[0]].key, focus: tokens[range[1] + 1].key })} className="pointer-coarse:size-11 pointer-coarse:px-0">+</Button>
              </span>
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { setSel(null); refocus(); }} className="pointer-coarse:h-11">Clear</Button>
            </div>
            {changeBlocked && onRegenerate && <p id={`${uid}-why`} className="text-small text-fg-muted">{changeBlocked}</p>}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{said}</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```
