## tattva/organisms/TranscriptSync.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AIMark } from "../atoms/AIMark";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";
import { formatMediaTime } from "../atoms/Waveform";
import { AudioPlayer } from "../molecules/AudioPlayer";
import type { AudioPlayerProps } from "../molecules/AudioPlayer";

export interface TranscriptLine {
  id: string;
  /** Key into `speakers`. */
  speaker: string;
  /** When the line starts, in seconds from the start of the recording. */
  start: number;
  /** When it ends. Defaults to the start of the next line. */
  end?: number;
  text: string;
  /** Wall-clock time, such as "14:02:10", shown beside the offset. */
  clock?: string;
  /** `interrupted`: the speaker was cut off, and only the first `spokenUpTo` characters were played. `redacted`: the text was hidden, such as a card number. */
  status?: "final" | "interrupted" | "redacted";
  /** With `interrupted`, how many characters were actually spoken. The rest is struck through and marked Not spoken. */
  spokenUpTo?: number;
}

export interface TranscriptSpeaker {
  /** Name shown on each line, such as "Maya Okafor" or "Support assistant". */
  label: string;
  /** This speaker is an AI. Its lines get the AI mark; people's lines stay neutral. */
  ai?: boolean;
}

export interface TranscriptSyncProps {
  lines: TranscriptLine[];
  /** Who is who. Every `speaker` in lines needs an entry. */
  speakers: Record<string, TranscriptSpeaker>;
  /** Wires in a player above the transcript. The part then keeps the time itself, so `current` and `onSeek` are not needed. */
  audio?: Omit<AudioPlayerProps, "current" | "onTimeChange">;
  /** Playback position in seconds, when your own player keeps it. */
  current?: number;
  /** Called with a line's start time when the line is pressed. Seek your player there. */
  onSeek?: (seconds: number) => void;
  /** Name of the transcript region. */
  label?: string;
  /** Shows placeholder lines while the transcript is being made. */
  loading?: boolean;
  /** Shown when there are no lines. */
  emptyText?: string;
  /** Classes for the scrolling list, for example to change its height. */
  listClassName?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Index of the line that holds time t, or -1 before the first line. */
function lineAt(lines: TranscriptLine[], t: number): number {
  let found = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const end = lines[i].end ?? lines[i + 1]?.start ?? Infinity;
    if (t >= lines[i].start && t < end) return i;
    if (t >= lines[i].start) found = i;
  }
  return found;
}

/**
 * A recording's transcript that keeps in step with playback. The line being played is marked, the list follows it
 * until the person scrolls away, and pressing a line plays from there. Speakers are named in words; AI speakers also carry the AI mark.
 */
export function TranscriptSync({
  lines, speakers, audio, current, onSeek, label = "Transcript", loading = false, emptyText = "There is no transcript for this recording.",
  listClassName, className,
}: TranscriptSyncProps) {
  const hintId = useId();
  const [ownTime, setOwnTime] = useState(0);
  const [seekTo, setSeekTo] = useState<number | undefined>(undefined);
  const [follow, setFollow] = useState(true);
  const list = useRef<HTMLOListElement>(null);
  const items = useRef<(HTMLLIElement | null)[]>([]);
  const ours = useRef(0);

  const time = audio ? ownTime : current ?? 0;
  const active = lineAt(lines, time);

  const seek = (t: number) => {
    setFollow(true);
    if (audio) { setSeekTo(t); setOwnTime(t); }
    onSeek?.(t);
  };

  const inView = (i: number) => {
    const box = list.current, el = items.current[i];
    if (!box || !el) return true;
    const top = el.offsetTop;
    return top >= box.scrollTop && top + el.offsetHeight <= box.scrollTop + box.clientHeight;
  };

  // Keep the current line in view, without moving the page, until the person scrolls away.
  useEffect(() => {
    const box = list.current, el = items.current[active];
    if (!follow || !box || !el || inView(active)) return;
    ours.current = Date.now();
    box.scrollTop = Math.max(0, el.offsetTop - box.clientHeight / 3);
  }, [active, follow]);

  const onScroll = () => {
    if (Date.now() - ours.current < 150) return;
    if (active >= 0 && !inView(active)) setFollow(false);
  };

  const backToCurrent = () => {
    setFollow(true);
    const box = list.current, el = items.current[active];
    if (box && el) { ours.current = Date.now(); box.scrollTop = Math.max(0, el.offsetTop - box.clientHeight / 3); }
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3", className)}>
      {audio && <AudioPlayer {...audio} current={seekTo} onTimeChange={(t) => { setOwnTime(t); setSeekTo(undefined); }} />}
      <div className="flex min-h-8 flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p id={hintId} className="text-small text-fg-muted">{loading || lines.length === 0 ? label : "Press a line to play from there."}</p>
        {!follow && active >= 0 && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={backToCurrent} className="pointer-coarse:h-11 motion-safe:animate-fade">Back to current line</Button>
        )}
      </div>
      <section aria-label={label} aria-busy={loading || undefined} className="min-w-0">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3" aria-label="Transcript loading">
            {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
              <div key={i} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 px-3">
                <Skeleton className="h-3 w-32" />
                <Skeleton className={cn("h-3", i === 1 ? "w-3/5" : "w-11/12")} />
              </div>
            ))}
            <span role="status" className="sr-only">Transcript loading</span>
          </div>
        ) : lines.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-line px-4 py-6 text-center text-compact text-fg-muted">{emptyText}</p>
        ) : (
          <ol ref={list} onScroll={onScroll} aria-describedby={hintId}
            className={cn("relative flex max-h-80 flex-col gap-0.5 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain", listClassName)}>
            {lines.map((l, i) => {
              const who = speakers[l.speaker] ?? { label: l.speaker };
              const on = i === active;
              const cut = l.status === "interrupted" && l.spokenUpTo !== undefined && l.spokenUpTo < l.text.length;
              return (
                <li key={l.id} ref={(el) => { items.current[i] = el; }}>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => seek(l.start)} aria-current={on || undefined}
                    className={cn("relative flex w-full min-h-11 cursor-pointer flex-col gap-1 rounded-control py-2 pr-3 pl-4 text-left transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast) hover:bg-hover",
                      "before:absolute before:inset-y-2 before:left-1 before:w-0.5 before:rounded-full before:transition-colors before:duration-(--dur-fast)",
                      on ? "bg-selected before:bg-fg forced-colors:outline forced-colors:outline-1" : "before:bg-transparent")}>
                    <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-small">
                      {who.ai ? (
                        <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-lime text-on-lime"><AIMark size={16} /></span>
                      ) : (
                        <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line bg-surface text-nano font-medium text-fg-muted">{who.label.charAt(0)}</span>
                      )}
                      <span className="font-medium text-fg">{who.label}{who.ai && <span className="sr-only"> (AI)</span>}</span>
                      <span className="text-fg-muted tabular-nums">
                        <span className="sr-only">at </span>{formatMediaTime(l.start)}{l.clock && <span className="text-fg-muted"> · {l.clock}</span>}
                      </span>
                      {on && <span className="rounded-control bg-fg px-1.5 text-nano leading-4 font-medium text-bg">Now</span>}
                    </span>
                    <span className={cn("text-compact leading-5", l.status === "redacted" ? "text-fg-muted italic" : "text-fg")}>
                      {cut ? (
                        <>
                          {l.text.slice(0, l.spokenUpTo)}
                          <span className="sr-only"> Not spoken: </span>
                          <s className="text-fg-subtle">{l.text.slice(l.spokenUpTo)}</s>
                          <span aria-hidden className="ml-1.5 inline-block rounded-control border border-line px-1 text-nano leading-4 text-fg-muted not-italic">Not spoken</span>
                        </>
                      ) : l.text}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/VariantGrid.tsx

```tsx
import { useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { useAnnounceChange } from "../lib/focus";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";
import { type Variant, VariantTile } from "../molecules/VariantTile";


export type { Variant };

/**
 * Generated options as a radio group. Loading slots reserve space so the layout never jumps.
 * Focus roves like a native radio group: only the selected tile (or the first when none is selected) is a tab stop,
 * arrow keys move focus and select with wrapping, and Home and End jump to the first and last tile.
 * Screen readers hear when options start generating and when new ones arrive.
 */
export function VariantGrid({ variants, selectedId, onSelect, loadingCount = 0, label = "Generated variants", loadingMessage = "Generating options", readyMessage = (n) => (n === 1 ? "1 option ready" : `${n} options ready`) }: {
  variants: Variant[]; selectedId?: string; onSelect: (id: string) => void; loadingCount?: number;
  /** Name of the group. */
  label?: string;
  /** What screen readers hear when loading slots appear. */
  loadingMessage?: string;
  /** What screen readers hear when new options arrive, with the number now shown. */
  readyMessage?: (count: number) => string;
}) {
  const said = useAnnounceChange(`${variants.length}|${loadingCount}`, (now, before) => {
    const [n, l] = now.split("|").map(Number), [n0, l0] = before.split("|").map(Number);
    if (n > n0) return readyMessage(n);
    return l > l0 ? loadingMessage : "";
  });
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const selectedIndex = variants.findIndex((v) => v.id === selectedId);
  const stop = selectedIndex >= 0 ? selectedIndex : 0;

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || !variants.length) return;
    const tiles = Array.from(ref.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="radio"]') ?? []);
    const from = tiles.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
    if (from < 0) return;
    let to = from;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") to = (from + 1) % variants.length;
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") to = (from - 1 + variants.length) % variants.length;
    else if (e.key === "Home") to = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") to = variants.length - 1;
    else return;
    e.preventDefault();
    tiles[to]?.focus();
    onSelect(variants[to].id);
  };

  return (
    <>
    <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{said}</p>
    <div ref={ref} role="radiogroup" aria-label={label} onKeyDown={onKeyDown} className="grid w-full grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
      {variants.map((v, i) => <VariantTile key={v.id} variant={v} selected={v.id === selectedId} onSelect={onSelect} tabIndex={i === stop ? 0 : -1} />)}
      {Array.from({ length: loadingCount }, (_, i) => <Skeleton key={`l${i}`} className="aspect-square" />)}
    </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/VersionHistory.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useAnnounceChange, useFocusReturn } from "../lib/focus";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { SparkleIcon, UsersIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";

export interface VersionEntry {
  id: string;
  /** Overrides the automatic name "Version N". */
  name?: string;
  /** Display time such as "2 min ago". */
  time: string;
  author: "ai" | "person";
  /** Person name, or the model name for AI. */
  authorName?: string;
  /** One line about what changed. */
  summary?: string;
}

export interface VersionHistoryProps {
  /** Newest first. Versions are numbered from the end of the list, so the oldest is Version 1. */
  versions: VersionEntry[];
  /** Id of the current version. Defaults to the first entry. */
  currentId?: string;
  /** Controlled preview. Pass null for no preview. Omit to let the component manage it. */
  previewId?: string | null;
  onPreviewChange?: (id: string | null) => void;
  onRestore: (id: string) => void;
  title?: string;
  /** Note shown under each Preview action. */
  previewNote?: string;
  /** What screen readers hear after a restore. Defaults to "Restored (version name)". */
  restoredMessage?: (name: string) => string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Auto-numbered version list with a preview mode and a restore action. */
export function VersionHistory({ versions, currentId, previewId: controlled, onPreviewChange, onRestore, title = "Version history", previewNote = "Preview does not create a new version.", restoredMessage = (name) => `Restored ${name}`, className }: VersionHistoryProps) {
  const [inner, setInner] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const previewId = controlled === undefined ? inner : controlled;
  const setPreview = (id: string | null) => { if (controlled === undefined) setInner(id); onPreviewChange?.(id); };
  const current = currentId ?? versions[0]?.id;
  const nameOf = (v: VersionEntry, i: number) => v.name ?? `Version ${versions.length - i}`;
  const previewIdx = versions.findIndex((v) => v.id === previewId);
  const previewing = previewIdx >= 0 ? versions[previewIdx] : undefined;
  // After a restore the restored row loses its buttons, so focus moves to that row and the restore is read out.
  // Leaving a preview from the bar above returns focus to that version's Preview button.
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const rows = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLLIElement>());
  const lastPreview = useRef<string | null>(null);
  if (previewId) lastPreview.current = previewId;
  const seenCurrent = useRef(current);
  useFocusReturn(`${current}|${previewId}`, root, () => {
    const row = rows.current.get(current ?? "");
    if (current !== seenCurrent.current) return row;
    return (lastPreview.current ? rows.current.get(lastPreview.current)?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("button[aria-pressed]") : null) ?? row;
  });
  useEffect(() => { seenCurrent.current = current; });
  const restored = useAnnounceChange(current, (now) => { const i = versions.findIndex((v) => v.id === now); return i >= 0 ? restoredMessage(nameOf(versions[i], i)) : ""; });

  return (
    <section ref={root} aria-label={title} className={cn("space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3", className)}>
      <h3 className="px-1 text-lead leading-6">{title}</h3>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">{restored || (previewing ? `Previewing ${nameOf(previewing, previewIdx)}` : "")}</p>
      {previewing && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-2">
          <p className="text-body leading-5">Previewing <b>{nameOf(previewing, previewIdx)}</b>. {previewNote}</p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => setPreview(null)}>Exit preview</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => onRestore(previewing.id)}>Restore</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <ol className="space-y-1">
        {versions.map((v, i) => {
          const isCurrent = v.id === current;
          const isPreview = v.id === previewId;
          const name = nameOf(v, i);
          return (
            <li key={v.id} ref={(n) => { if (n) rows.current.set(v.id, n); else rows.current.delete(v.id); }} tabIndex={-1} aria-current={isCurrent ? "true" : undefined} className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 rounded-card px-3 py-2", isPreview ? "bg-sunken" : "hover:bg-hover")}>
              <div className="min-w-48 flex-1">
                <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-body leading-5 font-medium">
                  {name}
                  {isCurrent && <Badge tone="accent">Current</Badge>}
                  {isPreview && <Badge>Previewing</Badge>}
                </p>
                <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                    {v.author === "ai" ? <SparkleIcon width={11} height={11} /> : <UsersIcon width={11} height={11} />}
                    {v.author === "ai" ? "AI" : "Person"}{v.authorName ? `, ${v.authorName}` : ""}
                  </span>
                  <span aria-hidden>·</span>
                  <span>{v.time}</span>
                </p>
                {v.summary && <p className="mt-0.5 text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{v.summary}</p>}
              </div>
              {!isCurrent && (
                <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-pressed={isPreview} aria-label={`Preview ${name}`} onClick={() => setPreview(isPreview ? null : v.id)}>Preview</Button>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" aria-label={`Restore ${name}`} onClick={() => onRestore(v.id)}>Restore</Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      <p className="px-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-subtle">{previewNote}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/VoiceConsentCheck.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { AlertIcon, ApproveIcon, CameraIcon, LockIcon, MicIcon, ShieldIcon, StopIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { headingTag, type HeadingLevel } from "../lib/useFocusAfter";
import { Badge } from "../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Checkbox } from "../atoms/Checkbox";
import { Callout } from "../molecules/Callout";

export type ConsentStep = "explain" | "micCheck" | "reading" | "checking" | "verified" | "failed" | "lockedOut";
/** What is being verified: a voice to clone, or a likeness (face and voice) for video. */
export type ConsentSubject = "voice" | "likeness";

export interface VoiceConsentCheckProps {
  step: ConsentStep;
  /** The lines the person reads out, one at a time. Make them new each attempt so a recording cannot be replayed. */
  lines: string[];
  /** Index of the line being read. */
  currentLine: number;
  /** "voice" for a voice clone. "likeness" for face and voice in video: the copy then talks about the camera too. */
  subject?: ConsentSubject;
  /** What the voice or likeness will be used for, who can use it, and how to remove it. Shown before anything is recorded. */
  consentText: ReactNode;
  /** True while the current line is being recorded. */
  recording?: boolean;
  /** Input level from 0 to 1 during the mic check and while recording. Shown as quiet, speaking or loud. */
  level?: number;
  /** Result of the mic check. Leave out while still listening. */
  noise?: "ok" | "noisy";
  /** Tries left after a failed check. */
  attemptsLeft?: number;
  /** When the person may try again, written out by your code, for example "14:20 tomorrow". */
  retryAt?: string;
  /** The person ticked the agreement and pressed Continue. Move to the mic check. */
  onAgree: () => void;
  /** Leave the mic check and start reading. Also "Continue anyway" when it is noisy. */
  onContinue?: () => void;
  /** Listen again after moving somewhere quieter. */
  onCheckAgain?: () => void;
  onStartLine: () => void;
  onStopLine: () => void;
  /** Start a new attempt after a failed check. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  /** Close after success. */
  onDone?: () => void;
  /** Link to a check by a person, for anyone who cannot read aloud. Shown on every step before the result. */
  manualReviewHref?: string;
  /** Link to support, shown when locked out. */
  supportHref?: string;
  headingLevel?: HeadingLevel;
  className?: string;
}

const words = {
  voice: {
    title: "Confirm this is your voice",
    agree: "I am the person whose voice this is, and I agree to it being cloned as described.",
    device: "mic",
    deviceCheck: "Check your mic",
    checkPrompt: "Say a few words in your normal voice so we can check your mic.",
    readHint: "Read this once, then press Stop.",
    verified: "Your voice is verified. You can now use it.",
    manual: "Cannot read aloud? Ask for a check by a person",
  },
  likeness: {
    title: "Confirm this is you",
    agree: "I am the person shown and heard, and I agree to my likeness being used as described.",
    device: "camera and mic",
    deviceCheck: "Check your camera and mic",
    checkPrompt: "Look at the camera and say a few words so we can check your camera and mic.",
    readHint: "Look at the camera, read this once, then press Stop.",
    verified: "Your likeness is verified. You can now use it.",
    manual: "Cannot read aloud or use a camera? Ask for a check by a person",
  },
} as const;

const stepNames = ["Agree", "Check", "Read lines", "Result"] as const;
const stepIndex: Record<ConsentStep, number> = { explain: 0, micCheck: 1, reading: 2, checking: 3, verified: 3, failed: 3, lockedOut: 3 };

const levelWord = (l: number) => (l < 0.2 ? "quiet" : l < 0.75 ? "speaking" : "loud");

/** Three steps of level, never a moving wave. Neutral: this is the person's own voice, not the AI. */
function LevelMeter({ level, label }: { level: number; label: string }) {
  const word = levelWord(level);
  const filled = word === "quiet" ? 1 : word === "speaking" ? 2 : 3;
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">
      <span role="meter" aria-label={label} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={3} aria-valuenow={filled} aria-valuetext={word}
        className="flex h-4 items-end gap-0.5">
        {[1, 2, 3].map((n) => (
          <span key={n} className={cn("w-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast)", n === 1 ? "h-1.5" : n === 2 ? "h-2.5" : "h-4", n <= filled ? "bg-fg" : "bg-line")} />
        ))}
      </span>
      <span>Level: {word}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Live consent check before cloning a voice or using someone's likeness. The person agrees to plain terms, checks their
 * mic, then reads prompted lines aloud one at a time, so a recording of someone else cannot pass. Every step is driven by
 * props: your code records, checks and counts attempts.
 */
export function VoiceConsentCheck({
  step, lines, currentLine, subject = "voice", consentText, recording = false, level = 0, noise, attemptsLeft, retryAt,
  onAgree, onContinue, onCheckAgain, onStartLine, onStopLine, onRetry, onCancel, onDone, manualReviewHref, supportHref,
  headingLevel = 2, className,
}: VoiceConsentCheckProps) {
  const w = words[subject];
  const H = headingTag(headingLevel);
  const headId = useId();
  const headRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const [agreed, setAgreed] = useState(false);
  const [agreeError, setAgreeError] = useState(false);
  const [leftPage, setLeftPage] = useState(false);
  const idx = stepIndex[step];
  const line = lines[currentLine] ?? "";
  const DeviceIcon = subject === "likeness" ? CameraIcon : MicIcon;

  // Move focus to the heading when the step changes, so keyboard and screen reader users start at the top of it.
  const firstRender = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (firstRender.current) { firstRender.current = false; return; }
    headRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [step]);

  // Recording stops if the page goes to the background, as on a phone when the app is left.
  const recRef = useRef(recording);
  recRef.current = recording;
  const stopRef = useRef(onStopLine);
  stopRef.current = onStopLine;
  useEffect(() => {
    const onHide = () => { if (document.hidden && recRef.current) { stopRef.current(); setLeftPage(true); } };
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onHide);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onHide);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { if (recording) setLeftPage(false); }, [recording]);

  // Space starts or stops a line from anywhere in the panel that is not itself a control or a text field.
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (step !== "reading" || e.key !== " ") return;
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (t.closest("button, a, input, textarea, select, [contenteditable='true']")) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (recording) onStopLine(); else onStartLine();
  };

  const stepTitle =
    step === "explain" ? "Before you start"
    : step === "micCheck" ? w.deviceCheck
    : step === "reading" ? `Read line ${currentLine + 1} of ${lines.length}`
    : step === "checking" ? "Checking your recordings"
    : step === "verified" ? "Verified"
    : step === "failed" ? "We could not verify it"
    : "Too many tries";

  // One polite message per change. During reading it carries the line itself, so each line is read once.
  const announce =
    step === "reading" ? (recording ? "Recording" : `Line ${currentLine + 1} of ${lines.length}: ${line}`)
    : step === "micCheck" ? (noise === "ok" ? `Your ${w.device} sounds clear` : noise === "noisy" ? "It is noisy where you are" : "Listening")
    : step === "checking" ? "Checking your recordings"
    : step === "verified" ? "Verified"
    : step === "failed" ? `Not verified.${attemptsLeft !== undefined ? ` ${attemptsLeft} ${attemptsLeft === 1 ? "try" : "tries"} left.` : ""}`
    : step === "lockedOut" ? `Too many tries.${retryAt ? ` Try again after ${retryAt}.` : ""}`
    : "";

  const manual = manualReviewHref && step !== "checking" && step !== "verified"
    ? <a href={manualReviewHref} className="tap text-compact text-fg underline underline-offset-2">{w.manual}</a> : null;

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headId} onKeyDown={onKey}
      className={cn("flex w-full min-w-0 flex-col gap-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 sm:p-6", className)}>
      <header className="space-y-2">
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted">
          <ShieldIcon width={14} height={14} className="shrink-0" />{w.title}
        </p>
        <ol aria-label="Steps" className="flex gap-1">
          {stepNames.map((n, i) => (
            <li key={n} aria-current={i === idx ? "step" : undefined} className="flex-1">
              <span className={cn("block h-1 rounded-full", i < idx ? "bg-fg" : i === idx ? "bg-fg-muted" : "bg-line")} />
              <span className="sr-only">{n}{i < idx ? ", done" : i === idx ? ", current" : ""}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
        <p className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-muted" aria-hidden>Step {idx + 1} of 4: {stepNames[idx]}</p>
        <H id={headId} ref={headRef} tabIndex={-1} className="text-subhead font-semibold text-fg outline-none">{stepTitle}</H>
      </header>

      {step === "explain" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2 rounded-card bg-sunken p-4 text-compact text-fg">{consentText}</div>
          <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">Next you will read {lines.length} short {lines.length === 1 ? "line" : "lines"} out loud. Nothing is recorded until you press Start.</p>
          <div>
            <Checkbox checked={agreed} onChange={(c) => { setAgreed(c); if (c) setAgreeError(false); }} label={w.agree}
              invalid={agreeError} aria-describedby={agreeError ? `${headId}-err` : undefined} />
            {agreeError && <p id={`${headId}-err`} className="mt-1 pl-8 text-small leading-4.5 text-danger-fg">Tick the box to continue.</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {step === "micCheck" && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-compact text-fg"><DeviceIcon className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />{w.checkPrompt}</p>
          <LevelMeter level={level} label="Input level" />
          {noise === "ok" && <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-compact text-success-fg"><ApproveIcon className="shrink-0" />Sounds clear.</p>}
          {noise === "noisy" && (
            <Callout tone="warning" title="It is noisy where you are">
              Background sound can make the check fail. Move somewhere quieter, then check again.
            </Callout>
          )}
          {!noise && <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">Listening…</p>}
        </div>
      )}

      {step === "reading" && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">{w.readHint}</p>
          <blockquote key={currentLine} className="rounded-card bg-sunken px-4 py-5 text-title-sm leading-snug font-medium text-fg motion-safe:animate-rise sm:text-title-md">
            {line}
          </blockquote>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
            {recording
              ? <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-compact font-medium text-danger-fg"><span aria-hidden className="size-2 rounded-full bg-danger" />Recording</span>
              : <span className="text-compact text-fg-muted">Not recording</span>}
            <LevelMeter level={recording ? level : 0} label="Input level" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-small leading-4.5 text-fg-subtle max-sm:hidden">Space also starts and stops.</p>
          {leftPage && <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">Recording stopped when you left this page. Read the line again.</p>}
        </div>
      )}

      {step === "checking" && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-compact text-fg-muted">
          <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="size-4 motion-safe:animate-spin"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeOpacity="0.25" strokeWidth="3" /><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 0-9-9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>
          This takes a few seconds. You can keep this open or leave it.
        </p>
      )}

      {step === "verified" && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-compact text-success-fg"><ApproveIcon className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />{w.verified}</p>
          <div className="space-y-2 rounded-card bg-sunken p-4 text-compact text-fg">{consentText}</div>
        </div>
      )}

      {step === "failed" && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><Badge tone="danger"><AlertIcon width={12} height={12} />Not verified</Badge>
            {attemptsLeft !== undefined && <span className="text-compact text-fg-muted">{attemptsLeft} {attemptsLeft === 1 ? "try" : "tries"} left</span>}</p>
          <p className="text-compact text-fg">The lines did not match well enough. Read in a quiet place, at your normal pace.</p>
          <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">Your earlier samples are kept safe. You will not need to record them again.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {step === "lockedOut" && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-compact text-fg"><LockIcon className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            {retryAt ? `You can try again after ${retryAt}.` : "You can try again later."}</p>
          <p className="text-compact text-fg-muted">This limit protects people from having their {subject === "voice" ? "voice" : "likeness"} copied. Your samples are kept safe.</p>
          {supportHref && <a href={supportHref} className="tap text-compact text-fg underline underline-offset-2">Contact support</a>}
        </div>
      )}

      {manual}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line pt-4 max-sm:[&>*]:flex-1">
        {step === "explain" && <Button onClick={() => { if (!agreed) { setAgreeError(true); return; } onAgree(); }}>Agree and continue</Button>}
        {step === "micCheck" && noise === "ok" && <Button onClick={onContinue}>Continue</Button>}
        {step === "micCheck" && noise === "noisy" && <>
          <Button onClick={onCheckAgain}>Check again</Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onContinue}>Continue anyway</Button>
        </>}
        {step === "reading" && (recording
          ? <Button variant="secondary" leading={<StopIcon width={14} height={14} />} onClick={onStopLine}>Stop</Button>
          : <Button leading={<MicIcon width={16} height={16} />} onClick={onStartLine}>{currentLine === 0 ? "Start reading" : "Start next line"}</Button>)}
        {step === "failed" && onRetry && (attemptsLeft === undefined || attemptsLeft > 0) && <Button onClick={onRetry}>Try again</Button>}
        {step === "verified" && <Button onClick={onDone}>Done</Button>}
        {step !== "verified" && <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onCancel}>{step === "lockedOut" ? "Close" : "Cancel"}</Button>}
      </div>
      <p role="status" className="sr-only">{announce}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent, type ReactNode, type SVGProps } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { XIcon } from "../lib/icons";
import { Button } from "../atoms/Button";
import { Kbd } from "../atoms/Kbd";
import { SegmentedControl } from "../atoms/SegmentedControl";
import { AIPresence, type AIPresenceState } from "../atoms/AIPresence";

/**
 * Every state a voice session can be in. The first six are the original VoicePanel states, so old code keeps working.
 * micBlocked and noMic are the only states where the person must act, so they are the only amber ones.
 */
export type VoiceState =
  | "listening" | "thinking" | "speaking" | "interrupted" | "muted" | "reconnecting"
  | "connecting" | "ready" | "userSpeaking" | "working" | "held" | "micBlocked" | "noMic" | "ended" | "error";
export type VoiceSessionState = VoiceState;
export type VoiceInputMode = "handsFree" | "pushToTalk";
export type VoiceMediaState = "on" | "off" | "stoppedBySystem";

export interface VoiceCaption {
  id: string;
  speaker: "you" | "assistant";
  text: string;
}

export interface VoicePanelProps {
  state: VoiceState;
  /** Overrides the visible text for each state. */
  stateLabels?: Partial<Record<VoiceState, string>>;
  /** Hands-free listens all the time. Push-to-talk turns the main control into Hold to talk. */
  inputMode?: VoiceInputMode;
  /** Shows a Hands-free / Push to talk switch when given. */
  onInputModeChange?: (mode: VoiceInputMode) => void;
  /** Push-to-talk: the person pressed Hold to talk (pointer down, or Space held). */
  onTalkStart?: () => void;
  /** Push-to-talk: the person let go. `cancelled` is true when they slid off the button before letting go. */
  onTalkEnd?: (cancelled: boolean) => void;
  /** Live captions. Either simple caption objects, or your own node such as LiveCaptions. */
  captions?: VoiceCaption[] | ReactNode;
  /** Speaker names used in simple captions. */
  speakerLabels?: { you: string; assistant: string };
  emptyCaptions?: string;
  muted?: boolean;
  onMutedChange?: (muted: boolean) => void;
  /** Shows Hold when given. The session pauses: nothing is heard or said until Resume. */
  onHold?: () => void;
  /** Called by Resume in the held state. */
  onResume?: () => void;
  onEnd?: () => void;
  /** Shows Interrupt while the assistant speaks, and makes Esc stop it. */
  onInterrupt?: () => void;
  /** Microphone level from 0 to 1. Moves the disc while listening and fills the neutral level bars. */
  inputLevel?: number;
  /** Assistant audio level from 0 to 1. Moves the disc while it speaks. Ignored under reduced motion. */
  outputLevel?: number;
  /** Text for the working state, for example "Checking your calendar". */
  workingLabel?: string;
  /** Mic blocked or no mic: the button that asks for the microphone again. */
  onMicRetry?: () => void;
  /** Mic blocked or no mic: the way out to typing. */
  onTypeInstead?: () => void;
  /** Camera and screen share. "stoppedBySystem" shows a notice with Turn on again. */
  media?: { camera?: VoiceMediaState; screen?: VoiceMediaState };
  /** Camera toggle shows when `onCameraChange` is given. */
  cameraOn?: boolean;
  onCameraChange?: (on: boolean) => void;
  /** Screen share toggle shows when `onScreenChange` or `onScreenShareChange` is given. */
  screenSharing?: boolean;
  onScreenChange?: (on: boolean) => void;
  /** Older name for onScreenChange. */
  onScreenShareChange?: (on: boolean) => void;
  /** Time since the session started, for example "02:14". Shown, never announced. */
  elapsed?: string;
  /** Minutes or credits used, for example a compact UsageMeter. */
  usage?: ReactNode;
  /** Who is talking and whether it is recorded, for example an AIDisclosure. */
  disclosure?: ReactNode;
  /** Extra content under the state, for example a connection hint or a retry button. */
  footer?: ReactNode;
  /** Shows the key hints (Esc, M, Space) on screens with a fine pointer. */
  showKeyHints?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}
export type VoiceSessionProps = VoicePanelProps;

const DEFAULT_LABELS: Record<VoiceState, string> = {
  connecting: "Connecting",
  ready: "Ready. Start talking.",
  listening: "Listening",
  userSpeaking: "Hearing you",
  thinking: "Thinking",
  working: "Working on it",
  speaking: "Speaking",
  interrupted: "Stopped. Go ahead.",
  muted: "Muted. The assistant cannot hear you.",
  held: "On hold. Tap Resume.",
  reconnecting: "Reconnecting",
  micBlocked: "Microphone blocked",
  noMic: "No microphone found",
  ended: "Call ended",
  error: "Something went wrong",
};

/** How each session state drives the shared orb. The disc has five looks; dimming covers the paused ones. */
const ORB: Record<VoiceState, { look: AIPresenceState; dim?: "soft" | "still" }> = {
  connecting: { look: "idle", dim: "soft" },
  ready: { look: "idle" },
  listening: { look: "listening" },
  userSpeaking: { look: "listening" },
  thinking: { look: "thinking" },
  working: { look: "thinking" },
  speaking: { look: "speaking" },
  interrupted: { look: "idle" },
  muted: { look: "idle", dim: "soft" },
  held: { look: "idle", dim: "still" },
  reconnecting: { look: "idle", dim: "soft" },
  micBlocked: { look: "idle", dim: "still" },
  noMic: { look: "idle", dim: "still" },
  ended: { look: "idle", dim: "still" },
  error: { look: "error" },
};

const icon = (p: SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>) => ({ width: 16, height: 16, viewBox: "0 0 24 24", fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeLinecap: "round" as const, strokeLinejoin: "round" as const, "aria-hidden": true, ...p });
const MicIcon = () => <svg {...icon({})}><rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="11" rx="3" /><path d="M5 11a7 7 0 0 0 14 0M12 18v3" /></svg>;
const MicOffIcon = () => <svg {...icon({})}><path d="M4 4l16 16M9 9v2a3 3 0 0 0 5 2M15 9V6a3 3 0 0 0-5.5-1.7M5 11a7 7 0 0 0 11 5.7M12 18v3" /></svg>;
const CameraIcon = () => <svg {...icon({})}><rect x="3" y="6" width="13" height="12" rx="2" /><path d="M16 10l5-3v10l-5-3" /></svg>;
const ScreenIcon = () => <svg {...icon({})}><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="12" rx="2" /><path d="M8 20h8M12 16v4" /></svg>;
const PauseIcon = () => <svg {...icon({})}><path d="M9 6v12M15 6v12" /></svg>;
const PlayIcon = () => <svg {...icon({})}><path d="M8 5.5v13l10-6.5z" /></svg>;
const StopIcon = () => <svg {...icon({})}><rect x="7" y="7" width="10" height="10" rx="1.5" /></svg>;

const isCaptionList = (c: unknown): c is VoiceCaption[] =>
  Array.isArray(c) && c.every((x) => x !== null && typeof x === "object" && "speaker" in x && "text" in x && "id" in x);

/** Three neutral bars for the person's own mic level. Never lime: lime marks the AI only. Steps, not a moving wave. */
function MicLevel({ level, off }: { level: number; off: boolean }) {
  const step = off ? 0 : level > 0.66 ? 3 : level > 0.25 ? 2 : level > 0.04 ? 1 : 0;
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex h-4 items-end gap-0.5">
      {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <span key={i} className={cn("w-1 rounded-full transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast)", i === 1 ? "h-1.5" : i === 2 ? "h-2.5" : "h-4", step >= i ? "bg-fg" : "bg-line-strong")} />
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

/** A notice where the person must act. Amber, no role of its own: the state is already announced once by the disc's status region. */
function ActNotice({ title, children, actions }: { title: string; children: ReactNode; actions?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="w-full rounded-card bg-warning-soft p-4 text-body leading-5 text-warning-fg motion-safe:animate-rise">
      <p className="font-medium">{title}</p>
      <p className="mt-0.5">{children}</p>
      {actions && <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{actions}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

/** A calm notice that needs no action. Neutral, no role. */
function InfoNotice({ children, action }: { children: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-2 text-compact text-fg motion-safe:animate-rise">
      <span>{children}</span>{action}
    </div>
  );
}

const typing = (el: EventTarget | null) => {
  const t = el as HTMLElement | null;
  return !!t && (t.tagName === "INPUT" || t.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || t.tagName === "SELECT" || t.isContentEditable);
};

/**
 * A voice conversation (VoiceSession). The disc is the shared AIPresence, the state is always written in words, and
 * captions give the conversation without audio. Mute, Hold and End are separate: End sits apart, in a danger outline.
 * The mic blocked and no mic states are the only amber ones, because there the person must act.
 */
export function VoiceSession({
  state, stateLabels, inputMode = "handsFree", onInputModeChange, onTalkStart, onTalkEnd,
  captions, speakerLabels = { you: "You", assistant: "Assistant" }, emptyCaptions = "Captions appear here as you talk.",
  muted, onMutedChange, onHold, onResume, onEnd, onInterrupt, inputLevel = 0, outputLevel = 0, workingLabel,
  onMicRetry, onTypeInstead, media, cameraOn, onCameraChange, screenSharing, onScreenChange, onScreenShareChange,
  elapsed, usage, disclosure, footer, showKeyHints = true, className,
}: VoicePanelProps) {
  const labels = { ...DEFAULT_LABELS, ...(workingLabel ? { working: workingLabel } : {}), ...stateLabels };
  const label = labels[state];
  const orb = ORB[state];
  const isMuted = muted ?? state === "muted";
  const camera: VoiceMediaState = media?.camera ?? (cameraOn ? "on" : "off");
  const screen: VoiceMediaState = media?.screen ?? (screenSharing ? "on" : "off");
  const setScreen = onScreenChange ?? onScreenShareChange;
  const ended = state === "ended";
  const held = state === "held";
  const blocked = state === "micBlocked" || state === "noMic";
  const ptt = inputMode === "pushToTalk";

  // Simple captions are a log people read on demand. A custom node (LiveCaptions) brings its own log.
  const list = captions === undefined ? [] : isCaptionList(captions) ? captions : null;
  const hasCaptions = list ? list.length > 0 : !!captions;

  // Push-to-talk: pointer or Space held. Sliding off the button before letting go cancels.
  const [talk, setTalk] = useState<"idle" | "talking" | "cancel">("idle");
  const talkRef = useRef(talk);
  const setPhase = (p: typeof talk) => { talkRef.current = p; setTalk(p); };
  const canTalk = ptt && !ended && !held && !blocked && !isMuted;
  const startTalk = () => { if (!canTalk || talkRef.current !== "idle") return; setPhase("talking"); onTalkStart?.(); };
  const endTalk = (forceCancel = false) => {
    if (talkRef.current === "idle") return;
    const cancelled = forceCancel || talkRef.current === "cancel";
    setPhase("idle");
    onTalkEnd?.(cancelled);
  };
  const onTalkMove = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (talkRef.current === "idle") return;
    const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const inside = e.clientX >= r.left && e.clientX <= r.right && e.clientY >= r.top && e.clientY <= r.bottom;
    const next = inside ? "talking" : "cancel";
    if (next !== talkRef.current) setPhase(next);
  };

  // Keys work while focus is inside the panel, never while typing, never with a modifier. End has no key.
  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (typing(e.target) || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
    if (e.key === "Escape" && state === "speaking" && onInterrupt) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const hadFocusOnInterrupt = (e.target as HTMLElement).dataset.interrupt !== undefined;
      if (hadFocusOnInterrupt) interrupt(); else onInterrupt();
      return;
    }
    if ((e.key === "m" || e.key === "M") && onMutedChange && !ended) { e.preventDefault(); onMutedChange(!isMuted); return; }
    if (e.key === " " && ptt) {
      const onButton = (e.target as HTMLElement).tagName === "BUTTON" && !(e.target as HTMLElement).dataset.talk;
      if (onButton) return; // Space presses whichever other button has focus
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!e.repeat) startTalk();
    }
  };
  const onKeyUp = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => { if (e.key === " " && ptt) endTalk(); };

  // Interrupt disappears once pressed, so hand focus to the main control instead of losing it to the page.
  const section = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const interrupt = () => {
    onInterrupt?.();
    requestAnimationFrame(() => section.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-main]")?.focus());
  };

  const talkText = talk === "talking" ? "Release to send" : talk === "cancel" ? "Release to cancel" : "Hold to talk";
  const mainSize = "h-14 px-6 text-body leading-5";
  // Every button in the control row is as tall as the main one, so the row reads as one even line. The main control
  // leads by place and width, not by height.
  const rowSize = "h-14";

  const muteButton = (main: boolean) => (
    <Button variant="secondary" data-main={main ? "" : undefined} aria-pressed={isMuted} onClick={() => onMutedChange?.(!isMuted)}
      leading={isMuted ? <MicOffIcon /> : <MicIcon />}
      trailing={!isMuted && !ptt && !blocked && !held ? <MicLevel level={inputLevel} off={state !== "listening" && state !== "userSpeaking"} /> : undefined}
      className={cn(main ? mainSize : rowSize, "aria-pressed:border-fg aria-pressed:bg-fg aria-pressed:text-bg aria-pressed:hover:bg-fg")}>
      Mute
    </Button>
  );

  return (
    <section ref={section} aria-label="Voice conversation" onKeyDown={onKeyDown} onKeyUp={onKeyUp}
      className={cn("flex w-full max-w-lg flex-col items-center gap-4 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-6 max-sm:p-4", className)}>
      {(disclosure || elapsed || usage) && (
        <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted">
          <div className="min-w-0">{disclosure}</div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {usage}
            {elapsed && <span className="font-mono tabular-nums"><span className="sr-only">Time </span>{elapsed}</span>}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className={cn("flex flex-col items-center gap-2 transition-[opacity,filter] duration-(--dur-slow) ease-(--ease-standard)",
        orb.dim === "soft" && "opacity-70", orb.dim === "still" && "opacity-45 grayscale")}>
        {/* The disc's status region is the one polite announcement for state changes. Its own label is hidden; ours cross-fades below. */}
        <AIPresence state={orb.look} size={hasCaptions ? "md" : "lg"} showLabel={false}
          level={orb.look === "speaking" ? outputLevel : orb.look === "listening" ? inputLevel : 0}
          labels={{ [orb.look]: label }} />
      </div>
      <p aria-hidden key={label} className={cn("-mt-1 text-center text-body leading-5 font-medium motion-safe:animate-fade",
        state === "error" ? "text-danger-fg" : blocked ? "text-warning-fg" : "text-fg")}>
        {label}
      </p>

      {state === "speaking" && onInterrupt && (
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" data-interrupt="" onClick={interrupt} leading={<StopIcon />}
          trailing={showKeyHints ? <Kbd className="pointer-coarse:hidden">Esc</Kbd> : undefined}>
          Interrupt
        </Button>
      )}
      {state === "micBlocked" && (
        <ActNotice title="Allow the microphone to talk"
          actions={<>
            {onMicRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onMicRetry} leading={<MicIcon />}>Allow microphone</Button>}
            {onTypeInstead && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onTypeInstead}>Type instead</Button>}
          </>}>
          Your browser is blocking it. Allow it in the address bar or in your settings, or type instead.
        </ActNotice>
      )}
      {state === "noMic" && (
        <ActNotice title="Connect a microphone to talk"
          actions={<>
            {onMicRetry && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onMicRetry}>Check again</Button>}
            {onTypeInstead && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onTypeInstead}>Type instead</Button>}
          </>}>
          We could not find one on this device. Plug in a headset, or type instead.
        </ActNotice>
      )}
      {camera === "stoppedBySystem" && !ended && (
        <InfoNotice action={onCameraChange && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => onCameraChange(true)}>Turn camera on</Button>}>
          Camera stopped when your phone locked.
        </InfoNotice>
      )}
      {screen === "stoppedBySystem" && !ended && (
        <InfoNotice action={setScreen && <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => setScreen(true)}>Share again</Button>}>
          Screen sharing stopped when your phone locked.
        </InfoNotice>
      )}
      {footer}

      {list ? (
        <div role="log" aria-live="off" aria-label={ended ? "Transcript" : "Live captions"} tabIndex={0}
          className="max-h-48 w-full space-y-2 overflow-y-auto rounded-card bg-sunken p-3 text-compact">
          {list.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-fg-muted">{emptyCaptions}</p>
          ) : list.map((c) => (
            <p key={c.id} className={c.speaker === "you" ? "text-fg-muted" : "text-fg"}>
              {c.speaker === "assistant" && <span aria-hidden className="mr-1.5 inline-block size-1.5 rounded-full bg-lime align-middle" />}
              <span className="font-medium">{speakerLabels[c.speaker]}: </span>{c.text}
            </p>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="w-full">{captions as ReactNode}</div>
      )}

      {!ended && (
        <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-3 motion-safe:animate-rise">
          {onInputModeChange && (
            <SegmentedControl size="sm" label="How you talk" value={inputMode} onChange={onInputModeChange} className="self-center"
              options={[{ value: "handsFree", label: "Hands-free" }, { value: "pushToTalk", label: "Push to talk" }]} />
          )}
          <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {ptt ? (
              <Button variant="secondary" data-talk="1" data-main="" disabled={!canTalk} aria-pressed={talk !== "idle"}
                onPointerDown={(e) => { if (e.button !== 0) return; e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); startTalk(); }}
                onPointerMove={onTalkMove} onPointerUp={() => endTalk()} onPointerCancel={() => endTalk(true)}
                onBlur={() => endTalk(true)} onContextMenu={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                className={cn(mainSize, "touch-none", talk === "talking" && "border-fg bg-fg text-bg hover:bg-fg", talk === "cancel" && "border-line-strong text-fg-muted")}
                leading={<MicIcon />}
                trailing={showKeyHints && talk === "idle" ? <Kbd className="pointer-coarse:hidden">Space</Kbd> : undefined}>
                {talkText}
              </Button>
            ) : muteButton(true)}
            {ptt && muteButton(false)}
            {held ? (
              onResume && <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onResume} leading={<PlayIcon />} className={rowSize}>Resume</Button>
            ) : (
              onHold && <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onHold} disabled={blocked} leading={<PauseIcon />} className={rowSize}>Hold</Button>
            )}
            {onCameraChange && (
              <Button variant="secondary" aria-pressed={camera === "on"} onClick={() => onCameraChange(camera !== "on")} leading={<CameraIcon />}
                className={cn(rowSize, "aria-pressed:border-fg aria-pressed:bg-fg aria-pressed:text-bg aria-pressed:hover:bg-fg")}>
                <span className="max-sm:sr-only">Camera</span>
              </Button>
            )}
            {setScreen && (
              <Button variant="secondary" aria-pressed={screen === "on"} onClick={() => setScreen(screen !== "on")} leading={<ScreenIcon />}
                className={cn(rowSize, "aria-pressed:border-fg aria-pressed:bg-fg aria-pressed:text-bg aria-pressed:hover:bg-fg")}>
                <span className="max-sm:sr-only">Share screen</span>
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onEnd} leading={<XIcon width={14} height={14} />}
              className={cn(rowSize, "ml-auto border-danger-line text-danger-fg hover:border-danger hover:bg-danger-soft")}>
              End
            </Button>
          </div>
          {showKeyHints && (onMutedChange || onInterrupt || ptt) && (
            <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-small leading-4 text-fg-muted pointer-coarse:hidden">
              {ptt && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><Kbd>Space</Kbd> hold to talk</span>}
              {onMutedChange && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><Kbd>M</Kbd> mute</span>}
              {onInterrupt && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><Kbd>Esc</Kbd> interrupt</span>}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** The original name. Same component: every VoicePanel prop still works. */
export const VoicePanel = VoiceSession;
```

## tattva/organisms/VoicePicker.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "../lib/cn";
import { Skeleton } from "../atoms/Skeleton";
import { VoiceCard, useSimulatedSamples, type VoiceConsent, type VoicePreview, type VoiceSource, type VoiceStatus } from "../molecules/VoiceCard";

export interface VoiceOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Used for the filter chips as well as shown on the card. */
  tags?: string[];
  source: VoiceSource;
  owner?: string;
  consent?: VoiceConsent;
  status?: VoiceStatus;
  /** Written-out date from your code, for example "3 March 2027". */
  withdrawsOn?: string;
  lockedReason?: string;
  /** Sample length in seconds, for the built-in stand-in player. */
  sampleSeconds?: number;
  /** Makes the stand-in sample fail, to show the error state. */
  sampleFails?: boolean;
}

export interface VoicePickerProps {
  voices: VoiceOption[];
  /** Id of the chosen voice. */
  value?: string;
  onChange: (id: string) => void;
  /** Name of the group, shown above the list. */
  label?: string;
  hideLabel?: boolean;
  /** Shows filter chips built from the voices' tags. */
  filters?: boolean;
  /** Placeholder rows while the voices load. */
  loading?: boolean;
  /** One column (the default), or two columns from 640px wide. Always one column on a phone. */
  layout?: "list" | "grid";
  /**
   * Your own player. Return the preview for a voice. Leave out to use the stand-in player, which simulates a sample
   * with a timer. Either way only one sample plays at a time: when one starts, stop the others.
   */
  previewFor?: (voice: VoiceOption) => VoicePreview;
  /** Text when there are no voices at all. */
  emptyText?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * A radio group of VoiceCards with optional tag filters. Each card has its own sample button, and starting one sample
 * stops any other. Choosing a voice never plays it, and nothing plays by itself.
 */
export function VoicePicker({
  voices, value, onChange, label = "Voice", hideLabel, filters = false, loading = false, layout = "list",
  previewFor, emptyText = "No voices yet.", className,
}: VoicePickerProps) {
  const labelId = useId();
  const group = useId();
  const sim = useSimulatedSamples();
  const [tag, setTag] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const tags = useMemo(() => Array.from(new Set(voices.flatMap((v) => v.tags ?? []))), [voices]);
  const shown = tag ? voices.filter((v) => v.tags?.includes(tag)) : voices;

  // A sample for a voice the filter just hid would keep playing out of sight, so stop it.
  const { id: playingId, stop } = sim;
  useEffect(() => { if (playingId && !shown.some((v) => v.id === playingId)) stop(); }, [playingId, shown, stop]);

  const preview = (v: VoiceOption) => previewFor ? previewFor(v) : sim.previewFor(v.id, { seconds: v.sampleSeconds ?? 8, fails: v.sampleFails });

  const chip = (t: string | null, text: string) => {
    const on = tag === t;
    return (
      <li key={text}>
        <button type="button" aria-pressed={on} onClick={() => setTag(t)}
          className={cn("tap inline-flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-control border px-3 text-compact transition-colors duration-(--dur-fast)",
            on ? "border-fg bg-fg text-bg" : "border-line bg-surface text-fg-muted hover:border-line-strong hover:text-fg")}>
          {text}
        </button>
      </li>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("min-w-0", className)}>
      <p id={labelId} className={cn("mb-2 text-body leading-5 font-medium text-fg", hideLabel && "sr-only")}>{label}</p>

      {filters && tags.length > 0 && !loading && (
        <ul aria-label={`Filter ${label.toLowerCase()} by tag`} className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {chip(null, "All")}
          {tags.map((t) => chip(t, t))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {loading ? (
        <div aria-busy="true" aria-labelledby={labelId} className="space-y-2">
          <span role="status" className="sr-only">Loading voices</span>
          {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => <Skeleton key={i} className="h-20 w-full rounded-card" />)}
        </div>
      ) : voices.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-line px-4 py-6 text-center text-compact text-fg-muted">{emptyText}</p>
      ) : shown.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-line px-4 py-6 text-center text-compact text-fg-muted">
          <p>No voices tagged {tag}.</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setTag(null)} className="tap mt-1 cursor-pointer text-fg underline underline-offset-2">Show all voices</button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby={labelId}
          className={cn("grid gap-2", layout === "grid" && "sm:grid-cols-2")}>
          {shown.map((v) => (
            <VoiceCard key={v.id} groupName={group} name={v.name} description={v.description} tags={v.tags} source={v.source}
              owner={v.owner} consent={v.consent} status={v.status} withdrawsOn={v.withdrawsOn} lockedReason={v.lockedReason}
              selected={v.id === value} onSelect={() => onChange(v.id)} preview={preview(v)} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {filters && !loading && voices.length > 0 && (
        <p role="status" className="sr-only">{tag ? `${shown.length} ${shown.length === 1 ? "voice" : "voices"} tagged ${tag}` : ""}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## tattva/organisms/genui/catalog.ts

```ts
import { createElement as h, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Badge } from "../../atoms/Badge";
import { Button } from "../../atoms/Button";
import { Callout } from "../../molecules/Callout";
import { ConfidenceIndicator } from "../../molecules/ConfidenceIndicator";
import { EmptyState } from "../../molecules/EmptyState";
import { StatTile } from "../../molecules/StatTile";
import { DataTable } from "../../molecules/DataTable";
import type { Source } from "../../molecules/SourceCard";
import { BarChart } from "../BarChart";
import { Checklist } from "../Checklist";
import { LineChart } from "../LineChart";
import { ParameterPanel, type ParameterSpec, type ParameterValues } from "../ParameterPanel";
import { PlanCard } from "../PlanCard";
import { SourceList } from "../SourceList";
import { SummaryCard } from "../SummaryCard";
import { VariantGrid } from "../VariantGrid";

/**
 * The allowlist. A model may only ask for the parts listed here, with the props listed here.
 * Everything else is dropped or shown as a quiet fallback. The host owns styling: no part accepts classes or styles.
 */

export type PropType = "string" | "number" | "boolean" | "enum" | "array" | "object";

export interface PropDescriptor {
  name: string;
  type: PropType;
  required?: boolean;
  /** Allowed values when type is "enum". */
  enumValues?: string[];
  description: string;
  /** For arrays and objects: the shape of the contents, written for the model. */
  shape?: string;
}

export type GenUIActionType = "press" | "submit" | "select" | "change";

export interface RenderContext {
  nodeId: string;
  /** True while the host is still handling an action from this node. Controls should be disabled. */
  pending: boolean;
  /** The last action from this node that went out, so a part can show that it was used. */
  sent?: { type: GenUIActionType; value: unknown };
  /** Report something the person did. The renderer decides whether to ask for confirmation first. */
  act: (type: GenUIActionType, value: unknown) => void;
}

export interface CatalogEntry {
  type: string;
  description: string;
  whenToUse: string;
  props: PropDescriptor[];
  canHaveChildren: boolean;
  interactive: boolean;
  /** Props that must be present and not empty, because a person using a screen reader needs them. */
  accessibilityRequires: string[];
  render: (props: Record<string, unknown>, children: ReactNode[], ctx: RenderContext) => ReactNode;
}

/** Props the renderer handles itself on interactive parts. */
export const COMMON_INTERACTIVE_PROPS: PropDescriptor[] = [
  { name: "confirm", type: "boolean", description: "Set to true when pressing this does something that is hard to undo, such as sending, buying or deleting. The person is asked to confirm first." },
  { name: "consequence", type: "string", description: "One plain sentence saying what will happen if the person confirms, for example \"This emails 12 customers.\"" },
];

/** Names that are never accepted anywhere in a node's props. The host owns styling, scripts and handlers. */
const FORBIDDEN = new Set(["classname", "class", "style", "styles", "dangerouslysetinnerhtml", "innerhtml", "css", "sx", "srcdoc", "src", "href"]);
const isForbiddenName = (k: string) => FORBIDDEN.has(k.toLowerCase()) || /^on[A-Z]/.test(k);

/* ---------- small readers, so render never trusts a value ---------- */

const isRec = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => typeof v === "object" && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
const str = (v: unknown, d = ""): string => (typeof v === "string" ? v : typeof v === "number" ? String(v) : d);
const optStr = (v: unknown): string | undefined => (typeof v === "string" && v ? v : undefined);
const num = (v: unknown, d = 0): number => (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : d);
const arr = (v: unknown): unknown[] => (Array.isArray(v) ? v : []);
const recs = (v: unknown): Record<string, unknown>[] => arr(v).filter(isRec);
const oneOf = <T extends string>(v: unknown, allowed: readonly T[], d: T): T => (allowed.includes(v as T) ? (v as T) : d);

/** Only web addresses are kept. Anything else (javascript:, data:, file:) is dropped. */
export function safeHttpUrl(v: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof v !== "string") return null;
  try {
    const u = new URL(v);
    return u.protocol === "https:" || u.protocol === "http:" ? u.href : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function toSources(v: unknown): Source[] {
  const out: Source[] = [];
  recs(v).forEach((s, i) => {
    const url = safeHttpUrl(s.url);
    if (!url) return;
    out.push({ id: i + 1, title: str(s.title, new URL(url).hostname), url, domain: str(s.domain, new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, "")), snippet: optStr(s.snippet) });
  });
  return out;
}

const tones = ["info", "success", "warning", "danger"] as const;
const badgeTones = ["neutral", "accent", "lime", "success", "warning", "danger", "info"] as const;

/* ---------- small stateful wrappers (the model never sees these) ---------- */

function ParametersNode({ props, ctx }: { props: Record<string, unknown>; ctx: RenderContext }) {
  const kinds = ["segmented", "aspect", "presets", "number", "seed"];
  const parameters = recs(props.parameters)
    .filter((p) => typeof p.id === "string" && typeof p.label === "string" && kinds.includes(str(p.kind)))
    .map((p) => ({ ...p, options: recs(p.options).map((o) => ({ value: str(o.value), label: str(o.label, str(o.value)) })) })) as unknown as ParameterSpec[];
  const [values, setValues] = useState<ParameterValues>(() => {
    const init: ParameterValues = {};
    for (const p of recs(props.parameters)) {
      if (typeof p.id !== "string") continue;
      const d = p.default;
      init[p.id] = typeof d === "string" || typeof d === "number" || typeof d === "boolean" ? d : p.kind === "number" ? num(p.min, 0) : recs(p.options)[0] ? str(recs(p.options)[0].value) : null;
    }
    return init;
  });
  return h(ParameterPanel, { parameters, values, onChange: setValues, onGenerate: (v) => ctx.act("submit", v), title: str(props.title, "Settings"), generateLabel: str(props.submitLabel, "Apply"), busy: ctx.pending });
}

function VariantsNode({ props, ctx }: { props: Record<string, unknown>; ctx: RenderContext }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const variants = recs(props.variants).filter((v) => typeof v.id === "string").map((v) => ({
    id: str(v.id), label: str(v.label, str(v.id)),
    node: h("span", { className: "flex size-full items-center justify-center p-3 text-center text-body leading-5 text-fg" }, str(v.text, str(v.label))),
  }));
  return h("div", { className: "space-y-2" },
    optStr(props.title) ? h("p", { className: "text-body leading-5 font-medium" }, str(props.title)) : null,
    h(VariantGrid, { variants, selectedId: selected, onSelect: (id: string) => { setSelected(id); ctx.act("select", id); } }));
}

function PlanNode({ props, ctx }: { props: Record<string, unknown>; ctx: RenderContext }) {
  const steps = recs(props.steps).map((s, i) => ({ id: str(s.id, String(i + 1)), title: str(s.title), description: optStr(s.description) }));
  const sent = ctx.sent?.value;
  const state = sent === "approve" ? "approved" : sent === "revise" ? "revised" : "awaiting";
  return h(PlanCard, { title: str(props.title, "Plan"), steps, estimate: optStr(props.estimate), state, onApprove: () => ctx.act("press", "approve"), onRevise: () => ctx.act("press", "revise"), readOnlyLabel: null });
}

/* ---------- the catalog ---------- */

export const catalog: CatalogEntry[] = [
  {
    type: "Group",
    description: "A container that lays its children out in a column or a grid.",
    whenToUse: "Use it to put several parts together under an optional heading. Keep it to one level of nesting.",
    props: [
      { name: "title", type: "string", description: "Optional heading above the group." },
      { name: "layout", type: "enum", enumValues: ["stack", "grid"], description: "stack puts children in one column. grid puts them side by side when there is room. Default stack." },
    ],
    canHaveChildren: true, interactive: false, accessibilityRequires: [],
    render: (p, children) => h("section", { "aria-label": optStr(p.title), className: "space-y-3" },
      optStr(p.title) ? h("h3", { className: "text-lead leading-6" }, str(p.title)) : null,
      h("div", { className: p.layout === "grid" ? "grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 [&>*]:min-w-0" : "space-y-3 [&>*]:min-w-0" }, ...children)),
  },
  {
    type: "Text",
    description: "A short paragraph of plain text.",
    whenToUse: "Use it for a sentence or two of explanation. Do not use it for long answers; reply in text instead.",
    props: [
      { name: "text", type: "string", required: true, description: "The words to show. Plain text only." },
      { name: "tone", type: "enum", enumValues: ["normal", "muted"], description: "muted is for small side notes. Default normal." },
    ],
    canHaveChildren: false, interactive: false, accessibilityRequires: ["text"],
    render: (p) => h("p", { className: p.tone === "muted" ? "text-body leading-5 text-fg-muted" : "text-body leading-5 text-fg" }, str(p.text)),
  },
  {
    type: "Callout",
    description: "A highlighted note with a short title and a sentence of detail.",
    whenToUse: "Use it for one thing the person should notice: a result, a warning or a tip. Only use warning when a person has to act.",
    props: [
      { name: "tone", type: "enum", enumValues: [...tones], description: "info, success, warning or danger. Default info." },
      { name: "title", type: "string", description: "Short heading." },
      { name: "text", type: "string", required: true, description: "The note itself." },
    ],
    canHaveChildren: false, interactive: false, accessibilityRequires: ["text"],
    render: (p) => h(Callout, { tone: oneOf(p.tone, tones, "info"), title: optStr(p.title) }, str(p.text)),
  },
  {
    type: "StatTile",
    description: "One headline number with a label and an optional change.",
    whenToUse: "Use it for the two to four numbers that answer the question, such as orders this week. Put them in a grid Group.",
    props: [
      { name: "label", type: "string", required: true, description: "What the number measures, in sentence case." },
      { name: "value", type: "string", required: true, description: "The number, already formatted, for example \"1,240\" or \"$4.2K\"." },
      { name: "delta", type: "object", description: "Change since before.", shape: "{ text: string (for example \"+4.2%\"), direction: \"up\" | \"down\" | \"flat\", versus?: string }" },
      { name: "goodDirection", type: "enum", enumValues: ["up", "down", "neutral"], description: "Which way counts as better. Default up." },
      { name: "detail", type: "string", description: "A small line under the number." },
    ],
    canHaveChildren: false, interactive: false, accessibilityRequires: ["label", "value"],
    render: (p) => {

      return h(StatTile, { label: str(p.label), value: str(p.value), delta: d, goodDirection: oneOf(p.goodDirection, ["up", "down", "neutral"] as const, "up"), detail: optStr(p.detail) });
```
